tei:titleStmt.tei:title: pod 1 dgon gong ma'i lo rgyus 'pho 'gyur rang yul srol

tei:div.tei:p: ༷/de ༷ baX ༷ rgyuX ༷༷ ༷ ༷༷ rngo ༷ ༷ ༷༷ / 0/

dkar chag(1) pha/bam snyeyirjeshas lagleng pa (/)dang po/ bod yulagyisnad bcud/ / (/)ga pa/ bod mi'i byu rabs mngo tsam gleb pa / (6)gsu4/ mdo da batshul 4 ba nga pa/ (151tshor+ṣab/ lha mkha ba phyog 4 ༅gsasubyungab da rgangs sa sa (2 )dang po/ reb gongasnyi'i gnas (0 )gnyes pa/ dgon gong ma rab go btsan ༄su gyi 4 gyal ko'u sde na da 4/ / (28)༄ spyo ba/dgon cama'i྾byu ra rir ྾ ma /(36)dang po/ mes po dag la brgyud pa'i ngag sgyun/ / (36)gnyis pa/ dgonashang ma dang reb gong bar gyi 'brel ba/ /1

(39)gsum pa/ dgon gong ma gle khog nas 'ba' lung du spor ba'i rgyu rkyen/ / (39)bzhi ba/ dgon gong ma dus skabs nam zhig la da lta'i sdod gnas 'dir spor ba dang sa bzung tshul dzi ltar yin pa/ /(42)lnga ba/ dgon gong ma reb gong dang 'azel lam chad pa'i rgyu rkyen gtso bo/ / (44)le'u bzhi ba/dgon gongama'i cho rteng bshi za bye zagatu bshad pa/ / (46)dang po dpa' mchog bshad pa/ / (46)gnyis pa/ o'u rgya bshad pa/ / (93)gsum pa/ nya nag bshad pa/ / (136)bzhi ba/ g.yer skyong bshad pa/ / (155)lnga ba/ gser lag mtha' ba (174)drug pa/ dgon gong ma'i nywa nag tsho phyed mtsho sngon po rkang tshar song tshul bshad pa/ / (175)bdun pa/ zhing chen 'tsho 'debs 'dzugs ra ba na yod pa'i yo'u rgya'i ru skor 'ga'i gnas tshul/ /(179)2

le'u lnga ba/dgon gong ma'i cho ba'izig gzhi/ / (181)dang po/ tsho ba'i sgrig ga / / (181)gnyis pa/ tsho sde'i dpon po'i rim pa/ / (190)gsum pa/ 'chang pe hu'i dbang cha/ / (195)le'u drug pa/dgon gongasa'ithal srol dang dmangasakhrod dadamos/ /(200)dang po/ skye rga na 'chi'i yulasrol/ / (202)gnyis pa/ 'gro 'dug 'chag gsum gyi yul srol/ / (221)gsum pa/ dmangs khrod dad mos/ / (225)bzhi ba/ dgon gong ma'i chos lugs dad mos kyi gnas tshul/ / (239)me'u bdun ba/dgon gongama'i dgon sde dngashā ba'i lo sa/ / (245)dang po/ gser lag dgon dge ldan phun tshogs bstan rgyas gling gi lo rgyus/ /(245)gnyis pa/ dkar mo phug dge ldan bkra shis chos 'khor gling gi lo rgyus/ /(319)gsum pa/ o'u rgya sngags mang gi gdan rabs/ /(369)bzhi ba/ mkhan slas dgon sogs kyi 3

gnas tshul rags bsdus/ /(392)lnga ba/ dgon gong ma'i tsho ba so so'i spyi ba/ /(400)drug pa/ pha yul dgon gong ma yin pa'i bla chen 'ga'i lo rgyus mdor bsdus/ / (407)le'u brgyad pa/dgon gongamar mangs ga 'i bcos bsgyurabus tshun gyi gnas chul/ /(416)dang po/ chab srid dang dpal 'byor thad kyi 'pho 'gyur/ / (/16)gnyis pa/ lo gsum ring gi god chag skor/ /(420)gsum pa/ lo rabs drug cu par legs sgrig byas rjes kyi 'phel rgyas skor/ (427)bzhi ba/ rig gnas gsar ba chen po'i lo bcu'i ring gi gnas tshul/ / (430)lnga ba/ bcos bsgyur sgo 'byed byas tshun gyi gnas tshul/ / (441)le'u dgu ba/dgon gongam mi grags can dag gi lo sa dor bsdus/ / (448)zur bkod dang po/ dgon gong mar byas rjes yod pa'i mi grags can/ / (4 8)zur bkod gnyis pa/ pha yul dgon gong ma yin pa'i 'go khrid

las byed pa dang ched las mkhas pa/ / (490)zur bkod gsum pa/ da lta'i dgon gong ma'i zhang krang gzhon pa yan chad kyi las byed pa'i gnas tshul sna tshogs mtshon pa'i bya ra/ /(522)zur bkod bzhi ba/ nyis stong lo'i dgon gong ma'i gnas tshul mdor bsdus/ /(529)zur bkod lnga pa/ gser sdong mchod rten rdo rje lhun po'i dkar chag/ (531)mjugabyungad (560)mdun sha 'dra par/ dgon gong ma'i skyes ri ma gyes gle 'phyor/rgyab gog 'dra par/ gser lag dgon phun tshogs bstan rgyas gling /mdun shog phyang phyag bris gnangaca na/ rgyal yongs srid gros kyi kru'u zhi gagon pa nga phod ngag dbang 'jig med/5

mchod bajod/brtan g.yo'i dngos kun rang bzhin nam mkha'i mtha'/ /mkhyed dpyod gshog 'gyur gcig gis nyer bgrod cing / /dug gsum brang 'gro za la snying khams can/ /'dren mchog mkha' lding dbang por snying nas 'dud/ /shes rab glog gi ral gri stong dkrigs pas/ rmongs ba'i mun pa mdud par mkhregs pa'i dpung / /dge legs me tog gzhon nur 'dzum pa'i dpyid/ /skal bzang zag med glu ru len des skyongs/ mdzes sdug sgeg mo stong gi 'gyur bag legs byas 'dod lhas gcig tu bsdus bzhin yi gar rab 'jo mtshan dpe'i sku/ /rab snyan glu dang brtse ba'i spyan dkyus dge la rab g.yo chos rnams rang bzhin pad mo'i sbubs rgya lhug par 'dzum/ /ji ltar snying rtse bsnyen pa de ltar brtse ba'i 'od kyi zhags pas mun tshogs ma lus rab tu sreg pa khyod/ /bdag snying 'phyo ba'i rgya mtsho'i klong du 'ja' tshon bye ba'i 'od dang 'grogs te zab rgyas de nyid glu ru longs/ /rgyal kun thugs rje'i 'o mtsho 'phyur las dkar gsal lang tsho'i dkyil 'khor rdzogs/ /bsil ljongs — dpal gyi 'dzum dkar rgod la 'od snang stong gi gur khang mdzes/ /'gro gun mnyes gshin me tog gzhon nu zhi bde bdud rtsi'i klong 'dzum pas/ /mi 'dod sdug bsngal smag rum stug po ma lus skad cig gzhom par mdzod/ /rang gi rigs la zhen pa dkar po'i gshis/ /g.yung drung ris su bkra ba'i lhag bsam can/ /mkhyen ldan dag gis skul ba'i lha rdzas ni/ /kho bor thob pa gus pas 1

dang du blangs/ /mes po dam pa'i mdzad rjes gsal byed du/ /dngos don byung rabs tshon gyis mdangs phyung ste/ rnam daphyod pir gyis bris pa'i ri mo ni/ /mkhas pa'i gzigs mor phul 'di skal ba bzang / /'di ni grags 'dod dbyug pas rnga la min/ /rgyus med gang bsam bshad pa'i tho co min/ /'on te bden pa brdar na dpyad tshugs pa'i/ /sngon byung gsal byed rigs pa'i me long zhig /zhes sho lo ka 'gas sngon bsus nas da ni bod chol kha gsum zhes su grags pa'i ya rgyal mdo smad rta'i chol kha'i gras kyi mang 'bal bya gsum zhes pa'i 'bal gyi sar gnas pa'i mi sde chen po dgon gong ma'i lo rgyus 'chad par byed/

le'u dang po/bod+dhi tram̐X ༷ hrī t+t+waṃ dro dzhai di sdi 'i dang po/ bodayul rgya snod bcud/ /bka' gdams glegs bam las shar rdo rje gdan gyi byang phyogs na/ /gnas srur rgyal bod ces bya ba yod/ / ces pa dang rgya'i thang yig tu da lta rgya'i mnga' chab tu gtogs pa'i sa cha rnams kyi bdag po ni thang yin/nub kyi sa cha'i bdag po ni thu stod yin / 3 ces pa ltar gna' snga mo zhig nas/bod mi rang gis bon nam bod ces bar 'bod pa'i yul gru 'di ni/ mi yi grangs 'bor dang stobs 'byor mnga' thang shes rig dar rgyas gang gi cha nas yang grags pa dkar bo'i ba dan srid rtse na g.yo ba'i rgya dkar nag gi yul thu gnyes la lho dang shar nas 'brel zhing / nub byang dang shar lho sogs kyi phyogs mtshams nas tor dang / li yul/ bru sha kasmir/ bal bo/mya dkar nag sogs la thug pa/ de min stag gzig dang / u rgyan/gam sto dza/ 'bar ma sogs kyi yul rnams la'ang khad mi ring bar gnas/rang cag gi mes po rnams kyis rang gi pha yul 'di la dzigangs ri mthon po'i ni dbus/ chu bo chen po'i ni mgo/ yul mtho sa gtsang / zhes pa dang /ba'i(ni / nasgodi dādī snyi/sgo rdo gnyi kyi ra 'i ga ga 'i bod na 1

ri mthon po gnam gyi ka ba yod/ mtsho dma' mo g.yu yi maskol yod ces lta bu sogs rna ba bdud rtsi'i bang mdzod du sgrub pa'i snyan tshig bsngags brjod kyi mchod tshogs mang por bkram yod pa ji bzhin du sngongs 'di'i khor yug gi bar skabs rnams su 'od dkar cha shas kyi lang tsho mngon par rdzogs pa'i zla gzhon stong phrag du ma lan brgyar nying khur bzhus pa'i khu bas bran pa dang gnyis su ma mchis pa'i gangs kyi ri bo shel dkar gyi mchod rten 'dra ba mang pos bskor zhing / stod mnga' ris su gangs ri'i rgyan gcig ti se dang /mdo smad du gangs ri'i dmag dpon rma chen sbom ra dang / mdo stod du gangs ri'i dmag dpon gnyan chen thang lha dang / dbus su gangs ri'i rgyal bo 'o de gung rgyal sogs bod kyi lha srung mthu rtsal chen po gangs gnyan brgyad du grags pa yod la/ ma pham g.yu mtsho dang / yar 'brog g.yu mtsho/byang gnam mtsho phyug mo/ mtsho khri shor rgyal mo sogs mtsho dang mtshokhu lteng ka chig stong lnga brgya lhag bod yul stod smad bar gsum du khyab nas yod/ der ma zad ye she ya'i chu bo chen po phal mo che'i 'byung khungs yang rang re'i bod yul 'dir yod de/ lho phyogs su rgya gar sogs kyi yul grur 'bab pa'i stod kyi kha 'bab gtsang po bzhi dang / bar gyi yar klung gtsang po dang rdza chu sogs yod la/ smad nas rgya nag gi yul gru mang po brgyud nas shar phyogs zhi bde rgya mtshor 'bab pa la'ang rma chu dang 'bri chus gtsos ba'i chu sna khri stong mang po yod/gangs can bod kyi yul 'di ches gna' dus su dma' zhing drod gsher 'dzoms la/ gang sa kun tu nags tshal stug pos g.yogs shing / klung rnams su sngo bsang nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor nyi ma gagon nus bzhus pa lha bu'i chu rgyun gyis ma lus bar gang ste gnas pas sa la bcud kyis sgyug par grags/deng dus kyi tshan rig zhib 'jug pa dag gis rtog zhib bgyis pa'i 'bras bur yang ri bo dag gi ngos su rgya mtsho'i nang gi srog chags sna tshogs kyi 'gyur rdo 2

mang po rnyed pa sogs tshan rig gi rgyu mtshan mang po la brten nas gangs can bod kyi yul 'dir mi'i 'gro ba ma byung ba'i sngon gyi bskal ba shin tu ring po'i dus la yul thams cad chus gang nas yod par bzhed la/ rang re'i lo rgyus deb zer du yang yul 'der ri lung chags nas mi'i 'gro ba ma chags pa'i sngon du/ ri lung thams cad chus gang nas yod par bshad/ ces grags la/dus nam zhig na chu bri tshul yang skong chu lag kha bye nas chu thams cad der song ste / skong chu lag tu thim zhes 'khod pa dang / chu 'khyil sa'i yol go rnams kyi kha shor te chu rnams rgya mtshor bzhur ba'i shul du rim gyis rtsi shing nags tshal rgyas shing lung gzhung rnams su gtsang po che chung sna tshogs 'bab tshul yang sngon gyi lo rgyus su ri rnams ni shing nags su song / klung rnams ni chus khengs zhes byung pa las gsal por rtogs / /yul 'di'i chags dbyibs ni nub mtho zhing shar dma' bas sngar gyis mkhas pa rnams kyis stod kyi mnga' ris skor gsum dzing gi tshul/ / bar du dbugagatsang ru bzhi yur ba 'dra/ / smad du mdo khams sgang drug zhing lta bu/ / zhes gsungs/ /rang cag kha ba can gyi gzhis chags sa 'di yul gru gzhan dang bsdur nasabalta sa na khyad par can gyi gnas tshul mang po yod pa ni 'di lta ste/ lho nub rgyud kyi ri bo jo mo glang ma de mtsho ngos las smi brgyad stong brgyad brgya bzhi bcu lhag gi 'phags yod pas 'dzam gling gi ri rtse ches mtho shos yin pa dang /mdo dbus mtho sgang 'di cha snyoms byas na mtsho ngos las smi bzhi stong lnga brgya mtho ba dang spyi'i rgya khyon la spyi le gru bzhi ma sa ya gnyis dang sum stong lhag yod pas 'dzam gling nas ches mtho ba'i mtho sgang yin/ drod grang dang rang byung cha rkyen gzhan dag gi cha nas mi yul ga na dag las ches cher zhan pas 'khyag rom gyis bzung pa'i sa'i go la'i lho sde dang byang sde dpe mtshon du byed/ lo stong gcig lhag sngon gyi rgya'i mkhas pas bod kyi gnas tshul bris pa zhig la'ang 3

rgyun par thog sdir/ glog 'khyug rlung g.yug ser 'bab/ sa cha gangs kyis bzung / dbyar gzhung ni krung go'i dpyid dus 'dra/ ri lung ni rtse r+sha ༵༵ r+shardo sgyu/ ༵ rdodu mas/rgya /ral mabhe1 dī/sa kyadī la / / ṭ+wāṃ/ /༈ rdo /'dzam bu'i gling la/ yul grangs chen po lnga'am/ dgu yod pa'i ngan shos yin zhes bshad/ 'di ltar yul gru gzhan gyi mi rnams kyis sngon nas da bar gangs ldongs 'di mi 'tsho gnas byed dka' sa zhig la ngos 'dzin mod/'on kyang / rang cag gi snga rabs pa rnams kyis bod ces bya ba khyad par 'phags pa'i yul/ / ri mtho sa gtsang gangs ri gnyan gyi mgul/ /bsil la mdzes pa lha gnas gzhal yas khang / / ngo mtshar rmad byung phan bde 'byung ba'i gnas/ / chu bo bzhi 'bab rtsi shing nags kyis mdzes/ /'thu sna lnga 'khrungs rin chen sna tshogs 'byung / / rkang bzhi kun khyab rtsi thog mar la spyod/ / zhes dang / ri la shing sna tshang / / sa gzhi yangs pa la/ / 'bru sna lnga yi tshogs/ / go mtshams med par skyes/ /gser dngul zangs lcags sogs/ / rin chen du ma yod/ / dga' skyid de ltar yod/ / e ma ngo mtshar che/ / zhes bcos ma ma yin pa'i tshig gis bstod bsngags byas pa las/ sa gnas gzhan la 'gram chu ldang ba dang / rang gi yul la ngan smos sam 'khang ra ye mi byed pa red/ de yang yin pa ni gnas 'di ni 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi gdul zhing dam pa yin pas mtho ris kyi lam sna zin sa yin par yid ches pa dang / gzhan du na gangs ri dang rdza ri/ nags ri dang spangs ri/ gtsang po dang chu klung /mtsho dang mtshe'u/ thang leb mo/ gshong dma' mo sogs gang sa kun nas dpa' bo dang mkha' 'aka ka klu dang gnyan chen/ yul lha dang gzhi bdagale'u lha dang mgur lha mthu bo che rnams rtag tu mgon skyabs dang dpung gnyen 0) nga gag ra sku sa das napo da rgo thangs na gas /4

dam par bkur yod pas/ shing rkang thur zhig bcad pa'am/ sa lag mthil tsam bslog gam/ chu gong bu gang brnyog pa gang yin kyang dpal mgon sdong grogs dag la ngan du 'gro ba'am ma gus pa yin par sems pas bla gnas snod bcud thams cad srung zhing skyob par byed do/ /deng dus tshan rig zhib rtog zhib bgyis pa'i 'bras bu la bod mi rigs gzhis chags sa'i mdo dbus mtho sgang 'de'i khor yug gi gnam gshis snyom min gyis thad gar e she ya dang de las kyang rgya che ba'i 'jig rten sa sgang hril bo'i gnam gshis 'gyur sdog la shugs rkyen chen po 'byung bzhin pa mthong snang du grub pa dang bstun nas/ yul 'di'i bdag pos sngo zhing g.ya' dag pa'i nam mkha' dang / gtsang zhing dwangs pa'i chu rgyun/ ljang zhing sdum pa'i rtswa thang dang nags tshal sogs dri ma ma gos pa'i 'tsho gnas shig de gi du bar srung skyob byas yod pa 'dir rjes su yi rang byed pa dang chabs cigagal srid kha ba can pa zhes khor yug la byams shing 'dod chung chog shes yin pa'i mi rigs 'di 'dra zhig gis brlag sla zhing gso dka' ba'i yul gnyan sa 'dir bdag srung byas med pa yin na mi'i rigs kyi pha khyim la gnod pa dzi lta bu 'byung ba mi shes zhes bshad mkhan yang 'byung mus yin/ de yang yin te/dus thung lo bcu phrag gi ring 'di la'ang mi rnams kyis dngos po'i nyer spyad rgya nom pa'i dpal yon bsam te/ khor yug snod bcud srung skyob la dam lhod shor ba'i nyer len las 'dzam gling gi mi rigs chen po krung gas ma yum du bkur ba'i gser ldan rma klong ring mo'i 'o rgyun 'chad la nye zhing / rgya gar 'phags yul gyi yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa'i gago dug chur 'gyur skad pa red/ gnad 'gag gi skabs 'di la yul thu de dag gi mis chu bo gtsang po'i 'byung khungs dang ri bo gangs ri'i mtho sa 'dir srung skyob bla lhag bgyid dgos pa'i gal che'i rang bzhin kha brgya lce stong gis smra bzhin pa lags na/'byung 'gyur dngos po'i dpal yon je dar du gtong ba dang khor yug srung 5

skyob kyi 'brel ba thag gcod bzang po byed rgyu ni rang re'i dus yun ring bo zhig gi 'os 'gan la 'khums/ /gnyis pa/ podami'i byung rabasamado tsam gleng ba/ /bod yul 'dir mi'i 'gro ba ji ltar byung tshul la sngon gyi lo rgyus smra ba rnams kyis lta ba mi 'dra ba sna tshogs gleng yod la/ de dag 'dor dril na spre'u brag srin las 'phel ba dang / rgya gar shākya'i rgyal rgyud las mched pa/'jang gi rigs las byung ba bcas red/ dang po la 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi rnam sprul spre'u byang chub sems dpa' dang 'phags ma sgrol ma'i sgrul ba brag srin mo gnyis 'dus pa las ngang rgyud mi 'dra ba'i spre'u drug byung la de dag gi rigs rgyud rim bzhin 'phel nas bod kyi mi'u rigs drug se rmu ldong stong dbra 'dru rnams byung par bshad pa dang / gnyis par shākya ri brag pa'i rgyal rgyud rgyal bo skya seng zhes pa'i bu chung ba gcig gangs can gyi phyogs su bros pa las bod kyi mi rgyud dar bar bshad pa/ gsum pa ni rgya'i thang yig gi bshad tshul ste thu stod ni nub 'jang gi rus su gtogs la/ der yang rigs brgya dang lnga bcu mchis/ rma chu dang / tsongaklecu/ 'bri chu/rgyal mo dngul chu'i 'bab yul du bkrams te gnas ① zhes 'khod yod pa ltar red/ de dag nang gi spre'u brag srin gyi rgyud las bod rang sa nas bod mi 'phel ba ni mkhas pa phal mo ches gtsig chen byed pa'i lta ba zhig yin la/lta tshul gzhan rnams kyang 'gog par mi byed de/ rgyu mtshan ni bod mi rigs byung 'phel gyi lo rgyus chu rgyun ring mo'i khrod mi rigs gzhan dang gzhan la 'brel ba rgyun ma chad par byung pas shākya'i mi rgyud dang 'jang gi mi rgyud de min mi rgyud gzhan pa dag kyang 'dres yod nges pa ni 'dzam gling spyi'i mi rigs byung 'phel gyi gnas tshul las shes thub/ /sngon chad zhib 'jug pa la las bod 'di sa dpangs mthon po dang ( 3 /ga thog gra sa na gas /6

gnam gshis grang mo yin pas mi rgyud mched khungs shig yin mi srid ces bshad myong kyang / tshan rig rtog zhib mkhan gyis bod kyi sa gnas nas rdo chas gsar rnying dang de las kyang snga ba'i dus skabs kyi mi'i gna' shul rnyed pa las bod yul 'di mi rgyud 'phel sa zhig yin pa bden dpangs byas/ /lo rgyus deb ther dag tu dang po bod yul 'dir gnod sbyin/ bdud srin/ klu btsan/ ma sangs spun dgu/ za ram skyes drug la sogs mi ma yin bcu yis dbang bsgyur bar bshad kyang don dam du de dag ni yul gru 'dir 'tsho ba rol myong pa'i gdod ma'i tsho ba dag yin de/ kho tsho phan tshun gyi bar la 'phrog rtsod kyi dmag 'khrugs rgyun mi 'chad par 'byung gin yod stabs/ mthar mchims dang / zhang zhung / myang ro phyed ga gnubs yul gling dgu/ nyang ro sham po/ kyi ri ljang sngon/ ngam shod khra sna/'ol phu spang mkhar/ sribs yul ral gong / kong 5kha bre sna/ nyang yul rnam gsum/ dwags yul gru bzhi bcas rgyal phran bcu gnyis byung par ོgrags shing / de dag gi bar la'ang rgyal phran de rnams 'thab rtsod gsod gcod dga'/ / legs nyes mi rtsi bkyon 'bab btson rar 'dzud/ / ces pa ltar phan tshun dbang 'og la sdud pa'i 'thab rtsod yun ring byas te bde ba'i go skabs gtan nas ma byung / /skabs der yul yar klung gi phyogs su bod ka g.yag drug gam nya drug tu 'bod pa'i mi sde gzhan las stobs dang shes rig ldan pa zhig yod pa de'i btsan pa lho dang gnyags/ btsun pa khyung dang snubs/ gnyan pa se dang sbo ste yab 'bangs rus drug dang lha bo lhams/ se bon rma bon/ cog la bon/ zhang zhung bon/ tshe mi bon sogs shes pa can bcu gnyis kyis gakhyo' khri btsan po rje la bkur pa nas bzung da gzod bod kyi rgyal rabs kyi mgo tshugs/ de la dbon zhang 'dum pa'i rdo ring du ༄ / 'phrul rgya lha btsan po 'o lde sru rgyal/ / yul byung sa dod tshun cad 'ung nas thu'i rjer/ /7

bod kyi rgyal po chen po mdzad pa yang / / gangs ṛ mthon po'i ni dbus/chu bo chen po'i ni mgo/ yul mtho sa gtsang ba la gnam rgya lha las/ /byu'i rgyal por gshegs te/ / gtsug lag chen pos ni yund kyi srid/debatsugs/ / chos khrims bzang pos rna tshul gnang / / byams pa'i bka' dṛn gyis ni nang gi tshis sbyard/ / dgra thabs mkhas nas/ /phyi'i dgra btul te/ / chab srid ni thur zheng che dbu rmog ni slar zhing phyong brtsan pa(yang nam)nam zhar(zhar)kyi 'gyur/ / byin byu nyams pa'i g.yang drung rgyal po chen po ni che ①zhes pa ltar/ 'o lde spu rgyal te gnya' khri btsan po steng ma lha nas gangs can gyi sngongs 'dir mi'i rjer byon pa nas pho brang gi thog ma yum bu bla gang brtsigs pas yul byung par mdzad pa dang /yul yar klung gi phyogs cha bzung pa las sa dod de/ yun du brtan pa'i srid kyi gtsug chen po btsugs/ 'dzig rten mi chos dang mthun pa'i khrims srol gyis yul mi rnams tshul bzhin bskyangs/ byams pa'i bka' drin gyis skye bo kun bde ba'i lam la bkod/ dgra 'dul ba'i thabs la mkhas pas phas rgol tshar bcad de mnga' khongs rgya chen por bskyed/ stobs dang mnga' thang che ba 'gran pa'i zla dang bral/ mtshan snyan grags g.yung drung gi tshul du gyur pa ni rgyal po chen po de yin par bshad/ skabs der gnya' khri btsan pos bod ka g.yag drug gi rje bo mdzad pa las bod khams spyi la da dung dbang bsgyur thub med de/ phyis su khong gi gdung rgyud du byung pa'i gnam la khri bdun/ stod kyi steng gnyis/ bar du legs drug sa la lde brgyad/'og gi btsan gsum sogs rgyal rabs mang po zhig gi ring la rus rgyud tsho ba dag rim bzhin dbang 'og tu sdud thub pa byung / gnya' khri btsan po sbyi lo'i sngon gyi bgrang bya127lor bod ka g.yag drug gi rje bo mdzad pa'i lo rgyus bzhed bya sgo gagra 51 nad sa pa gi 1 ra na bya pa'i da kyi rdo ring ge da dri bras 8

tshul gyi dbang du byas na lcags mo bya ste spyi lo 841par dar ma 'u dum btsan gyi skabs bod sil bar 'thor bar gyi lo ngo968 gyi ring ni bod gcig sdud bya4pa'i dus skabs yin/ de yang lo rgyus yig rnying du gan yul yul na rgyal pran dang blon po 'di ltar bab ste/ / my-i mang gi rje/ yul che'i bdag byed byed pa las/ rgyal po btsan pa dang / blon po 'dzangs pa dku' bo che rnams kyis ga ga shes gachig brlag ste/ 'bangs su bkug na/ mtha' ma 'o lde spu rgyal rgya dbu rmog mtho ba/ mar (nar ) ni lha nar gyis nard/thun ni rje thun gyis bathun te bkug go / / zhes byung pa ltar dang thog bod yul 'dir rgyal phran sil ma mang pos rang rang gis sa khul re bcad bzung byas nas stobs shugs che bas chung ba dbang du bsdu ba'i 'thab rtsod yur ring byas rjes/ tha ma 'o lde spu rgyal ba'i rgyal rabs kyi do zla gzhan gyis ma yong bar dbang 'og tu shor tshul bshad/ tshul de'i lo rgyus gsal bo yin pa'i skor la yang rgyal rabs so gcig pa stag ri gnyan gzigs kyi ring la sum pa'i blon po myang tseng sku dang / dbas dbyi tshab/ mnon 'dron po/tshes po nag seng la sogs pas zing rje (sum pa'i rje bo )rgyab tu 'dor ba dang spu rgyal pang du len pa la 'chams te stag ri gnyan gzigs dang mnyam du zo bor bar brtsams pa na/ spu rje'i zhal nas rang gi sring mo gcig zing rje'i drung du yod pa yang blos btang ste de rnams dang bro bor/ 'on kyang / mi ring pa na stag ri gnyan gzigs dgung du gshegs pas don de 'grub ma thub/ /spyi lo 569 tsam la gnam ri srong btsan yab kyi khri la bzhugs nas zing bo'i yul khams sru rgyal pa'i 'og tu bsdu ba'i khur de bzhes nas/ nyid kyi gcung slon kol dang khong spun mched gnyis nas zing rje'i blon po sru rgyal ba'i ngor blta pa po myang rung sku dang / dbangs dbyi tshab/ dbangs mes snang /dba'aha pu tshab/ mnon 'dron po/ tshes pong nag seng dang bcas paha 3

zing rje rgyab tu dor nas spu rgyal pang du len pa la yang bskyar bro bor te/slon kol (gnam ri srong btsan gyi gcung )dang yug stong tsun gnyis 'phyong rgyas stag rtse ru bzhag cing / myang byung sku dang mnon 'dron po gnyis zing rje'i gnas tshul brtag pa'i bya ra bar mngags/ dba'as dbyi tshab dang tshes pong nag seng gnyis kyis lam sna drangs/ btsan po rang gis dmag chig khri lhag gi kha lo bsgyur te zing yul du dpung drangs mthar yul gru phal mo che spu rgyal ba'i mnga' 'og tu bcug de'i rjes sor khyung bo spungs sad zu rtse zer bas rtsang bod kyi rje bo mar mun gyi mgo bcad de gtsang khul gyi dud khyim nyis khri btsan po'i phyag tu phul/ seng go mi chen zer ba'i blon po zhig gis dpa' khas len sgos dmag dpung khrid nas dwags po thams cad spu rgyal ba'i mnga' 'og tu bsdus pa sogs te/ dbus gtsang phyogs su skabs der zhang zhung ma gtogs pa'i yul gzhan thams cad gcig tu bsgril nas bod chen po'i gcig gyur gyisred dbang 'dzugs par zang gzhi brtan po bsgun/ /zhang zhung ni hrag dmag khri tsho 'ga' yod pa'i tsho khag stobs ldan zhig yin te/ srong btsan sgam po nar son rjes zhang zhung dbang 'og tu bsdu ched khong gi sku sring ming la sad ma gar bya ba zhig yod pa de zhang zhung gi rje bo lig mi rgya la btsun mor byin te skog nas lig mi rgya'i chab srid kyi gnas tshul srong btsan la skad du sbran pas gnas tshul rtogs nas dmag drangs te yul rnams rgyag zengs gcig gis bcom/ /'a zha ni mdo smad kyi phyogs 'di na yod pa'i mi sde chen po zhig yin de rgyal bo stag ri gnyan gzigs kyi spyan gnyis long yod pa gso ched 'a zha'i yul nas sman pa gdan drangs par grags pa de ni 'a zha dang btsan po spu rgyal thog mar 'brel ba byung pa'i dus la nges/ spyi lo 633 sa sprul lor 'a zha thog mar bod kyi dbang 'og tu bsdus shing / chu phag ste spyi lo 663lor 'a zhas rgya'i ngo la bltas nas bod la ngo log byas par blon chen mgar stong btsan khros te hrag 10

dmag 'bum tsho gcig khrid nas 'a zha slar yang bod kyi dbang 'og tu bcugadang thog btsan po spu rgyal de yul yar klung gi phyogs tsam 'dzin pa'i rje bo chung chung zhig yin pa nas rim bzhin bod khams spyi la dbang bsgyur mkhan du gyur pa ni/ rje yi bka' btsan 'bangs rnams bde zhing skyid / / rgyal po'i chab srid dbyar gyi mtsho ltar 'phel/ / zhes pa ltar btsan po sku rabs brgyud kyis srid kyi skyong lugs gzhan las khyad du 'phags par rags las pa yin/ lhag par tu spyi lo 629lor srong btsan sgam po rgyal sar bzhugs rjes btsan po'i chab srid la sngar med 'gyur ldog byung / khong gis dang jog yab gnam ri srong btsan bgrong mkhan gyi dug las byed mkhan rnams tshar bcad de nang khul bde 'jags su btang zhing / de nas gnyen zhang zhung / mdzo sum pa/ dwags po/ kong po/ myang po sogs spu rgyal la 'bral bar sems pa rnams slar yang chab 'og tu bsdus/ yang dgos su btsan po 'di ba'i ring la mdzangs blon thon mis gtso mdzad pa'i mkhas pa rnams kyis yi ge gsar tu baspun te/ rje blon 'bangs mi kun gyis yi ge bslabs shing rig pa'i gnas la legs par sbyangs par brten/ bod ni snga gong yab mes kyi sku ring gang las kyang shes rig dang ldan pa zhig tu gyur cing / yi ge ste skad cha'i yo byad de la brten nas btsan po'i srid dbang je brtan je rgyas su gtong ched/ btsan po'i khab so'i srid dbang lam lugs dang blon po'i go gnas gtan la phab nas/ so sor bka' chen po la gtogs shing phyi nang gnyis la dbang ba'i chab srid kyi blon chen po dang / nang blon/ phyi blon/ dmag go chog gi blon po sogs bskos pa las gzhan/ blon che chung rnams la yang rim pa ltar g.yu dang / gser dang / phra men dang / dadul dang /rag dang / zangs bcas kyi thabs gnang ste de rnams kyi go rim gsal bor phyes/ de bzhin du 'bangs kyi rnam pa yang rgod dang / g.yung dang /bran sogs su bcad nas go rim gsal bor byes/ rgyal yongs kyi mnga' 11

'bangs spyi yang dbu ru/ g.yas ru/ g.yon ru/ ru lag sum pa'i ru bcas ru chen lnga ru bsgos te/ de rnams kyi pho skyes rta gong zub pa dag g.yul gyi dus su dmag dang zhi ba'i dus su 'bangs yin pa dang / dmag gi las la zhugs pa'i dus pha rol bo'i bdog pa ci tsam 'phrog pa de rang la thob pa las logs su phogs ster rgyu med par bkas bcad pa dang chabs gcigasngar yab mes sku gong ma rnams kyi ring la dbu sgung bro bor ba'i rgyal phran dang rgyal phran bar dang / rje bo dang blon po'i bar/ rje blon dang 'bangs mi'i bar 'brel ba 'dzugs pa'am de dam du gtong ba'i lugs srol rnying ba'i dod du/ mdzangs dang dpa' bo la bya dga'/ sdar ma dang nyes can la chad pa/rgas dang pha ma la bkur ste/ nyam chung dang byis pa la snying rje sogs kyi khrims kyi rnam grangs so drug sogs btsugs te/ btsan po ma gtogs pa'i bod kyi rje 'bangs kun rgyal khrims gser gyi gnya' shing gcig gis mnan/de min sems can gyi kha grangs dang sa zhing gi che chung thad kyang rtsis gsal bor brgyab ste phyugs khral dang phyugs ril la sogs pa btsan por lo thang bla skyes 'bul ba'i lam lugs gtan la phab par ma zad/ tha na bre dang srang la sogs pa 'jal byed kyi lugs kyang gsar tu btod nas sngar tha gur mdud pa brgyab nas tho 'god pa'i ches rjes su lus pa'i srol ni mjug rdzogs so/ /de ltar srong btsan sgam po'i skabs su srid 'dzin dang dmag don lam lugs cha tshang ba zhig gtan phab byas stabs/ bod kyi stobs 'byor mnga' thang gong nas gong du 'phel ba'i mgo brtsams shing / lha sras gung ri gung btsan gyi skabs te spyi lo 670 lcags rta la/ bod dmag khri phrag li yul du drangs te chig tshi dang / yan jis/ byu'u li/ yis den bcas sde khag chen po bzhi blangs te rgya'i dar zab 'grul lam bcad pa dang / spyi lo 676me byi ste btsan po mang srong mang btsan gyi skabs su/ bod dmag gis rgya'i mkhar sha jo dang / ko jo/ phan jo rnams 'phrog nas mnga' khongs rgya 12

bskyed/ 'das srong mang po rje rlung nam 'phrul gyi rgyal pos srid skyong ring shar phyogs mya dkar nag gi yu la du dmag drangs de mya dkar po'i rje bo gag la 'ong bod la mgo 'dzul bas btsan pos gcung gi thabs bstsal/ skabs 'dir bod kyis mtha' bzhir mnga' khongs rgya bskyed pa'i dmag 'khrug yang yang byas pa'i nang rngog ring la nag po dang / rngog gling gam/ gnod rgyal mtshan/ dbas sgod ldongs btsan/ 'gos g.yag chung / cog ro 'brong shor/ gnon khri bdun g.yu sbyin bcas rtsal bo che bdun nam dmag dpon dpa' rtsal can mi bdun yang byung par grags/ de ltar btsan po khri srong lde'u btsan gyi sku che'i stod tsam la skebs dus/ shar nas lung hran la rgyud yan chad (da lta'i hran zhi dang gan su'i sa mtshams )dang / byang nas li yul gyi lho phyogs (da lta'i zhin cang gi then hran ri bo'i lho phyogs kyi sa khul mang che shos )/ nub nas stag gzig gi shar mtha'/ lho nas rgya gar chu bo guna'i 'gram rgyud sogs la dmag drangs nas sa bzung pas/ bod kyi —ma 'a khongs rgya che ba'i rtser son te btsan po khri srong lde btsan la 'dzam gling rgyal bo khri srong lde'u btsan zhes pa'i mtshan snyan thogs/ der ma zad khong gi sku ring la rgya gar nas snga rjes su mkhan po bo ci su to dang slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas sogs nang ba'i mkhas pa gdan drangs te/ dam pa'i chos lugs spel ba dang bsam yas gtsug lag khang bzhengs te bod la rab byung gi sde thog mar btsugs pa des lo rgyus kyi dus rabs gsar ba zhig gi mgo brtsams/ de nas bzung rab byung grwa btsun par srid kyi go gnas mthon po ster ba'i mgo yang tshugs pa dang / snga gzhug tu ban de chen po myang ting nge 'dzin bzang po dang bran kha dpal gyi yon tan sogs kyis bka' chen po la gtogs te byu nang gnyis la dbang zhing chab srid 'dzin pa'i blon chen khur/rgyal bo khri srong lde'u btsan gyis sangs rgyas chos lugs la rgyab skyor byed pa'i srid jus de mu ne+e btsan po dang khri lde srong btsan sad na legs mjing yon 13

rnam gnyis kyi dus su'ang mu 'thud nas rgyun 'khyongs byas shing gong du spel/skabs der lo tsā ba ska cog zhang gsum sogs kyis rgya gar gyi cho4gzhung mang po bod yig la bsgyur ba des bod du sangs rgyas chos lugs dar spel byed par cha rkyen bla med baspun/ chos gzhung bsgyur yig gi ming tshig gcig gyur dang bsgyur ba rnams bod kyi skad cha'i lugs srol dang mthun ched/ skad gsar bcad thengs dang po byas pa ni bod kyi rig gnas 'phel ba'i lo rgyus thog gi las don gal 'gangs che ba zhig red/ rgyal bo khri ral ba can gyis rgyal srid skyong ring rab byung grwa btsun rer 'bangs mi khyim bdun re sprad pa dang / grwa bar mig ngan bltas na mig 'don pa/ mdzub brda byas na mdzub mo gcod pa/ kha ngan bshad na mchu to 'breg pa/ lha khang dang grwa ba'i rgyu nor brkus na de'i ldab brgyad bcu tshab 'jal du bcug pa sogs byas pa'i rkyen gyis/blon po chos la mi dga' ba dang / bon chos la dad mkhan mang po zhig gi blor ma bab par btsan por ngan sgros mang po byas pa dang / phyis su blon po sbas stag sna dang / cog ro lha lod/ legs sdug btsan gsum gyis rgyal bo khri ral ba can gyis 'bras chang 'thung ste bzi nas yod skabs ske gcus te bkrongs thog glang dar ma 'u dam btsan la srid dbang 'dzin du bcug cing / sbas stag snas blon po byas te/ sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi rab byung par drag gnon ya nga ba dang / chos dpe rnams mer bsregs chur sgyur byas/rgyal bo glang dar rang nyid kyang dgung lo zhe bzhi ba me stag spyi lo 846lor lha sa gtsug lag khang gi mdun ngos su yod pa'i rdo ring gi yi ge bklag nas bsdad yod pa'i go skabs dang bstun nas lha lung dpal gyi rdo rjes rgyal bo la phyag 'tshal ba'i khul gyis mda' 'phangs te bsad/ rgyal bo glang dar bsad pa'i phyi lo der bu 'od srung dang / yum brtan gnyis 'khrungs rjes srid dbang 'dzin rgyur ma 'chams par 'od srung phyogs khag gis g.yo ru dang /yum brtan phyogs khag gis dbus ru bzung ste de la che srid dang chung srid/1

mang tshan dang nyung tshan/ gser ba dang g.yu ba/ sha zan dang rtsam zan zer ba'i phyogs khag gnyis su gyes pa rnams phan tshun nang 'khrug byas shing /rgyal pham thag ma chod gong spyi lo 869lor/ bod yongs su lo rgyus thog gzhi rgya che shos kyi 'bangs gyen log byung ste/ thog mar dbas kho bzher legs steng gis 'go khrid byas pa'i mdo khams kyi gyen langs byung / de rjes dbu rur 'bro dang spas gnyis 'khrugs pa byas par brten nas dbas lo pho chung gis 'go khrid de gyen log byung / de nas sgo kha dang / dwags po/ kong po bcas su 'chims kong mi drug dang / shud pu stag rtse gnyags kyis 'go khrid de 'bangs gyen log byung pa bcas kyis rgyal po gnya' khri btsan po dang /srong btsan sgam po'i gdung rgyud nas bod hril bor dbang bsgyur byed pa'i dus rabs mjug sgril bar ma zad/ lo grangs brgya dang sum bcu so bdun ring sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi chos khrims dang / grwa chas spyon pa'i grwa ba mig gis mthong rgyu med pa zhig tu gyur/ /gsum pa/ mdo spadakyi mi sde dar tshul cung zad gleng pa/ /(gcig) yam zhes pa'i ming gi 'grel chul/ /mdo smad sogs kyi ming 'dogs lugs la mkhas dbang dge 'dun chos 'phel gyi deb zer dkar por/ khams dang a mdo bsdoms pa'i shar phyogs kyi yul byings la khams zhes grags shing / khams ni sa mtha' la byas pa ste/ mtha'i rgyal phran la khams zhes 'bod pa lta bu'o/ / a mdo bya ba ni mdo bya ba'i tshig 'de'i sngon 'jug dag par klog pa'i dbang gis ya sgra zhig rang bzhin gyis byung pa tsam yin la/ a mdo'i yul spyi la snga mo'i dus na btsong kha bde khams su grags shing / de la yang da lta'i zi ling phyogs kyi yul gru 'di la btsong kha dang / de'i lhag ma'i yul la btsong kha chen por 15

'bod ()ces gsungs/ btsong kha che chung dang mdo smad ces pa ni bod btsan po'i skabs nas ming du grags yod mod/ a mdo zhes pa'i ming 'di ni ha lam bstan pa phyi dar gyi sngon la med pa 'dra/ a mdo la gong gi dge chos lags kyi 'grel tshul de las gzhan da dung mdo smad chos 'byung du'abri chu se bo'i lung ring brgal ba'i ba yan ha ri'i shar ngos a chen gangs rgyab kyi ri dang / mdo la (da skabs chi len ri bo zhes pa de mdo la yin par bshad mkhan yang yod )gnyis kyi ming bsdoms pas de man chad la ya mdo zer/ de ngos kyi chu rnams phyogs 'dres kyis rma g.yang byug mo'i gzhung du 'bab pa la rma chur grags pa mtsho so lo ma'am skya rengs kyi gzhung ba da lho phyogs su 'khyogs pa'i khug so man chad a mdo nyid la ngos 'dzin dgos pa ni / chol kha gsum du phye tshe ma 'a ris gung thang nas sog la skya bo yan chad dbus gtsang chos kyi chol kha/ de nas rma chu'i khug pa yan chad mdo stod mi'i chol kha/ de nas rgya'i mchod rten (da skabs gan su'u zhing chen yun cin rdzong na yod pa'i lig ca zha chu mdzod kyi nang du nub zin )dkar po yan chad mdo smad rta'i chol kha byed par shes so/ ②zhes gsungs yod pa ni da skabs kun gyis tshad mar 'dzin no/ /sngon chad tsong kha che chung ngam bod chol kha gsum gyi ya gyal mdo smad rta'i chol kha/ a mdo sogs su grags pa'i yul 'di'i da lta'i gnas tshul ltar bshad na/ phal cher mtsho sngon zhing chen gyi yul shul ma the ba'i mtsho lho dang /mtsho nub/ mtsho byang / rma lho bcas rang skyong khul bzhi dang / shar phyogs zhing las sa khul/ gan su'u zhing chen gyi gan lho rang skyong khul dang /dpa' ris rang skyong rdzong / zi khron zhing chen gyi ja ba rang skyong khul bcas ༷/ sadh+ri na/tsu /'u mi shā / na ༷ mo 8 rngo / ༷dī / / ༷༵ mardo rad da na // / 16

kyi sa khul yongs rdzogs 'du/ /(gnyis) lo rgyas deb ther thog bkod ba'i gna' rabs ma mdo'i gnasacol/ /de la rgya'i thang yig gsar rnying du han rgyal rabs kyi lo rgyus phyi ma 〉sogs deb ther gyi lta ba gzhir bzung nas bris par thu stod ni nub kyi chang gi rus su gtogs la/ der yang rigs brgya dang lnga bcu mchis/ rma chu dang tsong chu/ 'bri chu/ rgyal mo dngul chu'i 'bab yu la du bkram te gnas/de la'ang sto 'jang dang thang mo sogs mchis te/ mes por spur rgyal du 'bod cing / dpa' zhing mdzangs la 'jang ba kha shas bsdu rub kyis der gzhi btsugs stod dang sto sgra 'dra phyir de'i rjes rabs la thu stod du grags shing / rus ni spur rgyal du bya/ gzhan yang / nan leng thu h+pha li li ku'u yang zer/ de la sras gnyis byung ba 'phan rtsi dang ru than du grags/ ru than gyi da pa che spro kri phan bya bas bsdubs/ 'phan kyi gnyen 'khor dang bcas te che chu mang sung la gtad pa dang lin sung gis the hrig bya ba'i cho lo sbyar/ mang sung bkrongs nas 'phan myi gnyen 'khor dang bcas pa nub phyogs su bros/ rma chu brgal/ ri bo ci hri hran brgyud nas 'jang ba rnams 'bangs su bcug skad 0 ces 'khod yod la/ rgya'i mi rabs snga ma dpa' zha (shad )mi rigs kyis kho tsho'i nub phyogs su yod pa'i mi sde thams cad la 'jang ngam chang (za)zhes pa'i ming du 'bod cing / de la rigs mang po yod par bshad/ dpa' zha ni ha lam spyi lo'i sngon gyi dus rabs 22 gyi mjug nas spyi lo'i sngon gyi dus rabs 17pa'i bar da lta'i hran zhi dang / ho nan/ ho pe/ hran tung sogs kyi sa khul na yod de/ hrang dang / kro'u/chin sogs rgyal rabs kyi skabs brgyud nas han rgyal rabs kyi dus su glebs dbalha sa/na ni ma na dgyin gyi ba 'i sa gamar 'i da chen ba 17

dus dpa' zha'i ming han (ma)zhes par 'gyur/ rgya'i deb ther tu dpa' zha (rtsa )dang chang (za)gnyis la 'brel 'dris shin tu che tshul bshad yod la/ kho tsho'i bar 'brel ba 'byung sa'i sa khul ni rma chu dang tsong chu'i 'bab yul gtsor byas pa'i ma mdo'i yul phyogs 'di yin/ da lta chang (bye )zhes par 'bod pa'i yi ge 'di'i gzugs 'grel la mi zhig gis lug cig ded 'gro bar bshad la/ de ltar na (tsho)ni phyugs las gtso bor gnyer ba'i gna' rabs kyi 'brog sde dag yin pa gdon mi za/ de la rigs mang po yod par bshad pa ni/ gcig gi dbang 'og tu gcig mi 'du ba'i 'brog sde dag yin la/ gnya' khri btsan po'i yar sngon bod yul du rgyal phran sil ma bcu gnyis nas bzhi bcu yod par bshad pa'i gras su 'du'am snyam/ de nas phyis su spyi lo'i dus rabs gnyis pa nas bzhi ba'i skabs su li'o nyin shar phyogs su sdod pa'i zhan pās (pa sgo )zhes pa'i mi rigs des sog po'i rtswa thang brgal te ya mdo'i phyogs 'dir slebs te gdod ma nas yod pa'i 'brog sde rnams dang mnyam du gzhi bzung / spyo lo'i dus rabs bzhi ba'i mjug tsar la mi sde de'i rje bo thu'u h+pha bu'u ku'u yis ya mdo'i yul 'di nas li' lho ma'i rgyal khab btsugs/ dang thog gro tshang nas rgyal sa bzung ste/ rje bo'i ming la nub bde rgyal por btags/ spyi lo 399lor nub bde rgyal po —gshegs nas gcung byu'u t+pa lis lu'u ku'u (zatshotshe/chom)yis rgyal srid bskyangs shing rgyal sa zi ling du spos/ spyi lo 402lor thu'u t+pa lis lu'u ku'u gshegs rjes khong gi gcung thu'u h+pha ru'u than (chotsho )gyis rgyal srid bskyangs shing khos skabs dang bstun nas sgo tshang (da lta'i gan su'u lu'u be rgyud du yod )dmag gis blangs nas de ru rgyal sa spos/ skabs der li'ang lho ma'i sa cha la shar lan kro'u nas nub mtsho sngon po'i bar dang / lho rma chu nas byang rma nub 'grul lam bar bzung yod/ spyi lo 414lor thu'u t+pa ru'u than chin lho ma'i rgyal khab la 'go 'dzul de/ li'ang lho ma'i rgyal khab rtsa thor 18

du gyur/ phyis su yang li'o nyin shar rgyud nas zhan pas kyi rje bo mu'u rung ( tshi)bya ba mtsho sngon du spos te rgyal srid bskyangs pa ni bod kyi gna' rabs yig rnying nas mang du 'byung pa'i 'a zha (tha tsho)zhes pa de yin/'a zhas bzung ba'i sa ni gan sung (da lta'i gan su'u men shan gyi lho phyogs )gi lho dang / 'brug chu'i nub/ ba yan ha ri'i ri rgyud kyi byang phyogs kyi sa khul rnams yin pas phal cher a mdo yongs rdzogs de'i khongs su 'du/ 'a zha'i rgyal sa thog mar da lta'i mang ra'i bye ma yod sa 'dir byas pa dang rjes su mtsho sngon po'i 'gram gyi 'theb brgya la spos par grags/ 'a zhas mdo smad kyi gdod ma'i 'brog sde dag la dbang bsgyur nas rgyal khab stobs ldan du gyur na'ang / spyi lo'i dus rabs bdun pa'i skabs su rgyal po srong btsan sgam po'i blon po mgar stong btsan yul bzung gis dmag drangs te bod kyi chab 'og tu bsdus/ spyi lo'i dus rabs bdun pa nas dgu ba'i bar la 'a zha ba phal mo che bod kyi tsho sde rnal mar gyur bas/ rang cag mdo smad pa'i mi rabs snga ma'i nang du bgrang chog pa red/ 'a zha ba bod kyi 'bangs rnal mar bkug mkhan gyi byas rjes chen po ni blon po mgar stong btsan pha bu rnams la mnga' ste/ spyi lo 659 lug lo nas 666stag lo bar blon po mgar rang nyid sku ngo ma mdo smad 'dir phebs nas 'a zha ba dbang du bsdu ba dang sa mtshams bsrung ba'i khur bsnams/ de'i phyis su khong gi bu 'bring ba khri 'bring btsan brod kyis dmag spyi chen po byas te spyi lo 698 khyi'i lo bar bzhugs/ blon po mgar pa bus mi lo lnga bcu lhag la bod kyi dmag don dang chab srid kyi dbang cha bzung ba dang / lhag par tu rgyal bo srong btsan sgam po sku grongs rjes sras gong srong dang tsha bo mang srong gnyis sku tshe ma ring stabs/ don chen rnams khong pha bus dbang thag gcod bzhin pa des btsan po'i chab srid la thad gar phog thug gtong gi yod par dgongs nas/ btsan po khri 'dus srong gis blon po blo nye ba gzhan dag dang gsang gros byas te/ skabs der lha 19

sa na yod pa'i blon po mgar gyi khyim mi dang nye bo nyis stong lhag dmar gsod btang pa dang / de nas btsan po khri 'dus srong khong gis ri dwags bshor bar ljags g.yar nas dmag daphung khrid de mdo smad 'dir phebs nas blon po khri 'bring gi dmag sgar glo bar tu bskor ba na/ khri 'bring gis rang srog rang gis bcad pa dang dmag mi gzhan rnams la rje bo med pas de mur kha thor tu gyur/ des na mdo smad 'dir blon po mgar gyi mi rgyud yin zer mkhan mang bar gnas lugs chen po yod de/ lo ngo lnga bcur nye ba'i ring mgar gyi khyim rgyud kyis mdo smad 'dir dbang bsgyur skabs bu rabs tsha rgyud rnams yong yod par ma zad/ dbus gtsang nas khong tshang gi nye du dang sde tsho gcig pa'i mi mang po yang lag rogs dang dmag mir yong yod pa red/ khri 'bring gi don rkyen de byung rjes de dag thams cad phyir dbus gtsang du ma song bar mdo smad 'di'i mi rgyud sngon ma'i nang gses su gyur/ de la mdo smad 'der mgar sras sam mgar rtse dang / blon che/ blon po gser chen—(mgar khri 'bring gi ming yin par grags )sogs kyi ming gis 'bod pa'i mi sde dang bla ri sogs da lta'i bar ma nyams par yod pa dang / gzhan blon po mgar dang 'brel ba yod pa'i dmag bka'i long ba dang mtsho sngon po 'phyur pa'i dmangs khrod kyi ngag rgyun zhig kyang yod pa las/ blon po mgar gyi mi rgyud dang a mdo'i phyogs 'di'i 'brel ba zab tshul yang dag mtshon yod/blon po mgar tshang gis mdo smad la dbang bsgyur ba mjug sgril rjes/ bod dbus nas khu mang po rje lha zung dang / blon mang rtsan ldong zhi/ zhang khri bzang stag tsab/ blon stag sgra khong lod/ dbas khri gzigs zhang nyen/zhang rgya sto/ sta gu ri tsab/ zhang btsan to re lhas byin/ cog ro khri —gzigs gnang gong / dbon da rgyal/ blon chen khri gzigs/ blon khri sum rje rtsang bzher/ blon khri gzigs gnang khong / blon skyes bzang ldong tsab/ blon chen cung bzang / cog ro mang po rje khri chung / 'gos khri 20

bzang yab lhag zhang mdo bzher/ blon khri sgra/ blon khri bzang / zhang stong btsan/ blon mang rtsan 'phan gang / skyes bzang stag snang / blon snang bzher rtsang khong / blon khri sgra stag tsab/ zhang rgyal gzigs shu theng /blon stag sgra klu kong / zhang stong btsan/ zhang btsan pa/ blon zhang khri sum rje sreg lha/ blon rgyal khri mdo gzigs/ blon mchims zhang rgyal btsan bzher sogs blon po mang po mdo smad phyogs 'dir phebs nas rgya bod kyi sa mtshams bsrung pa dang / 'dun ma bsdu ba dpya gcod pa sogs la 'go khrid byas shing / spyi lo'i dus rabs bdun pa nas dgu ba'i bar bod kyis mnga' khong rgya bskyed pa'i dmag 'khrugs che chung dgu brgya lhag brgyab pa'i nang gi mang che ba mdo smad kyi phyogs 'di la 'khel bas/ skabs de shed du dbus gtsang mnga' ris sogs nas phyogs 'dir dmag mir yong ba shin tu mang ste/mkhas dbang dge 'dun chos 'phel gyis kyang ya mdo'i rigs de phal cher ni sngon gyi dmag mi phyogs der slebs pa dag las mched par mngon zhing /gna' dus kyi dbus gtsang gi rus rnying skyi dang nyang dang khyung po la sogs pa'i mi sde yang mang / 0 zhes gsungs/ mdo smad chos 'byung 〉 du hor gyi sgom grwa bcom skabs dmag nang nas skyen po btus pa'i dpa' bo mi dgu dmag dang bcas pa hor bod kyi mtshams (phal cher deng sang gi dpa' ris phyogs )su bzhag ste rgyal po'i bka' ma byung bar du ldog du med gsungs pas dpa' bo mi dgu'i rgyud pa la bka' ma log tu thogs shing / mdo smad lho byang gi mi rgyud phal cher bod chos rgyal gyis rgya bod so mtshams su bzhag pa las mched pa sha stag yin pas skad rigs la'ang brda rnying ma 'argyur pa mang /de bzhin du sa skya 'khon gyi gdung rgyud dang / sgra bsgyur mar ba lo tsā/dpal chen rga lo/ rngog chos sku rdo rje/ gtsang rgyal ba lo ras rnams kyi rgyud ① rakar na ga gra sa sa gam /21

pa yin zer ba 'ga' re deng sang yang ngos 'dzin sgyu snang 0 zhes kyang bkod yod/ gong gi gnas tshul dag la bltas na ya mdo'i mi rgyud kyi nang na chang (za)dang / 'a zha (lo khye )/ rgya sogs kyang yod mod kyang gtso bo dang mang che shos ni dbus nas yong ba'i dmag mi'i rgyud pa yin/ de yang 'byung rtsis bum bzang 〉du yang na mdo khams smad 'di ni/ / gdong ni sa khams sha ba bla/ / 'bru ni chu khams g.yag la bla/ / spu ni lcags khams rkyang la bla/ / sgo ni me khams ra la bla/ / sga ni shing khams lug la bla/ / rus pa gtsang mar ma shes na/ / de yang gdong la bsdu zhes zer/ / zhes bod kyi rtsa ba'i rus gdong sogs ya mdor yod tshul dang /gzhan yang ya mdo'i mi rnams kyis brda rnying ma 'gyur ba'i bod skad rnam dag bshad pa (sa khul mig gi mi rigasagangagi thu cha ma na de'i skad rig nyid da rigs gtso bor 'a ra pa gan rabs da di sang phyi rgyal da rgya nang gang nas rgya dpe mtshon 'am zub )de yang bden dpangs su 'khyer chog par ma zad/ deb dkar tu lhag par tu yang sngon gyi srol lugs ma 'gyur bar gnas pa ni (a mdo'i )'brog sde khag rnams yin zhing / khong rnams 'brog dud skor re mnyam du sdod pa la yang ru ba dang / sgar sa phan tshun spo ba la yang ru 'gro ba sogs kyi tha snyad byed de/ ru ni brda rnying la dmag gi ming yin zhing / dmag dpon la ru dpon dang / mdung la ru mtshon sogs kyi tha snyad ni da lta'i bar yod/sngon bod kyi dmag rnams sbra nag phub nas 'gro ba yang / thang yig tu/ gru gu yul gyi yong du man chad du/ bod kyi dmag dpung sbra nag phub nas ni/sogs gsungs kyizhes pa ltar dang da rung ya mdo'i 'brog sde dag du dar shing 'dzugs pa dang / rong sde dag nas dus chen gyi skabs su mda' rtsed byed pa sogs sngar gyi bod dmag gi srol da lta bar ma nyams par yod pas nyu de do da da ra 3 ga gra shāchi nidiḥ/nag /22

kyang mtshon thub/ gzhan yang rgya'i lo rgyus dag tu bod kyi btsan pos mdo smad la dbang bsgyur ba'i rjes kyi cha'ang dang 'a zha'i gnas tshul bkod pa las kyang mdo smad kyi mi rgyud gtso bo dbus gtsang nas yong ba cung zad rtogs thub ste/ bod kyi rgyal rgyud jo sras kyi lo rgyus 〉zhes par tang zhang ( matso bod kyi lo sa thog mi nyag rgya rgod ces 'bod la da lta 'ga' res gdong spyang zhes kyang bsgyur yod ) la thu sgod skabs su snyod kyi phyi sde bzhi zer/dus rabs brgyad pa'i mgor da lta'i mtsho sngon shar lho'i rgyud dang / zi khron sung 'phan gyi nub na yod pa'i tang zhang ba rnams nas thu stod kyi gnya' gnon ma theg par 'u thug nas gan su'u dang / nying 'a/ hran zhi yi byang phyogs bcas la gnas spor/ 0 zhes pa dang / bod dmag gis 'a zha 'phab skabs dpon rgyud rnams gan su'i li'ang krig (da lta'ims zhes pa de yin)phyogs la bros pa dang / 'bangs mi mang che ba ni da lta'i hor rigs ( nga)yin par bshad pa sogs ltar ro/ /rgyal po glang dar ma lha lung dpal rdor gyis bkrongs rjes kyi spyi lo 843lor dmag dpon khong lod zhes pa zhig gis btsan po bgrong par dgra sha len dgos par kha g.yar te/ sum pa dang 'a 'a zhang zhung gsum gyi dmag rnams bskul nas we kro'u (da lta'i gan su'u 'ing li'ang )la dpung 'jug byas te dmag dpon zhang si lo pham par byas pa dang / de nas yang kha phyir 'khor te hran kro'u (da lta'i lo tu'u )bsrung mkhan gyi dmag dpon zhang 'bro btsan bzher la dmag 'khrug chen po brgyab/ de'i rjes su mdo smad byang shar gyi sa ṭ+wāṃ/༵sna ༵byār+sha dī'i lha di swā phadipu dī nakhri ga dī/ jidī ༵ hāng snyashā~X 6byedī sdidī sne khong lod stod pa'i dpa' rgod ces pa zhig gis bsad rjes da gzod nang 'khrug rgyag mtshams bzhag yin na'ang lo mang ring gi phan tshun mnga' 'og ( ) zho gra 10 gam /23

la bsdu ba'i dmag 'khrug nang dmag dpon mang che ba 'khrug rkyen la zha ba dang / de bas kyang tshabs che ba ni bod kyi dmag don stobs shugs ni lhag lus med par rtsa med du gyur/ spyi lo 860 yas mas la kha thor ya bral du gyur ba'i bod kyi mtha' dmag khrod nas dbas kho bzher legs steng zer ba zhig gis ming la cho (bod mi ye min snyam/)zhes pa'i dmag khag cig gi 'go khrid nas dbus gtsang phyogs su song ba de la bod kyi lo rgyus thog mdo smad kyi 'bangs gyen log gi dmag zer/ kho bos bltas na dmag de'i dmigs yul ni gyen ldog byed pa kho na ma yin par/ gtso bo ni gcig nas lo mang por snying bo med pa'i nang 'khrugs brgyab par yid bsun pa dang /gnyis su phyi la bud nas lo mang po 'gor bas pha yul dran pa bcas kyi dbang gis 'go bcangs mkhan zhig yod ma thag de'i rjes la ded pa red snyam/ de min kho bos rmongs tshod kyis dpyad na de dus dbus gtsang la log mkhan gtso bo ni rgyal po khri ral dang glang dar gnyis kyi skabs thog der dmag la yong ba yin pa ma gtogs de'i sngon gyi rgyal rabs khag gi skabs su yong ba rnams ni mdo smad 'dir khyim gzhis chags nas dus tshod ring po song bas phyir song med snyam/ /bod kyi rgyal rabs rtsa thor tu gyur te dmag don gyi stobs shugs nyams dmas su song rjes kyi spyi lo 950 ba'i rjes su a mdo'i byang mtha'i dpa' ris phyogs su gzhung drug bod sde zhes sde khag chen po zhig yod de/ rgya'i lo rgyus su bod sde de la dud grangs nyis 'i lnga stong drug brgya go gsum dang mi grangs chig 'bum nyis stong chig brgya go gnyis yod par bshad/ snga phyir rje bo 'ga' phyon pa'i nang nas ches phul du byung pa ni 'phan blo gros bya ba de yin zhing / khos nang khul du chab srid dang / dmag don/ dpal 'byor dang rig gnas sogs dar rgyas su btang zhing / phyi phyogs su sung rgyal rabs la 'brel ba btsugs pa dang mi nyag gi stobs shugs lho phyogs la rgya 24

bskyed par 'gog rgol byas pas mnga' 'bangs nas brtsi bkur thob/ spyi lo 1004 la 'phan blo gros nyid mnga' 'og blo log pa zhig gis bkrongs rjes mi sde de nyams pa'i lam la song / /de'i rjes kyi spyi lo1032 la rgyal po glang dar ma'i bu 'od srung gi mi rabs lnga ba khri lde'i bu rgyal sras gyis tsong kha'i yul (da lta'i zi ling dang phing an/ lo tu'u bcas yod sa de )lte bar bzung nas srid dbang btsugs pa la lo rgyus thog rgyal sras tsho ba zer/ de'i mi rgyud dang dpon rgyud la stobs 'byor ma 'a thang shin tu che bas ha lam a mdo'i phyogs 'di yongs dzogs la dbang bsgyur/ rgya'i lo rgyus ltar na rgyal sras la bkra shis yul lung ( zas7)zhes pa'i spun mched cig kyang yod par bshad la/ des da skabs kyi mtsho lho dang rma lho gan lho sogs kyi sa khul bzung zhes bkod yod/ spyi lo1104lo'i zla bzhi pa'i nang sung gi dmag dpon bang nyig (za )dang thung kon ( )bya bas tsong kha'i yul la dmag chen drangs te rgyal sras kyi srid dbang brlags pa nas bzung / a mdo'i phyogs 'di nas gcig gyur gyi srid gzhung zhig 'dzugs rgyu phar gog spo tho 'dril gyin je chung zhes pa'i dpe ba'in du/ sde ba tsho ba'i bar nas lo bstud mar phan tshun 'phrog bcom dang rgyag res gsod res kho na byas nas dus 'da' bas/ tha mar sha nye ru skor rmang gzhi byas nas gcig tu sgril ba'i sde chung tsho chung mang por kha thor ba'i tshad la bskyal/ des 'bras bur1949 lo'i yar sngon bar bod kyi rong 'grog pa mang che ba'i nang du rang rang gi sha nye ru skor gyi 'du shes tsam las mi rigs spyi'i las don gyi 'du shes cung zad yang med pas/ ches rtsod gleng yod sa ni rang mi rigs kyi nang yin pa dang ches snying nad yod sa yang rang mi rigs kyi nang yin pas/ gna' dang ma bod spyi'i chab srid gar mdzad la rje 'bangs yod do cog gi blo sems gcig thog tu 'khor thub pa gleng tshe yid ches dka' bar 'dug25

rgyal sras srid dbang thor nas lo brgya lhag gi rjes gyi spyi lo 1227 lor jing gar rgyal po'i dmag dpung gis mi shi rta 'gyel mang po byed ma dgos par mdo smad kyi yul 'di yongs rdzogs 'dzin 'go brtsams pa dang / mtsho sngon lo rgyus yig rigs phyogs bsgrigs zhes pa las min krin te'i ( shā15 1506)skabs su/ sog pos mtsho sngon bzung pas bod kyi sa shor zhing mang che bas gnas spos pa dang gnas ma spos pa rnams rang tshugs ma thub par sog po'i dbang 'og tu tshud ces pa ltar/ mtsho sngon po'i mtha' skor gyi rtswa chu bzang sa na yod pa'i bod sde rams rma chu'i lho phyogs su ded de phyir yong mi phod par byas nas lo nyis brgya lhag 'gor/rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i chu yos (1723)lor gu ze han gyi tsha bo blo bzang bstan 'dzin gyis mes po'i btsan dbang gi las don slar gso byed ched mtsho sngon gyi sog po'i the ju rnams la 'go 'dzin byas te ching srid gzhung la ngo rgol byas pa na ma 'gyangs par ching gi dmag dpon chen mo nyan keng yo'i dmag dpung gis bcom nas sog pos mtsho sngon la dbang bsgyur byed pa'i mjug rdzogs/ sog po pham rjes ching srid gzhung gis bsrung bya mang po gtan la phab cing rma chu sa mtshams byas te bod sog la dbang bsgyur byas pa yin mod/ 'on kyang skabs der bod sog la khag bgos nas bdag skyong byed pa'isnye'i rtsa don de yun ring la sgyun 'khyongs byed par dam lhod shor bas/ bod sde rnams kyis phyir rang gnas bsnyegs par phyi rol gyi cha rkyen ldan/ /26

le'u gnyis pa/〈ṭ+wāṃ dī ༵trīdinirdo t+t+waṃdī ༵ zlo swā /ṭ+wāṃ/sa su dang po/ reb gong sbyi'i gnas tshul/ /sog pos mtsho sngon la dbang bsgyur te bod sde thams cad rma gro'i lho phyogs la ded pa'i rjes nas/ rab gong ni a mdo'i mtsho sngon phyogs kyi bod sde'i lte gnas lta bur gyur yod de/ da lta bltas na'ang mtsho sngon po'i mtha' 'khor gyi rkang tsha dang 'khyam ru/ 'azeb brgya/ a tshogs lha sde/ bang stag sogs sde chen brgyad dang / rta bo dme tshang / rong bo blon chos tsā rteng gsum/ dgon gong ma/ sha sbrang tsho drug mgar rtse gong zhol sogs mtsho sngon gyi 'brog sde phal cher reb gong nas ma chad pa med pas/ rong bo dgon chen gyi gdan rabs 〉las rjongs 'dir mi chos lha chos gang thad nas khyad par tu 'phags shing yul mdo smad kyi bstan pa dang rigs rus longs spyod sogs kyi rmang gzhi'am 'byung khungs su gyur zhes pa don dang mthun/ rab byung bzhi ba'i smad tsam la dpal ldan sa skya ba'i gdung rgyud du gyur ba'i lha rje brag sna ba chen po 'khor sum brgya dang bcas te mdo smad reb gong du phebs nas chos srid gnyis kyi bdag por bkur ba nas bzung /khang skya leb can gyi khri sde/ sbra rog po can gyi khri sde/ gur dkar po can gyi khri sde/ gtsang la stod nas chad pa'i lha bzo'i sde zhes pa'i mi sde mang du 'thel ba'i lo rgyas yod/ spyir reb gong la lha rje brag sna ba'i tsha bo mdo sde 27

'bum kyi skabs nas bzung 'phreng yar nang mar nang dang shog kha bcu gnyis kyi tha snyad yod par bshad la/ phyis su spyi dpon rong chen mdo sde 'bum gyi skabs su rong blon sog gsum/ bse rgya hor gsum/ 'jam rag rgya gsum/btsun ko'u gling gsum bcas shog kha bcu gnyis kyi ming gi dbye ba gsal zhing /thog kha dag gi sdod gnas kyi cha nas yang lung chen sum mdo rong gis bzung /spang ri nags ri blon gyis bzung / stod lung nyen lung sog pos bzung /de la rong blon sog gsum zer/ bse lung na gzhung hor gyis bzung /dgu chu'i nyin lung bse yis bzung / brag dmar nang log rgyal gyis bzung /de la bse rgyal hor gsum zer/ chu gnyis mdo la btsun mo chags/ lung chen gzhung la ko'u sde chags/ gser chu mdo la gling rgya chags/ de la btsun ko'u gling gsum zer/ lung chen mdo nas 'jam sogs bsdad/dgu chu'i 'gram nas ri stag bsdad/ lho ri'i ri na rgya stag bsdad/ de la 'jam rag rgya gsum zer zhes pa ltar sde tsho gtan chags byas yod pa red/dgon gong ma'i mi rabs snga ba rnams kyis sde ba reb gong shog kha'i nang nas chad pa'i 'brel bar bsam ste da lta'i sdod gnas la spor nas kyang lo mang rabs la rong bo dgon par mang 'gyed gtong ba sogs kyi 'gro 'ong rgyun ma bcad pa'i lo rgyus yo da/ /gnyis pa/ dgon gong ma rnab gong ba na sde gsum gyi ya gyal rka'u sde nas chad tshul/ /de yang bod kyi rus chen bse chung spu la dkar nag khra gsum gyi dbye ba yod pa'i gdung rgyud la khyung ru dkar po zhes bya ba zhig 'khrungs shing / de'i gdung rabs mang po song ba'i phyis su shel mig ko'u mthong bya ba stobs dang shes rab gzhan las khyad du 'phags pa zhig byung / de dang mdzangs pa'i yon tan ma tshang ba med pa'i ong bza' bde skyid mo gnyis bshos nas sras brgyad dang sras mo gcig byung / che ba sras mo lab sgron dbang mo dang /28

gnyis pa sras 'phyong rgyal tshe ring / gsum pa 'ong thar 'bum/ bzhi ba gces thar rgyal/ lnga ba dpal 'byor/ drug pa 'jigs med/ bdun pa dpal skyong / brgyad pa rdor lu/ dgu ba dbang byams thar bcas 'khrungs pa'i gdung rgyud la sde ba brgyad dang tsho ba dgu byung zhing / yab dam pa shel mig ko'u mthong dang yum yong bza' bde skyid mo gnyis kyi ming gi yi ge go ma gnyis bsdoms nas sde brgyad tsho dgu la ko'u bde zhes pa'i ming btags par bshad/ de yang shel mig ko'u mthong gi sras brgyad kyi nang gi che ba 'phyong rgyal tshe ring la sras bsod nams rgya mtsho dang / blo gros rgyal mtshan gnyis 'khrungs pa'i chung ba blo gros rgyal mtshan la rjes rabs ming sring gsum 'khrungs pa'i nang gi gu ru rgyal mtshan la sras mtsho skyes rdo rje dang / bka' rgyal/ rdo rje grol lo gsum 'khrungs/ rdo rje grol lo la sras mo gcig byung /ming la bstan 'dzin chos spel sgrol ma zer zhing mdzes shing lta na sdug pa zhig yin/ nyin zhig bu mo des dzi bo byed skabs gnyid log pa'i rmi lam la skyes bu zhal mdangs dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa/ dbu la dar tshon sna lnga'i la thod bcings pa/ sku la dmar 'od 'tsher ba'i gos phyi nang nyis rtsegs can gyon pa/ de'i steng du byu chen ljang ser 'ja' 'od can gyon pa/phyag g.yas na mdung mo rtse mor me stag khrem khrem du mched pa/ phyag g.yon na za ma tog lto yangs shing mgrin pa ring pa'i nang nas bdud rtsi 'phyur ba'in pa/zhabs gnyis la sag lham me ri'i pa hra 'od du 'tsher ba gyon pa/ seng ldeng gi rga bstad cing mgo la gser srab g.yu mthur bskon pa'i cang shes rta pho ngang ba'i mdog can la bcibs pa'i steng nas 'gying nyams dang ldan par thon nas bu mo 'dzin grabs mdzad par kho mo shin tu skrag ste byol bsam kyang ma thar bar ded nas bzung ba dang / yang de nas thag mi ring sa na gser dang dngul dang lcags kyis grub pa'i sgo mo che gsum bstar nas yod pa'i nang nas gser gyi sgo mo las mi ser rta ser bcibs pa zhig dang / dngul gyi sgo 29

mo las mi dkar rta dkar bcib pa/ lcags kyi sgo mo las mi nag rta nag can gsum thon pa la mi stobs po che des de dag la kho mo ni khyed cag gi ma yum red/ sri zhu dang sdong grogs la ma g.yel cig ces bsgos pa la skyes bu gsum pos lags so zhes rta las babs te gus phyag 'tshal zhing bu ser bo des gser rmog blangs te mo'i mgo la bskon pa mis rjes gnyid las sad/de nas yar langs te bltas tshe/ sa gzhi la smig dkar lang long du 'khrigs shing mkha' dbyings su rgod thang dkar gcig dang thang nag gsum gyis—'phur lding byed bzhin pa mthong bas/ mo'i bsam par rgod 'di bzhi ni mi lam gyi skya mi bzhi bo'i rnam sprul 'dra zhing / don dam du yul lha'i rgyal bo se ke bya khyung nyid dngos grub gnang du phebs pa red bsams pa dang / yang mgo la bskon pa'i gser rmog dran de reg pa na 'dabs ma lhug par grol ba'i me tog shis dar ser bo zhig skra nang la gseb 'dug de nas kho mos me tog de lha rdzas dkar po dri ma med pa zhig gis dkris nas sa de'i mar gsham du ri chung zur gsum rtse mo no ba mdun du chu mig lhung lhung du 'bab pa zhig yod pa de'i rtse ru gter la sbas/ byus su bu mo chos spel sgrol mas skya mis ded pa'i mi lam rmis sa der sgo mo skya bda' thang dang me tog shis dar gter la sba sa der rmog ser zhes ming btags par grags/ /rjes su bu mo chos spel sgrol ma la snga gzhug tu pha su yin nges bzung med pa'i bu gsum 'khrungs pa la che ba'i ming la gong lha stobs rgyal dang / 'bring ba'i ming la yul bzung lha btsan/ chung ba'i ming la 'og min chos 'dzin btags te mi'i gzugs lha yi rnam sprul du brjod do/ / phyis su de dag nar son rjes bu che ba gong lha stobs rgyal gyis hor rte'u tshang nas ming la bkra shis bde skyid bya ba'i chung ma zhig bsus te/ bu bdud 'dul khro rgyal dang /bsod nams stobs ldan/ rig 'dzin 'jigs med gsum dang bu mo lha mo dbyangs can dang bde skyid dbang mo gnyis 'khrungs shing / de dag la 30

rigs rgyud mang du 'phel ba la mes po gong lha sgo gong ma nas thon pa'i rmi lam mis pa'i rten 'brel du sgo gong ma tshang zhes tsho ming thogs shing / bu 'bring ba yul bzung lha btsun gyis blon chos nags bza' nas ming la 'brug mo skyid zer ba zhig chung mar bsus te rigs rgyud 'phel ba la mes po lha btsan sgo bar ma nam thon pa'i rmi lam ltar sgo bar ma tshang btags/ bu chung ba 'og min chos 'dzin gyis bse chu ma nas ming la zhang mo skyid zer ba zhig bsus nas mi rgyud 'phel ba la rmi lam ltar sgo zhol ma tshang thogs pa bcas su grags/phyis su sgo zhes pa de dgon du sgra 'gyur nas sde ming la dgon gong 'og bar gsum du 'bod do/ /de nas gong lha stobs rgyal la bu bu mo lnga skyes pa'i bu che ba bdud 'dul khro rgyal la bu gsum skyes ba'i 'bring ba nyi ma tshe ring la bu kun dga' dpal ldan dang / rig 'dzin nyi ma/ dgra lha rgyal/ dpal mgon bcas bu bzhi skyes/ /kun dga' dpal ldan la rdo je khro lu dang kun thar zhes pa'i bu gnyis skyes kyang kun thar chung dus nas 'das/ rdo rje khro lu la bu rgya mtsho dang 'jigs med grags pa zer ba gnyis skyes/ rgya mtsho lo bco brgyad kyi thog nas ya rig gi khyim tshang phyug po zhig la mag par song ste lo nyi shu rtsa 'ga'i thog nas chung ma khrid nas rang yul la log pas kho'i ming la a rig rgya mtsho yang zer skad/ 'dzigs med grags pa la bu gcig dang bu mo gnyis skyes pa sogs kyi rigs rgyud mang du 'phel nas dpa' mchog dang gle ba'i tsho ba grub/dpa' mchog thogs don ni mes po rgya mtsho dpa' rtsal 'gran zla dang bral te dpa' bo mchog tu gyur ba'i ming thogs pa las byung zhing / gle ba thogs don ni mes po 'jigs med grags pa gzugs thung zhing phyi tshul nas nyams chung du snang bas kho la 'jigs med glud pa ces pa'i mtshang ming lta bu zhig thogs/phyis su kho'i bu rabs tsha rgyud 'phel ba la glud pa tshang zer ba dang / de yang 31

rjes su glud pa de zur chag nas rim bzhin gle ba zhes par ming 'gyur/ dang thog gle ba dpa' mchog dang sde mgo so so yin kyang phyis su mnyam du 'dres nas dpa' mchog gle ba tshang zer/ de dus 'di rnams kyi gnas yul ni bya khyung ri'i g.yas phyogs kyi/ thang nag thang ser ni dgun sa dang / na gyu'i yan chad khya se/ ka se/ zla tshang nar ma phyugs mo/ ba dgu'i stod smad rnams yin/ /rgya mtsho la bu bzhi skyes pa'i nang gi rdo rje bkra shis la bu bsod lo dang ri lo/ tshogs gzungs gsum skyes kho tsho cher skyes rjes dpa' mchog gi sde phyed kyis rtswa sa bzang po snyog ched rang gi gnas sras ko'u sde nas nub phyogs su song ste dgon gong ma zhes pa'i sde ming bzung / /de nas lo gsum gyi rjes 'jigs med grags pa'i ri skor gle ba yang rang gi phu nu dgon gong ma dpa' mchog gi rjes su song ste gzhis chags/ /de yang mes po gong lha'i mi rabs gsum pa nyi ma tshe ring gi bu rig 'dzin nyi ma la bu kun bzang dbang chen skyes shing / kun bzang dbang chen la bu bu mo drug skyes pa'i chung ba gcod pa rgyal/ gcod pa rgyal la bu ut+pal rgyal mtshan/ kun dga'/ dpal lo/ bsam 'phel/ 'byung gnas/g.yang skyabs tshe ring / tshe 'bum bkra shis/ ban de rgyal/ snyeng dkar rgyal bcas gcod pa bu dgu zhes ko'u bde sde brgyad tsho dgu'i nang skad grags shin tu che ba zhig byung skad yod/ /gcod pa'i bu che ba yut+pal rgyal mtshan gyi lo rgyus gleng na/ kho ni chos phyogs la gtong sgo che zhing / sde dmangs la byams pa/ dpa' zhing brtul phod pa zhig yin pas sa reb gong phyogs su ming grags yod/ kho'i gdong na sma ra phag spu ltar nag zing nge yod pa dang / zhal ngo 'od mazing mthing byed pa chag yin pas kun gyis kho la 'od rgya btags/ rjes su 'od rgya de bo'u rgya'am o'u rgya zhes par tshig zur chag nas yut+pal rgyal mtshan gyi rjes rabs 32

pa'i sde ming la thogs/ mut+pal rgyal mtshan gyi tsha bor bla ma dbu dkar pa sogs skyes pa dang / rab byung bcu gcig pa'i chu phag (1683)lor rje ma ṇi bas rdzong dkar dgon pa 'debs skabs hor tsho bzhi dang / rte'u tshang /dgon gong ma'i dpa' mchog dang gle ba rnams sbyin bdag la yong skabs bla ma dbu dkar pa sogs kyis dpa' mchog dang gle ba'i rgan po rnams la gros byas te yo'u rgya yang nub phyogs su 'gro ba'i gros thag bcad/ /gong lha stobs rgyal gyi tsha bo nyi ma tshe ring gi bu gsum pa dgra lha rgyal gyis sa skya 'khon gyi gdung rgyud sgar ba'i bla ma bser bu rtags pa zhes grub thob pa chen po de'i gdung rgyud yin pa'i bu mo zhig khab tu bzhes te/ rigs rgyud 'phel ba las thugs rje nywa gor dang / ting 'dzin lag gor/ sngags pa 'bum lo gsum skyes/ sngags pa 'bum lo la bu sbyin pa rgya mtsho dang bu mo rgyal mo skyid sogs bu bu mo mang du skyes/ sbyir reb gong gi mi rnams kyis hor nag la 'jag pa lung nywa ser zhes 'bod pa ltar ྅ nag gi mes po dgra lha rgyal kyis kyang lham yu ba nag po can rgyan pas nya nag ces pa'i tsho ming thogs/ sbyin pa rgya mtsho'i mi rabs bzhi ba ni tshe dbang dang kun rig skyabs gnyis te/ kun rig skyabs hor tshang du mag par song ste rjes rabs la hor tshang nywa nag tsho ba byung pa dang / phyis su nywa nag de tsho ba gnyis su gyes nas sno nag dang wa nag go/ tshe dbang la bu stag lha thar dang / bsam gtan/'brug thar rgyal/ gsang bdag rdo rje bzhi skyes shing / rab byung bcu gcig pa'i nang kho tsho gtso byas pa'i nywa nag gi ru skor mang che shos nub phyogs su yong nas dgon gong ma dang 'dres so/ /gong lha'i mi rgyud nyi ma tshe ring gi bu bzhi ba dpal mgon gyis reb gong glang rgya nas bu mo zhig khab tu bzhes rte / bu rdo rje dbang rgyal zhes pa zhig 'khrungs shing / kho lo bco brgyad yas mas kyi skabs su dngos 'bul mang po khyer te dbus gtsang gi dgon sde mang por mjal skor zhus pa dang / de nas 33

yang rgya gar gyi gnas chen mang por mjal rjes bal bo brgyud nas mnga' ris gung thang du 'byor skabs/ bla ma zhang gis gung thang dgon pa btab ste lha rten bzhengs skabs dang 'phrad/ khos bla mar mjal phyag dang lung bstan zhus pa na/ bla mas/ mdo smad g.yar mo thang gsum du/ / bya ba rung zhes bya ba yod/ / grub gnas brgyad kyis bskor nas gda'/ / mi yi re ba skong yul du/ / khyod kyi gdung rgyud 'phel bar 'gyur/ / zhes lung bstan zhing rten skal la byin gyis brlab ste gnang / /rdo rje dbang rgyal mjal skor nas phyir thon rjes thub chen rgya ra theg mchog gi gdung rgyud yin par grags pa'i ming la mtsho mo klu byung zer ba'i mdzes shing lta na sdug pa'i bu mo zhig khab tu bsus te/ khong gnyis la snga phyir sras gsum byung ba'i che ba'i ming la rdor dbang dar rgyas zhes yab kyi rus ming btags pa dang / 'bring bo'i ming la klu byung yul skyong zhes yum gyi rus ming btags/ chung ba'i mgo na sha men rwa co lta bu zhig skyes yod pas ming la mgo skyang zhes btags/ / rjes su bu che ba dang 'bring ba gnyes kyi gdung rgyud 'phel ba'i tsho ming la klu byung dang yul skyong zhes su 'bod pa dang /phyis su de yang zur chag nas klog byung g.yu skyong zhes su grags so/ /(gsham du yo da pa'i g.yer skyong zhes pa'i tsho ming ni pa chen sku zeng bcu pa'i dgongs 'char ltar btags pa yin par bshad/)de yang yul skyong la sras gcig byung ba'i ming la sgom pa rgyal/ sgom pa rgyal la sras ming sring bzhi byung ste rab rgyas dang / gzungs skyid/ nyi ma thar/ shes rab rnams so/ / rab rgyas la bstan pa rgya mtsho spun gnyis skyes pa dang kho tsho nar son rjes g.yer skyong gi ru skor zhig nub phyogs su gnas spor/ /gong du bkod pa ni blon chos bal bza'i tshe ring rgyal gyis bkod pa'i zin bris ltar bris pa yin/ khos blon chos rgya bza'i dge bshes gcod pas 34

rab byung dgu ba'i smad la mdzad pa'i lta ba mkha' khyab phyogs bral zhes pa'i reb gong gi lo rgyus de gtso bor bzung pa dang rus mdzod gzhan la yang zur lta byas tshul bshad yod/ zin bris 'di'i nang don mdor dril na dgon gong ma reb gong ko'u sde nas chad pa dang / nub phyogs su ma yong gong spun gsum gyi mi rgyud nas chad pa'i dgon gong ma dang bar ma zhol ma bcas kyi tsho chung gsum yod mod/ 'on kyang ko'u sde dang gyes nas yong pa ni dgon gong ma kho na yin pa/ dpa' mchog dang gle ba tsho ba so so yin pa/de min nywa nag gis sa skya 'khon gyi gdung rgyud la nye bshad yod pa dang /g.yer skyong gis grub chen mkha' spyod rgya ra theg mchog gi gdung rgyud la nye bshad yod pa bcas red/ /35

le'u gsum pa/dgon gong ma'i mi rabs dang sde tshor gyes rim/ /dang po/ mes po dag las brgyad pa'i ngagasgyun/ /dgon gong 'ba' lung la yong nas lo rabs mang po song pa dang /rang gi chad khongs reb gong ko'u sde'i 'brel thag yang je ring du gyur pas/sngar gyi lo rgyus la rim ba'in gsal cha med par gyur na'ang / sngon gyi mes po dag las brgyud pa'i ngag rgyun brjed du phangs ba 'ga' re da dung gleng rgyu yod de/ de dag mdor dri rang gi tsho ba'i mes po dang / sde tshor gyes tshul gyi skor yin/ /(gcig) mes po ngos 'dzin tshul/sngon gyi tshe bse rgyal mtshan 'bum zhes pa'i skyes bu shes rab dang dpa' rtsal gyis rab tu phyug pa zhig la/ tshe sngon bsod nams bsags pa'i stobs kyis rigs kyi bu bzhi skyes pa ste/ che ba bse dge dang / de las chung ba dge rtags/ de las chung ba dge rgyas/ spun bzhi'i nang gi tha chung dge 'phel yin par grags/ de bzhi bo'i rigs rgyud 'phel nas mi sde mi 'dra ba mang du 'phel bar 'dod la/ rang cag dgon gong ma ba rnams ni dge rgyas kyi bu rabs tsha rgyud 'phel nas thub par grags/ bshad tshul 'di gong gi blon chos tshe ring rgyal gyi reb gong lo rgyus lta ba mkha' khyab phyogs bral 〉gyi zin bris dang bsdur na mi ming ngos 'dzin tshul gyi thad nas khyad par yod na'ang / dgon gong ma bod kyi rus chen bzhi las bse chung sbra las mched pa 36

yin tshul 'dra bas don la bsnyegs rgyu yod pa'i ngag rgyun zhig yin pa sor ma chag/(gnyis)dgon gong 'og bar gsum gyi ngos 'dzin tshul/ /dgon gong ma bde rung gzhung nas gle khog la spor rjes dgon shul gsum gyi sa bzung pa dang / dpa' mchog gis lung pa'i stod kyi lhas gong ma zhes pa'i dgon shul nye 'dabs kyi sa bzung pas sde ming la dgon gong ma dang / ྅ nag gis lung sked kyi mchod rten sgar khug zhes pa'i dgon shul gyi nye 'dabs bzung bas sde ming dgon bar ma/ o'u rgyas gle khog lung mdo'i kha sog thang du gzhi bzung pas sde ming la dgon zhol ra thogs pa bcas su bshad/ dgon gong 'og bar gsum nang gi che ba ni dpa' mchog yin pas tsho sde spyi'i ming la dgon gong ma zhes su 'bod pa kun la grags/ da dung bshad tshul gzhan mig la reb gong gong ba mdzes byed du grags pa'i rdzong dkar dgon thog mar bzhengs skabs po'u rgya dang / nya nag/ dpa' mchog g.yer skyong bcas kyis sbyin bdag gtso bo byas pas dgon gong ma'i sde ming thogs pa'i bshad tshul mig kyang yod/ gong gi bshad tshul 'de dag blon chos tshe ring rgyal gyi zin bris dang bsdur na khyad par cung zad yod de/zin bris su rab gong ko'u sde'i nang du mes po gcig las brgyud pa'i dgon gong 'og bar gsum gyi tsho ba gsum yod mod/ nub phyogs su yong ba ni gong lha stobs rgyal gyi mi rgyud de sgo gong ma'am dgon gong ma tshang kho na yin la/de'i nang gi tsho ting bzhi bo ko'u sde nas gyes pa yang dpa' mchog dang gle ba gnyis sngon ma dang / yo'u rgya de'i rjes su yong ba/ nya nag dang g.yer skyong gnyis de las kyang 'phyi bar bshad/ /da lta spyir btang gi gnas tshul 'og dgon gong 'og bar gsum zhes pa'i brjod stangs shig yod mod/ 'on kyang / de dag dzi lta ra ngos 'dzin dgos pa su la'ang bshad rgyu med par bltas na/ tshe ring rgyal gyi zin bris la 37

bden nges yod pa 'dra/ /(gsum)tsho ting bzhi bo'i mes po dang ming thogs tshul/mes po sngags pa mthu chen gyi gdung rgyud de / oṃ chen dang / a chen/hūṃ chen gsum gyi rus rgyud las dgon gong ma mched pa'i ngag rgyun zhig kyang yod mod/ bshad tshul gtso bo'i dbang du byas na mes po gong lha stobs rgyal gyi gdung rgyud nyi ma tshe ring gi bu che ba kun dga' dpal ldan gyi gdung rgyud las dpa' mchog tsho ba dang / bu gnyis pa rig 'dzin nyi ma'i rgyud las yo'u rgya tsho ba/ bu gsum pa dgra lha rgyal gyi gdung rgyud las ྅ nag tsho ba/ bu bzhi ba dpal mgon gyi gdung rgyud las g.yer skyong tsho ba bcas byung tshul bshad yo da pa 'dis sngon chad rgan po dag gis dgon gong ma ni mes po gcig gi gdung rgyud las byung zhes par bden dpang byas/ de yang tsho khag so so'i ming thogs tshul la 1955lor dpa' mchog rta res dang ban de sogs rgan po rnams kyis bshad tshul gzhir bzung nas bris pa'i rgya yig gi lo rgyus yig cha zhig yod pa'i nang du sngon lo bzhi brgya yas mas kyi dus su reb gong ko'u sder ming la rgya mtsho zer ba zhig yod pa des ya rig nas chung ma zhig blangs/rgya mtshor lus stobs che zhing jag rkus la ngar ba zhig yin pas/ dpa' bo mchog tu gyur pa'i ming thogs/ kho'i ming la brten nas rjes rabs pa rnams la dpa' mchog zhes pa'i tsho ming thogs/ o'u rgya'i mes pos kha dog sna lngas gtsag drub byas pa'i dbus lham gyon pa la ya kyes 'bu'u khya zer zhing /phyis su sgra de 'gyur nas yo'u rgya'am bo'u rgya zhes pa'i tsho ming thogs/ nywa nag gi mes pos lham yu nag po can zhig gon (rkang snam nag po zer tshul yang yod )pas mi rgyud la nya nag tshang thogs/ g.yer skyong gi mes po rdo rje dbang rgyal la bu yul skyong zhes pa zhig skyes pa'i ming la brten nas phyis su yu skyong ngam g.yer skyong zhes pa'i tsho ming thogs zhes bkod yod/ /38

gnyis pa/ dgon gong ma dang reb gong bar gyi 'brel ba/ /sngon dgon gong ma'i mi rabs sngon ma reb gong bde rung khog tu rong ma 'brog byas nas bsdad par grags la/ ha lam spyi lo 1630yas mas la mi grangs mang du 'phel nas zhing sa dang rtswa sa mi 'dang ba'i gnas tshul byung pas/rtswa chu bzang pa'i rib gong kha stod gle khog tu spor/ de dus dgon gong mar gle ba dang / dpa' mchog yo'u rgya/ sman zhol/ nywa nag g.yer skyong bcas tsho khag lnga yod/ sde mgo reb gong kha stod la gtogs la/ kha stod hor tsho bzhi dang mnyam du rong bo dgon par mang 'gyel gtong ba'i 'gan len/ gnas tshul de 1923lo'i bar tu rgyan bskyangs zhing / lo der mā jag gis gser lag dgon pa rgyag skabs hor tsho bzhi nas dgon gong mar dmag rogs su yong ba des dran bskul byas 'og mā pu'u h+phang gis bod sde skor skor tu ma bcad na dbang bsgyur byed dka' bar bsams nas/dgon gong ma rab gong kha stod kyi khong gtogs nas blangs te/ rwa rgya'i mtha' 'dug tsho bzhi la sbyar/ 1988lor dgon gong mas sngar gyi 'brel ba slar gso byed ched hor dang mnyam du rong bo dgon par mang 'gyel thengs gcig gtong ba'i 'gan blangs/ rong bo dgon pas kyang thang ga sogs mchod yon 'azel ba'i skyes rnams gnang / /gsum pa/ dgon gong ma gle khog nas 'ba' lung du spor ba'irgubyun/ /gna' snga mo zhig nas mtsho sngon gyi bod sde rnams kyis mtsho sngon po'i g.yas g.yon sogs rma chu'i byang phyogs kyi sa rgya chen po bzung yod kyang /dus rabs bcu gsum par jing gar rgyal pos sog po'i rus rgyud tsho ba dag gcig gyur byas te stobs shugs che ru song ba dang bstun nas/ sog po gzhi rgya chen po'i sgo nas mtsho sngon du yong ba'i 'go brtsams/ phal cher spyi lo 39

1503 yas mas la sog pos dmag gi stobs shugs la brten nas bod sde phal cher rma chu'i lho phyogs su ded de lo nyis brgya tsam 'gor/ rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i chu yos (1723)lor gu shrī han gyi tsha po blo bzang bstan 'dzin gyis mes po'i btsan dbang gi las don slar gso byed ched/ mtsho sngon gyi sog po'i thes ju rnams la 'go 'dzin byas nas ching srid gzhung la ngo rgol byas pa ma 'gyangs par ching gi dmag spyi chen mo nyan keng yo'i dmag dpung gis bcom nas sog pos mtsho sngon la dbang bsgyur byed pa'i dus skabs mjug rdzogs/ 'de la bod kyi yig tshang du mtsho sngon dus 'khrugs dang dus zing zer/ sog po pham rjes ching srid gzhung gis bsrung bya mang po gtan la pab cing rma chu sa mtshams byas te bod sog la dbang bsgyur byas mod/ 'on kyang skabs der pod sog la khag bgos nas bdag skyong byed pa'i srid jus de yun ring rgyun 'khyongs byed par dam lhod shor pa dang / lo rgyus 'phel phyogs kyi dbang gis skabs de dag la bod skyor sog gnon gyi srid jus spyad pa phyi rkyen du thub pa'i khar rma lho byang gnyis kyi spyi tshogs gnas tshul la rtsa ba'i cha nas 'gyur ldog chen po byung stabs gong ma yung krin rgyal po'i dus mgo nas bzung bod sde rnams kyis chu'i byang phyogs sogs sngar shor ba'i sa cha brtson len byas/ rong bo blon chos kyi lo rgyus lta ba mkha' khyab phyogs bral 〉gyi skabs snga ma las/ rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i chu byi (1732)lor 'khyam ru dang / khrab rgyan/ 'azeb rgya/ dme sngags phyed tsam mtsho sngon po'i phyogs su bud de sgar ba'i bla ma sa lta ba chen po'i dka' ba spyad pa'i sa thog tu gzhi bzung zhes pa ltar/ skabs de shed du reb gong phyogs kyi tsho sde mang po rma phyi nang du 'bud pa'i dus su dgon gong ma yang rtswa chu bzang sa'i 'ba' lung du gzhi spor ba'i 'go brtsams/ des na dgon gong ma gle khog nas mar yong don gtso bo ni rtswa sa bzang sa snyeg pa'i ched yin/ phal cher dgon gong ma rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i smad tsam la gle khog nas rka che chung 40

dang 'jang che chung / 'ba' gzhung mang ra sogs su gnas spor/ da lta'i thun te'i nang lung gi sde chen gsum gyi nang sngon la gnas 'dir yong mkhan ni dgon gong ma yin pa dang de'i rjes su mgar rtse dang de'i rjes su sha sbrang yin zhes cha rgyus yod pa rnams kyis gleng / skabs der sa khul 'di dag tu a rig gi tsho ba rnams bsdad yod pas dgon gong ma dang a rig bar tu 'khrug rtsod mang po byung / phyis su phyogs gnyis kyi 'go bas gros bsdur byas te rtsa' 'gran nas su rgyal na sa cha'i bdag dbang 'dzin pa thag bcad/ de nas yo'u rgya'i ban de rgyal ske ring dang / dpa' mchog sangs chen/ nywa nag bla spyon/ g.yer skyong chos smyon/ gle ba'i khyi mo thar bcas nas rtsal 'gran pa'i dar langs la bud/ phyis su mo la brtag nas o'u rgya'i ban de rgyal ske ring gis rtsal 'gran pa bab/ a rig gi rtsal 'gran mkhan gyi ming la yang yem meg ban de rgyal zer/ rtsal 'gran skabs ban de rgyal ske ring gis mem meg ban de rgyal g.yug thengs gcig gis lnga lam la bsgral pas/ a rig gis dgon gong mar sa byin de stod phyogs la song / spyi lo 1588lo nas sgyuṭ+wāṃdī stu dro ༵༷dī rnyisdas shātsho maṭ+wāṃn dardospra /༵ du ༵ rdo tram̐ r+sha ༵ / rjirji ṭ+wādi ༷ ༷ bzhi dang / sog po'i rgyal rgyud yan ta han gyi bu du ku la/ de min mad tshan nyer bzhi'i chin wang dang 'bangs yongs kyis khong dbu blar bkur ba'i stabs kyis dgon gong ma 'ba' gzhung la thon rung skabs nas zhabs drung dkar po'i sku phreng rim byon tshang ma mang 'ba' bya gsum gyi sa bdag yin zhes pa'i bshad tshul de yod/ 'ba' 'am 'bal zhes pa 'di lo rgyus yig tshang las byung pa ches snga shos ni tun hong gter yig gi rgyal phran bcu gnyis sogs bshad skabs yul sum yul gyi ya sum na'/ rje 'bal rje mang ru ti/blon po rlang dang gam gnyis zhes pa 'di yin te/ dang thog sum pa'i rje bo zhig gi rus ming sa ming la thogs pa yin shas che/ de dus rka rgan dang 1

'jang che chung na rong bo blon che yod pa yang rim bzhin rma phar kha'i 'brong thu sogs su spos/ skabs der dgon gong ma reb gong ko'u sde la thag je ring tu song yod mod/ phyogs so so'i 'brel ba sngar ltar rgyun 'dzin byas yod pas dus rabs nyi shu pa lo rabs nyi shu pa'i bar reb gong thog kha bcu gnyis kyi gras su rong bo nang so'i mnga' 'og tu 'du/ 1924lo nas dgon gong ma bla brang dbon po'i mnga' 'og la gtogs par byas rjes stong dpon tshul dbang gis hor dpon por nged nas ske gcig gis mgo gnyis 'khur mi thub ces sa kha stod kyi 'brel ba thams cad med par byas skad pa dang / yang bshad tshul zhig la tshul dbang gis gser lag mā jag gis rgyag skabs reb gong lag rogs la ma yong bar gyod brgyab nas sku gzhogs shar skal ldan rgya mtsho sku phreng bdun pa'i phyag mdzod kyi mgo la gri ltag gis brgyab pa sogs kyi rkyen dbang gis reb gong dang 'azel lam chad zer srol zhig kyang yod/ /bzhi ba/ dgon gong ma dus skabs nam zhig la da lta'i sdod gnas 'der spor ba dang sa bzung tshulari ltar yin pa/ /bla ma dbu dkar pa yon tan rgya mtshos mdzad par grags pa'i 'bal gyi mthon po bcu gsum dang rtse drug snying bdun gyi bsang mchod ces pa de rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i me pho rta lor (1726)mdzad ces bkod yod par gzhigs na phal cher skabs de'i sngon nas dgon gong ma 'ba' lung la thon yod pa ra 'azod thub/ dgon gong ma mar thon rjes rtse 'du'i ri'i nub phyogs kyi sa rgya chen po ste/ sa bzung nas rma chu sngon mo'i 'gram ngogs bar glebs/ dgon gong ma 'ba' gzhung la ma slebs gong a rig dang bong stag gnyis sa 'dir gzhis chags yod la/ kho tsho yang rim gyis gnas spos te a rig mtsho sngon po'i byang phyogs dang rma chu'i lho phyogs su skor khag gnyis su chad nas song / bong stag yang stod smad gnyis su gyes te khag gcig mtsho nub tu song ba dang khag gcig rma chen gangs ri'i byang phyogs su song / a rig dang 2

bang stag gi rjes su rgya bza' dang blon chos gnyis kyis sa 'di bzung yod la/deganyis kyang rim gyis rma chu'i phar 'gram du gnas spos/ de dag gi rjes su dgon gong ma tsho bzhi thon nas 'ba' nyin srib tu gzhis chags/ sa gle khog nas 'ba' lung la spor skabs thog mar sa gnas mi 'dra ba gsum brgyud par grags pa ni/ ru tsho gcig bya 'dar brgyud nas yong zhing / ru tsho gcig skam chen brgyud nas yong bar grags/ yang ru tsho gcig sa nag brgyud nas yong bar bshad/ de nas 'ba' stod mo'u rgyas bzung ba dang / 'ba' sked dpa' mchog gis bzung / 'ba' smad nywa nag gis bzung / 'jang che chung gi ri lung thams cad g.yer skyong gis bzung nas 'tsho zhing gzhes par gnas/ rka mo che na zhing zhig yod pa la tshul dbang zhing rgan dang / kye phur na rta ris nags zhes pa yod/ dkar mo g.yang 'khyil gyi shar tu dpa' mchog gi bu mo zhig btsas pa'i ming la lha dbang mtsho zer la phyis su ming de sa ming la thogs te da lta lha dbang thang zer ba dang / khe rab byang du 'byung gnas lung ba dang 'byung gnas de'u 'bur zhes dpa' mchog bla ma 'byung gnas bsdad pas de ltar thogs/ sngon dus bar skabs shig la dpa' mchog dang hor gnyis ma 'chams pa'i dus su dpa' mchog gis kham ru'i sna nas rka chung zor wa'i bar sa bzung ste gnas/ spyi lo 1850 yas mas la dpa' mchog dang lo ba gnyis ma 'chams pa'i dus su dpa' mchog dpon po tshang rka chung sha mtha'i nyin na bsdad yod/ dpa' mchog gi dmag skyid po ri'i kha char (da lta rtse khog gi sa yin )'tshogs pa ltar sa de dag kyang sngon chad dgon gong mas bzung / dus rabs nyi shu ba'i lo rabs sum bcu pa nas bzung dgon gong ma spyi'i tsu sa gtan chags byas yod par ma zad/ tsho rteng bzhi bo'i bar mtshams kyang phal cher gsal bo yin/ skabs de shed du dgon gong mar 'tsho ba'i rtswa sa ni shar lho'i phyogs nas rtse 'du'i ri rtswa mtshams byas te rka rgan dang rka chung lung ba'i nyin srib yongs dzogs dang / byang 3
