phyogs su rka chung mdo nas 'ba' chu brgyud de rma chu la thug pa'i 'ba' srib yongs rdzogs/ nub phyogs su dge bsnyen rab gzigs nas rma chu brgyud de tshag wa wol bar/ lho phyogs nas ser 'ba' nyag kha nas rka rgan srib ngos ri rgyud ded de rma chu la thug reg bar yin/ gzhan bde chen dgon pa thog mar bzhengs skabs dgon bdag gis dgon gong ma'i 'go ba rnams la sa g.yar tshul dgon pa'i yig tshang lhag yod pa'i nang da lta'ang mthong thub/ de min yo'u rgya'i la bo zhes pa zhig gis ser 'ba' 'bri mar ser ro 'bud sa/ /dgon dzi rgod ma lo rkyang rtseb sa/ / tha thod thor rur kha lo 'dul sa/ zhes pa'i sa bstod chu bstod ring bo zhig thal byung du ngag nas thon par grags pa las mi rabs sngon ma rnams kyis rang gi pha sar brtse dung zab mo bcangs yod pa yang dag mtshon/ /lnga ba/ dgon gong ma reb gong dang 'brel lam chad pa'i rgya rkyen gtso bo/ /1923lor mā pu'u t+pang log spyod srid gzhung gis kho tsho'i ya nga ba'i dbang bsgyur la ngo rgol byas rkyen tu dmag dpung mi grangs stong tsho gcig lhag mngags nas/ gser lag dgon pa'i grwa ba dmar gsod dang lha rten chos gsum mer bsregs pa sogs kyi gtor brlag tshab chen bzos/ mā jag la 'gog rgol byed par gser lag dgon pa'i lha sder gtogs pa'i dgon gong ma dang sha sbrang tsho drug bcas mthun sgril gcig gyur sgos dmag la bud par ma zad/ stod phyogs nas hor tsho bzhi sogs kyi dmag kyang sa thag ring po nas yo nga ste tsho sde thun mong gi dgra bo 'gog ched rang rang gi gyong gud la mi lta bar stobs dang nus pa chen po bton/ hor dmag gser lag la yong ba'i lam skabs su chu log chen po brgyugs te mi brgya lhag chus khur na'ang yong mtshams ma bzhag par gser lag bskor yod pa'i mā jag gi dmag dpung la gtug res byed du yong / dmag 'khrug gi khrod du bo'u bza' mgon lo sogs kyis

dab 'a ma dzangs brtul phod sgos phar thol byas rkyen mā jag gis mi ro bcu phrag ba'ag nas mi 'bro ka med byung / don rkyen 'di'i nang 'brog dmangasas la mthun sgril de 'dra byung bas ma chi tshogs khag la 'jigs skrag chen po bskur ba dang / kho tshos 'brog dmangs kha thor ya bral du ma btang na 'byung 'gyur dbang bsgyur byed dka' bar bsams nas thabs brgya jus stong gis 'brog dmangs nang khul la the gtog byed pa'i 'go brtsams/ dper na/ bod sde'i nang 'gal ba cung zad re byung dus phyogs gnyis gar mnyam du rgyab rogs byed rgyu khas blangs nas 'gal ba je cher btang pa dang / sde gcig la ngan bskul byas nas sde ba gzhan zhig la btsan 'phrog byed pa sogs kyi don rkyen bstud mar bzos/ de bzhin du gser lag dgon pa'i don rkyen thag gcod par kha g.yar nas theg mi thub pa'i cha rkyen mang po bton pa dang /bla brang dbon po bstan dar bed spyad nas dgon gong ma reb gong phyogs su kha 'bral du bcug ste mtha' 'dug tsho bzhi dang mnyam du rwa rgyar gtogs par byas/ /dgon gong ma 'ba' lung du spor nas da lta bar mi rabs mang po zhig brjes yod rung / sde ba'i khongs mi yongs kyis rang gi pha mes kyi chad khongs reb gong phyogs yin pa ni sus kyang brjed med de/ phyogs de la bcos ma min pa'i brtse dung zhig da dung bcangs yod pa red/ yin na yang / sa 'dir gnas spor rjes sde ba tsho ba'i 'go ba rnams kyis reb gong phyogs la 'gro 'ong re byed thub pa ma gtogs/ phyogs gnyes ku'i sde dmangs mang che ba'i bar gyi 'brel ba ni yul gyi bskal bas rgyun skyong rgyu stabs mi bde bar gyur/de'i thog la mā chi srid gzhung gis srid 'dzin khongs gtogs kyi 'brel ba yang bsgyur bas/ sngar gyi sde tsho'i 'azel lam mi 'chad rang chad du gyur/ /5

le'u bzhi ba/dgon gong ma'i tsho rting bzhi bo bye brag tu bshad pa/dang po/ dpa' mchog bshad pa/ /tsho ba 'di'i ming thogs tshul ni/ ko'u sde'i rgya mtsho'i ming ngos nas thogs pa gong du bshad zin/ de la 'dir sde mthun ko'u sde dpa' mchog dang / der snga mo nas gyes pa'i su rig dpa' mchog kyang yod par grags la/'dir dgon gong ma'i dpa' mchog la tsho khag lnga mchis shing / de yang rab byung bcu ba'i nang ko'u bde bde rong nas nub phyogs su gnas spor skabs dpa' bo rgya mtsho'i bu rgyud la bu gsum byung pa'i gcen bsod lo dang gcung ri lo/ tha chung tshogs gzungs yin/ bsod lo'i rus rgyud ni dpa' mchog stag skor dang / ri lo'i rus rgyud 'phel ba bla rgan tshang / tshogs gzungs kyi rus rgyud 'phel ba dpon skor dang 'jam skor gnyis so/ /dpa' mchog gi dpon sa thog mar 'khur mkhan ni dge 'dun yin te/dang thog dge 'dun dang / lcags tho/ klu rgyal gsum po rgya nag tu 'gro dgos par bskul skabs dge 'dun gcig po las gzhan gnyis zhed nas 'gro ma phod/ dge 'dun la gong mas byu ru dmar po'i tog dang rma bya sngon mo'i sgro can gyi thabs zhwa byin te dgon gong ma'i spyi dpon du dbang bskur/de rjes dge 'dun gyi tsha bo chos los dpon sa khur/ chos lo ru ngan mtshal nag gis bsad rjes/ chos lo'i gcung rta kho tsug lis dpon sa bzung /de nas tsug lu'i bu tshul dbang gis bzung / de'i rjes su 'jam skor bstan 6

dar gyis dpon sa bzung / de'i rjes su bstan dar gyi bu rta ris kyis dpon sa bzung /(rta kho tsug lu dang bstan dar gnyis kyis dpon sa bzung ba'i dus yun shin tu thung bar bshad) de'i rjes su dpon skor bo bos tsho ba —bskyangs/ /(1) dpon skor/ /dang thog dpon skor dang 'jam skor gnyis tsho ba gcig yin te/ lo ngo brgya tsam gyi sngon la ching gong mas cho lo gnang 'ing spyi dpon du bkur pa'i dpon po dge 'dun gyi ring la dpon skor gyi ming byung zhing / dpon skor dang 'jam skor gnyis la dpon skor ru skor gnyes ka zhes gleng / dpon skor gyi tsho dpon ni dpa' mchog dang dgon gong ma'i dpon po rim byung gis zhor tu khur ba mang ste/ dpon po dge 'dun gyi rjes su kho'i tsha bo dpon po chos lo dang / rjes su gcung rta tsug de'i rjes su de yi bu dgon gong ma mgar rtse'i stong dpon chen po tshul dbang (yongs grags su dpa' mchog sdidīni rdobhe /༵ ༷ ༷ṭ+wāṃg/ dadu / ni ni ṭ+wāṃ/ bhe/ samaṭ+wāṃhūṃ ༵ṭ+wāṃ hādīdī padī sdudīṭ+wāṃ sde tsho gnyis lhan du bskyangs shing / 1951lor dpon po bo bo'u tshe las 'das rjes bu 'bum pa skyabs kyis dgon gong ma chus yi (chus gsum pa )chi krang khur/ /dpon skor gyi migrod/ tshogs gzungs dang bso lo/ phyug lo gsum pha spun yin la/ tshogs gzungs kyi bu ni dge 'dun dang / rta kho kha ra gnyis yin/ dge 'dun la bu sko lo mgo gyong dang / snying dkar rgyal/rta kho ṣā ra gsum yod/ rta kho kha ra ni 'jam skor gyi mes po yin par grags/sko lo mgo spyong la bu chos lo dang / klu tho/ rta tsug no'u zhes/sngags pa bcas spun lnga dang / bu mo ma ḍi dang / klu skyid gnyis yod/chos los stag yan ya rga'i bu mo gar skyid chung mar blangs/ de la bu 47

gsang bdag skyabs dang / lha rgod/ bu mo mkha' 'tsho gsum skyes/ /gsang bdag skyabs kyi bu ni brgyag thas yin/ brgyag thas la bu mo jo mo lab sgron dang ma ḍi skyid gnyis skyes/ lha rgod la bu dbang chen stobs rgyal dang pad+ma gar dbang gnyis skyes/ dbang chen stobs rgyal dpon sar bkur mod/ ma bsdad par rab tu byung / lde tshar song nas cang ma 'gor bar tshe las 'das/ pad+ma gar dbang la bu chos ldan skyes/ mkha' 'gro la mag pa chos byams bzhag de la bu 'jigs 'ba' skyes/ 'jigs 'ba' la rta mgrin tshe ring sogs bu gsum skyes/ /rta tsug la la kha'i rig ge hre sdang gi sring mo mtsho skyid blangs/ de la bu stong dpon tshul dbang dang rwa rgya chos mdzad gnyis skyes/ tshul dbang la bu bsod nams dang / dar rgyas gnyis dang bu mo tshe ring 'tsho/ cog lo bcas skyes la/ dar rgyas lo nyi shu yas mas su dred mong gis bsad/bsod nams la bu lha dpal gcig po las med/ /bu mo tshe ring 'tsho la mag pa ban de bzhag de la bu snying 'ba' dang 'jig med rab brtan gnyis skyes/ snying 'ba' la bu bzhi yod/ 'jigs med rab brtan mag par song / lha dpal la bu dpa' byams rgyal sogs bdun yod/ cog lo la mag pa cha ra mkhar byams bzhag bu mo mkha' po dang sgrol ma skyid gnyis skyes/ sgrol ma skyid la bu gcod pa dang tshul po gnyis yod/ /klu tho la stag yan ya rga'i bu mo snying yag chung mar bsus/ bu kun rgyal skyes pa dang / kun rgyal gyi bu rnams ni yu sto dang / tshe phyug snying bo lha/lha dbang gsum yin/ yu sto'i bu 'jam dbyangs yin pa dang / tshe phyug la bu mo zhig las ma skyes pas de la mag pa dngos thub tshe ring bzhag snying bo lha la chos mgon rgyal dang / dpal chen rdo rje bu mo gcig bcas gsum yod/ /8

nu'u zhes la bu dge lo (dge spyon yang zer )skyes pa dang / dge lo la bu bo bo'u dang / gnam rtse/ dpa' mkhar rgyal/ skal bzang rgyal bzhi skyem kyang / skal bzang rgyal chung dus nas shi/ bu mo gar rgya skyes/ bo bo'u'i bu 'bum pa skyabs yin pa dang / 'bum pa skyabs kyi bu ni mgon po yin/ gnam rtse'i bu ni ban de che lo dang bshad sgrub gnyis yin/ dpa' mkhar rgyal la bu mo gsum yod pa'i tha chung jo mo lab sgron la mag pa li thar rgyal bzhag nas khyim rgyud bskyangs/ gar rgya la bu mtshams pa dang / rgya 'ba'/ stobs rgyas rgyal gsum skyes/ bu mtshams pa dang stobs rgyas rgyal gnyis kyis so sor khyim rgyud bskyangs/ rgya 'ba' dpal chen rdo rjer bu skal du byin/ /sngags pa la bu mo gnyis yod pa'i che ba'i mag par yon tan dang chung ba'i mag par dbang rdor bzhag dbang rdor la bu gsang bstan dang yu rgyan gnyis skyes/ yu rgyan dpa' mchog ba rgya tshang la mag par song ba'i bu ni bdud 'dul yin/ gsang bstan la bu pad+ma rig 'dzin skyes/ /sko lo mgo gyong gi bu mo thu skyid la bu ban de dang / bu mo dpal mtsho gnyis skyes/ ban des chung ma a rig nas blangs/ de la don grub nor kha dang / dpa' mchog dge ma ming sring gnyis skyes/ don grub la bu med/dge ma la bu bla kho dang / rig 'dzin gnyis skyes/ rig 'dzin la bu nor bu rgya mtsho dang / bu mo chos sgron 'tsho skyes/ bla kho la bu ban de dpal ldan dang bu mo snying mtsho sogs yod/ snying mtsho la mag pa tshe ring 'bum bzhagade la bu u rgyan skyabs dang bu mo tshe ring skyid gnyis skyes/ dpal mtsho la mgon po mag par bzhag nas bu mo res lo skyes/ res lo la bu gnas brtan dang (grwa ba)/ bsam gtan (grwa ba)/ bu mo snying mo yag bcas skyes/snying mo yag la bu mo zhi rgya skyes/ zhi rgya la 'jigs med mag par bzhag nas khyim rgyud bskyangs/ /4 9

chos lo'i sring mo ma ṇi la mag pa dbang lo sna rgan bzhag de la bu tshogs gzungs rgyal/ bu mo rin chen skyid dang g.yang mo gsum yod/tshogs gzungs rgyal la bu mkhyen rab dang bu mo lcags mo byams gnyis skyes/lcags mo byams kyi bu ni chos dbyings rgyal yin/ tshogs gzungs rgyal gyi sring mo che ba rin chen skyid la bu nor bu rgyal dang blo bzang sngo ma gnyis skyes/blo bzang rab tu byung / nor bu rgyal la bu ke tho dang / bstan 'dzin/ tshe ring thar/ bu mo tshe byug rgyal bcas skyes/ /dpon skor la ya rig ya rga so gnyis zer ba'i tsha zhang zhig yod/ ya rga so gnyis la bu gu ru dang / yag wa/ dar rgyas gsum dang ma jo sngo sdang zer ba'i bu skal zhig kyang yod/ dar rgyas grwa ba byas te dgon 'brog gnyis kyi dbang bzung / rjes su skya sar bab ste gle ba'i ba lo'i bu mo chung mar bsus nas bu chos mdzad dang bu go g.yang mtsho rgyal gnyis skyes/ chos mdzad rab tu byung / g.yang mtsho rgyal la mag pa mkhyen rab bzhag de'i bu mo rin chen mtsho yin/ de la mag pa dpal chen rgyal bzhag nas bu rta kho dang tshe dbang nor bu skyes/ phyis su ya rig dar rgyas kyi chung ma 'das rjes de'i nu mo gar lo chung mar bsus/ de la ya lags smad sog 'khrungs/ yorig dar rgyas tshe las 'dagarjes/ bla ma ya rig tshang gis khong gi slob bu sman pa chos mdzad la dbon rgan dar rgyas nas nga'i sgar 'brog gnyis kyi 'gan gcig lcogs kyis blangs pa da lta kho tshe las 'das pas nga'i sems phangs bar 'dug sngon chad dpon skor sde bas dbon rgan la mi shugs dngos shugs gang thad nas rogs ram byas par bka' drin che/ da lta bu mo gar lo dang / dpon skor snying bo lha gnyes phan tshun brtse ba'i gnas tshul kho bos thos/ go skabs 'der bstun nas kho gnyis la gnyen sgrig byed du bcug ste nga'i sgar 'brog gnyis skyong du 'jug dgos zhes pa'i bka' ——gsungs ltar/ snying bo lha mag par bsdad de ya lags smad sog tshang bskyed 50

bsrings par ma zad/ a rig tshang gi sgar 'brog gnyis la dpon skor gyis bdag sdu ji/ga gu ru la shul med/ ya rig yag wa la bu sgom pa dang blo 'phel gnyis skyes/ blo 'thel la bu 'ja' rga dang yang kho gnyis/ 'ja' rgar bu gsum yod/ yang kho 'dzin bzung las phyir ma thon/ a jo sngo sdang la bu bsam me dang chongs dbyings gnyis skyes/ bsam me'i bu rnams ni lha 'brug dang / snyeng dkar/ bstan dar/ rig 'dzin/ dbang chen bcas yin/ lha 'brug la bu lha rgyal thar dang / lha byug tshe ring / ma tho/lha mkhar/ lo rdo/ g.yang 'bum rgyal/ rdo kho bcas skyes/ snying dkar gyi khyim rdo khos bskyangs/ lha 'brug shul dam chos rgyal/ lha mkhar la chung ma gar dros rgyal blangs nas mgon po lha mchog sogs bu gsum skyes/ /snying kho la bu a ge dang ban de/ chos byams gsum yod/ chos byams chos lo'i bu mo'i mag pa dang / ban de tshul dbang bu mo'i mag pa byas/ snying kho'i shul a ges bzung / ya ge'i bu ka rdo yin/ dbang grags la bu klu 'bum skyes/ klu 'bum bu ni ke tho yin/ klu 'bum gyi sring mor mag pa klu byug bzhag la/ der bu dbang grags rgyal dang bu mo 'thug rgyal gnyis skyes/ 'brug rgyal mag par skyabs kho bzhag nas bu khro rgyal skyes/khro rgyal la bu kos dpa' sogs bzhi skyes/ /snying dkar rgyal la bu klu tho rna 'byar dang / ri sdang / dkon mchog skyabs /sna/ /dūg/ skyadīX ༵ t+t+waṃ dī ṭ+wāṃ dī rde dī/sa/ la/ de la bu mo g.yu lo dang gnam mtsho gnyis skyes/ g.yu lor mag pa lha me bzhag pa dang / lha mtsho'i mag pa ni ya khu 'ba' yin/ de la bu zon ne+e skyes/ zon ner bu bzhi skyes/gnyis rab tu byung / gcig mag par song / bu che ba'i ming la lha bo zer/lha bo'i bu ni phun tshogs yin/ phun tshogs la bu mo gsum skyes/ che ba'i 51

mag par dpal chen ba'ag chung ba'i mag par rab brtan bzhag tha chung gnas la song / lha me'i bu ni rnam byams dang dar rgyas/ ku lo gsum yin/ rnam byams la bu snying brtse skyes shing / snying brtse'i bu ni bstan rgyam yin/ dar rgyas la bu dga' rab dang / chos dbyings gnyis skyes la/chos dbyings kyi bu ni rdo rje tshe 'phel dang sngags pa mthar phyin gnyis yin/dga' rab la bu med/ ku lo'i bu ni gser kho yin la/ gser khor bu mo gnyis skyes pa'i che ba'i mag par klu phyug dang chung ba'i mag par rta kho rgyal ba'ag lha me'i rjes la spun garma ma dang g.yang lo gnyis stag skor nas dpon skor tu ru yong / garma ma la rjes thogs kun thub dang tshe mgon snying mo thar ming sring gsum yod/ snying mo thar la bu mo gcig yod la der bu stag rtse skyes/ tshe mgon la bu dbang chen skyabs dang g.yang 'ba' thar gnyis yod/ kun thub kyis tshe mgon bu mo chos sangs sbyid bo dod du blangs nas de la bu gnyis dang bu mo gnyis skyes/ g.yang lo'i chung mar stag skor ya khu ja rgya'i sring mo blangs/ de la bu sngags pa chos 'apel dang tshe ring 'bum gnyis skyes/ tshe ring 'bum la bu pa pa dang pad+ma skyabs/ kun bzang skyabs gsum yod/ /klu tho la bu ban de (glu ban )dang bu mo rta lo gnyis skyes pa dang / ban de la bu ris mo dang bu mo rta yas dang thar mo sogs bdun skyes/ de'i nang jo rngo dang mkhar skyid gnyis ma gtogs gzhan tshang ma gnas la song / res mo'i chung ma ra bon brgya'i mgar nag dang bkra tho gnyis kyi sring mo blangs/de'i rus rgyud kyi khyim tshang 'ga' zhig bon brgya na yod/ bu mo rta po la bu gnyis skyes pa snying 'bum rgyal dang dpa' le thar gnyis yin/ dpa' le thar la bu gcig skyes pa'i ming la blo bzang zer/ de la bu mgon bkra dang /rdor skyabs/ ri rdo gsum dang bu mo gnyis skyes/ snying 'bum rgyal gyis tshe dbang rgyal bu skal du blangs/ de la bu g.yang drung rgyal skyes nas khyim rgyud 52

bskyangs/ /ris mos sring mo chung ba jo mo bo dod byas shing / de la bon brgya nas ming la bkra tho zer ba zhig mag par ba'ag ste/ bu mkhar 'bum dang /gnam lha/ dge slong khra sdang gsum dang bu mo ma cig skyid dang klu yag gnyis skyes/ /mkhar 'bum la bu yi dam rgyal las ma skyes pa dang / de la bu ban de rgyal dang rgya byis gnyis dang bu mo bdun skyes/ /gnam lha la bu mo jo mo tshe ring skyes shing / de la 'jam skor nas mkha' ro mag par bzhag ste/ bu gnam thar rgyal dang bu mo 'brug mo rgyal gnyis skyes/ 'byug mo rgyal la mag pa ma tho bzhag de la dpal chen rgyal sogs bu lnga skyes/ gnam thar rgyal la bu blo bzang bstan pa dang / rdza lo sogs bzhi skyes/ /ma cig skyid la bu stag lha rgyal dang / snying 'ba'/ chos dpal gsum skyes pa dang / stag lha rgyal la bu blo dar dang / g.yang skyabs rgyal sogs bzhi skyes/ jo mo'i spun mkhar mo skyid la bu gnyis skyes pa'i che ba gcod pa la bu 'gyur med skyes pa dang / de la bu ban de dang bstan pa gnyis skyes/ ban de o'u rgya'i a lags dzogs chen tshang la mag par song /ri sdang la bu skyabs ris dang yag lo bu mo klu skyid gsum skyes shing /skyabs ris la bu ma skyes par bu skal dbang chen blangs/ dbang chen la bu chos 'ba' skyes pa dang / de la bu mo mtsho mo dang dpal mo rgyal gnyis skyes/mtsho mo la rdo skyabs mag par bzhag nas bu gnyis dang rtsamo bdun skyes/ /yag lo la bu rta bo dang 'ja' pa gnyis skyes shing / 'ja' pa bla rgan tshang la bu skal du byin/ rta bo la bu mo gnam po skyes shing / de la bu kun thar rgyal dang bu mo bsod mtsho gnyis skyes/ da lta'i kun thar rgyal tshang gi sbra ni dpa' mchog dpon po dge 'dun gyi sbra yin/ /53

ri sdang gi sring mo klu skyid la bu ban de smig tho dang / blo gros/ bsam 'grub gsum dang / bu mo gar dros skyid skyes/ blo gros kyis bla rgan tshang nas dngos grub bu skal tu blangs nas de la bu snying dkar dang / bsod la/ku sdug bstan 'dzin bzhi dang / bu mo bsod 'ba' skyid skyes/ snying dkar 'jam skor la mag par song / bstan 'dzin stag skor la mag par song / bso las snying dkar gyi bu sras mchog bu skal du blangs nas khyim rgyud bskyangs/ bsam 'grub la bu mo tshe kho skyes par ya rig blo 'phel mag par bzhag de la bu yang kho dang / 'jam dbyangs gnyis skyes/ yang kho 'dzin bzung nas tshe las 'das/ 'jam dbyangs kyis khyim rgyud /de bskyangs/ /gar dros la mag pa 'bum ris bzhag nas bu mchog ldan dang bu mo 'phags ga skyes/ mchog ldan la bu rab rgyas dang / rgya mtsho gnyis dang bu mo a chog skyes/ 'phags ga la bu sman pa a bo dang / lo chos/ tshe dpal rgyal/ kun ldan rgyal sogs skyes/rta kho (rta har )la bu lha tho dang / gsang bdag stobs ldan/ bu mo bkra shis skyid bcas skyes/ /lha thor bu tshag ris dang / gza/ a rga nag gsum skyes/ ya rga nag la bu ma skyes/ tshag ris kyi bu tshe ba las rab kyis wa spas kyi khyim bzung /dpa' bos ya rga nag gi khyim bzung / dpa' bo la bu chos 'phel dang / bu mo smon lam skyid gnyis skyes/ de la bu tshe kho dang bu mo rdo rje gnyis yod/rdo rje la mag pa tshe ring thar bzhag tshag ris la bu gzi brjid/ mkhas lo/rta kho/ 'od rgyam/ bzang bo/ bsod lo rgyal/ ya lags 'dan/ che lo bcas bu bcu skyes pa la yang mi rgyud mang du 'phel bas/ dpon skor gyi nang nas dpa' mchog lha skor zhes pa'i ru skor che ba zhig byung zhing / lha tho bgres pa'i skabs su nged lha skor la bu tsha bo brgyad bcu yod ces ngoms so 54

byed par grags/ga ra bu med pas bskal bzang rgyal bu skal du blangs pa dang / de'i bu ni khri srong rgyal dang stag phrug rgyal gnyis yin/gsang bdag lo chung dus shi bar grags pa dang / kho'i bu rnams ni stag mig dang / ban de gyi log bun 'chang / tho ba bzhi yin/ /stag mig la bu mu rgyan dang / dbang chen thar/ gnam rtse/ bu mo gcig bcas skyes/ yu rgyan la bu dbang phyugs rgyal/ blo bzang chung ba gnyis dang / bu mo bsod nams skyid bcas skyes/ dbang chen thar mgar rtser mag par song ba phyir yong pa'i shul 'dzin ni ban de thar yin/ gnam rtse'i bu ni blo bzang che ba dang bsam 'phel gnyis yin/ /ban de gyi log gi bu ni gu grags dang / tshogs gnyis/ skal yas rgyal bcas yin/bun 'chang la bu ma skyes par rig 'dzin bu skal du blangs pa dang /rig 'dzin la chung ma blangs nas cang ma 'gor bar shi bas de'i shul nas ku sdug mag par bsdad/tho ba bla rgan tshang gi rig log gi bu a zhes tshang la mag par song pa dang /de la bu ma skyes pas skal yas rgyal bu skal tu blangs/ /bkra shis skyid la bu stag rgan dang bu mo sgrol ma skyes/ / stag rgan la bu dko lo (dko stug )dang ban ring gnyis skyes shing / dko lo'i bu ni phun tshogs nyi ma dang bang chen gnyis yin/ ban ring mtsho sngon por song /stobs ldan la bu gcig las med pa chung dus nas 'das/ de'i shul nya nag na yod/ ya ge'i tsha mo rgya bzar bag mar song pa de'i khyo bo 'das rjes phyir dpon skor nang yong / de la bu bsod grags dang blo bzang gnyis dang bu mo g.yang 'ba' yod/ bsod grags la bu gnyes yod/ blo bzang mag par song / g.yang 'ba' la bu sgrol skyabs skyes/ /55

dpa' mchog dpon po dge 'dun dang / chos lo/ tshul dbang bzhi la 'chang nyi'i cho lo yod pa dang / rta kho kha ra sogs la dpon skor rta kho rnam gsum zhes 'jon thang che tshul nas ming du grags yod/ yu sto dang /gnam byams/ pa lo/ gyi log sogs ni dpon skor gyi sde ba'i phyi nang gi don dag thag gcod byed mkhan gtso bo yin/ /(2) 'jamaskar/ /'jam skor ni mes po lha dge dang lu gu ban rgan gsum gyi rus rgyud 'phel bar grags la/ dang thog sngags 'chang chen po lha dges dpa' —mchog a che tshang gi ru skor de'i ru dpon gyi 'gan bzhes na'ang tsho ming ma thogs/ rjes su de'i bu bsod lag (bsod tho lag pa )gi ring la bsod skor zhes thogs/ de nas lha dge'i tsha mo zhig dpon skor sngags pa ral ba can la bo dod du byin yod pa der bu gsum byung ste/ dpa' mchog ya rgya lcags tho/ dpa' mchog grags pa gzur ru/ ban de rgyal (rte'u li )bcas yin/ bu tha zung ban de rgyal la bu 'jam me skyes pa'i ring la da gzod 'ja skor zhes tsho ming byung / /dpa' mchog gi gdong rgyud gcen gcung gsum gyi nang tshan tha chung tshogs gzungs kyi tsha bor lha dge dang / lu gu na rgan zhes pa'i spun gsum skyes/ lha dger bu bsod lag skyes shing / de'i bu ni skyabasakho dang snying tho lkung ma gnyis yin/ skyabs khor bu mkhas ring skyes shing / de'i ni bu ri rgya dang / ban ring / rig 'dzin gsum yin/ ri rgya'i bu ni stag lha yin la/ de la bu btsun thar sogs skyes/ ban ring la bu stag 'bum rgyal dang dpal mkhar gnyis skyes/ rig 'dzin la bu zhi thar dang bu mo tshe mo rgyal gnyis skyes/ snying tho skung ma'i bu ni ba ring yin la/ de la bu bon ne (pa pa )dang yag ga gnyis skyes/ bon ni la bu g.yang 'bum rgyal skyes shing de'i bu ni rgya kho yin/ yag ga la bu mo gcig las med/ /56

gong gsal lha dge'i tsha mo zhig zhes pa de ni lha dge spun gsum gyi sring mo 'brug skyid kyi bu mo bde skyid la bu a rgya lcags tho dang / grags pa bzur ru/ ban de rgyal bcas gsum skyes pa dang / da dung lha thung zhes pa'i bu skal zhig kyang blangs par bu gros chen bzhi zhes thogs/7rgya lcags tho la bu rgya tho dang snying rus gnyis skyes/ rgya tho la bu dpa' chen dang bu mo drug skyes pa ni/ snying mo yag dkar mo/ lha mtsho/rta mgrin skyid/ mkhar rgyal/ dgo lo bcas yin/ dpal chen la bu bstan 'dzin (grwa ba yin )dang / bu mo gar mo rgyal gnyis skyes/ gar mo rgyal la bu lcags thar rgyal dang / lcags byams/ stag lha sogs bu bu mo 'ga' skyes/ rgya tho'i bu mo rta mgrin sbyid la bu dge bzang dang bu mo gna' bo skyid gnyis skyes/ gna' bo skyid kyi bu ni rdo rje rgyal yin/ mkhar rgyal dang dgo lo gnyis sa gzhan du song / snying mo yag la bu zhing skyabs rgyal dang mkhar 'bum rgyal gnyis skyes la/ zhing skyabs rgyal la bu ban 'gro dang sngags zhas gser rdo sogs yod/ mkhar 'bum rgyal g.yer skyong la mag par song / gar mo yag la bu klu 'bum rgyal skyes pa dang / klu 'bum rgyal la bu stag 'bum rgyal dang me 'bum rgyal sogs skyes/ lha mtsho la bu kho lo skyes shing / kho lo la bu ston pa skyes/ snyeng rus la bu mo gnyis skyes pa'i che ba'i bu dkon mchog zung ba'i mag par gsang lo bzhag nas bu mo drug skyes pa'i che ba 'od zer la bu ḍa ke thar dang / bu mo mtsho skyid rgyal/ lo lo/klu skyid sogs yod/ lo lo'i skyes pa rin chen rgyal yin la/ dkon mchog gi bu mo 'bring ba kur rgyal la bu ye shes dang 'brug 'bum rgyal gnyis skyes la/ye shes la bu g.yang brtan rgyal dang phur ba/ bu mo 'ga' bcas skyes/'brug 'bum rgyal gyi bu ni 'jigs med rig 'dzin dang kun bzang skyabs gnyis yin/ dkon mchog gi bu mo chung ba la bu mo chos rgya skyes pa'i mag par tshe rdor bzhag de la bu dge 'dun sgal ba dang tshag ris rgyal gnyis 57

skyes/ dge 'dun gyi bu ni khro rgyal 'bum yin la de la bu mkha' 'gro thar dang bu mo pad+ma mtsho gnyis skyes/ tshag ris rgyal la bu yum skyabs dang / blo bzang / bzod pa gsum dang bu mo dgo mo thar skyes/grags pa gzur ru la bu gnam ring skyes shing / de'i bu ni rab brtan yin/ rab brtan la bu thar dros dang / 'jigs byed/ bsod nams bcas skyes/ thar dros la bu rta rgya dang / dbang grags/ bu mo g.yu rgya dang / g.yang skyid gnyis skyes/ rta rgya'i bu ni khyi rdo yin la de'i bu ni ke kho yin/ dbang grags la bu kun rgyal skyes/ rab brtan gyi bu mo'i bu ni dbang chen ser la yin/ bsod nams kyi bu dod tshogs thar dang / de la bu chos 'bum rgyal skyes/ /ban de rgyal la bu 'jam me skyes shing / de la bu bstan kho dang /bstan dar/ jo rus/ lha chen bzhi dang bu mo yang 'brug mo sogs bzhi skyes/ bstan kho la bu dge 'dun dang nam mkha' gnyis skyes la/ bstan dar la bu rta ris dang bshad sgrub gnyis skyes/ rta ris la bu blo bstan dang bu mo dbang chen skyid sogs bzhi skyes/ blo bstan gyi bu ni blo bzang lhun grub rdo rje dang 'bum me gnyis yin/ bu mo gsum gnas la song / bu mo dbang chen skyid la mag pa snying dkar bzhag nas bu bkra shis don thub sogs skyes/bshad sgrub la bu thu po dang zhing thar gnyis dang bu mo gsum skyes/ jo rus la bu tshe bo rgyal dang / dbang phyug gnyis dang bu mo bzhi skyes/ tshe bo rgyal shar tshang la mag par song / dbang phyug la bu ban de rgyal dang / a khang /ka dros rgyal/ kun ne sogs dang bu mo gcig skyes/ lha chen rwa rgya chu bar mag par song / 'jam me'i bu mo che ba'i mag par g.yu skyong lha rong bzhag la/ de'i bu ni snying nge dang gnam lha gnyis yin/ snying nge'i bu dpal rgyas yin/ de'i bu mo jo mo dang / jo mor kun ni sogs skyes/ 'jam me'i bu mo 'bring ba'i skyes pa ser 'gog tshe ris yin la/ de la bu rgya mtsho dang /58

chos skyong / dge legs bcas skyes/ rgya mtsho'i tsha mo khro thar rgyal la mag pa ba yan bzhag de la bu u lo dang bu mo phyug mo rgyal gnyis skyes/ gnam lha la bu gsang bdag dang / 'bum rtse/ chos sgrub gsum skyes/ gsang bdag gi tsha mo bo tho yin la/ de'i bu dod tshe kho dang bu mo sgrol ma rgyal yin/'bum rtse'i bu mo snyi rdo yin la der bu mang byung / /ma 'jig shā/ lce dī/ ༷ dī dīdī /ṭ+wāṃ~X skyel ༵ tho/'i bye rdo dī// / sna r+shaX didro //khyi mo thar/ dar rgyas(a zar)bcas yin/ 'phags pa skyabs la bu bsod tshe skyes shing / de'i bu mo bkra shis mtsho'i mag par 'jigs med bzhag nas bu u rgyan skyabs dang khyi mo thar sogs skyes/ khyi mo thar la bu tho rgya skyes shing / de la bu ban de dang / lha skyabs/ dpa' rdor gsum skyes/ban del bu tsa rdo skyes/ lha skyabs la bu mo 'ga' las ma byung / dpa' rdor la bu rgya pe dang / stag lha mgon/ 'brug rtse rgyal sogs dang bu mo ba'i skyes/dar rgyas la bu dbang chen dang / dam pa gnyis dang bu mo drug skyes/dbang chen la bu bdud 'dul dang bu mo gnyis skyes/ dam pa'i bu chung dus nas 'das la/ bu mo gnyis skyes pa'i che ba sgro rdo la mag pa thogs med bzhagam 'jigs la bu skya tho ma skyes shing / de la bu bla ma dang rta mgrin gnyis dang bu mo gcig skyes/ rta mgrin la bu tshe dbang skyes/ de la bu ting 'dzin dang klu 'bum rgyal sogs skyes pa dang / bla ma la bu 'ja' rgyam dang bu mo lha sgron skyes shing / 'ja' rgyam la bu skya kho dang bu mo 'ga' skyes/ skya tho ma yi sring mor a lags gcod lo mag par bzhag nas bu bsod tshe sngo cha dang gnam kho gnyis dang bu mo dpa' mo sogs skyes/ gnam kho la bu g.yang myug rgyal dang /bdud 'dul gnyis skyes/ dpa' mo la bu mo 'phags bzang dang / bsod nams mtsho skyes shing / bsod nams mtsho la bu dbang phyug dang bu mo 'ga' skyes/ byams pa la shul rgyud cher ma byung /59

'phags pa skyabs spun gsum gyisring mo che ba la bu bsod po dang / tshe mgon/ mkha' ro gsum dang bu mu tsho sogs skyes/ bsod po la bu snying thar dang bu mo gcig skyes/ snying thar la bu me rdo sogs skyes/ tshe mgon dang mkha' do gnyis mag par song / bu mo che ba mu tsho la bu skal bzang rgyal skyes shing / de la bu yo'u rgya sprul sku blo bzang 'jam dpal rgya mtsho dang /ma cig rgyal/ stag thar rgyal sogs skyes/ bu mo 'bring ba cog lo'i bu mo la mag pa bstan 'dzin bzhag par bu mang skyes/ ma 'jigs bu mor bu ya rga skyes shing / de la bu bla ma skyabs dang bu mo pad+ma mtsho sogs gsum skyes/pad+ma mtsho la bu ngag dbang dang lo rdo skyes/ yang ma 'jigs kyi bu mo zhig la bu lo stug skyes la/ lo stug gi bu bsod dar yin zhing / der bu phyag rdor dang rgya phrug gnyis skyes/ phyag rdor la bu pad+ma rig grol skyes shing / rig grol bu dpa' pe yin/ rgya phrug la bu 'jigs pe dang / da pe/ bdud pe sogs yod/ lo stug sring mo'i bu kho'u li yin pa dang / de'i bu byug lo/phyug lo'i bu ni tshul dbang rgyal yin/ de la bu stobs ldan dang / gu rdo/rgya sko gsum skyes/'jam me'i bu dod lha thung gi bu ni garma suta yin pa dang de'i bu mo sgo lo'i bu mo g.yang skyid la mag pa tshe me bzhag nas bu gcod pa rgyal skyes/ lha thung gi bu mor bu nor bzhon zhes pa skyes shing / de'i bu 'brug lha (rgya rgya )la bu rdo yes dang / tshul khrims ('a kho)/ bu mo lo'u mo gsum skyes/ lo'u mo'i bu dge legs dang sngags phrug gnyis yin pa dang / bu mo dbang mo thar skyes/ dge legs mag par song la/ sngags phrug gi bu ni mi 'gyur yin/ /ban rgan la bu bstan bzang dang / dkon mchog zhing lo/'ba' kho sogs skyes/ bstan bzang la bu gser 'bum rgyal dang / bsam 'grub/ sgrol ma/ tshe ring byug bcas skyes/ gser 'bum rgyal la bu rnam rgyal skyes/ bsam 'grub la bu sgrol ma skyabs sogs skyes/ dkon mchog gi 60

bu mo gser mo rgyal la bu sgo 'ba' skyes/ zhing lo la bu grags pa ('ing dge )dang / mkhyen rab/ blo sher/ bya 'ba' bcas bzhi skyes/ grags pa'i bu lcags ko rgyal yin la/ blo sher la bu bsod nams tshe ring skyes/ /lcags tho'i tsha mo zhig la pad+ma rgyal mag par bzhag nas bu gzungs nge skyes/ gzungs nge la bu tshe ring rgyal dang don grub rgyal gnyis dang bu mo kun skyid skyes/ kun skyid mkhas ring gi chung mar byin/ tshe ring rgyal la bu bsod po sogs skyes pa gong du lu gu tshang nas bstan zin/ don grub rgyal gyi bu mo gsum las 'byung ba 'brug rgyal la bu chos lo skyes/ chos lo la bu rdo rje rgyal sogs skyes/ pad+ma rgyal gyi mag pa la snying rtse zer/ snying rtse la bu mo ma ma dang 'ba' kho gnyis yod/ ma ma'i mag par stag lha bzhag ste bu yi dam skyabs dang / 'od zer/ bsod rgyam/ 'phags pa sogs skyes/'phags pa'i bu ni lha mgon dang / ngag dbang mkhyen rab yin/ 'ba' kho la bu gu ru rgyal dang / 'jam dbyangs/ sring lo/ no'u kho bcas skyes/gu ru rgyal la bu dbang chen dang / mgon po skyabs/ ngag bzang / sras mchog rgyal mtshan bcas skyes/ dbang chen la mdo skyabs skyes pa dang /mgon po skyabs la bu las dbang skyes/ no'u kho la dbu lo dang chur rdo gnyis skyes/ yi dam skyabs kyi bu ni skal yas rgyal yin/ 'phags pa'i bu mo 'bring pa la bu 'jigs ge skyes shing / de'i bu ni 'od ldan dang bu dod ri rdo yin/snying tho'i sring mo che ba la bu a khu sha nye skyes/ de la bu rig lo dang /klu 'bum/ bzang bo gsum skyes/ rig lo la bu bstan 'dzin dang blo gros gnyis skyes/ klu 'bum la bu ma cig rgyal dang blo bzang gnyis skyes pa dang /ma cig rgyal la bu phyug 'bum skyes pa dang / blo bzang la bu ka rdo skyes/ ya khu sha nye'i tsha mo zhig gi mag pa mgon tho yin/ de la bu phyag rdor skyes shing /phyag rdor gyi bu ni stag lha thar sogs yin/61

lha dge'i tsha mo zhig gi mag pa shing lha yin/ de la bu 'brug byams dang / dkon tshe gnyis skyes/ dkon tshe la bu mo gsum yod/ bu mo 'bring ba lcags rdo'i mag pa stag 'bum yin/gong du song pa'i lha dge lu gu ban rgan gsum gyi nang tshan lu gu la kha cig gis sog po'i lu gu lce nag zer la/ der bstun nas lu gu ni sog po red zer mkhan yang yod/ don dngos ni dang thog lu gu sog po'i dud tshang zhig la bu dod du byin/ sog po'i dud tshang de sri can yin pa la/ sngags 'chang chen po lha dges sri gnon brgyab ste shi 'phro bcad pa'i yon du 'bul ba ji tsam dgos na de tsam ster byas pas/ lha dges nga la yon gzhan ci yang ster mi dgos/ nga yi nu bo bu dod du byin pa phyir sprad na de yis chog zhes phyir blangs pas na lu gu sog po min par nges so/ /(lu gu lce nag zhes pa ni gtam kha lce rno ba'i stabs yin)/ lu gu'i bu dung dkar gyi ring la dung skor zhes pa'i ru skor zhig yod kyang tsho bar 'gyur ma thub/ de la bu gsum byung ba'i lo tho'i ming la sbyar nas pha dung lo tshang zer/yang so nag ban de rgyal rte'u li zer srol yod pa na/ 'ga' res kho so nag gi mi zhig red bsams mod/ don dngos su kho'i ma yum lha dge'i tsha mo la so nag nas mag pa zhig bzhag nas bu gsum skyes pa der so nag byi li cha bo zer ba las/ ru so na nas 'ong ba'am chad pa gtan nas ma yin la/ de'i bu mi dbang chen po dpa' mchog 'jam me skyes ring nas 'jam skor zhes tsho ming thogs so/ /( )stagaskar/ /de yang reb gong ko'u sde'i dpa' bo rgya mtsho'i bu che ba bsod lo'i gdung rgyud dgon gong ma tsho rteng bzhi'i ya gyal lam dpa' mchog gi pha ngo stag skor tsho ba'i lo rgyus rags tsam brjod pa la/ /dang po/ tsho ming thogs tshul dang tsho 'go skyong mi/ /62

dgon gong ma reb gong ko'u sde nas rma klong ring mo'i lho phyogs su gnas spor te sa 'dzin gyi gzhi thog mar chags skabs gnyen nye'i 'azel lam nam yang dpang du bya ba yod pa'i phyir tu/ dpa' mchog la spyi chos gser 'od gleg bam gcig yod pa khag gnyis su bgos te/ ko'u sde 'brog gi dpa' mchog ya che tshang gi shul da lta'i dbang grags rgyal tshang du stod cha dang /dgon gong ma'i dpa' mchog stag skor gyi ya gye ban theg (da lta'i de'u dkar sde ba'i rgya mtsho'i spu yin )gis smad cha khyer 'ongs nas tsho skor 'di'i 'go bcings/ a gye ban zeg ni dpa' snying che la/ khyad par tu rang sde'i la rgya'i don du rang srog la mi blta ba zhig yin/ dper na thengs shig la bud med cig gis gnas ngan bltas pa'i spyod don la pha rol sde ba nas kha ya ma byas pa la khag bzhag nas/ la lo ded pa dang spyod rtsa'i bud med kyang btsan gyis bzung nas yong / khos la lo 'ded skabs phyir spyod sde la/ nga ban theg thag ring stod nas yong/ / spyod sna nag da thengs mi 'grig na/ /gyi mgo nag btsan gyis 'phrog rgyu yin/ / kyi dgos na dpa' mchog sde bar shog/ nga dpa' mchog dpa' thog kher skyes yin/ / dpa' lo re bsdad na je skye yin/ / zhes skad bzhag pa da lta'i rgan po'i ngag rgyun na yod/ /ban theg gi rjes nas kho'i nu bo a kye tshogs pa la dpa' mchog seng chen skyes rjes tshogs skor zhes pa'i tsho ming thogs/ dpa' mchog tshogs pa ni ngang rgyud 'jam la gshis ka drang pa/ kun la phyogs ris med cing gnyen nye byams pas skyong pa zhig yin/ kho'i bu che ba skal bzang rgyal nag ra'am dpa' mchog meng chen ni kun gyis bshad rgyun du gling gi dpa' brtul gyi skye mtha' yin zer/ kho lo bcu gsum lon pa'i skabs/ jag pa skor zhig gis la lo 'ded bzhin pa ri kha nas mthong 'phrad/ lag tu mdung thung zhig bzung nas som nyi med par jag pa'i mdun bkag ste dmar 'dzing byas mthar/ la lo phyir 'phrog par ma zad jag pa gcig bsad pa dang gnyis la 63

rmas rdzid mo phog tu bcug de nas bzung dpa' mchog seng chen zhes pa'i snyan grags 'bar/de rjes dpa' mchog seng chen gyi gcung bsod nams rgyal gyi bu che ba tshag we skyes nas tshag skor thogs/ dpa' mchog tshag we ni chos dad che zhing /mtho dman kun la gcig tu blta ba/ khyad par tu dbul bo dang sprang bo rnams la lho gos nor gsum gang thad nas sbyin pa gtong ba dang rogs skyor la dga' ba zhig yin/ kho ni khyim pa yin yang lhan skyes kyi mngon mkhyen dang grub rtags 'ga' re yang yod par grags/de rjes dpa' ma chog tshag we'i bu che ba stag lha skyes ring la stag skor zhes pa'i tsho ming thogs pa da lta'i bar ma 'gyur bar yod/ dpa' mchog stag lha ni 'thab na snying dang dpa' rtsal che la/ bshad na gtam dang kha lce yod pa/daphyad na blo dang rig pa no ba/ blo brtan la gzhung drang pa/ sngar bshad tshig gi phugs zub pas 'bangs mi sde kun gyis gong bkur byed pa zhig yin/gnyis pa/ rus rgyud kyi 'phel tshul/dpa' mchog rgya mtsho'i bu che ba bsod lor bu ya gyes ban theg dang /tshogs pa/ klu 'bum rgyal g.yag 'dug dang bu mo zhig dang bcas bzhi skyes/a gyes ban theg la bu dpal chen dang dbang tho gnyis skyes/ dpal chen gyi bu pa mas/ de'i bu sto yas yin/ dbang tho la bu ma kho dang chos 'byor gnyis dang bu mo rin mo gsum skyes/ ma kho'i bu lha skyabs rgyal yin/ chos 'byor gyi bu ni lo chos yin/ rin mo'i bu mo'i bu rgya mtsho yin la/ da lta'i rgya mtsho'i sbra ni a gyes ban theg gi sbra yin/ /a byus tshogs pa la bu skal bzang rgyal nag ra'am dpa' mchog seng chen dang / bsod nams rgyal/ g.yang 'bum mgo ser/ bu mo klu mo sogs bzhi skyes/ skal bzang rgyal la bu mo zhig las ma skyes pas g.yu skyong chos ba rin po che'i sku spun blo gas mag par bzhag de la bu dar mig dang 6

dbang phyug bya gdong sogs lnga skyes pa'i nang gi gsum gser lag dgon pa mā jag gis rgyag dus bsad/ dar mig la bu dpal mgon rgyal dang zhi thar gnyis skyes/ dpal mgon rgyal la bu lo po dang / ba log rnam thar gsum skyes/ zhi thar gle bar mag par song / dbang phyug bya gdong hor ra tshang la mag par song ste rjes su ra dbang phyug ces sde 'go 'dzin mkhan zhig tu gyur/ /seng chen gyi gcung bsod nams rgyal la bu tshag we dang snying kha 'bum/gcod pa/ bu mo kha su ma bcas bzhi skyes/ tshag we la bu stag lha dang /zla ba gdong nag kho/ sri pas bzhi dang / bu mo gnyis skyes/ stag lha'i bu rta grags rab tu byung bas bu skal tu mkhas lo blangs nas khyim bskyangs/mkhas lor bu mo bkra shis skyid sogs gsum skyes/ bkra shis skyid la stag yan don 'grub rgyal mag par bzhag ste bu rta rdo dang/ li thar/ stag ka gsum skyes/ zla ba gdong nag la bu med/ bu mo tshe yag rgyal mtha' bar gnas la song / rta khor shul ma thog pas stag sher bu rgyal bo thar bu skal tu blangs/ de la'ang shul ma thog pas sangs rgyas bu skal tu blangs/ sri pas la bu dar rgyas dang a grags gnyis skyes/ dar rgyas bla rgan tshang la mag par song / a grags la bu sbyin pa dang no rgya gnyis dang bu mo ba tho gsum skyes/sbyin pa la bu 'phags rdo sogs bdun yod/ no rgya'i bu thugs rje yin/tshag we'i bu mo yul bsdad kyi bu rab rgyas dang de'i bu ni chos 'dzin dang sgo lo gnyis yin/ /tshag we'i gcung snying kha 'bum la bu lha rgyal skyes/ lha rgyal gser lag mā jag gis rgyag dus bsad/ lha rgyal gyi bu ni rta lo dang / btsun thar/blo bstan rgyal/ sdang ting 'dzin bcas yin/ rta lo ni dpa' snying che la gtam dang kha lce bde ba/ gzhung bzang la blo rig rgod cing / 'phong rkyen la'ang mkhas pas stag skor rta lo ces kun gyis gdengs 'jog byed pa zhig 65

yin/ kho la bu mgon lha dang bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho/ sangs rgyas/ bu mo 'bum mtsho skyid dang jo thar sogs skyes/ mgon lhar bu chos dbyings sogs gsum skyes/ btsun thar la bu lha 'bum rgyal skyes/ lha 'bum rgyal la bu ku gyes sogs gsum skyes/ ting 'dzin la shul ma thogs/tshag we'i gcung gcod par dpa' ris dang dbang chen kha dmar/'ba' de'u dpal 'byor bcas skyes/ phun tshogs dang dpal 'byor gnyis rab tu byung / dpa' ris la bu mgon rgyal dang / 'od zer/ ri bho/dkon rgyam/ bu mo ka ka sogs skyes/ ka ga'i bu sgol ma 'bum yin/dbang chen gyi bu dkon mchog dang 'phags rdo/ sangs rgyas/ ku rdo/don thub rgyal/ bu mo sgro ris sogs yin/ 'ba' de'u bu byams pa dang lo ris gnyis yin/ bsod nams rgyal kyi bu mo kha su ma la bu dbang chen 'bum skyes/ de la bu snying lo dang / don grub/ tshe snyo rgyal/ bu mo u skyid sogs skyes/ snyeng lo'i bu dbu lo yin/ don grub kyis lo lo skyid bo dod du blangs nas de la mag pa nyi ma tshe ring bzhag tshe sto rgyal la bu ma cig rgyal dang mgonapo gnyis skyes/ u skyid la bu mo lcags rdo skyes/ der mag pa lha 'bum rgyal bzhag/seng chen gyi gcung g.yang 'bum mgo ser gyi bu stag sher yin/ des glo'u dme rka nas chung ma zhig bsus pa'i bu chos dar dang / chos 'dzin/dpal ldan/ rgyal bo thar/ dpa' 'bum rgyal/ sgom pa/ skar ma rig 'dzin bcas yin/ dpal ldan gyis 'phags rdo bu skal du blangs/ rgyal bo thar rta khor bu skal du byin/ dpa' 'bum rgyal la shul ma thog sgo 'ba' la bu ka bo log dang / bu mo kur mo yag 'dzoms skyid rgyal bcas skyes/ka bo log gle bar mag par song / 'dzoms skyid rgyal gyi mag par ska yes bzhag ska mas kyi sbra ni stag sher sbra yin/ skar ma rig 'dzin dog tha'i dar lo'i bu skal du byin/ de'i bu g.yang mkhar rgyal yin/ /66

seng chen gyi sring mo klu mor gdong zhing 'brug lo (mgar ba )mag par bzhag nas bu lha chen skyes/ de la bu dar rgyas dang / gcod pa rgyal/'od zer/ snying la bcas dang / bu mo 'dzoms skyid dang / klu skyid bcas skyes/ dar rgyas rab tu byung / gcod pa rgyal la ja rgya'i bu mo lo lo chung mar blangs nas bu dbu lo dang / chos lo/ bstan 'dzin/ bu mo tshe sgron dang / phyug mo rgyal/ bstan ma/ snying mtsho sogs skyes/ 'od zer la shul ma thogs/ snying lar bu mo klu yag dang / chos skyid rgyal gnyis skyes/tshe sgron gyis tshul lo bu skal du blangs/ 'dzoms skyid glo'u tshang la bag mar song / /gcod pa rgyal gyi bu dbu lor bu mo phag mo dang / dpa' skyid rgyal/tshe ring skyid / mtsho mo bcas bzhi skyes/ phag mor bshad sgrub mag par bzhag nas bu dge bzang sogs ming sring gsum skyes/ dpa' skyid rgyal la bu tang zin skyes/ tshe ring skyid nywa nag la song / mtsho mo mgon lha'i bo dod du byin/ /gcod pa rgyal gyi bu chos lo la bu bstan dar dang / yum skyabs/chos dbyings rgyal/ pad+ma klong yangs/ dpal chen/ yang sangs sogs skyes/ yum skyabs 'jam skor la mag par song / dpal chen dpon skor la mag par song / yang sangs nywa nag la mag par song / /gcod pa rgyal gyi bu bstan 'dzin 'jam skor la mag par song / bu mo tshe sgron mo'u rgya sgar bar gnas la song / bu mo phyug mo rgyal bla rgan tshang gi 'jigs med kyi mna' ma byas rte bu mgon po dang bskal bzang sogs ming sring bzhi skyes/ /gdong zhing 'brug lo nas brgyud pa'i mi rgyud la stag skor mgar ba tshang zhes ru skor cung che ba zhig chags/ /dpa' mchog tshogs pa'i gcung klu 'bum rgyal ni gshis rgyud drang la 67

dpa' snying che yang dgra 'tsho mi shes pas ya gyes g.yag 'dug kyang zer/ kho la bu dge man dang / no'u rgan/ lcags byams gsum skyes/ dge rgan la bu bsod gdong dang bu mo sgron skyid sogs bu mo bzhi skyes/ bsod gdong la bu nam mkha' ske ring dang bu mo skyid po gnyis skyes/ nam mkha' sko ring ni gtam la mkhas shing kha lce bde ba zhig yin de la bu don grub tshe ring dang / bu mo 'bum mtsho skyid/ bo chog skyid gsum skyes/ don 'thub tshe ring la bu dbang chen skyabs dang / blo dar (grwa ba)/ phun tshogs rgya mtsho/(grwa ba) mkhas btsun bcas dang bu mo gsum skyes/ dbang chen skyabs la bu theg ma chog dang / tshe ring thar/ gdugs dkar/ chos grags/thabs mkhas bcas bu bu mo drug skyes/ mkhas btsun la bu bla ma rgyal skyes/'bum mtsho skyid kho nag la gnas la song / bo chog skyid la blo gsal gyi bu kun ris mag par bzhag nas bu mo g.yang mtsho rgyal dang / 'phags gagar mo rgyal/ snying mo/ tshe dbang skyid dang lnga skyes/ bo chog skyid kyi skyes pa kun ris mā jag gis bsad stabs/ bad kho nas tshe ring rgyal mag par bzhag nas bu yum chen skyes/ yum chen la bu thub pa rgyal dang / pad+ma/bsam 'phel bcas skyes/ snying mo la mag pa btsun thar bzhag nas bu dpa' rdo dang / yi bo rgyal/ a ga bu mo g.yu sgron bcas skyes/nam mkha'i sring mo sbyid po la bu yo rgyan dang / rdo rje/ nor dros/bu mo sgrol ma/ dbang mo rgyal bcas lnga skyes/ yo rgyan gyis sring mo sgrol ma'i bu no'u ba bu skal du blangs/ rdo rje la bu nyi mdzad dang / tshe mgon/ yi dam skyabs/ lha rdo/ tshe byams thar bcas dang / bu mo gser mo rgyal dang bkra shis skyid bcas ming sring bdun skyes/ nor dros la bu bsam gtan dang / skya lu/ bu mo tshe sgron dang 'brug kho bcas ming sring bzhi skyes/bu mo sgrol mas no'u ba yul du bzhag rjes tshe brtan tshang la mna' mar song ste bu g.yang skyabs rgyal dang/ stag phrug nyi ma/ thub bstan/ bu mo skya tho 68

ma bcas skyes/ bu mo dbang mo rgyal ru ngan la bo dod du byin/ nyi mdzad kyi bu dpa' chen rgyal yin pha shi rjes rang yul rgya bza' rong skor la song / tshe byams thar la bu bu mo bdun yod/ bu mo gser kho ྅ nag sog skor la gnas la song ste phyir yong rjes bu mo jo rdo dang / dpa' yag skyid/ mtsho mo sogs gsum skyes/ bu mo bkra shis skyid la bu ku rdo skyes/ tshe sgron la bu rdo thar sogs bu bu mo bzhi skyes/ no'u ba la bu nor rdo dang / btsan byug sogs bu bu mo lnga skyes/ thub bstan la bu mo gnam skyid sogs gsum — yod/ /dge rgan gyi gcung no'u rgan la bu zla bzang skyes/ de la bu sngags 'chang chen po pad+ma dbang grags (dpon a tho )dang / mgon po rgyu gar/mkhar dros dwa gshangs gsum skyes/ dpon ya tho ni mthu nus ldan zhing rgyun du mkha' 'gro'i brda yig mngon sum du 'bab pa zhig yin zer/ khong nyid rwa rgya dgon pas dpon du brten nas rgyun du mo lung dang bca' ba rim gro zhu/ma tho'i bu ni blo gros dang / mkhyen rab kha sred/ lhun thub/ 'jam dbyangs gsur khug bdud 'dul bcas yin/ blo gros kyi bu ni skal bzang rgya mtsho yin/ lhun 'grub gyi bu mo tshe rdor la mag pa mthu lo bzhag nas bu blo bzang skyes/ 'jam dbyangs kyi bu ni lha mgon dang lha mchog gnyis yin/ lha mgon gyi bu ni gsang sngags dang / ban thar/ pad 'byung gsum yin/ lha mchog gi bu ni gu drag dang / dge 'dun rgya mtsho gnyis yin/ /dpon a tho'i spun mgon po rgyu gar la bu ma skyes pas pad+ma rgyal (bu khur )gyi bu kun bzang gyo ma bu skal du blangs/ der mo'u rgya sgar ba nas bud med cig blangs pa'i bu lha 'ba' nag ril dang rab po gnyis yin/ lha 'ba' btsan mor mag par song nas bu mgon po dang bu mo gnyis skyes/rab po kha rgyar mag par song nas bu bsam me dang tshe rgyal sogs skyes/ kun 69

bzang gyo mas rjes su yang / bla rgan tshang nas bo 'ba' mna' mar bsus nas bu rta ro'u dang / bu mo gnam mtsho skyid dang bo po skyes/ gnam mtsho skyid la bu rig rdo dang bu mo ga ma gnyis yod/ bo po la mag pa tshe lu 'ba' bzhag nas bu dpal ldan sbyin pa skyes/ /dpon mtho'i gcung mkhar dros dwa gshangs g.yu skyong pa lo tshang nas mag par bsdad de bu yum rgyal dang gcod dros gnyis skyes/ de nas chung ma 'das pas phyir rang yul la yong nas bla rgan tshang nas lab sgron chung mar blangs par bu rin chen dpal dang bstan 'dzin/ 'jam dbyangs gsum dang bu mo bde lo skyes/ gcod dros la bu chos thar dang / rgya mtsho/gnam thar rgyal dang bu mo gsum skyes/ rin chen dpal gyis 'jam dpal bu skal du blangs/ 'jam dbyangs ni gser lag dgon pa'i rgya bza' sku phreng gsum par nges bzung ste 'jam dbyangs dge 'dun phun tshogs rgya mtsho zhes mtshan gsol zhing khri sar bkod/ rjes su thar shul dgon rnam dag khrims ldan gling du phebs nas yongs 'dzin rin po che blo bzang mkhas grub rgya mtsho sogs bshes gnyen du ma'i mdun du slob gnyer mdzad/ khong sku na phra dus nas shes sgrib kyi dri mas ma gos pa'i gang zag khyad par can yin stabs shes bya kun bslab pa tsam gyis tshegs med du mkhyen la/ khyad par rnam mkhyen gyi go 'phang lhan skyes su mnga' ba zhig yin/ dper na/ khong nyid sku na phra dus thengs shig la bya khog dbang 'ba' zhes pa zhig jag 'thab khrod na4mas ljid mo phog ste dran med du brgyal song bar 'gro rogs tshos kho shi song bsam nas ro shun bshus te phyir yong / g.yang 'ba' tshang gis skad ngan de thos ma thag bla grwa zhus nas gshin chos sgrub/ rgya bza' sgrul sku tshang yang gshin po'i shog bsregs bla mar gdan drangs nas 'bul bar rto g.yag chung ba zhig phul/ khong gis smon lam gsung mtshams su thugs—bsam cung gnang ste/ ngas da thengs 'das por shog bsregs mi byed/70

'bul ba'ang mi dgos/ khyed tshang gis nyin bdun la tsha gsur ma 'chad par phud dang go rgyu zhig ye 'dug snyam/ 'das po'i chung mas kyang 'dun ma byas na chog ces gsungs nas phebs grabs byas par/ gshin chos 'don pa'i grwa ba 'gas de thos 'phrad gad mo dgod bzhin/ da res gshin po 'di'i sngas mgo'i bla mar sa 'dir skad grags yod pa'i bla ma dag phebs nas gshin po'i spar chog kyang sgrub tshar/ bla ma de dag gis ma mkhyen pa btsun chung 'disamakhyen song zer nas zur za byas/ nyin 'ga' 'gor rjes bya khog dbang 'ba' dngos su ma shi gson por yod pa'i skad cha thos byung / de nas bzung rgya bza' sgrul sku zhes pa'i mtshan snyan sa phyogs kun tu khyab/khong gi sku tshe hril bor 'di 'dra'i grub rtags bstan tshul mang po yod kyang 'dir ma spyos/ khong gi tshe smad du rang sa'i gser lag dgon pa'i chos sgo phye skabs gtso 'gan bzhes nas dgon pa'i bya ba thams cad la thugs gnyer gnang / 1982lor khong gis dgon pa'i do dam u yon lhan khang gi gtso 'gan bzhes te bla grwa gzhan dang mnyam du dgon pa slar gso dang / lha rten bskyar bzhengs/ rgyun 'don nyams gso sogs kyi thad la brtson pa chu bo'i rgyun bzhin bsten/ lcags spul lor khong gis dad ldan mer skya mang po khrid de lha sar phebs shing / khong sku dngos kyis yi dam spyan 'dren mdzad de rta mgrin yang gsang gi sku byin rlabs can gdan drangs pa dang / se ra dgon pa'i mang 'gyed kyi rgyun sogs rten mang po 'du khang du bzhag lha sa nas phyir phebs rjes grwa ba rgan pa sum cu lhag khrid de bla brang dgon par phebs nas dge slong gi sdom rgyun mthud pa dang / dgon pa'i rgyun 'don dang dbang lung sogs kyi thad nas chad pa mthud cing nyams pa gsos te bka' drin bla med bskyangs/ /dge rgan gyi gcung lcags byams (lcags zhar )la bu ja rgya dang klu ris gnyis skyes/ phu bo dge rgan gyi bu mo sgron skyid yang bo dod du gsos/ ja rgya 71

la bu chos skyong dang / dko rgya/ dbang ras/ zhang ris bcas dang bu mo lo lo skyes/ chos skyong gi bu ni mchog gsum dang / ba pu rgyal/ skal pu ces gsum yin la/ ja rgya'i shul 'dzin ni skal pu ces yin/ dbang ris kyis bu skal la tshe bo rgyal dang / chos sgron gnyis blangs shing / chos sgron la bstan 'dzin mag par bzhag nas shul 'dzin byas yod/ dko rgya'i bu skal ni dpal chen rdo rje yin pa dang / des rgya 'ba' bu skal du blangs/ mchog gsum gyi bu ni lha rgyas rgyal dang tshe 'phel rgyal gnyis yin/ /ja rgya'i gcung klu ris kyi bu ni dbang chen cha kho yin/ klu ris ni chos phyogs la gtong phod che ba'i rgyu nor longs spyod can zhig yin/ khos sbyin bdag byas nas reb gong rong bo dgon chen gyi gos sku chen mo gsar bzhengs byas shing / thengs mang por dgon pa so sor dkar po lug la gcod 'ded dang nag mo nor la gdangs 'ded byas te dge rtsa sgrub pas/ dpa' mchog klu ris kyi dkar po chos kyi gtong phod ces kun gyis kha dpe byed pa zhig yin/ /bsod gdong gi sring mo sgron skyid lcags zhar gyis bo dod du blangs/de la ྅ nag sog skor nas pad+ma rgyal mag par bzhag nas bu gnam skyabs 'ba' sdang dang / kun bzang gyo ma/ rnal 'byor ba blo bzang sbyin pa/bsam 'phel sogs skyes/ de'i nang gi bsam 'phel spun gnyis gser lag dgon par mā jag gis rgyag skabs bsad/ gnam skyabs la bu 'jam dbyangs dang bu mo jo kho gnyis skyes/ 'jam dbyangs la bu g.yang 'bum rgyal dang tshe dbang rgyal/ bu mo ka ka dang mtsho lo sogs skyes/ jo kho stag skor rta lo'i chun ma byas te bu ka dros rgyal skyes/ de la bu mkhar byams rgyal dang gu drag gnyis dang bu mo gnyis bcas ming sring bzhi skyes/ kun bzang ni mgon po rgyu gar la bu skal du byin/ rnal 'byor ba blo bzang sbyin pa ni ya skyo ba byas te kho rang kher rkyang du rgya gar rdo rje gdan dang / bal bo'i mchod 72

rten bya rung kha shor sogs gnas chen du mar mjal skor lachos la bskyal ba zhig yin/ /dpa' mchog tshogs pa'i sring mo yul bsdad cig la reb gong rgyal bo ri drug sgang nas dpal rgyal zer ba'i mag pa zhig bzhag der bu tho mon dang /tshe ring ban phrug gnyis bcas skyes/ tho mon bu ri kho dang / klu 'bum gnyis yin/ ri kho'i bu nor kho (nor ring )yin/ de'i bu 'jam dpal rgyal dang / mkhas lo/ sbyin ring / bu mo dar yag bcas yin/'jam dpal rgyal gyi bu gdugs dkar yin/ mkhas lo stag lhar bu skal du byin/ klu 'bum gyi bu ka rdo yin/ de'i bu rnams ni phyag rdor rgyal dang /'jig pa/ ban de/ dko lo/ snying rtse/ phur ba bcas yin/ /tho mon gyi bu mo yul bsdad cig la bu lo kho ser dros skyes/ de'i bu mchog sgrub gshed kha dang yar 'phel gnyis yin/ mchog sgrub la bu ban de skyes pa dang de'i bu ni chos mgon rgyal dang byug 'bum rgyal gnyis yin/yar 'apel la bu gser mgon skyes/ /tho mon kyi gcung tshe ring ban phrug la bu mo dbang chen mtsho las med/mor dpa' lo mag par bzhag nas bu bkra ris dang bu mo mtsho skyid gnyis skyes/bkra ris kyi bu rtsis pa dkon mchog dang g.yang skyabs/ byams pa/ chog ris bzhi yin/ rtsis pa dkon mchog la bu mo mtsho kho dang lcags rgyal gnyisaskyes/ mtsho khor bu lcags ring skyes/ mtsho skyid la sman shul nas mag pa lcags byams bzhag nas bu dge slong na no dang lha bstan gnyis skyes/ lha bstan gyi bu klu skyabs yin/ de'i bu dga' rab dang dpal chen sogs yin/ya ma sog mo (pha yul smad sog yin pas de ltar btags )la bu gnam kho skyes/de la bu 'bog ge dang tshul blo (grwa ba )gnyes skyes/ 'bog ge la bu blo bzang dang bu mo byams me/ bso lo/ g.yang mtsho/ 'brug mo/ sgron dkar/ras kho sogs skyes/ /73

dpa' mchog ja rgya'i skabs su gnyen 'brel la brten nas klu tshang tshul dar dang zla ba gnyis stag skor tsho ba'i nang yong ste gzhis chags pas tsha zhang du gyur/ tshul dar la bu ban de bstan 'dzin dang de'i bu ni 'od zer 'bug ga dang ban spyon/ 'jam dbyangs/ klu dar / bu mo mtsho ris dang lu gu skyid sogs yin/ 'od zer 'bug ga la bu mo g.yu skyes/ der mag pa chos dpal bzhag nas bu gzhi thar rgyal skyes/ klu dar gyi bu ni ban kro rwa snying yin/ mtsho ris la bu ka ba skyes/ de'i bu mo ni dpal sgron rgyal yin/lu gu skyid la bu skya cor skyes/ de'i bu mo 'dzoms pa yin/ 'dzoms pa la bu dngos grub dang bu mo lcags mo rgyal gnyis skyes/ lcags mo rgyal la bu tshe ring rgyal dang bkra shis gnyis skyes/ bla ba la bu dbang chen rgyal dang lha ba tshe snya/dkon lo/ chos 'byor/ bstan pa/ tshogs lo/ bu mo klu do'u bcas skyes/ dbang chen rgyal dang lha ba tshe 'ba' gnyis mo'u rgyar mag par song /dkon lor bu mo ma tsi skyes de'i bu ya brtan rgyal yin/ chos 'byor la bu chos dbyings rgyal dang gcod pa rgyal/ bu mo bkra lo dang ne mo sogs skyes/bstan par shul ma thog klu ro'u la bu mo lha mo thar dang klu mo gnyis skyes/lha mo thar la dkon mchog mag par bzhag tshogs lor bu mo tshe lo skyes pa dang de la mag pa 'jam dbyangs bzhag gzhan yang rgyal khab gsar pa tshugs skabs su tsho ba 'dir ru yong nas gzhis chags te phu nur gyur yod pa'i khyim tshang ni lnga ba dang dbang byug bzang bo ske khra/ lha byams sogs yod/da dung tsha zhang phu nur gyur ba'i skor la'ang dbang byug rgyal dang 'ja' chos/tshe kho/ tshe bo rgyal sogs yod/ /(4) blagan tshangaka /bla rgan tshang zhes bya ba ni dpa' mchog nang gi mi grangs che mabashos yin la/ da lta'i g.yug lung dang g.yo 'bring rgyal bo bcas sde ba hril po gsum dang de'u dkar sde ba'i phyed ka yin/ dpa' mchog gi bu spun gsum 74

gyi 'bring ba ri lor bu tshe 'bum rgyal dang rab brtan gnyi skyes/ /tshe 'bum rgyal la bu bla ma 'byung gnas dang gcod pa sogs skyes shing /rab brtan la bu lha skyabs dang tshe dbang thar mgo mug skyes/ bla ma 'byung gnas kyi ming las bla rgan tshang zhes pa'i tsho ming thogs/ /bla ma 'byung gnas la bu klu byams dang / bla rgan/ gzungs skyabs/don grub bzhi dang / bu mo yum skyid dang / mtsho skyid gnyis skyes/gzungs skyabs la bu sngags ske dang / khro kho (ha lo mgo gar dros )gnyis dang bu mo nor bu skyid dang / bso rdo/ chos skyid/ pu gos sogs skyes/ /klu byams la bu dbu mdzad mkhar rgyal dang / dpyi chen gu ru bstan 'dzin/ snying rgyal/ ban de rgod mgo/ dbang chen gar dros sogs ming sring mang po skyes kyang / 'ga' re rwa rgya dang ma gar rtse sogs sa char song pas mi rgyud gsal bor mi shes/ mkhar rgyal gyis gser lag dgon pa dang dgon gong ma'i spyi chen gyi dbu mdzad gcig spyogs mdzad pas mtshan snyan shin tu che/ dpyi chen gu ru bstan 'dzin dgung lo brgyad kyi steng rwa rgya dgon tu sku gong ma'i khri la bkod/ snying rgyar bu ban de dang bstan 'dzin gnyis skyes/ klu byams kyi bu mo gcig gi mag pa si na mkhan chen yin pa dang /gcig gi mag pa ni g.yang skyabs rgyal yin la de'i bu mo la bu dung lo dang sran ma spyan pa gsum skyes/ sngags ske'i bu ni thugs rje lag pa dang / a khu se me/ yos dge 'dun/ dpa' mchog ba rgya bcas yin/ ba rgyas tsha bo thogs med bu skal byas/ ba rgya'i da lta'i shul 'dzin ni sring mo lha mo yag gi bu bdud 'dul yin/ /khro kho (ha lo mgo gar dros )la bu mo zhig skyes pa'i ming la mgo dkar gar lo zer/ de la bu gsum skyes pa'i che ba ma lo dang / 'bring ba kho lo/chung ba yar 'phel yin/ /yar 'phel la bu khro rgyal dang bstan rgyas gnyis dang / bu mo 'dzoms 75

skyid skyes la khro rgyal gyi bu rnams ni blo bzang rgya mtsho dang / dbang rgyal/stag 'bum/ tshe brtan/ nor bu bcas yin/ bstan rgyas la bu 'jam dbyangs grags pa dang / bsod nams dar rgyas gnyis dang bu mo chos mo skyid skyes/ 'dzoms skyid kyi mag par mkhas mchog bzhag cing / de la bu mkhar byams rgyal skyes/ /kho lor bu dbang chen dang bu mo gu lo skyes/ dbang chen la bu chos rdor rgyal dang bu mo skyid lo gnyis skyes/ gu lo'i mag par tshe ring rgyal bzhag nas bu 'jigs med mthar phyin dang bla ris gnyis skyes/ /ma lo la bu dpal skyabs dang / lcags rgyal/ dbang ldan gsum skyes/ dpal skyabs bu mo'i mag pa 'jam kho yin/ khro rgyal sring mo'i mag pa mkhas mchog yin/ de'i bu mkhar byams rgyal yin/ /nor bu skyid la brgya dpon yu lo mag par bzhag nas bu dpal skyabs dang ban kho gnyis skyes pa dang / dpal skyabs g.yu skyong la mag par song /ban kho'i shul stong / bsod rdo la stag skor dar rgyas mag par bzhag pa'i shul zi dar yin/ /gzungs skyabs bu mo pu gos la rgya mtsho ra cha mag par bzhag nas bu rgya thar skyes/ rgya thar la bu tshe ring rgyal dang / rdo ras/ gu ru/ gcod le bcas dang / bu mo gcig skyes/ gu rus bo skal zhig blangs nas de la mag pa phyug 'bum rgyal bzhagabla 'byung bu mo yum skyid la bu byams pa dang / dzam nag bsod rgya/dbang phyug gsum dang bu mo bo yag bcas skyes la/ bsod rgya'i bu ni chos 'dzin yin la/ bo yag gi bu ni bzod pa yin/ /bla rgan la bu sin rnyi dang / bla ma rgyal mtshan/ byams thung ngam chos mdzad nag po/ nor bu/ klu byams bzhi dang bu mo 'ga' skyes/ sin rnyir bu mo nag tho skyes/ de'i bu mo'i mag par ya ya bzhag de la bu 76

'jigs med skyes shing / de la bu mgon po dang skal bzang gnyis skyes/bla ma rgyal mtshan la bu garma dang 'jam dbyangs gnyis dang bu mo 'brug mo/gar rgyal mtsho sogs skyes/ garma la bu pad blo dang / blo bzang bstan pa/mgon po rgyal/ blo bzang chos 'apel bzhi skyes/ bla ma rgyal mtshan gyi sring mo zhig la bu gcig dang bu mo 'ga' skyes/ bu'i ming la bstan dar mdzug gu rag mo zer/ des rang gi sbra sgo nas dbang lda na bu skal du blangs/ de'i bu ni bsod tshe dang / mthu po/ ri rdo gsum yin/ de dag gi sring mo gcig yod par mag pa rgya sdang bzhag de la bu 'ba' tho dang / sangs rgyas/bu mo gcig bcas skyes/ sring mo'i bu ni mgon po tshe ring yin/ de'i sring mo'i mag pa ni tshul rgyam yin/ 'brug mo la bu 'dzigs med thub bstan dang /'jam dbyangs chos bstan/ tshe ring don grub/ pad+ma skyabs bcaso skyes/gar rgyal mtsho la bu blo gsal dang bstan rgyas gnyis skyes/ chos mdzad nag po la bu chos grags dang / g.yang 'ba'/ ban de gsum skyes/ chos grags rab tu byung / g.yang 'ba' la bu chos bzang dang bu mo gcig skyes/ban de la bu yi res rgyal skyes/ /don grub la bu rgyal 'ba' dang / rta bo gdong ba/ bu mo gar rgyal bcas skyes/ rgyal 'ba' la bu tshe byug dang / ban de khra sdang / ma phyagabu mo g.yang kho bcas skyes/ tshe phyug la bu mo mtsho rgyal skyes shing / de la g.yang drung sogs ming sring dgu skyes/ ban de la bu ban 'gro dang / ma cig do kho/ bu mo dpa' mo bcas skyes/ ya phyag la bu tshe ring thar dang /bu mo dkon mchog sogs skyes/ rta gdong gi shul ni kun thar rgyal yin/kur rgyal dpon skor la gnas la song / /lha skyabs kyis gle ba nas chung ma zhig blangs te bu skal bzang (skal nag )dang / yum skyabs (yum nag)/ sngags 'chang chen po pad+ma rang grol (sku nag )gsum skyes/ /77

skal bzang la rgyam kho dang / klu 'bum/ gnas lo gsum skyes/rgyam kho la bu tshe dbang dang / bu mo tsha lo dang g.yang lu gnyis bcas skyes/tshe dbang gi bu che ba dbang grags rgyal dang / 'bring ba lo stug chung ba khro kho/ bu mo ni jo mo yin/ /dbang grags rgyal la bu chos 'phel dang dbu pe gnyis dang bu mo bsod rdo skyes/ lo stug la bu 'jam dbyangs dang bu mo gnyis skyes/ khro kho la bu rta mgrin rgyal skyes/ jo mo'i bu ni pad dbang yin/ /tsha lo'i bu mo ni 'brug ga yin zhing / de'i shul ni sangs rgyas tshang yin/ /g.yang li la bu rgya mtsho dang jo thar gnyis skyes la/ rgya mtsho la bu ste pu rgyal skyes/klu 'bum la bu dpal 'byor (rab byung ba ) dang / byams grags/no'u 'ba' dang bu mo gar dros/ bo chog (bo 'ba' )sogs skyes/ /byams grags gle ba'i khyigs btsum tshang la mag par song ba'i shul da lta stong / no'u 'ba' nya nag dpon tshang nas ming la lcags rgyal zer ba'i chung ma zhig bsus te bu ma cig rgyal dang / bstan pa rgya mtsho (rab byung ba)/'jam dpal/ btsan lo bzhi dang / bu mo yang gar lo dang / stag mo/bo pa/ bkra bo bcas mingasring brgyad byung / /ma cig rgyal la bu 'brug lo dang 'jigs med gnyis dang / bu mo dar mo skyes/ 'jam dpal la chos rdo dang / dge 'phel/ bo rdo/ lha mchog rgyal/ lha dpal tshe ring sogs skyes/ /btsan lo nywa nag la mag par song nas chos bzang dang / legs —tshogs/ gas nga ras/ nyi yag dpa' ras/ sgrol skyid/ jo mo bcas bdun skyes/ /stag mo nya nag g.yang lha'i chung ma byas pa'i bu ni khro rgyal yin pa dang /78

de la blo bkra dang gangs mo sogs skyes pa mtsho sngon por yod/ /bo pa yo'u rgya'i bson thar chung ma byas pa'i shul ni da lta'i mog hor bzod pa tshang yin/ bkra bo la bu chos 'ba' dang / dpa' chen gnyis dang / bu mo sgrol yag dang / sa lo sogs skyes/ /klu 'bum gyi bu mo gar dros o'u rgya'i a lags la kha tshang la bag mar song / bo 'ba' stag skor la song / /gnas lo la bu lo ris dang bu mo chos 'ba' skyes/ lo ris la ma kho skyes shing de'i bu ni bu rgod yin/ chos 'bar g.yer skyong bstan skyong mag par bzhag /yum nag gi bu tshe dbang glo kha yin/ de la bu mo chos mo skyid dang lha ris skyid gnyis skyes/ chos mo skyid la 'jam skor jo ris tshang nas mag pa 'jam dpal dwangs mo bzhag ste/ bu che mchog rgyal (che lo ) dang /dpa' lo/ ye shes chos 'dzin/ ka rdo bzhi dang / bu mo rdor lo skyes/che lo kha gyar mag par song / dpa' lo'i bu rdo bo rgyal yin/ ye shes chos 'dzin la bu mo zhig las ma skyes/ bu mor klu rgyal mag par bzhag nas shul bzung / ka rdo'i bu rnams ni khyi bo dang do ri4sog4yin/ rdor lo stag skor gar dros rgyal gyi chung ma byas nas bu mkhar byams rgyal dang gu grags gnyis skyes/ tshe dbang glo khas gle ba nas chun ma zhig blangs pa'i ming la kur mtsho zer/ de la bu rta bo rgyal glang sna skyes pa dang / de la bu lo po/ phun tshogs/ bu mo stag mo gsum skyes/ /lha ris skyid la gle ba'i chos 'ba' mag par bzhag nas bu khyi mo thar (khyi thar )dang/ bu mo ka rdo dang rdo mo gnyis skyes/ khyi thar gyi bu ni bstan pa dang stag ga sogs yin/ / lha skyabs dang bla ma 'byung gnas kyi gcung tshul dbang mgo mug la bu lcags po ske ring dang ban ring / grags mchu bcas dang bu mo khyi lo / do'u 79

lo/ tshe lo/ 'dzoms skyid sogs skyes pa dang / lcags po ske ring gis o'u rgya sgar ba nas chung ma 'ig bsus te bu rgya lug dang / bu mo tshe 'ba' dang / 'brug ris/ yag lo/ skyid lo bcas skyes/ /rgya lug gis snga gzhug tu chung ma tā re dang / g.yang res/ mkhar skyid bcas chen chun du blangs par grags pa dang / bu tsho'u zhes dang rnga ba/bu mo chos sgron dang / ke li so gas skyes/ /tsho'u zhes la bu klu phyug dang / lha mchog bu mo gnam mtsho skyid bcas skyes/ klu byug gi bu ni chos dar dang / rdo rje/ 'phags skyabs rgyal/ mgon po bcas yin pa dang / chos dar la bsod nams rdo rje sogs bu bu mo brgyad skyes/ rdo rje la bu rta mgrin rgyal sogs bzhi skyes/'phags skyabs la bu don grub rgyal sogs bu bu mo lnga skyes/ mgon po la bu mchog gsum skyabs sogs bu bu mo bzhi skyes/ lha mchog la bu mo g.yu sgron rgyal skyes/ lha mchog 'dzin bzung byas rjes bu don yod dang bu mo gsum skyes/ dpal ldan gyi sbra ni dpa' mchog rgya lig gi sbra yin/ bu mo gnam mtsho la bu rnam thar rgyal dang / 'jam dbyangs don ldan (grwa ba)/ stag 'bum rgyal/ rta mgrin rgyal/ bu mo don grub sbyid bcas skyes/ ja ba la bu 'jam kho dang / stag mo/ rdor tshe bcas skyes/ 'jam kho la bu gnam phyug rgyal sogs bu bu mo dgu skyes/ stag mo la bu 'jam dbyangs brtson 'thus sogs skyes/ rdor tshe la bu rnam grol rgyal sogs skyes/ bu mo chos sgron la bu rang grol dang bu mo pes mo sogs skyes/ bu mo ke li la bu don grub dang sangs rgyas gnyis skyes/ don grub g.yer skyong la mag par song /sangs rgyas la bu tshe brtan rgyal sogs bu bu mo lnga skyes/ tsho'u zhes kyis chung mar yu kho dang bo rgyal spun gnyis chen chun du blangs/ bo rgyal la bu bso po dang / dbang rgyal/ bstan pa/ 'brug yag bcas skyes/ rgya lug gi chung ma mkhar skyid la bu bya lo dang / bu mo tshe ras/ chos lo/ ba yan 80

bcas skyes/ /khyi lo la bu ban tho dang / bskal tre/ sbag ga byams pa/ legs tshoka4lnga skyes/ ban tho la bu mdongs nge skyes pa dang / de la bu yi dam dang / blo bzang / khro rgyal/ bu lo/ bu mo chos mtsho dang / ras mo/bya mo bcas skyes/ yi dam la bu rig 'dzin dang chos dpal gnyis dang /bu mo chos mo dang / dpa' rdo/ yi ris bcas skyes/ rig 'dzin la bu kun mtshan dang / bu mo yum mtsho sogs skyes/ blo bzang la tshe brtan rgyal sogs ming sring dgu skyes/ chos dpal la bu chos skyong dang bu mo gnam mtsho gnyis skyes/ bya mo la bu a kho rgyal dang / byams mtha' gnyis skyes/chos mtsho dang ras mo gnyis bag mar song / /yang khyi lo'i bu gcig la sta po sbag ga dang / tshe ring 'bum/ mgon rgyal bcas skyes/ ban ring la bu gnyis skyes/ bu che ba la blo ba dang / rta po/ rta lo bcas dang bu mo gnyis skyes/ rta lo la bu bzhi dang bu mo gnyis skyes/ bu che ba 'od grags kyis a lags rgya bza' dang gter ston gnyis kyi dbon po khur myong / bu 'bring ba rab brtan la bu ba log dang dpal ldan bu mo gcig bcas skyes/ zla ba la bu tshe dbang dang / bu rgod/ no 'ba' gsum skyes/ bskal hre la bu 'phags ris dang / brtson 'thus/ stag lha/skya bo/ bya mchu bcas dang / bu mo gar dros dang / rgya mo/ g.yang kho sogs skyes/ g.yang kho la bu chos dbyings rgyal dang / phun tshogs/ sgrol 'bum/ sgrol tshe/ g.yang log sogs ming sring drug skyes/ chos dbyings rgyal la bu gcod skyabs skyes pa dang / 'phags ris la bu dbang chen rgyal skyes/ brtson 'thus la bu mo gsum yod pa dang phun tshogs kyis rdo bo rgyal bu skal du blangs/ stag lhar g.yang log rgyal dang / tshul rgyam/ mkha' res/dbu res/ klu rgyal/ sgrol ma sogs ming sring drug skyes/ /do'u lo la bu 'brug rgan dang / bla ma ya ser/ 'phags pa skyabs 81

'doms lug gsum skyes/ 'brug rgan la bu sngags zhes skyes pa dang /de'i bu ni gcod skyabs rgyal sogs yin/ a ser bla mar 4khu bstan kho sogs ming sring drug skyes/ de'i shul 'dzin ni bstan kho'i tsha mo'i mag pa skya sdang yin/ 'phags pa skyabs 'doms lug la bu dbu mdzad phun tshogs dang / 'jam dbyangs mig nag gnyis skyes/ 'jam dbyangs la bdud bdud sogs bu bu mo drug yod/ /'dzoms skyid la grags mdzug zer ba'i hor gyi grwa ba zhig mag par bzhag nas de la a nya skyes pa dang / ya nya la bu rna bo dang / g.yang lo/bskal rgyal bcas dang bu mo byugs mo rgyal dang / jo kho/ thar mo sogs skyes/ rna bor bu sman pa gnas brtan dang / ban 'gro/ snying lo/tsin thar sogs bzhi skyes/ g.yang lo la bu blo 'phel dang bu mo khros ma sogs bzhi skyes/ bskal rgyal mag par song / thar mo la bu lha dpal dang / bu mo lha mo rgyal/ ri rgyal bcas skyes/tshe lo la yo'u rgya sgar ba nas bso tho mag par bzhag ste bu mkha' 'gro skyabs dang / rig ga bla ma kha dmar/ dge bzang / gnam lha/ bu mo jo mo bcas skyes/ mkha' 'gro skyabs la bu stag lha skyes shing / de la bu jo zug dang / bu mo bzhi skyes/ rig ge mgar rtse zur tshang ta la tshang la mag par song zhing phyis su de tshang gi ri khrid nas phyir bla rgan tshang la yong /rig ge la bu kun thub rgyal dang / lha bo rgyal/ tshe phyug 'azug pa/ bu mo gsum bcas skyes/ kun thub rgyal la bu dar lo dang / khro bo rgyal gnyis skyes/ dar lo la bu chos 'dzin dang / don grub gnyis skyes/ tshe byug la bu lung rig dang bu mo gcig skyes/ 'brug pa la bu gangs ris rgyal dang stag phrug gnyis skyes/ gnam lha la bu ne dang bu mo g.yang rgyal gnyis skyes/g.yang rgya'i bu ni dge 'dun dang phur ba gnyiloyin/ jo mor bu mo gcig skyes shing / de g.yer skyong du gnas la song /82

bla ma 'byung gnas kyi spun gcod pa jag nas bsad par grags la/de la bu mo mtsho lo skyes/ de la bu bstan 'dzin dang dkon mchog gnyi4dang ngu mo bo lo skyes/ bu gnyis rab tu byung / mtsho lo la bu dpal 'phyor (grwa ba )dang / blo tshul (grwa ba)/ 'jam dpal (grwa ba)/ bsod nams/g.yang phyug 'jam dbyangs bcas skyes/ bsod nams la bu chos sgrub dang / brtson 'grus/ gsang bdag bcas skyes/ g.yang phyug mag par song / 'jam dbyangs la bu bo rdo dang / dar mgon rgyal/ gcod pa/bkra shis skal bzang / blo bkra bcas dang / bu mo gnyis skyes/dpa' mchog bla ma 'byung gnas kyis rka phug dpon po gdugs dkar skyabs kyi bu nor bu g.yang skyabs bu skal du blangs/ dzong bar mdo gser bris ma zhig dang gcod pa'i 'khor lo dadul thum can zhig rnam sras rta brgyad kyi thang ka sogs byin/ nor bu nar son rjes bla ma 'byung gnas kyi bu mo gnyis pa sgrol ma dang gnyen sgrig byas te bu klu 'bum ka yag dang / bla ma bkra shis/ 'ja' lo/ rin chen bcas skyes/ de dag la gdong zhing bu bzhi stag mo'i mche bzhi gnam sa'i ka bzhi zhes mtshan snyan ldan pa byung / de dag gi rjes rabs par gdong zhing zer don ni pha nor bu g.yang skyabs ska phug rong nas yin pa'i phyir yin/ bu che ba klu 'bum ka yag la bu rgyud ma byung /bu gnyis pa bla ma bkra shis kyis klu mtsho khyim thabs su blangs nas bu bon ne dang tshe kho/ 'bum kho gsum skyes/ bon ma'i bu bla ma skyabs dang / de'i bu ni dpal bzang yin/ tshe khor chung ma gnyis yod par bla ring dang / bla thung gnyis skyes/ bla thung bon mar bu skal du byin/ tshe kho'i sring mo'i bu rnams ni blo bstan dang / rgya lo/ 'od zer/ skya la/ mkhar skyid bcas yin/ blo bstan nya nag la mag par song nas bzod pa dang bu mo zhig skyes/ rgya lo mkha' ror bu skal du byin/ 'od zer la bu med/ skya la la bu sngags ris dang / bsam gtan/ chos skyong rgyal/ mgon skyabs rgyal/83

'jam dbyangs zla ba/ sgrol tshe sogs skyes/ bla ring la bu mo sgrol mtsho dang /klu mo rgyal/ mkha' 'gro skyid gsum skyes/ sgrol mtsho la khro rgya mag par bzhag nas bu no'u li rgyal dang / rdo rje/ bkra pe/ mkha' 'gro mtsho bcas skyes/ klu mo rgyal 'jam skor la song / mkha' 'gro skyid la mag pa nyi ma bzhag 'bum kho'i bu dbang grags skyabs/ de'i bu ni lha mchog rgyal yin/ bu gsum pa 'ja' lo la bu mo gnyis skyes te gcig gnas la song pa dang / gcig yul du bsdad nas bu yi dam dang / gser rgya/ bu mo lo rgya bcas skyes/ yi dam la bu phun tshogs skyes/ de'i bu mo bkra shis skyid yin/gser rgya'i bu tshe dpal/ de'i bu ni tshe 'bum rgyal yin/ lo rgya la rig tho dang / bstan rgyas/ blo gros bcas bu gsum skyes/ rig tho'i bu lha mkhar rgyal/ de'i bu ni ston pa skyabs dang ke min yin/ bstan rgyas kyi bu ni stag 'bum rgyal yin/ bu bzhi ba rin chen la bu ma ṇi 'bum dang tshul khrims co lkog gnyis skyes/ ma ḍi 'bum la bu rig 'dzin dang dpal chen gnyis skyes/ rig 'dzin la bu yi dam skyabs dang / dpal chen la bu blo bzang skyes/ tshul khrims co lkog gi bu ni dbu di dang pad+ma rdo rje gnyis yin/dbu di'i bu mo mkha' lor mag pa bso rdo bzhag ste bu dko rdo skyes/ pad+ma rdo rje la bu tshogs gnyis skyes/ rig 'dzin gyi chun ma jo thar la bu bstan pa dar rgyas dang / sgrol ma skyabs/ rdo rje rgyal 'ben kha sogs skyes/ /da dung gdong zhing mkhar gyol la bu gcod pa dang / dpal ldan/bu mo sgron rgan/ mgo skyid bcas skyes/ gcod pa la bu pa le dang /mgon skyabs rgyal/ sdom po/ bu mo ma bo tsi bcas skyes/ dpal ldan la bu zon thar rgyal skyes/ sgron rgan la bu khon thar skyes/ de dag rgya lug gi sbra sgo byas nas bsdad/ /bla ma 'byung gnas kyi sring mo dar skyid la g.yer skyong klu ring mag par bzhag de la bu rig log dang klu rgya skya bo bu mo tshe lo bcas skyes/ rig log 8

gi bu ni ma zhes dang / rta ba (rta pu lo)/ ban de gsum yin la/ ma zhes kyi bu tho ba/ tho ba'i bu ni skal yas rgyal yin/ klu rgyal skya bo la bu tshe dbang dang / stag lha/ bu mo chos mo yag bcas skyes/ tshe dbang la bu lha bo rgyal dang 'od zer (zho khag)gnyis skyes/ lha bo rgyal gyi bu ni ri bo dang blo bzang gnyis yin la/ ri bo'i bu ni pad+ma bdud 'dul dang phur rdo yin la/ blo bzang la yi pu rdo dang dpal bzang gnyis skyes/ tshe lo'i mag pa nywa nag lha chen yin/ de gnyis la bu dar mgon dang zhi pesnyes/ rta ba la bu lha byams skyes/ /stag lha'i bu ni dbang chen thar yin la/ dbang chen thar la bu lung rig dang / dpa' rdo/ tshe rdo gsum skyes/ lung rig gi bu ni 'brug thar dang / dpal rdo'i bu ni lha srung dang / chos dbyings rgyal/ 'phrin las gsum mo/ / tshe rdo'i bu ni g.yang skyabs yin/ /chos mo yag gi bu ni lcags thar dang rtsan thar gnyis/ lcags thar bu dbu rdo yin la / de yi bu ni gcod pa dang / phyag ge mkhas grub bcas yin/ tsin thar gyi bu ni dpa' rdo dang / yi bo rgyal/ a rga gsum mo/ /bla ma tshe ring gi bu ni rgyal lo dang / ngag dbang / dngos grub/dar rgyas bcas yin la/ rgyal lo yi bu ni kha rgya dang / rab lo/ bkra shis gsum yin/ kha rgya la dpa' bstan dang / stag rtse gnyis skyes la/ rab lo'i bu ni skal bzang dang / byams pa rgyal gnyis yin/ bkra shis kyi bu ni ku rdo dang / dar skyabs rgyal gnyis yin/ ngag dbang la bu mo tshe ring skyid skyes la der mag pa stag lha bzhag dngos grub kyi bu ni snying dkar dang /bso la/ ban de/ ku stug bcas yin/ dar rgyas kyi bu ni phun tshogs yin la/ phun tshogs la bu shes rab skyes/ /blo gros skya rgod kyi bu ni rnga ba yin la/ rnga ba'i bu ni pad+ma dang rig kho yin/ /8du

mkhar mo rgyal gyi bu ni mchog sgrub dang li zar yin/ /bon rgan ko ye'i bu ni snying 'ba' yin la/ snying 'ba'i bu ni phun tshogs yin/ /dpal 'azug gi bu ni ban de dang dkon mchog gnyis yin la/ ban de'i bu ni bkra shis rgyal dang de yi bu ni lhun grub yin/ dkon mchog gi bu ni tshe dbang dang / zho mgo kun thar rgyal gsum yin/ tshe dbang gi bu ni grags pa rdor legs dang stag byung gnyis yin la/ stag thung gi bu ni don grub rgyal dang / kun thar rgyal gyi bu ni blo bzang bstan 'dzin yin/ /mgar rtse'i lha 'phags sku nag gi tsha mo zhig gi mag par bsdad/ de la bu 'phags pa skyes/ de la bu thar dros dang bu mo lnga skyes/ thar dros bu ban skyang dang / dngos grub/ mthu stobs/ tha sngags/ 'e mo sogs yin/ban skyang la bu mgon rgyal dang / g.yang bstan/ mkha' 'gro gsum skyes/mgon rgyal la bu 'bum pa dang / rta pe/ gcod rdo gsum dang bu mo gnyis skyes/ g.yang bstan la bu skal yas dang shis skyabs gnyis skyes/ mthu stobs la bu 'dzigs med dang / tshe dbang rgyal/ tho ba/ phur ba/chos sgrub/ bu mo gcig bcas skyes/ mkha' 'gro la bu thug pe skyes/ tha sngags la bu gcod le dang gar dbang gnyis skyes pa dang / gcod le la bu sangs rdo dang bu mo lha log skyid gnyis skyes/ gar dbang la bu dar rgyas dang bu mo gsum skyes/ thar dros kyi sring mo gcig la bu ban ring skyes/ de la bu mgon kho dang / g.yang skyabs rgyal/ bu mo g.yang sgron gsum skyes/ yang sring mo gcig la bu rig 'dzin skyes/ de la bu lab sgron rgyal dang / tshe byuganor rdo gsum skyes/ /btsan mo so thar dang / tshe kho/ zha kha/ zhang 'ba' ming sring rnams bla rgan tshang la yong ba'i ri skor la btsan mo zer/ so thar la ban de dang tshe rdo gnyis skyes/ tshe kho la bu yul lha dang bu mo gcig yod/ /86

bla ma 'byung gnas dang lcags po ske ring / rgya lug tsho'u zhes —bcas kyis bla rgan tshang gi tsho dpon khur/ spyi lo 1940yas mas la rgya lug dang ma ṇi'i bu rig 'dzin gnyis gzhung khral 'gan len tshad kyi thad nas ma 'chams par ru skor khag gnyis su chad pa dang / rjes su ru skor de gnyis la tsho'u zhes can po (bla rgan tshang ngos tha ma ) dang / rig 'dzin can po (bla rgan tshang ske tha ma)zer/ 1947lor ru skor khag gnyis la dge slong byams pa thogs med sogs kyis bar 'dum byas 'og tsho ba'i nang khul nas yang bskyar 'grig mthun byung / /da dung rig 'dzin kha 'khob dang lham 'debs ska lo sogs kyi mi rgyud gsal bor rtsad ma chod pas rgyus yod rnams kyis kha gas gnang bar zhu/ /bla rgan tshang gi nang na klog byung dang / zur tshang / btsan mo/gdong zhing / bu dkar sbra bdun zhes pa'i ru skor 'ga' yod la/ klog byung ni g.yer skyong gi mi rabs sngon ma'i ming zhig la klu byung zer ba zhig yod pa de'i sgra 'gyur ba yin te ru skor 'di dang g.yer skyong bar gnyen byas pa sogs kyi 'azel ba zab pa las byung ba ye yin snyam/ zur tshang ni dpa' mchog gzungs skyabs kyi sring mor mgar rtse zur tshang nas mag pa zhig bzhag pa'i mi rgyud la ming de ltar btags par bshad/ btsan mo ni reb gong btsan mo'i ru yong khyim tshang zhig gi nye 'brel ru skor la thogs/ gdong zhing ni gcan tsha'i skal phug nas mag pa zhig bzhag pa la/ gdong zhing bu bzhi stag mo'i mche bzhi zhes pa'i mi rgyud byung ba dag yin/ sngon chad bla rgan tshang gi mi zhig gis phrug kha thel dkar po can zhig gon par bu dkar thogs shing /khong gi ru skor la bu dkar sbra bdun zer/ sbra bdun po ni dbu di dang /byams pa/ ya phyags/ dpa' lo rgya ras/ ban 'gro spyang kha/ tshogs gnyis tshang sogs yin par bshad/ /(5) gle ba/ /87

gle ba'i ming byung tshul la dpa' bo rdo rje khro lu'i nu bo 'jigs med grags pa dpa' rtsal che yang gzugs bongs chung bas glud pa zer ba nas ming zur chag pa dang / 'jigs med grags pa glu gar la mkhas pas 'jigs med glu ba tshang zhes pa'i ming thogs pa bcas bshad tshul 'dra min sna tshogs yod kyang /don ngo ma ni gzhi bdag a byu gle 'phyor gnas pa'i lung ba gle khog gi sa 'dzin sngon ma yin pas gle ba thogs pa yin/ de ni dgon gong 'og bar gsum thun mong gi skyes lha yogye gle 'phyor stod dus bsang me gle bas sngon la gso ba'i srol chags yod pas mtshon thub/ der brten/ snga dus rgan po rnams kyis kyang dgon gong 'og bar gsum/ gle ba/ dpa' mchog yo'u rgya/ g.yer skyong / nya nag zhes gleng skabs gle ba tsho ba so so'i sngon la 'jog pa྾red/ /dgon gong ma'i gle ba ni ko'u sde'i ka rong gle ba la rgya tshang dang kru'u tshang gdong rgya gsum yod pa'i rgya tshang gle ba nas chad/ da lta'i gnas 'dir spo skabs a jo dang dar rgyas spun gnyis dang / kho gnyis kyi tsha bo lcags thar dang bdud mgon bcas sbra sgo bzhi yod/ de dus ru skor gyi ru dpon a jo yin pa dang / rjes su kho'i bu mo'i bu khyi mo thar (khong grub dbang nam mkha' rgyal mtshan gyi sras yin par bshad )gyis tsho dpon khur/ khos tsho ba'i la rgya'i don du snying stobs kyi go cha btsan po dang / shugs drag dmag gi sbyor bas sdang dgra bo'i steng la gshed ma dang / gnyen phu nu'i nang du pha ma lta bu byas pa'i lo rgyus brjod kyis mi lang ngo / / khyad par du khya mdzo rdo gsum gyi sa mtshams yang bskyar gtan chags su btang pa ni kun gyis deng skabs kyang gleng bzhin yod/ gle khyi la bu sman tho dang / yar 'phel/chun mar ba kho bcas gsum byung pa'i nang du sman thos tsho ba bskyangs pa dang /de 'das rjes kho'i gcung yar 'phel gyis tsho dpon khur/ sman tho la bu gnyis skyes pa'i che ba snying dkar rgyal dang chung ba zhi thar yin/ snying dkar 88

rgyal gyis yar 'phel 'das rjes tsho dpon khur ba dang / zhi thar ni g.yer skyong la mag par song / yar 'phel kyi bu tshe dbang yin pa dang / de la bu dbu lo dang a khu sgyung gnas pa sogs yod/ dbu lo'i tsha mos khyim bzung yod/ mo'i mag pa da lta'i me ru khi sde ba'i tshe kho yin/ ya khu sgyung gnas pa gser lag dgon pa'i grwa ba byas shing sgyung gnas stong dkar mang po phud pas mtshan la sgyung gnas pa zhes 'bod/ 1999lor dgung lo bdun cu'i thog sku grongs/ /ba kho la bu sngags pa rig 'dzin skyes pa dang / de'i bu mo'i bu 'ja' chos kyis me ru khi sde ba'i thon skyed ru khag gi ru dpon dang / tang kri pu'u byu'u ci gzhon pa/ byu'u ci bcas kyi 'gan khur/ bu mo mtsho mo la bu tshe ro skyes/ tshe ro ni dpa' snyeng che zhing / gzhung sems drangs pa dang tsho dpon ka kes kyi lag grogs nus ldan zhig yin/ khos bu skal la tshe dbang bu 'azin las blangs/ de'i bu thug pe yis da lta de'u dkar sde ba'i tang kri pu'i byu'u ci khur yod/ gle khyi'i tsha po gsang nag gi bu mo la a pi ce mag par bzhagade'i bu mo bsod nams mtsho yi mag pa chos 'dzin gyis lo rabs bdun cu ba'i nang de'u dkar sde ba'i hru'u ci dang thu'u rin khur myong / gle khyi'i tsha mo zhig la bu bla ma glo blangs dang bu mo zhig skyes/ bu mo de'i bu mo rta mgrin skyid la bu chos sgrub dang / brtson 'thus/ gsang bdag (zhi lu )bcas skyes/dar rgyas la bu dbang lo dang tshe brtan rgyal gnyis skyes/ dbang lo la bu mkha' 'gro dang yag ge gnyis skyes/ tshe brtan rgyal chung dus 'das/gle ba ko'u sde'i gle ba dang bral nas sa 'dir yong skabs phu nu'i 'du shes yun ring bsrings ched spyi chos gser yum zhig snga dum phyi dum byas te snga dum rgya tshang gle ba'i bdud 'dul tshang gi khyim du bzhag pa dang / byu dum dgon gong ma'i gle ba'i mkha' 'gro tshang la khyer nas yong / /mkha' 'gro la bu chos 'byor dang / rta mgrin rgyal/ chig rgya/89

skyabs kho bzhi skyes pa dang / chos 'byor la bu dbang rgyal skyes/ dbang rgyal la bu tshe brtan rgyal (tsig ge)dang / gnam ris rgyal/ tshe phyug gsum skyes/ tshe brtan rgyal gyis bcings 'grol byas ma thag pa'i skabs mgo mang zhang gi gung ching thon gyi hru'u ci gzhon pa khur myong pa dang / rjes su thon skyed ru khag gi ru dpon dang / sde ba'i sde dpon/ sde ba'i tang kri pu'u byu'u ci sogs kyi 'gan khur myong / khos mang tshogs kyi bde sdug dang / sa cha'i rtsod gleng 'dum 'grig yong pa sogs kyi ched du sde dpon tsho dpon gzhan dang mnyam du zhing chen dang / khul/ rdzong sogs gong rim las khungs la rgyun du gnas tshul zhu 'bul dang thag gcod byed pa'i thad nus pa chen po thon pas/sde don la sha tsha snying nye byed pa'i a pa tsig ge zhes 'brog dmangs rnams kyis brtsi bkur byed pa zhig tu gyur/rta mgrin rgyal kyi bu mo'i bu ka kes kyis snying dkar rgyal gyi rjes su gle ba'i tsho dpon khur/ kho tsho dpon la ma bsdad sngon gyi gyod rigs sna tshogs 'dum 'grig dang / kha thor tu song pa'i gle ba'i ru skor gcig tu bsdus/btsan gnyom gyi ngo la mi blta bar bcings 'grol ma byas ring du sde ba legs par bskyangs/ khong gi bu gsang bdag gle ba'i mkhar rtse tshang gi bo skal mar mag par byin/ rjes nas sha sbrang kho nag gi yi dam skyabs kyi bu stag lo rgyal bu skal du blangs nas kho'i khyim 'dzin byas shing / 1980lor rang lo 76thog tshe las 'das/ /chig rgyal gyi bu dpa' ris gagon dus su tshe las 'das/ de'i bu mgon po rgyal bcings 'grol byas rjes rgyal nang gi sa cha mang por lta skor tu 'gro rtsong / khos tshe brtan rgyal gyi bu bzhi ba nor bu rgyal bu skal du blangs/tshe brtan rgyal gyi sbra ni mkha' 'gro tshang gi sbra yin/ /skyabs kho'i bu che ba dpa' 'bum gyi chung ma dpa' mchog dpon skor nas blangs/ bu dpa' chen rgyal skyes/ de'i bu ni 'tshams pa yin/90
