dpa' 'bum gzhon du4nas 'das pa dang kho'i chung ma gcung ban de la mgo spor/ mkha' 'gro'i spun yag ge yi bu lha 'brug yin/ lha 'brug gis gle khyi'i tsha bo'i bu mo zhig bo dod du blangs nas mag par dpa' kho bzhag bu skal la dbang rgyal gyi bu gnyis pa gnam ris rgyal blangs/ dpa' kho'i phu bo dbang ris la bu mo 'brug ge skyes/ de'i bu 'jam dbyangs rgya mtsho yin/ /lcags thar la bu ma ma dang / nor bu/ no'u 'ba' gsum skyes/ma ma la bu skar ma dang / a rga (a rga shing )/ lha 'bum bcas skyes/skabs der gle ba ru skor gnyis byas 'dug pas/ ma ma'i ru skor la ma skor dang / dpon po yar 'phel gyi ru skor la yar skor zer/ skar ma tshang ni khyim ha cang phyug po zhig yin par ma zad/ kho ni gzhan gyis rgyu 'bras —bsnogs pa lha bab nas zer 'don byed mkhan zhig yin stabs/ tshang mas lha ba tshang zhes che sar 'jog kho la bu bso ris dang / bu mo gsum yod pa'i gnyis dpon skor la gnas la byin/ bu mo chung par nya nag nas klu skyabs mag par bzhag nas bu tshogs 'phel dang / lung rtogs/ snying lcags (mkhar rtse'i bu mo'i bu skal yin)/ rin chen rgyal/ 'jigs med bcas skyes/ bsod ris kyis shar tshang nas mkhar rtse bu skal du blangs/mkhar rtses bo dod du ka lo blangs nas ka ke'i bu gsang bdag mag par bzhagades snying lcags bu skal du blangs/ mtha' yas dang bsam gtan gnyis ni gser lag dgon pa'i chos dang 'jig rten kun la mkhas pa'i grwa ba gnyis yin/ lha ba'i bu mo la mag pa zhig bzhag nas bu sngags pa skyes/ sngags pa la bu shes rab (pa kho )skyes/ pa kho'i bu mo la mag pa bsod nams 'bum bzhag a rga shing gi bu dpa' lo yin/ de la bu ka bo rgyal (ka pa )dang /ku ku/ rgyal po gsum skyes/ ka pa'i sring mo pad ma lha mtsho dang yo'u rgya'i dbang chen rdo rje gnyis kyis ting 'dzin rgyal bu skal du blangs/ 'di ni sngon gyi ma ma tshang gi khyim gzhi yin/ ku ku yi bu skal la yo'u rgya la mag par song 91

pa'i gcung rgyal bo yi bu rgya drug blangs pa dang de la bu dbang chen rdo rje skyes/ma ma yi tsha bo 'od zer (sngags pa skra lngang )gyi bu snying rgyal yin/ snying rgyal gyi bu ba rdor gyi bu ni g.yo 'bring tshogs 'phel yin/ lha 'bum gyi bu lha chen yin/ de la bu rgo lo dang / blo bzang / byams pa bcas skyes/ ma ma'i spun nor bu la bu gzungs rgan dang / rig rgyal gnyis skyes/ rig rgyal gyi bu ban de yin/ de la bu blo chos dang bu mo sgro chog gnyis skyes/ sgro chog la bu blo bzang skyes/ no'u 'ba' la bu bu mo ba kho dang / skyid dros/ dzatha/bzang po bcas skyes/ ba kho'i bu mo che ba'i bu phur ba skyabs kyis dus yun ring por phyugs sman gyi 'gan khur pa dang / lug rgyud legs bcos kyi ched du snga gzhug tu zhin cang sogs su thengs mang por song nas dka' tshegs la ma 'dzems par son phyug bzang po nyos nas phyir yong / bu mo chung pa'i mag pa dbang ldan rgyal yin/ bzang po la bu snying dkar tshe rgyal dang dpal mgon gnyis yod/ snying dkar tshe rgyal la bu dbang chen rdo rje dang / bu mo 'ga' skyes/ dbang chen rdo rje yis 1959lo nas 1986lo bar du gle ba dang /o'u rgya/ stag skor khag cig las thub pa'i bra shur sde ba'i kru'u rin dang /byu'u ci gagon pa bcas khur pa dang / lo rabs drug cu'i phyi dus la rgyal kha ru chen gyi tang kri pu'i byu'u ci yang 'khur myong / snyeng dkar tshe rgya gagon dus shi bas kho'i chung ma la gcung dpa' mgon gyis bdag byas/ skyid dros la bu mo sgron de rgyal (la la )skyes pa dang / de la bu mo bsod nams skyid (bso lo )skyes pa'i mag par stag shar tshang gika bo log mag par bzhag /bdud mgon gyi bu ni klu byams yin pa dang / de la bu snying 'bum rgyal skyes/ snying 'bum rgyal la bu dkon mchog dang / gdugs dkar gnyis skyes/ dkon mchog la bu gser rgyal skyes pa dang / de la bu dbang byug skyes/ dbang byug la bu ban 'gro skyes/ gdugs dkar la blo 'ba' dang thar kho gnyis skyes/ blo 'ba'i bu ni nam mkha' yin la/ de'i bu ni blo 92

gsal dang phun tshogs gnyis yin/ thar kho'i bu mo la bu tshe rgyal skyes/ klu byams kyi tsha bo g.yang drung gi bu rta bo rgyal yin la/ de yi bu ni lo po'u dang phun tshogs gnyis yin/ /gnyis pa/ yo'urgu bshad pa/rig 'dzin nyi ma'i rjes rabs pa dpal chen rdo rje'am dpal rdor la bu chos ldan gyol bo dang bla ma dbu dkar ba mkhyen rab rgya mtsho gnyis yod cing /chos ldan la bu dbang rgyal dang / bstan pa/ dge 'dun/ mkhar ris rgyal g.yag rgyugs bzhi skyes/ mkhar ris rgyal reb gong nas bsdad/gzhan spun gsum po dang pha chos ldan khu bo bla ma dbu dkar ba bcas nub phyogs su gnas spor nas dgon gong ma'i yo'u rgya tsho ba'i ming bzung / de dus yo'u rgyar khyim tshang nyi shu lhag yod/ bstan pas tsho dpon khur/bstan pa'i rjes su kho'i nu bo dge 'dun la bu ban de rgyal dang / tshe dbang skyabs/ tshul dbang rgyal gsum skyes pa las ban de rgyal gyis dpon sa bzung / ban de rgyal la bu bskal bzang rgyal (yongs grags su bskal —dbyangs zer )dang / 'jigs med/ gnam bzhes bcas bu gsum skyes/bu gnyis pa 'jigs med rkyen lam du 'das/ bskal dbyangs kyis dpon sa bzung / de dus yo'u rgya'i ya khu pad+ma dbang chen tshang dang / dge bskos 'jam dbyangangs tshang / a khu chos tho/ dpon rgan rdor skyabs/ rgan po paṇa chen/ a snyes la bo/ sgar ba'i gdugs dkar/ ha lo ban chung /don spyon/ a khu sde brgyad spun mched sogs kyis mnyam du yo'u rgya'i sde spyi gnyis lhan du bskyangs/ /bskal dbyangs kyi zu bo sngags pa 'jigs med la snying nad rtsod ched o'u rgyas bdud shul glo'u tshang la dmag drangs nas glo'u tshe ring sogs mi bdun bsad/ don rkyen de g.yol ched o'u rgya dgon gong ma dang gyes nas mgon zhol chu dmar nag bar song /93

dpon po bskal dbyangs ni sangs rgyas chos lugs la dad 'dun che ba zhig yin te/ kho lo drug cu yas mas kyi thog dbus su song nas se 'bras dge gsum mnyam du rgya lo'i smon lam la 'tshogs skabs zhol nas lag gnyis thal mo sbyar te tshe las 'das/ bskal dbyangs kyi rjes su nu bo gnam bzhes te yo'u rgya'i seng chen gyis dpon sa bzung / de'i chung ma gsum pa'i bu snying dpal sgal ring yin/ bu mo gnyis skyes/ bu skal zhig blangs pa bsod 'ba' rgya sdang yin/ de'i rjes seng chen gyi bu mo'i mag pa rdor skyabs kyis dpon po byas/ de la bu med par gar dros dang tshe 'ba' gnyis bu skal du blangs/ de'i rjes su o'u rgya sgar ba'i 'phags ris kyis dpon sa bzung /kho la bu ma skyes la srun ban chung dang kun thub gnyis yod/ de'i rjes su o'u rgya gong ma'i de bos dpon sa bzung / de bo la bu 'jigs med dang /ya khu 'jigs blo/ lha bstan sogs skyes la/ de gsum pos dpon sa ma bzung bar snying dpal gyi bu bsang khos 1956 lo'i bar tsho mgo bskyangs shing /khos mtsho lho khul srid gros kyi kru'u zhi gagon pa yang khur/ bsang kho'i bu jo skyabs rgyal yin/ bsang kho'i snga gzhug tu sgar ba'i skar skyabs yang tsho ba'i nang gi mi dbang chen gyi gras su song yod pas/ 1956 lor dgon gong ma chi yi chi krang gzhon pa khur/ /seng chen gyi bu skal bsod 'ba' rgya sdang ni dgon gong ma'i khyigs bdag brgyad cu'i gras dang yo'u rgya'i khyigs dpon yin/ kho o'u rgya'i khral don dang spyod don du khri ga'i ya mon nas btson la'ang 'dug rtsong / de'i bu ni o'u rgya'i rta bo rgyal yin te/ kho ni skabs de'i yo'u rgya'i sde ba skyong ba'i rgan po gsum gyi gras yin la/ dpon po bsang kho dang bskal skyabs sogs dang mnyam du tsho ba'i las don che phra thams cad la stobs shugs yod rgu bton/de'i bu ni dbu pe dang / yo rgyan 'jigs med/ rnam grol/ dge byams bcas so/ /9

(1) sgar ba/ /sgar ba zhes pa'i ming ni/ rab byung bcu ba'i nang du pha yul rab gong nas nub phyogs su 'ong ba nas ring po ma 'gor par sgar ba'i bla ma mgo dkar (reb gong bas sgar ba'i bla ma skra dkar zer )gyi ring la/ 'brog ru nas ras gur phub ste sgar kha rgyag pa de'i skor la sgar ba zhes ming du btags/gnas 'dir spor skabs sgar ba'i bstan pas sde dpon khur ba dang tsho ba'ang zhor tu bskyangs/ de rjes bstan pa'i nu bo dge 'dun gyi bu ban de rgyal ske ring gis sde tsho gnyis lhan du bskyangs/ de la seng chen spun gsum zhes bu gsum byung ba'i che ba skal bzang rgyal/ 'bring ba sngags pa 'jigs med/chung ba gnam bzhes gsum gyi nang du snga phyi ltar bskal bzang rgyal dang gnam bzhes kyis tsho sde gnyis kyi dpon po lhan du khur/ de rjes gnam bzhes kyi bu mo'i mag pa rdor skyabs kyis sde tsho lhan du bskyangs/ de rjes khams pa'i no'u bas tsho ba bskyangs pa dang / de rjes skar skyabs kyis tsho dpon khur/ skar skyabs kyi bu ni grags pa'o/ /sgar ba'i mi rgyud/ sgar ba ni chos ldan gyi bu bstan pa'i mi rgyud yin/de la bu gnam lha dang / tshe lo(tshe dkar〉/ klu ring / dpal lo/ ri spyon/ rgya mtsho bcas drug dang bu mo sgron skyid dang bsod skyid gnyis skyes/gnam lha la bu bla ma dang / am nag do lo(do spyon)/ gdugs dkar(ril lu ma)/ gdugs dge(rab tu byung )/ mgar ba ban thar bcas yod pa las/ 'di dag gi snga ma gsum gyi ma ni rnga rgya'i yin la/ rjes ma gsum gyi ma nywa nag gi yin/ /bla ma la bu g.yang 'bum rgyal dang 'jam dbyangs bstan 'dzin (rab tu byung )gnyis dang bu mo g.yang mtsho sgol ma skyes/ g.yang 'bum rgyal gyi bu rnams ni bsod nams rgyal dang / rdor kho/ rdor grags/ byang chub rnams yin la/ bu mo ni pad+ma skyid yin/95

bsod nams rgyal la bu 'jam dbyangs thub bstan chos 'byor (yo'u rgya'i ya khu che tshang)dang / chos skyabs thar/ 'brug thar/ lu gu thar/gangs chung rtse rgyal/ g.yang mo mtsho/ skyid po/ gar dros bcas ming sring rnams skyes/ /chos skyabs thar la bu mkhyen ba nyi ma dang / mthu chen rdo rje/ shākya skyabs/ bu mo hūṃ gar stong ldan snya ṭa rgyal bcas skyes/ 'brug thar la 'jigs med chos 'byor ming sring rnams skyes/ lu gu thar la tshe ring rgyal ming sring rnams skyes/ gangs chung rtse rgyal la rta mgrin rgyal ming sring rnams skyes/ g.yang mo mtsho shar sgar chung la bag mar song / skyid po la bu shes rab rgya mtsho dang / bu mo dpa' bzang sgrol ma la g.yu rngogs yon tan mag par bzhag/ /rdor kho dpa' mchog la mag par song nas bu dbang grags rgyal dang bu mo 'brug rgyal gnyis skyes rjes phyir yoku rgyar yong nas nya nag nas chung ma zhig blangs te bu phur ba dang rdo bo gnyis skyes/ phur ba nga brgyad lor tshe las 'das/ rdo bo ni a khu lhun po la bu dod du byin/ rdo bo'i bu mchog ldan phyir rdor grags la bu dod du byin/ mchog ldan gyi bu ni tshe kho dang rdo pe spun mched rnams so/ / rdor grags kyi bu dod la tshe 'ba'i bu mo bsod nams skyid blangs nas khams pa'i bu stag lha rgyal mag par bzhag stag lha rgyal gyi bu ni rab rgyas yin/ rab rgyas la mgon skyabs rgyal ming sring rnams skyes/byang chub kyi bu dod bsod nams yin/ bsod nams kyi chung mar 'ba' gzhes kyi bu mo blangs nas bu dpal 'bum rgyal dang / lha 'brug klu sdang /ba rdo bzhi skyes/ dpa' 'bum rgyal la nyi ma'i bu mo blangs nas bu dpa' chen rgyal skyes/ lha 'brug da lta ka rgya na yod/ klu sdang nag bza' na yod/ ba rdo mtsho sngon po'i rig sgon dang rgya yas kyi phyogs gtogs su yod(sde ming ngo ma mi gsal)/ pad+ma skyid kyi bu dod du rig ge'i bu mo chos 'tshams skyid blangs/96

de'i mag par gser lo'i bu tshe 'bum rgyal bzhag nas bu dge 'phel(rab tu byung)dang / rin chen/ ya khu dar rgyas/ bu mo dung mtsho skyid bcas skyes/g.yang mtsho sgrol ma la mag pa gsang bdag bzhag nas bu tshe 'ba' skyes rjes 'thor/ de nas shar tshang la mag par song nas bu do lo skyes/ tshe 'ba' yo'u rgya'i dpon rgan rdor skyabs kyis bu dod du blangs/ /am nag la sman pa bstan rgyas sam a khu sman pa da lde (rab tu byung )ṭ+wārdo sgro/ la shā ṭ+wāṃm/ sa ṭ+wāṃ shā/ nu'u 'ba'/ mchog we/ 'ba' lo/ bu mo bde khu rgya la bu rdob rgya dang bu mo cha yag gnyis skyes/ rdob rgyas chung mar rta mgrin skyid blangs nas bu mo bso da skyid rgyal dang / tshe gzungs/ bde sgon/ mtsho skyid bzhi skyes/ bsod skyid rgyal la mag pa bu chung bzhag nas bu mthu stobs skyes/ tshe gzungs dang mtsho skyid gnyis gnas la song /bde sgron la sgrol kho ming sring rnams skyes/ ya ma cha yag dang g.yu rngogs rtsa ring gi lha ba dge 'ba' gnyis bshos nas bu rta mgrin dang / dpal bzang /bu mo pa rgya/ lha mo bcas bzhi skyes/ rta mgrin gyis bu dod du lha mo'i bu dpa' mkhar rgyal blangs/ dpal bzang gi bu dod du lha yag gi bu mo sgrol ma mtsho blangs nas ྅ nag tshe ring thar mag par bzhag pa rgya la klu tshang tshe pa mag par bzhag nas 'jam dbyangs dang / khro mo/ 'o mtsho/ ye shes/g.yang sgron lnga skyes/ 'jam dbyangs kyi bu dod du sring mo 'o mtsho'i bu chung ba dbang rgyal blangs/ khro mo la bu bu mo 'ga' skyes/ 'o mtsho dpa' mchog bla rgan tshang gi bstan pa dar rgyas la chung mar byin/ de la bu sgrol skyabs rgyal dang / dbang rgyal/ bu mo gcig bcas gsum skyes/ bstan pa dar rgyas tshe las 'das rjes 'o mtsho phyir yo'u rgya sgar bar yong / ye shes la mgon po rgyal ming sring rnams skyes/ g.yang sgron sgar skor lha mchog rgyal gyi bu khon thar gyi chung mar byin/ lha mo bar kha'i lha btsun rgyal gyi chung ma byas nas bu 97

dpal mkhar rgyal dang nor skyabs rgyal gnyis skyes/ de rjes nywa nag la—gnas la song / lha bu no'u 'ba' la bu mo gcig las med pas de la rig log bsam po'u mag par bzhag 'di'i bu dod ni snying dkar yin/mchog we la bu sman pa brtson 'grus rag sdang (grwa ba )dang / chos grags (grwa ba )/ tshe lha thar/ khro mchog bcas skyes/ tshe lha thar gyi bu ni blo sher dang / snying dpal/ gser 'bum rgyal/ bu mo tshe thar bcas so/ /blo sher gyis tshe thar gyi bu phyug 'bum rgyal bu dod du blangs/ kho rang la'ang bu bu mo 'ga' yod/ 'ba' lo'i bu rdor skyabs rgyal dang / bkra bo rgyal/a khu rol/ bu mo thar dros bcas yin/ rdor skyabs rgyal gyi bu mo klu skyid/de'i bu phur ba rgyal ming sring rnams/ bkra po rgyal gyi bu mo lha mtsho skyid/(blo gros kyi chung ma) chos mtsho skyid/ dkar mo rgyal/ chos mtsho skyid la mag pa chung rtse bzhag dkar mo rgyal nywa nag la song / a khu rol gyi bu mo bzang mo/ rgya mo skyid/ sras rdo/ bzang mo nya nag la song / rgya mo skyid sgrol ma skyabs kyi chung ma byas/ sras rdo ya khu ban de'i bu dod du byin/ thar dros la mag pa khro mchog bzhag nas bu ya khu ban de dang / sman pa rgyal mo/bu mo jo mo thar/ ban de'i bu dod la a khu rol gyi bu mo sras rdo blangs/de'i bu nor bu rgyal yin/ sman pa rgyal mo'i bu bsod rgyam/ bu mo dpal skyid rgyal/ lha mo/ g.yang mo skyid bcas yin/ jo mo thar la rig ge'i bu gcod le mag par bzhag nas bu bun 'chang / blo gros/ bu mo lha mo yagamatsho lo/ snying skyid rgyal bcas skyes/ bun 'chang gis bu skal du dpal mo mtsho blangs/ blo tshos kyis chung ma lha mtsho skyid blangs nas bu dung ris spun mched rnams skyes/ lha yag la bu rang gsal dang / bu mo sgrol ma mtsho/dpal mo mtsho bcas skyes pa'i rjes su dpa' mchog la song / mtsho lo la mag pa khon thar bzhag nas bu lha 'bum rgyal skyes/ snying skyid rgyal dpal bzang gi chung ma byas/ bo dod la lha yag bu mo sgrol ma mtsho blangs/ am nag gi 98

bu mo bde chen sgrol ma la dpa' ris nor dkar gyi ya lags ban rgan mag par bzhag nas bu ha lo lha ba dang bu mo sgrol ma gnyis skyes/ ha lo lha bar bu lha ba lhun grub skyes pa dang / de'i bu mo lcags mo rgyal/ de'i bu dbang chen(lha srung)yin/ /do spyon la bu sde brgyad dang / bu mo lha skyid gnyis skyes/ sde brgyad la bu sngags 'chang / mkhas grub/ bu mo dpal sgron dang / g.yang mtsho bcas skyes/ sngags 'chang gi bu ni yo'u rgya'i sku lo/ gar lha/ bu mo hag lo bcas so/ / mkhas grub kyi bu tshul rgyam/ bkra shis/ bu mo snyeng lo/lo pu'u bcas bzhi skyes rjes rma nub ja rgyar song / /gdugs dkar ril lu ma'i bu dod yu lo/ yu lo'i bu thub bstan/dpa' po'u/ dkon mtshan/ bu mo jo thar/ sog mo/ rgya mo bcas yin/thub bstan gyi bu dod don ldan/ jo thar bu dam chos/(rab tu byung) rgya mo'i bu do le spun mched rnams/ sog mo'i bu sgrol skyabs rgyal srun mched rnams so /mgar ba ban thar la bu nams mkha'/ tshe ring 'on/ a jo/(rab tu byung) nam mkha'i bu mdo sde/ snyeng dkar/ tshe dbang / bu mo chos 'tsho bcas skyes/ snying dkar rig log bsam po la bu dod du byin/chos 'tsho'i bu bdud 'dul yin/ tshe ring 'on la bu gcig skyes kyang chung dus nas 'das/ bu mo mtsho kho dang / g.yu lo gnyis skyes/ mtsho kho ge tho'i chung mar byin/ g.yu lo'i mag par 'phags pa bzhag bu bu mo ma skyes par dar lo bu dod du blangs/ /bstan pa'i bu gnyis pa tshe lo la bu phyug lo dang / don ne/ thar lo/skabs lo/ phyug dge rab tu byung )/ zugs rje (lig )bcas skyes/phyug lo la bu gser lo dang / chos 'dzin/ u lo/ (gdugs dkar mi rgyud na gsal )lha rgod/ tshe lha/ bu mo g.yu sgron dang bzhi yod kyang gsum 99

gnas la byin/ gser lo'i bu blo bzang / nu'u thu/ blo 'phel/ (rab tu byung ) dpal bzang / g.yang drung 'bum/ dkon mchog rig 'dzin —(dkon rig) skar ma g.yang skyabs rgyal(skar skyabs)/ 'bum byug rgyal bcasaskyes/ blo bzang bu tshe 'bum rgyal/ mchog lo/(rab tu byung ) gnam rtse/ bu mo lha skyid yag sogs skyes/ tshe 'bum rgyal g.yang 'bum rgyal tshang la mag par song / gnam rtse'i bu rdo rdo ming sring rnams yin/ dpal bzang la bu byams mtha' dang / ngo mtshar/ ngag dbang / khyung rtse/lha rtse bcas dang / bu mo gsum bcas skyes/ g.yang drung 'bum ya rga lcags byams la bu dod du byin/ dkon mchog rig 'dzin gyi bu ni 'jam dbyangs mthar phyin yin/ skar ma g.yang skyabs la bu grags pa dang bu mo ku pe gnyis skyes/ 'bum byug rgyal la dpa' ris bu mo sgrol ma blangs nas bu stobs chen rgyal skyes/ nga brgyad lor 'bum phyug rgyal tshe las 'das rjes nywa nag rta'i bu ye shes sgrol ma'i mag par bsdad nas bu bkra shis tshe ring skyes/chos 'dzin (khon thar gyi bu dod yin )kyi chung mar nywa nag dpa' spyong bu mo rdo rje blangs nas bu chos bzang dang / yo'u rgya'i dge bshes chung ba tshang 'jam dbyangs dge legs dpal bzang dang / bu mo gar dros/ bo chog la pu'u/ kun 'tsho skyid bcas skyes/ kun 'tsho skyid la mag pa bstan pa bzhag nas bu yo brgyan rgyal dang bu mo dpa' yag skyid skyes/ chos bzang gi bu ni sku bo rgyal dang / 'tshams pa/ pad+ma bstan 'phel/ 'jigs med bzang po/ bu mo skyid lha bcas yin/ sku bo rgyal gyi bu ni sko me ming sring rnams/ pad+ma bstan 'phel gyi bu gu ru ming sring rnams/ 'dzigs med bzang po la phur ba ming sring rnams skyes/ lha rgod bu mo mkha' skyid rgyal/de'i bu don thub/ tsan grang thar/ bu mo 'bum 'tsho/ sgrol ma/ bso pa bcas yin/ don grub la bu 'brug 'bum rgyal ming sring rnams/ g.yu sgron la mag pa ya 'azin bzhag nas bu bso sdang / blo gsal/ (rab tu byung )100

stag 'bum/ bu mo g.yang mo rgyal/ yag ras/ sgrol yag bcas skyes/stag 'bum gyi bu ni ge thar ming sring rnams/ yag ris bu mo mkha' tshogs/de la mag pa bon skyabs rgyal bzhag /don ne'i bu chu gu thar/ zhing skyabs/ gcod dros/ zon thar/nyi ma/ bu mo ka lo/ tshe mtsho/ tshe ris bcas yin/ chu gu thar gyi bu dpal mkhar/ mu rgya/ dge tshogs(rab tu byung )/ 'jigs 'azin(rab tu byung )/ gnam lha/ tshe 'bum rgyal/ bu mo bsod rgyal/ lha mo ras/ dpal mkhar rwa rgya'i chu ba la mag par song / mu rgya la bu kun skyabs rgyal dang gong skyabs rgyal/ bu mo chog 'tshams skyid/ ka dros skyid/ lha rdo bcas skyes/ bsod rgya'i bu mo gna' sma yag de'i bu zhing skyabs yin/zhing skyabs la bu snying dkar/ thub pa(mgar rtse rgya mor song )/ g.yang lu/grags pa (rab tu byung )bcas skyes/snying dkar bu g.yang bstan rgyal/ de'i bu tshe 'bum rgyal ming sring rnams yin/ gcod dros la bu blo rgyam dang /mkhas mchog mgon lo ('di dag sha sbrang du yod)/ zon thar dang sring mo ka lo gnyis khyim gcig yin/ ka lo'i bu bsod pe/ de la bu tsho'u lo dang / dpa' phyug dpal bzang bcas dang bu mo gnyis skyes/ nyi ma'i bu gnas rgyam/(rab tu byung ) brtson 'grus/(rab tu byung ) tshe dpal/ ge tho/ bu mo mkha' 'gro/ bsod skyid rgyal bcas yin/ tshe ris la mag pa ya lo ka la bzhag nas bu bstan dar (rab tu byung )/ bu mo dpal sgron/mkha' la bcas skyes/ dpal sgron dbang chen gyi chung mar byin/ mkha' la la ka bo rdo rje mag par bzhag nas bu lung rig ri phyug sgrol lha/ bu mo dam tshig sgrol ma/ 'bo'u rdo/ g.yang rdo bcas skyes/ tshe dpal bu dod skar ma/ de'i bu do pu ming sring rnams yin/ ge tho'i bu dod gsar rgyas/bsod skyid rgyal dpal 'bum rgyal gyi chung ma byas/ mkha' 'gro la bu mthar phyin dang bu mo pa rgya gnyis skyes/ /101

thar lo'i bu thar drangs/ bu mo g.yang mo skyid/ thar drangs kyi4chung ma chen chun gnyis blangs/ chen ma dpa' mchog lha me'i sring mor bu mo tshe mtsho'am bde chen mtsho skyes/ chun ma stag skor bsam me'i sring mor bu rta mgrin skyabs skyes/ bu dod du grong ba'i dbang ris blangs/ tshe mtsho la sgar skor stag lha (stag thung )mag par bzhag nas bu mo tshe sgron rgyal skyes rjes 'thor/ de nas bla rgan tshang gi bsod nams rgyal mag par bzhag nas bu dod kha rgya blangs / rta mgrin skyabs la gong ma'i lha ba g.yang 'bum gyi bu mo g.yu rgyal blangs nas bu sbyin pa dang / byams pa/ skar ma/ bu mo g.yang mo thar bcas skyes/ dbang ris la skya ye sku bzhar bu mo na na blangs nas bu dpal ldan (rab tu byung )g.yu rgyal/ grags pa/ bu mo gnyis bcas skyes/g.yang mo skyid la mag pa 'ba' zhes bzhag nas bu sko lo/ snying rtse/ do lo/bu mo jo kho/ bstan ma/ yag mo bcas skyes/ sko lo'i bu mo ker dbang rgyal la bu 'jigs pe dang / bu mo be ta gnyis skyes/ da skabs dpa' mcho na yod/ snying rtse rab brtan tshang la mag par song / do lo gong ma la mag ra song / skabs lo'i bu tshe brtan ring / de'i bu thub brtan nyi ma gnyi da skabs stag skor na yod/ /thugs rje (lig )la bu khams pa dang / no'u rgya/ bsod nams dar rgyas/ bu rgyas/ bu mo lha ris bcas skyes/ khams pa'i bu dpal rtse rgyal/'brug rtse rgyal/ stag lha rgyal/ blo bzang / bu mo phag 'tsho/ bu mo chog bcas skyes/ dpal rtse rgyal gyi bu rab gsal (rab tu byung )/ 'phrin bzang / shes rab bzang po/ bu mo gna' sma/ snying kho/ bkra shis skyid bcas yin/ 'azug rtse rgyal la bu bsod rgyam ('di'i bu mo jo zhes da lta ྅ nag gsung rab kyi chung ma yin )dang / dbyig gnyen/ bu mo klu mo rdo bcas skyes/ 'brug rtse rgyal ni no'u rgya'i bu dod yin/ phag mo 'tsho la mag pa dbang 'ba' bzhag nas bu mo 'od gsal/ g.yu rgyal/ 'o mtsho skyid/102

khro mo thar bzhi skyes/ 'od gsal dang g.yu rgyal dpa' mchog la song 'o mtsho skyid la mag pa dpal chen rgyal bzhag khro mo thar la kho nag dbu rdo mag par bzhag bu mo chog lags dzong sngon tshang la song / bsod nams dar rgyas kyis pag we dang gu grags gnyis bu dod du blangs/ pag we la chung ma dpal sgron blangs/ bu mkhar byams dang / skal thu/ dkon mchogabu mo mtsho yag bcas skyes/ gu grags bu 'jam sher/ chos 'byor/ ma cig ba/ bu mo dbu rdo dang mtsho skyid bcas skyes/ 'jam sher gyis bu dod du ye rdo blangs/ zla ba da skabs mgar rtse na yod/ mtsho skyid kyi bu mo lcags mo thar yin/ bu rgyas la bu mkha' ro'u phun tshogs/ 'di'i mi rgyud ni da lta'i nu gu'i bsod byugs tshang yin/ lha ris bu rab brtan/ bu mo lcags 'ba' dang gsum yod/ rab brtan bu ban 'gro/ lha dpal/rab 'phel/ bu mo ge tho bcas skyes/ ban 'gro la bu zhing gi tshe ring skyes/lha dpal dge sher tshang la mag par song / rab 'phel bu ri kho spun mched rnams yin/ ge tho sgar kha'i bstan dar bu stobs chen gyi chung mar byin/tshe dkar sring mo sgron skyid la mi rkyang dka' gyo mag par bzhag nas bu dpal mkhar rgyal dang bu mo g.yang mo mtsho skyes/ dpal mkhar rgyal la bu chos dbyings/ bkra snya/ snying rgya/ 'phags ras/ ban chung / yag lo/ kun thub/ bu mo cha cha bcas skyes/ chos dbyings la rin chen dang /'ja' kho/ snying lo/ do ras/ bu mo me lo/ mtsho kho bcas skyes/ rin chen gyi bu dod byug ge yin pa dang / de'i bu ni gnam po rgyal yin/ 'ja' kho (bkra 'ba'i bu dod )la bu dpa' rgyal/ blo bzang / snying dkar/ban de/ ya bzhes bcas lnga skyes/ dpa' rgyal la bu sgom pa dang bu mo sgrol ma skyes/ blo bzang la bu u de dang lhun grub rgyal/ bu mo dar mo/ cha ras/sgrol ma bcas skyes/ snyeng dkar dang / ban de/ a zhes gsum mag par song / snyeng lo'i bu sga ne/ 'jam dbyangs dar rgyas (rab tu byung )103

bkra shis rgya mtsho (rab tu byung ) bso bo/ bu mo las rab bcas skyes/ sga ne'i bu bzod pa dang sgrol ma skyabs gnyis/ nga brgyad lor sga rte tshe las 'das rjes phyir pha yul nya nag la song / bso bo dpa' mchog la bu dod du byin/ las rab gnas la song / do ris bu don grub/ bskal ldan/lha mkhar bcas/ me lo la bu phyug ge dang / mu jo/ bu mo pad+ma skyid bcas skyes/ phyug ge bu dod du byin/ u jo'i bu dpa' rdo rgyal yin/ phyug ge'i bu dod du sring mo pad+ma skyid kyi bu gnam po rgyal blangs/ mtsho khor bu dbang chen dang tshe 'bum gnyis skyes/ dbang chen gyis ya lo ka la'i bu mo dpal sgron chung mar blangs nas bu la la dang / jo'u lo/ mgon po/ bu mo lo mo/seng ldeng / chog we bcas skyes/ la la'i bu bskal bzang spun mched rnams yin/ mgon po mag par song / seng ldeng mgar rtse gong ma la song /tshe 'bum la gsang bdag ming sring rnams/ snying rgyar bu za kho dang bu mo bo yag gartes skyes/ za kho'i bu ban de grog dmar (mgar rtse la song ) / yo rgyan ( na pa mkhyen rab tshang la mag par song )/ rgya pa(gong ma'i g.yang 'bumathar tshang la song )/ no tho bcas bzhi yin/ bo yag la bu seng log (mgar rtse la song )dang / snying phyug rgyal/ bu mo gar mo yag tsha mo rgyal bcas skyes/ snying phyug rgyal gyi bu dod du ker mo yag blangs nas de la klu 'bum rgyal ming sring rnams skyes/ dpon rgan 'phags ris la bu mo rgya mo dang / lha mo thar/ bo yag gsum skyes/ rgyal mo la bu mo tsha mo rgyal dang /skar ma gnyis skyes rjes rdo rje'i chung ma byas/ lha go thar la mag pa chos ba bzhag nas bu ge rjo dang / stag lha rgyal/ bu mo bkra shis/ sgol ma/dpal yag klu bo sogs skyes/ bu mo bkra shis la mag pa lo po'u bzhagabo yag la rdzogs sgrul ma yum gyi mtshe ya bsod nams mag par bzhag nas bu rgyal mtshan (rab tu byung )dang / bu mo chos ris rgyal skyes/ chos ris rgyal la phur ba mag par bzhag nas bu mo gcig skyes/ de'i mag par tsan grang 10

thar bzhag ban chung gi bu dpa' ris kyis chung mar ya mtsho blangs nas por dbang dang / dbang mo/ sgrol ma/ dar rgyas/ nyi ma sogs ming sring rnams skyes/ dpa' ris tshe las 'das rjes kun thub bu mthar phyin bu dod du blangs/ de dang g.yu rdo gnyis la ya lags mgo dge rin po che sku 'khrungs/ mgo dges hor gdong lha brtan bu mo spas mo yag khab tu bzhes nas bu 'jam dbyangs rdo rje (rab tu byung )skyes pa dang / bu dod du pad+ma dbyings blangs/ yag lo la bu bkra shis dang bu mo g.yang mo rgyal skyes/bkra shis la bu rta bo dang ka rga rgya mtsho gnyis dang / bu mo sgrol lo skyes/ rta bos bu dod da re blangs/ de'i mag par bskal 'ba' bzhag g.yang mo rgyal la mag pa pad ma rig rtsal bzhag nas bu phyag 'tshal dang / klu sgrub/bdud 'dul/ bzod pa bcas skyes/ phyag 'tshal bu stag go/ klu sgrub bu dod rta pu rdo/ bdud 'dul bu phag mo/ bzod pa'i bu rta pu rdo/ zla ba bzang po(rab tu byung)/ bsam 'grub rgyal spun mched rnams/ kun thub (tshe tho'i bu dod )kyis bsod 'ba' chung mar blangs nas bu mthar phyin dang /dbang chen/ phun tshogs sug ring (rab tu byung )/ bsod rgyal cha sdang bcas skyes/ mthar phyin ban chung la bu dod du byin/ dbang chen gyis ri rgya chung mar blangs nas bu yid rgyam dang / 'od gsal/ 'phags pa/(rab tu byung) o rgyan/ chos rgyam bcas skyes rjes ri rgya tshe las 'das/de nas byams pa'i bu mo mkha' 'gro blangs rjes bu mo cha mo skyes/ bsod rgya cha sdang la bu tshul lo skyes rjes phyir ma yul du song / ya ma cha cha la bu g.yang 'bum skyes/ de'i bu mo mkha' la/ de'i bu nor bu rgyal/ de la g.yang rdo ming sring rnams skyes rjes se rgyar sob/ g.yang mo mtsho la bu skya ye dang bu mo pa rgya gnyis skyes/ skya ye la bu mo gar sgong dang / a lags chu ba'i ma yum/thar mo/ snying mo gar(snying tho)/ na na/ lha mo rgyal/ g.yu rdo bcas skyes/ gar sgong stag skor dpon a tho tshang la song / thar mo'i bu snying 100

dkar/ de'i bu thub bstan/ bsod chos/ bu mo ka lo bcas yin/snying tho no'u rgya'i chung mar byin/ na na dbu ris kyi chung mar byin/ lha mo rgyal la a rga kha skyang mag par bzhag nas bu mo gar dros dang bstan ma gnyi4skyes/ bstan ma'i bu mo tsha mo rgyal/ pa rgya la mag pa dge 'dun bzhag nas bu rga po dang / nu'u li gnyis skyes/ rga pos chung mar tsha mo rgyal blangs na4bu ma skyes bar bu dod bskal bzang blangs/ nu'u li la bu bstan pa/bskyags was/ bskal bzang / bu mo sgron yag bcas yod/ bstan pa chos bzang tshang la mag par byin/ bskal bzang rga po la bu dod du byin/sgron yag sha sbrang 'be bza' la song /klu ring la bu lha skyabs dang / ban de/ khon thar/ tshe tho/ bu mo gcig bcas skyes/ lha skyabs la bu lcags byams dang / bzod pa/gzungs nges/ mchog sgrub/ 'od zer/ chos 'dzin (rab tu byung )bcas skyes/ bzod pa'i bu dod skyid le/ de'i bu chos rgya mtsho/ dbang rdor(nywa nag na yod)/ bu mo lha yag bcas yin/ lcags byams kyi bu dod g.yang drung 'bum/ de'i bu 'od zer (grwa ba)/ gsung rab/ don ldan/(u lo'i bu thub bstan la bu dod du byin) bu mo gna' sma/ 'di'i bu mo bde 'tsho rgyal yin/ gzungs nges kyi bu byams pa dang / dpa' phyug bu mo bsod sgron/ klu ris sogs/ byams pa'i bu rab bzang / de'i bu pad+ma rdo rje ming sring rnams yin/ 'od zer gyis bu dod du bsod sgron blangs/de'i bu mo khros ma la dpa' ris g.yang 'ba'i bu chos 'phel mag par bzhagamachog sgrub kyi bu da 'dug bu mo a skyid/ g.yu rdo (hor gdong gcod dros kyi chung ma ) bcas yin/ da 'dug gi bu mo ni tshe ring sgrol ma yin/ ya skyid bu sgrol ma skyabs yin/ de'i bu gter bsrung dang / bu mo dung mtsho skyid spun bzhi/ ban de'i bu snying 'ba'/ ya khu pad+ma rgya mtsho/ bu mo mkha' 'gro/ gnam po bcas skyes/ snying 'ba'i bu mo jo mo thar (stag skor 106

dkon mchog gi ma)/ tshe yag(hor gdong sngags bstan gyi chung ma)/ phyug tho bcas yin/ byug tho'i mag par bsod nams 'bum bzhag nas bu chos grags dang rgya pe gnyis skyes/ mkha' 'gro la bu mgon po tshe brtan/ bu mo tshe rgyal (grong ba'i ngag dbang gi ma ) bsod mtsho (ya khu go'i chung ma) mgon po tshe brtan gyi bu ni chos 'phel dang / dkon mchog 'od ldan/ tshe mgon/ bu mo klu yag bcas yin/ khon thar gyi bu dod chos 'dzin gyi mi rgyud rnams sgyug lo'i mi rgyud na gsal/dpa' lo la nu'u nag jo spyon/ dge long / bu mo gcig bcas skyes/ nu'u nag la yo'u rgya sku phreng lnga ba/ ri nag blo 'ba'/ snying rgyal bcas skyes/ blo 'ba' la bu ka bo rgyal dang / byams pa/ bu mo gna' sma rgyal bcas skyes/ ka bo rgyal la bu mo ma kho dang / 'brug mo skyid/sgron skyid bcas skyes/ ma kho'i bu ni bu rdo rgyal ming sring rnams yin/gna' sma rgyal la mag pa ku yang bzhag nas bu dbang phyug dang / rab brtan gnyis skyes/ dbang byug gi mi rgyud rnams ྅ nag na yod/ rab brtan mag par song / byams pa la bu mo phag mo(sngo ris dang ban gro'i ma)/mkha' 'gro (dbang chen gyi chung ma)/ rta rdo skyes rjes gnas la song / snying rgyal la bu dpa' ris dang / bsam 'grub/ klu 'bum/ rgyal lo/ no tho bcas skyes/ dpa' ris la ma lags rgya bza' sku phreng gsum pa 'jam dbyangs blo bzang zub bstan rgya mtsho dang / zon thar/ bu mo gar dros/g.yang 'ba'/ bo log bcas skyes/ zon thar la bu blo bzang bsam 'grub (blo bsam )dang / bu mo dbang mo rgyal/ ka rdo/ klu mo yag bcas skyes/gar dros la bu pad ma 'od zer dang / tshe ring rgyal (tshe pu'i bu dod)/ bu mo tshe ring sgrol ma bcas skyes/ g.yang 'ba' la bu chos 'phel (klu ring gi mi rgyud na gsal )dang bu mo gangs mo gnyis skyes/ rgyal lo la bu dbang rgyal dang / tshe pu/ dpa' skyabs/ 'jam dbyangs rgya mtsho (rab tu byung )/101

stobs ldan/ bu mo snying mo gar/ sko bo/ rgya mo bcas skyes/ dbang rgyal la bu legs tshogs ('di'i bu dod rta rdo yin )dang / rta pu'u/ bu mo cha ris bcas skyes/ rta pu'u bu sngags phrug yin/ tshe pu'i bu dod ni brtson 'grus dang / tshe ring rgyal yin/ dpa' skyabs kyi bu dod ni sko rdo nag yin/rgya mo la bu blo brtan dang / chos mchog gnyis skyes/ sko bo la mag pa dpa' lo bzhag bu dod du blo brtan blangs/ snying mo gar ya mchod sha wa ri tshang la gnas la byin nas bu 'jigs med mthu chen dang / ban 'gro rgyal/u po bcas skyes/ jo spyon gyi bu rgya thus no tho bu dod du blangs/ no tho'i bu ni rgyal mtshan dang / ban 'gro/ bsod po rgyal/ bu mo chos mtsho sgrol ma bcas yin/ rgyal mtshan gyi bu mo tshe lo la bu sko ring skyes rjes gnas la song /ban 'gro la bu grags pa bstan 'dzin dang bu mo bde lo sogs skyes/ bsod po rgyal la bu 'jam dbyangs blo gros dang / tshul khrims/(rab tu byung) sko rdo nag sgrol lo bcas skyes/ chos mtsho sgrol ma la bu mo chos sgron rgyal skyes/de'i rjes rabs pa ni yu po rgyal ming sring rnams yin/ /rgya mtsho la bu ye chung skyes pa dang / de la bu 'jam dbyangs (rab tu byung ) dang / bkra kho/ snyan grags phra mo/ bu mo gar rgya/ rdo rje mtsho sogs skyes/ gar rgya'i mag par lcags rgyal bzhag nas bu 'jam dbyangs mkhas btsun dang / rgya mtsho/ bu mo jo phrug skya tho/ cha ris sogs skyes/ 'jam dbyangs mkhas btsun gyi chung mar cha ris blangs/ de'i bu dod ni sngags phrug yin/ rgya mtsho la bu 'od zer (rab tu byung ) dang / bu mo ting 'dzin skyid gnyis skyes/ jo phrug la mag pa sangs lo bzhag nas bu dodadu rgya rigs blangs/ rdo rje mtsho la bu g.yang 'bum (g.yang ring )skyes/de'i bu dod du gnam lha blangs/ gnam lhas chung ma gnyis blangs pa'i sngon mar mkhyen brtse dang / bu mo jo kho/ sgyug tho/ bkra shis skyid bcas skyes/rjes mar bu rgya ma gsum spun mched rnams skyes/ /108

bsod skyid la bu smon lam dang / zla grags/ (rab tu byung) gnam rgyal/ bu mo chos mo sgron/ smon lam la bu lo zhes star kha dang / dbu mdzad nag rdo/ dge legs('di'i mi rgyud g.yu rngogs na yod) / chos mo sgron gyi bu mo chos mo rgyal yin la de'i bu ni rdo rje dang / chos grub/ (rab tu byung) lha rgyal bcas yin/ rdo rje la bu gdugs dkar dang / bu mo bo mo chog 'phags ma skyid/ tsher ma rgyal bcas skyes/ gdugs dkar gyi rjes rabs pa ni sgrol skyabs rgyal ming sring rnams dang / 'phags ma skyid gyi bu ni jang len ming sring rnams yin/ tshe ma rgyal gyi bu tshe ring don grub yin/lha rgyal gyi bu mo 'brug mo rgyal la mag pa sgar skor ku lo bzhag nas bu tshe brtan rgyal skyes/ /na skar/ /de yang sgar skor zhes pa'i ming gi byung tshul ni/ yo'u rgya rdo rje 'chang gi sku phreng sngon ma gnyes snga gzhug tu sgar ba'i dge slong gi sras dang tsha bor 'khrungs pa dang / khyad par tu sgar kha'i rta sto'i bu mo bzang mo la yo'u rgya rdo rje 'chang 'jam dbyangs mkhyen rab dpal bzang 'khrungs/ dus de nas bzung dge slong tshang dang rta snyo tshang ni bla ma sku phreng gsum gyi sku yul yin pas sgar kha zhes 'bod pa dang / dge slong dang rta sgo la sgar kha'i dge slong dang sgar kha'i rta sto zer/ phyis su sgar kha'i dge slong dang sgar kha'i rta snyo zhes pa'i ming de bsdus ming du gyur nas sgar dge dang sgar rtam du 'bod cing /sgar rtam spun mched kyi sbra kha rnams ri skor gcig byas nas bsdad pa la sgar kha zer zhing / phyis su rim gyis ming 'gyur nas sgar skor zhes pa'i da lta'i ming 'di thogs so/ /sgar ba'i bstan pa la bu gnam lha dang / tshe lo/ klu ring / dpal lo/ ri spyon/ rgya mtsho bcas bu drug yod pa'i nang gi ri spyon la sgar skor dge slong dang bu mo gnyis skyes/ sgar skor dge slong la bu lnga skyes pa'i che ba 10 9

a lags yo'u rgya sku phreng gsum pa yin/ 'di ba chung dus gshegs/'di'i yang srid dge slong gi sring mo'i pa du 'khrungs/ 'di ba yang chung dus gshegs/ sgar skor dge slong gi bu gnyis pa rta stongam sgar rtam la bu gzungs lo dang / tshul khrims bya mgo gnyis dang bu mo lnga skyes/ gzungs los snga phyir chung ma gnyis blangs pa'i sngon ma bla rgan tshang gi mtsho mo yin/de la mkhar 'bum mingasring gnyis skyes/ rjes ma mgar rtse sman zhol gyi yu rdo yin/ de la bu ma skyes pas gzungs lo'i sring mo'i bu mo mtsho mo'i bu bstan dar dang dko ring gi bu bzang bo gnyis bu skal du blangs/ bzang bo rab tu byung / bstan dar gyis mgar rtse sman shul nas sgrol ma mtsho blangs te gser lag brtsi bzhag byams pa zla grags sku phreng gsum pa blo bzang lung rig rgya mtsho dang / stobs chen/ rgyal mtshan/ bu mo dpal mtsho rgyal dang / dar mo/ mtsho yag sogs ming sring drug skyes/ /gzungs lo'i bu mkhar 'bum la nya nag nas chung ma tshe lo blangs te bu ma skyes par dkon dar dang sras lo gnyis bu dod du blangs/ dkon dar rab tu byung / sras los zur tshang nas ma kho skyid chung mar blangs te/ bu ye shes skyes/ sgar rtam gyi bu chung ba tshul khrims bya mgo la so nag nas chung ma zhig blangs/ de la bu med pas kho'i sring mo'i bu blo bzang (lo po )bu skal du blangs/ lo po ni sgar skor gyi las don la mgo 'dzin mkhan 'jon thang can zhig yin/ lo po'i a ma'i ming la dkar mo zer zhing sgar rtam gyi bu mo 'bring ba yin/ kho mo gle ba'i thar lo'i chung ma byas/ bu bsam kho dang /lo po/ pad+ma rig rtsal bcas skyes/ thar lo 'das rjes mos bu gsum po khrid nas phyir yo'u rgyar yong / lo pos sha sbrang stag yan nas chung ma mtsho mo blangs te bu byams grags dang / lha btsun rgyal gnyis skyes/ byams grags kyis chung ma tsher ma rgyal blangs te bu tshe ring don grub skyes/ lha tsun rgyal gyis chung ma lha mo blangs te bu dpa' mkhar rgyal skyes/ dge slong gi bu gsum 110

pa klu 'bum la bu dbu mdzad shes rab dang / dbu mdzad byams pa (byams ring )/ bu mo yag ge sogs ming sring gsum skyes/ dbu mdzad shes rab ni 'don rta dbyings la shin tu mkhas pa zhig yin te/ khong gis snga phyi gnyis la dbu mdzad kyi las sne khur zhing gser lag dgon pa'i 'don rta dbyangs la dag bcos mdzad pa'i lo rgyus yod/ dbu mdzad byams ring ni bla ma yo'u rgya tshang gi dbon po yin/ klu 'bum gyi bu gsum pa ni dkon me (pa bo yang zer )yin/ dkon me la dpa' mchog nas dpal mo chung mar bsus kyang bu ma byung / klu 'bum gyi bu mo yag ge la kho nag nas bkra rgyam mag par bzhag ste/ bu blo bzang rgya mtsho dang (rab tu byung)/ 'jam bzang / bu mo skyid mo rgyal bcas gsum skyes/ 'jam bzang la sgar ba'i dpon rgan 'phags ris kyi bu mo rgya mo'i bu mo gar ma chung mar blangs nas bu kun bzang rgyal dang / bsam pa'i don grub/ spul thar rgyal/ bu mo dbang mtsho rgyal sogs ming sring drug skyes/ kho ni dgon gong ma'i khyigs bdag brgyad cu'i gras yin/ skyid mo rgyal la mag pa klu tshang dbang chen rgyal bzhag nas bu blo bzang mkhas mchog dang / nam mkha' rdo rje/ chos bzang / bstan 'phel/ bu mo sgrol ma skyid/ khyi mo thar bcas ming sring drug skyes/ /sgar skor dge slong gi bu chung ba ya rda la bu klu sgrub (rab tu byung ) dang /bsam 'grub rab tu byung ) / bu mo klu skyid bcas skyes/ klu sgrub ni ma lags glo'u rgya sku phreng snga phyi gnyis kyi dbon po yin zhing / kun gyis kho la nang chen dbon rgan zer/sgar skor a rdas nya nag nam mkha'i bu mo phyug mo bu skal du blangs/ de la yo'u rgya gong ma'i dko ring mag par bzhag nas bu phun tshogs(rab tu byung ) dang / bzang bo(rab tu byung ) / che lo/ sras lo/ thogs med(rab tu byung ) / chos 'byor(rab tu byung ) sogs skyes/ che lor glo'u jo kho'i bu mo lha rgya chung mar blangs/ de la bu med pas sgar skor bstan 111

dar gyi bu chung ba rgyal mtshan bu skal du blangs/a da'i bu mo klu skyid la mkhas grub mag par bzhag nas bu chos skyabs skyes/sgar rtam gyi bu mo che bar bu chos 'phel (da rda )skyes rjes nywa nag la song /der bu mang / chos mdzad dang thog dgon pa'i grwa ba yin/ phyis su skya sar bab te kho rgya nas g.yang rgya chung mar blangs/ de la bu med pas snying dkar skya la'i bu lha mchog rgyal bu skal du blangs/ de la bla rgan tshang nas bkra ma rgyal chung mar blangs nas bu bstan 'dzin dang / kho lo/ bu mo dpal mo rgyal bcas ming sring gsum skyes/ nga brgyad lor bkra ma rgyal tshe las 'das rjes lha mchog rgyal gyis yo'u rgya gong ma nas lha mo chung mar blangs/ lha mchog rgyal tshang gi sbra 'di ni o'u rgya rdo rje 'chang tshang 'khrungs khyim yin/ /bsam kho'i chung ma ni bkra rgyam gyi sring mo yin/ der bu mo mkhar mo rgyal skyes/ mo la lcang skya nas tshe ris mag par bzhag ste bu mkhas btsun dang / ma cig bsod grags gsum skyes/ bsam kho'i nu bo pad ma rig rtsal sgar ba'i yag lo tshang la mag par song / /sgar rtam gyi bu mo bzang mo la ya lags yo'u rgya sku phreng drug pa 'jam dbyangs mkhyen rab dpal bzang dang / dge legs (grwa ba yin/ o'u rgya tshang gi dbon po byas )gnyis skyes/ dge slong gi sring mo'i (bla ma'i yum )bu mos ya gyes 'brug lo zer ba bu skal du blangs/ de la bu gsang bdag dang /chos skyong sngo la/ 'jam dbyangs/ tshe dbang thar/ bu mo gser mo bcas skyes/ gsang bdag la bu bkra shis rgyal dang / bsam 'grub rgyal/ ngag bzang gsum skyes/ 'jam dbyangs la bu blo gros dang / ngu mi g.yang mtsho rgyal gnyis skyes/ tshe dbang thar la bu snying dkar rgyal skyes/ /sgar rtam gyi sring mo chung ba'i bu mo khyi mo la bu dge bzang dang stag thung gnyis skyes/ dge bzang rgya bzas bsad/ stag byung la bu ku lo dang /113

bstan pa/ mgon po rgyal/ bu mo gcig bcas skyes/ ku lo dang mgon po rgyal gnyis da lta kho rgya na yod/ bstan pa 'ba' lung rka bar ma na yod/bu mo'i ming la tshe sgron rgyal zer/ yo'u rgya sgar bar gnas la yong / /sgar rtam gyi spun dar mig gi bu ni skya pa ser dros yin/ de'i bu'i ming la pe zi zer/ de'i rjes rabs pa ni da lta'i ja la sde ba'i sdom po zer ba de yin/ /(2) zags nagasngags nag ni sgar ba las gyes pa'i tsho ba zhig ste/ sgar ba'i dge 'dun gyi mi rgyud yin/ yo'u rgya'i dpon po gnam zhes skabs su sngags mang gi spyi dpon dbang kho (dbang chen )la bu zhig skyes pa'i ming la sngags pa chos skyong nag sdang zer ba dang / de'i ru skor la sngags nag ces btags/de'i skabs kyi tsho dpon ni sngags pa nag sdang yin zhing / kho rang lo sum bcu'i steng 'das/ de'i rjes su bsang khos tsho dpon khur ba dang / de'i rjes su bsod pa rgya sdang / de'i bu rta bo rgyal gyis tsho dpon khur/ de'i rjes nas u rdo ring bas tsho dpon khur ro/ /zagasanag gimi da/ /sgar ba'i dge 'dunal bu ban de rgyal dang / tshul dbang rgyal/tshul dbang skyabs/ bu mo bsod sgron/ 'brug mtsho bcas skyes/ /ban de rgyal la ྅ nag nas chung ma bsus te bu skal bzang rgyal (skal dbyangs )'jigs med/ gnam zhes/ a khu dbang kho bzhi skyes/ da dung a ma tshe mo zer ba zhig kyang yod skad pa de g.yer skyong du song zer/ /bskal dbyangs la bu mo gcig skyes pa'i mag par rdor skyabs bzhagade'i bu skal ni gar dros dang tshe 'ba' gnyis yin/ /gar dros la bu yu rdo dang / grags bzang (rab tu byung )/ chos lo/'phags skyabs rgyal/ sngo ris rdo/ bde po/ g.yang skyid/ g.yang sgron/113

gu ru mtsho bcas skyes/ /u rdo la bu jo phrug dang / bu mo la po/ mgo rdo/ g.yang skyid bcas skyes/ /tshe ring la 'jam bzang dang / lo brgya/ skyid rgya/ gar yagakho'u chog ri rdo bcas ming sring drug skyes/ /tshe 'ba' la dpa' rdo dang / chos bzang / bsod nams skyid gsum skyes/ /dpa' rdo'i bu mo lha mo rdo la mā yun tshe mag par bzhag nas tshe ring rgyal ming sring rnams skyes/ chos bzang la rdor 'bum ming sring skyes/ /'dzigs med kyis lhun po bu dod du blangs/ des chung ma gnam po blangs/ des rdo bo bu dod du blangs/ rdo bo la pad ma 'azin las dang /thub bstan/ btsan rgod/ sras mchog mchog ldan/ snying mo dang drug skyes/ nga brgyad lor mchog ldan phud gzhan tshang ma tshe las 'das pas/mchog ldan dang phur ba khyim gcig tu bsdad/ phur ba'i chung ma g.yang mo'i bu skal du yo'u rgya sku zeng brgyad pa blangs/ban de rgyal gyi bu yo'u rgya'i meng chen gnam phyug gam gnam zhes la chung ma 'ga' yod pa la nu gu 'jigs med dang / snying dpal/ bsod pa/tshe mo rgyal/ gnam mtsho skyid/ bu skal tshag snya/ bo skal pad ma mtsho bcas bdun las/ snying dpal la dpon po bsang kho/ bu mo sgrol ma mtsho/chos mo yag lha 'tshams skyid dang bzhi skyes/bsang kho la jo skyabs rgyal dang / ke lo/ gar ma skyid/ rdo mo/dar kho bcas skyes/ chos mo yag la mag pa sher dmar bzhag nas bu skal skya kho dang 'a 'a cha gnyis blangs/ skya kho'i bu ni ban 'gro yin/ 'ba' char mag pa dpa' mchog lo dpa' bzhag ste tshe dbang rgyal dang / lcags thar rgyal/ bsod nams rgyal/ gru'u mo/ tshe mo dang lnga skyes/ /11

bsod pa rgya sdang la bu rta bo rgyal dang / bu mo ma kho/ bu skal bkra shis/ thub bstan bcas yod/ rta bo rgyal la bu dbang chen rdo rje dang /yo rgyan 'jigs med rnam grol/ dge byams/ bu mo rdo mo bcas yod/bkra shis la pad ma 'phrin las dang / do pe/ dpa' mtsho/ dpa' skyid rgyal/ bde bo/ gcod mo sogs skyes/ de dag mgar rtse gong ma na yod/ /dpa' mtsho la thub bstan mag par bzhag tshag 'ba' la bu rgya me dang / 'u no/ dpal le/ dbang ldan rgyal/ bu mo dpal sgron sogs skyes/ dbang ldan rgyal gyi bu bar rdo da lta shar tshang na yod/ /rgya mes bu mo sgro ris/ gur mo/ g.yang rdo/ tshe rdo bzhi skyes/g.yang rdo la mag pa hri hrin tshe bzhag nas bu mo g.yang mo mtsho sogs bzhi skyes /tshe rdo 'be bzar song /dang 'a lar ya rga dang / bla rdo/ ban 'gro/ g.yang mo mtsho/gcod mo rdo bcas ming sring lnga skyes/ dpal sgron la mag pa g.yang 'bum bzhag nas bdud lo dang / rta mgrin/ thub bstan/ rdo log mgar ba/ tshe skyid/ tsher ma bcas bdun skyes/gnam mtsho skyid la 'phags pa mag par bsus nas rnam rgyal dang /thar mtsho/ gar lo gsum skyes/ thar mtsho la rab brtan mag par bsus nas 'brug rdo dang / lo sdang / g.yang drung 'bum/ stag 'bum rgyal/gter 'bum rgyal/ bu mo jo mo/ jo tshe dang bdun skyes/ /pad+ma mtsho'i bu mo g.yang 'ba'/ de'i bu mo rta lo/ sgrol ma skyid/'tshams skyid/ 'tshams skyid la ngag dbang mag par bsus nas bu mo chos thar skyid ming sring rnams skyes/a khu dbang khos chos skyong nag sdang dang a mchod sha wa bu skal du blangs/chos skyong ni sngags pa togs ldan pa sman rtsis sogs la mkhas pa zhig yin/115

kho'i ring nas bzung sgar ba'i dge 'dun gyi bu rabs tsha rgyud la sngags nag tshang thogs/ a mchod sha pa'i ma ni hor gyi yin skad/ /chos skyong la rdor lo dang / stobs ldan/ mthu stobs rdo rje/ jo mo bcas skyes/ mthu stobs rdo rje la garma/ theg lo/ snying 'ba' gsum skyes/kerma'i bu 'od gsal/ theg lo la ke skyabs rgyal sogs bu bu mo brgyad skyes/sha wa'i bu mdo sde mag par song / /sgar ba'i dge 'dun gyi bu tshul dbang rgyal la bu 'jam dpal dang /a ba/ bkra tho gsum skyes/ 'jam dpal la bu stag dkar dang / phun tshogs(rab tu byung) / bu mo mtsho skyid gsum/stag dkar la bu byams bzang (rab tu byung ) dang / 'gru ba/ nor bu rgyal/ bu mo klu yag phyug ge ya yag wa/ tshe lo dang bdun/ /a ba la bu ba lo dang / dkon mchog rgya bo/ rgyan 'phangs nyi zla/bde sgron dang ming sring drugab lor gcod dros dang / blo bzang (rab tu byung )/ pad+ma skyid/tshe lo/ g.yu lo/ g.yu mtsho/ chos mo yag chos lu dang bu bu mo — brgyad/ /gcod dros bu skal ni tsha bo stag lha dang / tsha mo dpal mo gnyis/ /stag lha'i bu ni khyung skyabs rgyal dang / bu mo bde kho/ dpung yas gsum mo/dpal mo la zon thar rgyal mag par bsus te/ bu yi rdo dang / bu mo 'dzoms skyid rgyal sogs yod/ /tshe lo la rgyal mtshan mag par bsus shing / der bu bla ma blo bzang phun tshogs rgya mtsho (phur tsha tshang)dang / ngag dbang phun tshogs/ bu mo g.yang dkar gsum skyes/ ngag dbang phun tshogs la dpal pe ming sring rnams skyes/ /116

dkon mchog la bla rgan dang / dbang mo/ u mtsho gsum/ bla rgan la bu mkhyen rab dang / dbang mo rgyal la rig 'dzin mag par bsus nas g.yang byug rgyal dang / yo rdo/ mtsho rgyal/ g.yang sgron bzhi skyes/ /rgya bo'i bu a skyabs dang mtha' tshe gnyis/ a skyabs la bu mo gar skyid la dkar sde mag par bsus shing / bu stong thar ming sring rnams skyes/mtha' tshe'i bu ni sgro sto dang tshe sto gnyis so/ /rgyan 'phangs la gnam byams rgyal dang / bla ma hor gdong tshang /sgrol ma mtsho/ 'brug mo ming sring rnams/ gnam byams rgyal la hor gdong blo 'azin tshang dang / rig 'dzin rdo rje (rig pe)/ ka lo/ sgrol dkar/klu mo rgyal rnams skyes la/ klu mo rgyal la bu dko rdo rgyal skyes/ sgrol ma mtsho'i shul na tsin thar rgyal tshang yod pa mgar rtse na yod/ 'brug mo la bu yi dam dang / bu mo bu rgya/ 'ga' rgya/ ma cig rnams/ 'ga' rgya la klu po dang klu mo ming sring gnyis/ bu rgya dang grags pa gnyis la bkra 'bum dang /tsher ma skyid/ bo mo mtshams/ tshe ring sgrol ma/ dka' thub drug klu mo la lis thu men mag par bsus nas gang be spun mched rnams skyes/ /nyi zla'i bu byams rgyal/ no'u li/ dpa' bo dkar sdang gsum/byams rgyal la bstan dar dang / mu rdo/ ka dros/ g.yang byug bzhi/bstan dar gyi bu mo ri mtsho la stag ma mag par bsus nas dga' rab ming sring rnams skyes/ /mu rdo la bu thogs med rgyal dang / bu mo bde mtsho/ sngo ras/ gyug tho bzhi/ /ka dros dang tshe bdag gnyis la mthu rdor dang / dpa' lo/ phur ba/phag mo rgyal ming sring bzhi/no'u lha'i bu mo lha sgron la lha brtan mag par bsus te/ bu g.yang drung dang / thabs mkhas/ tshe rdo/ bas mo yag kar mo yag bcas —117

skyes/ /g.yang drung la gcod thar sogs bu mo lnga/ thabs mkhas la 'jam dpal rdo rje ming sring rnams/tshe sgron la 'phags skyabs rgyal mag par bsus nas bu mu rgyan dang /lha chen/ bsam 'grub/ bu mo phag mo tshe ring / dga' skyid/ bsod nams mtsho bcas so/ /bde sgron la nges 'ba' mag par bsus/ de'i bu mo ya ma rgyal/ ya ma rgyal gyi mag par 'ja' dmar bsus/ de'i bu ban sna dang / rgya rdo/bu mo lcags thar/ zu mo/ rgya kho/ tsha lo/ sgro ris dang bdun/ sgro ris la ban 'gro dang / jo the/ gcod thar ming sring ngo / /bkra tho la bu snying dkar rgyal dang khon ne gnyis/ snyeng dkar rgyal la bu g.yang skyabs rgyal dang / snying kho rgyal/ dkon mchog dar rgyas/byams pa (rab tu byung ) / don grub/ lha mchog rgyal/ bu mo snying mo skyid/ g.yu lo dang brgyad/ /snying kho rgyal gyi bu ni bsam gtan dang / chos dpal/ bu mo dpa' mo rgyal gsum/ bsam gtan la bu stag rtse ming sring rnams dang / chos dpal la bu phur ba ming sring rnams skyes so/ /g.yu lo'i mag par tsa gi'i mgar ba bsus/ bo skal du bkra shis skyid blangs/tshul dbang skyabs la bu 'brug lha dang / 'brug ban/ la bo/ bu mo lha sgron dang bzhi skyes/ /'brug lha'i bu rgya mtsho (rab tu byung ) dang / dpal chen/ rus grags/ bsam gtan (rab tu byung )/ ka dros (bu skal du byin )bu mo snying kho dang drugadapal chen kyi bu ni lhun grub rig 'dzin/ bu mo jo rgan/ tshe ris/118

g.yang sgron/ bo yag kar skyid/ 'brug sdu dang bdun/lhan grub rig 'dzin la bad kho'i lha mo chung mar bsus te bu mo tshe ring skyid dang / mkha' 'gro 'tsho gnyis/ /tshe ring sbyid bad khor song / mkha' 'gro mtshos mag par bkra shis bsus/ /rus grags kyi bu ni byang 'dren zla grags dang / tshe 'bum/ mkha' ne/ g.yu sgron bzhi/zla grags la 'jigs med rnam rgyal dang rin chen mtsho gnyis/ tshe 'bum bu kun bzang dang de'i bu ni dge slong ming sring rnams/ /snying kho'i bu ni bkra bo rgyal dang / 'jigs tshogs (rab tu byung ) /sgro ris gsum/ /bkra bo rgyal la sgrol skyabs rgyal dang / dge slong / tshe sgron gsum/ /mkha' ne la ban 'gro dang mgo mtsho rgyal gnyes skyes/ ban 'gro'i bu skal ska rdo dang / mgo mtsho rgyal ban 'gro rma bya'i chung ma byas/ /sngags 'chang 'brug ban la bu dge 'dun dang / bstan ne+e/ a khu ba res/ chos skyong / lha chen/ bsod 'ba'/ bu mo sgron kho rnams skyes/ /dge 'dun la bu phun tshogs bkra shis/ bsod dar/ skya sdang / bu mo phag mo thar/ bsod mtsho/ mdong mo/ dge ma dang bdun/ /phun tshogs bkra shis la bu tshe ring thar dang / bu mo rgya mo rdo/ g.yang 'dzoms gsum/ bsod dar la bu ban 'gro sogs skyes/ skya sdang la tshe ring bkra shis ming sring rnams dang / bsod mtsho la bu ku pe skyes shing kho da lta mgar rtse na yod/ /phag mo thar la bu bsod rdo dang / smon lam/ thub bstan/ dpal bzang / stag pe lnga/ /119

bstan ne la rab brtan dang / shes rab (rab tu byung ) / chos 'byor/ zla ba/ bu mo pa pa dang lnga/ /rab brtan la bu bsam gtan dang / 'phrin rgyam/ gsung rab/bu mo gzungs mo dang bzhi/ /chos 'byor la bu dpal ldan dang / bu mo dpa' mo rgyal/ klu 'ba' rgyal/ gar mtsho/ bde mtsho dang lnga/ /pa pa'i bu dpal thar dang yu rgyan rgyal gnyis/ /a khu pa re g.yer skyong pa yas tshang la mag par song / phyis su pa yas tshang yongs dzogs khrid nas yo'u rgyar yong / kho'i bu skal du ri po dang snying 'ba' gnyis blangs/ /ri po'i bu yu po dang / no pe/ rgya phrug bu mo bsam 'grub bzhi/ /snying 'ba' la nya nag rta kho mag par bsus nas bu tshe 'bum rgyal dang /ye shes/ seng lo/ ban de thar/ dpal chen rgyal/ lha chen rgyal/ klu po dang brgyad(tshe 'bum rgyal dang ye shes gnyis kyi ma de bo'i bu mo dang /ban thar dang seng lo gnyis kyi pha dbang byug go) /ye shes la bu stobs chen rgyal dang bkra po/ seng lo'i bu skal du rgya phrug blangs/ba ris a zhang pa yas bu chos 'bum/ jo rgya/ snying 'ba'/ lo po skyid/ mkhal ma dang lnga/ /chos 'bum bu rto lo dang / dar rdo/ gnam phyug bu mo snying mo rgyal/ bu rdo/ cha ras/ bo 'tshams dang bdun/ /a ma sgon kho'i bu sman rgan mkhyen rab de'i bo skal ma g.yang mo rgyal/g.yang mo rgyal la mag pa yo rgyan bsus rte bu mo lcags the dang / lcags the la do le ming sring rnams skyes/ /yo'u rgya'i ya kyes la bo la bu skal lha chen dang / lha chen gyi bu ni mkhar 120

'bum rgyal dang dzam 'ba' gnyis yin/ /mkhar 'bum rgyal gyi bu skal ni 'gyur med dang 'jam sher gnyis yin/'gyur med kyi bu ni 'jam dbyangs mthar phyin dang / phun tshogs/gser rdo rgyal/ 'jigs med don 'grub/ bu mo phur ba mtsho dang lnga/ /sgar ba'i dge 'dun gyi bu mo 'brug mtsho la bu tshe brtan rgyal dang a che 'tshams pa gnyis/ /tshe brtan rgyal gyi bu ni a lcags dang nges 'ba' yin/ ya lcags la bu ya bo/ de'i bu dbang 'ba'/ legs bshad/ lo gas/ bla ma/gnam lha/ bu mo sgro lo/ g.yang rgya/ chos 'tsho skyid/ gar mo rgyal bcas ming sring dgu/ /lo gos bu yang sangs/ de'i bu rdo kho rgyal ming sring rnams/ /bla ma'i bu tshe ring don grub ming sring rnams/ sgrol lo'i bu skal du bsod nams rdo rje dang dpa' lo blangs/ /ya che 'tshams pa'i mag par bkra 'bu bsus shing / de la bu mkhas grub dang / mkhas thub kyis chos skyabs rgyal dang g.yu mtsho gnyis shul 'dzin du blangs/ /chos skyabs rgyal gyi bu skal ni bsam 'grub rgyal dang / sgrol ma skyid do/ /g.yu mtsho la don 'grub rgyal dang / zon thar rgyal/ byams pa gsum skyes la/ byams pa'i bu mo ni ka pe yin/ /dge 'dun gyi bu mo bsod sgron la bu kha bo skyes la/ de ya rig dge rgya tshang la mag par song zhing / ru phyir khrid yong rjes bu ma khu yo tshar (rab tu byung ) dang / tshul khrims (rab tu byung ) / a she jo mo/ g.yang skyid/mkha' mo sogs ming sring drug skyes/ / —a she la bu mu rgyan skyabs dang bu mo gnam me gnyis skyes/ 121

yu rgyan skyabs la bu ban de dang bu mo lngang lo gnyis skyes/ ban de'i bu lha mchog skyabs/ gu ru skyabs/ stag lha skyabs/ bu mo bsod ldan skyid dang bzhi yin/ /jo mo la lobyes rdza lo mag par bsus/ de'i bu rab brtan/ de'i bu dbang grags dang / bu mo phag mo sogs drug yod/ dbang grags la 'phags pa spun mched rnams dang / phag mo la snying brtse mag par bsus/de'i bu phyug go rgyal dang / don grub/ dge bsam/ ban dmar/ bu mo jo rig bsod skyid dang lnga/ /g.yang skyid la mag pa rta kho bsus/ de'i bu bkra dbang ('di mgo log ha skor gyi dpon po byas)/ bsod nams/ chos 'phel/ gnas brtan/ sgro ris/ /bsod nams la bu thang lo dang / ri po/ klong grol/ ngag dbang /bu mo tshe mo dang lnga/ /chos 'phel gyi bu ni gnas brtan rgyal dang blo rab gnyis/ gnas brtan rgyal la bu ngag rgyam dang / lo thar/ klu 'bum rgyal/ / bu mo ska yag skyid/ jo mo/ bkra mo dang druga.a khu klong grol gyi chung ma sgrol ma skyid kyi pha rgan kwa ci'i a jo dang a ma snying mo gnyis la bu gon tan dang / ska yag bu mo bun khrang / 'ga' dbang / sgrol ma skyid/ bya lo/ bo tsig zon rte dang brgyad yod do/ /( ) yo'urgya gong ma/ /yo'u rgya gong ma zhes pa'i ming byung tshul ni sa 'dir rim gyis gnas spos te 'ong ba'i lam khar ru skor gong zhol du babs pa'i gnas ltar btags pa yin zhing / ru skor gong ma de tor dang ha cang thag nye ba'i sar gnas pas hor dang 'dres cha che la hor gyi skyes lha gyes ser rgod kyang mchod/ sdod gnas khyad par gyis tsho ming btags pa de las gzhan da dung kha cig gis ru 122

skor 'dir bu mang po yod pas yo'u rgya bu mang tshang zer srol yang mchis par bshad/ 'di'i tsho dpon rim byung ni dang thog tsho dpon su yis khur gsal cha ma mchis kyang / rjes su ban mo che rkang rgan gyis tsho ba bskyangs/ de nas de bos tsho sde gnyis mnyam du bskyangs shing / de'i bu ban phrug dang /'jigs med/ 'dzigs blo sogs yin/ 'jigs blo ni yo'u rgya sngags mang gi sngags rabs bdun pa yin zhing / 1998lor sku chos dbyings su /dephebs/ /yo'utha gong ma'imirabs/ /yo'u rgya gong ma ni chos ldan gyi bu dbang rgyal las chad pa yin/ dbang rgyal la bu bde lo rgyal bo dang / ska ska/ sbyin spyong / ban 'greng / yi dam mam yi ban/ bu mo pad+ma mtsho bcas ming sring drug skyes/ /de yang bde lo gyol bor bu tshogs rnam mam tshe dbang rnam rgyal dang /a dge gyol bo/ dge 'dun hre bo gsum byung / /tshogs rnam la bu sman pa mthu 'ba' dang / sman pa snying rgyal/ bu mo gser mtsho dang / gur mo/ sgrol ma/ g.yang sgron skyid/ sgron dkar/g.yang skyid bcas ming sring brgyad byung / /sman pa mthu snyar bu ya rga yang dag dang sman pa chos dar gnyis skyes/ /spun pa chos dar gyi bu tshab la bu mo dam tshig blangs nas mag pa rta bo bzhag par bu mo lha sgron rgyal skyes/ de la mag pa 'brug rdo bzhag nas bu mo rdo mo skyes/sman pa snying rgyal la bu pa pa rgya mtsho dang / dkon mchog klu skyabs/bstan ne/ bu mo thar mo/ ka rgya'i mkhas btsun ma bcas ming sring drug skyes/ /thar mo la gle ba'i shing nge mag par bsus nas bu ka pa dang / ke ku/bu mo 'brug mo gsum skyes/ /123

ki ku la sngags pa 'jig med dang 'brug mo gnyis skyes/ /pa pa rgya mtshor bu 'jigs med (che )dang / bstod po/ 'jigs med (chung )/ mo'u rgya sgrul sku blo bzang rgya mtsho/ bu mo dbang rgyal/bsod sgron bcas ming sring drug byung / /dkon mchog gi bu mo jo thar la dbang chen thar mag par bzhagadis tshe pe bu tshab tu blangs/ /klu skyabs la bu mkhar rgyal skyes shing / mkhar rgyal la bu chos dbyings dang / rta mgrin/ lo po bcas skyes/ /bstan ner bu skar ma tshe brtan skyes shing / skar ma tshe brtan la bu thub bstan dang / mgon chung / g.yang pe/ dpag med rgyal bcas skyes('di rnams hor na yod)/ /bu mo gser mtshor dpa' mchog stag lha'i bu mag par bzhag ste/ bu 'jigs med skyes pa dang / de'i bu lo rgas (de'i bu dpal ldan)/ ka bu (de'i bu rang grol)/ bstan pa (de'i bu mo g.yang mo skyid ) bcas skyes/bu mo gur mo'i bu rta rgya/ de'i bu ya rga gser dang / no'u 'ba'/ni ge/ zi lo bcas spun bzhi/ /ya rga gser la bu rab rgyas dang / 'jigs chos sogs skyes/ no'u 'ba' la bu mthu stobs dang / sgrol ma skyes/ /ni ge la bu dbang chen rdo rje skyes la/ de la gle ba nas chung ma ba tha blangs par bu ting 'dzin rgyal skyes/ zi lo'i bu ni rta re rgyal yin/ /sgrol ma'i bu lha ba yin la/ de la bu dge 'dun dang bu mo bo ne skyes/dge 'dun bu gsang lo dang bo ni la bu 'ja' 'phrin skyes/ /g.yang sgron la 'bag ga ('bag zhar ) dang rgya mtsho gnyis skyes/'bag ga'i bu ni rta kho dang dge bo gnyis yin/ rta kho sngags nag la mag par song / dge bos chung ma snga gzhug gnyis blangs pa'i sngon mar bu ban 12

zhar skyes/ de'i bu mo lha yag la mag pa bstod po bzhag par bu mo gsang ris skyes/ rjes mar bu lcags ris skyes la de'i bu bkra shis tshe ring yin/rgya mtsho la bu ma sang sngags pa pad+ma kha lo dang / snying ris (mgar rtser song )dge slong shes rab (dge sher〉/ nor kho (nor kho'i bu mo mkhar rdor mag pa gha grags bzhag par bu tshe ring don grub dang bu mo phag mo thar sogs skyes/dge mar mag pa mkhar byams bzhag par bu rang byung skyes ) sogs ming sring bcu gcig skyes/ gzhan bu mo gnas ma lnga dang / yul bsdad bu mo g.yang mo rgyal la bu ge tho ('di'i bu ba dbang yin ) dang / a lo lcags ('de'i bu ni dge legs dang / tshe brtan/ gsang po bcas yin ) bu mo pad ma mtsho (hor gdong bstan 'dzin kha skung mag par bzhag par bu dbu di dang /g.yang drung / bu mo dbyangs sgron rgyal gsum skyes/ dbyangs sgron rgyal la bu hro'u le dang bu mo phag mo tshe ring gnyis )bcas skyes/ /sgron dkar la bu bkra nag dang / rig grol ske stug gnyis/ rig grol ske stug la bu snya ru ring ba dang / bu mo snying kho/ klu mo rgyal/ gur mo/g.yang skyid bcas/ g.yang skyid la bu mo klu span skyes/ /ya dge gyol po la bu rig sna dang tshe ring mug mo gnyis/ rig sna la bu snying dkar sngo sdang dang / a skyabs gdong lo/ ban de ri 'bu/ bu mo tshe mtsho/ pa pa/ mgon lo ske ma sogs skyes/ /snying dkar sngo sdang gi bu tshe bha/ de'i chung mar dge legs bu spug gi sring mo nu mo blangs/ rdzogs sgrul gsum pa chos dbyings stobs ldan rdo rje dang / bu mo mtsho skyid rgyal/ bod lo/ cha ris bcas ming sring bzhi skyes/ /bod lor mag pa 'jam dbyangs bzhag de la bu 'jam dbyangs grags pa dang / zla ba (grwa ba) yu pe gsum skyes/ /a skyabs kyis dpa' skyabs bu dod du blangs/ dpa' skyabs kyis yo'u 125

rgya zhang gi zhang krang khur/ /ban des bu tshab tu klu 'ba' blangs/ der mag pa mkhas btsun —bzhag ste bu ban de rgyal skyes/ des dpa' ris rgyal bu dod du blangs/tshe mtsho la a lags rdo rje shes rab dang bsang kho zha ra gnyis skyes/bsang kho 'a ra'i bu ni lha chen bya sug dang / tshe tho/ 'bum skyabs gsum yin/ /lha chen la bu lha mgon shi ma dang g.yang skyabs gnyis/ lha mgon gyi bu ni mgon po bkra shis ('di mtsho sngon po na yod )dang / gser 'bum rgyal/bu mo skya tho ma bcas yin/ /g.yang skyabs kyi bu ni dpa' le yin la/ de'i bu mo da chog yin/ tshe tho la bu dor rgya dang / ya ma rgyal/ bu mo lha kho bcas skyes/ /'bum skyabs kyis dor rgya bu tshab tu blangs nas de la bu dpa' tshe dang bu mo a ne+e gnyis skyes/ dpa' tshe'i bu stag rdo yin/ ya rna la mag pa chig lo bzhag nas bu stag ma dang / no'u rdo/ bu mo jo lo sogs skyes/ /a ma rgyal gyis chung ma snga phyi gnyis blangs pa'i snga mar bu thub pa dang /rjes mar jo ris dang zon kho/ bu mo sgrol ma bcas skyes/ thub par bu ban 'gro dang / bkra shis/ bstan 'dzin gsum skyes/ /jo ris la bu lha dbang dang / rta mgrin/ rdo rje gsum skyes/ pa par bu 'jam dbyangs dpal ldan (rab tu byung ) dang bu mo klu 'ba' (ban de ri 'bu tshang la bo dod du byin)gnyis skyes/ /mgon lo ske ma la bu bzod pa dang / mkhas lo/ g.yang drung rgyal gsum/ /bzod pa'i bu dbang lo dang kun ne gnyis/ dbang los bu tshab la kun ne yi bu gnyis blangs pa de'i gcig gi bu der bu mo tshe po skyes shing /der mag pa sman pa bstan dar bzhag ste bu bla ma dzong sngon thugs mchog rdo rje 136

dang / ye shes rgyal/ dge slong thogs med/ a lags ya rig tshang /bu mo ri mtsho bcas ming sring lnga byung / /ye shes rgyal la bu ban de rgya 'da' dang / phag mo skyabs gnyis —skyes/ /kun ne la bu rta 'phel dang / gnas brtan/ bu rgod/ bu mo g.yang mo rgyal sogs ming sring brgyad yod/ /dngos thub la bu 'brug byams dang / ya rga dpa' le rgyal/ rdo thog mgar ba phyag rdor/ bu mo sngo ris bcas ming sring drugadapa' le rgyal gyis ka dros ma bo dod du blangs te mag par mgon po ske bya bzhag nas bu mo dpal mo skyes/ /bu rgod la bu tshe gzungs dang / bu mo 'phags ga lha bo/ sran ma/sha phrug sogs ming sring drug skyes/ tshe gzungs kyis bu skal du bstan 'dzin dang jo mo tshe ring gnyis blangs/ /mkhar mo rgyal la bu rig 'dzin dang / bu mo stag ge gnyis skyes/rig 'dzin la chos 'phel sogs ming sring bdun byung / /tshe ring mug mo'i bu mthu rdor dang sngags pa blo ldan nam dgra 'jom gnyis skyes/ /mthu rdor la bu ya ris dang / dpa' stobs/ yum chen/ lha mgon/dpal sgron/ ka lo/ pad+ma skyid bcas ming sring bdun byung / /a ris la bu mi 'gyur dang / phur ba/ lha rdo/ dbus rdo/ byug mo bcas mingasang lnga skyes/ /dpa' stobs ya skyabs kyi bu tshab la byin te bu skal ye rgyal dang /dbang rdor ram 'jigs med rtsal/ pad+ma skyabs bcas skyes/yum chen la bu rta mgrin rgyal skyes shing / lha mgon la bu sngo ris dang /ban 'gro mo bcas ming sring gsum skyes/ /127

sngags pa dgra 'joms la bu mo ko'u sde dang g.yang byug skyid gnyis skyes shing / g.yang byug skyid la bu mo bsod rdo yag skyes/ /mkhas lo la bu mchog lo dang / bla ma/ ban 'gro sogs skyes/ /g.yang drung rgyal la bu pad+ma rig 'dzin dang bu mo tshe sgron gnyis skyes so/ /dge 'dun hre bo la bu gdugs dkar ril bu dang / tshe ring don grub/ha lo yum bha/ bu mo tshe sgron dang lha sgron bcas skyes/ /gdugs dkar ril bu la bu da rda 'gyur dang zhang kho gnyis skyes/ da rda 'gyur gyi bu tshab la zhang ris kyi bu chos 'byor blangs/ chos 'byor gyi bo dod la ka lo blangs/ de la mag pa snying 'ba' bzhag par bu g.yang byug rgyal skyes/ zhang kho la bu chos 'byor (da rda 'gyur gyi bu skal)dang / 'bum kho/u rgyan/ grags pa bcas skyes/ /'bum kho la bu bon skyabs rgyal dang gnam skyabs rgyal gnyis/ /tshe ring don grub la sman pa lab sgron dang / zhing skyabs/ chos sgron sogs skyes/ sman pa lab sgron gyi bu tshab la bsod nams blangs/ de'i bu tshab ni 'jigs chung ngo / /zhing skyabs sam zhing kho la bu dpa' bo dang tshe dpal lam rnam rgyal gnyis skyes pa dang / dpa' bo la bu dka' thub skyes/ rnam rgyal la bu 'phags rdo skyes/ /chos mo rgyal la mag pa lcags po rgyal bzhag ste bu dge rgyam skyes/ /yum 'ba' la bu rdor 'ba' skyes shing / der bu mkhas btsun dang /mgon ne+e/ lha bo lug bu mo kur lo sogs ming sring bdun skyes/ /tshe sgron la bu byams me rgyal dang klu rgyal gnyis skyes/ byams me rgyal la bu khro bo dang stag lha/ /khro bo'i bu khams bla dga' rab yin par bshad/ stag lhas dge sher gyi sring mo g.yang mo blangs bar bu ge tho skyes/ /128

klu rgyal la bu dbang rgyal dang che mchog skyes shing / dbang rgyal gyi bu dpa' pe yin/ che mchog la bu dpa' thar dang / tshe pe/ rdo pe sogs skyes/ /lha sgron la bu tshe ring dang rdo skyabs gnyis skyes/ tshe ring gi shul 'dzin bkra shis tshang yin/ rdoskubs kyis bskal dbyangs bu mo'i mag pa byas/ /ska ska la bu thar ris dang / snying dkar kwa la/ dbang chen/ rta me/mgar nag sa mo lha skyid bcas ming sring drug byung / /thar ris la bu klu byams dang rgya tshag rta me keg li/ rgya rgya dpal mgon/ g.yang skyabs sgal ba'i pha bcas ming sring lnga skyes/ klu byams la bu zon kho dang / bsam gtan/ dkon mchog banakho ba'i skyes/ /zon kho la bu bdud 'dul dang lcags po gnyis skyes/ bdud 'dul gyi bu ni dbang rgyal dang stobs bas rgyal gnyis yin la/ lcags po'i bu ni 'jam dpal dang dpal 'bum gnyis so/ /bsam gtan la bu dbang phyug dang / gu grags/ 'gyur med/ rgya mtsho/ bdud lo sogs skyes/ /dbang byugs la bu dpal chen dang / sangs lo/ ban de thar/ bu mo g.yang ris sogs skyes/ bdud lo la bu 'jigs med rdo je dang sngo rdo sogs skyes/ /dkon mchog la bu chig lo dang mgon po gnyis skyes/ mgon po la bu ra rdo dang / ban 'gro gnyis skyes/ /ban kho la bu bde legs dang / thub bstan/ a lags 'thab bral tshang / bu mo thang lo sogs bu bu mo brgyad skyes/ /bu mo thang lo la sgar ba'i rab brtan gyi bu lha dpal mag par bzhag par bu smin grol skyes/ /rta me keg li la bu ba skyabs dang / rin chen rgyal rong ba/ don /29

'grub gsum dang / bu mo g.yu rdo bcas skyes/ /ba skyabs kyis chung ma gnyis blangs pa'i sngon mar bu mo dpal mo dang na lo gnyis skyes/ na lo la mag pa do lo bzhag nas bu yar 'apel dang / kun bzang nyi ma/ blo 'ba' (blo bzang 'jigs med)/ blo bzang tshe ring /bu mo sgrol ma sogs mingasreng byung / /rin chen rgyal rong bar bu rig 'dzin dang g.yang drung sogs bzhi — skyes/ /g.yang drung la bu ye rgyam dang rdo rje gnyis skyes/ g.yu rdo la bu skar dbang dang / khon thar/ chos dbyings (mgon po )bcas skyes/ skar dbang la bu dbang chen skyes/ dpal mgon la bu mo gnam po dang tsha rgyal gnyis skyes/ /snying dkar bu chos tho dang bdud lha nya 'ching / bu mo 'dzoms kho dang rgya ma bcas skyes/ /chos thos chung ma snga phyir gnyis blangs pa'i snga bar bu mo tshe sgron dang /rjes mas bo dod la yag lo blangs te mag pa dko ris bzhag par bu don grub rgyal skyes/ /bdud lha la bu mo gcig skyes/ 'dzoms khor bu rta po skyes shing / de la bu theg mchog dang / rdo bo/ bu mo tshe mo('di bstan pa'i ma yin)/ tsha mo (blo gsal gyi ma)/ lha rgya ('dzigs chung gi ma yar)/ ba yan bcas 11sa/ /theg mchog la bu yo rgyan dang / bu mo mtsho skyid/ bde lo (bsod rgyam gyi chung ma byas )gsum skyes/ /rdo bo la bu rig bzang dang / ban ser/ bu mo dwangs ma bcas skyes/rig bzang la bu dge 'dun sogs dang bu tshab bkra lo'o/ / dwangs ma la bu sgrol pe dang / gnam rtse rgyal/ tshe ring rgyal/ bkra shis tshe ring /130

bu mo tshe ring skyid sogs skyes/ /ba yan la mag pa dzam pa bzhag par bu lha 'brug dang / sku nag yang sprul 'jigs med khrag 'thung dpa' bo/ 'od zer/ 'jam sher/ kru'u pe/ bu mo ka lo bcasasnyes/ lha 'brug la bu ban grub skyes/ /dbang chen la sngags 'chang tshul khrims spul phrug dang bu mo mkha' 'gro skyes/ /tshul khrim4 sbrul phrug la bu mo rdo rje skyid dang / der bu mo g.yu lha skyes shing / de'i bu ni rab bzang ngo /mkha' 'gro'i bu lcags po jo jo dang / de'i bu ni dge rgyam yin/ rta me'i bu skyabs po dang / de'i bu ban de/ de'i bu ni garma rdo rje'o/ /lha skyid la bu a rgya mag pa dang / lhun po/ bu mo klu skyid bcas skyes/mag par bu mo dga' bo skyes shing / der sman pa bstan dar ram da rda skyes/ /lhun po'am lhu tho la bu bkra bo dang / pad ma yo chi/ rnam grol rdo rgan/bu mo byug mo bcas skyes/ /bkra bor bu mo dpal sgron dang sgrol ma gnyis skyes shing / bu mo dpal sgron la mag pa lha lha bzhag ste bu skal bzang sogs skyes/ pad mo yo chi la bu mo skya lo dang / tsha mo rgyal/ rnam grol rdo rje sogs skyes/ /klu skyid la bu rin chen 'bum dang mgar ba ja rgya srun gnyis skyes/rin chen 'bum la bu thabs mkhas dang (de'i bu mo lha mo yag la mag pa chos skyong bzhag)/ dbang grags sam a grags/ de la bu dbang rgyal dang /lab sgron rgyal/ ban 'gro/ mi rkyang sogs skyes/ /sbyin pa'i (sbyin gyong )bu skyabs be dang / klu byams ka kor/ bu mo gzungs mchog gsum skyes pa dang / skyabs be'i bu ma pa tshe dang thub bstan gnyis khyim gcig byas te bu skal chos tho'i spun bdud lha'i bu mo rgya kho gcod 131

pa rgyal gyi ma yar tu blangs/ /bson thar la bu gcod pa thar dang de'i bu mo kun bzang dang chos 'dzin (de'i bu skal pad ma)/ sgrol ris sogs ming sring lnga skyes/ /chos 'dzin la bu dbus lo dang pad ma rdo rje gnyis skyes/ klu byams ka kor la bu ya tho dang bdud lha gnyis skyes par/ a tho la bu dang / ban de byams/ dkon mchog bu mo tshe ring skyid bca skyes te/ kurmar bu chos ldan dang / de la bu gcod pa rgyal skyes/ ban de byams la bu lcags po rgyal dang / de'i bu mo rgya pe ni deng gi bde mchog tshang yin/ /dkon mchog gi bu bde rdor(de'i bu sngags pa dpal chen)dang /g.yang skyabs rgyal/ dpal rdo/ bu mo dbang grags kyi chung ma/ tshe ring skyid(de'i bu mo tshe mo rgyal de'i bu 'ja' 'od)bcas yin/ /bu mo gzungs mchog gi bu lha bo dang / bstan 'dzin/ shes rab/bu mo kun mtsho (tshogs rnam tshang la gnas su song )bcas ming sring bzhi byung /lha bor bu ro kho lo skyes shing der mag pa g.yang 'bum bzhag par bu mo sgrol ma dang skyid lha gnyis skyes/ /skyid lhar mag pa rgya mtsho bzhag par bu mo dbang mo skyes/ bstan 'dzin la bu mo 'brug mo rgyal dang sgrol ris gnyis skyes/ /ban 'greng gi bu ni dpal chen dang gnam kho rgyu ma gnyis yin la/ ru skor 'di sngon rab gong nas tshur gnas spor skabs hor nas lus shing /byus su ya khu tshogs rnam gyi sku ring la mar blangs pa'i yo'u rgya so ma zhes ming chags pa de yin/ kho tsho hor nas bsdad rkyen hor gyi gzhi bdag ya kye ser rgod mchod do/ /dpal chen la bu dpa' bo tshogs lo (deng mi bskyod tshang ) dang /dpa' bo the mgo'i bu g.yang 'bum thar dang / bu mo ku pe/ phyug mo sogs yin/ g.yang 'bum thar gyis bsod nams sngo sdang gi bu mo bo skal du blangs 132

par mag pa rgyal pa bzhag ste bu mu rgyan skyes/ /bu mo ku per mag pa rta mgrin tshe lo bzhag par bu mo a rdo skyes/ der mag pa 'ja' lo bzhag par rgya drug dang 'gyur med gnyis skyes/ gnam kho rgyu mar bu dang po snying 'bum khyo lag dang (de'i bu khon thar bye tho dang ban de rgyal khro mgo g.yang rgyal/ bsod nams 'bum bzhi)/bu gnyis pa dpon po de bo (de'i bu lha brtan dang / tshe rgyal/ ban phruga'ajigs med/ 'jigs blo/ bu mo thar mo dang ka lo/ dbang mo rgyal rdo/ṭ+wā ) bum pa/ pa ṭ+wā/ bhe / ༷༷༵ ) sda /r+sha rdo hūṃ zlo chi sdub pa sde dī sdidī dang mi bskyod/ gu ru ) bu lnga ba dkon mchog (de la bu che lo sogs skyes )bu drug pa 'apags mo (reb gong lha sder song bar bu mkhar 'bum skyes ) bu bdun pa dpal 'byor (deng sang gi mgo pe tshang ) brgyad pa bu mo g.yang sgron (hor la bag mar song )sogs yod/ /yo'u rgya gong ma'i gcod skor ram gdugs skor zhes pa'i khyim rgyud ni sngar reb gong nas sa 'dir gnas spor skabs g.yu rngogs su ru song ba de ya khu tshogs rnam gyi skabs su phyir o'u rgyar blangs nas slar yang phu nu lhan —'dzoms byas/ ma khu yi ban sogs ru skor 'di'i ming la g.yu rngogs nas yong ma thag pa'i skabs su gcod skor zer zhing / phyis su gdugs skor tu 'gyur/ /yi dam mam yi ban gyis gtsang g.yu rngogs nas chung ma zhig bsus te/bu mo ya na dang / a lag ga khro mo sogs dang / bu ba lo sogs lnga skyes/bu ba lo la bon brgya nas chung ma zhig blangs kyang bu ma byung par sring mo'i bu gcod le bu skal du blangs/ yi ban bu mor bu gcod le dmar sdang dang / mu lo/ bkra lo gsum dang / bu mo khro lo dang bzang mo bcas lnga skyes/ gcod les khro mo'i bu mo rko tho bo skal du blangs/ der mag pa a 133

lags dga' rab bzhag par bu mo mkha' 'tsho skyes/ yu lor chung ma klu ris blangs te bu tshe dpal glo drud dang / bu mo gar dris/ nya nya/ 'od bsnam bzhi skyes/ bkra lor bud gyed kor ma blangs nas bu gzungs 'dus dang /chos lo/ 'phags pa/ lha lo bzhi skyes/ /gzungs 'dus la bu ra lo dang / lcags rdo/ bu mo dbus mo bcas skyes/ chos lor bu grags pa dang / ma pu/ bu mo sgo lha gsum skyes/'phags par bu dar lo dang bu mo sgrol ma yag gnyis dang / lha lor bu rdo log dang / tshe brtan/ gsar rgyas/ bu mo ris ces dang / lo brgya bcas ming sring lnga skyes/ kho lor bu zhi tho dang / ha rgya/ bu mo gar dros bcas ming sring gsum/ 'i tho la bu g.yang 'bum ja lo dang / dge legs bu lhug bsod nams mig dong / bu mo nu mo bcas ming sring bzhi/g.yang 'bum mag par song / ha rgya la bu shes rab dmar po dang / a rga bla ma/ bu mo snying kho bcas skyes/ /'khyams skor snying phyug rgyal la spun tshe mkhar dang rgya rdo gnyis/ snying phyug rgyal gyi bu skal tshe po/ tshe mkhar gyi bu dpal chen/ de'i bu rta kho/ tshe dbang nor bu sogs/ rgya rdo so nag la song / de'i bu mo a lags dpal chen (rdo rje gdung bzhi'i ya rgyal ling thugs mchog rdo rje'i yang sprul yin )gyi chung ma yin/ dge legs bu lhug gi bu g.yang byug de'i bu u rgyan dang /chos rgyam/ bu mo bod lo sogs/ gar dros la bu gun tshogs ke li dang /phyag rdor/ snying dkar bya gdong bcas/ phun tshogs rab tu byung / phyag rdor la bu bsam 'grub dang / jo bo gnyis/ bzang mor sangs rgyas mag par ba'ag ste bu 'brug byams skyes/ bu 'brug byams la bu ri lo dang /tshul khrims/ 'azin las mgo khra/ a lo ka la/ rta mgrin tshe lo/ bu mo nu mo sogs ming sring bdun skyes/ ri lor bu bdud lha skyes shing / de'i bu ban 'gro dang / kun 'dzoms/ yar 'phel/ ma ne 'bum sogs yin/134

lo ka lar bu da de (de'i shul bkra shur lung rigs tshang yin )dang rab rgyas gnyis skyes/ nu mo la bu mo gar kho dang snying kho/ gar lo la bu sog po dang /lha 'bum/ gser 'bum gsum dang / bu mo chog bcas ming sring bzhi skyes/ snying kho la bu chos mchog dang / ban de thar gnyis skyes/ /khro mor mag pa na na bzhag nas bu nor kho dang / gdugs gedapal 'phyor/ mkhyen rab/ bu mo rko tho bcas ming sring drug nor kho la bu lo dang / blo 'phel/ stag lha/ g.yu phrug bu mo 'brug mo/ 'bo bo/tshe sgron bcas ming sring bdun/ bu lo la bu a rdo rgyal dang / bu mo g.yu mo/'bo bo la bu mo ma pu (de'i bu mo sgrol rdo la bu ting 'dzin rgyal ) tshe sgron la bu dpa' rtse dang / sman bla gnyis/ gdugs ge la bu a jo dang / 'od zer/bu mo tshe rgyal/ lo mo/ lha sgron bcas lnga/ a jo la bu nor bu dang /gser rdo gnyis/ 'od zer la bu stag lha dang / stag mo/ gdugs skyabs gsum/ tshe rgyar bu ban 'gro (de'i bu bla ris dang sangs kho )dang /gcod thar (de'i bu rko rgyal )dang / bon skyong / bon po/ bu mo g.yang ris bcas ming sring lnga/ bkra shis la bu 'jigs ge dang de'i bu mo sgrol ma yin/ dpal 'byor la bu dar skyabs rgyal dang / kun bzang / kun ne rgyal/ lha yas sogs ming sring drug dar skyabs kyi bu tshab la rgya mo blangs/lha yas la mag pa rgya rko bzhag ste na na'i bu bzhi ba dpal 'byor gyi shul bzung yod/ tshogs gzungs kyi bu phur skyabs dang / bu mo jo kho/ no rgya bcas/phur skyabs (bu tshe rgyal skyes pa dang / de'i bu ni yi dam dang / bla bo/mthar phyin/ sangs rgyas/ bu mo 'brug ge bcas )dang / khri lo (de la bu blo gros dang / chos skyong / gnam lha/ bu mo lha mtsho ) do lo (de la 'jigs med bstan 'dzin dang / rgyal bo/ 'u kho sogs ) dge slong grags pa/ bu mo pad ma mtsho/ /pad ma mtsho la bu pad mo che rkang rgan skyes shing / der bu 'ba' lo 135

dang / bu mo klu mo gnyis/ /'ba' lo la bu rdo rab dang / 'brug thar/ bu mo gur mo/ mtsho rgyal bcas mingasreng bzhi/ /rdo rab la bu ban de rgyal dang mdo sngags gnyis/ 'brug thar gyi bu ni rdo rje yin/ klu mo la mag pa lcags po rdo dmar bzhag nas bu mo chos sgron dang / lcags mo thar/ jo ni/ ban de ring bcas skyes/ bu mo chos sgron la mag pa mgar ba lha mchog bzhag par bu thar 'bum dang ya lags rig rgyam/ bu mo jo mo bcas skyes/ /gsum pa/ nywanag bshad pa/ /nya nag 'di sngon chad tsho ba cung che ba zhig yin rte/ phyis su rim bzhin kha 'thor nas bang stag nywa nag dang / rkang tsha'i nywa nag jo skor/ nywa nag so ma/ dgon tshang bcas dang / dgon gong ma'i ྅ nag tsho ba sogs su gyes/dgon gong ma'i nya nag bshad pa la thog mar mes po dgra lha rgyal gyi gdung rgyud ya gyes mgo khra nas gleng dgos/ mgo khra'i ming dngos la dar rgyas zer/mgo khra thogs don ni mgo na rgyag res byas pa'i tha shul mang po yod pas yin/mgo khra'i pha'i ming la gda' bo zer te/ kho ni sa phyogs la ming du grags pa'i phyug po zhig yin par grags/ mgo khra'i ya che ni rkang tsha'i bla ma rab brtan gyi ma yin pas/ skabs de nas bzung sde ba gnyis kyi 'brel ba shin tu bzang / a gyes mgo khra tshe las 'das rjes/ gle zhar gtam lce klad ces pa'i sa char gdung sbyin bsregs la bzhus pa'i rten 'brel du kho'i rjes rabs pa'i nang du gtam bshad mkhan mang po byung yod zer srol yod/ ya gyes mgo khrar bu mo gnyis yod par gdung rgyud sa skya nas yin par grags pa'i tshogs chen tshogs chung spun gnyis mag par bzhag tshogs chen (yongs grags su tshogs tho rna ris zer )la bu bla spyon dang bla dkar gnyis skyes/ bla spyon la bu nor rgan skyes pa dang / des chung ma chen chun gnyis blangs rte /36

chen ma rwa tshang bza' la bu gzigs ka dang mkhas btsun gnyis dang bu mo zhang mo bcas mingasringagasum skyes/ bu gzugs ka ni blo rig shin tu skyen pa zhig yin par grags la/ khos sgar kha nas rdo ris zhes pa'i chung ma zhig blangs te bu tshul khrims dang / tsin thar rgyal/ bu mo pad+ma/ klu mtsho/ lcags rgyal/ lo lo bcas ming sring bdun skyes/ bu mkhas btsun ni sngags pa zhig yin la/ rtsa rlung la dbang 'byor ba zhig yin/ gzigs ga'i bu blo bzang tshul khrims ni lha rje zhig yin la/ khos hor mo shugs drag tu mchod pas mngon mkhyen dang grub rtags la thogs pa med par grags/ /nor rgan gyi chun mar bu a khu rgyal dang / rnam rgyal/ bsod nams gsum dang / bu mo g.yu lo dang / ma kho/ bkra bo bcas ming sring drug skyes/ rtsis pa zhig gis nor rgan tshang la mi dpyad byed skabs bu'i phyogs nas sde mgo chings thub tshod yod mod/ bu mo tsho gnas yul so sor song ba de nya nag tsho ba 'thor ba'i rgyu ru 'gro zhes bshad par grags/ don dngos su yang bkra bo gcig po dgon gong ma'i nang khul dpa' mchog stag skor du gnas la song ba ma gtogs/ g.yu lo bang stag tshe rgyal gyi chung mar song ba dang / ma kho rkang tshar gnas la song nas stong dpon chen po dpal bzang dang 'ching nyi dgra lo sogs skyes pa dang / nye 'brel de la brten nas nya nag tsho ba gsum po'i nang gi dpon tshang dang 'khyam skor gnyis kyi mang che ba mtsho sngon por song / /nor rgan gyi chun ma ni dpa' mchog gi yin te/ nor rgan mi phyug po yin pa dang nya nag nang du dbang shed che ba sogs la bltas nas/ chung ma'i nu bo dkon mchog nag sdang dang / bsam 'grub ol ring / sangs rgyas skam po bcas kyang nya nag khrod du ru yong / sangs rgyas kyi chung ma ni g.yer skyong cholospyon gyi sring mo yin/ /bla dkar gyi bu ni ban de bstan 'dzin yin pa dang / de'i bu ni bla ma 137

nyi 'bum (nyi ma yang zer )dang g.yang kho ril ma gnyis yin/ bla ma nyi ma'i bu ni tho tho dang / de'i bu ni ba res (ba rgan )yin pa dang / de'i bu ni snying 'bum dang / ba lo/ 'bo rgyal/ bstan 'dzin/ chos 'dzin bcas yin/ /nya nag gi dpon po rim byung ni ya gyes mgo khra dang / sangs rgyas skam po/ ban de bstan 'dzin/ nyi 'bum/ tho tho/ ba res/ ba lo/rig lo/ chos 'byor bcas yin pa dang / yang kha cig gis bla spyon dang g.yang kho ril ma gnyis kyis kyang dpon sa bzung zer/ /(1)dpon tshang / /nywa nag dpon po bla spyon tsho ba 'di'i mi yin pas/ kho'i ru skor la dpon tshang zhes thogs pa dang / a kyes mgo khra'i bu rabs tsha rgyud la dpon tshang thogs pa'i bshad tshul gnyis yod/ nywa nag bla spyon ni rab byung bcu ba'i nang du sa 'dir gnas spo skabs kyi ya gye mgo khra'i bu mor sa skya'i gdung las mched pa'i tshogs tho rna ris zhes pa mag par bzhag pa'i bu yin la/de'i gcung gi ming la bla dkar zer/ tsho dpon rim byung ni/ bla spyon gyis sde tsho gnyis mnyam du bskyangs shing / de rjes dkon mchog nag sdang dang /bsam 'grub ol ring / sangs rgyas skam po (sangs skam )spun gsum gyi nang du tha chung sangs skam gyis spyi dpon gyi go gnas bzhes shing man ju gong mas thabs zhwa gnang ba mig gi mthong snang du gyur zer mkhan yod/ sangs skam gyis sde tsho gnyis kyi dpon po gcig lhog byas/ de rjes dpon tshang gzigs gas kyang tsho sde gnyis mnyam du bskyangs/ dpon po sangs rgyas kyi bu ri ngan gyis brlags pa de yi bu grags pa kha lug de la bu gnyis byung ba'i che ba chos ldan kha lug (1923lor gser lag dgon par drag gnon byed skabs mā jag gis bsad )chung ba ya khu rgya tho yin/ rgya thos kyang tsho ba bskyangs par grags/ /138
