tsho ba 'di'i nang gi bla spyon ni mi skye mtha' can zhig yin zer ba dang /rta dge ni gtam kha lce la 'gran zla med pa zhig yin par bshad/ dus rabs nyi shu ba'i lo rabs sum cu'i nang rkang tsha'i dpon po'i ma yum tsho ba 'di'i yin pa'i 'brel ba brgyud de tsho ba'i khongs mi mang che ba mtsho sngon po'i rkang tshar song nas dgon tshang tsho ba'i ming bzung / /nywanag dpon nga gcas da/ /dpon tshang gzu ga'i bu btsun thar rgyal dang / lcags go thar/ nyi lo/ sgron yag jo mo/ dpal rgyal bcas yin/ /lcags go la bu ban de dang / rdo rje tsas pug bu mo zon mo/'brug ge gangs mtsho/ gser rdo/ snying mo bcas yod/ /nyi lo la bu tshe brtan rdo rje dang / bu mo rdo rje sgrol ma/ rdo rje skyid bcas yod/ /sgron yag gi bu ni gnam lha rgyal dang / de'i bu ni 'brug go rgyal yin/jo mo la bu kun bzang rgyal dang / bu mo sgrol ma gnyis skyes/ /gzu ga'i bu mo pad+mar mag pa mkha' ro don grub bzhag nas bu ban skyong dang / 'bum rgyal/ snying kha/ lcags ris bcas dang / bu mo a mo dang / bstan ne/ g.yang mtsho bcas ming sring bdun skyes/ /'bum rgyal la bu ting 'dzin dang 'brug lha/ mkha' pe bcas dang /bu mo jo kho dang mkhar mo byams bcas ming sring lnga yod/ /snying kha la bu tshe ring thar dang / rgya bza'i rnam byams rgyal/'jigs skyabs/ lcags thar rgyal/ bskal pe/ bsod pe bcas dang /bu mo sgrol ma rgyal/ mi rdo/ chos mo byams/ 'brug yag bcas yod/lcags ris la bu klu byams dang / bu mo 'brug mo rgyal/ sgrol ma mtsho sogs yod/ a mo la bu mo bsod nams mtsho dang / byams pa gnyis skyes/bsod nams mtsho la rnam byams dang / snying rtse gnyis skyes/ byams par 139

bu mo klu mo rgyal skyes/ /gzu ga'i bu mo lo lo la bu don ldan dang / g.yang 'ba'/ bu mo thar mo bcas skyes/ /don ldan gyi bu ni blo brtan rgyal yin/ g.yang 'bas mkha' rdo bo dod du blangs shing der mag pa g.yang 'bum rgyal bzhag/gzu ga'i tsha bo khu ring la bu stag lha gar sdang dang / no tho/ ri dar/ku ma/ ye shes kha stug a ma bcas skyes/ /stag lha la bu bsod pa dang / dpal lo rgyal/ bde chen bcas skyes/bsod pa la bu rin chen rgyal dang bu mo lha mo sgrol ma sogs skyes/ ru skor 'di da lta rgan gya'i brag dkar na yod/ /no tho la bu mo bkra thar dang / zhi rdo/ lo lo gsum skyes/ bkra thar la bu klu rgyal dang bu mo zhi rdo gnyis skyes/ zhi rdo la bu rig 'dzin dang gser rdo/ bu mo stag mo gsum skyes/ /ru dar la bu 'od zer rgya mtsho dang / 'brug rtse/ 'od ldan gsum skyes/ 'brug rtse'i bu do lo yin/ /ku ma'i bu ni 'azin bzang dang dbang 'ba' gnyis yin/ dbang 'ba' la grags pa sogs mingasreng gsum yod/ /ye shes kha snag gi bu ni mdo sde ltag dkar yin/ gzu ga'i sring mo'i bu 'phags pa thod sko'i bu ni lcags byams yin/ de la bu dpal phyug dang /bsod rdor/ dar yag rgyal/ gsang bstan rgyal/ dge 'dun phun —tshogs bcas skyes/ 'phags pa thod sko'i sring mo g.yang mtsho'i bu ni lha bo yin/ lha bo la bu g.yang kho rgyal dang / a khu/ bu mo bsod sgron rgyal bcas skyes/ /nywa nag brlu war gyi bu mkhar byams skug po la bu sgom pa 'brong rgyugs dang / bla ma nyi ma/ bstan 'dzin dngul kha/ bkra skam/ mkhas mchog 140

rgya sdang / g.yang kho ril ma/ dpa' bo hre sdang bcas bu bdun skyes/ /sgom pa 'brong rgyugs la bu tshe thar bag ma gcig po las ma skyes/ de la bu ban de dang / klu rgyal/ dge 'dun/ shes rab/ bu mo mtsho mo/g.yu mo bcas drug skyes/ /ban de la bu blo dar skyes/ mtsho mo la bu bstan dar dang / tshe brtan/ri kho bcas skyes/ bstan dar la bu rgyal mtshan skyes/ tshe brtan gyi bu tshe phyug yin/ ri kho la bu 'jam dbyangs bzang po dang rta bo gnyis yod/'jam dbyangs bzang po'i bu ni lha dpal rgyal dang / legs bshad/ dar rgyas gsum yin/ g.yang mo'i bu mo dpal mo la bu gnyis yod de mkhas grub dang bdud 'dul gnyis yin/ /mkhar byams skug po'i bu bkra skam gyi bu ni blo bzang bstan pa yin/de la mkhas mchog dang / ngag dbang / ban de dmar dros/ 'dzigs med bcas bu bzhi yod/ ban de'i bu ni dpal 'bum dang khro rgyal gnyis yin/ dpal 'bum la chos 'phel dang / mthu stobs/ dpal lha/mgon skyabs/ nor bu/ dung bzang rgyal/ dbang kho bcas bu brgyad yod/ 'jigs med la bu dbang 'bum dang bstan pa gnyis yod/ dbang 'bum la bu dpal chen rdo rje dang / btsun phyug 'bum byug bcas bu gsum yod/ mkhas mchog rgya sdang la bu chos 'byor dang blo gros bzang po gnyis dang bu mo gcig skyes/ chos 'byor gyi bu ni tshe mgon rgyal dang /ban de 'jam me/ 'brug byams/ nyi lo/ tshe mkhar/ lha bo bcas yin/tshe mgon rgyal la bu ya ting 'azin las dang / 'ja' rdo/ stag 'bum bcas skyes/ mkhas mchog gi bu mo la bu thub bstan dang ban thar gnyis skyes/ dpa' bo tre sdang gi bu ni blo bzang dang mkhyen rab gnyis yin/dpa' mo la bu bkra shis dang tshe lha/ 'jam dbyangs bstan pa bcas skyes/dpon tshang nor rgan gyi tsha mo a pe la bu mkhas mchog skyes/ mkhas mchog la 1 1

bu zon thar yag dang bu mo mkhar skyid rgyal skyes/ dpon tshang skya bu'i tsha bo lhum pa la bu dge 'phel dang snying dpal rgyal gnyis dang bu mo byams pa gsum skyes/ snying dpal rgyal la bu g.yang 'bum tshe ring dang / dbang bha/'phrin bzang / dpa' rdo bzhi skyes/ dbang lha'i bu ni grags pa dang /dpa' rdo'i bu ni dbus rdo dang dbang rgyal gnyis yin/ dpon tshang bkra skam gyi tsha bo dge sa la bu mo bsod lo skyes/ de la mag pa dbang rdor bzhag nas bu mkhas grub dang dpal mkhar gnyis skyes/ dge sa'i chung ma'i tsha bo chos 'bum la bu gnyis te che ba 'phags tshe dang chung ba lha dbang yin/ lhum pa'i bu ni 'jam dbyangs dang tshe mgon gnyis yin/ tshe mgon gyi bu ni ban de 'phrin las dang bkra lo/ 'jam dbyangs bshad sgrub gsum yin/ /dpon tshang bkra skam gyi bu na rgyo dang / na sgo'i bu na dges/ rgya rgya/rgya mtsho gsum dang bu mo mgon skyid bcas yin/ na dges dang / rgya rgya/rgya mtsho gsum la bu med/ mgon skyid la bu yi dam smig sdang skyes/ spig sdang gi bu ni ne re yin/ ne re'i bu ni dpal mgon dang mkhas btsun gnyis yin/ dpal mgon la bu gnam rgyal sogs bzhi yod/ gnam rgyal la bla brang gser khri blo bzang nam mkha' rgyal mtshan sogs bu bu mo drug yod/ /྅ nag bla spyon gyi bu mo pad+ma mtsho'i bu gangs pa la bu byams pa skyes/byams pa'i bu nyag nag ban de yin/ ban de la bu tshe skyabs dang cha tho/ rdo rje/ thub bstan bzhi skyes/ /(2) 'a ma skor/ /tsho ba 'di ni nywa nag dpon tshang nas gyes shing / dkon mchog nag ldang gi bu rta lo ril ma dang rgya tho nag ril gnyis kyis jag rkus 'khyam gsum byas rkyen ru skor gyi ming la 'khyam skor thogs shing / rta lo la 'khyam rta zhes kyang 'bod/ rta lo'i bu tshul dbang skyabs/ de'i bu 'khyam skor lcags res dang tshe ring 'bum gnyis yin/ skabs shig la bla ma nyi ma'i bu tho tho dang 1 2

de'i bu ba res(ba rgan) de'i bu snying 'bum/ ba lo bcas kyis ྅ nag dpon po 'khur skabs tsho dpon yang zhor du khur bar bshad/ /tsho ba 'di yang dpon tshang dang mnyam du rkang tshar song ba dang / ba ris dang ba lo pha bu lta bu'i mi dpa' blo gnyis ldan can dang / g.yang 'bum sogs lta bu'i mi byug po yang mang du byung par bshad/ /nywanag 'thamaskar gyi rusargud/ /rta lo ril ma la bu tshul dbang skyabs dang / rta mgrin lag pa/mkhar 'bum thar/ dge ring a ba bcas yod/ tshul dbang skyabs la bu tshe ring 'bum dang / lcags res/ bu mo sgrol lo bcas skyes/ tshe ring 'bum la bu blo gros dang / bstan 'dzin ring / bzod pa/ dbang grags rgyal/ phu thung / tshe phyug bu mo klu mo rgyal dang phag lo/ chos lo sogs mingasang bcu yod/ /bzod pa la bu bkra 'ba' dang / dpal chen/ bu mo tshe ring mtsho bcas skyes/ phu thung la bu skal ba rgyal dang / lung rig 'brug thar bcas skyes/ /lcags ris la bu rin chen phyug dang bu mo tsher ma rgyal gnyis skyes/rin chen phyug la bu 'brug lha rgyal dang phag mo/ bu mo tā re sgrol ma tshe thar bcas skyes/ /rta mgrin lag pa'i bu ya rta/ der bu tshe 'bum rgyal dang / ye shes/dpal chen rgyal/ klu 'brug bcas yod/ /mkhar byams thar la bu pad+ma nor bu dang / thos bsam mig rko/ bu mo gar dros ma bcas skyes/ pad+ma nor bu'i bu shes rab dang / yon tan/lcags thar/ bstan 'phel bzhi dang / bu mo 'dzoms rgyal dang / tshe ring mtsho/ mtsho mo bcas yod/ /kur dros ma la bu mo lha ris skyes pa dang / de la bu ma ma/ de'i bu ni 143

dge legs dang / tshe ring bkra shis sogs so/ /thos bsam mig rko la bu zhi thar dang bu mo bo zed gnyis skyes/ dge ring la bu khe lo dang / lcags lo ring / snying kha rgyal bcas skyes/ /'khyam skor rta lo lo'i spun tshe tho dang de'i bu ba ring / byams ring sogs mang yang de dag gi mi rgyus gas por bshad dka'/ ba ring bu mo'i bu gdugs dkar/ rab brtan gdong nga / bsam gtan bcabayin/ /gdugs dkar gyi bu khro rgyal dang / chos bstan/ tshe dbang 'bum gsum yin/ rab brtan gyi bu ni kun lo dang tshe dbang rgyal gnyis yin/tshe dbang rgyal la bu lha bzang rgyal dang thogs med gnyis skyes/ /byams ring la bu chug 'ba' dang / no'u kho/ ban de sngon mo/dbang grags bcas yod/ zug 'ba' la bu rgyal mtshan dang / g.yaba'abum/ ba 'ba' bcas yod/ g.yang 'bum la bu mo kun thar rgyal skyes/ba 'ba' la bu 'od zer dang kur rdo sogs bu bzhi yod/ /no'u kho la bu rta kho dang dpal ldan grags pa gnyis yod/ rta kho'i bu ni 'jam dbyangs yin/ /ban de sngon mo'i bu ni klu lo dang skal ldan gnyis yin/ klu lo la bu tshe ring rdo rje dang thos bsam gnyis yod/ stobs po la bu bstan rgyas dang /g.yer skyong ka rdo/ mkhar byams/ ri rdo bcas yod/ /(2) sogasgor/ /nywa nag sog skor gyi byung ba rags tsam brjod na ni/ sa skya'i gdung rgyud tshogs chung la bu spun gsum byung ste/ che ba dpon po ral ba can nam ban ling bang / 'byung ba sog mo'i ban de/ chung ba bkra shis skam bcas yin/ ngag rgyun la spun 'di gsum po'i ma sog mo zhig yin pas kho tsho'i rus rgyud la sog skor zhes thogs par bshad/ dus rabs nyi shu ba'i lo rabs sum cu dang bzhi bcu pa nas nya nag dpon tshang dang 'khyam skor gnyis kyi ru 14

skor mang che ba mtsho sngon po rkang tshar song rjes/ dgon gong ma'i nya nag tsho ba ni gtso bo sog skor gyis grub pa yin/ /sog skor gyi tsho dpon rnams ni ban de ral ba can dang / de'i spun bkra skam/ de yi bu skya lo/ de la bu bzhi skyes pa'i nang gi tha chung dge bskos (skya dge )bcas kyis rim par khur/ de'i rjes su nywa nag rig los sde tsho gnyis kyi dpon po gcig spyog byas pa dang / de'i bu chos 'byor (྅ nag dpon po ban de dug kha yang zer )gyis kyang pha bzhin du sde tsho gnyis ka mnyam du bskyangs/ /tsho ba 'di ni dgon gong ma'i nang gi mi sde phyug por brtsi bar ma zad/dpon po rig lo pha bu'i phan chad nas da dung dmar mo rkan la brdab na nya nag chos 'phel yod/ khra ring bo'u kha bzhag na nya nag tshe to yod ces pa'i bshad mkhan dang dpa' bo yang byung myong / /nywanag sog skorargyadus da bshad pa/ /da lta'i ྅ nag sog skor gyi ru skor tshang ma ban ling spun gsum nas mched pa yin pas/ gsham du de dag gi rus rgyud bshad par bya/ /dang po ban linganas mched pa'imi da/ /ban ling la bu klu 'bum gar sdang dang / tshe brtan/ gcod pa/bstan skyong / bu mo lha skyid bcas mingasang lnga yod/ /klu 'bum gar sdang la bu bla ma snyan grags dang / 'bum me/ ba tho gar sdang / 'jigs byed/ khyi lo thar(khyi zed)/ dpal chen skyabs(dpal zed)/ skya lo/ rig 'dzin/ bu mo 'brug kho dang / mtsho mo bcas ming sring bcu yod/ /bla ma snyan grags ni ྅ nag spyi ba'i dbu mdzad thog ma yin/ 'bum me'i sbra ni nya nag ban ling gi spu yin pas kho'i phyi rabs pa rnams la nya nag sbra rgan zhes 'bod/ kho la bu rta mgrin dang / dkon mchog dran pa/1 5

gar rdo/ bu mo sprel thar bcas yod/ /rta mgrin la bu rdo po dang / bu mo skya la/ bu skal khro rgyal/ gnam mtsho bcas bzhi yod/ rdo po la bu rdo rje dang / bu mo lha mtsho gnyis yod/khro rgyal la bu zhi kho dang / 'brug dge bu mo lcags yag bcas skyes/ skya la la lha chen mag par bzhag nas bu mo sgrol ma skyes/ gnam mtshos bu tshab la yang sangs blangs/ / /dkon mchog gi bu ni bsam gtan rgya mtsho dang lha rdo gnyis yin/bsam gtan rgya mtshor bu stod bos rgyal sogs lnga yod/ lha rdo'i bu ni 'jam dpal yin/ /dran pa'i bu mo byams skyid la mag pa 'jam dpal ba gagar rdo la bu dar mgon rgyal skyes/ de'i bu ni lha mgon dang stobs ldan gnyis yin/ /sprel thar la bu tshe 'bum dang bu mo tsher ma gnyis skyes/ tsher ma la bu gnam rgyal dang / snying dpal rgyal/ bu mo chung ris gsum skyes/ tshe 'bum la bu rin chen thar dang / de'i bu ni skal ris yin/ gzhan lha chen gyis kho'i spun dbang phyug gi ru yo'u rgya nas blangs te nya nag sbra rgan la sbyar/dbang byug gi bu rnam rgyal dang / stag rdo/ dbu ris/ gsar ris —bcas yin/ /bla ma snyan grags kyi tsha bo snying lcags kyi bu ni tshe ring rna thes dang bla skyabs gnyis yin/ bla skyabs la bu 'phags cha dang / bsod nams/ bu mo g.yang res/ tshe lo/ dpa' ris bcas ming sring lnga skyes/ 'phags cha la bu bo rdo dang / yang sangs/ tshe gzungs gsum skyes/ bsod nams la klu mtsho dang / sgang mo/ lcags thar bcas skyes/ /ba tho gar sdang la bu kun bzang rnam rgyal dang lha chen gnyis skyes/ /lha chen la bu dar mgon dang / khro rgyal/ kun lo/ 'brug lo 146

bcas ming sring bzhi skyes/ /dar mgon la bu bsod rdo/ zhi pe/ rdo rje rgyal/ bu mo gar rdo/pad+ma skyid/ tes lo/ cha ris bcas skyes/ kun lo la tshe ring rgyal sogs bu lnga yod/ /kun bzang rnam rgyal la bu ba rgya dang ban de gnyis skyes/ ban de la bu 'jam dpal dang 'jam dbyangs sbyin pa gnyis skyes/ /khyi lo thar la bu ban de rgyal dang bu mo gar kho gnyis skyes/ ban de rgyal la bu byams pa dbyig gnyen dang / bu mo lcags rdo gnyis skyes/ gar kho la bu mo gar mo rgyal skyes/ de la dpon tshang nyi lo mag par bzhag nas bu dpal chen dang / tshe thar/ dpa' bo rdo rje/ mkhar rgyal thar/ rigs mchog rgyal sogs skyes/ /dpal chen skyabs la bu mo rta mgrin skyid skyes/ der mag pa rig rgyal bzhag nas bu dge 'dun skyes/ dge 'dun gyi bu ni gnam lha rgyal yin/ /skya lo'i bu mo chung ba la bu mo mtsho lo skyes/ mtsho lor mag pa khro kho banag nas bu bstan pa dang / 'jam dpal/ lha mkhar yag 'phags skyabs rgyal/ 'bum pa bcas skyes/ /'brug kho la bu dpal ldan sna bo skyes/ sna bo'i bu mo klu lo yin/ klu lor bu stag 'bum rgyal skyes/ /'jigs byed la bu med/ mtsho mo la mag pa zan rgyal bzhag nas bu lha tho skyes/ lha tho la bu yum rgyal dang / glang lung mtshams pa zer ba'i — 'jigs byed brnyen chen bcu gnyis phud pa'i mtshams pa ming grags can shig skyes/ /rig 'dzin la bu do le dang / bu mo da rda/ a nyung gsum skyes/ do le la bu sbyin pa gar sdang dang / lha mkhar/ tshe 'bum gsum skyes/ sbyin pa rab tu byung / lha mkhar la bu mo lha mo rdo skyes/ tshe 'bum bu skal la 1 7

byin/ /tshe brtan nag sdang la bu dge slong dang / tshe ring bsam 'grub/snying 'bum/ gnam lha bcas skyes/ dge slong ('di'i phyi rabs par nywa nag dge slong tshang zer )la bu nam mkha' dang / g.yang nge / blo cha gsum dang bu mo gnyis skyes/nam mkha' la bu garma dang / stag lha spyong / 'phags pa rgyal/bsod nams/ dbang chen/ ban thar (bu skal la byin ) bcas drug skyes/ /garma la bu lha bo dang / chos 'ba'/ tshe brtan gsum skyes/ lha bo la bu dpal chen dang / mthu stobs/ 'jam dbyangs lha btsun sogs skyes/tshe brtan la bu snying byams dang stag lha gnyis skyes/ /stag lha gyong la bu lha byams dang bu mo lha rgyal gnyis skyes/ lha byams la bu bsam 'phel dang / dbang byug ya pu rgyal/ gnam thar rgyal bcas dang bu mo bo mo thar skyes/ /g.yang nge la bu med/ blo cha'i bu 'od grags dang / 'od lo/dpal chen bcas yin/ 'od grags la bu snying dkar dang bu mo sgrol ma skyes/sgrol ma'i bu g.yang 'bum rgyal yin/ nywa nag dge slong gi tsha bo dpal mkhar gyi bu ni chos rdor rgyal yin/ /tshe ring bsam 'thub la bu chos grags (tsho dpon byas )dang bu mo chos mtsho gnyis skyes/ chos grags la bu med/ chos mtsho la bu dkon mchog mig rko skyes/ /dkon mchog la bu tshul rgyam dang / klu skyabs/ khen thar/ bu mo mkhar mo yag gnam sman bcas skyes/ mkhar mo yag gi bu bstan dar gyis da lta khyim skyong bzhin yod/ /snying 'bum la bu blo bstan rgya kha dang / legs bshad gser nya/ khyi 1 8

kho/ bde ldan bcas dang / bu mo tsas mo/ g.yu ne bcas ming sring bdun skyes/ /legs bshad gser nya dge slong yin/ blo bstan rgya kha la bu med/khyi lo la bu stag lha rgyal dang / ban de mgo se/ rdo rje nag bcas skyes/ /stag lha rgyal la bu brtson 'grus dang / bu mo dar mo gnyis skyes/ban de la bu rgya mtsho dang / khon thar/ rta mgrin bcas dang / bu mo kun mtsho rgyal/ bo chog bcas mingasreng lnga skyes/ /rdo rje la bu sbyin pa dang stag thar gnyis dang / bu mo sgrol ma skyid dang /gser rdo bcas ming sring bzhi skyes/ /bde ldan la bu mo dung mo rgyal skyes/ de'i bu sngags ris yin/ tsas mo yul 'dug yin/ bu thar 'bum rgyal dang / bu mo la bo gnyis skyes/thar 'bum la bu yang sangs dang bu mo dpal mtsho gnyis skyes/ /g.yu ne+e la bu bzod pa dang bu mo jo mo gnyis skyes/ jo mo la mag pa rab 'byor bzhag nas bla ma gter ston 'jigs med dam chos rgya mtsho'i sprul sku 'jams dbyangs lung togs rgya mtsho 'khrungs/ gnam lha la bu med/ /gcod pa la bu ྅ nag gzungs dmar skyes/ gzungs dmar la bu zan kho sngon mo dang / dge slong gong 'phel/ no'u 'ba'/ bon de bcas dang / bu mo do le dang ma gar gnyis skyes/ zan kho sngon mo la snan pa grags can dge 'dun dge legs gnyis dang bu mo byams skyid skyes/byams skyid la bu mo lha sgron skyes pa dang / de la bu dge slong byams pa rnam grol dang span pa bsod nams tshe ring / bu mo mag thar bcas skyes/ mag thar la nor lo mag par bzhag nas bu dge slong chos lo dang rab rgyas gnyis skyes pa dang / bon ne la nya nag gnyer ba dpal bzang dang / a rig sgrul sku 'jam dbyangs bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan/ chos lo/ bu mo thar ba bcas skyes/ chos lo'i bu gsungs rab yin/ dpal bzang la bu med/ thar ba 1 9

la mag pa sgrol rgyal bzhag /bu mo do le la klu tshang nas mag pa zhig bzhag ste bu lhun dbang dang /sbyin pa (cha)/ bu mo bo skyid/ zhi pa/ mu tsho bcas ming sring lnga skyes/sbyin pa la bu tshe ring thar dang / bu mo mkhar rdo/ jo rig bcas ming sring gsum skyes/ /྅ nag chos grags kyi tsha mo lha min la mag pa sman shul dge lo bzhag nas bu 'jam dpal dang / zon kho/ bu mo rin mo dang / g.yu rdo/ lha mtsho bcas ming sring lnga skyes/ /dge lo'i spun yo rgyan nag la bu mo dpal mo skyid dang / bsod mo skyid/mkhar li gsum skyes/ mkhar li la kho nag khro rgyal mag par bzhag ste bu bsun thar dang / gnam lha/ dbang rgyal bcas skyes/ /nywa nag blo bstan rgyal kha'i tsha bo snying dkar la bu mgon po dang / ru dar gnyis skyes/ ru dar la bstan 'dzin dang bu mo mkhar mo yag gnyis skyes/ mgon po la bu med/ /bsnan skyong la bu nya nag dbu mdzad dang / gdugs dkar/ ya bstan/ bu mo ja pa/ tshe sgron/ klu mo bcas ming sring drug skyes/ /gdugs dkar la bu ban de rgya ring dang bu mo g.yang lo gnyis skyes/ban des mkha' log bo dod du blangs nas de la bu thos bsam dang / dpal rdo/ yum chen/ bsod rdo bcas yod/ /g.yang lo la bu sman pa chos 'dzin (thung )dang snying bo gnyis dang /bu mo g.yang rgyal dang khyi mo thar bcas ming sring drug yod/ chos thung la sgrol ma skyabs dang mi rdo gnyis skyes/ /ya bstan la bu mgar ba bdud pa dang bu mo lo brgya gnyis skyes/bdud pa'i bu kun ldan yin/ /ja pa la bu mo dbang mo skyes/ de la dpon tshang 'jam dbyangs a sman 50

mag par bzhag nas bu sman pa chos 'dzin ring skyes/ chos 'dzin sgyu bu ni lha mgon dang phun tshogs gnyis yin/ /tshe sgron la skal phug rdo rje bkra shis mag par bzhag nas bu shes rab dang / 'jam dbyangs/ skyabs kho/ yi dam bcas skyes/ /shes rab la bu dar rgyas lo 'is gnyis dang / bu mo ku skyid skyid rgya gnyis skyes/ dar rgyas la bu rta dbang skyes/ lo mis kyis yum chen bu skal du blangs/ /'jam dbyangs la byams pa rgya mtsho'am dge bskos sna lo/ ban de ser dros/ phyag rdor bcas dang / bu mo klu mtsho skyes/ /chos skyong la bu mo dpal mo skyes/ ban ser gyi bu ni stag yan 'bum pa dang 'ba' rdo'u gnyis yin/ phyaganor la bu bsam 'phel dang / gdugs dkar/ bkra shis thub pa/ sko lo bcas lnga dang / bu mo rdo mo dang / ma ras/ snying mo bcas ming sring brgyad skyes/ klu mtsho la bu mo chos skyid rgyal dang / ba ris gnyis skyes/ skyabs kho la bu mo khams mtsho rgyal skyes/ de la dpa' mchog btsan lo mag par bzhag nas bu chos bzang dang / legs tshogs/ gsang res/ nyi ma yag dpal ris bcas dang / bu mo lcags rgyal/ kun 'tsho/ u lo bcas ming sring brgyad skyes/ /ba lo rgyal la bu sko lo dang bu mo 'phags mo gnyis skyes/ lcags rgyal la bu 'jam dbyangs shes rab dang / 'jigs med/ gsang bdag bcas dang / bu mo tshe lo dang sgro bo sogs ming sring lnga skyes/ /gnyis pa/ nya nag ban leng gi spun 'bring pa sog mo'i ban de nas mched pa'i mi rgyud/ /ban de la bu don ne dang / sman pa bsam 'grub/ tshag lo re'u snying bcas skyes/ /don ne la bu don grub spu ring skyes/ spu ring la bu rta rgyal dang /15/

mgon po tshe brtan/ dpal 'byor/ dbu lo bzhi skyes/ /rta rgyal la bu bsod nams rgyal dang bu mo tshul lo gnyis skyes/ tshul lo la mag pa ban de rgya bzhag nas bu klu sde dang mkhar byug rgyal gnyis skyes/dbu lo la bu 'od zer dang / tshe lo byams/ 'brug mo byams gsum skyes/dpal 'byor gyi bu skal la zla ba yag blangs/ /sman pa bsam 'thub la bu ban de pu ra dang / mkhas blo/ sngo rdo gsum skyes/ ban de pu ra la bu tshe dbang dang / khro kho/ 'od zer rgya mtsho gsum skyes/ tshe dbang gi bu skal ni 'jam dpal yin/ sngo rdo la bu jo mo dang / rdo rig lung rtogs bcas skyes/ mkhas blo nya nag sku lo tshang la mag par song / /tshag lo re'u snying la bu gnam kho skyes/ de la bu dbang chen rgyal dang /bsod nams/ 'jam dbyangs/ yum skyabs/ g.yang skyabs/ 'jam dbyangs grags pa bcas dang / bu mo dpal mtsho/ chos mo skyid bcas ming sring brgyad skyes/ /chos mo skyid la bu chos 'bum rgyal dang / lhun thub rgyal/ btsun thar rgyal bcas skyes la/ de dag gi khyim gzhi kos nan rgya zi sde ba na yod/dbang chen rgyal la bu rdo po dang / lung togs/ mkhar byams gsum skyes/bsod nams la bu mkhyen rab dang / ri lo/ tshe mkhar/ sgom pa/ zla ba/ tshe ring don grub sogs dang bu mo rdo rje skyid bcas skyes/ 'jam dbyangs grags pas rta kho rgyal bu skal du blangs/ yum skyabs kyi bu skal la mkhar byams blangs/ /gsum pa/ ྅ nag ban leng gi spun chung ba bkra shis skam po nas mched pa'i mi rgyud/bkra shis la bu the le dang skya lo gnyis skyes/ /the le la bu mo chos dbyings sgrol ma dang / chos sgron/ tshe mtsho skyid/ 52

g.yang sgron/ mkha' yag bcas lnga skyes/ /chos dbyings sgrol mar g.yang drung mag par bzhag nas bu nywa nag sku lo dang / mgon po rgyal gnyis skyes ('di nas bzung rjes rabs pa rnams la nya nag sgar skor ma zer〉/ mgon po rgyal la dge sgong bsam gtan dang /blo bzang 'azin las/ bu mo tshe lo dang rin chen mtsho bcas ming sring bzhi skyes/ tshe lo la mag pa mkhas lo bzhag nas bu mo mkha' rdo dang dkar dbang gnyis skyes/ mkha' rdo la mgar ba'i mkha' bo log mag par bzhag nas bu mo chos sgron dang / nywa nag sku lo'i yang sgrul ma lags 'jam dbyangs/ bu mo bkra shis gsum skyes/ rin chen mtsho la snying lcags mag par bzhag nas bu chos grags dang bu mo 'phags mo gnyis skyes/ chos sgron la gsang spyon mag par bzhag nas bu rig lo dang blo bzang / bu mo ma yus bcas ming sring gsum skyes/ rig lo (྅ nag dpon rgan )la bu lcags ga dang /'jam dbyangs don yod/ 'phags pa/ chos 'byor bcas bu bzhi skyes/lcags ga la bu mo tshe mo rgyal dang / jo mo tshe ring / bo chog skyid/ lcags mo bcas bzhi skyes/ tshe mo rgyal la chos 'phel mag par bzhag ste/ bu mo 'brug mo rgyal dang / bu kun bzang / lcags byams/ klu 'bum thar dang tshe 'bum yag bzod pa/ bu mo tshe yag skyid bcas skyes/ chos 'byor la bu tshe 'brug dang / bstan pa rab rgyas/ rab brtan rdo rje/ bu mo sgrol rtse dang / tshe mtsho bcas ming sring lnga skyes/ ma yas la reb gong rdo rje mag par bzhag nas bu dbang chen skyes/ dbang chen la bu dar rgyas dang /mkhar byams/ bu mo sa le dang la rdo bcam skyes/ /tshe mtsho skyid la bu sngags pa rig 'dzin dang / gnas brtan skya rgod/tshogs rgyal bcas srun gsum skyes/ rig 'dzin gyis g.yang skyabs bu skal du blangs/ de la bu mo zhig skyes shing / da lta stag skor na yod/ /tshogs rgyal la bu a skya ba dang / bu mo ka lo/ lu gu skyid sogs skyes/153

khuskya ba la bu sgom pa dang / gsung rab/ rdo rje/ rta kho rgyal bcas skyes/ /ka lo la bu mo 'phags thar dang / klu mo rgyal/ bo zed gsum skyes/lu gu skyid la snying po mag par bzhag de la bu dpal lo rgyal dang bu mo dge mtsho gnyis skyes/g.yang sgron la sman shul bo mo thar mag par bzhag nas bu dpa' bo ngo ra skyes/ dpa' bo'i bu skal bzang rgyal dang / bstan 'dzin/ bu mo mkha' rdo dang bde skyid/ g.yang mtsho bcas skyes/ /mkha' yag la sman pa rna ba'i dang pad+ma gnyis skyes/ pad+ma la bu dar rgyas dang / blo bzang rab 'phyor/ stag ga rgyal/ bu mo la la bcas ming sring ba'i skyes/ /dar rgyas la bu ban 'gro dang / bshad sgrub/ bu mo stag mo/ glu mo byams bcas skyes/ la la'i bu 'gur pa dang / 'gur pa'i bu dpa' rdo yin/ /gnyis pa sog skor lo ba ma'i mi da/gtsang pa sku phreng bzhi ba lngags nag pa byams pa bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho'i sku spun lo ba klo skor seng chen gyi ring nas bzung ru skor 'di nya nag sog skor dang skyid sdug mnyam gcig tu gyur/ seng chen la bu tho pa dang / tshe pa/pad+ma rgyal sogs skyes/ /tshe pa la bu snying rgyal byams dang / g.yang skyabs rgyal/ chos rdo'i a ba gsum skyes/ snying rgyal byams la bu blo bzang tshul khrims dang / rig 'dzin rdo rje/ li thar rgyal bcas dang / bu mo ye shes dbang mo bkra shis dbang mo bcas skyes/ /blo bzang tshul khrims la bu bkra shis don grub dang / zla ba bzang bo/bu mo lha mo tshe ring / dkar dbang mtsho/ bde skyid rgyal/ zon thog skyid 15

bcas skyes/ /bkra shis don grub kyi bu ni dar skyabs dang rta mgrin tshe brtan gnyis dang / bu mo rta mgrin sgrol ma bcas yin/ / bkra shis dbang mo la yo'u rgya nas mag pa 'jam dbyangs bzhag nas bu gcod pa sogs bu bu mo lnga skyes/li thar rgyal la bu lha bstan rgyal sogs gsum skyes/ /bzhi ba/ g.yer skyong bshadapa/ /(1) gam skyong gi tsho ming thogs tshul/g.yer skyong gi tsho ming la yul skyong dang / g.yu skyong / klu byung / yu skyong sogs kyi rnam grangs du ma yod/ yul skyong ni mes pa'i khrod na yul skyong zhes pa zhig yod pa'i mi ming las thog4par bshad pa dang / klu byung ni mes pa'i ma yum grub chen rgya ra zeg mchog gi bu mo mtsho mo klu byung gi mtshan las zogs pa/ phyis su de yang tshig zur chag nas klog byung zhes par gyur/g.yer skyong zhes pa'i ming 'dir paṇa chen sku phreng bcu ba rin po che'i zhal nas/g.yer ni chu'i g.yer mo lta bur dpe blangs te sde ba rgya mtsho 'dra ba zhig 'khyil 'ing rgyu nor ba rlabs 'dra ba zhig 'phyur ro zhes pa'i bkra shis kha g.yang gi tshul du btags/ g.yu skyong dang yu skyong zhes pa ni brjod bde'i sgo nas yig thog dang ngag thog la mang du 'byung ba las don 'di la bsnyegs zhes pa bshad rgyu med do/ /( 2) gamar skyong gimisgyud/ /mes po dpal mgon gyi gdung rgyud bstan pa rgya mtsho la bu dgra 'dul rdo rje dang / nam mkha' ru dmar/ dpon gyo dmar/ chos spyon phu nu bzhi skyes shing de dag gi rus rgyud 'phel ba las g.yer skyong tsho ba grub/ de yang dgra 'dul rdo rje dang nam mkha' ru dmar gnyis kyi rgyud la g.yer skyong sbra rgan byung zhing / dpon jo dmar dmar dang chos smyon gnyis kyi rgyud la g.yer skyong dpon tshang byung / /153

de yang bstan pa rgya mtsho'i bu dgra 'dul rdo rje dang nam mkha' ru dmar gnyis spu che ba'i nang bsdad pas gdung rgyud la sbra rgan zhes pa'i ming thogs/dgra 'dul rdo rje la bu sbra rgan rta mgrin dang / bu mo bkra shis mtsho gnyis skyes/ nam mkha' ru dmar la bu sngags 'chang rdo rje skyes shing de la klu 'bum skyes/ /rta mgrin gyi bu ni gsang bdag yin/ gsang bdag la bu pad+ma tshe ring dang / g.yang 'bum tshe ring / ban de thar/ dpal 'byor (dmag ring )bcas skyes/ pad+ma tshe ring gi bu mo chos mtsho'i bu ni tshe dbang dang /dpal lha/ gnam lha/ 'jam dbyangs dar rgyas bcas yin/ tshe dbang gis khro 'bum rgyal bu skal du blangs/ de la bu 'dzigs med skyes/ dpal lha la bu sgom pa dang / bzang bo/ bu mo bsod ris gsum skyes/ sgom pa la bu mo bsod rdo skyes/ de la mag pa mgon po tshe brtan bzhag nas bu mo sgrol kho skyes/ bsod ris la bu mo rgya mo skyid skyes shing / de'i mag par mkhyen rab bzhag nas bu mo bkra shis sgrol ma skyes/ /gnam lha la bu klu 'bum rgyal dang bskal bzang chos 'phel/ bu mo g.yang mo rgyal/ nor bu skyid/ ko thog bsod nams skyid/ gnam mtsho skyid/ bu mo ting 'dzin mtsho/ mkha' 'gro skyid bcas skyes/ /g.yang 'bum tshe ring la bu blo bzang bstan 'dzin dang / ya rdo rgyal/dpal rgyal/ snying 'bum/ lha 'bum/ bu mo lha mo bcas skyes/ /ya rdo'i bu nam mkha' rgyal dang / bu mo bo rgyal/ gar skyid/ snying kho/ bo zad/ chos mo rgyal/ kho lo bcas yin/ nam mkha' rgyal la bu chos dar dang / bsam 'phel/ 'phags pa/ la ro'u/ tshe lo/dpal rdo/ khe rdo bcas skyes/ nam mkha' rgyal gyi bu chos dar la bu kun mtshan rgyal dang / kun bho rgyal gnyis skyes/ bo rgyal la bsod po dang /dbang rgyal/ bstan pa/ bu mo byug mo/ khen thar/ u mo/ chos po/156

'brug yag bcas skyes/ bsod po la bu nor bu rgyal dang / bu mo pad+ma/phyug mo la mag pa chos dpal bzhag nas bu mo sher byin dang bu chos skyong skyes/ /dpal rgyal la bu mo 'brug mo dang / snying mo/ chos mtsho gsum skyes/'brug mo'i mag par gle ba'i zhi thar bzhag nas bu rgya lo dang dbu lo/ bu mo la po bcas skyes/ rgya lo la bu skyu rdo dang 'dzigs pa sogs skyes/ dbu lo'i bu ni bsod pe yin/ snying mo la bu 'brug rgyal dang / khro 'bum rgyal/gnam po gsum skyes/ 'brug rgyal la bu dpal chen rgyal dang bu mo 'brug kho gnyis skyes/ /snying 'bum bu mo ri rgya la dpa' skyabs mag par bzhag ri rgya la bu phur ba dang klu po/ blo bzang chos 'byor/ bu mo 'brug mo/ klu yagalcags pa bcas skyes/ phur ba la bu ku rdo dang / bu mo klu yag skyes pa dang /klu po'i bu ni sgrol skyabs yin/ /g.yang 'bum tshe ring gi bu mo lha mo la bu lha mkhar dang / bsod tshe/dpa' 'bum gsum skyes pa dang / lha mkhar la bu rdo ris dang bu mo rig 'dzin skyid gnyis skyes la/ rdo ris la bu chos skyong dang bdud 'dul/ bu mo lcags mo dang dpal sgron sogs skyes/ /bsod tshe la bu rta lo dang / gcod pa rgyal/ tshe 'bum/ bsam 'phel nor bu/ sman bla rin chen/ bu mo chos po/ zhing mo/ 'o mtsho bcas skyes/ rta lo la bu lha mgon dang / tshe brtan rdo rje/ g.yang chen tshe ring / pad+ma nor bu/ bu mo gangs dkar bcas skyes so/ / gcod pa'i bu ni kun thar rgyal dang 'brug thar rgyal gnyis yin la/ tshe 'bum gyi bu ni rta mgrin rgyal dang / tshe rdo/ rdo rje rgyal bcas yin/ /dpa' 'bum gyi bu mo sgrol mtsho la 'jam skor yo lo mag par bzhag nas/bu mo dpal mo dang / bsas mo/ khon po/ lcags mo/ bu las zhan 157

rgyal bcas skyes/ lcags mo la kho nag do rgya mag par bzhag nas bu chos mchog rgyal skyes/ /ban de thar la bu rab brtan dang u rgyan tshe ring / dkon mchogadapal ldan/ bu mo jo mo/ lha mo skyidabacas skyes/ rab brtan gyi bu ni yi dam skyabs dang dbang grags rgyal gnyis yin la/ yi dam skyabs la bu dka' thub dang tshe lha 'bum gnyis dang / dbang grags rgyal la bu phun tshogs dang / bu mo pad+ma skyid/ bsod kho skyid bcas skyes/ u rgyan tshe ring gi bu mo bkra shis skyid la mag pa blo bzang rgya mtsho bzhag nas bu nyi ma dang /'phrin las/ chos rje/ bu mo mkhar mo yag bcas skyes/ u rgyan la bu mo chos mtsho dang / snying lo gnyes skyes/ dkon mchog la bu 'jam dbyangs dang / phur ba/ bu mo gar mtsho/ g.yang mo skyid sogs skyes/ dpal ldan la bu 'jigs med rdo rje dang bu mo skal bzang skyid gnyis skyes/'jigs med rdo rje la bu rdo bo sogs skyes/ jo mo la bu dge 'dun rgya mtsho dang / g.yang rgyal/ lha rgyal bcas skyes pa dang / lha rgyal la bu tshe dbang rgyal dang / bu mo mtsho lo gnyis skyes shing / tshe dbang rgyal la bu tshe ring rgyal dang / mtsho lo la rin chen 'bum mag par bzhag nas bu bsod nams rgyal skyes/ /gsang bdag gi bu dpal 'byor (dmag ring )la bu klu rgyal dang /rig 'dzin/ bu mo yum skyid gsum skyes/ klu rgyal la bu tshe dbang skyes pa dang / de la bu lha bo skyes/ lha bo'i bu rin chen tshe ring dang blo bzang gnyis yin/ rin chen tshe ring la bu bdud 'dul dang / phur rdo/ bu mo mtsho mo skyid bcas skyes/ blo bzang la bu yum skyabs rgyal skyes/ /yum skyid la bu dpal rtse dang / rab rgyas gnyis skyes pa dang /dpal rtse la bu dkon lo dang / bu mo lha smin gnyis skyes/ lha smin la bu sbyin pa dang / sras mchog sgrol ma skyabs/ bu mo dbang mtsho bcas skyes 158

la/ dbang mtsho'i bu ni 'jigs med yin/ /sngags 'chang rdo rje'i bu sbra rgan klu 'bum la bu lhun grub dang / gu ru skyabs/ bu mo rgyal/ kun dga' bcas skyes/ lhun grub la bu rin chen dang / a tho/ bu mo rta mgrin skyid dang / gnam mtsho skyid bcas yin la/rin chen la bu tshe bo dang / za lo/ bu mo u po bcas skyes/ tshe bo la bu rdo rje thar dang / ba lo gnyis skyes/ ya tho'i bu mo na lo la btsan mo'i byams pa rgyal mag par bzhag/gnam mtsho skyid la bu gnam gzhis dang / chos 'dzin/ bu mo snying 'ba' bcas skyes/ gnam gzhis la bu rgya rgan dang / bu mo yu po/ snying lo skyid/ jo lo bcas skyes/ rgya rgan la bu gnam phyug rgyal dang phag rdo gnyis skyes/ za lo la bu a rga dang / 'jam dpal/ bu mo rdo rje mtsho/dar mtsho/ tshe rdo/ kun 'dzoms bcas skyes/ /klu 'bum bu mo bo mo rgyal la bu rig bzang dang / bu mo g.yang mtsho/g.yang ris bcas skyes/ rig bzang gis dpal rgyal gyi bu mo khro mo bo dod du blangs te mag pa lha mchog bzhag nas de la dang pe dang bu mo 'brug ge gnyis skyes/ 'brug ge'i mag par chos don bzhag/klu 'bum bu kun dga' la bu blo gsal dang / dge 'dun/ g.yer skyong chos pa rin po che bcas skyes/ g.yer skyong chos pa rin po che skye sa'i sbra ni da lta'i stag skor rig pe dang gser 'bum tshang yin/ dge 'dun sgyu shul ni da lta'i dpa' mchog gle ba'i 'jam dbyangs cha tho tshang yin/ blo gsal dpa' mchog seng chen tshang la mag par song / /klu 'bum bu gu ru skyabs (khro rgyal )la bu bla ma lag pa dang / bla ring gnyis skyes pa las bla ma lag par bu lcags byams skyes shing / de la bu rta mgrin skyes/ rta mgrin la bu 'phags pa skyes pa da lta hor na yod/ bla ring la bu chos byams dang no no rgya sdang gnyis skyes/ no no la bu rnam grol dang 159

mes tsug gnyis las mes tsug la bu don yod skyes pa dang / rnam grol la bu skyabs rgyal dang / dpal 'bum/ bu mo ri rgya/ chos sgron bcas skyes/ /bla ring gi bu chos byams la bu byams rgyal dang / skal hang / lo tho/rgya kho/ bu mo log rgya bcas skyes/ byams rgyal la bu bstan skyong dang /rig lo/ pa ring / bu mo gangs mo/ sgo kho bcas skyes/ skal hang la bu lha 'bum rgyal dang / rgya me/ ka bo rgyal/ snying rgyal bcas skyes/ /bstan skyong la bu a lags smrar skam sku phreng bdun pa dang / bu mo snying mo skyid/ khro mo/ ma kho bcas skyes/ rig blo la bu u po dang / ba blo/bu mo gnam mtsho gsum skyes/ ba blo la bu 'brug rtse dang dpa' chen gnyis skyes/ 'brug rtse la bu stag lha dang / bu mo ma cig mtsho skyid bcas skyes/byams rgyal gyi bu mo gangs mo la bu bla ma bkra shis dang / rta mgrin/ bu mo ri pe/ nu kho bcas skyes/ /bskal bzang gi bu rgya me la bu bstan 'dzin dang / 'jam dbyangs rgya mtsho/ bu mo snying lo/ g.yu sgron/ u rdo/ chos mtsho bcas skyes/bskal dbang gi bu ra po rgyal la bu dge legs dang / dbu rdo gnyis skyes pa da lta hor na yod/ bskal dbang gi bu snying rgyal la bu gnas brtan skyabs dang / bu mo dpal mo rgyal/ zhing sgron/ sgro sto/ nu bo sogs skyes/chos byams kyi bu lo tho la chos sgron chung mar bsus te bu ko'u ba chos rgya mtsho dang / a lags thar shul/ lha chen/ tshe 'ba'/ bu mo mkhar lo/chos mo/ ku pe bcas skyes/ tshe 'a 'a la bu khro kho dang / tshe 'bum rgyal/garma blo gros/ bu mo mkhar lo/ chos mo/ ku pe/ la rol/ las nol bcas skyes/ /khro kho la bu bskal bzang rgyal dang / 'jam dpal/ bu mo pad+ma mtsho gsum skyes/ tshe 'bum rgyal la bu jo bo dang bsam 'phel/ bu mo rin chen mtsho bcas skyes/ tshe 'ba'i bu blo gros la bu lab rgyas dang / bu mo tsha mo 160

rgyal/ mkha' mtsho gsum skyes/ chos dbyings kyi bu rdor lo la bu dbu rdo dang / bu mo 'dra rdo/ sgro rdo/ ye shes skyid bcas skyes/ chos dbyings kyi bu mkhas mchog la bu bo rgyal dang / bsam 'apel gnyis skyes/lha chen la bu dpa' lo dang / bkra shis gnyis skyes/ mkhar lo la mag pa chos dbyings bzhag ste bu rdor lo dang / tshul khrims/ shes rab/bu mo mkhal ma/ g.yu ris/ g.yang kho/ chos lo bcas skyes/ dpa' 'bum la bu sgo ril skyes/ bstan skyong gi bu blo 'phel la bu sgrol ma skyabs dang / shes rab/ skal bzang / rnam rgyal/ rgya lo/ skye mchogabastan pa bcas skyes/ /bstan skyong gi bu lha bo la bu 'bum pa dang / bu mo bkra pe/ khang ris/tshe ring bcas skyes/ bstan skyong gi bu mo khro mo la mag pa ban de bzhag ste bu gnas bstan dang / chos ldan/ grags pa/ bu mo g.yu sgron bcas skyes/g.yu sgron la ྅ nag ka rdo mag par bzhag nas bu rin chen skyes/ byams rgyal gyi bu mo gang mo la bu bla ma bkra shis skyes pa dang / de la bu nam mkha' dang /mthu la/ gsang bdag a chas bcas skyes/rgya me'i bu bstan 'dzin la bu 'phags skyabs rgyal skyes/ 'jam dbyangs rgya mtsho la bu bsod rdo skyes/ dpa' lo la bu nor 'ba' dang /gsang sngags/ tshe po rgyal/ don ne bcas skyes/ jo mo la bu sang rdo dang /sgrol yag mtsho skyid/ gangs rdo bcas skyes/ /ma kho la dpa' mchog bu rgod mag par bzhag nas bu dbang po dang /bu mo khu po/ sgrol ma tshe ring bcas skyes/ rig lo'i bu u po la bu stobs rgyal tshe ring dang / mgo le/ 'ja' bde/ don kho/ bu mo g.yang rgyal/pad+ma mtsho/ sras mo/ gzig lo/ 'brug mo bcas skyes/ 'brug mo la dbang chen mag par bzhag ste bu sang ris rgyal skyes/ /lha smin gyi bu bkra shis la bu dpal lha rgyal dang blo gros gnyis skyes/161

rnam grol bu mo ri rgya la bu mo gser rgya skyes pa dang / de la mag pa yum chen bzhag nas bu chos skyabs rgyal dang / nor skyabs rgyal skyes/ sgo ril la bu chos 'phel dang / gdugs dkar/ 'brug rgyal/ bu mo g.yang skyid/bsod nams/ tshe ring / jo mo bcas skyes/ ban de'i bu chos ldan la bu khri srong rgyal skyes/ /bu rgod kyi bu dbang po la bu mo 'ju bo skyes shing de la mag pa lha mgon bzhag nas bu 'jam dbyangs dpal ldan skyes/ snying rje'i bu mo dpal mo rgyal la chos po mag par bzhag nas bu rig 'dzin dang bu mo bde lo skyes/snying rje'i bu mo zhing sgron la mag pa grags pa bzhag de la bu lha brtan rgyal dang / lha mgon skyabs/ chos rdo bcas skyes/ /bla ma bkra shis kyi bu nam mkha' la bu dpal mgon tshe ring dang / bu mo rta po/ ka phrug bcas skyes/ bla ma bkra shis gyi bu gsang bdag la bu mo g.yang kho rgyal dang bu chos skyong rgyal skyes/ chos 'phel la bu 'phags ke skyes/tshe mgon gyi bu mo mkha' ris la mag pa rnam rgyal bzhag nas bu gnam thar rgyal skyes/ dpa' stag rgyal gyi bu nor 'ba' la bu mo tshe mo rgyal skyes/de la mag pa bkra shis tshe ring bzhag nas bu mo ku po skyes/ khro kho'i bu bskal bzang rgyal la bu don ldan dang / dbang grags rdo rje skyes/ /dpal le rgyal gyi bu sto le la bu ri phyug skyes/ rta mgrin la bu dpal rgyal dang / khrang po/ bu mo tshe dbang skyid bcas skyes/ ma cig la bu bkra shis don grub skyes pa dang / khrang po la bu mu rgyan tshe ring skyes/byams rgya'i bu rgya kho la bu bsod nams rgyal skyes pa dang / de la bu mkhar 'bum rgyal skyes/ mkhar 'bum rgyal gyi bu ni nor 'ba' dang /gcod pa/ klu po/ lha mchog bu mo jo lo lo mo la po bcas yin/bskal dbang gi sring mo skya rdo la bu mo snying ris dang 'brug mo skyid gnyis skyes/snying ris la bu garma 'bum dang / bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho/ mgon po bcas 162

skyes/ garma 'bum la bu mo mkha' rdo dang / phur tho/ tshe rdo bcas skyes/mgon po la bu mo byug rgya skyes/ bu mo tshe rdo'i bu ni mgo bo rgyal yin/gnyis pa/ dpon rgya dmar dang chos spyon phu nu gnyis kyi rus rgyud dpon po chos spyon gyi ru skor la g.yer skyong dpon tshang zhes pa'i ming thogs/chos smyon la bu ya ba dang tha ris/ g.yang lo/ bu mo g.yang mo bcas skyes/ ya ba la bu thar rgya dang / snying tho/ ka kho/ lhun grub/ rig nar/ no'u 'ba'/ rdor lo/ hre dga'/ 'phags nag bcas skyes/snying tho la bu stag yan ri nag dang bsod nams chos 'ba' gnyis skyes/ ri nag la bu tshe ring skyes/ bsod nams chos 'ba' la bu don grub dang /mchog grub gyi bu ni sangs rgyas yin/ 'jam dbyangs la bu yo rgyan skyes shing /chos lo'i bu ni don 'grub rgyal yin/ g.yu ris la bu a la dang / klu tho la bu chos 'byor skyes/ /ya ba'i bu lhun grub ni/ spyi lo1860tsam la gong stod dang hor tsho bzhi sogs brgyud nas glo'u tshang la song / de la bu jo mo rgyal dang / 'od zer/sangs rgyas/ ban de/ lha 'brug bcas skyes la/ de dag gi mi rgyud legs bshad dang / tshe lha rgyal/ rdo zu tshe brtan/ bshad sgrub bcas da lta gos nan sum mdo 'ang du yod/ /ya ba'i bu rig zhar dang / no'u 'ba'/ rdor lo/ tre dga' bcas kyi mi rgyud da lta a rig na yod/a ba'i bu ka kho la bu phun tshogs dang rnam rgyal gnyis skyes/ phun tshogs la bu phur skyabs dang bu mo 'phreng thar gnyis skyem/ rnam rgyal la bu 'od zer dang / grags pa sogs skyes shing / 'di dag gi mi rgyud da lta mgo log rma chen dzong sgro mgo 'ang na yod/chosasnyon bu tha ris la bu ba ris dang / bstan pa/ mgon po/ bu 163

mo 'brug mo bcas skyes/ g.yang lo la bu yi dam dang / mgur pa/ lha rgyal/ thar rgyal bcas skyes/ g.yang mo mtsho la bu dpa' lo dang lha 'bum gnyis skyes/a ba'i bu thar rgyal la bu sngo lo dang hre rgod gnyis yod/ 'phags nag la bu mo skar ma skyid skyes/ tha ris bu ba ris la thu yol lug dang / bdud lha/ rin tho bcas skyes/ bstan pa la bu gcod rgan dang / ku stugaskal pe/ thub bstan/ rgya bza'i dpon mo bcas skyes/ mgon po la bu tshe ring rgyal skyes/ 'brug mo la bu tshe brtan rgyal dang / blo brtan/ bu mo klu mo rgyal bcas skyes/ /g.yang mtsho'i bu dpal lha la bu klu ring dang sbyin pa gnyis skyes/ lha 'bum la bu klu tshe dang / a rda 'brong / dbang chen 'bum gsum skyes/thar rgya'i bu sngo lo la bu rta 'bo dang / pa ldi/ 'ba' tho/ ban de khams/ bu mo lha ris bcas skyes/ 'phags nag bu mo skar ma skyid la bu mo g.yang mo rgyal skyes/ba ris kyi bu yol lug la bu zon thar skyes pa dang / bdud lha la bu g.yang 'ba' skyes/ rin tho la bu khro rgyal thar skyes/bstan pa'i bu gcod rgan la bu ban 'gro skyes pa dang / 'di'i mi rgyud rwa rgya'i chu ba na yod/ ku sdug la bu bsod rgyal dang / bu mo lo po/ lha mo thar bcas skyes/ skal pe la bu ban de dang / tshag ris rgyal/ phyag rdor/bu mo gnam ris bcas skyes/ thub bstan la bu mo tshe sgron dang tshe mo rgyal gnyis skyes/ mgon po'i bu tshe ring rgyal la bu 'bum rgyal dang ya lags ya yag gnyis skyes/yi dam bu gcod pa la bu yi kho dang / no'u rgya/ ban de byams/ bla rgan bcas skyes/ mkhar rgyal gyi bu mo skyid mo rgyal la bu tho li dang / tshe bo/bu mo ma rte skyid/ dkar mo rgyal bcas skyes/ mgur pa'i bu rgya log la bu mo 16

skyid le dang nu mo gnyis skyes/ bstan rgyas la bu dko pe dang bu mo mtsho mo /༵༵ ṭ+wāṃspra ṭ+wāṃ / ri/ nga shā busna ga dīsbyon ditram̐ sdu ༵ sgyu rdo ngadi ṭ+wāṃ shā ṭ+wāṃ~X mtsho skyes/lha 'bum gyi bu a rda la bu mo zla sgron skyes/ dpa' chen 'bum la bu g.yang lug dang rgyal mtshan gnyes skyes/ sngo ris la bu snying po yag skyes/sngo lo'i bu ban de khams la bu blo bstan(grwa ba)dang / bu mo gnam mtsho dang gur mtsho sogs skyes/ 'ba' tho la bu bsod ris dang / bu mo khyi gu/la sgron/ dpa' mtsho bcas skyes/ a rda'i bu mo zla sgron la zla ba mag par bzhag nas bu mo sras mo skyes/ dbang chen 'bum gyi bu g.yang lug la bu rab rgyas skyes/ rgyal mtshan la bu rdor lo skyes/ sngo ris gyi bu snying bo yag la bu khyi thar skyes/rta 'ba'i bu mo ma 'bo la thar ris mag par bzhag nas ma lu dang dar rgyas gnyis skyes/ 'ba' rde'u bu tshe brtan rgyal la bu dpa' lo dang /dbang chen/ bu mo klu mo/ gangs rdo/ mkha' 'gro bcas skyes/ ban de la bu ba rdo dang / bu mo rta po/ sgrol bde/ bu mo sgrol ma bcas skyes/ban de khams kyi bu mo mgur mtsho dang gnam mtsho gnyis la yo'u rgya'i 'o no mag par bsus shing / kho mo gnyis chen chun byas te bu brtson 'grus dang /bu mo dbang mo/ bskal rdo/ nor bu rgyal/ dbang rdor/ bu mo dbang mo/ pad+ma/ klu mtsho sogs skyes/ 'ba' tho'i bu bsod ris sgal ba la bu rta mgrin dang bu mo rdo mo sogs skyes/ ku stug bu mo lha mo thar la bu gdugs dkar skyes/ bsod rgyal la bu u rgyan dang / bu mo gser kho/ chu lo bcas skyes/ skal pe'i bu phyag rdor la bu dge rgyal dang / bu mo ma ma/g.yang mtsho bcas skyes/ /thub bstan gyi bu mo tshe sgron rgyal la sbyin pa mag par bzhag nas bu 'jig rdo dang / bu mo phag mo/ tshe rdo/ bde kho/ stag rdo bcas skyes/ /165

tshe ring rgyal gyi bu 'bum rgyal la bu ri rgyal skyes/ 'brug mo la bu yid pa dang / bu mo do pa/ g.yu rdo bcas skyes/ blo bstan gyi bu mo nu mo la mag pa tsho'u zhes pa ba'ag nas bu dpa' bo rgyal dang / lha mchog tshe res/bu mo bo yag bcas skyes/ /lha mo thar gyi bu gdugs dkar la bu mo bde mchog skyes/ phyag rdor gyi bu dge rgyal la bu mo jo pe dang / a mtsho gnyis skyes/ 'bum rgyal bu ri rgyal la bu lha brtan rgyal skyes/ tsho'u zhes bu dpa' bo rgyal la bu sangs rgyas dang / bu mo lha kho gnyis skyes/ tshe lo'i bu mo g.yang mo rgyal la bu stag lha rgyal dang / bu mo cha tho gnyis skyes/ yol lug gi bu zon thar la bu mo g.yang mo rgyal skyes/ bdud lha'i bu g.yang 'ba' la bu phur rdo dang / rin tho'i bu khro rgyal la bu 'jam bstan dang / lha phyug 'bum skyes/ /chos rgyal la mag pa rgya lo bzhag ste bu stag lha rgyal dang / g.yang 'bum rgyal/ bu mo rwa 'jig bcas skyes/ tshe brtan rgyal la bu a lags nyi ma skyes/gcod pa'i bu yi kho la bu thogs med dang / bu mo gcod mo/ khams skyid bcas skyes/ no'u rgyal la bu mo chu rdo skyes/ ban de byams pa la bu mo bkra shis mtsho skyes/ bla rgan la bu dge bo skyes/ skyid mo rgyal gyi bu tho li la bu tshe bkra dang / dbang phyug le mo/ bu mo phur mo/ na na/ tshe lo bcas skyes/ rgya log gi bu mo nu mo la ban de mag par bzhag nas bu dpa' chen skyes/ skyid le la rab rgyas mag par bzhag ste bu chos srung dang / chos don/bu mo stag mo/ mkhal ma/ bsod rdo bcas skyes/ /bstan rgyas kyi bu dko be la bu dam chos dang / bu mo yag re/ 'brug lo bcas skyes/ klu ring gi bu rig 'dzin la bu chos rdo dang / bu mo sgrol ma/bo 'o / bsod rdo/ bsod nams bcas skyes/ tshe ring la dpa' chos mag par bzhag nas bu mo bde lo skyes/ klu tshe'i bu pa yes la bu chos 'bum dang ri po gnyis skyes/ /166

rgya lo'i bu stag lha la bu mo gcod pa skyid skyes/ nu lo'i bu tshe dbang la bu lcags thar rgyal dang / lu'u hrin rgyal gnyis skyes/ chos 'bum la bu rto lo dang / dar rdo gnyis skyes/ ri po la bu u po dang / no pe skyes/ zla sgron sgyu bu mo sras mo la bu mo 'brug rdo skyes/ /bstan pa rgya mtsho'i spun chung ba rdo rje rgyal la g.yer skyong dpon po jo dmar skyes/ dpon jo dmar la bu no'u chung dang / dko rgyal/ chos lo gsum skyes shing / no'u chung la bu dge 'dun dang / tshe byams/ byams pa/ kun tho/ lha ba gshed kha/ gnam lha rgyal/ rgyas lo bcas skyes/dko rgyal la bu g.yang ring dang / rgya mo/ chos lo bcas skyes/ tshe byams la bu bzod pa dang / dbang sde/ bsod stobs/ thub chen/ bu mo tā re bcas skyes/ byams pa la bu bstan rgyas dang / rgya mtsho/ stobs ldan bcas skyes/ rgyas lo la bu tshe 'bum rgyal dang bu mo tshe mo rgyal gnyis skyes/g.yang ring la bu mu tho dang chos dar gnyes skyes/ rgya mo la bu rdo pu tshe brtan skyes/ kun tho la bu thub bstan skyes/ de la bu mgon po skyabs dang snying 'bum rgyal gnyis skyes pa da lta rtse khog hor na yod/ lha ba gshed kha la bu yu rdo skyes/ gnam lha rgyal la bu lha mo skyabs skyes/ /g.yang ring gi bu mi tho la bu bstan rgyas dang / g.yung drung / bsam gtan/ byams bzang bcas skyes/ chos dar gyi bu ni sgom pa dang zhu kho gnyis yin/ rdo pu tshe brtan la bu tshe ring rgyal skyes/ /thar ris la bu rgya mtsho rta rna skyes pa dang / de la bu mo bsod skyid dang /jo mo/ klu yag bcas skyes/ dbang sde'i bu ni gar dbang skyabs dang /chos 'phel/ tshe rdo bcas yin/ thub chen gyi bu ni mthu po yin/ bsod stobs la bu mo yi pa dang bsod tshe gnyis skyes/ tā re la bla ma mag par bzhag ste bu blo bzang nyi ma dang / rta mgrin tshe ring / mchog thub bcas skyes/ yi pa'i bu mo bsod mtsho la chos 'dzin mag par bzhag nas bu lha 167

mchog rgyal dang dpal 'byor bcas bdun skyes/ byams pa la bu rgya mtsho dang stobs ldan gnyis skyes/ rgya mtsho la bu 'jug po dang / bkra shis don thub/ bu mo zu lo skyid bcas skyes/ stobs ldan la bu bskal bzang rgya mtsho dang / gtsug tor/ bu mo 'phags ma rgyal/ 'dzoms pa/ sman bla skyid bcas skyes/ bde lo'i bu tshe 'bum rgyal la bu 'o g.yang rgyal skyes/ /gsum pa/ sde gzhan na yod pa'i g.yer skyong gi mi rgyud/ /yo no'u bu mo pad+ma dang / klu mtsho/ dbang rdor sogs mog hor na yod/ sbyin pa mgo rag gi mi rgyud lcags thar rgyal da lta mgar rtse gol ma'i a sangs na yod/ klu ring gi shul 'dzin ban de da lta mgar rtse gong ma na yod/ /a ba la bu drug skyes rte rig zhar dang / rdor lo/ no 'ba' gsum gyi rigs rgyud gsung rab dang dge blo bcas kyi gzhis da lta rma byang sog rigs rdzong gi ya rig zhang na yod la/ /snying tho'i bu ri nag dang / de'i bu tshe ring sogs mgar rtse zhol ma'i stag yan na yod/ /ka kho ngang sdang gi bu rgyud phur skya sa dang / grags pa/ 'od zer bcas kyi gzhis da lta g.yon gzhis su yod/ /lhun grub gnam sa ske gon gyi bu rgyud legs bshad dang / rdo pu tshe ring / tshe lha rgyal/ dpa' yag rgyal sogs kyi gzhis da lta mang rdzong glo'u tshang na yod/dpon spyo dmar gyi bu rgyud mi tho dang / chos dar/ rgya mo sogs kyi shul 'dzin sgom 'ba' dang / g.yung drung / tshe ring rgyal sogs kyi gzhis da lta sgo me tha dung du yod/ /ya khu skal hang gi bu ka bo rgyal dang / de'i bu dge legs/ nam 168

mkha' ru dmar gyi bu rgyud lcags byams kyi bu rta mgrin sogs kyi gzhis da lta hor na yod/nam mkha' ru dmar gyi rus rgyud mes tsig gi bu don yod kyi bu rabs tsha rgyud rnams da lta g.yon gzhis su yod/ /dgong du spros pa'i khyim gzhis dang bu rgyud la da dung phyogs sosor gyes pa mang po po da mod de tsam gyis 'thus par bya'o/ /( 2) g.yer skyong gi tsho dpon/ /bstan pa mtsho/ kho ni g.yu skyong gi tsho dpon thog ma yin te/ kho'i skabs su spun rdo rje tshe brtan sogs g.yer skyong gi ru skor zhig da lta'i gnas 'dir spor mgo tshugs/ spun chung ba gu ru skyabs sogs rang gzhis su bsdad cing / da lta reb gong phyogs su g.yer skyong klog byung dang g.yer skyong dgon pa sogs kyang yod pa de ga yin/ bstan pa rgya mtsho'i ru skor la mi nyung stabs thog mar yo'u rgya'i ru skor byas nas bsdad par grags/ sa 'dir thon rjes snga phyir bu ja la can dang / gyo dmar/ nam mtha' ru dmar bcas la khyim thab bsus pas/ kho tshor mun thal dkar lding dang / sog ru'i bo'u dmar / mgo log phyag bo'u sogs khyim nor rtsa chen yod pa gnang nas khyim gzhis so sor 'dzin du bcug chos spyon da dung lo chung bas pha gzhis nas sdod cing brgya bo'u kha log ces pa'i me mda' ches bzang ba de kho la khas btags/ sa 'dir spor dus bstan pa rgya mtsho lo mthon por slebs yod pas cang ma 'gor bar tshe las 'das/ /gamar skyong chos spyon/ bstan pa rgya mtsho'i rjes su chos smyon gyis g.yer skyong gi tsho dpon khur/ kho ni chung dus nas gnyen la byams shing dgra la sdang ba zhig yin te/ lo bco lnga yin pa'i skabs shig la jag pa skor zhig gis khong ma bu gnyis la thub tshod 'phrog bcom byas pa tshang ma tshar bcad pas/dpa' bo dom nag spyon pa lta bu zhig red ces bshad pa la brten nas g.yer 169

skyong chos spyon zhes pa'i ming thogs/ khos tsho don du dka' sdug ci 'dra myong dgos kyang sems phangs med byed la/ lo rer pha sa reb gong phyogs su song nas rdzong dkar dgon pa nas rang sder skyabs 'jug zhu ba dang / phyis su rdzong dkar dgon pa'i bla ma rje ma ṇi ba bkra shis la nged g.yer skyong la gzhi bdag btsan po zhig dgos zer nas bla mas rgyal bo sku lnga gnang / phu bo ja la can dang mnyam du dbu rta tsheg lug gis rgyu 'byor ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa btang ste yum dum pa bcu gnyis gser bris su bzhengs/ rgya bza' khri bas gser lag dgon pa bskyar bzhengs byed pa'i sbyin bdag gtso bo mdzad/skyabs mgon zhabs dkar ba gdan drangs te bka' chos mang po zhus pa sogs zhabs dkar ba'i rnam thar du gsal/ mdor na gagayer skyong chos spyon ni kha las rlung rta dar zhing / dbang thang lam 'gro rgyas pa/ dgra 'dul bar rgod pa/ gnyen skyong bar byam4pa/ g.yer skyong kho nar ma zad dgon gong ma spyi'i las don la'ang mdzad rjes che ba'i skyes bu dam pa zhig yin/ /bstan pa/ chos smon gyi tsha bo yin la/ g.yer skyong gi dpon rabs gsum pa khur/ kho ni gzugs stobs che zhing dpa' rtsal ldan pa zhig yin pas bstan pa 'brong sna zer/ kho dpa' mchog chos lo dang mnyam du sog por dmag 'thab tu song / kho tsho sha bo ri phyor gyi tho rgyud du dmag kha gtad du sdod skabs/ 'brong rgod cig dmag sgar tu brgyug 'ong ba la/ kho rang gdong du mchongs rte rwa la 'jus shing gri yis bsnun nas bsad pa pha rol bos mthong ste dmag rgyag ma phod par phyir 'then byas/ de ltar kho'i dpa' rtsal dang gzi bajid kyis mi shi rta 'gyel gyi g.yul ngo bzlog par gyur/ phyis su khos rma ngos nas gser mang po rnyed de lha sa'i jo bor gser zhal bsgron pa dang / ngag rgyun du kho'i rnyed pa'i gser ni gser nag ma mo'i mchin pa zhes pa yin par grags/ gzhan khos spyod chen sna tshogs bsdums pa sogs sde ba 170

skyong ba'i byas rjes bzhag tshul gleng rgyu yod/ /g.yer skyong che 'ba'/ kho ni a lags ko'u ba dang thar shul gnyis kyi nu bo yin/ 1881lor skyes/ 1903lo'i zla pa'i tshes19nyin a la gas ko'u bas mang tshogs kyi don du log spyod srid gzhung gi khral bkag 'gog byas pa sogs la rkyen byas nas/ a lags ko'u ba 'khor dang bcas pa lha sar pebs pa'i lam bar nas khri ga'i sa sgos bsrus te 'dzin bzung byas rjes/ma lags ko'u ba dang thar shul rnam pa gnyis de mur dmar gsod btang /lo bco brgyad yin pa'i tshe 'bas nyin der mig 'jigs dang khrims gcod dus thog tu myong zhing / khong khro'i me lce 'bar ba'in ske sgo dang lcags sgrog khrol ler khrims mun du bcug nyams nyes chags sgo byung pa'i dus der/skal phug dpon po rna thos zhes pa des tshe 'ba' la lta ru yong ba'i go skabs dang bstun nas khyod kyis sa skung mang po brgyab yod tshul gyi nges len rdzun ma gyis dang / kho tshos bden par bsam ste longs zer na/ ngas khyed khrid de thar ye thub lta zhes bshad pa ltar bgyir pas/ gshed ma tshor yang dngul thob 'dod kyi ham pa langs te tshe 'ba' sa skung 'don du btang bas skal phug dpon pos rogs ram la brten nas thar thub pa byung / tshe 'ba' phyir ko'u ba dgon par thon rjes khos dpon po ka mdo dang khon rgyal sogs dang mnyam du/ hor mo khag gsum gtso bo byas pa'i sde tsho nyer dgu dang / rang 'og tshud ci thub kyi dmag rta bsdus 'ing / tshe 'ba' khong dmag dpon gtso bo byas te/ me mda' sgrul mgo ma khur/ rta pho sngo khra bcibs/ khri ga'i rdzong mkhar du dmag chen drangs nas khong gis ra sa gcig nas jag mag bzhi bcu lhag bsad par ma zad/ bla ma gnyes bgrongs mkhan gyi lag dmar gson bzung byas te gson snyi ton/ phyis su log spyod srid gzhung gi mgo gtso la'ang thabs zad de g.yer skyong bstan skyong la spyod chen 'dum rgyu'i re 'dun zhu yig btang bas/ bstan skyong gis thabs la mkhas pa'i sgo nas gyod gzhi 171

'grig par byas/ tshe 'ba' la thabs dang tham ka byin zhing / de nas bzung khos sde tsho skyong ba'i khur bsnams/ /bstan skyong / g.yer skyong gi dpon rabs lnga ba ste/ kho ni rig pa skyen zhing thabs la mkhas pa zhig yin pas/ g.yer skyong mkhas chen zhes pa'i mtshan snyan thob cing / khos dgon gong ma'i phyi nang gi spyod gzhi kha mchu bsdums pa dang / spyo chos sgrub pa sogs sde don gang ci'i thad nas nus pa gal chen bskyed par ma zad/ ko'u ba dgon pa'i lha sde hor mo khag gsum la'ang sngar gyi 'brel rgyun mthud pas/ de tsho'i khrod du ko'u ba'i bstan skyong zhes mtshan grags yod/ /gamar skyong gi dpon rabs drug pa khro kho/ pha tshe 'bas chung dus nas kho la sde mgo skyong ba'i dbang cha sprad cing / khos kyang a khu tshe bo dang dpa' bo rgyal gnyis kyi gzhogs 'degs la brten nas g.yer skyong dang dgon gong ma spyi'i las don la 'bad pa lhod med gnang / 1954lor thun te rdzong mi dmangs srid gzhung gi 'bru snum kha'o yi kha'o krang la bskos/ 1958lo'i dus zing khrod 'dzin bzung byas pa dang / 1981lor nyes pa med pa'i —dkar 'don byas te khrims nas glod 'grol btang / kho yul la thon rjes tsho ba'i nang gi dpal 'byor 'phel rgyas dang rig gnas dar rgyas sogs la rang nus gang yod bton/ khong gi 'go khrid la brten nas g.yer skyong tsho bas bla ma rin po che blo bzang legs bshad rgya mtsho tshang zhus nas pha mes yang mes ring bstad pa'i dgra 'joms lab tse bskyar gso mdzad cing gsol ka rgya chen po gsungs pa dang / yo'u rgya'i ya khu 'jigs blo tshang zhus nas g.yer skyong tsho ba'i chos thog bskyar gso byas shing / gzhan gser lag dgon pa'i rta— mgrin yang gsang gi sku yi sbyin bdag mdzad de sgor khri bzhi lhag zhal 'debs byas/ 1995lor g.yer skyong gis 'gro song yongs rdzogs btang ngos bla ma rin po che g.yer skyong chos pa rin po gdan drangs nas ser skya mang tshogs khri 172

phrag mang por dus 'khor dbang chen gnang pa sogs sde don chen po rnams bsgrubs/ da lta ya khu khro kho lags dgung lo brgyad cur son yod na'ang /da dung sde don la sngar ltar thugs khur gnang bzhin mchis/ /gzhan yang sbra rgan gsang bdag ni 'byor ba dang longs spyod phun sum tshogs pa'i phyug po ya med cig yin pas/ g.yang dkar khri la bud pa'i rten 'brel du khrom (lug byug )rwar dngul dkris brgyab/ kho tshang gi sha bzan 'tsho sa la sha bzan 'phong zhes pa'i sa ming thogs pa da lta'i bar ma 'gyur bar yod/ kho tshang gi sbra la mdzo khal bzhi yod pas g.yer skyong sbra rgan zhes pa yang don thog la bab/ skabs der shar khog tshong ba'i lag nas gshog dkar mo chu'i gnyer ma can dang dme dgu sha zan spul nag sbal ba 'greng 'dra zhes pa'i me mda' gnyis la dngul srang stong re byin nas nyos/ kho'i spun rdo rje ni sngags 'chang chen po zhig yin te/ khong gis bsten pa'i yi dam ni rta mgrin lcags ral nag po yin pa dang / chos skyong ni drang srong chen po rwa hu la yin pas/ de'i gsol ka dur khrod rab 'jig dung gyur phud cing /khong gi chos skyong zhal thang dang mdung nag las me stag 'tshub pa kun gyis mngom sum du mthong / gsang bdag gi bu ni g.yang 'bu ste sbra rgan bo'u chu (me mda' 'phang na gzu bas de ltar btags )yin/ des me bo'u rgyag skabs da lta'i lnga grags me mda' rgyag pa ltar mgyogs la 'ben la phog thub par bshad/ /gzhan dpon po tshe 'ba'i skabs su g.yu skyong rgya kho la'ang phyugs kyis sa zhi khebs shing / g.yang dkar khri la bud de khrom rwa dngul gyis shan pa'i lo rgyus yod/ /de min g.yu skyong gi mi sna grags can ya lags thar shul dang / a lags dgon drungs/ yolags g.yer skyong / dpon jo dmar/ gser lag dgon pa'i dge bskos chen mo blo gros/ bzang po/ sngags 'chang chen 173

po rnam grol/ a khu yi dam/ ba re/ lha chen/ a snyes sngo lo/ bla ma bkra shis/ no'u rgyal/ skyabs rgyal/ rdor lo/ ban de/ tshe 'bum rgyal/ bsod tshe/ dpal lha rgyal/ bstan 'dzin/ klu 'bum/ 'od blo sogs mkhyen ldan gyi bla ma dang / nus ldan gyi sngags 'chang / rtogs ldan gyi grwa ba mang po yod kyang / de dag re re bzhin zhib tu ma spros so/ /lnga ba/ gser lag mtha' ba/ /ma gzhir gser lag mtha' ba ni dgon gong ma'i ྅ nag dang /dpa' mchog yo'u rgya bcas kyi khyim tshang dbul bo skor zhig gis 'tsho ba'i rgyab rten 'tshol ched rgya bza' khri rgan tshang gi sku ring nas bzung snga gzhug tu gser lag sgar mthar yong nas chags pa'i sde ba zhig yin/ kho tshos phyugs 'tsho ba dang shed zog len pa/ dmar las byed pa/ bud shing len pa/ar las rgyag pa sogs kyis dgon pa nas zas gos kyi brgya cha'i brgyad bcu yan chad lon gyi yod pa red/ 1919nas 1949lo'i bar la gser lag mtha' bar phyim tshang 41dang mi grangs 232yod cing / byugs rigs 918yod/ rig 'dzin kha 'khyig zer bas sde dpon lta bu byas par grags/1923lo'i 46nang mā jag gis gser lag dgon par drag gnon byed skabs mtha' ba'i rta po mgo zor dang / dge legs 'bug ma/ chos pa sngo sdang / bstan pa nag rul sogs kyis lag tu gri ring bzung ste/ dgon gong ma'i byung dkar dmag dang mnyam du jag dmag la dpa' ngar sgos dmar 'dzing byas/ 1940yas mas la gtsang ba blo bzang ngag dbang 'azin las rgya mtsho lags nas dbu 'dzin gnang 'og gser lag srib lung gi dzam bha la'i lab tse bstad pa dang / rgya bza' rin po che dang nya nag sku lo rnam gnyis kyis thugs bkod la brten nas sgar mtha'i grwa shags dgu dang a lags brtsi bzhag gi nang chen/ mtha' ba bcas kyis mnyam gcig tu gnyis pa'i bskang gso'i chos thog 'dzin pa'i 'go brtsams/ bcings 174

'grol byas nas1958lor dgon pa bcos bsgyur byed ring bar/ srid—gzhung gis thugs khur dang dgon pas rgyab skyor byas 'og mi phyugs kyi 'phel kha dar te khyim tshang53 gyi mi grangs370la/ phyugs rigs sna tshogs2610yod par gyur/ 1956lo'i lo stod du gser lag mtha' ba'i sde phyed bcings 'grol mnyam las khang la bsgyur nas thun mong du phyugs zhing mnyam gnyer byas/ 1958 lor zing 'khrugs zhod 'jags btang rjes/ mtha' sde ja la dang gser thang gnyis su bcad nas thon skyed ru khag tu bsgyur/ /drug pa/ dgon gong ma'i nywa nag tsho byed mtsho sngon po rkang tshar song tshul bshad pa/ /nywa nag tsho gyed mtsho sngon po'i rkang tsha ru gyes don ni sa 'dir jang mā log spyod srid gzhung gi dpya khral 'u lag sogs kyi mnar gcod mang po byas stabs 'brog pa tsho ha cang dbul bor gyur yod/ skabs der mtsho sngon po'i mtha' 'khor gyi rkang tsha sa khul du mi grangs nyung la rtswa sa che bar ma zad/ tshwa khu'i 'byung khungs kyi tshwa mtsho la'ang thag nye ba'i gnas tshul de nya nag dpon tshang dang 'khyam skor gtso byas pa'i sde dmangs kyis thos pas sa der 'gro 'dod gyi smon pa skyes/ rkang tsha'i dpon po dpal bzang nya nag gi tsha bo yin te/ bla spyon gyi bu nor rgan gyi bu mo dpal bzang gi a ma yin pa'i 'bre bar brten nas/ nor rgan gnam rgyal dang rta dge gnyis kyis 'go drangs te mtsho sngon por 'gro grabs zengs 'ga' byas kyang dgon gong mas bkag nas 'gro ru ma bcug ska sa der ru bshol tshul gyi skor la bshad rgyu mang po yod skad/ rjes su rkang tsha'i dpon po dpal bzang gis bla brang dbon po bstan dar la sde de yong gi chug ces 'azin yig bskur ba la brten nas kho tsho'i re ba mngon 'gyur byung / rab byung bcu drug pa'i me mo glang ste/1937lor dgon gong ma'i spyi ba'i dge bskos rta dge dang nor rgan rnam rgyal gnyis kyis nywa nag dpon tshang gi skya yas dang / pa pa/ dge bskos/175

bon ne/ dge 'dun/ bzod pa/ don rgyal sogs khyim tshang bcu gcig gi mi lnga bcu lhag khrid de/ rma chu'i byang phyogs brgyud nas rkang tsha'i stong dpon chen mo dpal bzang lags la mgo bcol zhu bar song / kho tsho lam skabs nas rnga thang rtsi kor thang du ha lam zla ba bcu lhag bsdad pa dang / de nas rkang tsha'i dpon pos khong gi bsrung dmag gcig dang ྅ nag so ma'i snying thar gnyis la lag skyes dang bcas te bsu bar mngags pa dang 'grogs nas mtsho rnga'i nywa nag so ma'i ru nang du yong / de ru lo gnyis bsdad rjes dpon po dpal bzang gi bka' lung ltar mtsho nyin gyi ha dger ru spos/ /rab byung bcu drug pa'i sa yos ( 1939)lor bla ma hre bos mgo — bcings nas/ nya nag 'khyam skor gyi ban de dang / shākya/ rig 'ba'/'od gsal/ bstan ne/ phur ba/ thub pa/ gnam po/ phur dros/snying dkar bcas khyim tshang skor zhig dang / lcags mo sbrul (1941)lor yang ba lo dang nam mkha' gsum kyis ྅ nag 'khyam skor dang dpon tshang gnyis kha'i khyim tshang bzhi bcu rtsa 'ga' khrid de mtsho sngon por song / de'i rjes su yang nya nag gi khyim tshang gcig re gnyis re byas nas1949lo'i bar mtsho sngon por 'gro mtshams ma bzhag spyi lo1941lo'i hor zla brgyad par nya nag ba lo sogs kyis khrid pa'i ru skor bu ha chu bo'i 'gram rgyud du thon skabs der stong dpon dpal bzang gis kho'i nu bo dgra lo dang g.yang rung blo gros sogs 'thus tshab tu mngags nas dga' bsu byas par ma zad/ rkang tsha'i mi dang khal ma rtsa 'dzugs byas te ha dge sa khul bar du skyel ma byas/ /ru skor de ha dger thon rjes stong dpon dpal bzang dngos su phebs nas bsu chang dang gos dar sogs khyer te btsan gdong na yod pa'i nor rgan rnam rgyal tshang nas dga' bsu byas shing / snga gzhug tu yong ba'i nywa nag gi ru skor rnams la jag rkus 'khyam gsum byas mi chog pa dang / ri skyes srog chags kyi rigs gcig kyang bsad mi chog pa/ sa rko rdo slog gi rigs la /76

gzab dgos pa/ chos la dad cing bla ma dang rgan pa sde dpon tsho dpon sogs chen po rnams la bkur dgos tshul sogs kyi 'grig lam nan bshad dang bcas/ ha dge chu bo dang tsha la chu bo'i 'gram rgyud/ dzong sko/ tsha la thang / ra 'khyog lab tse/ tong par/ sna nag sdang bcas kyi rtswa sa'i bdag dbang sprad de rkang tsha tsho sgo drug dang skyid sdug gcig par byas pa bka' yis bsgrags/ nya nag ba lo stong dpon gyi lag rogs par (yongs grags su dpon po'i mi sna zer )blangs pa dang / nam mkha' tsho dpon du bskos/ba lo dang / bu lo/ bla ma gsum gyis khyigs bdag khur/ 1953lor tsho dpon nam mkha'i bu gnyis snga gzhug tu tshe las 'das nas khor sems sdug che ba'i khar/ lo tshod yang mtho bas tsho dpon bu los khur/ kho'i tshab tu gsang bdag khyigs bdag la bskos/ 1946nas1950lo'i bar gyi lo bzhi'i nang snga phyir thengs gnyis la dgon gong ma'i nywa nag dpon po chos 'byor (ban de )dang bla ma sku lo gnyis kyis dgon pa dang sde ba'i tshab byas te mtsho sngon po'i rkang tshar phebs nas phu nu tsho phyir pha yul la log dgos tshul kyi kha ta mang po byas kyang / rkang tsha'i dpon po dang sde dmangs thams cad kyis kho tshor ru yong gi lta tshul mi 'dzin par phyogs gang ci'i thad nas bdag skyong byas pa bzang tshul bshad nas phyir ma yong / 1954lor rkang tsha dgon gyi tsho dpon nam mkha' lha sar gnas mjal 'gro ba'i lam bar nas 'das/ba los snga gzhug tu rkang tsha rdzong mi dmangs u yon lha na khang gi u yon dang na rin chi srid gzhung gi yu yon sogs kyi 'gan bzhes snyong / 1985lor tshe las 'das/ /bcings 'grol yar sngon la rkang tsha'i dgon gong ma tsho bar khyigs —bdag gcig dang khyigs g.yog gsum yod de/ kho tshos dus rgyun tsho dpon la gagogs 'degs byas te tsho ba'i las don mtha' dag bdag skyong byed/khyigs bdag 'khur yun ni lo gsum re yin/ /117

1949 lor rkang tsha sa khul zhi bas bcings 'grol thob cing /1950lo'i dbyid gar rkang tsha dgon gong ma'i ban de tshur nag gis dpon po dpal bzang gi tshab byas te lan krig tu song nas mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag la dga' bsu byas pa dang / de'i rjes nas kho mtsho sngon zhing chen gyi grangs nyung mi rigs lta skor tshogs pa'i nang zhugs te pe cin sogs nang logs kyi sa khul mang por lta skor tu song / kho phyir thon rjes phyugs las mnyam las khang du bsgyur ba'i sngon thon mi snar gyur/ /1956lor rkang tsha dgon tsho bas phyugs las mnyam las khang btsugs pa des dzong yongs la mig dpe'i nus pa thon/ thub pas mnyam las khang gi hre krang gi 'gan khur/ skabs der tsho ba yongs la dud tshang180lhag yod/1958lor tsho ming rkang tsha phyugs las mnyam las khang dang por bsgyur/1966lor ming de yang hrin las thon skyed ru chen du bsgyur/ 1983lor sde ming slar yang dgon gong ma zhes su bsgyur/dgon gong ma'i nywa nag tsho ba mtsho sngon po rkang tshar chad nas lo ngo drug cu lhag gi ring la mi phyugs kyi 'phel kha legs pas da lta dud tshang 250lhag dang mi grangs 1400lhag yod par phyugs rigs sna tshogs 84000lhag la 'phel yo da/ sa rgya mu'u khri tsho nye shu lhag yod cing / mi re'i cha snyoms yong sgo sgor 1385 yin/ deng skabs sde ba 'dir khul rim pa'i las byed pa gcig dang / dzong rim pa'i las byed pa gnyis/ rgyal khab kyi las byed pa phal ba nyer gcig bcas yod/mtsho sngon po'i dgon gyi mi chen dag gi gnas tshul bshad na/ nor rgan rnam rgyal la bu ma skyes par bla rgan sring mo dpa' mtsho bo dod du blangs/de la bang stag gong ma nas dbang phyug zer ba zhig mag par bzhag nas bu mo gcig skyes/ de la bu kun bzang skyes/ de la bu rnam rgyal dang chos 'bum rgyal gnyis skyes/ 1945yas mas la nor rgan rnam rgyal tshe las 'das/ /178

ba lor bu bsas lo dang / che lo/ bkra lo/ lung rtogs bzhi yod pa dang / bsas lor bu stag wa dang / don grub/ bstan 'dzin gsum yod/ lung rtogs la bu dka' thub dang / rta mgrin gnyis yod/ /nya nag rta dge'i shul 'dzin mkhan la kho'i nu bo no tho'i bu lha rgyal yod/ /bu lo'i bu ni dpal mgon thar dang / de'i bu ni bsod nams tshe ring /de'i bu ni mkhar 'bum mo/ /bla ma hre bo'i bu ni dpal 'bum rgyal dang ban 'gro gnyis dang / nam mkha'i bu ni ba rgya dang / dar rgyas/ lcags lo gsum yin la/ ba rgya la bu dpa' rtse dang / do rdo/ chos 'byor gsum yod/ /bcings 'grol byas rjes kyi lo lnga bcu'i ring la snga gzhug tu thub pa dang bla rgan/ bzod pa/ klu skyabs/ lung togs/ lung rig sgro le/'brug 'bum rgyal/ bsen kho/ stobs ldan rgyal/ pad+ma rgyal/ rin chen sogs kyis ru chen dang ru chung gi 'gan khur khur/ /bdun pa/ mcho zon zhing chen phyugs las thing gi 'cho rtswa 'debs 'dzugs ra ba na yod pa'i yo'u rgya cho ba'i khyem tshang skor zhig gi gnas tshul/ /1967lor srid gzhung gi brkad sgrig ltar shes rab bzang po tshang dang /a rga tshang / dkon mchog tshang / dbu rdo tshang / dbyig gnyen tshang /'phrin bzang tshang / rang grol tshang / bsod dbang tshang / u de tshang /lhun grub tshang bcas khyim tshang bcu dang / mi grangs29de skabs der lan krig dmag khul gyi dmag rta ra ba yin pa der song nas phyugs 'tsho mkhan byas/da lo (2000lo )khyim tshang 34dang mi grangs 161la 'phel yod/ de'i nang du ched sbyong 'bring rim slob grwa'i mthar phyin 'dzin yig yo da pa1dang bcas las byed pa dang / rlangs 'khor kha lo ba 7dang bcas las bzo ba 52 slob 179
ma 18bcas yod/ /da lta kho tsho'i rgyun ldan gyi zla re'i cha snyom yong sgo ni sgor 400lhag yin la/yong sgo ches mang ba ni sgor 1200lhag dang ches nyung ba ni sgor 250yin/ /180

le'u lnga ba/dgon gong ma'i tsho ba'i sgrig gzhi/ /dang po/ tsho ba'i sgrig gzhi /dgon gong ma'i mi rgyud ni reb gong ko'u sde'i pha gro lo nas chad pa yin pas da lta tsho rteng ba'i yod pa'i sde chen la gyur ba'i skabs 'di la'ang tshang mas sngar gyi mes po'i 'brel ba de la bsam nas sbra ka mgo gcig nas gyes pa'i phu nu yin zer/ yin 'ang / da lta'i tsho ba dang sde ba'i gnas tshul ni dang thog gi sha nye'i 'brel bar gzhi byas nas chags pa las 'gyur ldog byung ste/mes po gcig la bu rabs tsha rgyud mang du 'phel ba las rim bzhin sha khrag gi 'brel thag de je ring du gyur nas/ spyir btang bod mis gnag tshan bdun gyi bar tu sha nye'i 'brel bar brtsi ba de las ches cher brgal yod pa red/der ma zad tsho ba 'phel ba'i lo rgyus khrod du tsha zhang dang / ru yong / mgo btags/ kha 'byar sogs gzhan sde'i khongs gtogs nas yong ba'i mi khyim yang mi nyung ba zhig yod pas na/ da lta'i dgon gong ma'i khongs mi rnams ni mes po gcig kho na las brgyud pa yin pa'i nges pa med/ spyir tsho ba 'phel ba'i dus nges can zhig la thon na de'i gdod ma'i ngo bo 'gyur te sngar gyi nye du'i 'brel ba las rim bzhin srid gzhung gi zus pa can du 'gyur ba de bzhin du/ dgon gong ma'i tsho sde la'ang de 'dra'i nus pa ldan zhes zer mi chog pa'ang med snyam ste/ khong mi rnams la tsho sde zhes pa'i rgyab brten sa zhig yod na/ dgra btsan por thug dus dpung rogs yod pa dang / las khag por 'phrad dus rgyab rogs yod pa zhig yin te/ gal te su zhig la sde ba tsho ba 18

zhes pa'i rgyab brten sa zhig med na/ de 'dug thabs 'grig dka' ba ni kun gyis shes nges yin/ de bzhin du mi su zhig sde ba tsho ba'i gras nas bsdad na rang rang gis kyang thun mong gi 'os 'gan nges can re 'khur dgos te/ brgya la khongs mi zhig gis thun mong gi 'gan khur ma khur ba'am sde don la gnod pa'i bya ba sgrub na des chad pa nges can yang 'khur dgos pa red/tsho sdes phyi dgra 'gog pa'am nang gi 'tsho ba dang / thon skyed/ chos lugs bya 'gul/ 'grig lam gtan 'bebs dang lag bstar sogs bya ba thams cad kyi spyi mgo 'dzin thub par ma zad/ phyi nang gang rung gi gnad don thag gcod byed pa de la srid gzhung gi nus pa thon pa zhes bshad chog de lta bu'i tsho ba'i 'phel tshad la thon na sha nye las sbra sgo gtso ste/ rgyu mtshan ni mi ru sde ru dīshāhā / sgyu ṭ+wāṃspra /rje / r+shaXs 1 ༵dra dīṭ+wāṃ / rje ṭ+wāsdu ṭ+wāsdi /ci/ ga / ṭ+wāṃ bhe hūṃṭ+wā 'du shes 'dzin pa red/ dper na/ 'jam skor gyi mi rabs snga ba'i nang na lug gu'am ban rgan zer ba gang yin pa zhig ma gzhir sog phyogs kyi ru yong ba yin mod/ 'on kyang / dpa' mchog lha dges de gnyis sbra sgor blangs nas skyid sdug gcig ltar byas pas/ dpa' mchog 'jam skor kyi mi dngos mar gyur pa red/ de la rjes su 'jam skor mkhas ring gis nga lha dge lu gu ban rgan gsum/ rwa gser mig thod pa'i dkyil nas skyes zhes rang gi mes po ngom so byas par grags pa de las/ dpa' mchog gi mes po rdo rje khro lu'i gdung rgyud ngo ma yin pa'i lha dge dang ru yong de gnyis la lta tshul gcig 'dra 'dzin pa shes thub/ de las sdog ste sha nye yin kyang gzhan du song na sde tsho gcig gi lta tshul mi 'dzin de/ dper na/ dpa' mchog lha dge'i sring mo zhig la grags pa bzur ru dang / ma rgya lcags tho/ ban de rgyal rte'u lu sogs skyes rjes mo rang mag pas khrid de so nag la ru song bas/ phyis su la las de dag gi rjes rabs pa phyi la bcad de so nag byi li khyod tsho/ ra tho 182

lu ko ba'i khug nas 'bur/ nyis lug khrom la mi 'jog tsha zhang dpon la mi bkur/ zhes bshad par grags pa lta bu red/ gzhan dgon gong ma'i khrod na ya rig gi shul chen bco brgyad kyi nang gses sman shul gyi ru skor zhig kyang yod mod/ de dag dgon gong ma'i phu nu min zhes su zhig gis kyang phyi la mi gcod do/ gsham du gong nas bshad pa ltar gyi 'phel rgyas kyi go rim nges can zhig la thon yod pa'i dgon gong ma 'di'i sgrig gzhi'am grub tshul zhib mor bshad par bya ste/ /(1) phastengag da dung pha 'og (ha yog )dang sbra kha zerapol yang yod/ de ni tsho sde'i nang gi ches gzhi rim du gyur ba'i skor khag cig yin te/ rtsa ba'i khyad chos ni pha gcig gi bu rnams dang gnas la ma song ba'i bu mo dag gi 'brel ba yin/de dag chung dus khyim gcig nas sdod kyang / cher skyes nas gnyen bsgrigs te logs su sbra phub rjes sbra kha tsho'am sbra rgan spre'u tshe zhes pa'i ming 'dogs pa red/ de dus dpal 'byor thad nas spyi la dbang ba nas so sor gcod pa'i 'go tshugs mod/ 'on kyang / so so'i khe phan gyi thad nas da dung gzhi gcig gi bsam blo 'dzin pa red/ dper na/ pho las thams cad gyes pa tsho'i bar nas las bgos byas te sgrub pa dang / mo las thams cad skyes ma tsho'i bar nas las bgos byas te sgrub pa lta bu red/ 'brog phyogs kyi dus tshugs dang rtswa sar bstun nas rgyun du ru spor dgos ba'i thon skyed byed stangs dang / spyi tshogs kyi dmu rgod pas rgyun du gsod 'phrog dang btsan gnon la gzab dgos pa la pha rteng gi 'brel de ni med du mi rung zhig yin te/ dgra yong na mdung mo mnyam 'dzin/ mgron yong na sder kha mnyam sgrig ces pa'i thun mong gi dpung stobs la ma brten na 'tsho gnas byed rgyu r+shan tu dka' ba sus kyang shes/ pha gcig gi bu rabs tsha rgyud rnams mang por 'phel na dpal 'byor thog nas so so kher rkyang ma byas thabs med yin kyang /183

ming la da dung pha rteng 'dogs pa mi 'gyur bar khyim tshang gcig gi mi ltar mthun sgril byed pa red/ 'brel ba de ma mtha' yang mi rabs bdun gyi bar rgyun skyong la/ de'i bar tu pha rteng nang nas gnyen sgrig byed pa gtan 'gog byed cing / 'dun sgo stong tho skyes lha sogs gcig las tha dad med pa red/ mi rabs de las kyang mang por song rjes phal cher tsho ba'i dus skabs la thon pa red/ /(2)sgru sgo/ /sbra sgo ni gong nas bshad pa'i sbra kha dang cung zad mi 'dra ste/ sbra kha yin na khyim tshang gcig nas gyes pa'i srun mched ming sring dag gi 'brel ba yin shag shag yin kyang / sbra sgo yin na de 'dra'i nges pa med/ spyir btang du tsho ba gcig gi khyim tshang yod tshad sbra sgo yin par 'dod na'ang mi chog rgyu med de/ gsal por bshad na gnag tshan bdun gyi bar ram 'dun sgo —gcig pa thams cad sbra sgo yin/ de la gnas tshul gzhan zhig yod pa ni sru sgo'i nang mi'i bar phan tshun sha nye min kyang / mi ga ge mo pa zhig sbras ded na nged tshang gi yin zhes rgyun du bshad pa thos pa des/ sha nye min kyang sbra sgos nye ring 'ded chog pa de shes thub/ 'on kyang / de la gsham gyi cha rkyen dag nges par ldan dgos te/ khyim tshang zhig la rang gi bu rgyud ma byung bar bu dod kyis khyim bskyangs pa dang gcig rkyen glo bur bas dbang gis khyim mi yongs rdzogs shul chad nas mi gzhan gyis sru la bdag byas pa dang gnyis/mgon skyob dpung gnyen du btsal nas yong ba'i mi gzhan pa dang gsum bcas yin/ sbra sgo'i bar la sbra'i gzhi ma ste sbra rgan la tshang ma'i brtsi 'jog byed dgos te/ sru rgan gyi rgan po de ni tshang ma'i blo 'dri sa dang don dag thams cad la kha 'bud mkhan yin / gal srid rgan po de tshe las 'das pa'am dbang bos mi sgogs na/ ru skor du de'i zhol na lo su mtho bas kha 'bud mkhan byed dgos pa red/ spyir ri skor nang lo mtho bar rgan bkur /84

gyi cha nas brtsi 'jog byed dgos par ma zad/ der khongs mi rnams la mgo 'dzin dang kho tsho'i bya spyod la tshod 'dzin pa'i dbang cha yod pas kyang nges par bkod sgrig dang len byed dgos pa red/ /( 2)rusgor/ /ru skor ni phyi tshul nas bltas na ru 'bab phyogs kho na nas btags pa 'dra yang / don dam du ru skor byed mi byed de gang 'dod byed pa zhig min te/ des rtswa sa dang 'tsher sa la khag bgos nges can yod pa de brtsi dgos par ma zad/ phal cher ru skor byed pa thams cad la 'brel ba nges can med mi srid de/ de'i nang na pha rteng gcig gi sha nye rnams yod par ma zad/skabs 'gar tsha zhang gi phyogs dang / sna sa gang bzang btsal nas 'gro ba'i mi rkyang / 'tsho ba'i rgyab rten bsnyegs pa'i dbul bo/ de min bzang sa dang mna' bcad/ sde gzhan nas spyod la thug nas yong ba sogs yod/der brten/ ru skor kyi khongs mi rnams sha nye yin min gnyis ka yod kyang /kho tsho'i bar na 'tsho ba'i dka' ngal sel rogs dang / phan tshun bar phyugs 'tsho skyong / ru 'gel spor/ bal len rtswa 'breg sogs thon skyed thad kyi rogs res yod par ma zad/ gnyen ston dang shi bo'i dge rtsa sgrub pa sogs kyi skabs su'ang khag khur mnyam len byed pa dang / dgra jag dang rang byung gnod 'tshe mnyam 'gog byed pa lta bu'i 'brel ba dam po yod pa red/'brel ba de dag ni ru skor gnas pa'i rtsa ba'i rgyu rkyen yin te/ brgya la kho tsho'i bar gyi 'brel ba gang rung zhig la 'thus shor byung na ru skor yang 'thor sla ba red/ dper na/ ru skor kyi khyim tshang zhig gi la lo jag pas ded na ra mdar 'gro grogs ma byas pa'am/ yang na gnyen ston gyi skabs su ston skal dang mag skag ma byin pa/ ru 'gel rogs dang khal ma ma g.yar sogs kyi don rkyen ni ru skor mi 'grig pa'i rgyu ru 'gro zhing / mu mthud nas ru skor byed min yang mi shes pa red/ spyir btang du mi rgyug po dang / gtam 185

bshad gyod bshad la mkhas pa/ dpa' snying dang dgra rus yod pa/ gzhan don la sha tsha zhing mi mang la mgo bsdu byed pa'i blo bkod mnga' ba zhig yin na rgyun par mtha' 'khor tu ru skor mang po 'du sla zhing / ma bskul rang 'gul gyis dpon por bkur nas rtsa 'dzugs dang las bcol dang du len/ dpon byang sems can la mi sde 'khor/ zhes pa'i glu tshig cig yod pas tag tag don de'i gnas lugs gsal bshad byas/ ru skor ni pha rteng dang sbra sgo lta bu'i gtan chags shig min mod/ 'on kyang / de nyid tsho ba sde ba dang dpon po 'byung ba'i ru ma lta bur gyur yod/ de nyid gtan chags shig min pa'i rgyu rkyen ni khongs mi rnams la rang dbang yod pa'i stabs yin/ dper na/ mi rkyang zhig yin na sna sa bzang gi bsam na ru skor nas 'dug 'dod pa dang mi bzang gi bsam na gzhan gyi sar 'gro ba rang dbang yin pa dang /dbul bo zhig yin na 'tsho ba'i rgyab rten la re chog na 'dug pa dang re ma chog na gzhan du 'gro ba/ gzhan gyi gyod pa zhig yin na rgyab rtsa 'pher bar bsam na 'dug pa dang / mi 'pher bar bsam na mgon skyob gzhan nas btsal chog pa lta bu red/ ru skor de sde ba dang dpon po'i 'byung rtsa yin pa ni dngos gnas mi khyad du 'phags pa zhig yin na dri ldan me tog rgyang ring yang / bung ba sprin gyi tshogs bzhin 'du zhes pa lhar rgyab dpung du btsal mkhan mang po byung ste srid gzhung gi byed nus yod pa'i tsho sde ma chags rang chags su 'gro'o/ /(4)ruskoranas cho bar bar bags byas pa/ /gong gi pha ting dang sbra sgo ni tsho ba chags pa'i grub cha zhig tu 'gro srid mod/ de'i rgyu rkyen gtso bor mi 'gyur la/ tsho ba thub byed kyi rgyu rkyen gtso bo ni ru skor yin par sems/ rgyu mtshan ni ru skor la bkur sa'i dpon po dang bkur mkhan gyi 'bangs mi gnyis char nas byung yod pa'i stabs kyis te/mi dbang sdud can gyis kha 'dzin byed pa'i gzhung shing zhig chags pa na de la 186

'brel ba'i yal 'dabs rgyas thub bo/ yang kha cig gis pha rteng dang sbra sgo'i nang gi rgan po dag kyang kha chen dbang chen yin pas de tshor gzhung shing gi nus pa med dam zer na/ de la khyad par yod de/ pha rting sbra sgo'i lo lon dang khongs mi'i bar kyi 'brel ba ni pha pha khu dang bu tsha bo'i 'brel ba kho na yin pas/ kho tshos 'go 'dzin kha bsgo byed pa'ang khyim tshang gi las don la gtso bor bsam pa'i sger don yin/ mi dbang sdud can dang khongs mi'i bar gyi 'brel ba ni nye ring gi 'brel ba las kyang gtso che ba ni bdag po dang lag grogs kyi 'brel ba dang / byugs bdag dang phyugs dzi'i 'brel ba/ dmag dpon dang dmag mi'i 'brel ba/ blo 'don pa dang dang len byed mkhan gyi 'brel ba sogs yin pas/ des rtsa 'dzugs dang 'go 'dzin byed pa'i dmigs yul gtso bo'ang khongs mi yongs kyi spyi don yin/ yin na'ang /pha rting dang sbra sgo'i nang gi lo lon tsho'i skad chas tsho dpon bkur mi bkur dang kho'i bkod sgrig brtsi mi brtsi la 'brel ba tshen po yod de/ dgon gong ma'i lo rgyus thog tsho dpon gyis phyogs ris bzung ba dang sger don gnyer ba sogs kyi dbang gis lo lon tsho'i blo la ma bab par brje spor byas pa'i gnas tshul yang byung myong ba ltar red/ tsho ba ni 'pho 'gyur 'byung ba'i dus skabs shig la gnas de/ khongs mi je mang dang sha nye'i 'brel thag je ring bcas su 'gro bzhin yod/ tsho ba byung pa'i thog ma'i dus su stong sgo gcig yin par ma zad/ khongs mi'i nang la gnyen lam med cing 'dun sgo yang gcig yin/de ni tsho ba'i nang du sha nye'i 'brel thag da dung thag nye ba'i rkyen yin te/rim bzhin mi rabs brjes nas 'brel ba sna tshogs thag je ring du song rjes/'dun sgo mi gcig pa dang gnyen lam yang yod par 'gyur/ de dus tsho ba'i nang du 'brel thag cung ring ba'i pha rteng dang sbra sgo du ma yod par 'gyur la/de dag kyang ru skor du mar chad nas tsho chung du 'gyur pa'i mgo rtsom/ dper na/ o'u rgya la mtshon na sa 'dir yong ma thag pa'i skabs tsho ba gcig yin 187
