kyang / phyis su mi rgyud 'phel te sgar ba dang sngags nag gong ma sogs tsho chung du gyes shing / bla rgan tshang la mtshon na'ang dus rabs 'di'i lo rabs sum bcu ba'i nang tsho'u zhes can po dang rig 'dzin can po'i ri skor gnyis byung ste/ tsho chung gnyis su 'gyur grabs byas/ de min dgon gong ma'i tsho ba so so'i nang du gdugs skor dang / ri nag tshang / dbu bsa'/ zur tshang / gdong zhing / shing skor/ klog nung / hor gdong sogs ru skor mang po zhig 'byung bzhin pa de yang tsho ba gsar du 'byung ba'i snga ltas red/ /(5)cho ba nas cho sder bar brgal byas pa/sa cha rgya bskyed dang khyad par tu phyi dgra 'gog par dpung shugs dgos pa'i skabs su tsho ba gcig gi stobs shugs chung drag pas/ tsho ba du ma zhig mnyam 'brel byas na da gzod rang bsrung dang gzhan gol gang byed dgos kyang stobs med par sems khur byed mi dgos pa red/ mtsho sngon 'brog khul gyi tsho sde chags pa'i gnas tshul la gzhigs na sngar gyi nye 'brel la gzhi byas nas tsho sde chags pa dang / tsho ba stobs ldan la mgo btags nas tsho sde chags pa/ sa cha'i 'dug gnas kyi sgo nas tsho sde chags pa/ srid gzhung gis 'chang pe hu'i( za )go gnas sprad de tsho sde chags pa sogs kyi rgyu rkyen mi 'dra ba du ma yod kyang / reb gong lo rgyus lta ba mkha' khyab phyogs bral 〉las byung ba ltar gyi dgon gong ma'i gnas tshul la bltas na gong gi rgyu rkyen dang po dang gsum par mazun la/ rgyu rkyen gnyis pa'ang cung zad yod pa red/ dang thog ko'u sde nas nub phyogs su 'gro mkhan ni dpa' mchog kho na yin te/ kho tsho sgo gong ma'i mi rgyud yin pa'i cha nas dgon gong ma zhes pa'i ming yang bzung yod pa red/ gle ba ni dpa' mchog gi kha 'byar tsho ba yin pa dang / phyis su ko'u sde'i ut+pal rgyal mtshan gyi gdung sgyud yo'u rgyas dpa' mchog la pha spun gyi 'brel ba bzung nas nub phyogs su yong pa dang /188

nywa nag dang g.yer skyong gi nang du dpa' mchog la tsha zhang gi 'brel ba bzung nas yong ba yang yod pa/ sman shul gyis sde mthun gyi 'azel ba bzung nas yong ba bcas yin/ sa cha'i 'dug gnas kyi sgo nas dpa' mchog ni gzhi sa 'dzin gyi tsho ba yin la/ ga na dag ni kha bsnan gyi tsho ba yin pas tsho sde'i ming yang sngon gyi dgon gong ma sor bzhag byas/ stobs che chung gi thad nas bltas na dpa' mchog la bu rta mang pa dang rgyu 'byor ba yang cung che bas dgon gong ma'i spyi dpon phal cher dpa' mchog gi nang nas byung / de ltar dgon gong ma'i tsho sde grub rjes nang khul la gnyen sgrig gi lam yod pa dang /'dun sgo mi gcig pa/ rang rang gi mchod pa'i gzhi bdag dang bstod pa'i la tse yod pa/ rab byung bcu drug pa'i shing khyi (1934)lor/ khyigs dpon rta re dang yo'u rgya'i rab brtan mdzu gu gnyis kyis rdung res byas te gyod la chad par rkyen byas nas dgon gong mas spyi bsrung mnyam du 'dzin pa yang mtshams bzhag ste tsho ba khag rang rang gis bzung / de nas bzung dgon gong ma yongs kyi stong sgo yang mi gcig par gyur ba dang / 1947 lor spyi khyab pe hu( tshotshophyozob)bo bos dpa' mchog nang khul gyi tsho chung so so'i bar du yang stong sgo mi gcig par byas pa des tsho sde'i ngo bor yang 'pho 'gyur gsar ba byung ba mtshon/ /da ni dgon gong ma'i ming la tsho sde zer dgos pa'i don la gsal bshad cung zad byed de/ spyir tsho zhes par nye 'azel gyi don yod pa dang de la bdag po'i sgra ba sbyar na sha nye ba'i mi'i skor tshogs shig gam shog kha zhig la gosde ba ni sa gnas kyi 'dug phyogs dang srid 'dzin gyi bgo stangs yin pa las/sha nyes ded yod tshul de 'dra mi gsal/ de bzhin du dgon gong ma'i nang du sngar gyi nye 'brel gyi 'du shes de ni kun gyi sems la gnas pa dang mthun sgril gros 'grig yong ba'i cha rkyen du 'gyur bzhin pa dang / phyogs gcig nas bshad na sha khrag gi 'brel ba ring du song yod pa'ang don dngos yin pas ming 189

de ltar btags na 'grig gam snyam/ /gnyis pa/ cho sde'i dpon po'i3ma pa/ /( 1) 'chang nyi ( ba )'chang nyi ni stong dpon gyi don yin de/ mtsho sngon 'brog khul la yon rgyal rabs kyi skabs nas bzung go gnas de 'dra zhig ster srol yod par bshad/ yin na yang / dgon gong ma'i ta ming 'chang nyi (ma shā ba)zer srol la bltas na/ ming rgyal rabs skabs kyi stong dpon lam lugs kyi rgyun bskyangs ba ye min snyam/ kha cig gis dgon gong ma'i stong dpon dang po hwa nag sangs rgyas skam po dang gnyis pa dpa' mchog chos lo yin zer yang / yang kha cig gis de gnyis gyis tsho dpon gyi go gnas las stong dpon khur ma myong / stong dpon ngo ma ni dpa' mchog dpon po dge 'dun yin zer/ yang kha cig gis mā chis gser lag brgyab rjes dgon gong ma hor gyi khongs gtogs nas blangs te bla brang dbon po'i dbang 'og la 'jog skabs/dpa' mchog tshul dbang la dgon gong ma'i ta min 'chang hu'i thob thang dang /྅ nag rig lo dang / dpa' mchog bstan dar/ yo'u rgya'i rdor skyabs/g.yer skyong tshe 'ba' bzhi bor pe hu'i (zab)thob thang byin pa de ni dgon gong mar 'chang pe hu'i lam lugs dar ba'i thog ma yin zer/ bshad tshul rjes ma gzhi byas pa'i ta min 'chang hu tshul dbang gi lo rgyus cung tsam bshad na/ tshul dbang ni chung dus nas dpa' la 'thab ya dang gyod la bshad ya med pa'i mi dpa' blo gnyis 'dzoms shig yin par grags te/ 1920 lo yas mas la dpa' mchog chos lo tshong lam nas ru ngan mtshal nag gis bsad pa'i snying nad la tshul dbang gis dpa' mchog gi dmag khrid nas nga glag tshang tsher ma'i ra la brgyugs/ mi khrag rta khrag la bsres/ rta khrag ka ran klu chur bsres/ zhes pa'i dpa' rtags rjes rabs par gleng rgyu yod pa bzhag190

1924lor mā chi yis tshul dbang la dpa' yod pa der rkyen byas nas dgon gong ma dang mgar rtse'i ta min 'chang hu'i cho lo sbyar/ 1930 yas mas la mgar rtses sog po bang ya ma tshang gi rta ded de mā chi la zhu gtugs byas rjes/mā chi nas tshul dbang la khyod dgon gong ma dang mgar rtse gnyis ga'i dpon po yin pas/ nges par tu rta ded pa phyir sprod du 'jug dgos zhes bshad par/ tshul dbang gis sog po dang nged phyogs rgyad ya rnying ba yin/ pho gyod pha bong rgas rgyu med/ mo kyod shug pa rul rgyu med/ rta ded pa gtan nas phyir mi sprod/ sprod dgos na nga yi mgo bo byin chog de ma gtogs ster rgyu med ces par/ mā chis khyod kyi bshad pa de bden nam zhes dris pa la/ ngo ma yin zhes ske bstan nas bsdad/ de nas mā chis khyod bod kyi bu bzang po zhig red zer nas gzengs bstod du sngar gyi go sa'i thog si lin (tha )zhig gi thabs bsnan par grags/1936 lor mā chi dang mā pu t+pang pha bus thun te'i dzong dpon zhan gar sdang brgyud de dgon gong ma'i mi ming can rta re dang bo bo'u gnyis zi ling du bos/ skabs der po bo'u lus phung la mi bde ba zhig byung nas 'gro ma thub par rta re gcig pos 'tshams rtags khyer de zi ling du song / rta re zi ling la 'byor rjes mā pu h+phang srid gzhung gis nyin gsum ring sde len ston mo byas pa dang / mā pu t+pang dngos kyis thug 'phrad byas te rgyal nang gi ri 'gog gnas tshul dang 'go ba rnams phyir log rjes sde mgo bzang por bcang dgos tshul sogs kyi gtam bshad/ rta re zi ling la song ba'i thengs der dgon gong mi'i ta min 'chang hu'i thabs dang tham ka sprad nas phyir log rta re ni mi dbang sdud can zhig yin pa dang gyod bshad la shin du mkhas pas sde phyi nang gi gyod gzhi mang po 'dum 'grig byas shing / mi shi rta 'gyel gyi spyod gzhi chen po kho na yang drug tsam bshad nas 'grig par byas/ yin na'ang /khos 'chang hu'i go gnas lo gsum la ma gtogs ma bsdad par dpon sa nas 1rgya1

bab/ de'i rgyu rkyen ni kho'i bu blo bstan gyi bshad pa ltar na/ 194)lor mā pu t+pang jag dmag gis gtsang dgon pa rgyag skabs/ dmag spyi gtsang zi lin gyis khri ka nas dmag don mkho rdzas mang po dbor 'dren byed pa'i 'gan khur de dgon gong mar sprad pa ma khur stabs/ gtsang zi lin gyis kho'i bka' ma brtsis par ma dga' bar rta re bsrus nas gsod grabs byas/don de rta re'i bzang sa za lar 'ur za zer ba zhig gis gdams pas/ rta re myur bar zi ling la song nas mā pu h+phang la gnang ba zhus te dpon sa nas bab zer/ kho'i pha bstan dar gyi skabs nas bzung tsho ba gcig pa'i a khu mkhas ring la mi 'grig kyang / bu blo bstan gyi skabs su phan tshun nang mthun byung / 1958lo'i ston khar dpa' mchog rta re la mnyam las khang la rgyab skyor dang zing 'khrug sngon 'gog gi byas rjes yod na'ang 'dzin bzung thebs pa dang / btson du 'dug ring rtsa ba'i bla ma sku gzhogs gtsang rgan tshang la ngo rgol byed dgos par bskul ba dang len ma byas stabs gcar rdung 'khel zhing / bza' btung ngan ngon spyod rgyu'ang mtshams bzhag pas zla bcu ba'i nang tshe 'di dang gtan bral byas/ kho tshe las 'da' skabs lo re brgyad yin/ /1941 lor dgon gong ma'i brgya jus thog nas rgan po tsho gcig mthun gyis dpa' mchog bo bo'u dgon gong ma'i spyi dpon du bkur ba dang / mā pu t+pang srid gzhung gis kho la dgon gong ma spyi'i pe hu zhes pa'i thob thang byin/bo bo'u ni dema'adra'i gtam bshad mkhan zhig min kyang tshig la chod yod cing ldir bshad tshig thog nas sgul med du 'dug thub pa/ dgra 'thab na dpa' ngar che 'ing bo'u 'phang na shin tu skyen pa zhig yin te/ dper na/ rta 'ded jag pas kho rang rmas de lo gsum la ma drag pa'i skyin par/ spyod ya'i ru nang la brgyugs nas kho rang rmas su 'jug mkhan de bsad pa dang da dung mi gzhan pa gcig rmas su bcug nas phyir log zer srol yod/ bo bo'u ni sde 192

dmangs la byams pa dang gyod kha mchu yod yod thams cad kho la ma gtug kyang rang 'gul du song nas rtsad bcad de 'dum par 'jug cing gzu tsha phran tsheg tsam yang mi len pas/ khong mi rnams kyis brtsi 'jog byed cing ci bshad kha la nyan pa zhig yin par bshad/ 1947 lor thon dus dpa' mchog nang rol nas rgyab rtsa btsan par brten nas gzhan sder spyod btsal mkhan mang po byung bar dmigs nas tsho ba so so'i bar stong sgo mi gcig par byas te mi la las sde ba rgyab la phyar nas gang 'dod du mi gsod pa'i don rkyen sngon 'gog byas/ khos sems khur lhod med byas 'og bcings 'grol yar sngon du thon skabs dgon gong ma'i nang na kha mchu rtsod gleng med pa dang nang mthun gros 'grig yong / 1951 lo'i zla10 pa'i nang skun ga'i zhig gi dbang gis 'chang hu bo bo'u tshe las 'das/ spyi tshogs gsar ba'i nang kho'i bu 'bum 'ba' skyabs la thun te rdzong gi chu gsum pa'i chu krang dang / rdzong rig 'phrod kho yi kho krang dang mtsho lho khul srid gros kyi kru'u zhi gzhon pa/ zhing chen srid gros kyi rgyun las u yon bcam kyi 'gan khur 'khur tu bcug/(2)pe tu/pe hu ni 'chang hu las rim pa gcig gis dma' ba'i go gnas shig yin te/ 1924 lo'i rjes nas mā pu h+phang srid gzhung gis tsho ba so so'i tsho dpon la byin pa'i go gnas shig yin/ dgon gong mar tsho dpon bzhi yod/ de dag gi dus rgyun gyi 'gan khur gtso bo ni tsho ba'i phyi nang gi gyod kha mchu bsdum pa dang / tsho ba spyi'i khe phan dang phan gnod la 'azel ba yod pa'i las don rnams thag gis gcod pa/ de'i 'phro nas mā pu t+pang srid gzhung gis khral rigs sna tshogs bzhag pa tsho ba'i nang gi mi thog dang phyugs thog la bgos te bsdur tshad ltar bsdus nas sprod pa'i 'gan len dgos/ dgon gong ma'i tsho dpon brje spor ni pha shul bus bzung ba kho na min par da dung mi rgyud gaban gyis bzung ba yang yod/ gtso bo ni mi rang nyid la 'jon thang yod 193

med dang nye ring chags sdang med par spyi snyom byed thub min de tsho dpon la 'dug thub min gyi 'gag rtsa yin/ /( ) khyigs dpon/ /khyigs dpon ni dgon gong ma spyi nas btsugs pa'i spyi'i sgrig lam srung skyobs dang / 'chang hu la rogs byas nas sde ba'i phyi nang gi gnad don rnams thag gcod byed mkhan gyi dpon po zhig yin/ lo rabs sum cu par dgon gong ma'i tsho ba so so nas rtsa 'dzugs byas pa'i khyigs bdag brgyad cu yod par grags la/ de dag gi khyigs dpon ni snga gzhug tu dpa' mchog rta re dang / mkhas ring / yo'u rgya'i 'phags ris bcas kyis khur/ khyigs zhes pa'i tshig la chad pa'i don yod de skad cha bshad pa nor na kha khyigs gcod pa dang / rtswa bkag dang zhing nang du zog 'chor tu bcug na rtswa khyigs dang zhing khyigs gcod pa/ dus tshugs ltar ru 'gel ba'i sgrig lam ma brtsis na ru khyigs gcod pa'i srol yod par bltas na/ khyigs bdag —tshogs pa'i 'gan khur gtso bo ni spyi'i sgrig lam las 'gal mkhan la chad pa gcod rgyu de red/ 1936 lor dgon gong ma'i khyigs dpon rta re nas khyigs bdag brgyad bcu khrid de dus bcad ltar ru 'gel ba'i sgrig lam ma brtsis pa'i yo'u rgya'i rab brtan mdzu gu'i g.yag cig ru khyigs la btsan gyis blangs nas bsha' skabs/ rab brtan mdzu gu glo bur tu brgyug nas rta re'i mgo la sor rgyag byas te bros/ phyis su rab brtan mdzu gur kho'i rta ming can na bzhi mgo byas pa'i dgu tshan dgu yi gson stong 'jal du bcug pa ni dgon gong ma'i khyigs bdag gis dbang cha spyad pa'i lo rgyus gnas tshul zhig red/rgyun par khyigs bdag la ngo ya byas na tsho sde spyi gyod par btsal ba dang gnyis su med pas/ de dag la nong 'gal cung tsam byas na'ang rang 'gul sgos skyon ngos len dang 'dzul tsha byin na da gzod chad pa byu mo las g.yol thub/ /(4) sbyi ba'i dge bskos/194

spyi ba'i dge bskos ni dgon gong ma tsho rteng bzhi bo mnyam du 'tshogs nas chos lugs rim gro sgrub par 'go 'dzin byed pa'i dpon po zhig yin/bltas tshod la der srid kyi dbang cha chen po med par snang mod/ 'on kyang /spyi chos sgrub pa'i las don yod tshad de/ dus tshod gtan 'a bas dang 'gro song bsdu tshad spyi ba 'tshogs skabs sgrig lam dang 'gal ba'i don rkyen byung na chad pa gcod tshul sogs la spyi dpon las kyang dbang cha yod pa red/ sngon dgon gong mas spyi thog mnyam du 'dzin skabs nywa nag rta dges spyi ba'i dge bskos khur/ 1934 lor spyi thog nas o'u rgya'i mi 'ga' zhig gis rdung res byas te sgrig lam las 'gal bar rta dges chad pa lci mo bcad pa'i lo rgyus yod/ dgon gong mas spyi srung mnyam du 'dzin pa mtshams bzhag rjes spyi ba'i dge bskos yang med par gyur/ /gsum pa/ 'chang pe hu'i dbang cha/ /rgya yig gis bris pa'i mtsho sngon 'brog phyogs kyi tsho sde'i spyi tshogs zhib 'jug zhes pa'i nang na 'chang tu ni mna' 'brel tsho sde'i 'go ba ches mthon po yin la/ de la tsho sde'i khongs mi gson du 'jug gam yang na gsod par byed pa/ de min rgyu nor 'phrog pa bcas kyi dbang cha chen po yod/ 'di 'dra'i 'chang pe hu'i dbang bsgyur sgrig gzhi ni shin tu rjes lus yin mod/'on kyang / las khungs sne 'dzing zhing / dbang bsgyur shin tu dam pa'i gnas tshul la bltas na ha las rgyu yod/ 0 ces bkod pa'i don de 'dra zhig mtsho sngon 'brog khul mang che ba na yod pa ma thos shing / ma mtha' yang dgon gong ma'i gan4tshul la bad de mi mthun pa zhig red/ thog mar dgon gong ma'i nang du gong nas bzhag pa'i 'chang pe nyi yin min la de 'dra ga nib ju ga shā ga dushās bye na/sa 8 ra par na pa'i na zog phyog kyi 'i 195

gtsigs chen mi byed de/ go gnas der dngos gnas nang don gang zhig yod pa dang / des srid gzhung la 'gan khur ci zhig len dgos pa/ khyad par can gyi dbang cha gang dag yod pa sogs la mi phal mo ches rgyus lon pa shin tu nyung / dper na/ rgya tho zhes pa'i ya mar sgam chung khyad par can 'ig yod pa de'i gnas tshul dris par dang po dpon po'i tog bsdu sa ('jog sa ) yin/ bar tu tsher mas rna tog bsdu sa/ tha mar rgya thos 'bug bsdu spyad byas/ zhes lan btab pa de las dpon rgyud yin pa dag gis kyang thabs de gal chen 'ig yin tshul de 'dra shes med pa mtshon/ don ngo ma mang tshogs kyis gtsugs chen byed pa ni rang rang tsho ba'i tsho dpon dag yin te/ tsho dpon byung tshul gong nas kyang cung zad bshad pa ltar ru skor nang gi mi gshis rgyud drangs shing dpa' ngar ldan pa/ spyi sems yod cing gtam la mkhas pa zhig yin na da gzod mtha' 'khor la mi mang po 'dzoms nas rang shugs su dpon por bkur te kha len tshig brtsi byed/ dpon por su 'dug pa'i thad la stag sha ras ma bgos spyi ma yin zhes pa ltar su la 'jon thang yod na de 'dug pa las dpon rgyud yin min la 'brel ba chen po med/ der brten/ dpon por bsdad pa thams cad ni gzhan don 'bad pa chen pos sgrub mkhan 'ba' zhig yin pas/ mang tshogs kyis shin tu brtsi bkur byed de/ gru tshig cig gi nang du'ang gong dpon po dgung gi nyi ma 'dra zhes pa lta bu bzhag yod la/ de ni rang gi sems gting gi bstod bsngags byed 'dod kyi skad cha yin pa las ngo skyid 'dra byed 'dun kho na min/dpon po dag gi dbang cha ni chab srid thad nas tsho don dang sde don la khyim bdag rnams 'tshogs nas brgya gros byas pa'i bcad mdo lag bstar byed rgyu de yin pa las/ rang gi gcig gcod byas chog pa'i khyad dbang gang yang med/ dpal 'byor thad nas spyi don du yar mar 'gro dus lam gron dang mtshams rtags sogs la 'dang ba'i bsdu cha zhig sde ba spyi nas 'gan len dang /196

yang na tsho sde phyi nang gi gyod kha mchu re bsdum na gzu tsha cung zad re len pa sogs las dpon por nges gtan gyi phog len rgyu phran tsheg tsam yang med pas/gtso bo rang gi ngal rtsol la brten nas kha gso dgos pa red/ dpa' mchog dpon po bstan dar la mtshon na kho tshang la myugs zog shin tu nyung bas 'jam skor 'phags pa skyabs tshang nas khal ma bcu g.yar nas lhum rtsa bkal te btsong ba dang / dus rgyun du gser rko la khal 'gel ba/ shar ba'i lag grogs sogs la song nas kha gso bzhin yod par grags / dpa' mchog bo bor mtshon na kho lo nyi shu yas mas kyi skabs su nor bcu lhag dang lug lnga bcu lhag las 'tsho rten gnan med pas rgyun du ri dwags bsad nas kha sgon btsal dgos dang / rjes su kho dpon por bsdad rjes yang sngar ltar rang kha rang gso byed pa las gzhan nas gzu ba byas pa'i gzu tsha gtan nas mi len pa red/ yo'u rgya'i tsho dpon de bo la mtshon na g.yag dkar po gcig las zhon rgyu'i rta med pas de bo g.yag dkar zhes pa'i mtshang ming thogs yod/ de min ya tshogs chos 'bum rgyal gyis tsho ba'i nang gi rtswa sa chen po bdag 'dzin byas tshul gyi gnas tshul de 'dra ba ni dgon gong ma'i nang du lhag par byung med de/ rgyu mtshan ni de dus dgon gong mar mi grangs nyung stabs byugs zog yang mang po med de/ da skabs lta bu'i zhing sa yang mang po bslog med pas rtswa sa'i rgya khyon shin tu che/ der brten/ rang rang mtho rtse khog nas dma' dkar mo g.yang 'khyil dang 'ba' nyin srib 'jang che chung gang la ru babs kyang rtswa bkag byed mkhan med pas su zhig gis rtswa sa zhig ched du bdag 'dzin byed pa'i dgos pa chung / gong gi gnas tshul bzhin du dgon gong ma'i tsho dpon sderapon ni sde dmangs la zhabs 'degs zhu mkhan yin pa las/gnya' gnon bshu bzhog byed mkhan gyi rim gras shig la ba rgyu med de/gong gi dpyad rtsom de'i nang du brgya la 'chang hu'i bka' yang da dung mi brtsi na/ yangs mo la rgyu nor gyi gyed ka gzhung bzhes byed pa dang de la bod skad 197

du mda' mo ltong gshag zer/ lce ba la rgyu nor thams cad gzhung bzhes byed cing gcar rdung byas rjes sde gral nas phyi la 'phud/ de la bod skad du sgo glegs kha tshub zer zhes bris yod pa'i gan4tshul de tsho sde gzhan nas byung yod kyang srid mod/ dgon gong ma nas gna' gsal cha yod pa'i tshun chad nas de 'dra'i mda' mo stong gshags dang sgo glegs kha tshub byas myong ba'i gnas tshul zhig go thos med pa dang / nye rabs su yo'u rgya'i rab brtan mdzu gus dgon gong ma'i sde gros bshig pa'i thog la khyigs dpon gyi mgo la sor rgyag byas pa'i sgyud gzhi chen po bzos kyang / de la'ang sgo glegs kha tshub ma byas par stong 'jal pas 'thus par byas/ de min dpon pos dbang cha spyod pa ni sde dmangs kyi lta rtogs 'og tu yod pas don jams cadasnyi stom du khyad par ma btod na gong bkur byed pa dang / phyogs ris 'dzin pa dang dpon po'i dbang char brten nas sger don sgrub na brgya jus tshogs 'du nas go gnas len pa ni dgon gong ma'i lo rgyus las gsal yong / dgon gong ma'i nang du gong gi khral rigs sprod pa dang / nang gi chos lugs kyi 'dzad spyod khag khur len pa/ spyi'i dmag tshogs kyi nang du 'gro ba sogs tshang ma dpon po dang 'bangs mi 'dra mnyam yin par ma zad/dpon po'i rang dpe gzhan ston byas te don legs par sgrub tu brtson/yang gong nas bshad pa'i las khungs sne 'dzing zhing / dbang bsgyur shin tu dam zhes pa'ang gnas tshul dang mi mthun te/ dason gong ma'i dpon po'i nang nas tsho dpon tshor dus rgyun sgrub rgyu'i bya ba re yod pa las/ spyi dpon te 'chang hu la be/ dbang spyod sa shin tu nyung bas ming tsam las don gyis stong yod pa'i go gnas shig red ces bshad na'ang mi chog rgyu med/ de ni lo ngo ba'i bcur nye ba'i ring la dpon po chos lor snying nad rtsod pa'i don du dpa' mchog gtso bo byas pa'i dgon gong ma'i dmag chen ka ran gzhung la drangs pa de las tsho sde thun mong gis bya 'gul thengs gcig kyang spel ma myong ba dang /198

phyis su o'u rgya glo'u tshang la thug pa dang nya nag rgya bzar thug pa'i skabs gang yin kyang tsho ba rang rang kho na'i stobs shugs la brten pa las dgon gong ma spyi nas mnyam 'brel du rgyab rogs ma byas pa red/ 1934 lor dgon gong ma'i spyi ba 'thor ba nas bzung de bas kyang spyi'i las don sgrub rgyu 'i mā pu h+phang gi khral bsdu skabs tsho ba so sos ji tsam 'gan len rgyu yod pa rtsis rgyag rgyu las med par byur/ dgon gong ma'i spyi dpon la bsdad pa'i a khu rta re dang bo bo'u gang yin kyang kho tshos rgyun du bsam blo gtong sa dang 'gan khur gtso bo len sa ni rang ge tsho ba yin zhing / tsho ba gzhan rnams la rang rang gi 'thad phyogs ltar 'jog pa las dbang thag bcad pa shin tu nyung / dper na/nywa nag gi gyed ka mtsho sngon por ru 'gro skabs tsho dpon rnams dang 'chang hu song nas phu nu kha gyes na mi bzang tshul gyi gnas lugs re bshad pa ma gtogs/ de tsho mtha' gcig 'gro bar brtsams dus rang 'dod du 'jog pa las gcun shugs btsan po zhig med pa las tsho sde'i khongs mi la dbang bsgyur dam po byed thub med pa yang shes thub/ /193

le'u drug pa/dgon gong ma'i yul srol dang dmangs khrod dad mos/deng skabs rgyal spyi'i steng gi mi'i rig pa'i mkha4dbang la la'i lta ba ltar na rang byung khor yug ni mi rigs gang zhig gi rig gnas 'grub byed kyi rtsa ba'i rgyu rkyen du 'gro ba yin/ de la re zhig bsam blo mi thong pa ltar snang mod/ ri mtho sa gtsang chu bsil tshad pa med/ /sgrul gdug stag gzig ce spyang du na sbrang med/ /'dzam gling chu bzhi'i mgo bo gangs can gnas/ /sa las lcags sogs rin chen sna lnga 'byung / /spang dzongs mtsho dang chu rgyun rab tu mang/ / zhes pa'i yul thu khyad par can 'dir bod mi rigs kyis—gnasabacas yod pa las da gzod khyad par can gyi bod kyi rig gnas zhes pa 'di rtsa nga zhing / gal srid bod 'di chags sa gangs sngongs ma yin pa'i yul gru gzhan zhig tu yod pa'i dbang du btang na/ dar ba'i rig gnas kyang rnam pa ga'an zhig tu yod nges yin zhes 'grel na/ khong tsho'i rnam bshad la go ba mi lon rgyu yang med pa red/ dper na/ thon skyed byed stangs kyi cha nas mtho sgang 'dir 'phrod pa'i phyugs las gnyer yod pas/ 'tsho ba rol stangs yang rtswa chu dang dus tshugs ltar rgyun du ru spor dgos shing / der bstun du 'dug gnas la khang ba ma dar bar sbra dar ba/ gyon pa ni pags rigs gtso bo yin pa/ bza' btung la dkar dmar gnyis te 'o ma dang mar chur nor lug gi sha shas che ba/ rang byung khams kyi 'gyur ldog las mi rnams la skyid sdug 'dres ma'i tshor ba byin pa las snod bcud kyi nang na gnas 200

pa'i stobs shugs shig gam sems ldan zhig gis bsam bzhin du tshod 'dzin pa'i bsam blo byung ste/ chu la klu dang / sa la sa bdag ri la gzhi bdagabar snang na btsan gnyan mthu bo che rnams gnas bar 'dod la/ de dag la mchod bkur byas na mgon skyob byed cing ma gus ma mchod na bar chad gtong ba sogs kyi'adu shes 'dzin stangs las gdod ma'i chos lugs byung zhing /mchod 'ab tha kyi thabs la'ang rgyag jan lha bsang gtong ba/ yul lha gzhi bdag gi gas ra mkhar bzhengs pa/ ri gter chu gter 'jog pa/ de min lha klu'i gnod pa 'gog ched sa 'dul byed cing bskang gso'e cho ga sgrub pa sogs yod la/ de dag tha sa cad sgrub skabs byed stangs nan mo zhig sgo bstun dgos pa las rang snang gang dran byed pa zhig gtan nas min/ de lta bu'i byed thabs dang sgrub stangs goms srol sogs kyi thad na mi rigs kyi thun mong min pa'i rig gnas kyi khyad chos mtshon yod sa da lta'i rig gzhung gi zhib 'jug byed yul zhig yin/ sbyir da lta'i dmangs srol zhib 'jug la dngos bo'i dmangs srol(1 sdod gnas/ 2 gyon pa/ 2 bza' btung / 4 thon skyed 5 'grim 'grul/ 6 to tshong bcas/)dang / spyi tshogs kyi dmangs srol(1 khyim tshang / 2 gnyen nye/ na sde ba/ 'u spyi tshogs kyi ched las tshogs pa/ 5 mi'i skye rga na 'chi'i rim gro/ 6 gza' skar gyi ngos 'dzin bcas/)ngag rgyun skad cha'i dmangs srol/ (1 lha sgrung / bshad rgyun/ gtam sgyud/ 2 glu gzhas/ don gyi byung ba brjod pa'i snyan ngag gtam dpe/ khed/ ba dmangs khrod rtsal bcas/)bsam blo'i dmangs srol(1 lha 'bebs/ 2 chos lugs/ dad mos/ 4 'dzem bya/ 5 kunaspyod/ mdzad spyod/ 6 dmangs khrod rtsed mo/)sogs phyogs mang po zhig yod mod/ 'on kyang / de dag re re nas bshad na mang drag pa dang dgos pa yang chung / der brten/gsham nas 'brog pa'i 'gro 'dug chags gsum dang dus rgyun gyi 'tsho ba'i khrod 'gro srol 'dug mal ji lta bu yin pa gtso cher bzhag nas bshad pa la/201

de dag mang che ba bod mi spyi'i khyad chos dang 'dra zhing / kha shas la sa gnas kyi khyad chos yang yod/ /dang po/ skyegaja 'chi yul spol/ /1 byis pa btsa' dusakyi grol/ /(1) ma la du ma spum gong byis pa skye bar re ba/'de ni byung ba shin tu snga ba'i dmangs srol zhig yin nges che ste/ mi rigs mang po'i nang bud med sgrum pa la ya mtshan can gyi 'grel bshad sna tshogs byed srol yod/ dper na/ mi rigs la la'i nang bu dang bu mo gang skye ba ni lha'i byin rlabs la rag las tshul dang / la la'i nang 'gro ba rigs drug gang zhig gi rnam she khog tu zhugs pa yin tshul/ lha sgrung la la'i nang mi bskyed pa'i lhas sa 'dam gyis bzos pa yin tshul sogs kyang bshad yod/de dag las gna' snga mor mi rnams kyis mngal spum pa ni shin tu lkog gyur ba zhig tu brtsis yod pa shes thub/ dgon gong ma'i nang du'ang gna' rabs kyi yul srol de dag dar ba'i rkyen gyis sgrum ma chags pa'am bu mo las bu ma skyes na/ bla mar lung bstan zhu ba dang mo la brtag nas rim gro sna tshogs sgrub pa'i srol da lta bar ma nyams par yod/ /(2) ma la sgrum skabs kyi 'dzem bya/ /mngal sgrum pa la dgon gong ma'i nang phung bo yod pa zer zhing /de ni khyim tshang gi don gal chen zhig la brtsi bas/ sgrum mas nges par tu spyod lam dang bza' btung sogs kyi 'dzem bya sna tshogs srung dgos par ma zad/ sa thag ring gi 'grul ba yong ba dang / glo bur skug snang yong ba/khong khro langs pa sogs la rkyen byas na mngal log pa'am mngal gyi byis pa ma gzhir bu yin pa bu mor 'gyur nyen (hro'u log pa )yod par sems pas de dag g.yol thabs la nan tan byed/ /(2) byis pa btsa' skabs kyi 'dzem bya/202

byis pa btsa' ran skabs ru skor nas bu phrug skyes skyes thams cad—'tshams por yod pa dang yug sar ma bud pa'i bud med cig gdan drangs de spum mar btsa' rogs byed pa dang / skabs der sbra sgo mar phab nas 'grul ba dang khyad par tu ser mo ba khyim la yong ba gtan 'gog byed dgos/ /(4) byis pa btsas rjes kyi mdzad sgo/byis pa btsas ma thag thod pa dang kha la mar cung zad bsku ba dang /bu zhig yin na sbra'i kha tshub las rlung rta'i dar bo 'phyar zhing / sbra'i phug chon gyi gong nas bsang phud de dgra lha wer ma mchod pa/ nyin bdun gyi rjes nas byis pa rta thog la phud de sbra la g.yas skor thengs gsum byed/ bu mo zhig yin na rlung rta phyar ba dang bsang mchod byed pa/ rta thog la 'phud pa sogs kyi mdzad sgo de med/ gal srid byis pa gnyis nag dang bra nye sogs gza' skar la skyes na btsas skar gyi rim gro byed dgos/ /2 miming 'dogs pa'i yul zas/ /spyir btang byis pa skyes nas nyin bdun 'gor rjes ming 'dogs par byed de/ ming 'dogs mkhan ni khyim tshang gi pha rgan nam dgon pa'i grwa ba dmangs khrod kyi rtsis pa sogs yin/ ming 'dogs pa la ma'i bar chad zhi ba dang / kha las rlung rta dar zhing longs spyod bde skyid ldan pa sogs kyi smon 'dun nges can mtshon par byed pas ming 'dogs tshul la'ang gnas tshul mi 'dra ba sna tshogs yod pa gsham du re re bzhin bshad par byed de/ /(1) spar kha ltar btags pa'i ming / /ming 'dogs tshul 'di ni 'byung rtsis ltar byis pa'i btsas skar gyi spar kha ded nas li thar rgyal dang / khon thar 'bum/ zon ra skyid/ dar skyabs sogs su btags pa lta bu red/ ming 'dogs tshul 'dis byis par che'i bar chad mi 'byung pa'i bsam 'dun mtshon yod/ /(2) sri ming / /203

byis pa sngon ma dag ma 'tshams na byis pa rjes ma skye dus tshe sgrub gtor bzlog sogs kyi chos lugs cho ga nges can sgrub rjes/ ming la khyi mo thar dang / mying med skyid/ rdo log ci thar rgyal/ rgya tho/ nog ge (khyi )sogs su btags pa lta bu red/ ming 'dogs tshul 'dis tshe bgegs g.yol ba'i bsam blo zhig mtshon yod/ /(2) gces ming / /gces ming ni khyim mi che ba rnams dang lhag par tu a mas rang gi bu bu mor btags pa'i ming yin te/ de'i khyad chos ni thog mar btags pa'i ming de la kho dang log pe po'u dziris sog4gces ming spyor bar byed/ dper na/ rta mgrin la rta kho dang / rgyal mtshan la rgya logadabang chen rgyal la dbu pe/ skal bzang skyid la ska ras/ bkra shis tshe ring la bkra pu'u zhes su 'dogs pa lta bu red/ ming des byis par gces pa'i bsam blo mtshon yod la/ lan 'gar gal srid ming de ltar btags rjes tshe gang bor ming de gtso bor 'gyur ba las thog mar btags pa'i ming de kun la cha rgyus med par 'gyur ba'ang yod/(4) tshab ming / /mi la tshab ming 'dogs pa ni spyir 'brog pa'i khyad chos shig yin pa dang dgon gong ma'i nang du'ang khyab gdal du gnas/ dper na/ yar 'apel mgo stug grags pa kha che/ chos bzang sna bo/ snyan grags spyol bo/bsam gtan zhar ra/ dge bzang kha yon/ sbyin pa rgya tho/ skal bzang rgyal nag ra sogs dbang bo dang byad bzhin gyi mtshang ming dang / mi gzugs thung la 'jo'u mo (mo ra so gnyis )dang / gzugs ring yang lus phung cha mi mnyam pa la bla ring rkang ring ske ring ngo ring / tshon po la dmu lugagadong mi mdzes pa la drel ngo / dpa' snying yod kyang dgra 'tsho mi shes pa la g.yag 'dug sogs mi ngos 'dzin ched dang kha mtshar gyi don du rgyun du 'bod 204

par byed kyang / ming de 'bod skabs gnas bab nges can la ma bstun na gyod kha mchu 'bud kyang srid/ gzhan mi kha bde la dug kha dang / skye gnyis/zar ma kha/ yer ma kha/ gyi kha sogs dang / mi dpa' bo la sangs chen/mi blo rig skyen pa la mkhas chen/ mi skye gzugs mdzes pa la a no(yag pa'i don)/ shom can la rma bya dang skya ka sa mo/ skad ngag bde ba la khu byug bcas su 'bod la/ ming de dag gis bstod bsngags kyi don mtshon yod pas kho tsho rang nyid dang rjes rabs pas rgyun par ngoms so byed pa mthong / /dgon gong ma'i nang du tshab ming dang mtshang ming 'dogs pa shin tu rgyugs che bas/ gal srid mtshang ming dang tshab ming kyis ma bos na mi su yin pa sde ba tsho ba phar zhog kho tsho mi rgyud ngo mas kyang ngos zin dka' bar 'dugadaper na/ dpa' mchog sangs chen ma bshad na stag skor skal bzang rgyal yin pa mi shes pa dang / g.yer skyong mkhas chen ma bshad na bstan skyong yin mi shes pa/ dpa' mchog mkhas ring gi ming ngo mar ci zer kho tsho tsho ba gcig gi mi mang che bas yang mi shes pa lta bu red/ /(5) bu phrug mi skye ba'i ming / /khyim tshang la lar bu phrug skyes pa mang drag pa'am khyad par tu bu mo mang nas bu zhig zhig skye bar 'dod na bo mo chog gam bo chog da chog zhes byis par ming 'bod pa dang / lha sa dang khams phyogs sogs na bu khrid dang /mtshams gcod sgol ma zhes pa sogs kyi ming yod pa'ang de dang 'dra'o/ /(6) shi bo'i ming / dgon gong ma'i nang du mi shi rung ming ba da ces pa'i kha dpe zhig yod mod/ 'on kyang / mi phal ba'i nang du shi bo'i ming nas 'dzin par shin tu 'dzem dgos te/ gal srid su zhig gis yul srol de ma shes par shi bo'i ming nas bzung na gyod kha mchu chen po 'byung srid/ khyim tshang gi pha ma shi ba'i ming la dga' ldan po dang dag zhing ma pha drin chen po ma drin can ma zhes su 'bod pa dang / skyes pa dar ma dang pha spun mched 205

sogs yin na bla spang po zer ba/ chung ma dang sring mo nu mo sogs yin na mtho ris ma zer ba/ byis pa yin na lam la ma song ba de zer/ bla ma dang grwa ba yin na bde gshegs dang gshegs pa po sogs zer ba lta bu red/ /(7) ngo bsrung gi ming / ngo bsrung gi ming ni mna' mas rang gi skyes pa'i sha nye lo che ba dag gi ming nas thad kur mi 'dzin ched btags pa'i tshab ming yin te/ de dag la khugyes bca' sa g.yang zer/ a rgya dang a pa sogs rang gi skyes pa'i 'bod srol gyi rjes 'brang ba las gzhan/ pha spun dang de las kyang sha nye'i 'brel thag ring ba rnams la nges par tu tshab ming gis 'bod dgos/ dper na/ 'gan khur ltar btags pa'i tshab ming la sngon chad a khu dpon po dang / a pa khyigs bad sogs dang da skabs a pa byu'u ci/ a pa tos krang / a pa zhang krang / a pa thos zhig(zacho)sogs yod pa dang / 'brel ba ltar btags pa'i tshab ming la a gye bca' dgos sa'i bu dang bu mo spun zla sogs kyi 'brel ba ltar btags pa ste/dper na/ don grub kyi a rgya/ rta mgrin gyi a khu/ bsod skyid kyi dga' po lha bu yin te/ don grub dang rta mgrin sogs skyes pa rnams nges par tu mna' ma rang dang na mnyam yin pa'am rang las lo chung yin dgos/ ngo bsrung gi ming nas 'dzin par shin tu gzab dgos pa'i rkyen gyis ya mas bu mo gnas la skyel sa tshang la ya gye bca' sa gang dag yod pa sngon nas rtsad bcad de bu mor re re bzhin sems la 'dzin par bskul ba dang / gal srid de dag gi ming nas thad gar bos na pha rol bos mna' ma des rang la ngo bsrung mi byed par sems/ ngo bsrung byed sa'i ming nas 'dzin pa 'di la gzab che ba'i rkyen gyis dgod bro ba'i don yang byung yod de/ dper na/sngon chad ru skor zhig du khul lu zer ba'i mi zhig yod pa de'i ming la rkyen byas nas mna' ma tshos nor khul la'ang g.yag gi rgyab kyi de zhes tshab ming mi 'dogs ka med byung pa dang / khyi mo thar zer ba'i ming la rkyen byas nas 206

khyi'i ming du'ang dang la dang / sda lu sogs mi 'dogs ka med byung pa lta bu red/ byis ba'i mnol skya men pa'is da sgo/ /byis pa pho mo gang yin rung skyes nas lo gsum bar skra mi bzhar la/ de la mnol skra bzhag pa zer/ lo gsum son rjes ru skor nang nas bu ches mang pa dang tshang ma 'tshams por yod pa 'byor ba ches bzang ba'i rgan pa su yin pa des nyi ma rtse shar la byis pa'i skra khrus chus (chu nang la 'o ma cung zad blug ste sngags bzlas nas bsngags pa )bkrus rjes/ mi brgya'i mgor lcag g.yug thub/ rta brgya'i mgor srab skon thub/ tshe ring / lo brgya/ ces kha g.yang brjod zhor skra bzhar bar byed cing / ru skor gyi mi dang sa gzhan na yod pa'i nye mi rnams kyis byis pa'i mgo la 'dogs rgyu'i tsor lo khyer yong nas rten 'brel zhu zhing tshang mas dga' dga' spro spros mnol ston byed/4 darama'im da sgo/de la skra phab pa yang zer/ dgon gong ma'i nang du bla brang dang khri ka sogs sa khulagazhan ltar skra ston zhes pa zhig logs su byed rgyu med de/ bag ston byed pa'i nyin ni skra 'phab pa'i nyin yang yin/ de'i mtshon rtags ni pha yul nas bag sku sla skabs lan bu g.yas pa'i sde la bal dkar po zhig bsla zhing rgyab la kha brtags shig 'dog4pa dang / gnyen tshang tshang nas lan bu g.yon pa'i nang du bal dkar po bslas nas kha btags shig 'dogs pa de red/ sku 'phab skabs skra shad byed kyi so mang gi kha grangs nges par tu cha grangs yin dgos pa dang / skra sla mkhan ni nges par tu bza' zla 'dzoms shing / bu phrug 'tshams por yod pa zhig yin dgos/ /gzhan bu mo lo bco lnga bcu drug la bud rjes khyim tshang gis mi che dang 'dra ba'i rgyan cha dang gon rgyu gra sgrig byed cing / mi gzhan pas gnas la'ang slong chog pa red/ byis pa pho yin na pho lo lnga gsum bco lnga bud nas/207

drug gsum bco brgyad ltag par bzhag na/ zas mar mi slong / blo phar mi 'dri zhes pa'i kha dpe yod pa las de dus dar ma'i nang tshud par lta ba mtshon thub/ /5 gnyen sgrig gi 'gro grol/skyes pa gcig gis bud med gcig chung mar len pa ni dgon gong ma'i nang nas gnyen sgrig stangs gtso bo red/ sngon chad 'byor ba cung bzang pa'i skyes pa'i nang na bud med gnyis chen chun du blangs yod pa'ang yod par grags mod/ phyis su gnas tshul de phal cher mthong rgyu med par gyur yod/dus rabs dang sbyi tshogs kyi 'pho 'gyur la bstun nas gnyen sgrig gi 'gro srol la'ang 'pho 'gyur 'byung bzhin pa red/ sngon chad bu mo lo bco lnga yas mas su slebs rjes pha mas slong mkhan byung ba'i nang nas mag pa'i mi gshis bzang min dang khyim tshang la rgyu 'byor ba yod med sogs la bltas nas mna' mar ster ba las/ bu mo rang 'thad yin min la de 'dra mi blta ba red/ de'i rgyu mtshan ni gcig nas bu bu mo lo chung stabs phal cher rang rang gi gnyen ya 'dems pa'i bsam da dung shes med pa dang / gnyis su'ang tshe gcig gi las don chen po'i thad nas pha ma'i kha ma blangs na tha shal gyi bya ba zhig la ba bas gagon nu pho mo phal cher gyis pha ma'i thag bcad dang len byed/ der brten gnas tshang la 'gro reg bar rang gi skyes pa'i kha ngo yang mthong ma myo nga ba'i bu mo mang po yod/ pha mas bu mo lo chung dus man2 mar ster ba las gzhan da dung pho mo ga nyis rang mos kyis dga' rogs sgrig tshul yang yod de/dper na/ nyin mo pho mo gnyis kyis dus btab ste/ mtshan mo skyes ba tsho dus brtab pa'i sar yong nas ming bu btang nas brda brgyab na ba mo tsho'ang sa der 'ong ba de'i ming la rku chad zer/ de nas tshang mas ma ma du ong ba sogs btus nas me bus pa'i mtha' 'khor tu pho mo phan jun bar la gzhes len res byed pa dang / la ga sa brgyud nas phan tshun sa rang gi 'dod 208

pa'i dga' rogs 'tshol ba dang / de ltar dus tshod nges can zhig 'gor nas phan tshun bar brtse dung chags na thog mar skyes pas rang gi pha mar bshad nas gnyen slong ba'i sta gon byed/ gnyen sgrig ni skyes pa'i phyogs kyi rang 'gul gyi bya ba zhig yin te/ khyim tshang gang zhig gi bu lo bcu bdun bco brgyad son rjes bar ba zhig btsal nas (khyim bdag dngos su 'gro ba yang yod )cha rkyen phal cher 'dra mnyam yin pa tshang zhig tu chang dam bu 'ga' dang kha btags sogs lag skyes khyer nas mna' ma slong du 'gro la/ thog mar sman bu mo'i bzang ngan ma ltos zhes pa ltar a ma khyim bdag la mkhas pa dang lag las gar bzang ba zhig yin na/ bu mo mna' mar slong mkhan mang po yod la de ni khyim tshang de'i rgyan zhig tu'ang brtsi/ bar ba'i khyer yong ba'i chang dang kha btags blangs na khyim bdag gis gsal bor ma bshad kyang bu mo mna' mar ster rgyur 'thad pa byung tshul mtshon yod cing / phal cher nye mi tshor gros bsdur byas rjes lan gsal bo 'debs/ nye mi tsho'i gros bsdur byed pa'i nang don gtso bo ni bu mo khyim tshang der byin na bzang min yin la/gnad don de'i rjes nas nye rtags sogs kyi cha rkyen yin/ gal srid bu mo mna' mar ster bar 'thad pa byung na bar ba brgyud nas bu mo slong mkhan tshang la nye rtags ji tsam rgyag dgos pa dang nye rtags ster sa'i mi gang dag yod pa/bu mor rgyan cha dang gon rgyu ji tsam gra sgrig byed dgos pa sogs kyi cha rkyen bshad nges yin/ khyim tshang mang che bas bu mo'i nye rtags rgyag tshad bshad skabs gnas yul tshang gi dpal 'byor cha rkyen ga'ir 'dzin pa las blo la mi shong ba zhig bshad mi srid/ yin na'ang sngon chad gnyen sgrig gi don de nyo tshong gi 'brel ba kho na'i steng du bzhag pa'i srol ngan yang byung yod pa red/khyim gnyis ka bu bu mo'i gnyen don la gros mthun byung rjes/ gza' skar bzang po zhig la bltas nas khyim tshang phan tshun bar mag pa 'bod pa dang mna' ma skyel ba'i gnyen ston byed / mag pa 'bod skabs ri skor gyi skyes pa 209

rta thub thub thams cad mag skyes kyi sngon la sa thag ring bor bud nas bsab byed/ phan tshan 'phral rjes rgan po zhig gis ya/ gnyen tshang tshang bde mo yin nam zhes 'tshams 'dri byas na/ mag skyes tshang mas mgrin gcig tu a zhang tshang / bde mo yin/ bde mo yin zhes lan btab rjes/mchod kha 'phen zhor skor ba lan gsum byas nas myur du sngon la rgyugs/mchod kha 'apen byed ni 'o ja mar gyi kha rgyan btang ba zhig yin la de'i ming la dri skor mtshad kha zer/ mag pa khyim la thon reg bar de lta bu'i dri skor thengs gsum byed cing / skor ba rjes ma grub ma thag myur bar sngon la song nas rta rnams btags rjes gzab 'phyor spras te bsgug nas bsdad yod pa'i ma sru tsho dang mnyam du sbra'i sgo sdun nas mag pa dang mag skyes kyi rta kha len pa'i sta gon byed/ mag pa dang mag skyes khyim la bsus rjes thog mar kho tshor bza' btung spyod du 'jug la/ de nas chang 'dren zhor glu len pa dang /ya zhang tshang gi ma sru tshos mag skyes dag la chu dar zhes pa zhig ster dgos par bshad cing / de ster mi ster gyi thad nas phan tshun bshad res mang pos rtsed mo byed la/ myur bar ma byin na ma sru rnams kyis skyes pa tsho'i lag nas btsan 'phrog byed par rtsom/ chu dar ni kha btags shig dang chang dam bu gang yin/ de ltar cung zad 'gor rjes ya zhang tshang gi mi kha bde zhig yar langs nas ya/ de ring gi nyi ma bzang po/skar ma bzang po/ zhes ston bshad byed pa dang / de nas mag byis cha lo yar la longs zhes mag pa gdan dkar po zhig thog la langs su bcug nas ya zhang tshang gi nye mi dang ru skor nas byin pa'i mag lu dang mag skag rnams re re rnams mtshams spyor byed/de la yongs grags su skon dang ske rag zer/ go rim de mjug dzogs rjes ston mo mjug rdzogs reg bar glu len gar rtsed byed/ /bag ma bsu ba'i ston mo'i rgya cung zad che dgos par ma zad gang yin sa nas ya zhang tshang la ba bkur byed pa'i nang don mtshon dgos pa red/210

thog mar bag skyes yong ba mag skyes las ldab gcig gis mang la/ skor ba byed skabs phyogs phyogs su bros na re re bzhin bda' nas khrid yong dgos shang / a zhang tshang rta las 'bab ched gos dar 'doms bcu can zhig gi 'bab rten 'phyar dgos pa red/ 'bro res byed pa dang 'bab rten phyar ba gang yin kyang rtsed mo'i rnam pa zhig yin rung / don gyis ya zhang tshang la brtsi 'jog byed pa mtshon yod/ gnyen tshang gi skyes pa tshos ya zhang rnams kyi rta kha len pa dang / bud med tsho'i khrod snga mo nas bag ma dang lo res spar kha mthun pa'i bu mo gnyis bag ma'i rta kha len du 'dems yod pas/ de gnyis kyi lag tu kha btags bzung nas bag ma'i rta kha len pa dang / rta kha len zhor du bag ma'i zhwa mo sngon la yen tsam 'then pa ste de ni ma ne dang a gyes rnams la brtsi bkur byos zhes pa'i don mtshon/ bag ma ni gnyen tshang gis khyim la gom pa brgya'i mtshams nas 'bab tu 'jug na 'dod kyang ma 'ang tshang gis sgo srun bar rta las ma babs na rab yin sems/ bag ma rta las babs rjes sna phu rung byas nas rang gi ngo bsums pa dang / de nas rta kha len mkhan bu mo de gnyis kyis bag ma'i mchan gnyis nas skyor tsam byas te brgyad stong ba'i chos bzhag yod pa'i pa'i ngo sgo'i 'og nas khyim la 'dzul dgos/khyim nas bag ma'i lan bu'i sne nas nyung tsam bshig ste snga mo nas mos khyer yong yod pa'i so mang gis sku shad rjes de'i nang kha btags shig skra dang mnyam du bsla dgos/ so mang de nges par du cha grangs can yin dgos/ khyim nas sku bslas tshar rjes bag mas ja nyung tsam 'thungs pa dang de nas ched du thabs pa'i ras gur nang du so nga nas bag rogs dang mnyam du 'dug pa yin/ston mo'i nyin der bag ma dang mag pa'i sngon gyi sder skal sgrig spyad kyi sgod chas tshang ma'i kha la bal dkar pos dkris yod par ma zad/ 'thung spyad kyi dkar yol kha yang bal dkar gyis dkris yod pa dang / tha na sder ma'i nang gi tshang ra dang zhun tshang ma yang bal gyis dkri la/ des sems pa dang gshis 211

rgyud bal las dkar ba'i bkra shis pa'i don mtshon yod/ zhang gnyen gang yin kyang ston mor sgrig pa'i zas rigs ni sha dang / go re/ gro ma/ ka ra/sil tog sogs yin/ ma zhang tshang gis bza' btung byas tshar rjes de tsho'i nang du a pha dang / ma khu/ phu bo/ nu bo/ pha spun sogs yod na gos phyi nang bzo wa gcig gi tshad dang ske rag ster la/ de min gzhan pa'i ya zhang rnams la'ang gos dang ske rag che chung ltar bag mar sha nye ring ltar ster/skon ske rag bcangs tshar rjes gnyen tshang gi bud med tshos a zhang tshang la bag ma'i skal chang slong ba dang / a zhang tshos de ma thag skal chang mi ster bar bud med tshor ku re kha shags mang po bkyes rjes da gzod ster ba yin/ skal chang byin rjes ston bshad byed pa dang / de nas sman khra mo glag mo bcum bcum byos/ sha khra rgod lu gu 'khur 'khur byos zhes bshad ma thag snga mo nas sgo yi phyar ba'i steng lug sha hril bo mgo sug dang bcas bzhag yod pa de dag (ston thog gi mi'i mang nyung ltar lug sha sgrig par grags )bya rgod ltar 'phrog res byed pa'i rtsed mo byed/ bud med tshos 'phrog pa'i sha rnams ni kho mo tshos bgos te yul la 'khyer ba dang / ya zhang tshang gis 'phrog nas blang yod pa ni mi 'khyer/ rjes nas rim bzhin bud med tshos kyang yul la mi 'khyer ba dang phyis su sha 'phrog res byed pa de rten 'brel tsam gyis chog par byed/ rtsed mo de mjug sgril rjes glu len pa dang glu la glu chung glu rgan gnyis te nyin mor glu chung len pa dang mtshan mor gru rgan te la gzhas len pa yin/phyis su nyin dkar la gzhas len pa'i srol yang dar yod de/ dus rgyun du ru skor nas thos mtshams su la gzhas blangs na gyod kyi gzhi ru 'gro mod/gnyen ston gyi dus der ya zhang su zhig gis dgung a sngon dkyil na 'brug gsum yod/ 'brug gcig grags nas stod la song / 'brug gcig grags nas smad du song / 'brug gcig ma grags da rung yod/ 'brug gcig po grags pa'i gnang ba zhig nang khrom pa'i dkyil na sku gsum yod/ glu 212

gcig blangs nas stod la song / glu gcig ma blangs da rung yod/ sku gcig len pa'i gnang ba byin/ zhes gnyen tshang gi gad po zhig la gnang ba zhu ba'i sngon brda btang rjes la gzhes len res byed pa red/ la gzhas len pa dang 'dod gtam bshad pa'i mgo rtsom skabs ngo bsrung dgos pa rnams phyi la g.yol ba'i bzo lta tsam ston mod/ don dngos su ston thog de nas da dung ma song ba yang yod/ /gsham nas gnyen sgrig la 'dzem bya gang dag yod pa dang sta gon mi 'dra ba gang dag byed dgos pa cung zad bshad par bya ste/ /(1) nya'i bar gnyen sgrig pa gtan 'gog byed pa/ /thog mar gnyen sgrig phyogs kyi sha rus (pha phyogs dang ma phyogs )gang nas ded kyang mi rabs bdun gyi gnag tshan gyi phyi yin dgos shing / sngar nas mnyam du bsdad pa'i tsho ba gcig yin na sha nye'i 'brel ba gnag tshan bdun las brgal yod kyang ngo bsrung nas gnyen lam mi btod/ gnyen sgrig gi 'brel ba la shin tu nan tan byed pa ni dgon gong ma'i nang snga mo nayodar yod pa'i goms srol rnying ba zhig yin te/ rus rgyud nye na byis pa dbang bo skyon can skye ba'i 'du shes shig mi thams cad la khyad med du yod pas/sha nye'i gnyen sgrig las byung ba'i mi dbang bo skyon can gtan nas med zer chog yin na'ang nye ba'i lo bcu phrag gi rang 'dir mi rigs gzhan pa'i shan zhugs pa yin nam sha nye'i gras su pha phyogs las ma phyogs mi brtsi ba zhig rim bzhin dar ba ni 'dor dgos pa'i bya ba tha shal zhig red/(2)gnyen sgrig phyogs gnyisaka'i lo rusam kha mthun dgos pa/de ni chos lugs kyi 'du shes las byung ba'i srol lam zhig yin te/gnyen gyi sta gon thog mar byed skabs dmangs khrod kyi rtsis pa'am dgon pa'i grwa ba zhus nas pho mo gnyis kyi skyes skar la 'brel ba yod pa'i nyi ma zla ba lo sogs la 'byung rtses byas te mthun min dpyad par byed/ spyir btang du 213

glang lug gnyis kyi phung spyod/ bya sprel gnyis kyi mchu brdar/ 'brug lug gnyis kyi thog rgyag zhes pa ltar lo rtags de dag phan tshun bsdebs par gzab pa dang / de min khyim tshang phyogs gnyis ga'i bsten pa'i srung ma mthun min la'ang lta ba red/ bcings 'grol byas pa'i tshun chad nas srol lam de dag phal cher med par gyur yod/ /(2)bag ma'i spyod lam gyi blangabyu/ /bag ma ma song ba'i bdun gcig gi ring nas sha khu re 'thung rgyu las bza' btung la tshod 'dzin la/ de la bag ma'i kha bkug pa zer/ de ni phal cher ston mo'i nyin la gnyen tshang nas gsang spyod la 'bud mi dgos par byed pa'i don du yin/ de min bag ma'i skra slas skabs ru skor gyi bud med bza' tshang kha tshang ba gshis rgyud bzang ba zhig pos nas bkra shis pa'i rten 'brel mtshon pa'i bal dkar po lan bu dang mnyam du sla ba dang / bag mar 'gro ba'i nyin la tsha ru'i thog tu phyu ba zhes thog lu gnam mdog can zhig rgyan pa dang / thog lu de'i phu rung gi kha ni rta rmig gi dbyibs ltar dras yod pa red/ rgyab tu rgyab dar ces pa'i kha dog lnga yi gos dar 'dogs pa yin/zhon pa ni rta dkar bo tshig yin dgos/ bag ma lam la chas khar ngu dgos pa dang / bag ma ma ngus na than zer/ bag ma sgor bud rjes rta la zhon nas skyel ma byed mkhan dang bag rogs dang mnyam du pha khyim gyi sbra la skor ba thengs gsum rgyag pa dang / skor zengs rer khyim nas ya mas skad mthon pos bu mo'i ming nas bos rte skyid dang skyid dga' khyod kyis khyer/ g.yang dang mdzo mo a mar zhog zhes bshad na/ bag rogs dang yang na skyel mi tsho'i nang nas mi zhig gis 'o ya zer nas/ bu mos ngu ngag gis yul mi dang 'bral mi 'dod bzhin du 'gro/ gnyen tshang la thon par nye dus de tshang gi ston thog la 'tshogs yod pa'i bu mo na chung ma skor zhig bar thag ring bo'i bar sngon la bud nas bag ma'i ming bo'i lag nas rta kha len par brtsams na 21

de ma thag kho mo tshor rta kha ster mi nyan te/ gnyen tshang gi sgo sdun la ji ltar thag nye sa nas bag ma rta las 'bab thub na de ltar bzang / de min bag ma rta las 'bab tu bcug rjes bag rta sgo chon sne la ye 'dogs la'ang blta dgos/bag ma khyim la thag ring sa nas rta las 'bab tu bcug bcug nas kyang zhwa mo'i rtse mo gdong la mar 'azen/ bag rta sgo chon la btags nas mnol 'phab pa gang yin thams cad kyis bu mos rjes phyogs gnas yul nas kha len tshig brtsi kho na byed pa las rang dbang byed rgyu med pa mtshon yod pas/gnyen tshang gis mna' ma smad 'dod kyi re ba 'grub tu mi 'jug ched/ bag rta 'khrid mkhan dang bag rogs kyis sgo sdun bar bsu ma'i lag la rta kha 'chor tu mi 'jug pa dang bag ma thang la babs ma thag zhwa mo sngon la 'then na myur bar phyi la 'then pa/ bag rta sbra'i sgo chon la 'dogs su mi 'jug pa bcas kyi go chod dgos/ bag ma rta las babs rjes bu mo na chung ma gnyis kyis mchan nas bskyor te dal bum khyim la 'gro la/ de dus bag mas sna phu rung byas nas gdong mi tshogs kyis mi mthong pa byed dgos/ de la bag mas tsho'u byas pa zer/ bag ma phal cher ston thog de nas chu tshod gnyis tsam bsdad rjes rang gi ming bo'am skyes ba lo chung gzhan zhig dang mnyam du phyir rang yul la log cing / bag skyes gzhan tshang ma mu 'thud nas glu len gar rtse byas nas 'dug nyin 'ga' 'gor rjes bu mo'i pha'am mi bdag gtso bo zhig gis bskyal rte gnyen tshang la song nas nyin gnyis gsum tsam 'dug la/ de la bag ma gnyen 'phral du song ba zer/ sngon chad yin na de dus da gzod bu mos rang gi skyes pa'i gdong dzi lta bu yin pa mthong thub/ gnyen 'phral gyi rjes nas bag mar skyel ba'i don de yongs su mjug sgril ba mtshon/ mna' ma so mas gnas yul nas rang gi 'gro srol 'dug mal la shin tu do snang byed dgos te/ dper na/ ru sgor sgyu thos sa nas skad mthon pos rang gi skyes pa'i ming nas 'bod pa dang / skyes pa'i a pha dang phu bo de min lo che ba'i 215

skyes pa sha nye gzhan gyi ming nas thad ker bos na gus lugs mi shes par brtsi ba dang / sbra'i nang na pho khyim mo khyim phyes yod pa'i pho khyim gyi gong la rang 'dod du 'bud pa dang dkyil krung gis 'dug pa sogs bud med kyi 'gro srol mi shes bar brtsi pas/ nges par gzab gzab byed dgos/ /pha mas gcig chod byas nas gnyen sgrig pa'i phan chad nas da dung—gnas yul btsal ba dang bu gyed 'khyid pa sogs kyi gnyen sgrig srol yang yod de/(1) gnas yul btsal ba/bud med rang 'dod du pha ming dang bral nas sde ba gzhan la song ste bdag po byung na de la gnyen sgrig pa yin te/ dgon gong gong ma'i mi rgyud kha yar gyi ma phyogs nas sa gargan nas rang 'gul du gnas yul btsal nas yong tshul rgan po dag gis bshad/ nye rabs su de 'dra'i gnyen sgrig srol zhig byung ma rtsong bas/ de'i rgyu rkyen ci yin gsal bor mi shes kyang / de la khyad chos shig yod pa ni gnas yul btsal nas yong mkhan gyi pha yul shin tu thag ring ba dang / phal cher rjes su rtsad gcod mkhan med pa/ lag las gar ngar ba dang 'tsho ba'i nus shugs che ba bcas yin/ gnas tshul de la bltas na phal cher bud med kyis gnyen sgrig rang dbang brtson len byas pa yin shas che la/ de min yug sar bud pa dang pha mas dbang thag pa'i gnas yul nas 'dug ma 'dod pa/ yang na dbul phung la g.yol ba sogs rgyu rkyen ga'an yod kyang srid/ /(2) bud cad 'bad pa/bud snyed 'khyid pa ni dmangs srol rig pa'i khrod btsan 'thog gnyen sgrig (tshoza)ces pa de dang phal cher cha 'dra/ de ni tsho ba'i phyi la gnyen sgrig pa'i lam lugs dar bas byung ba'i ches snga ba'i gnyen sgrig srol zhig yin par bshad de/ rgyal khab phyi nang gi mi rigs mi nyung ba zhig gi nang du 216

gnyen sgrig srol de dar myong / dgon gong ma'i nang der gsham gsal gyi khyad chos 'ga' yod/ /gcig ni pho mo gnyis mdza' zhing mthun pas pha mas byin pa'i gnas yul la 'gro ma 'dod par/ pho mo gnyis kyis gsang gros byas te pha mas gnyen lag bstar byed par lag snga brtsad nas skog tu skyes pa'i khyim la 'khrid pa/ /gnyis ni pho mo gnyis gnyen sgrig rang 'thad byung rjes/ skyes pas bar ba btsal te gnyen slong du 'gro skabs bu mo'i pha ma 'thad pa ma byung bas/pho mo gnyis kyis dus btab rjes skyes pas lag rogs btsal te mtshan mor 'khrid pa/ /gsum ni pho mo gnyis gyis rang 'thad du dga' rogs sgrig pa pha mas blor ma babs par mag pa gzhan zhig btsal nas/ bu mo de la 'khrid du 'jug pa ste/ gal srid gnas tshul de bu mo'i dga' rogs gyis kyang shes na/bud byud 'phrog res byed pa'i mi shi rta 'gyel gyi don rkyen 'byung srid/ /bzhi ni pho mo gnyis sngon la mdza' zhing mazun nas gnyen sgrig pa'i dus btab kyang / rjes su bu mo'i blo 'gyur te dga' rogs gzhan btsal ba la skyes pa ma dga' bar lag grogs btsal te bu mo chu len dang zog dzi sogs thang la 'bud skabs lam bsgug nas bzung ste yul la btsan 'khrid byed pa'am/ yang na kha sna gcod pa'am skra 'breg pa sogs bu mo'i bzhin ras brlag ste skyin pa len pa/ de ltar byas rjes khyim tshang bar dang sde ba tsho ba'i bar gyod gzhi chen po langs te lo mang rabs la 'grig mthun ma byung ba'i gnas tshul yang yod pas mo gyod shug pa rul rgyu med ces pa'i gtam dpe zhig kyang byung / /lnga nas bu dang bu mo rang 'thad yin pa'i thog pha ma gnyis kyang 'thad na'ang / da dung skye pas mtshan mo skog nas bud gyed 'khyid pa'i rnam pa 217

tsam byed de/ de'i rgyu mtshan ni spyir btang du bu mos pha ma'i 'dod blo dang ma bstun par gnas yul btsal na pha mas dpal 'byor thad nas 'gan cung zad kyang mi len par ma zad/ tha na pha bu dang ma bu'i 'brel ba yang med par byed cing / de la gshar la brgyab nas sha thag mdud pa zer/ pha ma 'thad na'ang bu mo lkog nas 'khyid du 'jug don ni gtso bo dpal 'byor thad nas stabs bde byed 'dod yin te/ bu mo'i rang lam rang gis btsal ba'i kha g.yar sa zhig yod na nye rtags dang gon rgyu 'dogs cha ston mo sogs 'gro sgo gtong sa yod tshad nas stabs bde byas na gnyen nye dang tsho sde thams cad nas ngan smos byed rgyu med pa red/ des sngon chad kyi gnyen sgrig srol khyad par can la nang don gsar ba bsnan pa mtshon zhing / tsho tshong gi 'brel ba'i gnyen sgrig dang gnyen don la rgyas spras chud zos byed pa'i srol ngan 'gog par sngon thon rang bzhin yod/ /bu kyed 'khrid skabs nyams 'jog sa gtso bo ni gsang ba byed dgos pa de yin zhing / pha ma 'thad pa byung yod pa yin kyang rnam pa'i steng nas mtshan mo mis ma shes par 'khrid pa 'dra byed dgos/ de min bu mo'i gon rgyu thams cad brje spor byas te yul nas 'jog dgos shing / 'gro skabs nges par tu kha btags shig pa'i sgo chon la btags nas 'jog dgos/ de ltar ma byas na bu mo khrid pa ra rtags shig kyang ma brgyab par bsam nas pha ma lhag par khong khro langs srid/ /bu mo gnas la phar 'gro ba las gzhan mag pa tshur 'jog pa'i gnas tshul kyang yod de / spyir btang du mag pa phar bsdad dang khang ba klad ri ma zhes gnyen mi brtan pa dang gzhan gyis mthong chung yang byed srid pas/rgyu 'byor bas dman pa dang mi bdag mi rtsa med pa zhig min na mag pa phar 'dug byed mkhan shin tu nyung / /6 khrim tshang bca' ba'i ma da sgo/ /318

bu la mna' ma len pa dang bu mor mag pa ba ga na mi mang por gyur pas spu gsar tu phub dgos pa red/ khyim gzhi gsar ba 'dzugs par rten 'brel zhu ched/ ru skor dang sde ba mgron du bos nas glu len dga' rtsed byed/nyin der ston mor yong ba'i mi rnams kyis lag skyes la sngon chad skye snod dang dkar bca' sogs khyim tshang gi ca lag 'khyer kyang / da lta gos dang chang sogs 'khyer bar byed/ /7 lo lon gyim dasgo/ /pha ma lo brgyad bcur bud na bu dang tsha bo rnams dang spra sgo nye mi rnams kyis rten 'brel zhu ba'i ston mo byed de/ rgya ston la 'gro ba'i lag skyes la ja dang gyon pa sogs 'khyer zhing / nyin der bstod glu sogs len pa'i bde dgar rol/ khyim tshang gis dgon par dge rtsa sgrub pa'i thebs kyang rgyag / na ba'izabasashāthal zol/ /sbyir btang du nad byung na sman pa bsten pa dang bza' btung spyod lam sogs la gzab pa las gzhan/ da dung lha mo rtsis gsum la bsten pa de yang bcos thabs kyi phyogs gtso bo zhig la brtsi par ma zad/ de dag gi bstan don la mi phal mo ches yid ches brtan po byed/ lha mo rtsis gsum gyi bcos thab4la lab tse bstod rgyu dang / bsang mchod khas len rgyu/ gdon yod pa'i dngos po med par bzo ba/ sngags rgyag rgyu/ chos 'don pa'i bca' ba rim gro sgrub rgyu sogs yod/ /'a 'dasamachod spub babs/ /mi shi na sngas mgo'i bla ma zhus nas 'pho ba gsungs pa dang / grwa ba gdan drangs nas bdun 'dzugs pa/ a mchod zhus nas zhe dgu 'don du 'jug pa/ ru skor gyis ma ṇi mtshan skor byed pa sogs yod la/ de dag thams cad la shi bo'i dge rtsa sgrub pa zer/ shi bo'i dge rtsa sgrub pa'i rgya che chung de khyim tshang gi 'byor ba la'ang 'brel ba che ste/ khyim phyug po zhig yin 219

na sngas mgo'i bla ma du ma zhu ba dang / grwa ba mang po gdan 'dren byed/dur 'jug byed thabs gtso bo byar g.yeng ba yin zhing / sngon chad mi dar ma glo bur tu shi ba dang grir shi thebs pa/ 'go nad sogs kyis shi na sbyin bsregs la sdug pa dang sa 'og tu 'jug pa chu nang du 'apen pa sogs kyi srol kyang yod par bshad/ dur sar skyel ba'i dus skabs ni mtshan mor byed pa de la skar ma byed pa dang skar mar song ba zhes su bshad/ skar ma byed du 'gro skabs ru skor dang sde ba'i nang gi skyes pa 'gro thub tshad thams cad 'gro la/ lo lon shi ba'i skar mar lo chung song na tshe thag je ring du 'gro bar bshad/ mi shi bo'i 'dzem bya gtso bo ni ro 'jog sa'i gzur (yol ba )gyi nang du khyi dang byi la 'dzul rgyu gtan 'gog byed dgos pa dang / ro g.yag la bkal nas dur sar skyel skabs lam nas ngal gso byed mi chog pa/god sogs bya rigs las khyi dang gcan gzan gzhan la g.yeng du 'jug mi rung pa/ skar mar song nas phyir yong skabs lam na sbar yod pa'i me thog tu lding ba dang kha lag bkrus nas thub sel byed dgos pa sogs dang / shi bo'i spun mched dang bu bu mo'i thos sa nas nam yang shi bo'i ming gis 'bod mi rung pa dang / gal srid de ma brtsis na nged kyi shi bo'i bla skul byas song zhes gyod rgyag nges yin/ shi bor 'dun byed skabs sngon chad skyes pas zhwa phyir slog nas gon pa dang bud med kyis rgyab kyi dmar gdan dang ske yi rgyan cha len pa/ pho mo gnyis kyis ske rags mdun nas bcings pa/ bud med rnams kyis skra mi sla pa dang skyes ba rnams kyis skra mi bzhar ba/ lo gsar sogs dus ston mi rol ba dang / glu len gar rtse sogs bzhad gad slong ba sogs la mi zhugs pa bcas yod/ da lta 'dun byed yus dang 'dun byed thabs sogs la 'gyur ldog phran bu 'byung bzhin mchis/ /gong du bshad pa ni skye rga na 'chi'i go rim ltar song ba'i yulapol goms gshis kyi mtshon tshul tsam yin la/ gsham du 'gro 'dug 'chag gsum —220

sogs kyi mtshon tshul re mtshams sbyor bar bya/ /gnyis pa/ 'gro 'dug 'chag gsum gyisal srol/ /1 'cho ba dang sdod gnasakyi goms srol/ /'brog pa'i kha zas la rigs mang po med kyang zas bcud shin tu che/zas rigs la gtso bo rtsam pa dang mar chur/ nor lug gi sha dang 'o ma/ gro gye dang nas bye sogs yod/ spyir dkar gsum mngar gsum dang sha mar thud gsum bcas ni za ma'i phul du brtsi/ spyor btang du nyin rer zas thengs bzhi za ba dang zog dzi yin na thengs gnyis las mi za/sdod gnas ni sbra nag yin pa dang de la'ang sbra dang ras nag gnyis te/sbra ni rus sbal gyi dbyibs dang 'dra la ras nag ni gru bzhi sgam gyi dbyibs yin/ sru dang ras nag gang yin kyang nor gyi rtsid khul 'khel 'thag byas nas bzos pa yin la/ de'i rgya khyon la ha lam spyi khru gru bzhi ma nyi shu yas mas yod/ sbra ras la nang ka dang phyi ga gdung ma/ phur ba/ 'char buzung ba (pho zung mo zung ) khyon thag (gru khyon/ sgo khyon/ phug chon/dkyil khyon )kha tshub/ sgo yol bcas kyi ming gi rnam grangs yod/2 zananganas 'dugapol/sbra nang du pho khyim mo khyim gnyis su bkar yod de/ khyim tshang phal che ba'i mo khyim ni thab ga'i g.yas phyogs dang pho khyim ni thab ga'i g.yon phyogs su byas yod la/ spyir btang du pho mo gnyis kyi 'dug gnas brje bar mi byed/de min thab ga'i dbang du byas na bang kha dang / yar rjed rtsa/ mar rjed rtsa/go kha'i dkyil bcas dang / sbra'i dbang du byas te gru 'og dang ya phuganang kwa gong zhol/ phug tho/ sbra sgo sogs yod pa las/ pha rgan dang ma rgan ma rjed rtsa nas 'dug pa dang / 'grul ba yong na sbra sgo gnam la bkyags nas khyim du bsu ba dang skyes pa yin na pho khyim gyi ya rjed rtsa nas sdod du 'jug pa dang / skyes ma yin na mo khyim gyi ma rjed rtsa nas sdod du 'jug221

chos sgam dang dngos po rtsa chen nams pho khyim gyi ya phug la rtsig pa dang /dkar bca' dang sgod spyad bza' btung gi rigs sogs mo khyim la 'jogasrung mda' dang g.yang ra bang kha'i phu la 'dzugs pa dang / bsang khug ni bang kwa'i thog la 'gel bar byed/ pho khyim gyi nang kwa zhol ma'i thog rta'i srab mthur 'gel cing / sbra'i mkha' 'og tu 'bru rigs dang glang sga sogs rtsig par byed/ khyim nas 'dug skabs kyi 'dzem bya ni pho rnams dkyil grung gis 'dug pa dang mo rnams pus tsog gis 'dug pa las gan rkyal du nyal ba dang /lhag par tu go kha'i nang du 'bab pa dang thab ka dang ya phug la rkang ba gtad mi rung / lham dang rkang snam thab thog dang ya phug gi do cha'i thog de bas kyang 'jog mi rung / zas rigs dang / gon rgyu/ yo byad sogs kyi thog tu 'gom par yang gzab dgos/ /2 gyon chas dngagron cha'i goms spol/gyon pa ni slog pa dang tsha ru/ ras wa/ phrug bar phying / chu phying / tshil len/ rkang snam(dgon gong mas nang bug 'be'u zer la/sngon chad skyi 'be'u gon pa shas che zhing / da lta tshang ma ras 'be'u yin)/zhwa(wa zhwa/ phying zhwa/ tshar zhwa/ rgya zhwa lis mo sogs yod)/ tshil len dang rkang snam/ zhwa dang lham bcas rgyun du gyon pa las/ slog pa dang ras lu bar phying ni nam zla'i drod 'khyag ltar brjes nas spyon/ tsha ru dang phrug wa ni 'phyor lu yin pas rgyu can zhig min na rgyun du gyon pa ni ha cang nyung / wa ba gang gyon yang ske rag gi sne gnyis rkang ba'i phyi rteng dang mnyam pa byed cing de la ske rag sug bzhi zer/ mgo la phying zhwa mgo ring gi 'dabs su tshar ru brgyab ste rtse mor ja la btags nas gyon pa dang / rkang la rang gis las snon byas pa'i ko lham spyon pa yin/ sngon chad ras shin tu dkon phyir skyes pa tshos rgyun du tshil len gon pa ha cang nyung pa dang / tsha ru dang phrug wa'i 'dabs su sram brgyab pa gri ltag gi zheng tshad las med de/ de las che na ཿ2ཿ

bsod nams kyi mi non zer/ rjes su rim bzhin je cher song nas da lta tshar ru gcig gi kha la sram pags gnyis gsum re rgyag mkhan yang byung yod/ de ni mi rnams kyi lta ba 'gyur ba dang dpal 'byor cha rkyen je bzang du song bar yang rag las/ sgog par kha khyon rgyag na slog pa'i 'dabs yongs su gla pags mnyen ma sor gang yod med tsam gyis g.yog pa ste/ de la skyi khyon zer/ de'i yan chad la ras nag po sor mo gsum can gyis g.yog la/gong ba'i kha ru stag lngags sam gzig lngags rgyag pa yin/ mo slag la kha khyon sum rgyag ste rte'u pags dang tshar ru/ ras dmar po dang ljang khu nag po bcas 'ja' sgrig tu rgyagasngon chad skyes pho mo gnyis kur rgyan cha 'dogs pa'i srol yod de/skyes ma'i rgyan cha la ske rgyan dang / ga'u/ rna lung / gdub kor/mdzub dkris/ bzho lung / rwa 'char/ a lung / dung bcas yod la/sko rgyan la sngon chad rdo byur dang / kha dkar/ spas byur bcas 'dogs la rjes su rim ba'in g.yu dang / byu ru/ gzi/ gser min sogs 'dogs/a lung bzho lung yang sngon chad dbyibs chung la rgyu zangs dang rag yin pa da lta dbyibs che bar gyur ba dang rgyu dngul gyis byas yod/ dung ni rgyab la 'dogs pa'i rgyan cha zhig ste/ de'i ming la dmar gdan yang zer/ dmar gdan ni ras brtsegs ma gsum bzhi ngos sbyar nas bzos pa'i ras leb gru bzhi nar mo gsum gyi rnga ma phyogs gcig tu sprel nas steng du dngul dung khag gsum byas nas bsgrigs yod/ dkyil gyi ras leb ni ral ba 'dogs sa yin/ dmar gdan zer don ni gna' snga mor ras leb steng du dmar chags zhes pa'i rgyan cha zhig btags pa yin pas/ dmar gdan te dmar chags kyi gdan zhes pa las btags/ de'i rjes su rdo dung ste dung dkar gyi dkyil nas gtubs te byed ka de gnyis dmar gdan steng phyogs kyi g.yas g.yon du 'dogs/ lo du ma'i rjes nas rdo dung ni dngul dung du 223

bsgyur ba dang / dmar chags ni g.yu byur tu bsgyur/ dmar gdan gyi steng phyogs g.yas g.yon du dadul dung chen po gnyis 'dogs pa de'i ming la phrag dung gnyis dang / de'i man la dkyil dung / de'i man la mtha' dung yin la/ dkyil ral gyi steng du tha na zhes pa dang g.yu byur 'dog par byed/dung la ches mang na dgu yod/ 1958lo'i rjes nas bzung las ka las skabs stabs bde sogs la dmigs nas g.yas g.yon gyi ras leb blangs nas ral chung 'dogs par bsgyur/ /skyes pa tshos ral ba bslas pa'i dkyil du dngul gyi skor bu zhes pa zhig sprad de sne mor ja la nag po mthud de mgor dkri/ rna g.yon par rna lung 'dogs pa dang / gzhog g.yas la me cha dngul shan ma dang gzhog g.yon la a lung nyi zla ma'i logs su gru chung 'dogs par byed/ da dung ske la gon rgyu'i ga'u yang yod/4 lasaka'i las bgos/sngon chad dgon gong ma'i nang du pho mo gnyis kyi las bgos gsal bo yod de/ sa thag ring bor khal ma ded nas nyo tshong la 'gro ba dang / phyugs dzir 'gro ba/ gon rgyu 'tshem pa/ pags pa mnyel ba/ thig gu rgyu ba sogs ni pho las yin pa dang / nor bzho ba dang / 'o ma bshig pa/ rtsam pa 'thag pa/ chu len pa/ zas g.yo sbyor byed pa/ lci 'phud thang las byed pa/ 'dam las byed pa sogs ni mo las yin/ spyir btang tu pho las tshang ma mo yis sgrub chog kyang pho yis byu 'phud thang las dang chu 'khur ba/zas g.yo g.yo spyor sogs byas na mi mdzes par sems/ /5 spyod lam gyi 'jem bya/gnyan rigs kyi rma byung skabs dang bsang 'phud dus me nang du sha bsregs nas gsur byed pa gtan 'gog byed dgos/ rgyun par mi gzhan pa'i gon rgyu gon par 'dzem zhing lhag par tu mi bzang mgo yi zhwa gon pa las 324

mi ngan rkang gi lham gon zhes pa ltar mi gzhan pa'i zhwa mo gon par shin tu 'dzems/gsum pa/ dmangasakhrodakyi dad mos/ /dmangs khrod dad mos la lha mo rtsis gsum dang 'dre 'dul gto 'phen la sogs gna' bo'i lam srol mang po yod pa de/ sangs rgyas chos lugs dang phar 'dres tshur 'dres byas yod pa'i rnam pa ltar snang / gsham nas phyogs che ba 'ga' zhig gi thad nas cung zad brjod par bya ba la/ /gcig lab tse stod pa/ /lab tse stod pa ni sa la sa bdag dang chu la chu bdag yod par 'dod pa'i rang byung khams kyi snang tshul las byung pa'i gdod ma'i dad mos kyi rigs shig yin zhing / 'o de gong rgyal dang yar lha sham po gnyan chen thang lha sogs srid pa chags pa'i lha dgu dang / rje yi mgur lha bcu gsum sogs gzhi bdag chen pornams bkur ba'i mgo tshugs pa nas bzung lab tse bstod pa'i grol yang byung bar nges/ de dus ni sangs rgyas chos lugs bod la dar ba'i sngon gyi lo rabs shin tu ring bo'i skabs yin/ lab tse zhes pa'i tha snyad kyi nges tshig la dpyad na/ lab ces pa ni brjod bde'i dbang gis rjes 'jug ba rang shugs su thon pa ma gtogs/ don dam du rjes 'jug med pa'i la yin la/ de ni la kha'am ri rtse khis kha sgang rgyud sogs sa dpangs mtho sa nas lab tse rtsig pa'i gnas kyi khyad par gyis don yin/ tse ni zhang zhung gi skad de sgod la 'jug pa bon gzhung nas bshad/ gzhan lab tse la gsas mkhar yang zer/ gsas zhes pa lha la 'jug pas gsas mkhar zhes pa lha mkhar te gzhi bdag bzhugs sa'i gnas yin/ gzhan lab tse la dbye na kye tu dang / lab tse/ dpa' mkhar sogs kyi ming gi rnam grangs yod cing / zhwa dmar dge 'dun bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho'i lab tse'i mchod chog 〉tu/ btsan po'i lab tse ri yi rtse mo dang / 'phan po'i lab tse ri yi khis 225

kha ste/ phyug po'i lab tse ri shod klong du brtsigs/ yus mi'i btsan byug 'phan gsum dar bar byas zhes 'byung ba sogs la bltas na/ lab tse la rigs dang byed nus mi 'dra ba yod pa ltar stod sa'i gnas la'ang khyad par yod pa shes thub/ /sngon chad kyi lo rgyus las btsan po'i dus su sa mtshams kyi ri dang la chen khag tu la dzi sa bsrungs pa mang po bzhag pa dang / mtha' mtshams nas yul dbus bar gyi ri rtse mthon po gcig nas gcig mthong sa na dmag gi gnas tshul dud pas brda gtong sa yod pa de dag kyang phyis su lab tse dang rigs 'dres par mngon/ /de yang lo rgyus 'phel phyogs dang bstun nas lab rtse stod pa'i nang don dang rnam pa gang thad nas 'gyur ldog yong gi yod pa red/ dper na/dang jog gzhi bdag mnyes pa'i ched yin na 'brong mgo dang sha rwa tha na mi mgo sogs kyis kyang lab tse rtsig par bshad pa dang / dgra lha dar ched yin na mda' mdung sogs mtshon chas lab tse rtsig pa/ bsang mchod byed skabs yang dmar mchod byed pa sogs bon lugs sha che yang / nang ba sangs rgyas kyi chos lugs bod du dar ba nas bzung / sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi shan zhugs pa'ang shin tu mang / lab tse byung ba'i dus yun shin tu ring na yang de'i spyir btang gi rnam pa da dung bsgyud 'dzin byas yod de/dper na/ lab tse dmu thag gis 'bran pa des/ dang thog gnam gyi khri bdun dmu thag la 'jus nas gnam tu phebs pa ltar lha dang mi gnyis kyi 'brel lam mtshon zhing / da lta'ang phal cher de 'drar ngos 'dzin pa dang /lab tse rtsig byed mang che ba lcer ba dang ja rta spen ma nya rig sogs shing zan gyi rigs dang shug pa sogs yin kyang de'i nang du mda' shing dang gri mdung mang po 'jog pa las bu rta dar zhing dgra jag gnon pa mtshon/ deng gi char yang yul kha cig tu sngon chad kyi sa mtshams chu mtshams de lab ma'i mtshams nas 226

'byed pa yang yod/ /sangs rgyas chos lugs ltar na gzhi bdag ni 'jig rten pa'i lha yin pas skyabs gnas su mi 'dzin kyang / slob dpon pad 'byung bod du phebs nas bstan ma bcu gnyis sogs gzhi bdag nag phyogs pa dam la btags te/sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrungs pa dang bod khams skyong bar zhal gyis bzhes nas bka' dang tha tshig la gnas bar byas rjes/ dgon sde dag nas kyang gzhi bdag gi rigs phal che ba rten dge bsnyen 'dzin cing sa dang lam la gnas pa'i bstan bsrung la bkur/ lab tse rtsig skabs kyang chos lugs kyi 'gro srol ltar rab gnas byed pa dang / chos dang mthun pa'i bsang mchod byed pa red/ /dgon gong mar mtshon na gle khog na yod dus ba a bye gle 'phyor ram gle zhar gyi lab tse bstod cing / gzhi bdag de ni dgon gong ma'i dpa' bo zhig gi bla gshed yin par grags/ gle 'phyor ni dgon gong ma yongs kyi skyes lha yin pas/ 'ba' lung la spor ba'i rjes su'ang lo mang rabs shig la lo re'i zla drug pa'i nang tsho rteng bzhi bo phyir gle khog la song nas la tse bstod par byed/ phyis su rim bzhin 'ba' lung nas ko chen sogs sde bas rgyun du bstod dgos pa'i la tse byung ba nas bzung / gle 'phyor bstod pa'i bar mtshams je ring du song na'ang bsang mchod rgyun chags su byed/ya gye gle 'phyor gyi bas mchod/ /mdo smad gser gzhung nor bu'i lte ba ru/ /sra brtan brag ri rdza klong pho brang nas/ lha gnyen gle zhar 'khor bcas spyan 'dren no/ /sku mdog dmar sgrug stag ral gzig shub can/ /rgyan dang cha lugs mnab bza' bsam mi khyab/ /phyag g.yas mdung dar g.yon pas nor gzhong bsnams/ /rta mchog rag ser bcib nas las kun sgrub/ /'dir byon brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la/ /rnal 'byor 'khor srung gdug pa'i rkyen ngan zlog/ ma—221

'da' bcol ba'i 'phrin las sgrub par mdzod/ /'ba' lung mthon po bcu gsum dang rtse drug snyeng bdun gyi bsang mchod/ /dgon gong ma 'ba' lung la yong ma thag pa'i skabs su yul lha gzhi bdag mchod pa'i mgo yang 'dzin dgos par dgongs nas yo'u rgya'i bla ma dbu dkar bas 'ba' lung mthon po bcu gsum dang rtse drug snying bdun gyi bsang mchod ces pa zhig mdzad pa 'di lta ste/ 'phrin las nyi ma'i gzi 'od stong 'bar ba'i/ /'dod yon pad dkar rnam par bzhad pa'i gnyen/ /mthon po bcu gsum rtse drug snying bdun la/ /gnas pa'i gzhi bdag ma lus 'dir byon la/ /dri bzang ngad ldan sngon shing spos sna dang / /bye mar zas phud bsregs pa'i dud sprin 'dis/ /mthu ldan dkar phyogs skyong pa'i dgra lha che /rgyal bo ko chen blon po lha bca' bsang / /zi mi dmag dpon pā yan g.yu thod bsang / /ngang tshang g.yu sgo nga nyin shig brag dkar bsang / /spos lung rdo rje chu nag be'u ngur bsang / /dge bsnyen rab gzigs lha yi lcam mo bsang / /sa ki de'u dwa wa lung rdza dmar bsang / /khe rab dpag chen la —sogs 'bal phyogs kyi/ /ri klung kun la gnas pa'i lha klu sogs/ /sde brgyad gzhi bdag 'byung bo'i tshogs kun bsang / /rtse drug snying bdun zhe'u (de'u )bco brgyad dang / /zhe'u (de'u )chung brgya dang brgyad la dbang pa yi/ /yul lha gzhi bdag klu gnyan ma lus bsang / /bstan la dad pa'i (lha )rigs khyod rnams kyis/ /bsang mchod mthun pa'i dam rdzas 'di bzhes la/ /bdag cag mi myugs nad rims dgra gdon gyis/ /gnod 'tshe'i 'jigs skrag ma lus zhi bar mdzod/ /khyed rnams dgyes pa'i 'dzum zhal lham me ba/ /sna tshogs tshe bsod dpal 'byor la sogs tshogs/ /nyi mas 'byed pa'i 'dabs brgya'i tshal bzhin du/ /rtag tu 'gro la 'azin las game med sgrubs/ /lhag bsam dag pas tshul 'der brtson pa na/ /tshangs dang dbang po 'jigs rten skyong pa 228

dang / /mthon po bcu gsum la sogs bsrung mas kyang / /g.yel ba med par rtag tu grogs byed shog/ /rgyal borka chen/ /rgyal bo ko chen ni 'ba' yi mthon po bcu gsum gyi rje bo yin par brtsi bas/ la tse de bstod pa la gzhan las kyang gtsigs chen byed/ lab stod la 'gro skabs khyim tshang rnam sa la kha rgyan gyi 'gan 'jog pa dang / lab tse stod pa'i nyin gtan 'khel byas tshe tshang mar bdo rgyag pa yin/ spyir btang gi lab tse bstod pa'i nyin ni lo re'i bod rtsis kyi zla bzhi ba'i tshes bcu gcig nyin yin/ lab tse bstod pa'i nyin der lab bstod pa rnams kyis kha rgyan khyer yong ba dang / thog mar la tse'i nye 'dabs su tshang mas ja bskol nas 'thung / ja yi bskol mgo ni gzhi bdag la mchod/ de rjes mar chur gnyis ka mnyam du badzi zhor mdo smad gter lung nang bcud du/ yid 'ong spang ris yongs bskor ba'i/ /dbus su sa 'dzin lhun po bajid/ /rtsa ba spangs ljongs me tog bkra/ /lhang lhang sgra ldan nyal 'gros gtams/ /sked pa lhun stug ḍā k+ki'i gling / /'ja' tshon sna lnga'i bro ra 'khrigs/ rtse mo g.yu 'od lha lam bsnyegs/ /sprin dkar na bun 'khrigs klong nas/ /skad chen g.yu 'brug sngon co grags/ /pho brang de dbus gzhal yas nas/ /rma phyug dpal gyi ri bo la/ /bsten bcas yul lha ko chen dang / /yum sras mched 'khor gzhi bdag rnams/ /'dir gshegs gdan bzhugs gus pas bstod/ /dngos yid sngags rgya ting 'dzin gyis/ /rab spel bsang gsur gtor ma skyems/ /gsol lo mchod do thugs dam bskang / /mkho dgu 'bul lo nyes stung — bshags/ /bdag cag gzhi byes gar 'gro yang / /bsam pa sgrub la re ba skong / /nad yams gdon bgegs dgra jag bzlog /tshe bsod rlung rta yar la bskyed/ /gang bsam don kun bdag la stsol lo/ /bcol ba'i 'phrin las 'thub par mdzod do/ /ke ke bsi so che' lha rgyal lo/ / zhes pa'i 229

bsang mchod 'don zhor lab tse'i dngos grub ba sa pa tshang mas mnyam za byed/ lhag 'tho rnams ma lus par yul la 'khyer/ de nas rim bzhin lab tse'i kha rgyan brtsigs te rmu thag 'bran pa dang / mda' dar ral gri sogs gyi mtshon cha lab tse'i khong gseng du gseb ste bsang 'phud pa dang skad gseng mthon pos ke 'debs shing lha rgyal lo zhes mang du sgrog lab tse bstad tshar rjes la ru'i sgang du rta daphyad rgyag pa dang / sa bde sar yong nas tshang rag la brgyug ste bo'u rgyag gyes khar rta yi bang rtsal 'gran ched phan tshun gyi zhwa mo 'phrog res byed pa dang bda' res sogs kyi rtsed mo byed/ko chen lab tse ni dgon gong mas mnyam gcig tu bstod pa las gzhan/tsho ba so sor rang rang gi lab tse yang yod/ dper na/ yo'u rgyas btsan skyes nor bu dgra 'dul bstod pa dang / g.yer skyong gis stobs ldan nor bu dgra 'joms bstod pa/ nywa nag gi lha ri zhal dkar bstod pa/ dpa' mchog stag skor gyis 'brug lung dpa' bo g.yu rgod bstod pa/ dpa' mchog bla rgan tshang gis btsan rnga rdung bstod pa lta bu red/ /yo'u18 lab btsan skyes/ /btsan skyes ni o'u rgya'i sngags 'chang chen po 'jig med gnas sa yin par bshad pa dang / dus rabs nyi shu ba'i stod tsam la yo'u rgya'i sngags mang gis bstad/ nga brgyad lor lab tse de mer bsregs nas med pa bzos kyang /1985lor yang bskyar bstad pa dang / yo'u rgya'i gnam bzhes lha sa nas grongs pa'i shul tu skyes pa'i sdong bo'i yal ga zhig kyang lab tse'i srog shing du bzhagayo'u rgya'i sngags pa 'jigs med ni rgya gar grub chen sha wa ri ba'i skye ba yin par grags la/ khong gis chos dang 'jig rten gnyis ga'i thad nas yo'u rgya'i spyi sde mnyam du bskyangs te bka' drin shin tu che/ chung dus nas chos la phu dud bya zhing kha ton dge sbyor la shin tu dmar ba zhig yin/ sku tshe 230

gzhan dbang du ma gyur gong phur ba dung phyur gnyis bzlas shing rtogs pa mthon po'i tshad la slebs yod/ bde chen blo brag rin po ches kyang khong ni yi dam gyi skur bzhengs pa las mi shi btsan skyes su gyur ba ma yin pas/ mchod gnas dam pa mdzad na bzang zhes gsol ka gsungs shing / rdzong sngon pad+ma thugs mchog rdo rje rin po ches kyang ya khu dbang kho tshang la lab tse bstod pa sogs kyi bka' slob gnang zhing / gsol ka gsung pa ni/ hūṃ rang byung lhun grub gzhal yas nas/ /rtsa gsum kun 'dus pad+ma dbang / /dbyer med thugs mchog rdo rje sogs/ /brgyud gsum bla mas byin chen phobs/ /kyi —dmar po'i sde dpon chen po yi/ /bka' 'khor drag po'i tshul bzung pa/ /sra brtan gnam lcags las thub pa'i/ /pho brang rab tu 'jigs pa'i klong / /mi ro rta ro bkram pa'i dbus/ /dgra bgegs pho mo bsnol ba'i steng / /mchog chen g.yang bzhi'i gdan steng du/ /btsan skyes nor bu dgra 'dul bzhengs/ /sngags 'chang te ru ka yi chas/ /dus gsum legs nyes ga ler gzigs/ /sngon gyi smon lam mthu btsan pa'i/ /gsang chen bstan la phya ra mdzad/ /bstan 'dzin skyes bu'i sku tshe bsrings/ /'khor srung rkyen bzlog bar chad sel/ /res 'ga' skyes gzhon dar ma'i chas/ /bse khrab gsol zhing bse rmog gyon/ /btsan chas 'khor gsum sked la bskor/ /phyag g.yas btsan mdung dmar po dang / /g.yon pa spul zhags nag po thogs/ /myur mgyogs gyi ling sngo nag bcibs/ /g.yas na lha dmag gyi li li/ /g.yon na gnyan dmag thib se 'thib/ /mdun na btsan dmag sha ra ra/ /rol du stag gzig dom dred jams/ /mthu rtsal thogs med dgra la chas/ /rang gi bu rta'i dpa' ngar bskyed/ /go khrab mtshon cha'i bkrag mdangs byung / dpa' rtags ru mtshon dgung du phyar/ /phyi nang gsang pa'i rlung rta bskyed/ /dgra bo btsan po'i don snying byungs/ /mtshon cha non po'i rtse mo chog/ 'og rta mgyogs po'i jid pa 'ching / /sha khrag dgra lha'i dpa' zos gyis/ /dgra bo'i zas nor 231

longs spyod kun/ /mchod gtor 'bul lo 'phrin las sgrubs/ /gnod byed dgra bgegs rdul du rlog/ dam las ma 'da' sa ma ya/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /dba'amachog lab tshe 'a lung dba' po gamulacul/ /'brug lung dpa' bo g.yul rgyal ni 'jang chen 'thug lung phu'i ri rtse mthon po'i dgon gong ma dang mgar rtse'i sa mtshams su yod/ lab tse der dpa' mchog seng chen rte stag skor skal bzang rgyal gnas pa dang / dpa' mchog sngags pa sku nag gis bstad cing bsang yig kyang khong gis mdzad/de'i bsang mchod ni/ / :kye/ mdo smad gser ldan yangs pa'i sa 'dzin spor/ /yul lha'i rgyal bo ko chen zhes grags pa'i/ /nub kyi sgo bsrung rdo rje rab bajid tshal/ /zhal gcig 'dzum bag nyams ldan dgyes pa'i bzhin/ phyag g.yas mdung dar ba dan rtse brgyad 'phyar/ /phyag g.yon dgos 'dod gter sgrom dar gyis spras/ stu la mtshams sprin mdog ldan mna' bza' dang / /be+er lngang mig sman chosna gos mdzes par bklubs/ mu men prog zhu dar dkar ske rag dang / /rna cha brang rgyan me tog do shal 'phyang / /rtag tu nag pa'i rgya lham zhabasal gsol/ /rta mchog rag pa gser gyi spu mdangs 'dzin/ /sga srab gong med ldan pa'i chibs par bcibs/ /yum mchog lha sman 'phyor sgeg rin chen rgyan/ /mdzing gos phyag gnyis shel gzhong shel dkar 'dzin/ /gnas bdag 'khor bcas tha tshig nyer dgongs la/ /'dir phyon dngos bshams yid sprul mchod pa'i rdzas/ /'dod yon rnam lnga dkar gtor sman gyi — bshos/ /tshim byed man da ra dang phud skong skyems/ /dkar gsum mngar gsum bdud rtsi shing sna'i bsang / /mi zad 'dod rgu'i gter bum mda' mdung mtshon/ /sna tshogs ljon pa'i yal ga bal tshon rgyan/ /'bru rigs zas phul shel tshigs dkar nag sogs/ /'byor tshogs bskang rdzas gtsang ma sbyar ba yis/ /mthu ldan yul lha chen po 'khor bcas mchod/ /dgyes bar bzhes 232

nas rnal 'byor bdag cag gi/ mi 'dod nyer 'tshe 'jigs brgyad zhi bar mdzod/ /tshe bsod dpal 'byor phywa g.yang legs tshogs bskyed/ /mnga' thang stobs 'byor rigs rgyud 'phel zhing rgyas/ /dgra spyod than ltas nad yams gto kha bzlog / thub bstan mdo sngags chos kyi brgyud 'dzin rnams/ /gang bzhugs tshogs kyi mdzad 'azin phyogs kun spel/ /rgyal khams yongs la bde skyid bkra shis 'phel/ /ci snyam 'dod pa'i re ba skong bar shog/ gsol lo mchod do lha la lo/ / zhes so/ /blagan tshang cho ba'i lab tse btsan jung / dpa' mchog bla rgan tshang gis bstod pa'i btsan ja rdung ni/ 'jang chen brag sgam mdo'i de'u 'bur zhig gi mgo na yod/ lab tse de'i ming la rnga rdung thogs pa'i rgyu mtshan ni skabs la lar lab tse'i nang ja rdung ba'i sgra thos par grags pas de ltar ming du btags/ dus rabs nyi shu ba'i lo rabs bzhi bcu'i nang du tsho dpon rgya lug gis bu rta'i rlung rta dar ba dang sngar byas nyes sgrib sel ched bstad la/ bsang yig ni o'u rgya rdo rje 'chang gis mdzad/ / kye/ brag dmar khyung rtse g.yu yi ldem 'phru can/ /pho brang dmar nag byi ru'i ba gam brtsegs/ /de la bsten pa'i gsang chen khrab rmog can/ /g.yas pas ru mtshon dmar po mkha' la 'phyar/ /g.yo na pas btsan zhags dam nyams mgul du bcings/ /nag phyogs bdud rigs thams cad cham la phab/ /chibs su rta mchog dmar po rlung gathog bcibs/ /bcibs nas stong gsum kun la bya ra gyis/ /nyin gyi bya ra mtshan gyi mel tshe mdzod/ /ma g.yel ma g.yel 'azin las myur bzhin sgrubs/ / ri la lab tshe/ /nor bu ri rgyal ni gser lag dgon pas bstad pa'i lab tse yin la/de'i bsang mchod ni/ /233
