kye/ bkra shis dge mtshan du ma'i gzi 'bar ba'i/ /phun tshogs dpal gyis mtho ba'i gnas mchog 'dir/ /dgos 'dod mchog stsol nor bu ri rgyal zhes/ /mthu ldan dkar phyogs skyong ba'i dgra lha che/ /ma lus 'khor bcas gnas mchog 'dir gshegs la/ /rang rang dgyes pa'i gdan la ོbrtan por bzhugs/ /yul 'di'i chu mig spangs ldongs nags tshal brag/nyin srib ri lung kun la gnas pa yi/ /bstan la 'dun pa'i srung ma mgron rigs kun/ /byams brtse sems kyis 'dir byon dgyes bzhin bzhugs/ /mgron rigs byams ldan lhag pa'i lha mchog la/ /nges par mos gus drag pos bshags bgyid na/ /ma lus zhing kun khyab pa'i mchod tshogs kun/ /dngos su gang 'byor yid kyis sprul de 'bul/ /bcud ldan zhal zas lngags dbang tshim phyir 'bul/ /brgyad ldan lhan skyes dri ngad ldang ba yi/ /nam mkha'i khyon kun yongs su gang ngo 'bul/ /rin chen rgyan ldan dam btags zhol g.yag lug/ go khrab gnam ru mda' mdung mtshon gyi rigs/ /mthun pa'i mchod tshogs dngos bshams yid kyis spul/ /gnas bdag 'khor mang mnyes pa'i rten tu 'bul/ /dkar phyogs skyong ba'i lha klu gzhi bdag rnams/ /snyigs ma'i rang mdangs rdol ba'i skye 'gro kun/ /sdig la rngams pa'i mi bzad grib phog na/ /lha shing mthun rdzas bsdigs pas byang gyur cig/ gnas 'dir rnam dag khrims ldan 'dus pa'i sde/ /phan tshun thugs mthun rab 'jam bzhugs lugs la/ /thos bsam sgom pa'i 'gal rkyen kun zhi zhing / /tshul bzhin —mthun rkyen sgrub pa'i sdong grogs mdzod/ / ces pa 'di ni phun tshogs bstan rgyas gling gser lag gzhung nas gsar tu 'debs skabs bla ma che ge mo zhig gis sbyar ba yin la/ phyis su 'jam bzhad sku phreng bzhi ba gser lag la phebs dus kyang bsang mchod cig mdzad yod/ /lhaja zhal dkar lab tse/ /lha ri zhal dkar ni mtshams thog dkar mo phug dgon pas stod pa'i 23

gzhi bdag yin par ma zad/ nywa nag tsho bas rgyang skyes lhar bkur nas bsang mchod byed/ de'i bsang ni/ /phun tshogs bkra shis dge mtshan 'byung pa'i gnas / /bajid chags lha ri dgung la bsnyegs 'dra'i spor/ /srid gsum dbang bsgyur 'dzad med gter gyi ngadag/ rab dkar zhal ras zla rgyas 'dzum pa'i mdangs/ /srid zhi'i dge rma tshan 'gugs pa'i lha chen po/ /ma g.yel ma g.yel sngags kyi ting 'dzin gyi / /rab dkar gser skyem mchod pa 'di bzhes la/ /ngur smig 'chang ba rig 'dzin bdag cag gis/ /bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan phyogs bcur bsgrings pa yi/ /rnam dkar rten 'brel sgrig pa'i sdo nga grogs mdzod/ /'khor lo'i bsgyur mdzad nam mkha'i pha mthar brdal/ /lhag bsam rim gnyis—bstan pa'i khur bzhes pa'i/ /bsam pa'i gsos sman mdzad pa'i byin rlabs phob/ /dag snang phyogs med rgyas pa'i nyi gzhon gyis/ /bde skyid rdzogs ldan dpal la spyod par mdzod/ /gamar skyong la rtse ma zas stobs ldan nong bu dgra 'joms kyi bsang mchod/ /bapa/ rmad byung bkra shis gser ldan 'dzin ma'i ltor/ /ngo mtshar dpal gyis rab mdzes lha yi rdzong / /phyi ltar rte mkhar pho brang dam pa —dang / /nang lta ra lha yi dkyil 'khor gzhal med lang / /gsang ba bde stong ting 'dzin gyis sgrul ba'i / /yid bzhin 'dod gu'i rab gter sum rtsen gyi/ /brgya byin khang bzang thig ler 'a bas pa yi/ /dge mtshan jam brjid mdzes pa'i gzhal yas khang / /rma sras stobs ldan nor bu dgra 'dul rtsal/ /sku mdog dmar nag phyag g.yas mdung dar 'dzin/ /g.yon pas nor gzhung dgos 'dod rab gter zhing / /khrab chag gsol zhing stag ral gzig shub bcings/ /rlung ltar rab mgyogs rta mchog rag gir bcibs/ yum sras bka' 'khor tshogs kyis spyan 'dren na/ /ma thog grog ltar shugs kyis myur 235

byon la/ /yid 'ong rten gnas 'di la brtan par bzhugs/ /dngos yod phyag rgya ting 'dzin gyis sprul ba'i/ /phyi nang gsang gsum 'dod yon mchod pa'i tshogs/ /ro brgya'i bcud ldan bza' bca' btung ba dang / /'khan shug ba lu lha shing sman sna dang / /dkar gsum mngar gsum bsang dang sman rdzas gtor/ /ja chang skyems dang phyi nang spyan gzigs dang / bkra shis rtags rdzas la sogs lha mi'i rdzas/ /ma tshang med pa'i mchod sprin rgya mtsho 'di/ /mchod do gsol lo bstan pa'i bya ra mdzod/ /bdag cag mi nor gzhis byes kun du yang / /kha 'dzin rgyab rten dpung shugs rtag mdzod la/ /gnod cing 'tshe ba'i sdang dgra myur tu sgrol/ /zhi rgyas dbang grags 'phrin las sgrub pa dang / /nad 'khrugs mu ge dus kyi rgud pa sogs/ /phyi nang 'gal rkyen zhu zhing mthun rkyen sgrub/ /rgyal bstan bsrung la nam yang g.yer med shog/lhag bsam dag pas tshul 'dir brtson pa na/ /tshangs dang dbang pos 'jigs rten skyong pa dang / /stobs ldan nor bu dgra 'joms la sogs pa'i/ /yul lha rnams kyis rtag tu grogs byed shog/gnyis/ lha klu gnyan gsum dang gdon bgegs btsan gsum sogs la ngos 'dzin zul/dmangs khrod nas de dag la ngos 'dzin tshul ni chos gzhung dang bsdur na cung zad khyad par yod de/ sbyi'i khyad chos ni de dag gang yin kyang phyogs ris kyi mig dang ldan pas bkur na grogs byed pa dang / ma bkur na ngan gtong bar byed zer/1 lha'i lta tshul/ /steng ma lha ste lha ni bar snang khams na gnas bca' ba'i sems can shin tu mthu nus chen po can zhig yin te/ des 'jig rten kham la dbang gyed pa yin pas/ rgyun par mi la nad tsha dang byugs la god kha sogs mi gtong ched/ mi rnams kyis lha la mchod pa dbyer med byed dgos/ lha'i nang gi 236

kun la rgyus che ba ni lha chen tshangs ba dkar po dang lha'i dbang po brgya byin/ge sar sgrung nang gi gnam a ne gong sman rgyal mo sogs yod/ de min lha ni zad mi shes pa'i bde skyid ldan pa dang blo rig shin tu skyen pa zhig yin par 'dod/ dper na/ sa skyid po lha yul lta bu zhes pa dang / mi blo rig can 'ig yin na 'di lha gnyid log cig gi rnam shes red zer ba lta bu red/ / 4 klu'i lta tshul/ /klu ni chu la gnas pa'i sems can zhig yin te/ des phal cher mi rnams kyi dbul phyug dang nad yams la bdag byas yo da/ de ches mi dga' sa ni dmar dang mi gtsang ba yin pas/ chu mgo'i nang du khrag bgro ru 'jug pa'am mi gtsang ba 'dre bar shin tu gzab gzab byed dgos/ gal srid de dag la 'thus shor byung na mi lus la rma rigs skrang rigs 'bud pa dang /rkang lag zha 'theng du 'gro ba/ phyugs la god kha rgyugs pa lta bu'i mi legs pa 'byung / /2 gnyan dang btsan gyi lta tshul/ /spyir btang du de gnyis ka lha'i phyogs gtogs shig la brtsi dus kyang yod mod/ gnas yul gyi cha nas btsan khis kha dang gnyan la 'og zhes pa ltar/ btsan ni ri rtse dang / nyag kha/ sgang rgyud/ sgo phyi khyim gyi mtshams sogs na rgyu bas/ gal srid de mi dang 'phrad na kha sna g.yon pa dang ngag 'khyer ba sogs su bshad/ gnyan ni brag sna dang / lung 'gag pha bong sogs su gnas yod par 'dod la/ rgyun par de sa gnyan sa zhig red zer ba thos shing / thun te'i nang lung du'ang sa gnyan rdo gnyan zer ba'i sa ming yod/ gnyan ni phyugs la god kha dang mi la nad tsha gtong mkhan zhig yin pas/ na par sa gnyan sa nas 'gro skabs gzab gzab byed dgos par bshad/ sde ba tsho ba dang mi sger gyis bstod pa'i gzhi bdag phal cher ni btsan gnyan gnyiyokyi khongs sa'adu la/ de gnyis la shin tu phyogs ris che 231

bas gzhi bdag mi gcig pa'i bar nas bsang dud 'dre ba yan chad la shin tu gzab dgos pa red/ rgyun par mi rnams kyis gzhi bdag dkar phyogs pa dang nag phyogs pa gnyis su gcod la/ dkar phyogs pa de bstod dgos shing / nag phyogs pa der 'dzems dgos pa red/ /4 gdon bgegs kyi lta tshul/ /spyir btang du gdon bgegs gnyis la khyad par med par 'dod mod/skabs la lar khyad par cung zad btod sa yang yod/ de gnyis 'dra sa ni phal cher gnyis ka gzugs med nus pa lta bu zhig yin te/ gnas sa ni mi gzhan gyis bkol phyong ba'i ca lag dang / spyon pa/ phyugs zog de min dngos po gzhan gyi thog yin/ gdon yin min ni tsho ba dang khyim tshang mi sger bcas rang ngos nas thag gcod pa las de'i gzhan ngos na med/ rgyu mtshan ni phyugs zog zhig gam dngos po zhig tsho ba dang khyim tshang mi sger zhig gi g.yang yin mod/ de gzhan gyi sar song na gdon du 'gro ba lta bu red/ de be+e bsten pa'i srung ma dang mchod pa'i gzhi bdag yang na mi'i bar gyi bla gshed la bzang ngan shor na 'gal zlar 'gro ba red/ de 'gog dgos na gzhan gyi gon rgyu dang dngos po mi bkol ba dang / srung ma mi gcig sa nas sgo phyugs dang dngos rdzas mi nyo ba dang / nyos kyang gdon sel cho ga nges can sgrub dgos pa red/ gal srid dngos po sogs gdon tshar na mo dang rtsis mngon mkhyen sogs la bsten nas ngos bzung ste med par bzo dgos pa red/5 than ltas dang 'gong bo'i lta tshul/than lhas ni rang gi tshe dang bsod nams dang snyan grags dang lam 'gro sogs la gnod pa'i rtags mtshan zhig la go ste/ dper na/ khyim tshang la 'gro skabs thal ba dang khyim phyags 'pho bar 'phrad na rlung rta nyams pa'i lhas ngan la go ba dang / lab tser thog gis brgyab pa dang bsang khri zhig pa sogs ni dgra lha nyams pa'i ltas ngan du go ba/ 'ug pa dang pho rog grags 238

na za'i bar chad 'byung ba'i ltas ngan du go ba lha bu red/ /'gong bo ni zas bcud sogs nyams pa'i nus pa zhig la go ste/ de 'gog par g.yang sgrub dang mnol bsang 'don dgos pa red/ /ji g.yang dang rlung rta/ / g.yang ni stobs dang bcud sogs 'dzin pa'i nus pa'am stobs shugs zhig la ngos 'dzin de/ dper na/ mi rgyud mang por 'phel na mi g.yang 'khor zer ba dang / phyugam zog mang du 'phel na phyugs g.yang 'khor zer ba lta bu red/ nor gyi rnga rtsid dang lu gu'i rna sne mang po mnyam gcig tu bzhag pa de la g.yang ra zer zhing de'i nang du rgyu nor gyi bcud 'dzoms par mtshon pas/ sbra'i ya phug la bkal nas mi 'gong bar byas yod la/ da dung g.yang sgrub sogs kyi chos lugs kyi cho ga yang rgyas pa zhig byed srol yod/rlung rta ni las dang bya ba thams cad lam du 'gro ba dang / mtshan dang snyan grags rgyas bar byed pa'i mi mngon pa'i nus pa zhig yin la/ de'i rtags mtshan ni rta mchog nor bu khur ba zhig yin te/ stobs rtsal che zhing myur la dgos 'dod ci 'byung gi don mtshon yod/ /bzhi ba/ dgon gong ma'i chos lugs dad mos kyi gnas tshul/dgon gong ma reb gong nas chad de mar 'ongs pa'i dus su tsho rteng bzhi bor spyi ba zhig las dgon pa zhig nges gtan du med la/ spyi ba'i spyi dpon nam bla ma ni yo'u rgya sku zeng dang po ste bla ma dbu dkar ba tshang yin/ de dus spyi ba'i 'don chos ni ha lam gsar rnying 'dres ma yin la/ grub mtha'i phyogs ris ni med do/ srung ma ni tor mo dang rgyal po bsten/ chos thog dang / 'don chos/ bca' kha phyag len/ nang rten/ ban sngags kyi grangs sogs rjes su dpag dka' bas re zhig bzhag bla ma dbu dkar ba khong gi bzhugs gnas ni rka rgan bu dgu lung ba yin la/ dgongs pa chos 239

dbyings su thim rjes sku gdung lung ba'i brag ngos shig tu bzhus pa'i shul da lta'ang mngon sum du mjal rgyu yod ces ya ga 'jigs blos gsungs so/de'i rjes su tshogs rnam zer ba zhig 'khrungs te/ des rdo grub kun bzang gzhan phan mtha' yas dang / dzogs chen chos dbyings stobs ldan bla mar bsten nas/ khong gi ring la yo'u rgya'i spyi ba zur tu btsugs shing / 'od gsal snying dzig gi bstan pa dar bar byas/ yi dam sgrub pa bka' brgyad btsugs/ chos skyong la ma gza' dam gsum bsten/ srung ma'i gtso bo gza' yin/ dus der ྅ nag dang dpa' mchog gnyis kyis ras mo che lto sprad nas mnyam du chos thog 'dzin cing / 'don chos ni gsar rnying 'dres mar mdzad/ dus rgyun gyi chos spyod kyi rim pa ni so sor byed kyang / lo re'i bzhi ba'i nang dgon gong mas mnyam du chos thog 'dzin pa'i srol ni sbyi lo 1934lo'i bar gnas so/ /dgon gong ma sngon chad reb gong shog kha bcu gnyis kyi gras yin pas mā chis gser lag ma brgyab pa'i yar sngon la/ lo skor bcu gnyis kyi nang du rong bo dgon par mang 'gyed thengs gcig gtong srol yod/ 1922lor gser lag mā chi yis rgyag skabs rong bo shog kha nas dpung rogs la dmag mang yong zhes dpa' mchog tshul dbang gis rong bo la gyod brgyab ste nang so'i mgo la gri ltag gis brgyab skad/ de nas bzung rong bo dgon chen la mang 'gyed gtong ba'i rgyun bcad de 1985lo bar lo ngo drug cu re gsum 'das/1985lor ya ga 'dzigs blo dang dpa' mchog 'bum pa/ dpa' mchog blo bstan/ g.yer skyong khro kho/ nywa nag dbyig gnyen sogs kyis gros byas te mang 'gyed kyi rgyun mthud/ skabs der rten 'brel gyi khyad par la dmigs te rong bo dgon chen dang dgon gong ma gnyis kyis sangs rgyas sman bla bde gshegs brgyad kyi zhal thang bzhengs te gsum dgon chen du bzhugs su ཿgsol/ lnga dgon gong mar gdan drangs te tsho ba res zhapa thang re bdag 2 0

byas/ /dgon gong ma gser lag gi lha sder nam gyur ba de yang rgya bza' rma chu sngon mo'i phar phyogs su spos pa'i rjes tsam yin la/ ha lam dus rabs bco brgyad pa'i mjug tsam yin shas che/ dgon gong ma gser lag gi lha sder gyur rjes rgya bza'i grwa ba rim gyis je nyung du song ste dgon gong ma'i grwa bas khengs/ de nas bzung tsho rting bzhi bos res mos su gser lag la mang 'gyed gtong ba dang / nyin dkar 'dzin pa/ tshogs 'gyed byed pa/smon lam 'dzin pa/ dgon par khur ci dang gang yod thams cad rang nus ci spyog gis khur/ /dgon gong ma'i nang sangs rgyas chos lugs la yongs khyab du dad pa byed de/ khyim tshang zhig la mtshon na'ang ma ṇi 'khor lo yod pa dang / cha rkyen la bsdun nas mdo gdugs sgrol gsum dang skyabs 'gro stung bshags ma ṇi sogs kyi lag 'khor dang sgam 'khor/ me 'khor/ chu 'khor/ rlung 'khor sogs yod la/ rgyu yi sgo nas 'khor lo dngul gyis btums shing g.yu byur gyi phras brgyan pa can dang / zangs kyis btums pa/ gos chen gyis btums pa/ ko yis btums pa sogs yod/ rgyun par pho mo rgan gagon thams cad kyis shes tshad kyis kha ton bzlas brjod dang phyag dang skor ba mchod bshams sems bskyed sogs la rtag par brtson zhing / chos dpe gsar bar blus pa zhig yin na rab byung pa zhig gdan drangs nas gser zhag 'don pa dang / chos dpe'i glegs bam 'khur pa dang ma ṇi bskor te sbra la skor ba rgyag pa/ bla mas dbang gsung pa sogs kyi skabs su dge ba khas len pa dang / sdug rgyun gcod/ sbra'i sgo phug tu sgo dar dang phug dar dar sngog sogs 'then pa/ rgyun par bsang 'phud cing gsur gtong bar byed/ sa gang tu spu gur pibs na de yi sgor sasmo 'debs pa dang / sa chu me rlung ste 'byung ba bzhi la dam pa'i gzugs brnyan dpar bar byed/ brag ngos dang ཿ 1

rdo leb sogs kyi ngos su mchod rten dang ma ṇi sogs brkos te sa gtsang sa dang mtho sar 'jog pa/ ja gsar bskol ma 'thung ba'i sngon du dkon mchog gsum la mchod pa byed pa/ chu len skabs chu zo ru ma bcus pa'i sngon du dkon mchog gsum la chu gtsang mas mchod pa/ sos ka ri mgor 'gro skabs me tog ma dzes pa zhig mthong na'ang khyer yong nas mchod mdun du bshams pa/ tshes pa bco lnga sogs dus chen gyi nyin la ri mgor song nas lha bsang btang ste dung 'bud pa dang / rlung rta 'phyar ba/ na par sman lha stong mchod sgrol ma la sogs pa'i bca' ba rim gro sgrub cing / ma ṇi dung phyur bton rte 'grub song ba'i khyim pa pho mo yang mang po yod/ da dung nub tsha'i rjes su mdo gdugs sgrol gsum dang skyabs 'gro gu ru sisnyi/ dmigs brtse ma sogs bzlas 'don byed pa dang / bud med rnams kyis bzhon ma bzho skabs sgrol ma nyer bstod dbyangs la gyer nas 'don pa dang / mar gtsang mar bzhus te mchod me 'jog pa/ dus chen gyi skabs su bsnyen gnas bsrung pa (rtsa ba bzhi dang chang dang gar phreng sogs/ mal stan ches mtho/ phyi dro'i kha zas te yan lag bzhi bcas nyin 'ag gcig spong bar khas blangs pa'i so thar gyi sdom pa)/ rtags rten 'brel gyi ston mo byed skabs ban sngags gang rung zhig gdan drangs te/ dar tshon sna lngas brgyan pa'i g.yang mda' 'phyar/ 'bri mar dang rtsam pa gang rung gis g.yang ra ba sgo ba'i bzhengs te/ de'i sgo re rer rta dang / lug nor/ ra ma bcas bzhi bzos te banag gser 'od g.yang skyabs dang / sgrol ma'i g.yang 'gug nor bdag dzam lha'i g.yang 'bod byas te bkra shis pa'i g.yang dang / tshe ring ba'i g.yang / bsod nams kyi g.yang / rgyu nor dpal 'byor 'phel ba'i g.yang / rlung rta'i g.yang sogs ma lus par blan no/ /mi zhig 'tsho bar ma gyur tshe/ bla ma gang rung zhig gdan drangs te 'pho ba smon lam gsungs pa dang / phar dzong bla ma la grangs bcad nges pa med 2 2

par phar la zhu'am tshur la gdan 'dren pa gang ltar yang rung ste/ de la sngas mgo'i bla ma zer zhing 'das bor bsngo smon byed do/ grwa ba bzhi sdes bdun 'dzugs pa dang / sngags gsar ma yin na kun rig dang sngags rnying ma yin na zhi khyo 'don/ yang na gsar rnying zung gi bdun yang 'dzugs la/'don bca' ni rang rang so so'i lugs ltar byed do/ /gshin po'i khyim bdag gis dgon pa so so dang a lags rnams la bsngo rten 'jog pa dang khyim mis bsnyen gnas bsrung pa/ rab yin na bsnyen gnas chog brgyad bsrung ngo /gshin po'i sgrib spyong du zhag zhe dgur a mchod bzhag ste thar mdo bzla ba dang / gnas shul du ma ṇi sogs gzungs sngags brko ba dang dar lhog 'then pa/ lo re'i dus ran la dge rtsa sgrub pa dang / gzhan rtsi shing nags tshal bcad na nyes pa yod ces gtor brlag mi byed pa dang / sa gtsang sar gad snyigs mi 'dor ba/ skyed pu'i sa las sa mi rko ba/ ri dwags bsad na sdeg sgrib che zhing kha mi sos bsod nams zad ces kun mi dge ba'i las la brtsi/ phug ron ni sgrol ma'i bla bya yin zer la rgyun du sus kyang gnod 'tshe mi byed pa'i dbang gis sgo khyim dang mi'i gam du bag yangs su rgyu ba mthong /'tsho ba gtso bo mar chur dang rtsam pa yin la/ sha za ba yang nor lug ra gsum las srog chags gang gi sha yang mi za/ sngon chad gnyen ston skabs su nor lug mang bo bsha' bar grags kyang / da lta sdug par 'dzems pa dang gron chung byed ched dkar khyab (sha ma yin pa'i bza' btung )gtso bo byed/sha za dus ma ṇi zhig bton ) bsad zin pa de'i ched rig bshags byed/nang rkus byed mkhan dang rgyu 'bras mi brtsi pa la mtha' gcig tu dgagagashis rgyud bzang zhing dad gus can la rjes su yi rang byed cing / bsam pa bzang na sa dang lam yang bzang / bsam pa ngan na sa dang lam yang ngan zhes pa skyes pho mo kun gyi nang na mi shes pa med/gong du bkod pa ni dgon gong ma'i dmangs srol gyi phyogs tsam yin la/2 3

da dung lus rtsal gyi rtsed mo'i phyogs nas rta rgyugs pa dang / 'ju res byed pa/ kyi mo phrag la len pa/ glang chen sa gshags sogs yod cing / rtsom rig sgyu rtsal thad nas ge sar rgyal po'i sgrung dang / dmangs khrod kyi gna' gtam dang ngag rgyun/ gtam dpe/ khed/ bshad pa ston bshad/sa bstod chu bstod/ kha shag sogs yod)/ gru(glu shag dang / bstod gluchos glu sogs yod)/ la gzhas/ be+er dkar sogs mang po yod kyang de dag re re nas bris na nang don rgya che song bas re zhig 'jog par bya/2

le'u bdun pa/dgon gong ma'i dgon sde dang spyi ba'i lo rgyus/ /dang po/ /gser lag dgon dge ldan phun tshogs bstan rgyas gling gi lo rgyas/ /gleng gzhi/gser lag dgon dga' ldan phun tshogs sgrung ni/ rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i bgrang bya dgu ba shing phag (1695)lor se ra'i dge bshes stag phrug gis phyag 'debs gnang nas da lta bar lo ngo sum brgya lhag phyin yod pas/mtsho sngon lho rgyud kyi dgon sde dag gi khrod nas btab pa snga thos kyi gras yin/ /mnyam med 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi rnam sgrul 4rig dge bshes chen mo7byams pa dge legs rgyal mtshan dang / skyabs rje shing bza' pani— ta7blo bzang dar rgyas rnam gnyes ni dgon 'di'i grwa rgyun snga ma'i gras su gtogs shing / so sor rtsa ba'i bdag po rgya li sku phreng gnyis pa blo bzang bstan dar dang / bstan pa'i bdag po gtsang pa dge bshes blo bzang chos 'phel las rab tu byung zhing chos sgor zhugs shing / phyis su bod khams yongs la snyan grags 'bar ba'i mkhas pa chen po'i go 'phangs bzhes/ /dge bshes stag phrug gis se ra rje btsun pa'i yig cha ltar mtshan nyid btsugs te/ 'chad nyan gyi 'azin las rgyas pa'i lo rgyus yod pa dang / nye rabs kho nar mtshon nas bshad na'ang khrims ldan 'dus pa'i gtsug rgyan lung dang rtogs pa'i thugs rgyud byug pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po rje 2 5

'jam dbyangs rgya mtsho'am mtshan gzhan a khu don ldan rin po che dang /mkhas pa'i dbang po rje byams pa chos grub/ 'dul 'dzin bya btang rje blo bzang yar 'phel/ dge bshes bsam gtan rgya mtsho/ gle ba dge bshes sogs gnas lnga rig pa'i pha mthar son pa mang po byon/ /khyad par tu dgon pa 'di ni sgrub pa snying por mdzad pa'i chos sde bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig yin te/ a rig rdo rje 'chang rje btsun 'jam dbyangs shes rab dang / o'u rgya rdo rje 'chang 'jam dbyangs mkhyen rab dpal —bzang sogs grub pa'i dbang byug yang byon myong / /dgon 'di'i chos thog sgrub mchod dang 'don rta dbyangs sogs kyi thad nas mtshan snyan mdo smad la khyab cing / chos sde 'di'i dbang drag rol ba'i dga' tshal zhes pa'i gtsug lag khang du gtso bor bkur ba'i rta mgrin yang gsang gi sku las chos thog dus mchod kyi skabs su zhal mdangs 'gyur pa'i mthong snang dang khyung gshog gi sgra 'byin pa'i rtags ya mtshan thon la/ chos skyong rgya li'i bag tse dmar sdang ma zhes pa dgon par chags 'dzigs ya nga ba gang zhig byung pa'i skabs su yang dgon par 'bral ma myong / sku byin can des gnad 'gag gi skabs su mthu nus thon tshul khyim pa rgan po'i ngag na'ang mang po thos rgyu yod/ /chos kyi 'gro 'ong gi thad nas gser lag dgon 'di rwa rgya dang 'brel ba shin tu che ste/ rwa rgya'i bdag po ya rig dge bshes chen mo dang shing bza' pani ta rnam gnyis gser lag gi grwa rgyun yin par ma zad/ rgya li sku phreng bzhi ba ye shes byub bstan dar rgyas lags rwa rgya'i khri rgan dge 'dun phun tshogs kyi tsha bor sku 'khrungs rjes/ khri rin po che khong tshab tu gser lag gi dgon bdag la phebs nas bka' drin gzhal du med pa bskyangs pas/sngar sa phyogs mang por spor kyang dgon sa 'dzin ma thub pa'i gnas tshul de nas bzung ma byung par dgon sa brtan por zin/ khri rgan tshang gis rwa rgya'i 246

brtsi bzhag byams pa bla grags gdan drangs nas 'chad nyan la dag ther gnang 'ing sgrub mchod so gas kyi phyag len phal cher rwa rgyar bstun/ shing bza' pani tas gser lag la thugs khur mdzad pa zhal gyis bzhes te dargon pa gnyis kyi chos srid bya ba la gcig mthun gyi thugs bkod bzung / dper na/ rab byung bco lnga pa'i chu phag ( 1922)lor mā jag gis gser lag dgon par gtor brlag tshab chen bzos rjes/ rwa rgya dgon gzhung nas lha rten chos gsum dang gzhan pa'i 'byor ba gang ci'i thad nas rogs skyor chen po gnang / rab byung bcu bzhi pa'i me lug lor rje gamer khang pa chen po dbus gtsang phyogs nas sku gshegs rjes sku gdung chos sde gzhan gyi lag nas ma lon pa'i skabs der/ gser lag gtsang pa lngags nag pa byams pa bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho phebs nas gnas lugs sgul med kyis pha rol bo smra bcad skug pa'i lam la bkod de sku gdung byin can rwa rgyar gdan 'dren thub pa byung / yang dus rabs nyi shu ba'i stod tsam la ting rgya sgar nas ya rig dge bshes chen mo'i sku gdung bzhengs srol gyi thad nas sgo me sngags mang dang 'gal ba byung ba'i skabs su/ gser lag a khu rta dge tshang phebs nas gyod kha mchu bsdum pa sogs 'brel 'dris rgyun tu byung / /gzhan bla brang bkra shis 'khyil dang rong bo dgon chen lde tsha bkra shis chos sdings sogs la'ang chos kyi 'brel ba byung yod/ dper na/ kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs ba'ad pa sku phreng bzhi ba dang sku gzhogs shar tshang rnam gnyis la dgon pa'i bya ba rnams zhu dus gzigs skyong gnang pa zhal kyis bzhes shing / kun mkhyen sku phreng lnga ba sku gshegs rjes bla brang dgon pas gser lag dgon la sku tshab mngags nas gdung skal gnang pa dang grwa tshang la dngul 'gyed btang ste dgongs rdzogs rgya chen po bsgrubs/ /lde tsha ni gser lag grwa ba slob gnyer la 'gro sa gtso bo yin te/ snga rjes su zhwa dmar pani ta'i thugs kyi sras bo lung dang rtogs pa'i thugs rgyud 2 7

phyug pa'i rje 'jam dbyangs rgya mtsho dang / mkhas pa'i dbang po rje byams pa chos grub/ 'dul 'dzin blo bzang yar 'phel/ smad sog sgrul ba'i sku/dge bshes bsam gtan rgya mtsho/ gle ba dge bshes sogs mkhagashing grub pa'i skyes chen dam pa mang po byon pas / bar skabs shig la lde tsha'i bstan pa gser lag gis bzung yod ces pa'i mtshan snyan thob/dgon pa'i mchod gzhi'i lha sde'i cha nas bshad na thog mar ya rig gis byas shing / de nas rim bzhin du rong bo blon chos tsā rteng gsum dang hor tsho bzhi/ dgon gong 'og bar gsum/ sha sbrang tsho drug 'ba' lung rong sde/ mgar rtse tsho ba bco brgyad sogs yod/ dus dang gnas tshul khyad par can la rkyen byas nas dgon pa'i mchod gzhis dang grwa rgyun yong khungs gtso bo la thengs du mar 'gyur ldog byung na'ang de dag gang yin kyang dgon pa'i 'dzugs sgrun dang 'phel rgyas la byas rjes mi dman pa bzhag myong /thog mar a rig la mtshon na dgon pa gsar 'dzugs kyi dus su rkyen sna tshogs kyi dbang gis 'debs sa zengs du mar spor skabs rgyu 'byor ba phangs med btang ste rgyab skyor byas pas dgon sa zin par rtsa ba'i mthun rkyen bsgrun/de min hor tsho bzhi dang sha sbrang tsho drug dgon gong 'og bar gsum la mtshon na'ang dgon par chags 'jig dang dar rgud du mar byung ba'i skabs su rgyu nor dang tha na tshe srog la'ang ma bltos par dgon par rgyab skyor byas/dper na/ spyi lo1923lor mā jag gis dgon pa rgyag par 'gog rgol byed skabs hor gyi mi brgya dang lnga bcu lhag dang dgon gong ma'i mi bzhi cu lhag gi rang srog blos btang / 'di dag gis rnam dkar las 'bras bsags pa ni dgon pa'i lo rgyus dang mnyam gnas yin/ /rang cag mnga' zhabs pa'i mchod yul dam pa 'di nyid mi lo brgya phrag gi kyag kyog lam phreng brgyud nas da lta'i tshad 'di 'dra zhig la 'apel rgyas byung zhing / bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu mang pos bstan pa dang sems can gyi don du 2 8

mdzad rjes bsam gyis mi khyab pa bzhag yod mod/ 'on kyang / da lta zer sgros rags ram tsam la brten pa las lo rgyus dag cing kha gsal ba zhig 'bri rgyu med pa 'di shin tu phangs/ kho bos gser lag dgon pa 'dis sngon chad gdan rabs stabs bde tsam yang thor bkod med pa'i rgyu mtshan la rtsad bcad rjes gnas tshul 'di 'dra zhig shes yong / khong tshos a rig dge bshes chen mo'i phyag srol ltar 'dul 'dzin bya btang ri khrod pa'i brtul zhugs kho na 'dzin pa las/ che 'dod grags 'dod sogs 'jig rten chos brgyad kyi dbang du phra mo tsam yang mi 'gro ba dam tshig tu bsrung yod pas/bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen dag gis rang gi chos dang 'jig rten gyi che ba brjod par gtan nas mi mos par rags las yod/ da thengs yang kho bo dgon pa gsar dar la bka' drin shin tu che ba'i smad sog sprul ba'i sku blo bzang legs bshad rgya mtsho tshang gi mdun du khong gi mdzad rnam bka' 'dri byed du song dus/ khong gis nga la bsgrags chog pa'i byas rjes ci yang med/dgon pa da skabs kyi tshad 'di 'dra cig la thon pa ni sngar gyi bla ma bka' drin can dag gi thugs bskyed smon lam dang / grwa tshang thun mong gi sku drin yin/khyod kyis nga la che che grags grags dang 'jig rten chos brgyad kyi dbang du mi 'gro ba'i chos rnam dag cig sgrub tu chug ces gsungs pas gnas tshul gzhan nas rgyus lon mi byed ka med byung / /dgon pa'i lo rgyus 'di'i gzhi 'dzin sa gtso bo ni dge bshes byams pa thogs med lags kyis zin bris gnang pa'i dpyad gzhi rnams yin la/khong gis bsgrigs pa'i dpyad gzhi 'di dag med na lo rgyus 'di 'dra zhig 'bri ba'i gzhi med pa red/ de min thun te dzong srid gros kyi kru'u zhi gzhon pa sman pa blo bzang bzod pa lags kyis 'brel yod lo tshugs dang bla ma skyes chen dam pa dag gi mdzad rjes mthong thos ci rigs mtshams sbyor gnang pa dang /dzong slob gso zhib 'jug khang gi kru'u rin dge rgan bstan 'phel lags kyis 249

yo'u rgya rdo rje 'chang mkhyen rab dpal bzang tshang gi rnam thar dpe rgyun dkon po zhig gi mthun rkyen sbyar ba sogs gzhogs 'degs shugs chen byas pa la snying thag pa nas rjes su yi rangs byed/ /lo rgyus 'di'i yig thog gi zur blta byed sa ni mdo smad chos 'byung deb theb ther rgya mtsho 〉dang / rong bo dgon chen gyi gdan rabs / rje zhabs dkar pa'i rnam thar / rje gser khang ba'i rnam thar / kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs ba'ad pa sku phreng bzhi ba'i rnam thar sogs yin/ lo rgyus deb ther 'de dag gi nang du gser lag dang 'brel ba'i gnas tshul thar thor re yod par dpyad pa btang na bla ma 'ga' re'i mdzad rjes dang 'khrungs 'das kyi lo tshugs gtan 'a bas byed pa la gzhi 'dzin sa cung zad re rnyed thub/ dper na/ a rig dge bshes chen mo chung dus nas mi gzhi dang shes rab legs pas rgya li sgrul sku blo bzang bstan dar gyis yab yum las bslangs te bskyangs zhes mdo smad chos 'byung 〉du byung pa las rgya li blo bzang bstan dar gyi 'khrungs 'das la nges shes cung zad rnyed thub pa dang /yang shing bza' paṇ+ḍi ta rab byung bcu gsum pa'i sa yos (1759)lor sku 'khrungs pa dang / dgung lo brgyad pa (1766)la gtsang ba blo bzang chos 'phel las rab tu byung tshul bkod yod pa las/ ngag rgyun du gtsang pa blo bzang tshos 'phel nyid dge bshes stag phrug dang mnyam du a mdor phebs nas dgon pa 'debs grogs byas par grags pa de dngos don min pa bden dpang byas yod/ rgyu mtshan ni rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i shing phag (16kyi5)lor dge bshes stag phrug gis dgon pa thog mar 'debs skabs dgung lo zhe lnga yas mas yin pa de ltar na/ gtsang ba tshang khong dang lo tshod mi mnyam na yang ma mtha' dgung lo sum bcu lhag la bud yod pas/ me khyi (1766)lor shing bza' tshang dgung lo brgyad kyi steng rab byung sgrub skabs gtsang pa tshang phal cher dgung lo brgyar bud yod pa de phal cher mi srid pas/ phyis su 250

rgya li sku phreng gnyis pa blo bzang bstan dar gyis dgon pa chags ma thub pa'i gnas tshul paṇa chen sku phreng drug pa dpal ldan ye shes la zhus dus bca' yig mdzad cing gtsang bkra shis lhun pos bsten pa'i bag tse lcam sring dgon pa'i chos skyong la gnang ba yongs su grags yod pa bzhin du gtsang gi dge bshes mkhas pa blo bzang chos 'phel yang de dus rgya li tshang la 'chad nyan spel grogs su mngags par byas na don dngos dang mthun phyogs che bar snang / de min dgon pa gser lag la ma spor ba'i yar sngon dgon ming la phun tshogs rnam rgyal gling zer ba dang phyis su paṇa chen sku phreng drug pas ming de gzhir bzung ba'i thog dga' ldan phun tshogs bstan rgyas gling du bcos pa yin tshul togs thub la/ dgon pa lha ri de'u dkar nas 'debs ma thub pa'i rgyu rkyen gtso bo gzhi bdag nag phyogs pa'i stabs lus pa yin tshul shes pa dang / gzhan zhabs dkar tshogs drug rang grol dang 'jam bzhad sku phreng ba'i ba rje gser khang ba sogs dam pa rnams gser lag la pebs tshul bkod yod pa sogs las de'i skabs kyi dgon pa'i gnas tshul shes bar yang phan pa byung /dper na/ kun mkhyen sku zeng bzhi ba skal bzang ye shes kyi rnam thar tu khong dgongs lo zhe gcig (rab tshes me sprel spyi lo1896lo ) steng brag dkar sprel rdzong du gnas skor tu song / hor sde gzhung la rigs gsum mgon po sogs kyi klags lung sprul skabs gser lag dgon gzhung nas gdan 'dren pa chu stod zla ba'i tshes gnyis nyin 'byor/ tshes bdun nas dpal mchog dang nywa nag sogs kyis rta bsu byas/ ja zhus kha shas blangs/ tshes bcu gcig nyin gser lag dgon pas zhags bsu/ nyin bsu/ ser spreng bcas phebs/ tshogs chen 'du khang nang nas ser skya dad ldan mang po la/grub rgyal lugs kyi tshe dbang dang lam gtso'i lung gnang / rta nor gos phrug sogs tshan grangs mang po'i maṇ+ḍal btegs/ bcu gsum la sprel dzong du thegaphyir lam bdun pa'i mas lnga la gser lag tu phebs/ nor bu ri rgyal gyi ri ཿ51

rtser phyin te lha bsang btang / ri rgyal gyi bsang yig zhig kyang bris/ mas bdun la bskyod/ mdzo mo na mi wan nas nyin 'gar zhag mal bgyis/dpal mchog chos lo sogs kyi ja zhus blangs/ yang skyabs mgon tshang —dgung lo zhe lnga'i rgya lo'i nang ya lag rgya bza' dang gtsang ba sogs kyis ras phrug sogs dngos 'bul btegs te zhus ngor/ gser tog che legs shig gser lag dgon la gnang / zhes bkod yod pa sogs lta bu red/ /dang po/ /dgon pa gnasabal gyi che ba bajod pa/dzi skad du bka' gdams glegs bam las/ kye gangs ri'i mgon po spyan ris gzigs/ /gnas de na khyod kyi zhing khams yod/ /zhing de na khyod kyi gdul bya yod/ /ces rnam 'dren phyag na pad+mo'i gdul zhing du lung bstan pa'i gangs can kha ba ri ba'i zhing mchog 'di nyid chol kha gsum du phyes pa las mdo smad rta'i chol kha/ ba yan ha ri'i shar ngos kyi chu rnams phyogs 'dres kyis rma g.yang phyug mor 'bab pa la rma chur grags pa'i 'argyu khug ba bdag 'khor lo sdom pa dang / 'phags mchog phyag na pad+mo'i zhing khams/dngos don rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i ye shes rang snang las grub pa'i gnas mchog brag dkar sprel rdzong gi shar phyogs/ rgyal kun ye shes kyi rang gzugs 'phags pa 'jam dpal ngur smig gar gyi rnam par rol ba 'jam mgon tsong kha pa chen po bltams pa'i gnas mchog sku 'bum byams pa gling gi lho phyogs/ mdo sngags bstan pa'i 'byung gnas dge ldan bshad sgrub dar rgyas bkra shis kun nas 'khyil ba'i gling gi nub phyogs/ rwa spreng gnyis pa rwa rgya bkra shis 'byung gnas bshad sgrub dar rgyas gling gi byang phyogs/ bde ldan zhing gi mgon po pan chen thams cad mkhyen pa dpal ldan ye shes mchog gis gnas 'khor lo rtsib brgyad 'dra ba'i yan lag lung gsum chu gsum 'dus pa'i mdo/beg tse gtso 'khor gsum gyi bla ri dngos su mngon pa'i gnas zhes dngos su lung bstan pa'i yul khyad par can/ shar gyi phyogs su 'jam mgon bla mas 252

bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan mthon por bsgrings pa'i rten 'brel du/ mdo smad rtse drug snying bdun du grags pa'i ya gyal sa 'dzin mdzo mo nu rtse rgyal mtshan mkha' la bsgrengs 'dra/ lho yi phyogs su mi mthun phas kyi rgol ba zil gyis gnon pa'i rten 'brel du/ 'brug lung dpa' bo g.yul rgyal g.yul la chas 'dra/ nub kyi phyogs su sde sgod 'dzin pa'i sde rnams pad+ma la bung ba ji bzhin 'du ba'i rten 'brel du/ g.yu lo dgung du mched pa'i nags tshal sdug pos kun nas mdzes pa/ byang gi phyogs su 'dus sde rnams sdom gsum gyi tshul khrims rnam par gtsang zhing / bshad sgrub 'khor lo gsum gyi las la rtse gcig tu gagol ba'i rten 'brel du/ ming yang ri rgyal du grags pa'i rgyab ri lhun po brtan zhing brjid chags pa/ ri rtser gdan sa 'di'i gnas bdag rma chen sgo bsrung dpa' bo thod dkar gyi rten mkhar sna tshogs dar dpyangs kyis mdzes pa/ chos srid legs tshogs kyi 'byor ba ngang gis rgyas pa'i rten 'brel du/ mdun ri rin chen byur bur spung 'dra la thang shing sngon mos rnam par brgyan pa/ mdo sngags 'gal med grogs su 'khyer ba'i rten 'brel du/yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa'i 'jang chen chu bo dang rka rgan chu bo gnyis shar phyogs nas so sor chos sde'i lho byang gnyis su bskor nas g.yu 'azug dal 'gros kyi tshul du rma klung phyug mor 'bab pa/ mdo sgad spyi'i rgyal mtshan gyi tog ltar mngon par 'phags pa'i lha gnyan rma chen sbom ra dang / gzhan yang a byes khra chen/ khe rab dpag chen/ rgyal bo go chen/ glang ma'i khyab chen sogs ming du grags pa'i gnas ri dag gis gtsos gangs dkar gyi lhun po mkha' la bsnyegs pa dang / tshon mdangs lang tsho'i sgreg pa'i rdza ri dang / g.ya' ri/ spang ri/ brag ri sogs dkar phyogs skyong pa la — mngon par dga' ba'i dgra lha sper ma'i gnas ri rnams ni 'jig rten byed pos ched du bsgrun pa bzhin chos sde 'di'i phyogs mtshams kun tu brtan zhing bajid chags par gnas so/ /chos sde chags sa'i gnas rang ni/ snang ba 253

bkra shis rtags kyi dge mtshan gyis kun nas brgyan zhing / snod phun sum tshogs pa'i dge bcu'i mtshan nyid ni/ ji skad du/ khang sa zhing sa sa yi dge/ gam 'brog rgyangs 'brog rtswa yi dge/ khang shing bud shing shing gi dge/ khang rdo thab rdo rdo yi dge zhes pa'i phun tshogs kyi dge bcu'i mtshan nyid rnams lhun gyis grub cing / 'du 'dzis dben zhing bag phebs pa/btung bya dang bud shing 'dzoms pa/ dgun rlung chung zhing sos mgyogs pa sogs klog spong thos bsam la 'os pa'i drang srong gi gnas kyi yon tan rang chas su mnga' ba de'o/ / sgrub sde 'di ni ma rig dge bshes stag phrug tshang gis se ra byes pa grwa tshang gi yig cha ltar btsugs shing / paṇa chen blo bzang ye shes dang dpal ldan ye shes sku phreng snga phyi gnyis kyis zhal bkod dang bka' yig rten khyad par can bcas kyis gzigs skyong gnang / snga gzhug tu skyabs mgon —'jam dbyangs bzhad pa sku phreng bzhi ba dang / yab rje bla ma skal ldan rgya mtsho sku phreng lnga ba/ shing bza' rin po che sku phreng rim byon/ rje gser khang pa chen po/ skyabs mgon tshogs drug rang grol/ sku gzhogs a gyu rin po sogs skyes chen dam pa rnams kyis zhabs kyis bkyags shing byin gyis brlab myong / da lta'i dgon pa'i mtha' 'khor gyi mi sde ni thun te rdzong gi mgo mang dang thang rgan zhang gnyis yin/ /gnyis pa/ dge bshes stag drug gis gdan sa thog mar btab pa'i rimapa/dgon pa 'di da lta'i gnas yul gser lag du ma chags pa'i yar sngon mdo smad chos 'byung du rgya li ser byes dge bshes grongs yul du mi phebs pas a rig 'brong thi'i lha ri de'u dkar zhes pa'i mdun du dgon pa btab pa mgo log gis gtor/ de nas hang nge ri rgan gyi 'dabs sgar chags tu spos rwa ngan gyis gtse bas 'jang chung du spos kyang da lta stongs/ (shog grangs25

265na gsal)zhes dgon gnas thengs gsum la spor ba'i gnas tshul bkod yod/ thengs dang po 'debs sa ni rma chen byang ngos lha ri de'u dkar zhes pa de yin par grags la/ 'debs pa po ni se ra'i dge bshes stag phrug zhes pa yin/ 'di'i nang du dgon pa thengs gsu ma la spor ba'i gnas tshul gsal na'ang nam zhig la spor ba dang / rgyu rkyen gang zhig gis sgo nas spor ba yin pa sogs kha mi gsal pa red/ des na nga tshos 'brel yod lo rgyus rnams gong bsgrigs nas rigs 'ded byas na/ dgon pa dang thog lha ri de'u dkar nas 'debs pa'i dus ni rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i shing mo phag (1695)gi lo yin pa dang / dge bshes stag phrug gis dgung lo zhe lnga'i thog dgon pa btabs par grags pa de gzhir bzung na/ khong 'khrungs ba'i lo ni rab byung bcu gcig pa'i bgrang bya bcu bdun pa'i lcags pho stag (1650)gi lo la 'khel 'dug 'khrungs yul ni a rig chu stod de/ yul mi rnams rang bzhin gyis dad pa che bas lha sa'i jo bos gsung byon pa dang / rgyal ba rin po che spyan ras gzigs dngos su snang ba byung pa'i lo rgyus ya mtshan can mang la/ kun gzigs lnga bas kyang dkar po thang du 'bod par a rig ces/ /dus kun g.yo med brtan pa'i dad gus mthu/ /lhun po 'bum gyis mtshon min khyab 'jug gi/ /shugs drag dpung gi stobs kyis 'phrog nus min/ / ces bsngags pa'i mi sde de yin la/ chung dus dbus su phebs te se ra byes pa grwa tshang du tshogs zhugs gnang nas/ paṇa chen rin po che dpal ldan ye shes dang / skabs de'i dbus gtsang phyogs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen mang po bsten te/ gzhung bka' pod lngas mtshon pa'i mdo sngags rig gnas la sbyangs pa mthar thug mdzad/ khong gis bka' chos tshogs gleng gnang na 'gran zla dang bral bas/ mtshan la dge bshes stag phrug gsol par grags/rgya li ni rus sam 'khrungs sa'i mi sde'i ming yin par 'dod/ khong de dus kyi dge bshes ming grags can zhig yin pas/ thams cad mkhyen pa paṇa chen 255

blo bzang ye shes nas a mdor dgon pa 'debs par bkas bskul zhing /rgyal ba dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i shangs khrag las bzhengs pa'i rta mgrin yang gsang gi zhal thang sogs rten byin can mang po gnang nas mngags/ dge bshes stag phrug tshang gis a rig sogs 'brog sde rnams kyis sbyin bdag byas par brten nas dgon pa gsar bzhengs byas na'ang / mgo log gi jag pa dmu rgod pa rnams kyis rgyun du 'phrog bcom byas pa dang / khyad par tu rgya li tshang gi mtshan lam du rgyab ri'i mgo nas mi skad drag che ba zhig gi mdun ri'i ngos na yod pa'i mi zhig rgyangs 'bod byas te ya ro/ bla rgan 'dis nga'i bla thog la me btsas mnan nas shin du na bar 'dug khyod la 'di mthar bskrod byed pa'i thabs re yod dam ces dris ba sogs rmis pa dang /de nas bzung lo rer grwa ba re stag gis khur bas sdod ma tshugs par dgon pa hang gzhung la spor/ de la mdo smrad chos 'byung du khri chen sprul stu bstan pa'i nyi mas/ 'brong thu'i mdor dgon pa 'debs dgos tshul bka' gnang / sa phyogs der sngar yang 'ga' zhig gis dgon pa 'debs pa'i sta gon byas kyang / gzhi bdag nag phyogs pa'i stabs lus pa'i rgyu mtshan zhus zhes pa'i 'ga' zhig de rgya li tshang yin nam snyam/ /lha ri de'u dkar nas ches ring na'ang lo bcu'i ring la ma gtogs sdod ma thub par mngon/ mdo smad chos 'byung du hang nge ri rgan gyi 'dab sgar chag tu spos zhes pa ma gtogs mi gsal na'ang gar chag de ni phal cher phun tshogs rnam rgyal gling zhes pa'i skabs der btsun pa 'ga' sdod pa'i—dgon rnying 'ig ral du gyur pa zhig yod pa de yin par mngon/ dgon pa de ni rab byung bdun pa'i nang chos rje bsam gtan 'od zer gyis btab pa dang /rje skal ldan rgya mtsho'i chos 'byung tshigs bcad mar sngon tshe co ne yer ba dang / /man ju'i chos sde chos rdzong dang / /mdzo mo'i mkhar dang bis mdo dang / /hang nge'i bya mdo'i dgon sogs su/ /mdo sngags bshad sgrub yun 256

ring dar/ / zhes gsungs yod/ de lta na dgon 'di ni gna' bo'i dgon rnying gi gras su gtogs pa smos ma dgos pa red/ der brten a rig gi lo rgyus rma chen gangs ri'i zegs ma 〉zhes pa'i nang du'ang 'de ni gtsang dgon pa dang / ya rig rwa rgya dgon pa/ ya rig dgon chen sogs kyi 'go khungs yin/ zhes bshad yod/ phyis su rab byung bcu ba'i sa stag (1578)lor a rig rgyal bo sangs rgyas gtso byas bla dpon rnams kyis zhus pa ltar rgyal ba bsod nams rgya mtsho a rig bya mdo'i dgon la phebs nas 'du khang dang rten gsum la dngos su rab gnas mdzad/ dgon ming la phun tshogs rnam rgyal gling zhes mtshan gnang / 'dus sde'i slob dpon la chos rje brtson 'grus bzang po bskos/ yin na'ang de nas mi lo brgya lhag gi rjes su/ rgya li'i sgar der spor skabs nyams nas sa 'dzin gyi btsun pa re gnyis las med pas/ 'dus sde gnyis bsres nas dgon ming sngar gyi phun tshogs rnam rgyal gling sor bzhag byas/ dgon pa hang nge ri rgan du spor nas ring po ma lon pa'i rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i lcags stag (1710)lor dge bshes stag phrug tshang gi sku mya ngan las 'das pa'i tshul bstan/ /skabs der rgya li tshang gi dgon pa 'debs grogs la da dung stong skor tshang dang sog po tshang zer ba'i bla ma gnyis yod la/ khong rnam par lo rgyus thog dgon sa 'dzin gyi bla ma rnam gsum zer/ /gsum pa/ sprul ba'i sku rgya li blo bzang bstan dar dngaka dge 'dun yar 'phel/ blo bzang ye shes thub bstan dar rgyas bcas kyi gnas tshulamador bsdus/ /bgrang yas bskal bar tshogs gnyis goms pas mthus/ /rgyal sras spyod pa kun gyi pha mthar son/ /zab don mngon du gyur pa mchog gnyis pa/ /blo bzang bstan dar zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /7dge bshes stag phrug gi sgrul sku ni rgya li blo bzang bstan dar lags yin la/ khong rab byung bcu 257

gnyis pa'i lcag yos (1711)lor sku gong ma'i 'khrungs yul a rig nas 'khrungs/ khong gis dam pa sngon ma'i rnam thar bskyangs te dgon pa'i chos srid gang thad nas thugs gnyer legs par mdzad/ rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i chu glang (1733)yas mas la a rig khyeb kyi ma khye 'phags pa skyabs zhes pa'i khyim bdag cig yod pa der khye'u gzhan las khyad du 'phags pa'i rig pa no ba zhig yod pa de bslangs nas thugs brtse bas bskyangs shing / lo grangs bcu bdun thog mthun rkyen sbyar te dbus su slob gnyer la mngags/ khong phyir mdo smad du phebs nas rab byung bcu gsum pa'i sa bya (1769)lor rwa rgya dgon bkra shis 'byung gnas btab/ khong ni skabs der mdo dbus gtsang gsum la mtshan nyi zla ltar gsal ba'i ya rig dge bshes chen mo rgyal mtshan 'od zer zhu ba de yin/ /rgya li tshang gis tang nge'i ri 'dabs nas gdan sa bskyangs te bzhugs na'ang / rwa ngan sogs kyi rkun jag gis yang yang 'phrog bcom tshod med byas rkyen/ yang bskyar dgon gnas mi spor ka med byung / de nas rma chur brgal te 'jang chung la dkar sdang zhes pa'i tshang tshing mang po skyes yod sa der spos/ nam zhig gi tshe de nas kyang jag rkun dang gcan gzan gyi kha nas sdod dbang ma byung pas/ rgya li tshang gi thugs la nga'i dgon pa 'di thams cad mkhyen paṇa chen blo bzang ye shes tshang gi thugs bkod ltar btab pa yin mod/'di lta bu'i bar chad gang nas bsdad kyang 'byung ba'i rkyen ci yin zhu dgos dgongs nas/ mchod gzhis a rig sogs rma nyin srib kyi dad pa'i sde nas dngos 'bul gya rnam pa dang rta khyu mang po bsdus te paṇa chen rin po che la 'bul ba spam mtho ba bstar ba'i zhor la dbus gdan sa gsum la rta 'gyed btang / lha sa'i po ta la'i rgyab phyogs su rta 'gyed gtong skabs bskor ba'i rgya li'i rta rwa sgor mo zhes pa'i shul yun ring la ngos 'dzin rgyu yod par grags/rgya ske tshang gis paṇa chen rin po che'i gser zhal mjal nas thog mtha' bar 258

gsum gyi gnas tshul rnams zhus pa la/ khong gi 'al nas dgon gnas srin mo'i lag pa 'dra ba/ chu gsum dang lung gsum 'dus mdo/ dug rtswa dang dug shing skye sa de nas btab na bstan pa'i gsos su 'gyur pa dang / yul de nas bkra shis legs tshogs 'byung zhes gsung par grags pa'i gleng tshul gcig dang / thang 'khor lo rtsib brgyad 'dra ba'i yan lag lung chu sum 'dres/ chos skyong gtso 'khor gsum gyi bla ri dngos su mngon pa'i bkra shis pa'i pon tan gyi brgyan pa'i gnas su spor dgos/ bsrung ma'i gtso bo ngag tse lcam sring bsten dgos zhes pa'i gleng tshul gcig yod pa gang gi ngos nas bltas kyang dgon pa gsar 'debs la pakho chen rin po ches zhal bkod gnang yod pa dngos don red/ da dung paṇa chen rin po ches dgon pa'i mtshan la phun tshogs bstan rgyas gling gsol rgyu dang / bca' yig dang /'phral phugs kyi zhal gdams mdzad pa dang lhan du/ paṇa chen sku phreng bzhi ba blo bzang chos rgyan gyi snyen thang chos rgyal phyi sgrub dregs pa pho brgyad mo brgyad kyis bskor ba'i zhal thang / thub sku/ beg tse'i sku byin can rnams rgya li tshang la gnang ba dang / rgya li tshang gis de dag bsnams nas mdo smad du slar log khong phyogs phyogs su phebs nas dgon gnas btsal skabs/nyin zhig sku 'khor 'ga' dang lhan du da lta'i dgon pa yod sa 'der slebs nas sku ngal gso skabs nam mkhar zho gsar spung pa lta bu'i sprin dkar leb mo re re lding bas mig la mdzes pa'i dpal ster zhing / phar tshur nas 'dab chags kyis gre 'gyur rgyag cing lung gzhung gi gtsang chu dngas mo lhung lhung du 'bab pa sogs kyis dben gnas nyams dga' ba zhig gi khyad chos rang byung du grub yod par gzigs/ de nas rtswa la rol bzhin yod pa'i cib pas 'gre log brgyab ste sha thag gi dngos bo thang la 'phang ba rgya li tshang gis gzigs te phyir 'dog tu 'gro skabs/ glo bur tu pho rog cig 'phur yong nas nam mkhar lding skor rgyag cing thang la babs nas grog babyug rgya li tshang gis 259

gzigs snang de chos skyong gi brda skad la go ste/ sha thag 'dog mtshams bzhag nas mdun ri'i ngos su phebs te gzigs pa na/ ngo ma paṇa chen rin po che'i lung bstan ji bzhin du snang bas gnas de nas dgon pa chags rgyu'i thugs thag bcad/ rab byung bcu gsum pa'i gser 'phyang zhes pa ste mo bya ( 1777)lor sa brtag bslang sbyangs gsum gyi sgo nas dgon pa gsar bzhengs kyi 'dzugs sgrun rgya chen byas/ /'di la bshad tshul gzhan zhig yod pa ni/ dgon 'di3 rtsa ba'i ma dgon 'debs pa po ni rgya li tshang yin kyang / da lta'i dgon gnas 'dir gser lag dgon phyag 'debs mdzad pa po ni/ rgya bza'i khri rgan 'jam dbyangs dge 'dun phun tshogs yin par bshad/ de'i phyir grwa rgan rnams kyi ngag rgyun la'ang / rgya bza' sku phreng rim byon la rtsa ba'i bdag po tshang zhes yongs su grags shing / grub pa'i phyir/ mdo smad chos 'byung las kyang gser lag dgon rgya bza' khri bas btab ste sku zeng rim byon gyis skyong zhes gsungs pa'i phyir do/ /zhes pa de red/ /thog mar la dkar sdang gi shing cha rnams rmang gzhi byas nas 'du khang ka ba brgyad bcu can zhig bzhengs pa dang / de nas rim bzhin du byams khang dang / btsan khang / sgrol ma'i lha khang / g.yu lo bkod pa'i dga' tshal rnams sku gsung thugs rten dang bcas par bzhengs/ /de dus dge 'dun 'al grangs nyis brgya lhag zhugs skad pa dang / sngar bzhin 'chad nyan dang bshad sgrub zung 'brel/ gzhi gsum gyi phyag len sogs dge bshes stag phrug gis ser byes ltar tu btsugs pa ji bzhin gnas pa'i khar/ paṇa chen rin po che dpal ldan ye shes kyi bca' yig gi phyag len dag kyang —bsnan/ /rab byung bcu gsum pa'i shing 'brug (1784)lor rgya li blo bzang bstan dar gyi dgongs pa chos dbyings su bsdus/rab 'byams dge la 'dun pa'i snying stobs kyis/ /nyams togs cha 260

shas yar ngos zla bzhin 'phel/ /snyigs dus nyams thag 'gro ba'i bshes gnyen mchog/ drin can bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /7rgya li sku phreng gsum pa dge 'dun yar 'phel ni rab byung bcu gsum pa'i shing sgrul (1785)lor rong bo mkhan chen gyi sku tshar 'khrungs/ khong skye khungs mtho bas gser lag gi khri sar 'god ma thub/ reb gong nas bstan pa bskyangs tshulani rong bo dgon chen gyi gdan rabs nang 'khod pa ltar na/ rgya li yang sgrul dge 'dun yar 'phel ni/ rong bo mkhan chen gyi sku tshar — 'khrungs/ rdzong ser nas ma ṇi ril sgrub gnang / g.yer gshong dge 'dun zla grags bla ma'i gtso po yin/ dgung lo zhe drug thog rgya li sgar btab/ ces 'khod yod pa ltar yin la/ dgung lo zhe drug thog rgya li sgar btab ces par brtag na khong gis reb gong nas dgon pa zhig btab pa yin nam snyam/ /de dus dgon pa skyong mkhan gtso bo ni gtsang pa tshang dang / sog po tshang / stong skor tshang / phur tsha tshang sogs yin la/ khong rnam pas rwa rgya'i sku gzhogs shing bza' blo bzang dar rgyas tshang zhus nas gser lag la thugs khur gnang dgos pa'i gsol ba phur tshugs su btab pa thugs bzhes gnang par grags/rab byung bcu bzhi ba'i chu bya (1813)lor 'jam mgon gser khang pa blo bzang bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho phebs nas/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi dbang dang / gzhan 'don chos ci rigs kyi lung gnang / phyag jos gang bsdog dgon sder bstsal/ /rgya li dge 'dun yar 'phel tshang gis rab byung bcu bzhi ba'i lcags 'brug (1820)la gzugs sku'i bkod pa bsdus par grags/ /blo bzang rgyal bstan sa 'dzin dbang po'i spor/ /ye shes 'od zer dra ba 'gyed pa yis/ /thub bstan pad tshal dar zhing rgyas mdzad pa'i/ /mchog sprul nyi ma'i mgon la phyag 'tshal lo/ /7rgya li sku breng bzhi ba ye shes thub 261

bstan dar rgyas ni rab byung bcu bzhi ba'i lcags sgrul (1821)la rwa rgya'i khri ba dge 'dun phun tshogs kyi tsha bor rgya bza' nas sku 'khrungs/ sku phreng 'di ba nas nas bzung rwa rgyar bzhugs mgo brtsams te sku gzhogs rnam gsum gyi gras su bkur/ sog po tshang dang stong skor tshang yang sku rjes su rwa rgyar phebs/rab byung bco lnga ba'i me phag (1887)lor sku zhi ba'i dbyings su gshegs/ /de dus gser lag dgon pa'i dgon sa thengs du mar spor nas chos srid kyi 'gan khur shin tu lci ba'i gnas tshul la dgongs nas/ khri rin po ches rgya li tshang rwa rgyar bzhugs su gnang pa dang / khong nyid gser lag gi dgon bdag tu phebs/ /sku phreng lnga ba grub dbang rgya li dge 'dun blo bzang ye shes bstan dar/rgya li grub rgan tshang yang zer/ khong ni rab byung bco lnga pa'i sa byi (1888)lor mgo log nas sku 'khrungs/ paṇa chen rin po che la sku 'bum nas rta lnga brgya'i 'bul ba bkyags pa'i lo rgyus yod/ rab byung bcu drug pa'i sa byi (1948)lor sku gshegs/ /de'i sgrul sku blo bzang 'phrin las bshad sgrub bstan dar ni rab byung bcu drug pa'i sa glang(1949)lor sku 'khrungs/ 19rta8lo'i bar rwa rgya nas bzhugs/ khri sar bkod pa'i pebs lam nas gser lag dgon pas ja thab rta bsu byas/ 1983lo'i zla pa'i nang smad sog rin po che dang / a khu thogs med tshang / ya khu phun tshogs rgya mtsho tshang bcas rnam pa gsum po sa sna dgon du gdan 'drin du phebs/ gser lag dgon par gdan drangs nas nyin shas bzhugs te ser skya mang tshogs la mjal kha gnang pa dang /btsan khang dang 'du khang sogs dgon pa'i rten rnams la rab gnas mdzad/ /bzhi ba/ khri rgan 'jam da ngas dge 'dun phun chogs dang khong gi sku zeng3ma byon gyi skor/ /262

dge legs tshogs gnyis ring nas goms pas mthus/ /bstan la 'dun pa'i thugs bskyed mthu grub pa/ /phun tshogs 'dod rgu'i chos char 'bebs mkhas pa'i/ /zla med bla ma mchog la gsol ba 'debs/ /7khri rgan rgya bza' dge 'dun phun tshogs ni rab byung bcu gsum pa'i shing 'brug (1784)lor rgya bza'i dpon po skal lo'i sras su 'khrungs/ (rong bo lha rgyal dpal gyi rma yul rong bo blon chos 〉dang bstun na rgya bza' khri ba'i 'khrungs lo 'di tsam las snga mi thub pas dpyad par mdzod) chung dus nas rwa rgya bkra shis 'byung gnas gyi chos grwar zhugs te slob gnyer mdzad/ dgung lo nyi shu yas mas su chos mdzad gnang zhing / de nas ring po ma thogs par rwa rgya'i khri bar bzhugs te grwa tshang yongs la chos srid kyi bka' drin bskyangs/gser lag dgon bdag rgya li tshang gi sprul sku khong gi tsha bor 'khrungs rjes/gser lag gis dgon sa ma zin par zengs 'gar spor ba'i gnas tshul gsan pa dang / sprul sku chung bas dgon pa gnyer ba'i khag khur jid mo theg dka' ba sogs la dgongs nas khri rgan tshang khong gi tshab tu phebs nas dgon pa bskyangs/ khong gser lag la phebs nas dgon pa'i rten bzhengs sogs kyi thad snga na med pa'i bskyed thon par ma zad/ chos spyod 'grig lam sogs kyi thad nas kyang zhib rgyas su btang / rwa rgyar bstun nas bde gsang 'jigs gsum gyi sgrub mchod btsugs pa dang / rwa rgya'i brtsi bzhag byams pa zla grags spyan drangs nas sgob gnyer rgya chen por spel ba sogs kyis 'chad nyan dar zhing chos srid kyi bya ba je legs je rgyas su btang / /rab byung bcu bzhi ba'i me phag (1827)lor 'bas dkar tshogs drug rang grol dgon par phebs nas khri rin po che las chos bka' gsan zhing /ja mar mdzo rta sogs kyi 'bul ba btegs/ rab byung bcu bzhi ba'i chu stag ( 1843)lor khri rgan tshang gi dgongs pa chos dbyings su bsdus pa'i tshul bstan/263

de'i sgrul sku rgya bza' blo bzang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan ni rab byung bcu bzhi ba'i chu yos ( 1844)la rgya bza' nas 'khrungs/ thub rtags bstan nas snyan grags rgyas pas rgya bza' grub rgan tshang thogs/ rab byung bco lnga ba'i me sprel (1896)lor kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa sku phreng bzhi ba brag dkar sprel rdzong la chos skor gnang pa'i lam skabs nas gser lag la phebs te nyin bzhi bzhugs/ rgya bza' tshang gis zhus pa ltar 'don chos mang po'i lung gnang zhing / gnas bdag gi bsang mchod sku gsum lhun grub mdzad/ dbyar gnas skabs dang / ba'i ba'i mchod pa'i skabs su sgrol ma'i maṇ+ḍal bzhi chog dpag bsam snye ma dang / gnas bcu'i phyag mchod thub bstan rgyas byed gnyis btsugs/ de skabs khong la dgon par phyogs gang ci'i thad nas thugs khur gnang dgos tshul zhus pa zhal gyis bzhes/ phyis su kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs ba'ad pas thugs kyi dgongs pa rdzogs pa'i tshul bstan skabs/ gser lag yang dgon lag rnams la gdung skal sbyin pa'i gras su bzhag ste/ 'thus tshab bstan 'dzin seng ge sogs grwa ba bdun mngags te dngul 'gyed btang / rab byung bco lnga ba'i me spul lor sku 'i ba'i dbyings su gshegs/ /rgya bza' sku phreng gsum pa 'jam dbyangs blo bzang thub bstan phun tshogs rgya mtsho ni rab byung bco lnga ba'i sa rta (1918)lor yab dpa' ris dang yum 'brug tho gnyis kyi sras su yo'u rgya nas 'khrungs/ rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po rje btsun 'jam dbyangs shes rab las rab tu byung / kun spong 'dul 'dzin rje 'jam dbyangs rgya mtsho dang / a rol lung rtogs bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'dzin pa 'jam dbyangs mkhyen rab dpal bzang /sha srung dge bshes snyan brgyud bstan pa'i ma 'a bdag rje blo bzang bsam gtan/ bshes gnyen dam pa byams pa chos grub/ 'dul 'dzin blo bzang yar 'phel rnams las dam chos bdud rtsis thugs kyi bum bzang byur bur 26

gtams shing / mkhas pa'i go 'phang thob ste che dgu yongs kyi gtsug tu bkur/ dgon pa'i bya ba thams cad la thugs gnyer mdzad de bshad sgrub 'khor lo gsum gyi bstan pa'i gdugs dkar dgung la 'degs par mdzad/khong gis dgung lo bzhi bzhes pa'i skabs su mā jag gis dgon par nyams nyes tshab chen bzos/ nga brgyad lo'i bcos bsgyur gyi skabs su dgongs pa chos dbyings su thim/ /sku phreng bzhi ba 'jam dbyangs blo gsal smra ba'i nyi ma ni yul mdo smad byang phyogs kyi rgyud hang nga gser gzhong ring mo'i nang tshan gnas chen brag dkar sprel dzong gi nye 'khor gyi sa gnas chu bzang bkra shis lung ring / dgra 'dul mgon po ri'i 'dab kyi rong bo blon chos kyi nang tshan lo ba ru yab rin chen rdo rje dang yum mtsho mo yag gnyis kyi sras su rab byung bcu drug pa'i chu yos ( 1963)lo'i zla brgyad pa'i tshes nyer bdun nyin bkra shis pa'i ltas khyad par ba sna tshogs dang bcas te sku 'khrungs/ sku chung ngu'i dus nas lhan skyes kyi shes rab shin tu gsal bas yul mi kun gyis rig bzang yin par gleng / dgung lo brgyad kyi steng 'brog phyogs sbra gur slob gyur zhugs nas yi ge 'bri klog sbyangs/ de dus slob grwa pa rnams kyi nang nas sbyangs 'bras bzang pa'i phul du brtsi/ 'on kyang der slob sbyong byed pa'i skal ba lo gnyis tsam las ma byung / 1980lor brag dkar sprel rdzong dgon pa'i chos sgo phyes shing / khong la sngon nas rab tu byung rgyu'i 'dun pa yod pa dang de dus shugs je drag tu song ste dgon pa'i chos sgor zhugs pa'i sta gon byas/tshogs la ma zhugs gong nas phur tsha spul ba'i sku rin po che 'jam dbyangs bstan 'dzin chos 'phel dpal bzang po'i drung nas dgon sde de'i tshogs chos kyi skor blo 'dzin skyor spyong byas/ 1981lo'i zla 10tshes 23la/ mkhan rin po che tshul khrims 'od zer mchog gi zhal snga nas rab byung dang dge tshul gyi sdom pa dkyus gcig tu sgrub/ mtshan blo gsal rgya mtsho zhes su gsol/265

bshes gnyen dam pa ngag dbang chos dar dpal bzang po dge rgan du bsten nas 'don bca' phyag len sogs byang bar byas/ 1982lo nas khong ya khu rin po che tshul khrims 'od zer mchog gi zhal snga nas gtso mdzad pa'i dam pa du ma'i zhabs la gtugs nas tshad ma'i gzhung lugs sogs la thos bsam byed 'go brtsams/ dgon der yang dar bstan pa'i 'chad nyan gsar—tshugs kyi thog ma'i kha dog dkar dmar gyi 'dzin grwa'i skyor dpon du bskos/bsdus grwa nas bzung ste blo rtags dang / grub mtha'/ sa lam rnam gzhag/lam rim blo sbyong dang / gzhan bslab bya'i skor dang / thun mong rig gnas kyi skor kha shas la sbyangs/ rnam daphyod kyi rtsal rgyas pa la de ga'i bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnam pas bsngags brjod kyi me tog 'thor/ de ltar brag dkar sprel dzong dgon rmad byung thos bsam yon rtan dar rgyas sgrung du lo lnga la tshogs chos 'grims shing slob gnyer gnang / /1985lo'i zla 4tshes 14nyin nas mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas pa'i rgya mtsho g.yas su 'khyil ba la thos bsam bshad sgrub gyi rlabs phreng gyen du 'phyur ba'i yul mdo smad kyi chos sde chen po bla brang bkra shis g.yas su 'khyil ba'i gling du phyin nas/ thos bsam sgom pa mthar phyin te 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum la 'gran pa'i zla dang bral ba'i sgo nas mkhas dgu'i gtsug gi cod pan du gyur ba khong a khu dge 'dun rgya mtsho dang / mkhyen brtse nus gsum gyi lus stobs yongs su rgyas pa'i paṇa chen yang srid sogs bla sgrul mang po'i rigs kyi cod pan du bkur ba'i khong a khu 'jam dbyangs rgya mtsho tshang /mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyi bdag nyid lhun gyis grub cing / deng dus 'phags yul 'bras sgo mang grwa tshang gi mkhas dgu'i gtsug rgyan dam par gyur ba khong a khu yon tan rgya mtsho tshang / mdo sngags gzhung brgya'i pha rol tu phyin cing / rnam daphyod 'gran zla dang bral ba'i khong ya khu grags pa tshang /yongs dzogs bstan pa'i 'chad nyan bshad sgrub kyi bya bar gcig tu brtson 266

cing / rnam dpyod phul tu byung bas bcu phrag rig pa'i bang mdzod gcig pur gyur pa khong a khu blo bzang rgya mtsho sogs yongs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen du ma'i 'bas la gtugs nas thos bsam lhod med byas/ dam pa de dag gis byugs brtse ba chen pos dgyes bzhin rjes su bzung zhing bsngags bajod kyi me tog yang yang gtor skyabs rje kun— mkhyen rin po che mchog gis kyang thugs mkhyen brtse mkha' ltar yangs pa'i klong nas dgyes bzhin rjes su bzung ste bka' lung rin po che 'gyur med rdo rje'i gzegs ma legs par phebs te/ dmigs bsal kyi sgo nas 1991lo'i zla 11tshes 17nas chos sde chen po bla brang bkra shis 'khyil gyi tshogs chos grwa gnyis la chud pa'i skal ba bzang po thob/ lo de'i gsar zhugs 'dzin grwa'i skyor dpon du bskos/ kha dog dkar dmar nas bzung bskyar sbyong gnang / /1993lo'i zla 4pa'i nang thar shul la mo yongs 'dzin rin po che blo— bzang mkhas grub rgya mtsho tshang gis thugs thag bcad pa ltar/ rgya bza' khri ba'i sku phreng bzhi bar nges bzung / lo de'i zla 4tshes 13 la mtshan yig rang dgon du gdan drangs/ tshes 15la a lags smad sog tshang dang / ya lags gtsang ba tshang / a khu grags pa dang gnyer ba smon lam sogs sku yul du phebs nas mtshan yig phul/ lo de'i zla 9tshes 15la sku yul rong bo blon chos nas kha btags btang / blo 9tshes 22la gser lag dgon dga' ldan phun tshogs bstan rgyas gling du sne len ser sprengs chos ston sogs gzab rgyas phun sum tshogs pa'i ngang nas dam pa gong ma'i gdan sar bkod/ dad ldan ser skya mang pos khong spyi bo'i gtsug tu bkur na'ang / khong gis sngar ltar grwa ba dkyus ma'i tshul bzung ste/ slar yang bla brang bkra shis 'khyil du phebs nas slob gnyer gyi 'phro bskyangs/ 'dzin grwa ma dzogs kyang / rnam 'grel/ phar phyin thad drang zur bkod dang bcas pa'i dpe khrid rdzogs par thob/ dbu ma dang 'dul ba'i dpe khrid kyang kha shas song / de'i zhor 267

la dbang lung rjes gsum khrid bshad lung sogs mang du thob ste mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas pa'i bstan pa yongs su dzogs pa'i mnga' bdag —gcig pur gyur pa khong a khu rin po che bsam gtan rgya mtsho mi 'dzigs—dbyangs can dga' ba'i blo gros mchog gi zhal snga nas dbang lung rjes gnang /khrid bshad lung / thun mong rig gnas kyi skor sogs chos bka' mang du gsan pas mkhas pa'i mdun sa thob/ rje btsun bstan pa'i 'khor lo ngur sbyig gar gyis rol ba'i khri gung thang bstan pa'i dbang byug dang / rje —'jigs med bstan pa'i dbang phyug dpal bzang po'i drung nas kyang /dbang lung rjes gnang sogs mang du thob/ yongs 'dzin rin po tshe saṃ gha'i mtshan can dang / mapa'i mtshan can sogs las kyang chos bka' mang du thob/1997lo'i bla 7 pa'i nang srid gzhung gi bkod bsgrigs ltar paṇa chen rin po che sku phreng bcu ba tshang gis dngos su phyag bzhes gnang pa'i krung go bod brgyud mtho rim nang bstan slob gling du slob gnyer la phebs/ thun mong rig gnas kyi skor dang / nang rig grub mtha'/ skabs don rgya yig sogs la slob spyong byas nas rnam daphyod phul du phyin par rig gnas gyi dge rgan sogs kyis gzengs bstod yang yang byas/ 1999lo'i spyi zla drug pa'i tshes bcu gcig la slob gling de'i sgob gnyer 'jug rdzogs shing /mthar phyin dpa yig dang bya dga' gzengs bstod bcas thob nas rang yul du phyin/ da lta sngar bzhin bkra shis 'khyil du slob gnyer gyi 'phro skyong bzhin mchis so/ /lnga ba/ ga nga pa blo bzangatshas 'apel dngakhong gi sku zeng3ma phyon/grwa btsun rgan pa tsho'i ngag rgyun du gtsang pa blo bzang chos 'apel ni dge bshes stag phrug dang mnyam du dgon pa 'debs grogs la phebs pa'i se ra'i dge bshes shig yin zer srol yod la/ de yin pa'i dbang du btang nas 268

bltas na lo tshigs go 'dzol ba'i gnas tshul 'di 'dra zhig yod/ mdo smad chos 'byung du a rig dge bshes chen mo'i gdan sa ba shing bza' sgrul sku blo bzang dar rgyas ni/ a rig gi sar yab mgon shul phyag rdor skyabs dang /yum ya rig bza' tshe dbang skyid gnyis kyi sras su rab byung bcu gsum pa'i sa yos (1759)lor 'khrungs/ brgyad pa la gtsang ba blo bzang chos 'phel las rab tu byung 0 zhes shing bza' tshang la rab byung sgrub pa'i dus ni rab byung bcu gsum pa'i me pho khyi (1766)lo yin pa shin tu gsal te/ gal te dge bshes stag phrug ma mdor phebs pa'i rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i me bya (1693)lor gtsang pa tshang dgung lo sum bcu rtsa 'ga' yin pa'i dbang du btang na'ang sku gzhogs shing bza' la rab byung sgrub skabs dgung lo brgyar bud yod pa de 'dra mi srid snyam/ kho bos dpyad pa zhig brtang na rgya li sku phreng gnyis pa blo bzang bstan dar lags gtsang bkra shis lhun por phebs nas paṇa chen rin po che dpal ldan ye shes la dgon sa 'dzin thub par thugs khur gnang dgos tshul zhu dus bkra shis lhun po ltar chos skyong bag tse lcam sring bsten dgos tshul gsungs pa kun la grags che ba de ltar tu/ mtshan la blo bzang chos 'phel zhu ba'i gtsang gi dge bshes mkhas pa zhig rgya li tshang la dgon pa'i chos spyod rnam dag yong ba sogs kyi don du mngags par byas na gnas lugs dang lo tshugs gang la'ang mthun pa yod snyam/ de ltar ma byas na gtsang ba blo bzang chos 'phel gyi gong du da dung sbu phreng zhig yod dgos 'dug mod/ 'on kyang de 'dra su la'ang ma grags pas thag gcod byed dka'/ /dge bshes gtsang ba rin po che gser lag tu phebs rjes dgon pa'i chos spyod rgyas par gnang zhing / dbang lung khrid gsum gyis skal ldan gdul bya mtha' yas pa smin grol gyi lam du bkod pas bstan pa'i bdag po ( 3 do da cho thog gra sa 363nangags /269

gtsang ba tshang zhes mtshan nyi zla ltar gsal/ rab byung bcu gsum pa'i sa byi (1768)lor gtsang ba tshang gi sku gzhan don tu gshegs so/ /gtsang pa sku phreng gnyis pa blo bzang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan ni rab byung bcu gsum pa'i sa gling (1769)lor mgo log nas 'khrungs/ me sgrul (1797)lor sku gshegs/ /sku phreng gsum pa blo bzang lung rtogs rgya mtsho ni rab byung bcu gsum pa'i sa rta (1798)lor blon chos nas 'khrungs/ chu 'brug (1832)lor sku gshegs/ /sku phreng ba'i ba gtsang pa ljags nag pa byams pa bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho ni rab byung bcu bzhi ba'i chu sbrul (1833)lor lo ba nas 'khrungs/ ya rig khri ba byams pa 'phrin las rab rgyas las rab tu byung / rje gser khang pa blo bzang bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho dang / shing bza' bstan pa'i dbang phyug/zhal dmar pani ta dge 'dun bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho sogs bla ma mang po bsten te mkhas pa'i snyan pa rgyas/ rab byung bco lnga pa'i me rta (1906)lor sku gshegs/gtsang ba sku phreng lnga ba 'di la sprul sku gnyis 'khrungs nas gtsang rgan dang gtsang chung du 'bod/ /rig dang dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag rje gtsang rgan blo bzang ngag dbang 'phrin las rgya mtsho'i rnam thar mdor bsdus/ /blo bzang rgyal kun mkhyen brtse'i rnam rol las/ /lung chos ngag la—dbang bsgyur 'phrin las can/ /lus can rgya mtsho'i ded dpon zla med pa/ /rigs kun khyab bdag bla mar gsol ba 'debs/ /khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang dang ngo bo gnyis su ma mchis pa/ rje gtsang rgan rin po che blo bzang ngag dbang 'azin las rgya mtsho ni rab byung bco lnga ba'i me rtal (1907)sku gong ma'i 'khrungs yul te/ rong bo blon chos kyi nang 210

tshan lo ba ru sku 'khrungs / lha dang bla ma'i lung bstan ltar sku gong ma'i yang srid du ngos 'dzin gnang nas gdan sa'i khri la mnga' gsol/ dgung lo bdun par kun spang 'dul 'dzin pa rje blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma las rab byung gi sdom pa legs par mnos te tshangs spyod ngur smig gi rgyal mtshan bzhes/bya bral dkon mchog rgya mtsho yongs 'dzin tu bsten nas yi ge 'bri klog dang chos spyod kyi rim par zhib tu spyangs/ gdan sa rang du rje blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma dban a rig rdo rje 'chang rje btsun 'jam dbyangs shes rab/ yo'u rgya rdo rje 'chang 'jam dbyangs mkhyen rab dpal bzang / rje 'jigs med 'phrin las rgya mtsho/ rje gzhan phan 'phrin las rgya mtsho/ kun spangs sems dpa' chen po rje 'jam dbyangs rgya mtsho/ snyan brgyud gdams pa'i mdzod 'dzin sha sprang dge bshes blo bzang bsam gtan sogs mkhas shing grub pa'i skyes chen dam pa du ma'i zhabs la bsten nas bsdus grwa nas blo rtags phar phyin sogs la thugs gnyer dpyis phyin pa mdzad/ dbang lung zab khrid man ngag rjes gnang sogs dam chos bdud rtsis thugs kyi bum bzang chos kyi gter tu bsgrub/ yo'u rgya rdo rje 'chang las rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i dbang lung cha tshang du gsan/ gcod dbang yang rje de nyid las gsan/bla brang bkra shis 'khyil du zengs gnyis phebs nas snga phyir lo bcu gnyis la bzhugs/ zhwa ser bstan pa'i sgron me ya lags bla kho rin po che'i drung du bsnyen par rdzogs shing / rje de nyid las bde gsang 'jigs gsum dang /ngapal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang dang rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur rin po che'i bklag lung sogs gsan/ dge bshes dkon mchog bsam 'grub las —dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi bskyed rdzogs gsan/ phar la'ang rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i dbang lung kha tshang bstsal/ bde thang mkhan chen blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma dang / lha mo tshul khrims rgya mtsho/ bsang khog ya khu 'dzigs med sogs dge ba'i bshes gnyen mang po bsten nas bka' pod 271

lnga'i gzhung lugs dri ma med pa'i rig lam la thos bsam dpyis phyin pa'i thugs gnyer khyad thon gnang / mdo sngags kyi chos rgyun mang po gsan/sgra snyan ngag dang rtsis dkar nag la sogs thun mong gi rig gnas la sbyangs/gtsang sprul chos kyi rdo rje zhes mtshan snyan gyi grags pa shin tu rgyas/ rten rnams dang 'dus sde yongs la mjal rten bsnyen bkur zhus/ mchod mas sogs spyi 'jog gnang / sku 'bum byams pa gling du pebs/ gser sdong chen po'i mdun du khri mchod phul nas rgyal bstan dar zhing 'gro kun yongs kyi 'du phyi'i legs tshogs 'phel rgyas kyi thugs smon nan tan mdzad/ grwa tshang yongs la sku 'gyed bstabs/ rang dgon gyi khrir bzhugs nas gzhi gsum gyi phyag len sogs dam pa gong ma rnams kyi srol ltar rgyun bskyangs/ grwa tshang yongs la snga gzhug tu rgyud sde sogs kyi dbang lung zab khrid rjes gnang sogs dam chos bdud rtsi'i dga' ston rgya cher bstsal/ 'chad nyan gtong sgo sogs sngar las rgyas par mdzad/ bla brang a lags la khong rin po che'i bka' lung bzhin lo re bzhin pa'i sgrub mchod 'dzugs pa'i srol phyes/gsang bdag 'khor chen gyi sku khang sogs rten bzhengs byas/ rong bo blon chos dang sha sbrang sogs rma nyin srib kyi dad ldan ser skya stong phrag mang por snga gzhug tu mi tra brgya rtsa dang dus 'khor dbang chen thengs gnyis dang /skyabs 'gro dang / ma ṇi/ dmigs brtse ma/ mdo gdugs sgrol gsum sogs kyi chos sbyin mtha' yas pa gnang nas sems can mang po smin grol gyi lam la bkod/ dkar mo gsang chen sgrub phug tu bcad rgya dam por mdzad nas bla ma'i rnal 'byor zab mo'i thugs dam dang / rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i bsnyen chen la bzhugs skabs yi dam gyi zhal yang yang gzigs/gsang chen sgrub phug bkra shis chos 'khor gling gi dge 'dun rnams la dbang lung rjes gsum gyi chos sbyin ci dgar bstsal/ zab don snyan ba da kyi mkha' 'gro'i phyi mtshams chen mo chu mig brgya rtsa sogs nyams len la gzhol/272

thengs shig rje nyid chu mig tu bzhugs skabs shig la nyams snang mtshar bo zhig thon par/ rje nyid kyis 'phrin bcol gyi lngags rtsom mod kyang bka' chad la dogs nas 'dir 'brir ma phod kyang / mjug gi yig chung la/ gcod yul bka' yi bsrung ma che/ /zangs ri'i btsan rgod mched gnyis kyi/ /thugs rgyud bskul byed lha yi rnga/ /gtsang sprul wa ke sa mu tras/ /chu mig 'gro ba'i thun mtshams shig/ rten 'brel rmad byung rang 'grig tshe/ /mgyogs bris drel chung 'gros shugs kyis/ / thal byung shog phabs dge gyur cig/ces bris 'dug skabs shig rje nyid dang smad sog rin po rnam gnyis zhabs 'bring ba 'ga' dang mnyam du 'ba' lung du phebs nas phyir dgon par log pa'i lam ri rgyal gong kha ru slebs skabs khong gi zhal nas rang cag tshos 'dir ngal gso zhig byed/ chibs rta tshor yang rtswa za ru chug gsungs nas der sku ngal gsos pa na/ me tog sna tshogs khra lam mer bzhad pa la gzigs nas/ smad sog rin po che la me tog 'di dag kha dog mdzes shing yid du 'ong pa zhig yod mod ston kha thon dus ba mos bcom 'gro ba red/'di ni 'jig rten gyi chos nyid yin pas bzlog thabs med/ 'jig rten bya ba thams cad kyi rang bzhin 'di yin/ rang cag dgon pa 'di skyong ba'i las khur de khyod kyi phrag par 'bab pa'i dus shig yong nges pas skabs der khyod kyis nus shugs bton nas skyong dang nga yang khyod kyi grogs su thon nges yin zhes dgongs gzhi can gyi gsung sgros gnang pa thub bstan yang dar gyi skabs su dgon pa skyong pa'i khur chen de smad sog rin po che'i phrag tu bab pa dang / gtsang pa sku phreng drug pa 'jigs med thub bstan rgya mtsho gdan sar byon dus nga la bla mas de dus lung bstan gnang pa skabs der ma shes/ da lta dngos gnas bla mas gsungs pa bzhin 'dug gsungs nas spyan chab bsil gyin 'dug ces gtsang rgan rin po che'i sngon gyi gsol thab pa chos bzang gis ngag las thos/ /273

rje 'di nyid ni gtsang ba rgya bza' phur rtsa gsum zhes pa'i gdan sa'i sku gzhogs rnam gsum gyi gras yin la/ bla ma gzhan rnams dang mnyam du thugs nus yod rgus dgon sde 'di nyid lugs gnyis kyis legs par /debaskyangs pas bka' drin gzhal du med/ phyogs 'dus kyi gdul bya bgrang las 'das la dam chos kyi sbyin pa ci yang bstsal te/ dad ldan ser skya mang po'i re ba yid ba'in du bskangs shing / yul phyogs 'di'i sems can —rnams kyi 'di phyi'i re stos 'cha' ba'i ded dpon du gyur/ khong gis sku tshe gang bor bstan 'gro'i don 'ba' zhig mdzad pa lhur bzhes te 'gro ba sems can gyi don rgya chen po mdzad mthar gdul bya rtag 'dzin can rnams chos la skul phyir rab byung bcu drug pa'i sa khyi (1958〉lor re zhig gzugs sku'i bkod pa chos dbyings su bsdus so/ /gsung gi bdud rtsi reg ba'i slob ma'i skor rags tsam brjod na/snod ldan slob ma grangs med pa la zab chos mtha' yas pa gnang zhing / skal ldan kyi slob bu mang por snga phyir dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa dang / bar ma rab byung gi tshul khrims/ dge tshul bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa phog ste/ nges legs thar ba dang thams cad mkhyen pa thob pa'i sa bon grung bo 'debs par mdzad/ ji skad du/ slob dpon dpa' bos/ 'dzig rten rnams la thugs brtse bas/ /yun ring sa steng dam chos bshad/ /'jig rten gsum phan 'dogs nus pa'i/ /slob ma dam pa mang du bsgrun/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ gsung gi bdud rtsi thob pa la brten nas bstan 'gro'i gsos sman du gyur pa'i zhal slob shin tu mang po chag byung yod pa de dag zhib par bgrang mi nus mod/ thugs kyi sras mchog 'jam mgon bstan pa'i nyin byed rgya bza' sprul ba'i sku 'jam dbyangs blo bzang thub bstan rgya mtsho dang / ya rig sprul ba'i sku 'jam dbyangs bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan/ yo'u rgya sprul ba'i sku blo bzang lung rtogs rgya mtsho/ lcang skya sprul ba'i sku blo bzang thub bstan rgya 27

mtsho bcas kyi gtsos sprul sku dam pa mang po dang / gzhung lug smra ba'i dge bshes/ tshe dang sgrub pa snyom pa'i bya btang pa sogs slob mas phyogs kun khyab par mdzad/ khyad par du skyabs rje smad sog rin po che 'jam dbyangs legs bshad rgya mtsho mchog gis gtsos zhal slob mi nyung pa zhig gis skyabs mchog de nyid kyi mdzad pa rnam thar gyi khur bzung ste/ thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i lam gyi nyams len gyi rim pa la chu bo'i rgyun bzhin brtson pa lhur len dang / bshad sgrub 'khor lo gsum gyis dus 'da' bar mdzad cing / skyabs mchog dam pa nyid kyi rmad byung mdzad bzang skyong bzhin bzhugs pa 'di lags so/ /khong gi gsung rtsom la dus gsum sangs rgyas kun 'dus kyi bdag nyid rje bla ma 'jam dbyangs mkhyen rab dpal bzang po'i rnam par thar ba rtogs brjod nyi blo'i 'od snang dang / 'khor lo'i dkar chag skal bzang yid dad 'phel ba'i rol mtsho/ ma ḍi 'khor lo'i phan yon brjod pa mthong ba'i yid la kun dga'i dpal ster/ beg tse lcam sring gi las sbyor sogs bzhugs/gzhan yang cho ga dang / phyag len/ gsol mchod sogs kyi ljags rtsom mang po zhig yod zer yang da lta dpe rgyun mi snang ngo / /zhes rje gtsang rgan rin po che'i rnam thar rgya mtsho lta bu las/ skra rtses blangs pa'i chu thigs tsam 'di ni/ blun rmongs pa blo bzang bstan 'phel gyis rang gi dad pas mtshams sbyar te bris pa dge'o/ /gtsang chung 'jam dbyangs bshad sgrub dam chos rgya mtsho ni rab byung bco lnga ba'i sa sprel ( 1908)lor sha spung kho nag nas 'khrungs/ gdan sar phebs rjes rdo rje 'chang 'jam dbyangs shes rab dang / rdo rje 'chang 'jam dbyangs mkhyen rab dpal bzang / rje blo bzang bsam gtan/ bya bral bsod nams grags pa sogs bla mar bsten nas mkhas grub gnyis 'dzoms kyi go 'phang bzhes/ khyad par du chu khyi lor mā jag gis chos sde 275

brgyab rjes 'du khang bskyar gso dang thar mdo'i par bskos pa sogs rten bzhengs la nus pa khyad par can thon/ nga brgyad lor dus zing gi dbang la song / /gtsang pa sku phreng drug pa 'jigs med thub bstan rgya mtsho ni rab byung bcu drug pa'i lcags pho byi (1960)lo'i zla gsum pa'i nang rong bo blon chos kyi khongs gtogs lo ba ste da lta'i zhin te dzong lung bzang zhang ja rdung sde bar yab blo gsal dang yum lha sgron gnyis kyi sras su g.yo lung gad pa dmar sdang zhes pa'i sa char ltas bzang po dang bcas te sku 'khrungs/ byis pa'i dus kyi ming la chos lha zhes btags/ khong gis dgung lo rtsa brgyad bzhes pa'i skabs su gser lag dgon nas —chos sde chen po gser lag dgon dga' ldan phun tshogs bstan rgyas gling gi bla ma/ rgan pa/ grwa tshang spyi thun mong nas yi ge sku gagogs gtsang rgan sang (tshang )khong gi gdan 'dzin mi—chos kyi ming 'dzin 'di nyid ma gtogs gzhan med pas/ 'di da lta nas bstan pa rin po che nam gnas kyi bar tu dus nam yang mi 'gyur pa'i bka' rtags yi ge zhes grwa tshang thun mong yongs kyi 'dod blo ltar rab byung bcu bdun pa'i bgrang bya dang po me mo yos (1987)lo'i khrums stod zla brgyad pa'i tshes bzhi la gser lag nas bris/ /yi ge pa ni dzong sngon thogs med/ zhes gser lag dgon nas yi ge btang ste khong gtsang ba sku zeng drug pa'i sprul skur ngos 'dzin rgyu thag bcad/ 1988lo'i4tshes nyin khong gis grwa chas thog mar mnabs shing / de nas ring bo ma 'gor bar grwa tshang gis bsu ba dang bcas te gser lag dgon par phebs/ 'dul—'dzin 'jam dbyangs dpal ldan las rab tu byung zhing bsnyen par dzogs/khong gi mdun nas yi ge 'bri klog dang gser lag dgon pa'i 'don bca' cha tshang la sbyangs/ smad sog sprul ba'i sku'i mdun nas skyabs 'gro sems bskyed nas 'jigs byed dang / rta mgrin/ kun rig gsang 'dus 276

bcas sgyud sde bzhi'i dbang rdzogs par thob/ 1988lo'i zla 11pa'i nang bla brang bkra shis 'khyil du phebs te chos skor dang dbang lung du mar gsan/1994lo'i dbyar khar bsang khog nas gung thang rin po che'i dus 'khor dbang chen gsan/ da lta dgon pa'i las don mtha' dag la tur thag rtsal sprugs gnang ba'i sgang yin/ /drug pa/ gser lag dgon pa'i rdorje 'changaram gnyis dang sku gzhogs yo'u rgya sku phreng brgyad ba blo bzang 'jam dpal rgya mtsho' lo rgyas mdor bsdus/ /bya sog sprul ba'i sku rdo rje 'chang 'jam dbyangs shes rab dpal bzang ni rab byung bcu bzhi ba'i shing sgrul (1845)lor ya mtshan pa'i ltas du ma dang bcas te ma rig nas 'khrungs/ ngag rgyun la khong 'khrungs sa ni khyim tshang shin tu dbul bo zhig yin pas khong bla ma'i spul sku la ngos bzung rjes/khri ston byed pa sogs kyi 'gro sgor g.yol ched yab yum gnyis kyis gsang stabs su khong khrid nas sa 'di phyogs la yong / dgon 'dir phebs nas slob gnyer la rtag spyor gyi brtson pa gnang / shing bza' bstan pa'i dbang byug sogs dge ba'i bshes gnyen mang po bsten te zab rgyas gdams pa'i mdzod 'dzin tu gyur/ dbang lung rgyas gsum gyis skal ldan gdul bya —mtha' yas pa smin grol gyi lam du bkod/ nyid dang thugs sras kyi gtso bo yo'u rgya sgrul ba'i sku 'jam dbyangs mkhyen rab dpal bzang rnam gnyis la gser lag dgon pa'i lo rgyus thog rdo rje 'chang rnam gnyis su brjod/gzhan slob ma slob rgyun mang po spel te kun mkhyen rgyal ba gnyis pa'i lugs bzang 'dzin skyong spel gsum byas pa'i bka' drin brjod las 'das kyang /rnam thar gas bo zhig kun la rgyus med pa shin tu phangs so/ rab byung bcu drug pa'i me yos (1927)lor dgongs pa chos dbyings su gtad/ /yo'u rgya sgrul ba'i sku rdo rje 'chang 'jam dbyangs mkhyen rab dpal 277

bzang ni rab byung bco lnga ba'i chu 'brug (1892)la yum bzang mo'i gras su dgon gong ma'i yo'u rgya sgar ba nas 'khrungs/ keti blo bzang 'phrin las kyis o'u rgya sprul skur thugs thag bcad/ gdan sar bkod rjes rje blo bzang phun tshogs las rab tu byung / shing bza' bstan pa'i dbang byug dang / kerti blo bzang 'azin las/ rdo rje 'chang rje btsun 'jam dbyangs shes rab rnams la sa dbang rjes gnang khrid lung sogs gsan bzhes gnang /rje legs bshad rgya mtsho las bsdus grwa nas gzhung bka' pod lnga rig gnas dang bcas pa la thos bsam rgya chen nang / mkhas pa'i grags pa 'bar/rgya bza' dang sha sbrang dgon gong ma bcas nas dus 'khor dbang chen gsum bskur/ gzhan phyogs so so'i dad ldan rnams la mi ṭa brgya rtsa dang / rdo rje'i phreng ba/ bde gsang 'dzigs gsum/ kun rig mi 'khrugs pa/'dod 'jo'i bum bzang sogs rjes gnang khrid bka' mang po'i rgyun bzang bskyangs/ sgrub phug dkar mo phug btab pa sogs bstan pa'i bya ba bsam gyis mi khyab/ slob ma'i gtso bo gtsang rgan ngag dbang blo bzang 'azin las rgya mtsho tshang dang / a lags smad sog tshang / a lags rdzong sngon tshang /sngags sa'i dge bshes don yod rdo rje tshang sogs yod/ rab byung bcu drug pa'i me byi ( 1936)lor thugs kyi dgongs pa gzhan du gtad pa'i tshul bstan/ /yo'u rgya sprul ba'i sku blo bzang 'jam dpal rgya mtsho ni rab byung bcu drug pa'i sa sprel (1968)lo'i zla bcu ba'i tshes nyer brgyad nyin yab skal bzang rgyal dang / yum rin mo mtsho gnyis kyi sras su thang rgan ha zha sde ba nas sku 'khrungs/ dgung lo bdun gyi steng slob chung du zhugs te yi ge 'bri klog sogs tshegs med du mkhyen/ dgung lo bcu gcig gi thog thang gon bca' sdod slob ga nas slob gnyer byas/ dgung lo bcu bzhi'i steng mtsho lho mi rigs slob grwar rgyugs 'phrod de rgya bod skad yig dang / rtsis rig rol 378

dbyangs/ ri mo/ rgyun shes/ chab srid/ lus rtsal sogs sbyang bya brgyad la hur thag gis slob spyong byas te 'bras bu legs po thon pas slob gas gsum bzang slob ma'i bya dga' gnang / yin na'ang slob grwa de nas lo gcig las 'dug ma thub par yul la yong dgos byung / rab byung bcu drug pa'i bgrang bya nga bdun pa chu phag (1983)lo'i hor zla dang po'i tshes bcu gsum nyin yab rje bla ma dam pa 'jam dbyangs dar rgyas kyi mdun nas rab byung dang dge tshul dkyus gcig tu bsgrub/ mtshan blo bzang rgya mtsho zhes su gsol/ sa ga zla ba'i tshes gcig nyin gser lag dgon pa'i tshogs su zhugs te dgon pa'i 'don bca' thams cad blor 'dzin dang 'don rta—dbyangs sogs chos spyod kyi rim par sbyangs nas byang chub par byas/ rje btsun bla ma smad sog tshang gi mdun nas rje yab sras gsum gyi gsung 'bum gyi klags lung cha tshang dang / spyod 'jug lam sgron 'jam sdud sogs thor bu'i lngags lung mtha' yas pa mnos/ dgung lo nyi shu'i dbyid dus su dkar mo phug nas yab rje bla ma 'jam dbyangs dar rgyas tshang gi mdun nas pra ti'i sum rtags cha tshang zhig khrid pa dang / rje de nyid kyis bskul ma thebs pa las spyi lo1987lo'i zla8tshes 23nyin yul mdo smad kyi chos sde chen po bla brang bkra shis 'khyil du phebs nas slob gnyer mdzad/ mtshungs pa dang bral ba'i mkhas pa'i dbang bo rje 'jam dbyangs rgya mtsho gtsos bshes gnyen ba'i'i zhabs la gtugs te bsdus grwa la gnad thing bar sbyangs shing / zhar la sum rtags dag gsum snyan ngag sogs rig gnas kyi skor la sbyangs te rtsom pa la bskyed chen po thob/ lo der (1987)rje 'jam dbyangs rgya mtsho las bsnyen dzogs yang sgrub/ de ru g.yeng ba'i le lo ring dor te/ /brtul zhugs spyod pa'i bag yod kyis/ /blo 'dzin dpe lta'i nyin mtshan mtha'/ /sprel ba'i las la gcig tu bsgrim/ /srog la 'tsho ba'i lto chas nyung / /grang ngar skyob pa'i man bza' srab/ /lus po rid pa'i grwa rkyang ngas/ /nyen mtshan sprel nas dka' ba 279
