spyad/ / ces khong gis gsungs pa ltar 'tsho chas la shin tu dka' ngal che yang snying rus bskyed de nyin mtshan stos med du brtson pa chu bo'i rgyun bzhin bsten pas dus yun thung ngu'i nang drang nges legs bshad snying po dang /rgyan gyi 'azel ba don gsal gnyis blor shar mar skyor thub pa byung zhing /1987lo'i zla11pa'i tshes nyin bla brang dgon pa'i mkhas mang 'dus pa'i dbus gral nas tshogs rgyugs sprad de yang ke dang po thob pas dgon gzhung nas chos grwar chud pa'i dga' rtags gnang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen dge 'dun rgya mtsho tshang gis kyang slob bu gzhan la skul ma thebs pa'i don du slob khrid kyi dus skabs dang bstun nas skyes bzang dang bcas te bsngags brjod chen po gnang pas rigs smra yongs kyi khrod nas gser lag blo bzang rgya mtsho dpe cha bzang zhes mig 'bur gtod yul du gyur/ /khong bla ma rin po che mtsho byung dgyes pa'i zhal snga nas dge 'dun nyis brgya'i tshogs dang lhan du brgyud ldan bla ma'i phyag len dngos kyi gsang 'dus 'jam pa'i rdo rje dang / bde mchog nag po spyod pa sogs bla med rgyud sde gsum gyi gtsos pa'i dbang rjes gnang brgya rtsa gsum dzogs par mnos/gzhan yang khrid bshad lung dang bka' rgya ma sogs thob pa mtha' yas pa yod/dgung lo nyer gnyis steng khong a khu blo bzang rgya mtsho tshang gi zhabs la gtugs nas yul yul can gyi rnam gzhag dang cha ba'i lugs kyi rdzas ldog sogs bsdus grwa'i rigs lam phra zhib rnams legs par spyangs shing / khyad par tu grub mtha'i rtsa ba blor byang bar bzung ste a khu blo bzang tshang la ched gnyer gyis zhus te tshig ṭig shel dkar me lung steng nas rgyas par khrid thob/ lo 'dir da dung chos grwar hur thag gis zhugs pa'i thun mtshams rnams su rnam 'grel gyi rtsa ba gsum dang rgyud bla ma blo la skyor thub pa gnang / lcags rta lo'i cho 'phrul sgron lam skabs su drangs nges legs bshad snying po'i tshogs rgyugs 'bul ba'i skal ba ldan te rgyugs legs par 'phrod pas 'jam dbyangs bla ma 280

dam pas gzan sham cha tshang zhig gi bya dga' gnang ste gzengs su bstad/bshes gnyen chen po 'jam dbyangs rgya mtsho las 'jigs byed mgon po lha mo bcas mu tra'i smin byed dbang legs par thob/ dgung lo nyer bzhi lon pa'i skabs su dge rgan rin po dge 'dun rgya mtsho tshang dang 'jam dbyangs rgya mtsho tshang blo bzang rgya mtsho tshang sogs dam pa du ma'i mdun nas dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang sogs ljags lung mtha' yas pa gsan/ bla ma lcang skya rin po che'i mdun nas yongs 'dzin ye shes rgyal mtshan gyi bla mchod ṭi ga'i khrid dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i bskyed jogs kyi khrid sogs rgyas par thob/chu sprel lor slob gnyer gnang tshul la khong gi zhal nas thad kyi bsdus chen ma chad ngos/ /rtags rigs gsar rtsod las la bsgrims/ /mkhas grub bye ba'i thor cog rtser/ /'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i ngal gso ba/ /mtha' yas gdul bya rgya mtsho'i mgon/ /yongs 'dzin dam pa gsum gyi drung / /rtags rigs rang lugs mtha' dpyod dang / / rnam 'grel mtha' daphyod phyogs sgra'i bar/ṭīk+ka chen mgo nas lung 'gal bar/ /rnam 'grel rtsa bar sbyar te daphyad/ /thar lam gsal byed mnyan bya'i thad/ /mnyan bya gong 'og gnyis dang — sbyar/ /phyogs chos 'khor lo'i zur bton te/ /ma grub 'gal dang ma nges pa'i/ /tshul las ji ltar rtsod pa'i don/ /phyi nang grub mtha' gnyis dang sbyar/ /sde bdun rgyan gyi 'gal rtags steng / /rigs rgyan mun sel zung du sbyar/ /le'u bzhi ba'i rang rten chos/ /le'u dang po'i sgra don dang / /sbyar ba'i chos can 'jog pa'i tshul/ /mtha' daphyod steng du rnam bshad bsnan/ /phyogs chos rjes ldog mtshan nyid kyi/ /sel bya spyor tshul mtha' dpyod steng / /rgya gzhung tshig don dang sbyar te/ /dpyad kyang rnam bcad sbyar tshul dka'/ /tshul gsum sgrub byed gtan tshigs dang / /bsgrub bya togs pa'i rjes dpag rnams/ /ji ltar bsgrub dang rtogs pa'i tshul/ /sde bdun ṭīk+ka chen rigs rgyan sbyar/ /rnam 'grel le'u dang po dang / /le'u ba'i ba'i sa bcad rnams/ /281

ṭīk+ka rigs pa'i rgya mtsho'i steng / /rtsa ba'i tshig dang sbyar nas blangs/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ lo der khong rnam 'grel gsar rtsod du zhugs te rig spu yongs 'dus kyi gral nas 'gran zla dang bral bar grags/ yang mkhas pa'i dbang po dmu dge bsam gtan tshang gi mdun nas srad rgyud lugs kyi khrid dang / skyabs 'gro'i khrid/ sems bskyed kyi khrid/ maskol gyi khrid/ brgya rtsa'i khrid/ rten 'brel bstod pa'i khrid/ 'pho ba'i khrid/dbyangs can dgyes glu'i khrid sogs mang du thob/ de ltar dam pa 'dis chos sde bla brang bkra shis 'khyil nas lo bcu'i ring yab yum gyi drung nas thengs gcig la ma gtogs lo gsar yang ma gnang par 'bad pa don gnyer byas te mkhas par bya ba'i gnas rnams la sbyangs/ spyo lo 1993lo'i sa ga zla ba'i tshes nyin/ sku 'bum gser sdong chen mo'i mdun nas bla ma du mas 'phrin bcol gsol 'debs phur tshugs su btab pa'i ngor khong la yo'u rgya rdo rje 'chang sku phreng brgyad pa'i mtshan yig bab/ zla 5tshes 4nyin gser lag —dgon gyi 'thus mis bla brang du sprul skur thugs thag bcad pa'i dri med kha btags dang por 'then/ 1993lo'i zla 6tshes 8nyin/ pha yul phyogs kyi dgon pa dang sde ba nye du tshang mas phebs bsu dga' ston rgya chen pos gser lag nas khri sar bkod/ de nas khri 'don gyi mdzad sgo rnams legs par grub rjes myur bar phyir bla brang la phebs ) zur bkod bzhi dang phar phyin drug gi gzhung sogs mkhas par bya ba'i gnas rnams la brtson pa lhur blangs te khrid dang 'azos don dogs gcod blor 'dzin dpe blta sngar bzhin mdzad/spyi lo go drug dgung lo nyer dgu'i thog bka' drin mtshungs med kyi bshes gnyen dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i zhal snga nas phar phyin skabs brgyad pa bstan sgron dang bcas pa'i gzab bshad rgyas pa'i khrid yang bskyar thob/ gzhan bla ma'i bka' bzhin bse bsdus tshar gnyis dang sa lam rin chen phreng ba tshar bzhi/ blo rigs dang rtags rigs don bdun bcu sogs dang sum rtags 282

dag gsum sogs thun mong rig gnas kyi skor don gnyer can gyi slob ma 'gar khrid/ khong a khu dge 'dun rgya mtsho tshang gi mdun nas dbang lung rgyas gsum dang khrid man ngag mang du thob cing / gsang 'dus 'grel ba bzhi sbrags/ lam sngags gnyis dang spyod 'jug bcas kyi bshad lung rgyas par thob/ lo 'dir rigs spu stong phrag 'dus pa'i dbus su nyin lnga'i ring phar phyin dam bca' bzhag ste khong gi rnam dpyod la kun kyang ya mtshan par gyur/ phar phyin dam bcar bzhugs rjes skyabs mgon rin po che la gnang pa zhus nas phyir rang dgon gser lag tu phebs/ 1999lo'i zla dgu ba'i nang rgyal sa pe cin tu thung go'i bod brgyud nang bstan slob gling du phebs te slob gnyer mdzad/ /bdun ba/ gdan sa'ikhri ba3ma phyon gyiskor/ /khri rabs dang po/ dge bshes stag phrug rnam thar mdor bsdus gong du bshad zin/ /khri rabs gnyirgapa/ stong skor dge bshes tshang / lo rgyus ci yod mi gsal/ /khri rabs gsum pa/ sog po dge bshes tshang / rnam thar mi gsal/khri rabs bzhi ba/ rwa rgya'i sku gzhogs rgyal ba/khri rabs lnga ba/ rgya li sku phreng gnyis pa blo bzang bstan dar/ rnam thar gong du song zin/ /khri rabs drug pa/ gtsang ba blo bzang chos 'phel tshang / rnam thar gong du song zin/khri rabs bdun pa/ phur tsha dge bshes byams pa mtha' yas ni rab byung bcu gsum pa'i shing 'brug ( 1784)lor mgo log nas sku 'khrungs/chung dus nas se ra'i chos grwar zhugs te slob gnyer phu thag chod pa gnang nas mkhas pa'i go 'phang bzhes shing / dgung lo bzhi bcu yas mas su se ra'i 283

mkhan por bzhugs/ dgon 'dir phebs nas chos tshul mtha' yas pas skal ldan tshim par mdzad/ /khri rabs brgyad pa/ gtsang pa sku phreng gnyis pa blo bzang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan/ rnam thar gong nas bshad zin/ /khri rabs dgu ba/ rwa rgya'i brtsi bzhag byams pa zla grags/ khong ma gzhi rwa rgya'i brtsi bzhag bla ma yin kyang / dgung lo lnga bcu yas mas su khri rgan dge 'dun phun tshogs dang mnyam du gser lag la phebs nas dgon pa skyong grogs byas pa dang / khyad par tu chos sde'i 'chad nyan gyi bya gal—bka' drin gzhal du med pa bskyangs/ dgon par jag rkun gyis gtse— skabs mdo rdzogs gsungs nas cham la phab pa'i lo rgyus sogs yod/ rab byung bcu bzhi ba'i chu byi (1852)lor sku gshegs/ /khri rabs bcu ba/ khri rgan dge 'dun phun tshogs/ rnam thar gong nas bshad zin/ /khri rabs bcu gcig pa/ gtsang pa sku zeng gsum pa blo bzang lung rtogs rgya mtsho/ rnam thar rags tsam gong du zhus zin/ /khri rab bcu gnyis pa/ gtsang pa lngags nag pa byams pa bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho/ /khri rabs bcu gsum pa rgya bza' sku phreng gnyis pa/ blo bzang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan/ /khri rabs bcu bzhi ba/ bya sog sprul ba'i sku rdo rje 'chang 'jam— —dbyangs shes rab/ /khri rabs bco lnga pa/ glang rnga dge bshes dge 'dun shes rab/rab byung bcu bzhi ba'i chu byi ( 1852)lor glang rnga nas 'khrungs/ se ra byes pa grwa tshang gi chos sgor zhugs nas slob gnyer gnang pas mdo sngags kyi gzhung la mkhas pa'i grags pa rgyas/ dgon 'dir phebs nas khrir bzhugs 28

pa dang 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyis mkhas pa'i bya ba rnam gsum spel/ khong gis blon chos ri khrod pa tshang dgon par gdan drangs nas chos spyod 'grig lam sogs kyi dpe tshul bzang po ston du bcug par grags/ /khri rabs bcu drug pa/ phur tsha sku phreng gnyis pa blo bzang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan/ rab byung bcu bzhi ba'i me sbul (1857)lor rgya bza' nas 'khrungs/ mdo dbus dgon sde du mar byon nas slob gnyer gnang /dgon 'dir chos srid phyogs gnyis nas bka' drin bskyangs/ 'du khang khyams ra zhig gso sogs kyi rten bzhengs rgya chen gnang / rab byung bco lnga ba'i lcag sgrul (1920)lor dgongs pa chos dbyings su thim/ /khri rabs bcu bdun pa/ brtsi bzhag sku phreng gnyis pa blo bzang dkon mchog rgya mtsho/ rab byung bcu bzhi ba'i chu glang (1853)lor glang ja nas 'khrungs/ gdan sar bkod rjes rgya li blo bzang bstan dar las rab tu byung / shing bza' bstan pa'i dbang phyug sogs bshes gnyen dam pa mang po bsten te mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas par sbyangs pa mthar phyin mdzad/ tshogs chen gser khrir bzhugs nas lugs gnyis kyi bstan pa rgyas par mthun rkyen sgrub/ rab byung bcu gcig pa'i sa spul (1929)lor sku zhi bar gshegs/ /khri rabs bco brgyad pa/ kun spangs 'dul ba 'dzin pa chen po rje bsod nams grags pa/ rab byung bco lnga ba'i lcags khyi (1910)lor lde tsha nas 'al dmar rin po che'i bka' ltar gser lag la phebs nas rgyun bzhugs ngos khrid bka' mang po'i rgyun bskyangs/ /khri rab bcu dgu pa/ mi 'jigs rnam bzhi'i mkha' la mngon — 'phags te/ /dri med mkhyen brtse'i 'phrin las snang ba 'bum/ /rgya mtsho'i gos can yongs la khyab mdzad pa/ /bka' drin mtshungs med zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes pa'i ko'u sde'i bla ma 'dzigs med rig 'dzin te nywa nag sbu 285

lo tshang / rab byung bco lnga ba'i chu rta (1882)lor dgon gong ma'i nywa nag nas sku 'khrungs/ khong gi yab kyi mtshan la g.yang drung dang yum gyi mtshan la chos dbyings sgrol ma zer/ khong ni rdzogs chen chos dbyings rdo rje'i sku zeng drug pa yin par grags la/ sku gong ma'i mtshan la lcer sgom pad+ma bkra shis zhu/yang kha cig gis ko'u sde'i bla ma 'jigs med bstan pa'i nyi ma'i yangasred yin zer/ gser lag gi chos grwar zhugs rjes bshes gnyen chen po legs bshad rgya mtsho las bsdus grwa nas bzung ste mtshan nyid la sbyangs/ shing bza' bstan pa'i dbang phyug dang zhwa dmar pani ta dge 'dun bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho/ ki blo bzang 'phrin las/ grub dbang 'jig med bsam gtan sogs mkhas shing thub pa'i dam pa rnams las dbang rjes gnang khrid bshad lung sogs kyis thugs kyi bum bzang yongs su gtams/ chos srid gang gi thad nas rnam daphyod rgya che ba smra bajod las 'das/ khyad par tu shing byi lor dgon pa'i lha rten chos gsum nyams gso byed skabs mdzad rjes rmad du byung ba bzhag/ khong ni gser la ga dgon pa'i las bya ba thams cad kyi blo 'dri sa zhig yin pas bla grwa yongs nas arga tshang zhes brtsi bkur bla lhag tu byed/rab byung bcu drug pa'i shing rta (1954)lor re zhig gzhan don tu gshegs pa'i tshul bstan/ /྅ nag sku lo'i yang sgrul rab byung bcu drug pa'i shing rta (1954)sku gong ma'i 'khrungs gzhis su 'khrungs pa rkyen dbang gis gdan sar 'god ma— thub/ /khri rabs nyi shu pa/ rje btsun 'jam dbyangs rgya mtsho/ khong spyi lo 1880yas mas la sman gol nas 'khrungs/ chung dus nas gser lag dgon pa'i chos grwar zhugs te 'don rta dbyangs dang rgyun chos la byang bar sbyangs/dgung lo bco brgyad yas mas su mi shi ba'i bdun zhig la song ste 'bo la bsha' lug gcig thob pa ded nas phyir log skabs thugs rgyud la snying rje tshad 286

med 'khrungs te/ sa de nas bsha' lug tshe thar la btang ste sde tsha bkra shis chos sdings su phebs nas chos dang mi tshe stom par mdzad/ phyis su khong zhal dmar paṇ+ḍi ta'i thugs kyi sras bor gyur zhing / rje rin po che'i byang chub lam rim nyams len gyi thad nas khrims ldan yongs kyi mig dpe'i tshad du song bas/'dul 'dzin 'jam dbyangs rgya mtsho'am a khu don ldan rin po che zhes bod khams yongs la snyan pa'i grags pa 'bar/ chos sde 'dir lan kha yar phebs skabs kyang rab byung bsnyen rdzogs khrid lung sogs kyi rgyun bskyangs te bstan pa'i bya ba rgya chen mdzad/ /khri rabs nyer gcig pa/ snyan brgyud bstan pa'i gter mdzod bya bral blo bzang bsam gtan/ rab byung bco lnga ba'i me pos yas mas la reb gong ze bu nas sku 'khrungs/ chung dus nas chos grwar zhugs rte chos kyi gzhung rnams la mkhas par sbyangs/ phyis su lde tshar phebs te zhwa dmar paṇ+ḍi ta'i slob ma gtso bor gyur/ bla ma bsten tshul legs pa'i tshad mar bshad/lam rim la shin tu mkhas/ rjes su gtsang brtsi bzhag gis gdan drangs rte sha spung nas dus 'khor dbang chen bskur ba dang spyi ba'i 'gan bzhes su bcug gtsang brtsi bzhag sku grongs rjes gser lag dgon par phebs nas 'jigs byed bsnyen mtshams la bzhugs pa dang / dus 'khor 'du khang sogs rten bzhengs rgya chen gnang / slob ma slob rgyun spel te rab byung bsnyen dzogs khrid lung sogs kyi rgyun bskyangs bas chos dang zing zing gnyis thad nas bla na mtho bar gyur/ /khri rabs nyer gnyis pa/ gter ston 'dzigs med blo bzang dam chos rgya mtsho/ khong ni gter ston sku phreng gnyis pa mi pham dga' ba'i blo gros kyi skye sprul yin/ rab byung bco lnga ba'i shing bya (1885)lor rgya bza' nas 'khrungs/ lung rigs smra ba'i gter mdzod chen po je legs bshad rgya mtsho las rab tu byung zhing bsnyen par dzogs/ khong las bsdus grwa nas bzung /287

rnam 'grel dang / phar phyin dbu ma sogs la sbyangs pa mthar byun mdzad/shing bza' bstan pa'i dbang phyug dang / sde snod 'dzin pa chen po rdo rje 'chang / rje btsun 'jam dbyangs shes rab dpal bzang sogs las dbang rjes gnang khrid bshad lung sogs kyi bgo bskal cir yang mnos/ lhag par tu rgya bza' khri rgan tshang gi tshab tu bla brang chen mor bzhugaganas dgon pa'i chos srid kyi sgrig lam bzung pa dang / 'chad nyan gong du spel ba'i mdzad bzang bdag gir bzhes/ rab byung bcu drug pa'i shing sprel la (1942)dgongs gzhan du gtad/ /gter ston yang sprul byams pa lung rtogs rgya mtsho ni rab byung bcu drug pa'i me khyi (1946)la nya nag nas 'khrungs/ dgung lo bdunapar khrir bkod/ rje byams pa chos sgrub las rab tu byung / bya bral 'jam dbyangs brtson 'thus klog gi yongs 'dzin du bsten nas yi ge 'bri klog dang chos spyod kyi rim par sbyangs/ da lta 'tsho bzhugs kyi skabs lags so/ /khri rabs nyer gsum pa/ o'u rgya rdo rje 'chang 'jam dbyangs mkhyen rab dpal bzang / rnam thar gzhan du bkod yod/ /khri rabs nyer bzhi pa/ grub pa'i gdung rigs za hor mkhan chen byang chub sems dpa'i spul ba'i zlos gar zhi ba 'tsho'am mtshan gzhan 'jam dbyangs mdo sngags bshad sgrub chos kyi nyi ma/ khong rdzogs chen chos dbyings stobs ldan rdo rje'i yang sgrul shar yarga tshang gi sras su 'khrungs/rong bo khri rgan 'jam pa'i dbyangs nas sprul skur thugs thag bcad pa dang /rab tu byung 'i bsnyen par rdzogs rte slob gnyer chu bo'i rgyun bzhin bsten pas mdo sngags gzhung lugs la mkhas pa'i grags pa 'bar/ dus rabs nyi shu pa'i lo rabs sum cu ba'i nang gser lag dgon pa'i tshogs chen khri bar lo gsum ring bzhugs te grong dgon sde gnyis la grags pa'i mdzad rjes bskrun pa'i lo rgyus yod/ /288

khri rabs nyer lnga pa/ gtsang rgan blo bzang ngag dbang 'phrin las rgya mtsho/ rnam thar gong du bkod zin/ /khri rab nyer drug pa/ lcang skya sprul sku 'jam dbyangs mthar phyin/ khong ni rig 'dzin nyi ma grags pa'i gter chos kyi bdag po chos bdag blo gros rgya mtsho'i skye phreng zhig yin par grags pa dang / tshogs chen khrir bzhugs nas dgon pa'i rten bzhengs dang chos spyod sgrig lam 'dzin pa sogs la mdzad rjes phul du phyin pa bzhag bas ma legs pa zhig la khong spyi lo1938lo'i 15ba'i nang rong bo dgon par phebs pa'i lam skabs nas mā jag gis reb gong 'phrang yar nang la drag gnon byed pa dang 'phrad nas sa de'i sde dmangs dang mnyam du sku bkrongs song / /lcang skya sprul sku blo bzang thub bstan rgya mtsho/ rab byung bcu drug pa'i ñca ga 'brug ( 1940)lor mgar rtse stag yan nas 'khrungs/ tshogs chen dbu mdzad zur pa rab 'byams pa blo bzang rgya mtsho las klog bslab/ rdo rje 'chang blo bzang ngag dbang 'phrin las rgya mtsho las rab tu byung / kun spangs 'dul 'dzin chen po rje blo bzang yar 'phel las bsdus grwa nas bzung blo rtags dang / rje btsun pa'i sa lam/ phar phyin spyi mtha' sogs gsan sbyangs mdzad/ grub pa'i gtsug rgyan 'jigs med bstan pa'i dbang phyug las gso dpyad la sbyangs/ gos sku chen mo gsar bzhengs byas/1987lor nor brgya lhag dang sgor stong lnga 'du khang gsar bzhengs la gnang / /khri rabs nyer bdun pa/ gtsang chung 'jam dbyangs bshad sgrub dam chos rgya mtsho/ /khri rabs nyer brgyad pa/ dzong sngon 'jam dbyangs bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan/ rab byung bco lnga ba'i shing stag (1914)lor yo'u rgya nas 'khrungs/dgung lo brgyad kyi steng bya khyung dge bshes sgra ba bsang kho tshang las yi ge 'bri 289

klog bslabs shing / rab byung dang dge tshul gyi sdom pa dkyus gcig tu bzhes/ rong bo khri rgan tshang dang sku gzhogs shing bza' tshang rnam gnyis byugs dgongs gcig mthun tu rdzong sngon pad+ma thugs mchog blo gros chos kyi go cha'i sgrul skur ngos 'dzin gnang / phyis su gser lag tu phebs nas a rig tshang dang yo'u rgya tshang rnam gnyis kyi mdun nas spyod 'jug 'grel ba dang snyan ngag dbyangs can dmar mo sogs bka' chos mang po'i lung thob pa dang /sgob gnyer la thugs shin tu dmar bas shes rab che ba'i rtags thon/ sgrub sde dag las skyes bu dam pa mang po gdan drangs nas o'u rgya spyi bar bka' chos mang po'i rgyun btsugs/ mdo mkhyen brtse grub rgan tshang nas snying thig rtsa gsum sogs kyi dbang lung mang po zhus pa dang / rdo grub sprul sku bstan pa'i nyi ma dang / sprul sku thub bstan 'jigs med/ yar lung sprul sku sogs las snga gzhug tu snying thig gi skor dang / phur ba rgyud/ tshe dbang sogs bka' gter gnyis kyi dbang lung mang po zhus/ mdo mkhyen brtse rin po che'i rgyal tshab dar mdo ba 'jigs med thub bstan nyi zla rab gsal (snyan spul tshang yang zhu)lags rka rgan gyi shub lung mdor zhus nas/ blo gsum gyi ring la rin chen gter mdzod chen mo'i dbang lung yongs rdzogs dang / snga 'gyur bka' gter gyi skor/ snying dzig yab bka' yum bka'i dbang ye shes bla ma'i khrid/ 'pho khrid/ gcod dbang sogs bskur nas o'u rgya'i spyi ba dang / hor chos sgar/ bde chen/ shar dgon sogs kyi bla ma ban sngags sum brgya lhag dang / phyogs so so nas yong ba'i dad ldan ser skya brgya bcas la dam chos bdud rtsi'i bgo bskal bstsal/ ma ṇi bla ma tshang zhus nas gar sgrung zhi khro dang / thugs chen/ rta chung sogs kyi dbang bskur/ rdzogs chen dang gser rta phyogs kyi 'don rta phyag len/ kur thig dbyangs sogs spyi bar sbyangs brtson byed du bcug pa sogs bka' drin shin tu che/290

gser lag dgon pa'i khri la lo gsum bzhugs/ dgung lo sumabacu'i jog bde chen dgon tu phebs/ de ga'i tshogs chen khri ba yang lo gsum khur/de rjes khams phyogs su pebs nas rdzogs chen mkhan po zub bstan snyan grags dang / rdzong ser 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse/ tel mgo mkhyen brtse sogs bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu dam pa mang po las snga 'gyur phyogs nas chos bka' mang po gsan/ lung dang rtogs pa'i yon tan gyi klong brdol/dgung lo zhe drug thog nga brgyad lo'i dus zing la thim/ /khri rabs nyer dgu pa/ phur tsha sku phreng gsum pa blo bzang phun tshogs rgya mtsho ni rab byung bco lnga ba'i lcags bya (1921)lor yo'u rgya nas 'khrungs/me rta ( 1926) la gdan sar bkod/ rje bya bral blo bzang nyi ma yongs 'dzin tu bsten/ rdo rje 'chang rje btsun 'jam dbyangs shes rab dang /rje btsun 'jam dbyangs mkhyen rab dpal bzang / kun spangs 'dul 'dzin chen po rje blo bzang bsam gtan/ je bsod nams grags pa/ rje btsun blo bzang 'phrin las rgya mtsho sogs las bsdus grwa nas gzhung bka' pod lnga la sbyangs pa ga'is phyin pa gnang / dbang lung sogs kyis thugs kyi bum bzang gtams/ rten bzhengs mang po byas pa sogs mdzad pa rgya che/ /khri rabs sum bcu pa/ rgya bza' sku phreng gsum pa 'jam dbyangs blo bzang thub bstan rgya mtsho/ /khri rabs so gcig pa/ a rig sprul sku 'jam dbyangs bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan/ rab byung bcu drug pa'i sa 'brug ( 1928)lor yab bon ne dang yum ma ṇi skyid (skyid sgang )gnyis kyi sras su dgon gong ma'i nywa nag nas sku 'khrungs/ shing bza' tshang gis ya rig 'jam dbyangs shes rab kyi yang sprul du ngos bzung / rje 'jam dbyangs rgya mtsho las rab tu byung / bya bral 'jam dbyangs dge legs klog slob pa'i yongs 'dzin tu bsten/ thub pa'i gtsug rgyan rje blo bzang bde legs dang / a rol lung rtogs bstan pa'i 291

rgyal mtshan/ rje btsun blo bzang ngag dbang 'phrin las rgya mtsho/ smra ba'i dbang phyug rje byams pa chos grub/ zhus chen blo bzang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan/ gzhung brgya spu ba'i dbang byug rje blo bzang yar 'phel/ paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa'i yongs 'dzin asbya'i mtshan can sogs mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa'i dam pa dag las dam chos bdud rtsi'i bgo bskal cir yang mnos pas/ mdo dang sngags kyi gzhung la nang byan chud de zab rgyas —gdams pa'i gter mdzod du gyur/ 'ba' mdo nas dus 'khor dbang chen gcig gnang pa dang / gzhan ser skya mang por dbang rjes gnang khrid bshad lung sogs kyi chos sbyin dpag med btang / /khri rabs so gnyis pa/ brtsi bzhag sku phreng gsum pa blo bzang lung rig rgya mtsho/ yab bstan dar dang yum sgrol ma mtsho gnyis kyi sus su rab byung bcu drug pa'i bgrang bya dgu ba shing phag ( 1935)lor yo'u rgya nas sku 'khrungs/ rje btsun a rol lung rtogs bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dang dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po byams pa chos grub/ rje blo bzang ngag dbang 'phrin las rgya mtsho/ mkhas dbang blo bzang yar 'phel sogs dam pa —rnams bsten nas mkhas pa'i dbang por gyur/ rab byung bcu drug pa'i bgrang bya nyer dgu lor sku zhi ba'i dbyings su gshegs/ /khri rabs so gsum pa/ nor rgan a lags yon tan tshul khrims rgya mtsho/ yab dpa' lo dang yum tshe lo gnyis kyi sras su rab byung bco lnga pa'i bgrang bya nga brgyad pa shing byi ( 1924)lor nywa nag nas 'khrungs/ rab byung bla ma sku gagogs shing bza' tshang dang bsnyen rdzogs bla ma ni bla kho rin po che tshang yin/ khams rdzogs chen zhi ba tshang bla mar bsten nas gso rig dang rtsis la mkhas par sbyangs/ dkar mo phug nas lo gsum dang gser lag nas lo gcig la khrir bzhugs/ 1956lor gser rdel bkra shis chos 'khor gling gsar 'debs mdzad/ skabs der khong gis mtsho byang khul srid gros 232

kyi kru'u zhi gzhon pa bzhes/ 1958 lor khrims khang la song nas bsgyur sdo/ni dī/ga/ gi ṭ+wāṃ9 ṭ+wāṃ par gserade dīdī du dīn darnordo dīr+sha dīhūṃ~X ༷ ṭ+wāṃ/sdi /ni che la phul/ rab byung bcu drug gi me stag la sku grongs/ /(gsal bsha / dgon sde btab nas lo nyis brgya lhag gi ring la tshogs chen khri ba sum bcu lhag las ches cher brgal yod mod/ 'di skor gyi dpyad gzhi med stabs/gong sgos dag mtshan las 'god rgyu ma byung / gong gi khri ba dag gi nang du'ang la las khri ba'i 'gan zengs gsum nas bzhi 'khur sgong pa'ang yod par gsungs/ /)brgyad pa/ dgon pa'i rten byin can rta mgrin khang gi ja rjod mdor bsdus/ /dbang drag rol ba'i dga' tshal lam rta mgrin khang mes pa 'di ni/gser lag dgon chags nas da lta'i bar dgon pa'i rten byin can gtso bor brtse ste/ chos sde 'dir chags 'jig du byung pa'i khrod 'di dang 'brel ba'i gtam rgyud mtshar bo mang po yang rgan po tsho'i ngag rgyun na yod pa red/ de dag thams cad 'bri bar mi btub na'ang gnas tshul gyi lo rgyus phran bu tsam brjod na 'di lta ste/ chos sde 'di 'debs pa po dge bshes stag phrug lags sngar se ra zeg chen gling gi grwa rgyun yin pa'i cha nas khong gis dgon par bsten pa'i chos skyong rta mgrin yang gsang yin pa 'di yang se rar sgo bstun par sems/ 'ga' res rta mgrin yang gsang rnying ma'i lha yin pa dge lugs dgon pas ci la bsten zer na/ ngag rgyun 'di 'dra zhig yod de/sngar se rar grwa tshang lnga yod kyang phyis su byes pa dang smad pa gnyis su bsdus pa'i byes pa grwa tshang gi bdag po mus srad pa blo gros rin chen meng ge ni dang thog 'bras spung gi dge bshes phul du phyin pa zhig yin/ khong gis yab rtogs ldan yon tan mgon po zhu ba'i rnying ma'i grub thob de las chung dus su rnying ma'i chos skor la gsan bsam rgya chen gnang yod pa red/ phyis su dpal ldan 'bras spung gi chos grwar zhugs te/ gzhung lugs rgya mtsho'i pha 293

mthar son pa'i mkhas pa chen por gyur zhing / thugs kyi bu slob kyang mang du byung / skabs la lar sngar gyi bag chags kyi dbang gis yab las brgyud pa'i gzungs sngags re bzlo ba thos nas/ chags sdang can la las skur 'debs kyi log sgrub mang du byas pa de la khong thugs bsun nas se rar pebs pa na/slob ma mkhas pa brgya phrag tsam yod pa yang rjes 'brangs nas der stan chags pas byes pa grwa tshang du grags/ khong se rar phebs nas nyin rer chos thun rnams rdzogs rjes dgon par chos skor re gnang pa rgyun du bskyangs/ nyin zhig bskor bar phebs dus shing ze ba zhig gi ra go la bya dmar po lta bas chog mi shes pa zhig babs yo da pa ya mtshan du dgongs nas thag nye sar bcar dus/bya de shing la dzim nas mi snang par gyur pa'i gzigs snang byung / khong gis de mur shing de gzan gyis dkris rjes/ phyir grwa shags la phebs te slob ma rnams bskul nas shing de gzungs gzhugs byas pa'i rta mgrin yang gsang gi sku bzhengs/ se ra'i rta mgrin yang gsang zhes pa'i rten byin de'i lo rgyus de tsam yin pa dang / dge bshes stag phrug gis yi dam rta mgrin gser lag tu bsten pa ni se ra byes pa grwa tshang gi dgon lag yin pa'i stabs yin/ sngar chu khyi lor mā jag gis gser lag rgyag skabs/ dbang drag rol pa'i dga' tshal yang gtsug lag khang gzhan dang 'dra bar lha rten chos gsum la gtor skyon tshab chen shor yod na'ang / chu phag lo nas slar gso byed skabs rten gyi gzungs gzhugs phal mo che bor brlag ma song bar yod/ /gtsug la ga khang de'i nang bzhugs pa'i gtso sku rta mgrin yang gsang de khong rdo rje 'chang chen po rje btsun 'jam dbyangs shes rab kyi thugs bkod ltar/ rgyu tsan dan dkar po/ che chung khong gi sku tshad tsam/ gzungs gzhugs sngon ltar grub chen 'dar 'phyar pa'i phyag phur/ lho brag phyag na rdo rje'i phyag mtshan/ ma cig lab sgron gyi dbu thod/ na ro pa'i sgom thagase ra kun mkhyen blo gros kyi sku lhug tshe lha pa bsod nams grags pa'i phyag 294

phreng kha tshang / kun gzigs lnga ba chen po'i dbu lo kha tshang / slob dpon pad ma'i per gyi cha shas bcas rten 'gangs chen mang po dang bzo rtsal phul du phyin par yod/ bzhengs legs par thub nas rab gnas mdzad rjes dus chen rnams la 'al mdangs 'gyur pa dang / khyung gshog gis tsag sgra 'byin pa/ rgyun du g.yas zhal ser por 'gyur pa/ sgra 'od zer gsum gyi rtags mtshan thun mong ba'i snang ngor yang 'gyur thub pa'i ngo mtshar can/ 'khor khro rgyal bzhi dang / sgo ma bzhi/ gza' ging klu bdud btsan gsum sogs khru gsum yod pa'i tshad can rnams bzhengs/ yang rdo rje 'chang 'jam dbyangs mkhyen rab dpal bzang gis bag tse lcam sring gi sku byis pa lo brgyad kyi lus tshad can rgyu tsan dan dkar po las grub pa dang / srog bdag dmar mo'i rgyud dang dmar mo khrag gi mda' 'phen ma'i rgyud kyi glegs bam rnams bzhengs/ sku bzhengs nas cang ma 'gor bar lte ba nas mtheb sor gyi tshad lta bu zhig gas pa dang / zhwa dmar pani ta'i thugs kyi sras po dgon 'di'i grwa rigs rje 'jam dbyangs rgya mtsho tshang gis sgrub dpon dang / rgya bza' blo bzang thub bstan rgya mtsho/ gtsang pa blo bzang ngag dbang 'phrin las rgya mtsho/ sgob dpon byams pa grags pa sogs bsnyen ldan bcu phrag zung gis nyin bdun gyi ring bsnyen sgrub tshad ldan gnang rjes sku'i lto ba gas shul zum nas spus bris pa lta bu zhig las mi snang par gyur/ sgrub gtor la bdud rtsi babs/ sgrub khang du mtshan mo 'od dmar po'i gzi 'od khyab pa sogs thun mong la snang / de'i 'khor gri thogs brgyad/ shan pa nyer gcig mgon po/ chos rgyal/ lha mo/ rnam sras/ dam can/ tha 'og rma rgyal rnams bcas khri tshad can re yang skabs der bzhengs nas grub/ sku'i — gzungs gzhugs rnams ni sngar rgya li sku phreng gnyis pa blo bzang bstan dar gyis dgon par bar chad thebs nas 'debs ma thub pa paṇa chen dpal ldan ye shes la zhus skabs gnang pa yin par grags/ khyad par du rgya li'i bag tse 295

dmar sdang ma zhes khyim pa pho mo'i nang na'ang drag po'i byin rlabs brjod rgyu mang po yod/ paṇa chen rin po ches sku gagogs rgya li tshang la gnang skabs rten de thang ka 'ig yin par grags la/ phyis su rdo dang / sman 'dam/shing sogs kyi rgyu du mar brjes/ /rten de nga brgyad dang drug bcu re drug lo'i god chag thengs gnyis kyi skabs su rang gi srog las kyang gal che bar bsrung skyob byed mkhan ni dge slong 'jam dbyangs sam a khu khya ris ma tshang yin la/khong gi mdzad rjes ni skal ba ma stongs bar gnas/dgu ba/ chos thog dang dus mchodakyi rim pa/ chos thog dang dus mchod la rgya lo'i cho 'phrul smon lam dang / gnyis pa'i bskang gso/ gsum pa'i sgrub mchod bcas la/ bde gsang 'jigs gsum dang kun rig mi 'khrugs pa/ sman bla/ rta mgrin/ dus 'khor ma gtogs pa'i gzhan rnams rdul tshon la brten/ bzhi ba'i mchod pa ni rje gser khang pa'i phyag bzhes ltar/ 'jug bla mchod tshogs/ sems bskyed mchod pa bcas nyin bco lnga'i bar byed/ drug pa'i nang dbyar gnas la rgyun du dam bca' dang skyor spyong res mos byed la/ yig cha rje btsun pa'i yig cha yin/ brgyad pa'i tshes gcig la ldongs rgyu dang / mi la'i rnam thar/ shā 'cham khyi 'cham sogs kyi bkod gzugs la lta nyan byed/bcu ba'i lnga mchod la kun rig gi dkyil 'khor ras bris la brten nas sgrub mchod byed pa dang / tshes nyer lnga'i phyi dror dus bzang rgyas par grol ba dang / tshes nyer drug nyin tshogs chen 'al ngo rnying pas zhal ngo gsar bar las sne rtsis sprod byed dgos/ bcu gcig pa'i nang bzang spyod ser byes phyag len ltar byed/ bod lo'i nang gtor rgyag gtor sgrub byed do/ /sngags pa grwa tshang gis rgya lo'i nang lcam sring gtor bzlog glo bur las bcol dang /'cham dang gtor rgyag byed/ gnyis pa'i nang / bskang gso byed/gsum pa'i nang / rta mgrin rdul tshon la brten nas sgrub mchod dang /296

las bzhi'i sbyin bsregs res mos byed/ bzhi ba'i nang / g.yang sgrub dang /rta ra grin dbang gi gtor sgrub byed/ bcu ba'i nang / dbang gi gtor sgrub byed/ bcu gcig pa'i nang rta mgrin gtor bzlog dang gtor rgyag bcas bag tse rten sgrub nyin bdun byed/ bod lo'i nang bskang gso byed/ /bcu ba/ dus dbang gis dgon par dar rgyad byu pa'i gnas tshul/ /gser lag dgon btab nas lo sum brgya lhag gi ring la rkyen dbang sna tshogs kyi dbang gis dgon sa thengs bzhi la spor dgos byung pa dang /gtor brlag tshab chen thengs gsum la 'khel bas/ dgon pa'i dar rgyas la gnod pa tshad med bzos/ 'ga' res gser lag dgon pa btab pa'i lo rgyus ring yang 'phel rgyas kyi tshad dma' bar bshad pa'i mtshan mthar ded na bar chad sna tshogs kyi rkyen dbang yin te/ lo mang po'i ring hur thag gis bzhengs pa de nyin 'ga'i ring sa mal rdo mal du btang rjes yang bskyar rmang nas 'go 'dzin pa de 'dra thengs gcig min du mar byas na gang nas 'phel rgyas 'byung thub/ der brten gser lag dgon pa ni dka' spyad kyi lam bu zhig brgyud de da lta'i tshad 'di 'dra zhig la slebs pa yin te/ 'das pa'i dus la phyi mig bltas na mdun bskyod kyi gom pa gang spo ba yang las sla bo min pa shes thub/ dper na/ chu khyi ( 1922)lor mā jag gis rgyag thengs gcig gis dgon pa spyo chag gyang hrul du btang ba dang / gang la bltas kyang bkol chog pa'i dngos po gcig kyang lhag med pa red/ de 'dra'i gnas tshul ya nga ba'i 'og dgon pa'i bla grwa rnams sems khong du chud nas ma bsdad par chos srid kyi bdag po rnam gnyis dang / rdo rje 'chang rnam gnyis/ ྅ nag sku lo tshang / a lags gtsang chung tshang sogs kyis gtso 'gan bzhes 'og lha sde dang dgon pa gzhan gyis rogs rams gnang ba sogs kyi mthu la brten nas lo gcig lhag gi rjes nas dgon pa'i chos dung 2kyi7

slar gso byed thub song / /de dus sna jag gis dgon pa brgyab pa'i gnas tshul cung zad zhus na 'di lta ste/ dgon pa ma brgyab gong gi lo bcu phrag gi ring la shar khog sung chu'i tshong bas ja dang / ras/ dkar yol/ bu ram sogs khyer nas tshong brgyab pas dgon pa dang 'brel 'dris legs po byung / mtsho sngon bod sog gon we hri ( ma)mā chi yis shar ba'i tshong brin pa'i gnas tshul thos rjes/ sdang sems skyes te thong shi man la sogs mngags nas tshong bar khral lci mo sdud du bcug tshong bas gnas lugs bshad pa la gcar rdung tsha nan byas pas/ mang tshogs kyis bar bkag nas ngo so byas pa la thong shi man las cung zad nyan pa phar zhog de las ldog ste srid gzhung la ngo log byed 'dod red zer nas gshe gshe btang / de ltar 'khon 'dzing byed pa'i khrod nas zung shu man lar gri rib byas nas bsad/ gnas tshul de mā chi yis thos rjes gon te'i ( )dmag dpon gyi zabs yod pa'i tsha bo ma pu'u yon dang /pang pan (tshozo)gyi thabs yod pa'i ma chon zhi gnyis la dmag stong lhag 'khrid du bcug nas gser lag dgon pa rgyag par mngags/ kho tshos thog mar dgon pa'i nye 'dabs su yod pa'i dpa' mchog dpon skor dang stag skor gyi khyim tshang bdun bcu lhag gi ru ba yod pa bskor nas skye pho mo bzhi bcu lhag dmar gsod btang pa dang / sum bcu lhag rmas/ de nas thad gar dgon par brgyugs te 'gog rgol byed mkhan gyi gnyer ba blo bzang sogs grwa ba bcu gsum bsad rjes dgon pa yongs rdzogs btsan 'dzin byas/ sgrung log de'i nang dgon pa'i grwa ba rnams 'ga' re rang khyim du log nas bsdad pa dang / mang che ba lde tsha sogs dgon pa gzhan du mi 'gro ka med byung /jag dmag dgon pa nas bsdad rjes lha khang mchod khang rta 'dogs sa dang bshas ra byas pa dang / lha rten chos gsum gang 'dod du bcom brlag byas/kho tsho dbyar thog gcig la bsdad rjes dgon pa'i gang sa kun du gyo chag dang 298

gyang byul/ ras chad dang shing tshigs las lam 'gro gcig kyang lhag med pa red/ de yang lo gnyis par nya nag sku lo tshang rwa rgyar 'bud sdud la phebs skabs khyed la dngos po gang dag mkho zhes dris pa la khong gis rab yin na lha rten chos gsum/ 'bring yin na lha chas mchod chas/ tha ma phor ba dkar bca' la sogs nged gser lag la mi mkho ba med ces gsungs ba las kyang dgon pa gtor brlag gi tshad dzi 'dra yin pa rtogs thub/ thengs 'dir dgon par gtor brlag byas pa'i tshad la gong bcad na dngul sgor sa ya lnga lhag yod pa red/ /jag dmag gis dgon pa btsan 'dzin byas rjes dgon gong 'og bar gsum dang sha sbrang tsho drug tor tsho bzhi sogs mchod gzhis mi sde dag gi mi chen rnams lhan du mdzoms nas sde ba so sor dgra bo'i 'dzing rags khag bgos te gtor tu 'gro ba'i gros 'cham byung / de dus dgon gong mar dgon pa'i mdun ri'i ngos na yod pa'i 'dzing rags gtor rgyu'i 'gan bab/gri mdung dbyug pa la sogs las med pa'i 'brog dmangs rnams kyis go mtshon bzang pa'i dgra bor phar rgol byed rgyu ni las sla bo 'ig min kyang /'os 'gan bsgrags ma thag tshang mas mgrin gcig tu dgon pa'i don du srog dang bsdos nas 'thab 'dzing byed rgyur dam bcas/ dgra bor phar rgol ba'i dus tshod mtshan gung la byed rgyu thag bcad pa dang / smag nag la dgra gnyen mi nor bar byed ched chu byung dkar po gon pas dgon gong ma'i dmag dkar dros zhes pa'i ming thogs par grags/ dmag thog na yod pa'i —dpa' mchog ba rgya dang nya nag gyi 'bu gnyis la rtsod rgyu byung ste mi 'grig kyang /dgung mo der phan tshun ming gis bos te sngon la dgra bo'i 'dzing rags nang mnyam rgyugs byas par grags/ thengs der dgon gong ma'i dmag gis 'dzing rags gsum gyi nang gi dgra bo phyir phud pa dang dgra dmag drug bdun zhig bsad na'ang / rgyab ri na yod pa'i dgra bos thog la me mda' mang po 299

brgyab pas/ blangs zin pa'i 'dzing rags btang nas phyir mi 'bro ka med byung / /bcu gcig ba/ dgon pas thengs gnyis la chos sgo zes pa'i gnas tshul dang / chos sde bskyar dar la bka' zin gzhal du med ba'i dam pa 'ga'i ma da sarags tsam zhu ba/ /dang po/ dgon pa sa khyi (1958)lor bcos bsgyur byas rjes/ lha rten chos gsum phar zhog khang mig rgyan gcig kyang ma lus par gtor brlag byas/ de nas lo bzhi 'gor ba'i chu stag (1962)lor krung dbyang dang mtsho sngon zhing chen nas spel ba'i tang gi chos lugs dad mos rang dbang gi yig cha'i dgongs don ltar/ gser lag dgon pa yang chos sgo phyes chog pa'i gras su bzhag lo bzhi'i srid jus kyi btsan gcun 'og sems khong du chud yod pa'i grwa btsun rnams kyis rang gi dgon pa'i chos sgo phyes chog pa'i gtam bzang thos rjes/ mdongs mtha'i tshogs la dbyar rnga ji bzhin spro sems rab tu 'khol ba'i nga nas phyogs so so nas dgon par yong / yin na'ang de dus thag gcod nan mo zhig byas yod pa ni 'byor med kyi khyim nas skyes pa'i grwa ba ma gtogs dgon par yong mi chog pa dang / chos lugs kyi bya 'gul dgon pa'i phan chad nas goms gang gi sar spel mi chog pa/ mgo mang bkra shur tos chen gyi 'go khrid brtsis te zhing btab nas rang kha rang gso byed dgos pa/ sbyin bdag gi lag nas khab skud tsam yang blangs mi chog sogs red/ /drug bcu re gnyis lo'i dbyar zla lnga ba'i nang phyogs so so nas yong ba'i grwa btsun sum bcu rtsa 'ga' yod pa'i nang khyim byug po nas yong ba'i grwa btsun phyir 'gro ru bcug pa'i shul na grwa btsun nyer bzhi yod/ de dag ni bla brang yul skyong bstan rgyas tshang dang / mtha' ba 'jam dbyangs tshang / nywa nag don yod/ dpa' mchog bstan dar / dpa' mchog dge 'dun rgya mtsho/300

'jam dbyangs kur dros/ o'u rgya bzang po/ yul skyong bzang po o'u rgya 'jam dbyangs dar rgyas/ bkra shis rgya mtsho/ o'u rgya 'jam dbyangs dpa' ldan/ dpa' mchog blo gsal rgya mtsho/ g.yer nag rgyal mtshan/yo'u rgya thub bstan/ o'u rgya mkhas mchog dpa' mchog dbu mdzad thogs med/ stag skor phun tshogs rgya mtsho/ yu skyong shes rab rgya mtsho/a sgar tshul khrims rgya mtsho/ grags pa/ nya nag blo bzang / dpa' mchog blo bzang tshul khrims rgya mtsho/ dpa' mchog dar rgyas/ dpa' mchog blo bzang nyi ma bcas yod/ de'i nang gi kru'u rin dang dge bskos gcig spyogs ni mtha' ba'i 'jam dbyangs tshang yin/ spyir btsun pa 'di dag gis rang nyid kyis bsam don ltar dam chos sgrub pa'i go skabs shig byung rung / kho tsho 'dzigs snang dang dogs mi bde ba'i ngang nas 'tsho ba 'khyol thabs byed dgos pa red/ de'i rgyu mtshan ni de dus spyi tshogs thog gral rim 'thab rtsod kyi tsha rlabs 'byur bzhin pas/ dgon pa'i nang du de'i me lce'i reg pa nyin mtshan gyi snga gzhug tsam yin pa shes/ kho tsho'i 'tsho rten bkra shur tos nas log mdzo bzhi bkol nas zhing sa mu'u nyi shu lhag btab pa dang /de'i khar dgun dus gro ma brko ba dang / dbyar dus sha mo dang za khyug tshod ma sogs btu ba/ gzhan ar las sogs kyi zhor las 'tshol ba/ gon rgyu bzo ba sogs la 'bad na'ang / 'tsho ba shin tu thabs sdug yin/ kho tshos 'du khang la sa thag ring po nas shing thur re btsal te gyan gsum can zhig phub/ nang gi lha rten la zhig ral du gyur pa'i lha khang rnying ba'i shul nas thang ka gnyis gsum tsam dang khyad par tu dga' rung pa zhig ni sngar gyi chos skyong byin can bag tse lcam sring rnyed/ rgyun par grwa ba na chung rnams phyi ru 'tsho rten sgrub tu 'gro dgos na'ang / rgan pa rnams kyis tshogs 'tshogs pa dang sgrub spyong rgyun 'khyongs byas/ kho tshos rgyun 'don byed pa'i chos skor la sman bla dang / bla mchod/ smon lam rnam lnga sogs yod/ de dus grwa ba 301

rnams kyis bza' btung ngan ngon dang sdod gnas nyal sa tsam shong pa'i khang mig re las med na'ang / dgon gnas su dge sgrub cung zad re byed chog pa'i go skabs shor 'gro bar dogs nas/ las byed pa dang mang tshogs su thig gi sngon yin kyang rgyud 'jam po spyod lam drang po kho nar 'bad/ skabs 'gar spyo bde mi sna'i las byed pas lha med 'dre med dang chos lugs ni mi'i bsam blo rmongs byed kyi dug chu yin pa dril bsgrags byed dus/ rang gi sems nas bshad mi 'dod na'ang de la mthun pa'i lan mi 'debs ka med byung / /1966zla 6pa'i nang rig gnas gsar brje chen po khyon yongs nas spel ba dang bsdun nas/ gyen ldog pas dgon pa'i grwa btsun la tshig mtshon 'debs pa rno ngar je cher song pa dang / zla drug pa'i tshes bzhi nas tshes dgu bar mgo mang dang zhol ma/ thang rgan bcas zhang gsum gyi gyen ldog pa dgon pa'i nye 'dabs la 'tshogs nas yig char slob spyong dang lha 'dre gdon bgegs la dgag rgyag nan mo byas/ tshogs 'du de grol khar gyen ldog pa skor zhig 'du khang gi thog la bud nas glad bkog 'go brtsams/ skor zhig nang du brgyugs yong nas thang ga re re mar blangs nas gshags/ grwa ba tshos gyen ldog pa'i 'go bar re ba yang yang zhus mthar/ grwa ba rnams kyis chos dpe dang mchod chas nyung tsam zhig yod pa mer bsregs rjes rang rang gi nyal chas khur nas yul la 'gro ru bcug ba rnams kyis mchod chas dang dpe cha thams cad mer bsregs tshar na'ang stabs legs shig la bag tse lcam sring sa 'og tu sbas pa gyen ldog pa'i mig 'og nas shor/ /gnyis pa/ brgyad cu gya gcig lor chos sgo slar yang phye dus drug cu re gnyis lo dang mi 'dra ste/ lo bcu'i ring gi rig gnas gsar brje chen po'i god chag dang / nga brgyad lo'i zing 'khrugs zhod 'jags gtong pa rgya che ru brtang ba sogs g.yon thal che ba'i nor 'khrul yo bsrang byas te/tang gi mi rigs dang chos lugs srid jus dngos 'bab legs po byas pas/302

chos lugs dad mos la dngos su rang dbang yo da pa'i khor yug lhod po zhig gi mthun rkyen yongs su 'dzoms/ rab rgyal lcags bya (1983)lo'i chu stod zla ba'i tshes bzhi nyin 'di phyogs dad ldan pa spyi nas yun ring re sgug byas par 'bras bu smin te/ chos sde chen po dga' ldan phun tshogs bstan rgyas gling ngam sngon chad rgya li'i sgar tu grags pa 'di'i bstan pa'i sgo chen bkra shis par phyes/ de skabs rgya bza' sgrul ba'i sku dge 'dun phun tshogs rgya mtsho dang /smad sog sprul ba'i sku blo bzang legs bshad rgya mtsho/ bya bral dge bshes byams pa thogs med/ gzhung brgya smra ba'i bdag nyid chen po rje blo bzang bsam gtan rgya mtsho/ byang 'dren rnying pa blo bzang phun tshogs rgya mtsho/'dul 'dzin 'jam dbyangs sogs gtso byas pa'i sngon gyi grwa btsun bzhi bcu lhag 'dus nas chos kyi dung brda thog mar btang zhing / rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che mi nyams gong du spel ba'i rten 'brel 'grig tshogs dang por 'tshogs pa'i nyin der rnam 'dren rgyal ba'i bstod pa skabs gsum pa dang /gnas bcu'i phyag mchod/ bla ma mchod pa'i cho ga tshogs mchod bcas gsungs pa dang / bstan pa'i 'chad nyan rgyas pa'i rten 'brel du rje blo bzang bsam gtan tshang dang dge bshes byams pa thogs med rgya mtsho rnam gnyis nas chos 'khor gyi tshogs gleng gnang / sangs rgyas bstan 'bar ma dang dge ldan bstan 'bar ma gnyis gsungs/ nyin der gong rim tang srid 'go khrid pa dang / chos lugs mi sna/ chos dad mang tshogs bcas mi sna nyis brgya tsam 'dzoms nas dga' dad spro gsum gyis chos sgo phyes par dga' ston byas/ nyin 'ga'i ring phyogs so so'i rong 'brog mang tshogs rnams nas ma bskul dang blangs sgos shing chas dang rgyu dngos 'bor chen phul te 'du khang gan gsum can zhig myur bar gsar bzhengs byas/ tshes bco lnga la rgyun 'tshogs btsugs/ lcags spul lor rgya bza' dge 'dun phun tshogs dbus su phebs skabs bsnams yong ba'i rta mgrin yang gsang gi sku rtsa 303

chen dang / se ra'i mangs ja'i rgyun sogs 'du khang du ba'agatshes nyi shu la srid gzhung gi mdzub ston ltar dgon pa'i dmangs gtso'i do dam u yon lhan khang 'dems thon byung / rgya bza' dge 'dun phun tshogs kru'u rin dang po dang / a khu 'jam dbyangs kyis kru'u rin gzhon pa khur/ khong mi rnams ni byams pa thogs med rgya mtsho dang / dbu mdzad blo bzang phun tshogs/ kho rgya thub bstan/ o'u rgya smon lam rgya mtsho bcas yin/ do dam yu yon lhan khang gi dbu khrid 'og dgon pa slar gso'i 'dzugs sgun hur thag gis spel/ grwa ba bzhis 'gan khur gtso bo blangs te sngon gyi btsan khang rgyang rnying la zhig gso byas/ lo smad la rgya bza' dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i thugs dgongs dzogs pa'i tshul bstan/ dgon pas dgongs rdzogs rgya chen sgrub/ dgon pa'i do dam mu yon lhan khang thengs gnyes pa 'dems bsko byas/ smad sog sgrul ba'i sku blo bzang legs bshad rgya mtshos kru'u rin dang po dang / dge bshes byams pa thogs med rgya mtshos kru'u rin gzhon pa khur/ khong mi rnams ni bya bral phun tshogs rgya mtsho dang /blo bzang rgya mtsho/ dge 'phel rgya mtsho/ shes rab rgya mtsho/ smon lam rgya mtsho/ thub bstan/ grags pa bcas yin/ 1982lor btsan khang bzhengs nas legs 'thub byung / 1984lor/ dge bshes byams pa —thogs med rgya mtsho dang / 'dul 'dzin phun tshogs rgya mtsho rnam gnyis khams sde dger pebs nas bka' bstan tshar gcig dang / gzhan pa'i gsungs rab po ti 'ga' dgon par gdan drangs pa ni gsung gi rten gyi thog ma yin/ lo der bshes gnyen chen po lcang skya sgrul ba'i sku 'jam dbyangs shes rab dar rgyas lags nas/ bla brang bkra shis 'khyil gyi phyag len ltar gzhi gsum gyi lam srol btsugs pa dang / khong nas rigs gsum spyi sgrub kyi rjes gnang sogs bka' chos kyi rgyun bskyangs/ /a lag lcang skya tshang dang /a lags smad sog tshang / tshogs chen byang 'dren phun tshogs/ slob dpon 304

'jam dbyangs/ tshogs chen byang 'dren rnying pa blo bzang bstan 'dzin/dge bshes blo bzang bsam gtan/ rab 'byams bstan dar/ dge —bshes byams pa phun tshogs rgya mtsho bcas nas 'du khang chen mo'i sa thig btab/ dbang drag rol ba'i dga' tshal lam rta mgrin khang gi nang rten bzhengs rgyu'i dbu brtsams te/ slob dpon pad ma'i sku dang / 'od dpag med kyi sku/ rdo rje 'chang 'jam dbyangs shes rab rin po che'i thugs dam gyi rten tshe dpag med rgya nag nas blus ba'i li ma khri tshad can/ grub thob 'dar 'phyar/ rgyal dbang lnga ba chen po sogs bla brgyud rnams kyi sku khri tshad can re/khrag 'thung rigs lnga sogs rta mgrin gsang sgrub/ rta mgrin lcags ral can rnams khri tshad re/ yi dam gtso bo rta mgrin yang gsang gi sku khru brgyad kyi tshad can de'i gzungs gzhug tu sngar gyi rten rnying pa ste grub chen 'dar 'phyar gyi phyag phur dang / lho brag grub chen gyi phyag mtshan sogs cha tshang ba'i thog gtsang ba'i bla ma blo bzang 'azin las rgya mtsho'i snam sbyar cha tshang gcig dang / rgya bza' dge 'dun phun tshogs rgya mtshos se ra nas spyan drangs pa'i rta mgrin yang gsang gi sku byin can/ dge bshes byams pa thogs med rgya mtsho dang / 'dul 'dzin phun tshogs rgya mtsho gnyis la sde dge dgon chen lhun grub steng gi bla ma 'chi med sgrul sku rin po che nas par khang chen mo sogs kyi nang rten gsar bzhengs kyi ched du lho kha phyogs nas rten 'gangs chen mang po phyogs sgrig byas pa'i nang nas rten sna rtsa chen rtags tham can gnang pa de dang / gzhan rgya dkar nag dang mdo dbus chos sde khag nas thob pa'i rten sna 'gangs chen kyis gzungs gzhug tshad ldan thub/de'i 'khor la mdun dbus su lcam sring gi sku brnyan dang / rig pa'i lha mo/las mkhan gri thogs brgyad/ shan pa nyer gcig sogs bzo bkod legs par bzhengs shing / gzhan yang dbang chen rigs bzhi dang / sgo ma bzhi/gza' ging / klu bdud btsan gsum rnams dang / mgon po/ chos rgyal/305

lha mo/ rnam sras/ tha 'og dam can/ rma rgyal sogs cha tshang par bzhengs/ g.yas g.yon du tshe sku stong dang / khyams su rgyal chen rigs bzhi/ yul lha rnams kyi bris sku/ mchod rdzas sogs bzhengs pa dang /phyi nang gi tshon dang / gser tog rgyal mtshan/ chos 'khor/ ri dwags/ dzig nag bcas kyis kyang legs par brgyan yod/ shing glang (1985)lor dgon pas zhus pa ltar rtsa ba'i bdag po rgya li sku phreng drug pa7blo bzang 'azin las bshad sgrub bstan dar lags kyi 'bas zung gser gyi pad mo gdan sa'i mi 'jigs gdong lngas btegs pa'i khri 'phang mthon por bkod de bu slob zhal lhan du 'dzoms nas rten 'brel gyi dga' ston mdzad/lo der dge ba'i bshes gnyen lcang skya rin po che dang / smad sog sprul ba'i sku blo bzang legs bshad rgya mtsho rnam gnyis gtsos dge 'dun bcu phrag bzhi lhag gis thugs sems gcig mthun sgos 'du khang chen mo sngar las rgya che bar bzhengs ba'i dbu brtsams te/ lo gsum gyi ring rtsig bzo yongs su 'grub/gnas tshul de shes ma thag chos dad mang tshogs spyi nas rang gi dad pa'i rten bskyar bzhengs byed pa la rgyu nor phul nas rgyab skyor byas/ dpa' mchog bla rgan tshang thun mong nas 'du khang chen mo'i gyang gi 'gro song la sgor khri tsho bdun btang pa dang / dpon skor thun mong nas 'du khang gi rgya phibs la sgor khri tsho bzhi dang stong lnga btang / de min yo'u rgyas sgor khri tsho bzhi dang /'jam skor nas khri gsum lhag g.yer skyong gis khri gnyis lhag nya nag gis gser lag dgon la phyugs zog bcu drug phul pa'i phan chad nas sgrub phug dkar mo gsar bzhengs kyi 'gan gtso bo blangs pa dang / stag skor nas sgor khri tsho gsum/ gle bas sgor khri gcig lhag bcas kyi 'gro song btang ste 'du khang chen mo dang gtsug lag khang gzhan rnams bzhengs/ 'ba' lung yongs kyi dad ldan mang tshogs nas 'du khang sogs gsar bzhengs skabs kyi bza' 'bru yongs rdzogs kyi mthun rkyen sbyar/ rong bo blon chos tsā 306

rteng gsum gyi dme gling bya gsum dang / rgya bza' gong 'og gnyis/ lo ba/bal bza'/ skya ra/ bong stag stod pa/ g.yon gamis nyin tha ma/ ban rgya/ sngags sa'i rgya skor bcas nas dgon pa gsar bzhengs la rgyab skyor chen po byas/ dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di legs 'thub yong pa la dbu ru phyugs mo'i dgon pa chos 'khor gling gi brtsi bzhag byams pa lung rtogs rgya mtshos thugs khur chen po gnang / de min yo'u rgya che los dgon gzhung la 'bri g.yag lnga bcu phul pa ni mi sger gyis zhal 'debs byas pa ches mang po yin/ gzhan sgor stong tsho gnyis yan chad kyi 'gro song btang ste dgon par rten bzhengs byed mkhan 'di dag yod de/ 'du khang chen mo'i nang rten la sbyin bdag bsam 'grub sogs nas rje yab sras gsum gyi sku brnyan khri drug 'jog can bzhengs/ /sbyin bdag stag lha thar gyis sangs rgyas mi 'khrugs pa'i sku brnyan khri drug 'jog can dang / mi 'khrugs pa glang khri can bzhengs/ a sangs bsam gtan gyis thugs rje chen po phyag bzhi pa dang / rje btsun 'jam dbyangs/ byams pa mgon po bcas khri drug 'jog can bzhengs/ dbu mdzad thogs med dang / stag skor phun tshogs rgya mtsho gnyis nas 'od dpag med khri drug 'jog can bzhengs/ a tshogs tshul rgyam gyis ston pa gartsa 'khor gsum khri drug 'jog can bzhengs/ nywa nag dpal bzang /gsung rab/ sgrol rgyal gsum nas a rig sprul ba'i sku 'jam dbyangs —bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi sku gdung rgyu dngul zangs dang / g.yu byur gyi phra rgyan/ dngul gyi dar dpyang can bzhengs/ stag skor sde ba thun mong nas rgya bza' khri rgan dge 'dun phun tshogs kyi sku gdung rgyu dngul zangs las grub pa/ ma no'i phra rgyan can bzhengs/ nya nag rgyal mtshan gyis ston pa gtso 'khor gsum dang rje tsong kha pa'i li sku bzhengs/ byams pa thogs med rgya mtshos ri bo rtse lnga nas mgon po'i li sku sor bcu gsum can gdan drangs/blo zang dang chos dpal nas sangs rgyas stong sku bzhengs/ bla rgan tshang spyi 307

nasaganas bstan bcu drug dang thugs rje chen po don yod zhags pa'i sku sman 'dam las grub pa bzhengs/ stag skor thun mong nas rgya bza' khri rgan gyi sman sku rgyan drug mchog gnyis kyis bskor ba bzhengs/ dge slong 'jam dbyangs dang blo gsal rgya mtsho nas gnas bstan brag ri ma sgan 'dam las thub pa bzhengs/ nywa nag sde ba spyi nas rje yab sras gsum gyi gsung 'bum tshar gcig blus/ dpa' mchog spyi nas bka' bstan tshar gcig dang /bka' gdams pha chos bu chos/ be+e ḍār g.ya' sel/ man ngag lhan thabs tshar re bcas blus/ 'jigs med thub bstan rgya mtsho lags nas dkar rtse las grub pa'i gnas bstan bcu drug gi 'dra sku 'du khang chen mo'i ka mgor bzhag pa dang / gong sa rgyal dbang chen pos dngos gnang thub dbang gi li sku gcig dang / paṇa chen sku zeng bcu ba'i gdung tsha'i rdo je 'jigs byed kyi sku gcig byams sku sman 'dam las grub pa/ mdo dbus khams gsum gyi dgon sde dag gi rten 'gangs chen sgam gang / lha sa rtse gol gyi bka' 'gyur tshar gcig dung chen cha 'grig gcig na lan ṭa dang wa ra na si gnyis kyi tshogs dung re bcas rten byin can mang po dad rten du bzhag dad ldan pa 'jam dbyangs dang / thub bstan/ 'jam dbyangs dar rgyas/ blo bzang rgya mtsho/ 'bum pa skyabs/ skal bzang rgya mtsho/ tshe thar/ lha bzo dge legs/ bzod pa/ blo bstan/ dge bskos bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho/ g.yang brtan/ bsod grags/ lha mkhar rgyal/ 'thab bral/sman pa bzod pa bcas gyis gyan thang dang zang ka mang che ba'i sbyin bdag mdzad/ smad sog sprul ba'i sku dngos yon gdag mdzad nas byams khang gyan bcu gnyis can dang rta mgrin khang gnyis bzhengs pa dang / nang gi lha rten chos gsum mang che bar yang khong gis 'gro song btang nas blus/ gtso sku rje btsun byams pa mtho tshad khru bcu dgu dang tshun lnga can de ྅ nag chos bzang gis sbyin bdag byas nas bzhengs pa dang / de'i nang 'brel thogs 308

pa'i dad ldan pa chos 'phel dang / bsam bzang / dbang chen skyabs/gdong zhing sde ba/ nywa nag bstan pa/ ban de thar/ tshogs gnyis/'od zer/ dkon mchog bcas yod/ /bachu gnyis pa/ dgon sde 'de'i bla sgrul ga cig gi lozusamador bsdus/je btsun bla ma dam pa 'a ma dbyangs legs bshad rgya mtsho dbal bzang po'i rnam thar mor bathus/ /rgyal ba'i yab gcig rje btsun 'jam dbyangs kyi/ /legs par bshad pa dam chos bdud rtsi'i bcud/ /ma lus char tu bsnyil mdzad drin can rje/ /skyabs gcig bla ma snying gi mun sel rgyal/ /dam pa 'di nyid sku bltams pa'i gnas ni mdo smad sa yi thig le dge bcu'i mtshan ma yongs su tshang pa'i 'ba' lung gser gzhung ring mo'i sa'i lte ba dgon gong ma'i dpa' mchog sde bar yab rigs rus phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa/ dpa' zhing brtul phod pa blang dor gyi gnas la mkhas shing /snying rje dang gtong phod ldan pa'i ya rig dar rgyas dang / yum mthon po'i rigs las byung 'i spyod lam la mkhas pa/ snying rje che zhing gtong phod ldan pa'i klu bza' dkar lo gnyis kyi sras su rab byung bco lnga ba'i me pho 'brug (1916)lor ya mtshan pa'i ltas dang bcas te sku bltams so/ /sku bltams pa'i tshe/ mtshan bzang po'i dpal gyis rab tu brgyan pa dang / sku mdog dkar zhing dbang po gsal ba zhig yin pas skye bo kun gyis mthong na mig gi bdud rtsi'i dpal du 'dren/ de nas yab yum gnyis kyis mthun par bskyangs te dgung lo drug gi skabs/ rgyun du yab la bdag gi slog pa 'di gon mi bde ba dang ha cang btsog por 'dug pas btsun chas gon 'dod ces yang yang bshad pas/ yab yum gnyis kyis khong ya rig rdo rje 'chang 'jam dbyangs shes rab rin po che'i mdun du khrid de gnas tshul rnams ji bzhin snyan gseng phul rjes khong ge thugs shin tu dgyes pa'i ngang nas 'di nyid ni 309

skye ba snga phyi shes pa'i dam pa zhig yin nges te/ sngon lan gcig ma yin par goms pa'i bag chags sad pa red/ da khyod gnyis kyis kho'i 'dod pa ltar chos gos gon tu chug ngas rab byung bsgrubs nas bskyed bsrings rgyu yin zhes gsungs pa ltar dam pa 'di bla ma'i drung du bzhag de nas smad sog sku gong ma'i dngos slob 'jam dbyangs bsam gtan tshang ched du klog slob pa'i dge rgan du gdan drangs nas 'phral spyor gyi klog dang / chos spyod thugs 'dzin gyi zhabs zhu zhus skabs mtshan brjod tshegs med du thugs su chud/de ltar ya rig rin po che'i mdun nas lo dgu'i ring bzhugs shing / rdo rje phreng ba dang mugs brgya rtsa sogs dbang lung rjes gnang sogs kyis rgyud smin par mdzad/ khong dgung lo brgyad la glebs pa'i lo der dgon gong mas sku gzhogs shing bza' rin po che rka rgan sha ra khu thul la gdan drangs nas dus 'khor dbang chen gnang skabs/ dbang mtshams shig nas shing bza' rin po ches mi tshogs kyi nang du yod pa'i ma bu gnyis sku mdun la bos te bu 'di bla brang dge bshes smad sog tshang gi skye sprul yin pas rgyun tu gtsang spra la mnyam zhogs la mnol grub ma shor bar gyis/ phyis su bab dang bstun nas khri 'don byed chog ces gsungs gor phyag mdud cig kyang gnang / de nas dgon gong ma'i bla dpon mi chen tshos byang chub sems dpa' bsam bzhin du nged sde bar mi'i rnam par rol ba ni kho bo cag gis bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa'i 'bras bu mngon du gyur pa yin na/ sde bar rgyu 'byor ba'i 'gro song ji tsam yod kyang khri sar bkod nas sems can gyi 'gro don sgrub tu 'jug rgyu yin zhesasta gon byed skabs/ khong gi 'khor ba mtha' can ma yin mtha' med yin/ nga ni sems can zhig gi rnam shes yin pa las bla ma dge bshes su gang zhig gi sprul ba min zhes khas ma blangs stabs/ bla dpon tshos kyang khong gi 'dod pa rgyal du mi 'jug thabs med byung / khong gis dgung lo bco brgyad bzhes pa'i duyosu rdo rje 'chang 'jam dbyangs mkhyen rab dpal —310

bzang gi mdun nas dge tshul gyi sdom pa sgrub ste mtshan la 'jam dbyangs legs bshad rgya mtsho zhes gsol/ bla ma 'di'i bka' drin dang 'di las chos bka' gsan tshul gsungs skabs/ da lta ngas dge sdug gi spangs —blangs tsam shes pa dang las 'bras la yid ches pa/ khyad par tu dkon mchog gsum gyi skyabs 'og tu chud pa ni rdo rje 'chang khong gi bka' drin yin/khong gi mdun nas sa dge rnying gsum gang gi sgo nas yin kyang dbang lung rjes gnang khrid man ngag thob pa bgrang gis mi lang ces gsungs pa las/ gang dag thob pa bye brag tu ma gsungs pas 'bri rgyu ma byung / dgung lo nyi shu bzhes pa'i dus su snyan brgyud bstan pa'i mdzod 'dzin sha sbrang dge bshes blo bzang bsam gtan rin po che'i spyan sngar bsnyen dzogs sgrub ste mtshan la 'jam dbyangs blo bzang legs bshad rgya mtsho zhes gsol/ rje btsun ma mkha' spyod dbang mo'i rnal 'byor ba chen po 'od zer rgya mtsho mchog gi mdun nas mkha' spyod ma'i dbang thob/ gtsang rgan blo bzang ngag dbang 'phrin las rgya mtsho las dben sa ba'i gcod dbang dang / dus 'khor/ rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur/ rdo rje phreng ba sogs kyi lung thob/ rje grags pa rgya mtsho tshang gi mdun nas rje yab sras gsum gyi gsung 'bum gyi lung thob/ lde tsha'i 'dul 'dzin 'jam dbyangs rgya mtsho tshang gi mdun nas chos 'brel zhus/dge ba'i bshes gnyen lha sde rin po che las bsdus grwa dang sum rtags sogs kyi bslab khrid gsan/ zhwa ser cod pan 'chang ba'i mnga' bdag bla kho rin po che 'dzigs med 'azin las rgya mtsho las dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed dang thugs rje chen po bcu gcig zhal gyi dbang thob/ bde thang blo bzang bshad sgrub bstan pa'i nyi ma tshang gi mdun nas kun mkhyen snga phyi gnyis kyi yig cha dang /gung thang bstan pa'i sgron me'i gsung 'bum/ rje shes rab rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ thu bkwan gyi mkha' spyod chos skor/ zhang ston bstan pa rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ rta mgrin gsang sgrub sogs kyi dbang lung thob/ de ltar 311

gong smras rnams gtso byas te mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa'i bla ma mang po gtsug gi nor bur bsten nas gzhung bshad zab khrid man ngag gi skor dang dbang lung rjes gnang gi skor mang du zhus pa dang / de dag snyan la brgyud pa tsam ma yin par lo zla khor mo yug tu bsnyen sgrub nyams len la rtse gcig tu gagol te/ tha ma bstan pa'i me ro slar yang gso skabs thar ba don gnyer gyi gdul bya rnams la rang rang gi blo dang mtshams par chos tshul mtha' yas pas tshims par mdzad de thar ba'i sa bon bskrun pa ni dam pa 'di'i bla na mtho ba'i mdzad pa'o/ /khyad par tu khong chos sde slar gso'i skabs su gzhung shing lta bur gyur yod de/ khong gi mdzad bzang las dgon pa sngar gyi dus skabs gang las kyang gong du 'phel yod pa red/ gya gnyis lor dgon pa zog mar slar gso'i skabs su gyang chag thar me yod pa'i dgon shul las ci yang med pas/ sku gsung thugs rten 'bor chen sgrub bzhengs dang gtsug lag khang dag bzo sgun byed dgos par ma zad/ chos spyod 'chad nyan/ dge bskul 'grig 'dzin dang / tha na bca' kha phyag len yan chad kyang sngon ltar rgyun skyong pa'i thad la nyin mtshan stos med du thugs khur gnang / mdor na khong gis chos dang zing zing gnyis ka nas dgon par bka' drin bskyangs pa ni brjod kyis mi lang / tshos phyogs nas lung las kyi bdag po yin pa dang /zing zing gi thad nas phyag rdzas gang yong log 'tsho'i dbang du cung zad yang ma song par yod tshad dgon pa gsar 'dzugs kyi 'theb tu gnang / /dge ba'i bshes gnyen rje 'a ma dbyangs bsam gtan rgya mcho/ /khong ni rab byung bco lnga ba'i shing stag lor dpa' mchog dpon skor nas sku——'khrungs/ rdo rje 'chang 'jam dbyangs shes rab las rab tu byung / rang gi a khu'i mdun nas yi ge 'bri klog dang 'don bca' sbyangs/ dgung lo bcu bdun thog lde tsha bkra shis chos sdengs la phebs nas zhwa dmar pani ta dge 'dun bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho dang / 'dul 'dzin bye ba'i gtsug rgyan 'jam 312

dbyangs rgya mtsho/ mkhas pa'i dbang po grags pa rgya mtsho/ yongs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen lha sde ye shes rgya mtsho sogs gnam sa bkab pa lta bu'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen mang po bsten nas gzhung bka' pod lnga la mkhas par sbyangs/ dbang khrid dang man ngag gi skor kyang mang po thob/ paṇa chen rin po sku phreng dgu ba lde tshar phebs skabs khong gis tshogs langs byas te brgal brtag gnang ba gas na nas dge bshes legs por 'dug ces bsngags bajod gnang / 'dzin grwa mthar phyin rjes bla brang sku gathogs bla kho rin po che'i mdun nas ri khrod kyi skyabs 'jug zhus te sgrub pa dang du blangs/1957lor rang yul la log rjes phyir dgon par phebs ma thub/ 1981lor gser lag dgon pas chos sgo phyes rjes khong gis lde tshar phebs pa'i sta gon yang yang byas kyang / dgung lo mtho ba sogs la rkyen byas nas yul mi dang dgon sdes zhu ba zhus nas phebs ma thub/ 1982lo nas gser lag dgon par phebs nas lung dang khrid kyi bdag por gyur/ khong gi 'dod chung chog shes dang chos rnam dag sgrub pa'i mdzad bzang gis rab byung pa gsar bar bag chags zab mo bzhag khong dgung lo mtho ba sogs la mi 'dzems par skal ldan slob ma rnams la bsdus grwa dang blo rtags lam rim gzhung khrid sogs kyi rgyun bskyangs pas dgon pa'i 'chad nyan la snga na med pa'i grub 'bras byung /1993lor dgongs pa chos dbyings bsdus pa'i tshul bstan/dge bshes byams ba thogs med rgya mtsho/ (dzong sngon thogs med)rab byung bco lnga ba'i me stag ( 1926)lor yo'u rgya nas 'khrungs zhing chung dus nas zhang bo dpa' mchog ba rgyas bu tshab tu blangs te gces par bskyangs/dgung lo brgyad kyi steng gser lag dgon du yong / dgung lo bcu'i thog tshogs chen dbu mdzad zur pa 'dul ba 'dzin pa chen po byams pa bzang po las rab tu byung zhing ngage tshul sgrub/ mtshan la byams pa thogs med ces gsol/ khong gi khu bo blo bzang nyi ma las yi ge 'bri klog dang chos spyod—313

'don bca' la sbyangs/ dgung lo bcu gnyis thog gser lag gi 'don bca' dbyangs sogs mthar phyin nas chos mdzad kyi ming btags blangs/dgung lo bcu bdun thog bros stabs su chos sde chen po bla brang bkra shis 'khyil du phebs nas tshogs chen khri ba rgya zhabs drung tshang la mjal/ gzhung rgyugs sprad de rtags rigs 'dzin gyur zhugs su gnang / mkhas dbang 'jam dbyangs brtson 'thus tshang gi 'bas la gtugs te bsdus grwa nas blo rtags sogs mtshan nyid kyi gzhung la sbyangs/ dgung lo bco brgyad thog rdo rje 'chang chen po rje btsun 'jigs med 'phrin las rgya mtsho las bsnyen rdzogs sgrub ste mtshan byams pa thogs med rgya mtshor gsol/ a lags rin po che khong gi mdun nas bde gsang 'jigs gsum dang / rigs gsum spyi sgrub/lcer sgang rta mgrin gsang bsgrub/ thugs rje chen po bcu gcig zhal/mgon chos/ lha mo/ lcam sring / na ro mkha' spyod ma'i byin rlabs/dbyangs can ma dkar dmar/ sa skya'i gser chos bcu gsum/ 'jam dbyangs chos skor sogs dang / gzhan lam rim chung ngu dang / rim lnga gsal sgron/ bla mchod dang phyag chen spugs ma/ sgrol ma phra sgrub/gdugs dkar rgyal mtshan 'khor lo/ me tog bcud len/ za byed mkha' 'gro rdor sems sgom bzlas/ mdo gdugs sgrol gsum/ gnas bcu'i byag mchod maṇ+ḍal bzhi chog sman gyi rgyud bzhi/ man ngag bka' brgya ma sogs kyi dbang lung khrid sogs mang po thob/ skyabs mgon sku phreng lnga ba bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi mdun nas rgyan 'jug gnyis dang / mdo gdugs sgrol gsum sogs kyi lung thob/ khong a khu tshul khrims rin po che'i mdun nas 'jams dbyangs chos skor dang gser chos bcu gsum sogs kyi dbang rjes gnang thob/ rin po che rje dkon mchog bsam 'thub kyi mdun nas rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur rin po che'i bklag lung co ne par ma'i steng nas zla ba gsum dang nyin nyer gsum la sems bskyed mchod pa dang sbrags nas—31

bstsal ba gsan/ thams cad mkhyen pa bde thang rin po che blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma gzhan phan 'phrin las rgya mtsho tshang gi mdun nas rje btsun rigs byed ma lha bco lnga dang rig byed ma'i chos skor/ sa skya'i rtsar chen gyi chos skor sogs chos bka' mang po'i dbang thob/ mdor na bkra shis 'khyil kyi bla ma dge bshes che khag dang gser lag dgon gyi ya lags gtsang rgan tshang / o'u rgya tshang gi sprul sku/ yul skyong bstan rgyas/ a lags dgon/ gzhung brgya smra ba'i bshes gnyen dam pa blo bzang yar 'phel/ khong a khu rin po che brtson 'grus sogs skyes chen dam pa rnams las chos bka' mang po dang thun mong rig gnas kyi skor kyi dbang lung khrid sogs thob pa grangs las 'das/ /rab byung bcu drug pa'i sa glang (1949)lor bla brang nas rang dgon gser lag tu phebs/ lcags yos ( 1951)lor phyag mdzod chen mor bzhugs nas las sne legs par 'grub / dgon pa'i spyi gzhung la mdzo mo bcu dang gos mang nag gi 'cham wa lnga bcas phul/ nga brgyad lor 'dzin bzung byas shing drug bcu re gcig lor khrims nas phyir thon/ re bzhi lo'i spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi slob gso dang / re drug lo nas 'go brtsams pa'i rig gsar gyi skabs su sku ngal brjod las 'das pa bzhes/ /1981lo'i zla bzhi ba'i nang dgon pa bskyar gso'i gzhi 'dzin sngon ma'i nang du thon te/ bsang khri rtsig pa dang / dar shing 'dzugs pa/ tshogs 'tshogs sa'i 'du khang stabs bde gyan lnga bzhengs pa sogs kyi sku las la hur thag gis zhugs/ bla drug pa'i tshes bzhi'i nyin dgon pa'i tshogs dang po ratshogs skabs 'chad nyan dar ba'i rten 'brel du dge bshes bsam gtan rgya mtsho dang mnyam du tshogs langs byas/ zla bdun pa'i nang dgon pa'i do dam u yon lhan khang gi kru'u rin la 'dems thon byung ste chos sde gsar dar gyi don la hur thag byas pa'i mdzad rjes la dgon bdag rgya bza' tshang gis bsngags bajod gnang zhing bya dga' gnang / /315

1987lo'i bla 4ba'i nang khong rang sger nas dngul gyi ja dem khri gang gi tshad sogs 'bul ba spam mtho ba bsnams nas 'dul 'dzin phun tshogs rgya mtsho dang mnyam du rgyal sa pe cin du phebs nas paṇa chen rin po che la mjal te dgon pa'i gnas tshul dang 'byung 'gyur thugs rje'i skyabs 'og la 'dzin pa sogs kyi zhu ba phul/ rin po che nas yang dgon pa'i nyams len la phan pa'i bslab bya mang po gnang / gser lag gi 'thus tshab ni paṇa chen rin po che'i mdun du thon pa'i dgon sde'i 'thus mi bdun brgya lhag gi mtshams yin/khong phyir phebs skabs ri bo rtse lnga nas dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi zangs sku sogs rten byin can blus/ /dgon pa'i rten gyi don du spog phar bajos byed pa'i a khu 'a ma dbyangs khya ris ma/ rab byung bco lnga ba'i me pho 'brug la dpa' mchog bla rgan tshang nas 'khrungs/ chung dus nas gser lag dgon pa'i chos grwar zhugs te tshe dang sgrub pa snyom par mdzad/ khong gis tshe gang bor 'dod chung chog shes sgos chos rnam dag sgrub pa ni kun spangs rab byung ba'i tshad mar 'pher/ khong gis rang la 'thab rtsod dang dgag rgyag btson 'jug sogs nyen kha ci yod rgyab tu bskyur te srog phar bsngos kyis nga brgyad lo dang re lnga lo thengs gnyes la dgon pa'i rten byin can bag tse lcam sring bdag dam byas pas dgon pa'i lo rgyus thog byas rjes bla na med pa bzhagatshogs chen byang 'dren rnying pa blo bzang phun chogs/ khong ni rab byung bco lnga pa'i me 'brug ( 1916)lor dpa' mchog bla rgan tshang nas sku 'khrungs/ chung dus nas rab tu byung zhing chos sgor zhugs te gser lag dgon pa'i tshos spyod phyag len byang chub par sbyangs/ khong 'don pa bzang zhing skad brling pas dgon pa'i lo rgyus thog nas ming du grags yod pa'i tshogs chen byang 'dren zhig yin/ a lags gtsang chung tshang sa kha stod nas gyod la thug pa gdan 'dren du song nas phyir log skabs dka' sdug dang nyen 316

khar ma 'dzem par mas phog pa'i mi skya skyabs pa sogs kyi lo rgyus yod/ khyad par du dgon pa slar gso'i skabs su dka' khag gang na che na der thon yod pa dang / sngon chad sa phyogs kun tu ming grags yod pa'i gser lag gi thar 'do'i 'khor lo sogs kyi don du dka' tshegs dang rgyu 'byor ba phangs med bton nas par khang dang par shing gsar bzhengs byas/ lo gnyis lhag gi ring la bde gsang 'jigs gsum dang / kun rig sman ring / thugs rje chen mo/ mgon chos lha lnga/ rta mgrin yang gsang / bag tse/gnas bcu'i phyag mchod/ masmol bzhi ba dpag bsam snye ma/ rgyan 'jug gnyis/ smon lam rnam lnga/ rje'i bstod chen brgyad/ pan chen bde lam/mdo gdugs sgrol gsum/ mi 'khrugs pa sogs nye bar mkho ba'i par — rnams bzhengs nas grub/ rab byung bcu bdun pa'i sa pho 'brug lor sku gshegs/ /ya lags 'jigs med thub bstan༅ mtsho/ 1982lor dbus gtsang dag pa'i zhing khams la phebs nas7paṇa chen sku phreng bcu ba las bsnyen par rdzogs/ zhwa ser bstan pa'i 'byung gnas dga' ldan rnam par rgyal ba'i gling gi byang rtse'i mkhan por bzhugs/ dga' ldan dam can chos rgyal dang dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sku byin can / a mdo'i khams tshan rnams bzhengs/ 1990lo'i ston mjug tu them chen rdzong gi gnas ri ngo mtshar can nas dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi bsnyen mtshams la bzhugs nas ngo mtshar kyi ltas mang po thon/ spyi lo 1992lor khong dngos su gser lag bgon la phebs nas lha sa'i rtse zhol par ma'i bka' 'gyur tshar gcig dang /legs bshad snying bo gser bris ma tshar gcig/ gong sa rgyal dbang rin po che'i dngos gnang thub dbang gi sku gcig paṇa chen sku phreng bcu ba'i —gdung tsha'i dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sku bsnyan sogs dang / dkar rtsi las grub pa'i gnas bstan bcu drug gi 'dra sku 'du khang chen mo'i ka mgor 317

bzhag pa/ dung chen cha 'grig gnyis/ dpal na lan ṭa dang wa ra na si'i tshogs dung re/ mdo dbus dgon sde dag gi rten 'gangs can sgam gang bcas bsnams yong / a lags 'dzigs med lags sa thag ring na — bzhugs kyang pha yul gyi dgon sder thugs khur gzhal med gnang bar rang cag gis rjes su yi rang byed 'os/ /318

gnyis pa/ /dkar mo phug dge ldan bkra shis chos 'khor gling gi lorgyas bden gsal gser gyi me long zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /rten 'byung tshogs pa'i sgyu 'phrul gar/ /chos nyid klong du thim pa'i mdangs/ /mnyam rjes zung 'jug 'dres ma'i sku/ /brtse chen bla ma rnams la 'dud/ /tshogs gnyis rin chen bye ba'i gter mdzod byang chen sku bzhi'i rgya mtsho cher/ /stobs bcu'i lhun po bang rim bzhis mdzes legs gsungs nyi zla'i 'od non gyis/ /sdug kun 'ching ba'i mun pa mthar mdzad skal bzang rnam 'dren nyi ma'i gnyen/ /'gog lam dam chos nyan rang sras bcas snying dbus 'dab brgyar rtag tu bsten/ /blo chen snyi yig dwangs ma'i bdud rtsi'i chab/ /mkhas btsun bzang po'i rtse dga' la chags pas/ /mdzad bzang grags pa rab 'bar rgyal ba'i tog/ 'gro ba'i mig gcig tsong kha pa la — 'dud/ /de yang 'dir bajod par bya ba ni mtshams thogs dkar mo phug dgon pa'i lo rgyus rags tsam zhig 'jug bde ba'i slad/ lung dang rigs pa'i spros pa dor nas phyogs lhung dang sgro btags kyi bslad pa ma 'dres par tshad thub drang po'i lugs kyis brjod pa la/ thog mar dge ba chos sde 'di 'debs mkhan gyi rnam thar brjod pa dang / bar tu dge ba dgon pa'i lo rgyus brjod pa/ tha mar dge ba mjug bsdu ba'i rim pa'o/ /gcig dang por dge ba dam ba'i ma thar bajod pa/ 1 ri khrod 'debs pa po rje 'jam dbyangs mgyen rab dpal bzang gi rnam thar mdor bsdus/ /blo chen kun bzang spyod pa'i brtul zhugs mdzes/ /'jam dbyangs mkhyen rab dpal gyi thugs rgyud phyug/ bzang po'i gzhan phan 'phrin las mkha' mthar khyab/ /sku gzhogs yo'u rgya rdo rje 'chang chen rgyal/ /spros bral 319

'jam dpal ye shes gzhon nu'i sku/ /gang 'tsham yan lag drug cu'i dbyangs ldan zhing / /mkhyen brtse rab rgyas dpal yon bla na med/ /rmad byung mdzad bzang ston la gus pas 'dud/ ces bsngags pa ltar ri khrod 'debs pa po sku gzhogs o'u rgya 'jam dbyangs mkhyen rab dpal bzang 'di nyid rab byung bco lnga'i zu pho 'brug ( 1892) lor sa la dge bcu 'dzoms shing /bka' gdams glegs bam las lung bstan pa'i mdzo mo nu rtse'i rdza lung /gnas mchog mthu rtsal rgyas pa'i dkar phyogs lha yi tshogs rnams rku zhing sa yi rgyan du gleng pa de'i nye 'dabs su yo'u rgya sgar ba'i sde nang du yab nges bzung med kyang yum bzang mo zer ba rjes su jo mo byas nas dgon pa ru bzhugs/de'i sras su bod zla lnga ba'i tshes bzhi'i nyen 'brug sgra lhang lhang grags pa'i chu 'dzin gseb nas char babs pa dang bstun nas 'ja' tshon rnam par bkra ba dang lhan du rje 'de nyid 'khrungs par gsungs/ de'i tshe 'od gor 'phags ma yid ba'in 'khor lo'i sku bsnyan lta bu zhig rje nyid la yang yang thim pa kun gyis mthong pa'i ltas bzang po ngo mtshar ba byung la/ der ma zad lhums su zhugs dus yum gyi nyams snang la 'od 'bar pa'i gser sku phyag mtshan ral gri can zhig 'od dang bcas te thim pa'i snang ba shar ba dang rjes su yang rje btsun sgrol ma'i sku che chung du nam mkha' las babs te lus la thim pa mis zhes thugs thag bcad rjes bshad pa ma gtogs sngon la gsang 'dug zer/yum gyi mtshan lam dang mthun pa'i sgo nas mtshan la 'jam dbyangs rgya mtsho zhes gsol de nas dgung grangs bdun son ( /899)pa'i lor kerte blo bzang 'phrin las rgya mtsho rwa rgyar phebs skabs chos sde gser lag dgon gyi bla grwa che khag 'ga' sprul sku thugs thag gcod par song / de'i tshe kerte blo bzang 'phrin las kyis bden gnyis shes bya'i khyon kun cig car gzhal ba'i ye shes kyi gzigs pa mchog tu yangs ba'i sgo nas thugs thag bcad dus sngon gyi 'khrungs yul du byis pa 'jam dbyangs rgya mtsho zer ba zhig yod pa de red ces 320

gsungs/ /de nas ring bo ma lon pa'i zla drug pa'i tshes bzhi'i nyin gser lag dgon nas me tog gur gum gsar ba'i phreng ba skyes su bstar ba'i ser spreng dang bsu ba rgya chen po mdzad nas khrir 'khod de zhabs sen zla tshes gsar ba'i bdud rtsi lus can bsod nams ral ba'i rgyan du rnam par mdzes par gyur/a rig rdo je mchang 'jam dbyangs shes rab las rab byung dang dge tshul dkyus gcig tu bsgrubs te 'jam dbyangs mkhyen rab dpal bzang zhes mtshan gsol zhing / thugs kyi ze'u 'bru ba'in tu gces par bskyangs/ thos bsam rgya chen mdzad cing 'dul khrims rnam par dag pa'i dge slong kun— dga' bzang po klog gi dge rgan du bsten nas yi ge 'bri klog dang sum rtags dag gsum chos spyod sna tshogs/ kun rig 'jigs byed sogs kyi cho ga bad 'jug dang bcas pa/ mgon chos lha bcu gsum gyi cho ga spyod 'jug chen mo sogs gang bslab thams cad thugs la shar shar thon pa'i rnam daphyod kyi rtsal 'gran zla dang bral bas na na mnyam kun las khyad du 'phags pa mngon gsal tu mthong thub/ dgung grangs bcu gsum par grwa tshang yongs la gtong sgo chen po mdzad de tshogs la zhugs/ de dus nas chen po'i go sa re ba'i 'dod gdungs dang / dar zab 'bol gdan brtsegs pa'i gagon sha rgyas pa'i 'gying bag gnyis ring du dor nas tshogs dang chos grwa la rgyun par hur thag gnang pa ma zad/ tshogs 'don dang rtsod pa'i skor brdar sha chod pa'i slob brtson gnang / de ltar blo 'dzin skyor sbyangs chu bo'i rgyun bzhin bsten ngos rje btsun blo gros rgya mtsho'i spyan sngar lam rim nyams khrid dang—sems bskyed/ blo spyong skor khrid cing / 'jigs byed/ gsang 'dus/bde mchog sogs gtso bor gyur pa'i smin byed dbang dang rjes gnang /grol byed bskyed rdzogs lam gyi rim pa'i khrid sogs chos bka' bslab bya'i rim pa mang du gsan/ de dus rje blo gros mchog thugs ha cang dgyes pa'i 321

ngang sprul ba'i sku mchog 'di nyid mkhyen rab 'gran zla bral ba 'ig yin gshis pegs bshad gsung gi nga ros snod ldan gdul bya'i tshogs tshims par byed pa'i dus shig 'ongs zhes 'byung 'gyur lung bstan dang sbrags pa'i bsngags bajod gnang yongs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen legs bshad rgya mtsho'i zhal snga nas bsdus grwa blo rtags/ sa lam/ grub mtha'/ don bdun cu/ rje btsun pa'i spyi don/ mtha' daphyod/ dge 'dun nyi shu/ kun gzhi )na 'brel/ drang nges/ bsam gzugs/ dbu ma/ mdzod 'dul/ lam rim che chung / lhag par zhi lhag skabs sogs dbu sems kyi phra ba'i rigs pa'i gnad rnams bshad sbyangs gtsor 'don gnang pas chos rab tu rnam 'byed kyi shes rab me ltar 'bar ba'i rnam daphyod kyi klong brdol bar gsungs/ /yab rje bla ma sku gzhogs a rig tshang nas rta ge na gyi chos skor/ khro4nag thugs rje chen po'i skor sogs kyi dbang dang rjes gnang gi rim pa mang du gsan/ lhag par tu lam rim chen mo'i bshad lung / rgyud sde rnams kyi gzab bshad/ rgyud sde gong 'og gi lam gyi rim pa mi 'dra ba'i gnad dang /gsang sngags rnying ma'i skor mang po/ dkyil 'khor so so'i thig rdul tshon/thig bshad/ las bzhi'i thabs dang sbyin bsregs sogs mthong ba brgyud pa'i lag len dngos ji lta ba ba'in rtogs par gyur/ /sa skya pa dang rnying ma ba (gter ston 'dzigs 'ba' tshang dang phan tshun bla slob yin )zhi byed pa sogs so so'i gzhi lam 'bras gsum nang byang chub pa'i mkhas shing grub pa'i tshogs kyi zhabs sen gtsug gi rgyan tu bkur te rgya chen thos pa mang tu btsal/ de tsam du ma zad de dag gi skabs su lam gyi gol sa dang spangs bya spong tshul/ dmigs rim dang thos pa bogs 'don tshul sogs bsam pas nges pa drangs te rgyud la sbyangs pas gzhung lugs gdams par shar zhing / bstan pa thams cad 'gal med du gzigs par 322

gyur/ /bgrang bya zhe brgyad pa shing stag (1914)lor dgung grangs nyer gsum steng bstan pa'i nang mdzod 'dul ba 'dzin pa chen po khri ga'i bla ma chos rje blo bzang phun tshogs kyis mkhan slob sbrags ma gnang/ sku gzhogs thar shul tshang gi sku gong ma dge legs dbang byug tshos skyong rgya mtshos gsang ston mdzad de bslab gzhi yongs dzogs dge slong gi sdom pa bzhes te rab byung pa'i bcas mtshams mtha' dag mig ltar bsrung bar mdzad/ rje 'di nyid chung dus gtong phod che zhing byams snying rje rang chos su mnga' ba zhig yin pas/ phyag rdzas gang yong thams cad sku gsung thugs rten dang dge 'dun gyi bsnyen bkur/ nyam chung la sbyin par gtong ba sogs las chud zas su gtong ba mi gnang la/ lhag par tu gzhan gyi sdug bsngal dang snying rje'i dmigs bu mthong ba na spyan chab lhug lhug tu bzhur 'ongs pa dang dam pa'i chos kyi phan yon dang lhag pa'i lha'i byin rlabs/ sems bskyed pa'i yon tan sogs 'chad pa'i skabs su'ang nam rgyun 'di bzhin gnang zhes gsungs/ /rang dgon gser lag nas khrir bzhugs te mu ṭa rdor phreng dang bde gsang 'jigs gsum sogs dbang rjes gnang dang / khrid bshad lung sogs chos bka' mang po'i rgyun bskyangs nas bka' drin shin tu che bar mdzad/ gtsang dgon pa'i mkhas pa'i gtsug rgyan rong bo brtsi bzhag chos rje tshul khrims rgya mtsho las dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang chen thob la/chos rje sras mchog blo bzang 'phrin las drung nas dus 'khor dbang chen khrid lag len dus go rdul tshon sbyin bsregs sogs byang chub par bslabs nas sku mtshams shin tu dam pa'i sgo nas dus 'khor bsnyen pa phud de kha skong sbyin bsregs skabs 'azin las kyi 'od snang phyogs bcur rgyas pa'i brda rtags shar bar gsungs/ de ltar rje 'di nyid kyis bka' sde snod gsum/ sgos rgyud sde bzhi'i lha chos gāgo'i rgyun bzang drang srong thugs kyi ral bar sim pa 323

snod ldan re bab gsos su smin ran pa na/ dgung grangs nyer lnga ba rab byung bco lnga ba'i me 'brug (1916)lor khrab chen phar 'khor rdza dkar rtsa ring du grags pa'i rma sras dkar phyogs skyong ba'i lha ri'i nye 'dabs su mtshams thog gong zhol gyi bla grwa yongs dang rgya bza' dme gling sogs kyi dad ldan ser skya stong phrag brgal bar dus 'khor dbang chen thengs dang por gnang/ dus der ye shes spyanasagyis gzigs stangs tsam gyis lha 'dre gdugs pa'i cho 'phrul rang sar zhi ba sogs spangs rtogs yon tan che mtho'i mtshan snyan gyis sa chen po 'di bkang bar mdzad do/ /gzhan yang de dus sngags sa'i mtshams thog gong ma 'i dge bshes 'jam dbyangs don yod sogs kyis bskul ngor stag phu ba'i dag snang sgrol ma'i chos skor/ bka' gdams thig le bcu drug sogs lhag lha du ma'i dbang rjes gnang / lung dang bshad pa sogs 'don chos mang bo gnang / gsang sngags chos 'khor gling nas mu ṭa rdo rje phreng ba'i dbang bshad 'byams klas pa dang phyag len phu thag chod par byas te skal ldan lus can tshogs rnams kyi yid tshim par mdzad/ lam rim 'jam dpal 'al lung dang dge ldan phyag chen rtsa ba rgyal ba'i gzhung lam bla mchod dang sbyar ba'i khrid tshogs pa zil gyis gnon pa'i spobs pa/ zab don thang mar— brdal ba'i rnam daphyod/ dri med lung dang rigs pa'i dgag sgrub sogs gang thad nas blo ldan skye bo'i yid dbang 'thog pa'i gzab bshad gnang pas rje nyed kyi gsang gsum byin rlabs 'od dkar zer gyis kun gyi snying la dad pa'i ut+pal lhug par grol bar gyur to/ /phyogs yas mas su sgod ldan mchog tu gzigs pa brgya lhag la bka' brgyud gtum mo lus spyor/ 'khrul 'khor/rtsa chung sogs dang mgon po bka' chen bcu gsum gyi rjes gnang sogs bka' dge sa rnying sogs grub mtha' ris med kyi bdag po gcig pur mdzad de so so'i 'dod mos ltar/ gdul bya'i blo dang 'tshams pa'i chos sbyin dgyes dgur bstsal/ rka rgan gzhung gi dar spyog mdo nas dgon gong ma 324

gtso byas pa'i dad ldan ser skya mang por dus 'khor dbang chen zengs gnyis pa gnang ste skye bo kun smin grol gyi lam la bkod cing ma 'ongs par rigs ldan sham bha lar 'khor gcig tu skyes nas rdzogs ldan dam pa'i chos kyi 'tsho ba'i sa bon khyad par can bsgrun par mdzad/ /skabs shig la tsha grangs ma snyoms pa'i rkyen lta bus sku la snyun ga'i byung par zhag mang por 'di snang gi spros pa dor nas mnyam ba'ag ting 'dzin gyi ngang la rtse gcig tu bzhugs/ de dus nyams snang la sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams mang por 'od kyis 'gengs pa mthong pa dang/ rgyud bla ma las/ skye ba mngon par skye ba dang / /dga' ldan gnas nas 'pho ba dang / /lhums su zhugs dang bltams pa dang / /bzo yi gnas la mkhas pa dang / /btsun mo'i 'khor gyis rol ba dang / /nges 'byung dka' ba spyad pa dang / /zhes pa nas/yongs su ma dag zhing khams su/ /srid pa ji srid gnas par ston/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar gyi mdzad chen bcu gnyis kyang mjal bar gsungs la/ de dus rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma bcos min sems kyi rol rtsed du bsus pa'i ting 'dzin zab mor mnyam brgag ngang nas lha sngags bsnyen pa'ang ma chad gsungs/ /nam zhig khong nyid kyi 'de snang phra mo je rags su song tshe yar bzhengs nas rdo lda phyag rjes phab pa'i grub rtags bstan/ bar snang du khri bdun tsam 'phags nas oṃ gsum ma'i sngags bgrang bzhin bzhugs pa sogs mdzad par gsungs la/ de'i tshe skyabs rje a rig rdo rje 'chang gis de ltar gnang mi chog ces bka' yis bkag de nas sku'i skun gzhi cung zad sde bar song 'phral dgon pa'i grwa tshang dang phyogs yas mas kyi bu slob mang po/ dgon gong ma'i sde ba so so bcas nas rim gro rgya cher bsgrubs/ rje nyid kyis kyang thugs snang sman gsum la bsten nas sgun gami rim gyis sangs/ de nas sku 'tshams bcad de kun mkhyen phar phyin mtha' dpyod las/ gzhung sher phyin la thos 325
