bsam dang lam sher phyin la nyams len 'tshang rgya kha'i bar tu dgos pa'i phyir/zhes gsungs pa ltar/ gser phreng dang rnam bshad snying po'i rgyan gnyis spyi don dang mtha' daphyod gnyis dang sbyar nas phra zhib blo gros kyis daphyad mthar sher phyin gyi dgongs don spu ba la gzhan dring mi 'jog pa'i spobs pa brnyes par gyur/ blo bzang snyan brgyud kyi gdams pa'i mdzod 'dzin grags pa rgya mtsho mchog gi mdun nas rje yab sras gsum gyi gsung 'bum gyi lung mnos/ngur sprig rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa'i sde gser lag dgon nas rje nyid kyis grwa tshang yongs la byang chub lam rim chen mo'i khrid lung rigs mtha' yas pa'i spros nas 'byams klas par gnang / rgyal sras chen po zhi ba lha'i spyod 'jug gi khrid rgyal tshab dar ma'i rnam bshad dang rgyal sras thogs 'grel sbrags nas zhib khrid mdzad/ dgun khar bcad rgya dam po'i ngang nas yi dam pad+ma dbang chen gyi bsnyen sgrub kha skong sbyin bsregs dang bcas pa mdzad/dpyid dus ne'u gsing chu mig ri brag sogs gnyan sa 'grims nas chu mig brgya rtsa phud/ rab byung bcu drug pa'i me yos ( 1927)lor ya rig rdo rje 'chang mya ngan las 'das pa'i tshul bstan par da ni chos kyi nyi ma nub rir yal gsungs nas thugs shin tu skyo ba'i ngang spyan chab mang po bsil bzhin bde gsang 'jigs gsum sogs bla med kyi rgyud sde mang po'i sgrub mchod dang tshogs 'khor rgya cher bskor nas thugs zag med kyi dgongs pa khyad par can 'grub pa'i bsngo smon bla na med pa mdzad/ de'i phyi lor khong gi zhal chems bzhin ri khrod dkar mo phug gsar 'debs mdzad/ de nas sku 'khor —'ga' dang lhan tu ri krod nas rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i mtshams la bzhugs shing nyams rtogs rgya cher 'phel/ /ri khrod btab (1929)nas de ru bka' chos kyi thog mar gsungs pa ni li u ba'i lugs kyi dpal 'khor lo sdom pa bde mchog gi dbang dang na ro mkha' spyod ma'i byin rlabs kyi rim pa yin la/ rjes nas kyang tshogs 'don 326

du btsugs pa sogs kyi gnas 'di mkha' spyod grub pa'i sgrub phug tu grub tshul gsung tshul ya mtshan 'ig yod de 'og tu dgon pa'i lo rgyus dngos kyi skabs su 'chad par 'gyur ro/ /ga'an yang grub dbang tshems bu ba'i dag snang chos skor las/ lo ki sha ra'i bskyed rim dang rdzogs rim gnyis dang sprel nas bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi khrid rgyas par gnang / /chos lung byang chub lha ri dkar po'i mgul sngags sa'i mtshams thog gong ma bkra shis tshos dzong dge 'phel byang chub gling nas bla ma sprul sku mang po gtso byas 'dus sde rin po che spyi dang phyogs kyi dad ldan mer skya mang por mi 'khrugs pa 'dod 'jo'i bum dbang / dben sa'i gcod dbang / gnyan khrod 'grims tshul gyi snyan brgyud zhal shes man ngag dang bcas pa'i 'i khrid/mgon bka' bcu gsum sogs rang rang gi 'dod mos bzhin mdo sngags kyi chos sbyin rgya chen po spel te rma phar kha'i phyogs der bde bar gshegs pa'i bstan pa yod do cog rje 'di'i bka' drin kho na las byung ngo / /phyir phebs nas 'du 'dzis dben pa'i gnas mchog dkar mo sgrub phug nas mtshams dang bsnyen pa/ phyag mchod/ skor ba/ sku dpar ba/ satsā 'debs pa sogs chos ldan gyi bya ba rnams chu bo'i rgyun bzhin bskyangs/ phyogs yas mas kyi 'bul ba rnams cung zad kyang chud zos su ma song ba byas te rje'i stong sku/ sgrol ma'i stong sku/ rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur ro cog dang bstan 'gyur bcas mchod khang rten dang brten pa rnams bzhengs/ rje nyid 'tsho thabs tsam gyis bzhes pa dang na bza' la brten nas bya btang ri khrod 'dzin pa'i brtul zhugs kyis phyogs dang phyogs mtshams so so nas slebs pa kun la bde gsang 'jigs gsum/ kun rigs/ mi 'khrugs pa/ thugs rje chen po/mgon chos lha lnga/ rje btsun ma'i byin rlabs sogs rang 'dod ltar zab rgyas chos kyi rgyun bzang gis tshim par mdzad/ /de nas mi ring bar bcad rgya mdzad de rgyu phar phyin theg pa'i lam thun 327

mong pa dang thun mong ma yin pa 'bras bu gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i lam la brtson bzhin/ phyag 'tshal masgol gyi tshogs bsags pa/ rdor sems bsgom bzlas kyis sdig sgrib sbyangs pa'i gnad rnams chu bo'i rgyun bzhin skyong skabs rje nyid kyi bka' drin gsum ldan gyi bla ma rin po che rje 'jam dbyangs shes rab sku gzi 'od rab tu 'bar ba zhig las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs nas khong nyid la dzim pa byung / 'di ni lung rtogs yon tan thams cad gyi rtsa ba bla ma bsten tshul la srel ma shor bar rigs gsum 'du pa'i bdag nyid dam par mos pa'i rnal 'byor gyi thugs yid chos sku'i klong nyid du 'dres shing bsnyen pa gnad du song rtags yang dag go/skabs shig rje btsun ma'i byin rlabs gnang skabs 'ja' tshon 'od lnga 'khrigs pa'i lding khang na rje nyid kyis rdor dril bzung nas phyag rgya'i gar dang bcas bzhugs pa las snang da / pa'i slob ma mang pos gzigs/ de yang snod dag pa bde chen gzhal yas khang dang bcud dag pa mkha' spyod dbang mo'i skur snang ba dag pa'i mthu grub pa yin zhes gsungs pa dang jo mo lha lcam ma'i nye 'dabs su'ang char sprin 'khrigs pa'i gur khang nas rje nyid kyis chos gsungs pa dang ma 'ongs 'byung 'gyur gyi lung bstan gnang pa sogs gsang pa'i rnam thar phra mo 'ga' re yang yod mod bri bar ma spobs so/ /rab rgyal chu bya (1933)lor sha ra'i sdong rgan dpon tshang gi gzhis ka ru phyogs de'i ser skya stong phrag du ma la dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang chen gsum pa gnang pa dang lhag lha du ma'i dbang rjes gnang / khrid man ngagalung dang bshad lung sogs kyis dad ldan mang po'i re ba bskangs shing rdzogs ldan chos kyi zhing khams su bsgyur te bod mi chos kyi 'tsho/ zer ba ltar bsam don yongs su dzog4par byas/ de dus dkar phyogs skyong pa'i lha klu gnyan gsum thugs dgyes shing 'azin las mdzad pa'i rtags mtshan thon/ rje nyid kyi snyan grags shin tu rgyas pa dang mdzad 'phrin yang lhag par 'phel bar gyur 328

to/ /lam skabs nas ka rgya gda' tshang / sha sbrang tsho drug sogs su thugs rje chen po dang rje btsun ma'i byin brlabs sogs chos bka' mang po gnang /dus skabs 'dir mtshon na 'ba' mang ra dang / rma nyin srib sogs kyi sa khul na rje nyid kyi mkhas btsun bzang gsum dang yon tan las lhag pa med par gsungs/ de ltar rje 'di nyid sa khul 'di'i grub mtha' ris med kyi mdo sngags bstan pa'i bdag po gcig pur gyur te chos dang rig gnas thad mdzad rjes khyad du 'phags pa bzhag gdan sa dkar mo phug tu byon nas dgu gu'i tshes bcu nyin rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs dang mchod pa rgya chen mdzad dus gzim gur gyi steng tu 'ja' tshon zum po shar ba nye 'khor gyis mthong / thun mtshams rnams su bu slob rnams la thun mong lam sbyangs sngon tu grub pa'i ched/ dal 'byor rnyed dka'/ 'chi ba mi rtag pa/ skyabs 'gro/ las 'bras/ nges 'byung / bden bzhi/ theg chen lam gyi gzhung shing byang chub sems bskyed kyi khrid la sogs yang dang yang du rgyas par gnang / daphyid dus nas rje nyid rnal 'byor brtson pa'i sku 'khor sum bcu dang bcas te chu mig 'grims/ thun mtshams rnams kyi dus tshod tsam re yang chud zos su ma song par byas te bla ma mchod pa'i khrid yongs 'dzin ye shes rgyal mtshan gyi ṭik+ka dang sbyar/ phyag chen rtsa ba'i gzhung lam paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan nyid kyi rang 'grel dang sbyar nas gzab bshad gnang /gzhan yang gcod dbang dang gcod khrid zu mig 'grims tshul bla ma dam pa'i phyag len phra zhib rnams khrid par mdzad pas skal ldan rnal 'jur gyi tshogs rnams de'i skor la nang byan chud de nyams rtogs klong brdol ba byung nas chos kyi rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa'i gangs phrug gis mtha' bskor bar gyur/ rje 'di nyid kyis dbu mdzad de dgon pa gong 'og gtso byas dgon gong 'og bar gsum gyi lha sde kun nas rgyal bstan yun du dar ba dang dam pa'i sku tshe brtan pa/ 'bangs la bde skyid ldan pa bcas par dmigs te/ gdugs ring 329

'bum/ ma ṇi dung phyur brgya/ sgyung gnas stong skor/ tshe thar tshe blu mang po/ gzhan yang bsrung ba'i rim pa dpag tu med pa mdzad/ dgun dkar mo phug nas bcad rgya dam po mdzad de rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i thun bzhi'i bsnyen sgrub la 'bad pas ltas bzang ya mtshan pa mkha' 'gro'i sichu ra'i rgyun babs pa dang / dkyil 'khor gsum dang mchod pa rnams li khri'i dwangs ma lta bur byung pa sogs sku 'khor nye gnas kun gyis reg kyang myong la bu slob grags can skor la yang springs/ dgun gyi tshogs mchod skabs shig ka pa la las ma da na 'phyur te phyir 'pho ba byung pa sogs ngo mtshar rten 'brel dpag tu med pa byung / da dung ye shes brda glu zhig kyang yod pa da lta dkar mo phug dgon pa dang rma phar kha tshur kha'i mkha' spyod tshogs glu mdzad bzhin yod/ /shing phag ( 1935)lo'i ston zla ra ba'i nang chos 'byung dmar po gru gsum pa nyis brtsegs pa'i gur khang gi dbus su rje btsun ma'i sku smad yongs rdzogs rak+ta rgyun gyis brlan pa gzigs shing tshogs mchod rgya chen po phul bar dgyes nyams mdzad pa snang pa dang skabs shig rgyun gyi dbang bzhi len skabs sgo mtshams brgyad kyis bskor pa'i gtso bo mkha' spyod mas rje nyid la dngos dbang bskur zhing byin gyis brlabs byung / mdor na rje 'di nyid kyis chung dus nas rje btsun rnal 'byor ma gsang ba'i yi dam du bsten nas rgyun gyi nyams mang po'i rim pa la chig 'dril byas/ dkar mo phug gi gnas 'di dang 'brel bar sku'i gzigs snang du mar byung pa dang gsung gi dbugs—dbyung bar mdzad pa/ lung bstan gnang pa/ bdud rtsis byin gyisobarlabs pa/ nyams dang rtogs pa 'phel ba 'di dag la dpags na gdan sa dkar mo gsang chen sgrub phug 'de rje btsun ma'i bsgrub gnas khyad par can zhig yin pa the tshom med/ /rje 'di nyid kyis rgyun ldan tshe gcig gi nyams len yang nyin gcig la sbyar na shes rla ste/ tho rangs ldang ba'i rnal 'byor gyi sgo nas khrus dang bdud 330

rtsi myangs/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed tshad med bzhi'i bsam pa rgya che ba'i rtsis zin pa'i sgo nas dmigs rim bskyangs/ de nas bla ma rnal 'byor zab mo'i srog tu bzung nas rtsa khams yan lag dbang po sogs dpa' bo dakhro' mor byin gyis brlabs/ ngag bzlas dang yid bzlas byas/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i thun mong dang thun mong min pa'i dag mdun sgrub pa dang bdag 'jug tshogs bcas gsungs nas tshogs grol/ da dung gtor ma brgya rtsa/chab gtor/ tsha gsur sogs dal bur gsungs te dmigs rnams legs par bskyangs/ de nas gtor bsngos dang mchod pa gsungs 'phral nangs ja bzhes/ de nas dung brda btang ste bu slob grwa 'khor dang bcas bla mchod bton rte mchod pa stong phrag mang po bshams/ lhung bshags spyi bshags/gnas bcu'i phyag mchod gsung bzhin bskyang phyag ma mtha' yang lnga brgya lhag tsam/ maskol brgya dang bcas te gnang / lam mchog sgo 'byed gsung 'phral bla mchod mjug bsdus te lam rim shar bsgom dang blo spyong byed/ de nas bsngo smon rnam par dag pas mtshams spyor bzhin thub dbang / mi 'khrugs pa/ 'od dpags med/ rdo rje sems dpa'/ 'jams —dbyangs/ byams mgon/ tshe lha rnam gsum/ rigs gsum mgon po/bde mchog mkha' spyod ma/ rje gzigs pa lnga ldan/ sgrol ma bcas kyi sku brnyan dgu re/ satsā dgu bcas rje nyid kyis 'debs par ma zad/ de nas tshar chen dang rje btsun ma'i chog bsdus gsungs te tsha stang ma bzhes/dmigs brtse ma sogs zhal 'don gnang / yas mas kyi bka' chos zhu ba rnams la 'dod mos bzhin re ba bskangs/ nyin gung dkon mchog rjes dran gyi mdo dang / lag mchod/ zas mchod bcas gung tshigs gsol/zas bsngo stung bshags sogs bton nas 'brel thogs shi gson re ltos can la dmigs pa'i bsngo sgron yang yang mdzad/ dpe gzigs gnang rjes phyi dro thun la zhugs/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i zab lam la sngar bzhin gzhol/331

srod dus mgon po dang dur bdag lcam sring / lha mo/ ma mgon/dam can/ lha ri zhal dkar bcas la bsangs dang gtor ma/ gser skyems bcas phul te byang chub sgrub pa'i bar chad zhi ba dang / legs tshogs yid smon bzhin 'thub pa'i 'azin bcol dang grogs dan bcol/ nyal khar mchog gsum rten gyi drung du ma mtha' yang mar me bdun mchod re phul te mchod chog mchod gzungs gsungs nas bden stobs brjod/ ja dang sil snyan/ ting shag rol mo'i sgra dang bcas dngos bshams yid kyis sprul ba'i mchod tshogs kun tu bzang po mchod sprin ltar 'bul bar mdzad/bstan 'gro'i don du bsngo smon rgya chen gnang / lus sbyin gsungs te mchod yul mgron du bsngos/ 'khor gsum dmigs med lta bu'i klong du yun ring bzhugs/ de nas langs te rdo rje mkha' 'gro sbyin bsregs dang dam tshig rdo rje bzlas pa/ stung bshags sogs 'al 'don dmigs bsal can 'ga' re gsungs rjes rgyud sde nas gsungs pa'i rnal 'byor 'od gsal du zhugs/nyin rer de lta bu'i chos kyi go rim mang po bsgrigs te sa lam gyi rtogs pa gong 'phel tu gtong pa la chig dril du 'bad cing gzhan don tu skyo ngal cung tsam yang med par 'dod mos bzhin byed pa/ byams dang snying rje lhan skyes su 'grogs pa 'di lta bu'i dam pa khyad par can zhig gis da dung khom long tsam yang mi bsten par mi tshe gang por chos kyi don du 'bad pa dang tha na bzhes pa gnang dus yang tha mal ba'i skad cha sdom par byed/ /rab byung bcu drug pa'i me byi (1936)dgung lo bzhi bcu zhe lnga pa la sngar gyi skun gzhi bslangs dgon gong 'og dang phyogs yongs kyi dad ldan mang tshogs kyis rim gro rgya chen bsgrubs nas cung zad bde bar gyur/ khong gi byugs bkod bzhin rwa rgya'i chos mdzad ngag dbang rgya mtsho tshang gis rwa rgyar sgo bstun nas dga' ldan bkra shis chos 'khor gling la gzhi gsum lag len dang dgag dbye gso gsum gyi 'dul ba'i lag len gzhi tshugs par mdzad de 332

phan bde 'byung gnas rgyal ba'i bstan pa gnas gzhi dang gangs can bod kyi rig gnas 'dzin skyong spel ba'i gdan sa khyad par can 'ig tu gtan 'jags mdzad/ ston zla ra ba'i dmar phyogs kyi tshes nyi shu la rang dason nas gzims mal du sezhe nyal stabs mdzad de gzugs sku'i bkod pa chos dbyings su zhugs pa'i tshul bstan pa'i tshe sku'i nyams cung zad zhan pa glo bur du dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs gzhon nu'i lang tsho ltar rgyas/ bal nub phyogs su bsgyur/ spyan gyi gzigs pa ma zum par cher gzigs/ thugs rim gyis stong ba gsum 'das nas thams cad stong ba 'od gsal don dam pa'i bden pa mngon du mdzad pa na dmar ser sprin gyi dra ba dkrigs/ khor yug 'ja' tshon phreng ba'i mdzes par bstar/ mkha' spyod dgyes pa'i rol dbyangs grags pa sogs ya mtshar ba'i ltas dang bcas rte mkha' spyod ma'i zhing la thugs kyi rtogs pa 'phos par gyur to/ /bu slob kun gyis mchod pa'i tshogs rgya chen po mdzad de rje nyed kyi zugs dgongs zab mo rdzogs pa'i phyir/ kun rig mi 'khrugs pa/ rje btsun ma sogs sgrub mchod mang po gnang 'ing rje nyid dang mtshungs pa'i slar skyes sprul sku zhig myur bar 'byon par smon lam nan tan gnang / zhag gsum rdzogs rjes thugs dam grol/ grol rtags rgyud sde nas gsungs pa ltar yo da pa zhugs su phul bar rang bsrel lnga ldan byung ba rnams mchod rten du bzhugs su gsol/ de ltar 'phen pa'i dbang gis sku lus rnying pa dor/ yid lus bzung nas zhing khams mang por byon mthar dad ldan slob bu'i tshogs rnams la thugs brtse ba chen po'i ye thes kyis phyir gzigs nas ma dag pa'i zhing khams mtha' klas par sku lus nyi zer gyi rdul ltar sprul ba las phyogs 'dir me tog phog pa'i lha skal ni blo bzang lung rtogs rgya mtsho nyid yin la/ de'i rnam thar ni cung zad 'og tu 'chad do/ /de lhar rje 'di nyid kyi rnam thar thun mong gdul bya la mdzad pa ston lugs dang thun mong ma yin pa ngo bo'i gnas tshod 333

gang gi dbang du byas kyang gong 'og sbyar te bsam na skyes chen dam pa'i mdzad 'phrin nam mkha'i mthar mi shong pa lta bu zhig yod pas kun gyis yid dag snang nor bu'i 'od snang 'phro bzhin rnam thar la yid smon dang bstod bsngags bajod par rigs so/ /mdzad pa 'azin las rje nyid dang mtshungs pa'i gsung las skyes pa'i slob ma yang gtsang sprul chos kyi rdo rje blo bzang ngag dbang 'azin las rgya mtshos rje nyid sku 'das rjes dkar mo phug nas gzims khang brtsigs te bzhugs/chos 'jig rten gnyis las ga'i thad nas bka' drin che bar bskyangs/ ya lags lcang skya 'jams dbyangs shes rab dar rgyas tshang / ya lags rgya bza' tshang / phur tsha tshang / brtsi bzhag tshang / a lags smad sog tshang /sngags sa gong ma'i dgon bdag 'jam dbyangs don yod tshang / mtshams thog zhol ma'i dgon bdag byams pa bsam gtan tshang / sprel rdzong ya lags phur rtsa tshang / a lags rdzong sngon tshang / ya khu 'jams dbyangs 'od rgyam tshang / o'u rgya'i dge zhes chung ba tshang (khong dkar mo phug gi grwa rgyun yin)/ a khu 'jigs lo tshang sogs rma phar kha tshur kha'i rigs gsum so so'i rnam sprul bla ma rnams dang grwa btsun yongs kyis bla mar ma bsten pa re gnyis las ma gtogs med pa gong gi rnam thar la bltas na gsal/rje 'di nyid kyis mdzad pa'i gsung rtsom yang yi dam lha'i bsnyen pa dang smon lam skor/ gsung mgur dang bslab bya'i skor/ gnas bdag lha ri zhal dkar kyi bsang mchod ring thung gnyis dang gtor chog bca' yig —sogs pod chung zhig yod/ /srus pa/ /sngon sbyangs bag chags zab mo'i rang 'od 'phro/ /phan sems bdud rtsi'i phyug pa'i bcud bzang 'grems/ /mdo sngags chos tshul rig pa'i rtse dga' sbyin/ /mkhasaklobatsun bzang 'dzoms 'di 'dra 334

bla ma dngos/ /2 rje 'jar dbyangs mkhyen rab dpal bzang gi sku phreng snga phyi'i rnam thar mdor bsdus/ /mkhas shing grub pa'i dbang po 'di nyed kyi sku phreng rim byon gyi dbang du byas na kun spangs 'dul ba 'dzin pa chen po nges pa don gyi bla ma rin po che rje lcang skya 'jam dbyangs shes rab dar rgyas tshang gi zhal snga nas grub pa'i gtsug rgyan paṇa chen na ro ba/ /za hor sku 'khrungs sngags spyon bzhad pa rtsal/ /o'u rgya sgar ba'i bla ma dbu dkar pa/ /zung 'jug thub pa'i dbang po rnal 'byor ba/ /mkhas btsun bzang gsum bdag nyid rdo rje 'chang / /sku gzhogs 'jam dbyangs mkhyen rab dpal bzang po/ /sprul ba'i sku mchog blo bzang lung rtogs te/ /mkhas grub gser ri'i phreng ba ltar brgyus pa'i/ /nged cag rnams kyi bgo bskal bla ma mchog/ rje btsun blo bzang 'jam dpal rgya mtsho lags/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar dam pa 'di nyid dpal 'khor lo bde ba chen po dngos su mi'i rnam par byon pa zung 'jug grub pa'i dbang po rje btsun te lo ba'i spas kyi thu bor gyur pa grub pa'i gtsug rgyan paṇa chen nā ro ba dang / 'phyongs rgyas za hor ma'i rigs su sku 'khrungs pa'i rgyal ba'i dbang po ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho mchog gnyis kyi sku phreng la ngos 'dzin la/ sa phyogs 'di nas yo'u rgya sgar ba'i bla ma dbu dkar pa zhes pa 'di a lags o'u rgya zhes ming 'dogs pa'i sku phreng gi thog ma yin/ /'di nyid chos sde che chung du ma 'grims nas zos bsam gsan bzhes mdzad de lung rigs smra ba'i khyu mchog tu gyur nas bla ma'i ming dang mkhan po'i go sa bzhes pa min gyi/ chung dus nas dbang lung rgyas gsum sogs gdams ngag rnams rgya cher gsan nas sku bzhi'i sa bon thebs nges su mdzad/dbang dus su khas blangs pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa rnams byang chub rtsa ba'i gzhung lam las 'byung ba ltar/ rtsa stung bco brgyad dang nyes byas zhe drug 335

phyogs kyi rtsa lhung bcu bzhi dang sbom po brgyad/ brtul zhugs nyer lnga sogs kyi bcas mtshams phra mo tshun chad la dag ther mdzad cing gces par bsrungs te grol byed lam gyi rgyud sgod rung gi gdul bya rin po che lta bu byas thog gzhi'i sku gsum lam 'khyer gsum gyi rim par spros pa'i bskyed rim dang dbon gsum rgyu 'od sogs rdzogs rim rnal 'byor bzhis nyams su blangs te spyos bcas spros med shin tu spros med kyi spyod pa mthar phyin te spangs rtogs ches mthon por son/ dag pa'i bzhed pa 'jug pa'i 'phrin las kyis phyin drug dang bsdu bzhi'i sgo nas sems can ma smin pa smin par byas/ smin pa rnams grol bar byas/ grol ba rnams mthar phyin par byas te 'gro don rgya che ba mdzad par ma zad/ tha na mngon shes lung bstan pa'i sgo nas rgyud ma rung pa dag 'gugs par mdzad pa/ mthu nus dang rdzu 'phrul gyis lha 'dre gdug pa'i cho 'phrul dang ngan sngags kyi byed las bzlog pa/ gcan gzan dang chom rkun rengs par mdzad pa sogs mngon shes dang rdzu 'phrul thogs pa med pa zhig yod zer ba las rgan pa rnams la gleng rgyu med kyang / mdor na thun bzhir sgom pa'i nyams len gyi togs pa byang chub pa sogs byas nas bsdu ba bzhi'i mdzad 'azin rmad du byung ba'i cha nas a lags yo'u rgya zhes pa'i mtshan zhig rang byung du btags par snyam te de dus kyi mi'i bsam blo'i 'du shes dang spyi tshogs kyi 'tsho ba'i brgyud rim dang mthun che bas so/ /'di'i sku phreng gnyis pa 'bo ra nas 'khrungs/ dgung lo gsum gyi steng sngon chad 'khrungs sa'i o'u rgya sgar ba'i mi 'ga' sgrul sku rtsad gcod du thon kyang / phyogs gang thad nas mi 'grig pa'i cha rkyen du ma brtsis nas blu kha ma bskor/ de nas rgad po rnams 'gro khar kha rgyus can zhig (sngags bzlas pa'i nus pa can )yod pa des phyag gsum 'tshal te khyed rang sde nas mi 'khrungs par sa thag ring blu kha yang mi skor sa zhig nas 'khrungs pas bla ma yin kyang dgos pa chung zer nas ngo la mchil ma zhig btab nas phyir yong zer/336

de'i rkyen nam byis pa de nyin shas 'gor nas tshe las 'das zer/ de'i skye phreng gsum pa dang ba'i ba gnyis yo'u rgya sgar ba nas sbra sgo ma brjes par skyes kyang / sngon gyi de'i rkyen yin zer gang ltar yang dgung lo gzhon tsam yang ma zub par byis pa'i dus nas 'das song pas rnam thar gang yang byung med/ /skye phreng lnga ba ni zung 'jug grub pa'i dbang po rnal 'byor ba zhes gsungs pa 'di ste/ 'di yang yo'u rgya sgar ba nas 'khrungs/ chung dus rab tu byung nas bla ma'i ming bzung / gser lag dgon nas chos la sbyangs/bla ma yin zhes che mtho'i cha lugs ye ma mdzad par grwa rkyang dkyus ma'i lugs su bzhugs/ de'i rkyen gyis kun gyi snang ngor yang bla ma yin bsam pa'i ha cang che 'jog da ba bkur med la/ khong nyid la'ang de dag re ba med par rnal 'byor gyi bzhugs pa kho nar snang / khong rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i nyams len mthil du mdzad de rtogs pa mthon por son pa zhig ste gtsang sprul blo bzang ngag dbang 'azin las rgya mtsho mchog gis/ rje 'di'i gong ma sbas pa'i rnal 'byor ba/ sku tshe de la zung 'jug rtogs pa mchog /mngon du brnyes mes rgya cher bsngags/ zhes skye phreng drug pa'i rnam thar rtogs brjod las gsungs/ sku tshe mthar phyin la nye ba'i skabs bstan 'gro spyi dang khyad par gser lag dgon pa'i don du gzugs sku'i bgod pa chos dbyings su bsdus pa'i tshul mdzad par snang ste/ de dus gser lag dgon par grwa sri zhig gam bla grwa bzang po re lo ba'in gshegs pa'i srol lta bur 'duganyin zhig zla 'dzin byung ba'i skabs dang bstun nas rje 'di nyid kyis mnyam bzhag thun gcig tsam la bskyangs nas nye 'khor kun la rje btsun ma thon gsungs/ der thams cad kyis sgrol ma nyer gcig bton/ khong gis don gyis ngo za gcig red gsungs/ de nas mnyam bzhag de'i ngang nas thugs dam la rtse gcig tu bzhugs te sku mya ngan las 'das pa'i tshul bstan/ 'di ni dpag bsam 'khri shing dpal sde'i rtogs pa brjod pa las/ kye ma srog ni 337

'gro na'ang / /snying stobs rgya mtsho snying stobs ldan/ /dam pa ya ngar lhung na'ang / /chen po nyid ni mi nyams bzhin/ /zhes dang / yang 'khri shing las/drangs r+shang rab skum mngar bas khengs/ /mtho zhing bcad par gyur ba yi/ /bur shing sdong bo lta bu yis/ /gzhan don bzod dka'i gdungs pa bzod/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ nor 'phrog pa dang yul nas 'don pa/ tshe srog gi 'dzigs pa sogs sdug bsngal du mas nyam thag pa la mngon tu phyogs pa'i 'gro ba sems can gyi don du sku srog la'ang mi 'dzems pa'i rgyal sras byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par thar ba'o/ /rjes su shing bza' bstan pa'i dbang phyug tshul khrims phun tshogs la zhus par khong ngo ma'i ya mtshan pa red/ khong nyid sbas pa'i rnal 'byor ba chen po sku tshe de la zung 'jug gi rtogs pa mchog tu brnyes ba zhig red mod/ gser lag gi grwa sri de gcod pa'i ched du bsam bzhin du zla 'dzin dang bstun nas grongs pa red/ rje btsun ma thon gsungs pa'ang sgrol ma yin gyi ma red/ khong gsang ba'i yi dam rje btsun rnal 'byor ma dbyer du med pa zhig red/ rjes su byon na bstan 'gro'i don rlabs chen 'thub rgyu red ces bsngags pa rgya chen gnang / de khungs su byas nas 'de ba tshang gi ming dngos mi gsal kyang zung 'jug grub pa'i dbang po rnal 'byor ba ces sa steng gi 'dul ba 'dzin pa kun gyi gtsug gi nor bu nges don gyi bla ma rin po che7lcang skya 'jam dbyangs shes rab dar rgyas pa'i 'al snga nas gsungs so /sku phreng drug pa ni mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyi bdag nyid du gyur ba rdo rje khamang 'jam dbyangs mkhyen rab dpal bzang lags yin la rnam thar gong du song zin/ /bdun pa ni ‘ sprul ba'i sku mchog blo bzang lung rtogs te zhes — gsungs pa 'di nyid rab byung bcu drug pa'i me glang (1937)lor yab zhis bzhes dang yum ras mo gnyis kyi sras su mo'u rgya gong ma nas sku 'khrungs/ sku 338

gagogs gtsang rgan tshang dang a lags lcang skya rin po che sogs gser lag dgom pa'i las khur pa mi lnga song ste khri ga'i yongs 'dzin tshang gi mdun nas thugs thag bcad/ gzhung lugs smra ba'i khyu mchog rje 'jam dbyangs blo 'phel klog slob pa'i dge rgan du bsten/ gtsang rgan blo bzang ngag dbang 'phrin las rgya mtsho las rab tu byung rje 'dul ba 'dzin pa blo bzang yar 'phel las 'chad nyan dpe khrid dang / sku gzhogs gtsang rgan tshang dang /gtsang gi ya khu sgyung gnas pa rje tshul khrims rgya mtsho/ a rol blo bzang lung rtogs bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan rnams las dbang rjes gnang sogs chos kyi rim pa mang du mnos/ lhag par tu zab rgyas gdams pa'i mdzod 'dzin rje bka' 'gyur ba yongs 'dzin dkon mchog rgya mtsho las rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur rin po che'i klags lung sogs bla brang du phebs nas gsan bzhes mdzad de chos la sbyangs pa hur brtson gnang nas dmigs pa'i re ba rgya chen po bzung yod pa red/ 'on kyang / dgung grangs nyer gcig pa ( 1958)lo'i ston zla ra ba'i tshes nyi shu nyin rma phar kha nas dus zing la thim/ /sku phreng brgyad pa ni yul 'ba' srib ri thang 'dres ma'i mtshams kyi gser gzhung du yab 'jam skor skal bzang rgyal dang yum rin mo mtsho gnyis kyi sras su rab byung bcu drug pa'i sa sprel ( 1968)lor ltas bzang po dang bcas te sku 'khrungs/ khong ni pha gcig pa'i srun ming sring bcu yod pa'i nang gi brgyad pa yin/ pha skal bzang rgyal ni blo rig gsal zhing rang bzhin bzang pa dad pa 'gyur ba med pa'i gzhung drang tshad thub zhig yin/ chung dus nas sgrol ma nyer gcig gi bstod pa rgyun 'don byed pas 'bum phrag bzhi lhag dang tā re bsnyen pa ni mang du song yod/ khos rgyun du nga la sgrol ma las lhag pa'i lha med/ de'i mi chog pa'ang med zer nas yid ches kyi dad pa thob pa'i rtags thon/ nga brgyad dang rig gnas gsar brje'i skabs su ru khag gi 'gan khur te mang tshogs la phan btags pa dang rogs ram byas pa'i 339

lo rgyus mang / rjes nas khong nyid kyis smon lam dag pa'i mtshams sbyar te chos sde chen po bla brang bkra shis 'khyil nas 4mtshan pa'i gnas tshul du ma dang bcas te shi 'phos/ yum ni blo dkar sems bzang zhig yin stabs chos kyi sde dang rab byung par dad pa brtan zhing khyim mtshes g.yas g.yon la byams pa zhig yin/ dam pa 'di 'khrungs sa na da lta 'jam skor sde bas sgrol ma'i sku 'bum brgyad lhag blugs pa'i mchod rten chung chung phyag skor byed sa zhig bzhengs yod/ khong dgung lo gsum gyi steng a lce g.yang lo zer ba de la bu skal du byin/ dgung lo lnga'i steng gces sems che ba'i ma drin mo che de tshe las 'das rjes khong gis dran gdung gis a ma zhes 'bod pa dang phyogs phyogs su song nas btsal zer/ /khong dgung lo brgyad dgu'i thog nas bzung ste slob grwar lo bzhi song pa dang / yi ge 'bri klog tshegs med par mkhyen pas na mnyam gzhan las blo rig skyen pa mngon du gsal/ dgung lo bcu drug par rab tu byung /gser lag nas lo gsum bzhugs ring mchod dbyangs pa dang / dge —g.yog pa/ ne'u zhes bcas kyi las sne khur/ dgung lo bcu dgu nas so gcig bar chos sde chen po bla brang bkra shis 'khyil nas slob gnyer hur brtson gnang ste phar phyin dam bca' bzhag dgung lo nyer drug gi skabs o'u rgya spul skur nges bzung / gser lag dgon pas bla brang nas kha btags 'then dkar mo phug nas khrir 'don gyi mdzad sgo sgrub/ dgung lo nyer dgu'i steng mtsho sngon zhing chen nang bstan slob gling du rgyugs sprad nas mthar phyin 'dzin yig blangs/ spyi lo dgu bcu go drug lor bla brang nas 'dzin grwa'i bla ma'i la sa khur dang grwa tshang yongs la gtong sgo/ yul mi sogs la phar phyin ston mo byas/ bla brang nas bsdus grwa tshar gsum dang / blo rtags/ sa lam/ grub mtha'/ don bdun bcu/ phar phyin skor 'ga' re/ drang nges/ sum rtags snyan ngag bcas slob khrid gnang zhing / gser lag dang 3 0

dkar mo phug chu dmar bcas nas skal ldan gdul bya rnams la bsdus grwa dang /skyabs khrid/ sa lam/ grub mtha'/ brda sprod/ snyan rtsom spos dkar dud pa'i me tog rgyan 'jug dang mtshan brjod/ spyod 'jug mdo gdugs sgrol gsum sogs kyi khrid dang lung gi chos sbyin dgos dgur — bstabs/ go bdun lor thar shul nas yongs 'dzin rin po che bsten nas dbang bka' mang po gsan zhing / phyir phebs nas de dag nyams len gyi sku mtshams la bzhugs/ da lta khong gis thun te rdzong chos lugs mthun tshogs kyi rgyun las u yon khur yod/ go dgu lo'i dgu ba'i nang krung go nang bstan slob gling du slob gnyer la phebs/ /2 thugs sras gtso bo a lags lcang skya 'jam dbyangs shes rab dar rgyas kyi rnam thar mdor bsdus/ṭ+wāṃdī hūṃ ṭ+wāṃṭ+wāṃ hūṃ ṭ+wāṃ byeni rte rdo/ // /ṭ+wāṃ byeṭ+wāṃX // hūṃ /ra/ /zhidīb zlo /ṭ+wā snat+ta/ ru zhes mchod pa'i lcang skya rin po che 'jam dbyangs shes rab dar rgyas khong nyid ni 'dzam gling lha sgrung las a phyi dug thang skya mor ngos 'dzin pa'i sa cha/ a rig dge bshes chen mo'i sku gdungs bzhugs pa'i nye 'gram sgo me zhes pa'i grong tshor rab byung bco lnga ba'i lcags sgrul ( 1920)lor bdud shul dang nag rta gang rung gi ri yong dud khyim zhig tu sku 'khrungs/ yum ni rang bzhin bzang zhing chos la shin tu brtson pa ya rab gzhung drang zhig yin la/rjes nas jo mo byas te dkar mo phug dgon pa'i nye 'dabs nas grongs/khyim tshang de la snga rabs pa'i byad phur zhig gis gnod pa yin nam byis pa lo dgu son dus shi 'gro/ de'i rkyen gyis khong yang lo dgu la nye dus shin tu gzab gzab byed bzhin yod/ de dus gser lag dgon pa'i slob dpon rnying pa a khu bden pa zer ba sa phyogs der phebs te/ tshe rabs las rtsis 341

byas nas byis pa 'di khyim nas bsdad na lo dgu'i steng tshe'i bar chad bzlog thabs med pa dang rab tu byung na chos kyi las 'phro shin tu ring bas tshe 'dzin thub zer/ mas bu sa thag ring por 'gro ba blos mi thongs na'ang tshe'i bar chad bzlog ched a khu bden pa la gtad de rab tu byung / de ltar lo gcig la yul gyi nye 'dabs nas bsdad rjes gser lag la 'gro chas byas/ 'gro khar a khu bden pas yum la ngas na chung 'di la bdag gnyer gang thon byed pa las dka' sdug phar zad tha na 'gram lcag cig kyang ster na zer nas mna' zhig bskyal te bud song / des stabs kyis yum yang sems ha cang bde ba byung yod gsungs/ de ltar a tshogs lha sde sogs brgyud nas rgya bza'i spyi thog rdza dkar rtsa thung la phebs dus dge 'dun pa nyi shu skor zhig gis dung dang rgya gling rnga sil sogs mchod rdzas kyi bye brag khyer nas ser spreng btang song / de ci yin ha ma go/ ras gur chen po'i phug na khri zhig brgyab yod/de'i steng du khong nyid bzhugs su gsol te der 'tshogs kun gyis mjal kha zhus nas kha btags 'then/ de'i skabs khri steng na ya lags bon po zer ba'i bla ma zhig yod pa des a khu bden pa la ngas khro'u skor a che tshang na sku gzhogs a rig tshang bzhugs pa'i mdun nas lo gsum gyi rjes nas byang phyogs nas khyod kyi lag la yid bzhin gyi nor bu zhig 'ong gsungs pa de byis pa 'di red/ 'di dpyad na chos bdag blo gros rgya mtsho'i yang sprul lcang skya 'jigs med dar rgyas kyi sprul sku red ces gsungs/ de nas bzung khong gi mtshan la sku lo zhes sgrul skur nges bzung nas phu dad byas/ spyir lcang skya zhes par reb gong gi lcang skya dang dpa' mchog stag skor 'dir lcang skya zer ba bcas dpyad pa gnyis yod kyang phyi mar 'brel ba che gsungs/ de'i phyi nyin sngags sa'i mtshams thog gol mar 'apyor dus de na kham rag khrom dgon pa'i bla ma dpyi chen bzhugs yod de/ bla ma de la sngags sa'i mtshams thog gis sprul sku gnyis kyi thugs thag zhus par khong gis cang mi shes gsungs/ de 342

dus rje 'di nyid byis pa'i nang du rtsed mo rtsed bzhin yod pa gzigs nas 'dir khrid shog gsungs/ nye bar phyin pa na dgon bdag byams pa bsam gtan tshang sogs bla grwa mang po bzhugs yod pa'i snyan sar bla ma dam pa zer ba 'di red/ ban phrug 'di lha sar song na dga' ldan gser khri 'ong nges/ zhes gsungs par kun kyang ya mtshan par gyur te/ sngags sa'i mtshams thog nas bzhugs rgyu'i zhu ba nan tan byas kyang / a khu bden pas gser lag la 'gro dgos tshul gsungs nas lam la chas te 'ong / dge slob gnyis rma chur brgal te thon pa na bla ma yo'u rgya rdo rje 'chang gis dkar mo phug na ri khrod phyag 'debs gnang bzhin pa thos nas der mjal kha zhu ru yong / de nas a khu bden pas sngon la a lags ra mang zhes mngon shes can zhig yod pa de'i mdun du song nas ngas ban phyug 'di gser lag dgon par 'jog bsam pa yin kyang ci 'dra yin pa khyed kyis rmi lam zhig brtag dgos zhes zhus/ phyi nyin a lags ra mang tshang gis ngas mdang dgung ban phrug 'di grwa ba nyi shu skor zhig gis ser phreng bsgrigs te dkar mo phug la bsus pa mis pas kho dgon 'de nas bsdad na bzang / zhes gsungs/ de nas dkar mo phug la thon dus dge 'dun pa tshos gur pib nas bzhugs yod/ mo'u rgya rdo rje 'chang mjal bar song dus khong gi thugs shin tu dgyes pa'i ngang nas 'di nged kyi dgon pa'i grwa rgyun thog ma yin/ 'di nga la gnong / khyed kyis grwa rgyun stong bzhag pa las nga 'di la dga' po yod ces gsungs nas phyag gis byil byil gnang / de nas bzung spyan gyi 'bras bu bzhin gces par bskyangs/ rab byung sgrub rte mtshan la mkhan po'i mtshan zur dang sku phreng sngon ma'i mtshan zur gnyis bsres te 'jam dbyangs shes rab dar rgyas zhes gsol/ rab byung bcu drug pa'i chu sprel ( 1932)lor khong dgung lo bcu gsum bzhes pa'i skabs dge rgan thugs rje can a khu bden pa sku —gshegs/ gshegs khar khong mdun du bos te kha chems mang po bzhag kyang 343

gnad kyi don po ni grwa sar song nas dpe cha gzigs rgyu de yin/ don de ngas yid la bzung nas shi 'gro gsungs pa ni dge rgan lags kyi tha ma'i zhal chems yin pas/ don de rgyun par sems la lci bar bzung nas lha sa dang bla brang gang la 'gro dgos par bsam blo btang / /sku gagogs yo'u rgya rdo rje 'chang gi mdun nas bde gsang 'jigs ྾gsum sogs rgyud sde mang po'i dbang rjes gnang dang / rgyal dbang lnga bamilam rim 'jam dpal zhal lung / spyod 'jug chen mo'i khrid/ dge ldan phyag chen/ bla mchod kyi khrid sogs bka' chos mang po'i rgyun gsan par ma zad/ ra tshang a khu che chung gnyis ga'i drung nas rje btsun ma'i chos skor bskyed rdzogs sogs mtha' yas pa gsan/ gtsang gi a khu sgyung gnas pa tshul khrims rgya mtsho ('di ba a rig kwa bcu'i yin )tshang gi mdun nas lam rim chen mo dang sngags rim chen mo sogs kyi bshad lung gi rim pa mang du gsan bzhes mdzad/ dgung lo bcu bdun steng khong o'u rgya rdo rje 'chang gi dgongs pa chos dbyings su bsdus/ dgung lo bco brgyad thog a lags gdong dpyad ces gtsang rta nag gi yin pa'i gdong dpyad mkhas pa zhig 'di phyogs la phebs skabs/ khong gi gdong gzigs nas 'di ltar gsungs khyod kyi gdong 'de ri dwags bse ru'i gdong red/ byang chub sems dpa'i rigs la gdong 'di 'bab pa ma gtogs gzhan la med/ shin tu ya mtshan 'dug de yang ri dwags bse ru rgan po'i bu bse ru dar ma'i gdong red/ gsungs/ de ni khong nyid ma yum lo na bgres po'i dus su skyes pa'i phru gu la dpyad gsungs/ rnam shes ni ming 'jigs med zer ba zhig lho phyogs nas nub phyogs su skyes pa red/ zer/ 'di la'ang lcang skya 'jigs med dar rgyas kyi mtshan zur dngos su thon yod pa gong nas zugs thag bcad pa'i brgyud rim dang gong bsgrigs na shin tu ya mtshan pa'i rnam par thar ba yod/ 'di'i lcang skya dpa' mchog stag skor la byas na khong gi skye yul sgo me 3 4

dang lho nub gong 'grigs pas bzang zhes gsungs/ da dung ma lags gdong dpyad kyis brda phab pa la/ mtho mi mngon nam mkha'i nor bu de/ /yul ska rags can gyi phyogs su dge/ /rten mi 'gyur gser gyi rdo rje de/ /mdog mi mngon shing shun can gyis sbas/ / zhes byung / rkang ba sngon ma gnyis khyod kyi bla ma'i brda red/ de khyed la 'bab don yo'u rgya rdo rje 'chang gi sgrul sku rjes nas khyed kyis 'tshol dgos pa red/ rkang ba phyi ma gnyis khyod kyi brda red gsungs/ 'di dang gong nas byang chub sems dpa'i gdong bab pa'i tshul la cung zad dpyad na 'di lta ste/ ri dwags bse ru ni 'du 'dzi dang g.yeng pa la mi dga' 'ing da na par gnas pa'i ri dwags byang sems can zhig yin/ de bzhin bse ru lta bu'i rang rgyal yang rang bzhin gyis nyon mongs pa shas chung bas 'du 'dzir mi dga' zhing gcig pur gnas par dga' ba sogs kyi rigs khyad par gsum dang ldan pa dang ri dwags bse rur rwa gcig las gnyis med pa ltar ram/ ri dwags bse ru rang gcig pur gnas pa ltar spyod pas na bse ru lta bur bshad de/ mdzod 'grel las bse ru lta bur yin zhes bya ba ni/ ji ltar bse ru dag gnyis pa med pa de bzhin du de dag kyang byu ba pa dang rab tu byung pa rnams dang rang sangs rgyas gzhan dag dang mi 'dres par gnas pas na bse ru rnams zhes bya'o/ zhes gsungs/ gser zeng las kyang / lus kyi gnas pa 'di ltar gsungs la/ thugs ni chos zab mo la mos pa dang rten 'brel zab mo la so sor togs pa lhur len pa dang / rnam thar sgo gsum yid la byed cing gnas par — gsungs yod/ 'di bse ru lta bu'i rang rgyal yin la dpe des bstan pa'i mtshon bya don gyi dge 'dun lta bu'i byang sems ni/ mdo las sha ri'i bu byang chen gang dag sangs rgyas mi bzhugs shing nyan zos rnams kyang med pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams su rang byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ba dag yod de/ de dag thabs la mkhas pas srog chags brgya stong bye ba phrag 3 5

mang po theg pa gsum gyis yongs su smin par byas nas bla med dzogs byang du mngon par dzogs par 'tshang rgya ba dag yod de zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar bla ma dam pa 'di yang sngon nas thugs bskyed smon lam rlabs po che'i mthu grub ste mgon skyabs dpung gnyen dang bral ba dam pa'i chos kyi phongs pa'i yul khams 'der tha mal mi'i rnam par byon/ de yang 'du 'dzi dang 'khrul ba dang ca co sogs rnam par g.yeng pa'i rigs la shin tu mi dgyes pa'i rang bzhin brtan po ni lhan skyes su 'grogs yod la/ de dang sgo mthun par dben gsum gdan la mnyam bzhag bsam gtan gyis 'tsho ba'i ri khrod 'dir grwa rgyun gyi thog ma byas/ chung dus nas 'khor ba'i phun tshogs la zhen pa gtan du bkag nas nges don du kun spangs 'dul ba 'dzin pa'i bsam gtan pa zhig la smon lam dang dam bca' 'gyur med du mdzad pa red/'di rgyud bla ma las gang byur brling pa snying po'i phyir/ gang phyir brtan pa mi phyed phyir/ mi phyed phyir na rdo rje bzhin zhes/ rdo rje ni brling pa/brtan pa/ mi phyed par gsungs pa bzhin dam pa 'di'i sgron lam dang dam bca' yang 'gyur ba med do/ /don 'di la a lags kyis brda dpyad skabs/ rten mi 'gyur gser rgya rdo rje de zhes bab la/ 'di ni sku tshe mthar phyin pa'i lus la'ang sbyar tu rung mod/ gong ltar thugs la gtso bor sbyar dgos so/ /de ltar khong gi dgung lo bcu nas nyi shu'i bar ri khrod kyi gnas 'dir bzhugs/ de nas ya khu'i zhal chems ltar dang khyad par du 'tshang rgya ba'i lam gyi nyams len chig dril du bsgom pa la bas ma pa'i nges shes rnyed dgos/de la thos pa rgya chen po 'tshol ba sngon du 'gro dgos par dgongs nas dgung lo nyi shu'i steng chos sde chen po bla brang bkra shis 'khyil du phebs nas bsdus grwa dang blo rtags/ grub mtha'/ sa lam/ dge 'dun nyi shu/ rten 'brel/kun gzhi/ drang nges/ bsam gzugs/ phar phyin skabs brgyad dang bcas te lo bcur sbyangs pa gnang / dgung grangs sum bcu'i thog phar 3 6

phyin dam bca' bzhag gor du yig gzugs legs bris dang sum rtags dag gsum sogs thun mong rig gnas spyi la byang chub par mdzad pas mkhas pa'i snyan pa bla brang phyogs su khyab par gyur/ khyad par tu khong nyid chung dus nas tshul khrims rnam par dag pa la goms pa'i stobs kyis sdom pa gsum gyi bcas mtshams mtha' dag mig gi 'bras bu ltar bsrung pas 'dul 'dzin kun gyi gtsug gi rgyan du gyur mang btsun pa'i rnam par thar ba la chen po kun gyis kyang smon pa'i tshad du byed/ sangs rgyas bstan pa'i srog shing bla kho rdo rje 'chang dang / a lag bde thang tshang / rje lha mo blo bzang tshul khrims rgya mtsho sogs las dbang dang rjes gnang khrid man ngag lung dang bshad lung gi chos bka' mtha' yas pa gsan/ khyad par du a lags bde thang tshang las rje btsun ma'i chos skor zab khyad gzhan las khyad du 'phags pa rnams dang /rje lha mo tshul khrims las dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi las rim 'phrul 'khor gyi man ngag sogs cha tshang bar nyams myong brgyud pa'i zhal shes dang bcas te phu thag chod par byas shing / rgyun par gam du bcar pa'i drung yig pa byas pa sogs slob ma nam mkha'i skar tshogs lta bu las thugs rtsis che bar 'dzin/yang dang yang du a lag gser lag can min zhes bsngags brjod byed myong / yin na'ang / khong nyid nga rgyal dang khengs dregs kyi dbang du phra mo tsam yang ma song bar grwa rkyang tha ma'i lugs ba'in slob gnyer la hur brtson dang chos bka' la rgyun chags su bldad pas/ kun gyis a lags gser lag ni mkhas btsun bzang gsum 'dzoms pa dang / dbang bka' chos dang gdams ngag gi rgya mtsho lta bur gleng / phar phyin dam bca' bzhag rjes phyir phebs nas ri khrod du lo gsum la bzhugs/ thun mtshams rnams su skal ldan gzhan rnams chos kyis skyong pa la rtag tu gagol/ de nas phyir bla brang du phebs rte dbu ma dang mdzod 'dul ba rnams la sbyangs brtson gnang ste drug bcu re gnyis bar bzhugs/ de nas lo brgyad la sa dkar dang bsang 3 7

khog na rgya/ tsa yas/ spos zi klad rnams su gsang stabs su byon nas bsnyen mtshams dang rgyal ba'i gsung rab la lta rtog 'ba' zhig mdzad/ lo rabs bdun bcu bar bla brang sa cha nas 'dug gi ma bcug pas/ sngon gyi 'khrungs yul sgo me la phyon nas lo bcu tsam bzhugs/ de nas yang mi gzhan la shes su ma bcug par kha 'don bzlas brjod dang lam rim dmigs skyong bskyed rdzogs nyams len gyi skor sogs la brtson pa chu bo'i rgyun ba'in bsten/sngon gyi phyag dpe pod bzhi bcu lhag dang grwa chas yo byad phran bu yod pa rnams 'gul spyod mang po'i nang du ma dzim par chos sgo slar gso'i skabs bar bdag gnyer byas/ gya gnyis lor a lags smad sog tshang gtso byas gser lag dgon pa'i grwa ba rgan pa 'ga' gdan 'dren la 'byor te gser lag tu phebs/bla brang dgon pa'i phyag len ltar dgag dbye gso gsum gyi bstan pa'i gzhi btsugs/ rigs gsum spyi sgrub/ grub rgyal tshe dbang sogs dbang rjes gnang bstsal/ rab byung bla ma thengs gsum mdzad/ sdom gsum bslab bya/sa lam/ lam rim nyams mgur/ rten 'brel bstod pa/ yon tan gzhir gyur ma/ thu'u bkwan gsung gi rje btsun ma'i bskyed rdzogs dang tshar chen gsung gi bskyed rim sogs kyi khrid rgyas par gnang / shing byi ste —1984lor yab rje bla ma dam pa 'di nyid kyis tshe blos btang gi kun spangs 'dul ba 'dzin pa'i brtul zhugs kyis ri khrod 'grims pa'i dam bca' 'gyur ba med pa rjes su dran te bka' gdams pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams kyi rdo rje gsum dang gtad pa bzhi/ bud bsnyegs thob gsum gyi rnam par thar ba bdag gir bzhes te rnga mong mtshams khang dang / dbu ru phyugs mo'i brag khung / dgon 'bug zho skya sogs su phebs nas sgrub pa nyams len byas/ de'i rjes su bla ma rdo rje 'chang gi gdan sa dkar mo phug dang nye ba'i rdzong rtse gsang phu nas bzhugs/ lo bcu drug la sku mtshams bcad de dal 'byor rnyed dka'/ 'chi ba mi rtag pa/ las rgyu 'bras sogs chung 'bring 348

thun mong gi lam gyi sbyangs pa sngon du song ba'i sgo nas byang chub sems kyis rtsis zin par byas te lam rim rnal 'byor zab mo thun bzhir mdzad de nyams len chig 'dril du bsgoms/ yi dam gyi lha ma rgyud 'khor lo bde mchog dang je btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i nga rgyal gsal snang la brtan pa thob cing bskyed dzogs kyi lam gyi gnad la thugs yid gcig tu 'dres pas nyin mtshan cha mi 'tshal bar rtse gcig tu gnas pa dang mngon shes dang lung bstan yang thogs med du 'byung pa yod rgyang de dag zhib tu 'bri bar khong thugs mi dgyes par dogs nas ma bris/ thams cad la ngas ci yang mi shes zhes 'dod chung chog shes dang dman sa kho na bzung ste chos 'dul ba'i bcas mtshams phra mo tshun chad la'ang tshul bzhin du bsrung pa'i sgo nas 'jig rten chos brgyad dang gtan nas ma 'dres par tshe blos btang gi ri khrod 'grims pa 'di/ a lags gdong dpyad kyis brda phab dus mdog mi mngon shing shun can gyis spras zhes dang / byang chub sems dpa' bse ru'i gdong yin pa'i don du sbyar na shin tu 'grigs pa dang lung bstan lta bur song yod de/ rje bla ma 'di nyid kyis 'khor ba'i phun tshogs gtan tu spangs te/ rkang thang yang bgrod par dka' ba'i gnas nags tshal gyis btum pa zhig nas bzhugs te gdul bya'i 'khor tshogs yang ma bsten par bzhugs pa ni thun mong ba ltar na mdzad pa 'phrin las cher ma rgyas par gleng srid kyang / deng skabs mang po zhig nas rab byung bas btsun pa'i gzugs 'dzin pa tsam las ston pa'i 'dul ba'i bcas mtshams la dang dod mi byed par 'gyur pa'i skabs 'dir khong gi mig dpe'i byin rlabs ni rin chen gang gis kyang bsgrun thabs med pa zhig red/ khong lta bu'i dam pa gong ma dag ni bka' gdams pa'i bshes gnyen dag gi mi gral nas bud khyi gral bsnyegs zhes pa'i spyod lam mi tshe dang snyom par rgyud la len mkhan 'ba' zhig yin kyang / deng skabs kyi rab byung ba la la'i bya byed la bltas na mi gral nas 'bud rgyu phar zhog de las 3 9

ldog ste mi'i nang du'ang dpon po dang phyug po byed 'dod pa de mthong snang du grub pas na 'di dag gis a lags lcang skya rin po che'i rnam thar la dpe bltas nas rang gi rgyud la dag zer nan mo zhig byed rgyu ni dam pa'i chos 'di mi nyams par gnas 'dod pa dag gi re ba nyag gcig red/ /spyir na rje bla ma 'di nyid dpal mgon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis rgyal bo rnams ni tshig gis 'grub/ /lha rnams bsam pas 'grub pa ste/ /tshul khrims ldan pa smon pas 'grub/ / ces gsungs pa ltar skye bo mchog dman mkhas blun su zhig mdun du glebs kyang / sku mthong ba dang gsung thos pa tsam gyis yid dbang drangs nas dad pa dang mos gus skye la/ de yang o'u rgya sgrul ba'i skus gzhan las chos bskal ba brgyar thos pa las khong nyid kyis ja yun tsam la gsung bshad gnang pa sems rgyud la phan nges pa zhig 'byung / de ni tshul khrims rnam par dag pas so/ / zhes gsungs pa legs bshad du snang /de ni skyes pa'i rabs las mkhas pa mkhas pas snyan pa bsgrags/ /de la lus can dad pa 'dren/ /ri bong sems dpa'i grags pa kun/ /brgya byin gyis ni bsgrags la ltos/ / gsungs pa ji bzhin no/rab byung bcu bdun pa'i sa yos (1999)lor bla ma rin po che dgung grangs brgyad bcur phebs pa'i tshes gcig nyin rang dgon gser lag gi grwa ba brgya lhag gis mkha' 'gro sde lnga'i brtan bzhugs dang mtshams thog gi grwa tshang yongs kyis sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo'i brtan bzhugs phul/rgyal bo sde ba'i bdud 'dul dang tshe rdo gnyis gtso mdzad bla rgan tshang gis brtan bzhugs phul te sku gsung thugs rten/ khri stan yo byad/ na bza' cha tshang / rkya mar gcig ja lan chung lnga/ sgor stong gnyis bcas phul/nya nag sde ba'i kun bzang dang 'jam dpal/ ban 'gro/ 'phrin las sogs kyis 'go mdzad de mi nyis brgya lhag gis sku gsung thugs rten dang rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur spus legs/ khri gdan rgyab yol/ na bza' cha tshang /350

yal ga gnyis ga'i steng na gnas brtan gyi sku re bzhugs pa'i byu ru'i sdong bo ya mtshan can/ sgor stong gcig dpa' mchog 'jam skor gyis sku gsung thugs rten/ sgor lnga brgya phul ba sogs mdor na ja ston gyi rten 'brel phun sum tshogs pa zhig mdzad/ khong gis phyag rdzas 'di dag thams cad sngon bzhin dgon pa gong 'og dang dbul bo la sbyin par btang nas tshes bco lnga nyin nas rgyun chags bzhin sku mtshams la bzhugs so/ /spus pa/chos dbyings mkha' yi bzhin ras la chags snying rje sku yi gzugs ris 'phos/ /goms pa'i bag chags gsal ba'i rtse dga' nyi zer dwangs ma'i dpal dang 'grogs/ /nges 'byung brtson pa'i ba dan dkar po gsang chen sgrub pa'i ri la btsugs/ /de tshe rgyal sras dang po'i mgon zhes bsngags 'os me tog khyod la gtor/ /zhabs zung rdo rje'i ri mo mngon dga' bkra this gser gyi 'dzin mar bsgyur/ /mdo sngags chos tshul zab don rol ba lnga rig lang tsho'i bzhin ras spras/ /snyan dang grags pa gsar ba'i 'azin bzang ut+pal dog pa mdzes ldem pas/ /mkhas thub kun gyi snyan gong mdzes byed ngal gso'i tshig gi pazo dgod/ /'on kyang chos brgyad rlung gi rgyal mtshan bral thob 'dzin pa'i rnam grol lam/ /mi shigs gzhom bral srog gi dngos por grub pa'i dam bca' 'gyur med pas/ /byang chen bse ru'i rgyal bo khyed nyid brtul zhugs rgyan du gshegs pa na/ /bco brgyad bgrang bya'i nyi zla'i 'phrang ring mnyam bzhag gcig gi klong du yib/ /ci yang med dang gzhan stong bsgom min tog btags bden dngos mtha' la min/ /'byed 'dzum lta stangs nyams la re min bsru ba'i mngon shes 'phrul la min/ /grub rdzun spyod pa'i ral ba 'ching min mi rkang gling bu'i dpung 'dren min/ /gcig pur dben gsum bsam gtan gdan la bskyed rdzogs bde stong rtsal gyis 'tsho/ /ngur sgrig tshon gyi mdzes pa tsam min tshul khrims ngad pa'i khor yug khyab/ /'jig rten zhi 3rgya1

rags rnam can bsgom min gsal snang ting 'dzin klong la 'byams/ /rtog ge la brten rjes dpag min gyi rnal 'byor shes rab mngon sum 'bar/ /'di yang phyogs lhung gtam dang 'dres min bden don mthong pa'i blo gros kyis/ /gang gi gsang gsum lhan skyes dri bzang rdzogs pa'i legs gsung sbrang ma'i rtsi/ /yang yang byin pa'i skal bzang la brten sru spobs rig pa'i rtsom 'di bris/ /'di bzhin skye ba kun tu yang / /bdag ni drang srong skal ldan bur/ /dam pa 'di yis rjes bzung ste/ /bslab gsum bsdu bzhis 'tsho bar shog/4 sgrub sde 'di thugs brtse ba chen pos bskyangs pa'i bka' drin can rje 'jam dbyangs 'od rgyam tshang gi lo rgyus mdor bsdus/rje 'jam dbyangs 'od zer rgya mtsho tshang ni rab byung bco lnga ba'i bgrang bya zhe bdun pa chu glang (1913)lor nywa nag dbu bza' sde bar yab lhun thub dang yum chos mtsho gnyis kyi sras su 'khrungs/ mi rgyud sngon ma mgo log dbal bza' nas chad pa ste/ lha sgrung las ri rtsa ba gsum de 'bri la thob/'bri rgyal sa non pa de don yin/ zhes pa'i a lcags 'bri yin/ srun dang sring mo med/ dgung grangs bcu drug steng dkar mo phug mtshams thog tu mjal skor tu phyin skabs o'u rgya rdo rje 'chang gis ma 'ongs mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyis sgod ldan du gzigs nas nan gyis grwa ba byed du bcug ste dgon 'di'i grwa rgyun byas/ sku phyogs gtsang rgan tshang gi mdun nas rab tu byung/ rdo rje 'chang rnam gnyis dang / rwa tshang a khu che chung gnyis/ gtsang gi ya khu sgyung gnas pa tshul khrims sogs las chos bka' mtha' yas pa gsan/ mkhas shing btsun pa'i rnam thar kun la grags/ rwa tshang a khu che tshang gis rje btsun ma'i chos skor ched du gtad pa'i bu slob grags chen nyer lnga'i nang tshan yin/nga brgyad sngon la rje btsun ma'i bsnyen chen gsum phud/ dgon pa bcos bsgyur byas rjes nyin mo las ka dang mtshan rnal 'phyor chig 'dril du bsgoms te tshul khrims rnam dag tu bsrung / bsnyen chen lo bzhir re re phud/352

gser lag gi chos sgo phyes rjes der phebs nas lo gsum la gso spyong bla ma mdzad/ rab byung thengs mang du sgrub te phyogs yas mas kyi grwa rgyun kun gyi mkhan por gyur/ gter lung dang mkhan lhas/ chu dmar sogs nas rong 'brog dad ldan mang por rje btsun ma'i byin rlabs gnang / 1985lor dkar mo phug tu phebs/ ras nag phib te bsnyen chen la bzhugs/ bcu cha'i sbyin bsreg thog mar blug bsregs rdzas rang 'bar tu song ba'i ltas ngo mtshar can byung/ 1986lor rje 'de nyid kyis gtso 'gan bzhes te — mtshams thog dkar mo'i chos sgo bskyar tu phyes/ 'du khang dang nang chen gyi gzhi btang / rje btsun ma'i bsnyen par bzhugs/ 'ba' mdo dang kha sgang / 'ba' gong zhol sogs nas rje btsun ma'i byin rlabs gnang / phyag rdzas gang yong thams cad 'du khang bzhengs ba'i thebs su phul/ mtshams thog gi grwa tshang yongs la rje btsun ma'i byin rlabs dang dur bdag gi rjes gnang gsungs/ bsam gtan dzong mdo nas rtsa rlung sogs nyin bcu lhag la rgyas par khrid/ rab byung bcu bdun pa'i nyag ma gnyis pa sa 'brug (1988)lo'i bod lo'i mas bcu bdun nyin/ 'ja' tshon sna lngas dar thag 'then pa dang bcas ngo mtshar ltas mang byung pa dang lhan du thugs dam la bzhugs nas dgongs pa chos dbyings su thim/ lcang skya rin po che dang a lags smad sog rnam gnyis pebs te sku gdung zhugs la phul/ ring bsrel lnga ldan du byung pa rnams nywa nag sde ba'i dad ldan mang tshogs spyi nas gtong sgo che ru phyes nas dngul gyi mchod rten rin po tshe'i phras brgyan pa'i nang bzhugs su gsol/ /smras pa/rigs lnga'i rnam dpyod dbang gzhu'i ri mo bkra/ /zab don sbrang rtsi'i dog pa bcud du 'khyil/ /lhag bsam 'o ma'i rlabs phreng mkha' ru mdzes/ /dam pa 'di ko 'dul 'dzin bye ba'i rgyan/ /353

gnyis/ b.racu dgon pa'i lo sa bshad pa/dgon gnas 'di nyid sa la dge bcu 'dzoms shing nags tshal dang 'dabs chags ri dwags sogs kyis bskor ba'i gnas shin tu sbyid pa tsam du ma zad lus 'du 'dzi dang / ngag ca co/ sems rnam tog gis dben pa'i bsam gtan gyi gnas thugs dam bags 'byin thub cing rtogs pa mngon 'gyur thob pa'i grub pa'i gnas mchog bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig tu sngon nas grub yod mod/ dkar mo phug ces ming thogs yod pa ma red/ rab byung bcu gsum pa'i me byi ste spyi lo1777lor rgya li tshang dang gtsang pa tshang sogs kyis gser lag dgon sa btsal skabs gnas 'di'i rten 'brel phun sum tshogs pas yid drangs te 'jang chung nas gnas 'dir phebs/ sa dpyad gnang skabs gnas 'dir dgon sa tsam du ma zad grwa ba lnga brgya'i gdan sa'ang yod mod/ gser lag chags pa'i dgon sa ma red/ byu nas ri khrod cig 'byung zhes lung bstan pa dang / nor bu de'u yag yang bsam gtan rdzong gi sgo bsrung tshul du yod pa'i stag sgang zhig tu nges bzung zhes rgan pa rnams kyis gleng / rjes nas rwa rgya dgon pa'i kun spangs 'dul ba 'dzin pa chen po tshe blos btang gi ri khrod pa zhig gnas 'dir phebs nas tshe mtshams la bzhugs/(shing bza' blo bzang dar rgyas kyi dngos slob cig yin) khong gi bsnyen bya'i yi dam gyi gtso bo ni sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo yin/der brten yul 'di'i ru ba kun gyis khong gi mtshan la dkar mo tshe mtshams pa zhes 'bod pa las mtshan dngos mi gsal/ rjes nas khong la sgrol dkar gyi zhal gzigs thon cing rtogs pa mthon por son pa'i rnal 'byor ba grub thob cig tu gyur zer tshul yod/ de ltar gnas 'di thog mar dkar mo tshe —mtshams pas zhabs kyis bcags te byin gyis brlabs/ dkar mo tshe— mtshams pa'i mtshan las drangs te dkar mo sgrub phug ces yongs su grags/deng skabs nye gnas kun gyis dkar mo phug sgrol ma dkar mo'i gnas yin 35

zer ba dang / ri khrod 'di'i grwa ba yin na tshe la bar chad med cing tshe thag ring zhes zer ba sogs kyang sgrol dkar tshe lha yin pa'i rgyu mtshan la gtugs te smra'o/ /gang ltar yang dkar mo'i sgrub phug tses da lta'i bar tu ming 'di rgyun chags su gnas pa ni mngon rtogs rgyan las/ kun nas 'i dang thams cad la/ /'dud dang nyon mongs las rgyal dang / /gnod las badzi ba med nyid dang / /byang chub dang ni rten mchod nyid/ / ces dang / gser phreng las rang dang gzhan rgyud du gtogs pa'i byed pa lnga dang gcig go zhes sgom lam gyi byed pa drug gsung pa'i dang po nang du sems dul bas phyi rol tu gzhan la 'dud pa/ gnyis pa nang du chags sogs zhi nas phyi rol gyi gnod pas mi badzi ba/ gsum pa lam gyi gnas skabs thams cad du sems la rang dbang nyid du byed pa/ bzhi ba dul ba'i rjes su khyad zhugs thob pa la rlom sems bkag pas skye bo thams cad la 'dud pa/ lnga ba gnyen po stobs ldan thob pas rang gzhan gyi nyon mongs pa zil gyis gnon pa/ drug pa sgom lam pa gang du gnas pa'i rten gyi yul sa phyogs lha mis mchod par bya ba'i yul du bzung nas phyag 'tshal ba dang mchod par bya yul du gyur pa sogs dang po lnga byang sems sgom lam pa rang rgyud dang phyi ma gzhan rgyud la gtogs par gsungs pa ltar tshe mtshams pas byin gyis brlabs shing mchod rten du gyur pa'i cha nas ming dang byin brlabs rgyun chags su gnas pa red/ /rjes su'ang sgrub pa snying bor gzhol ba'i rnal 'byor ba du ma bzhugs par snang ste/ dgon pa'i rgyab ri'i mar gsham na bgrod par dka' ba'i mtshams khang phug pa gnyis snang ngo / /des na ming 'di 'brel ba rgyu mtshan gyis btags ming rjes grub tu snang ste/ dper na/ dgon pa'i nye 'dabs kyi shug pa mang pa'i lung pa la shug lung dang dred tshang yod pa'i phug pa la dred tshang ces su btags pa lta bu'o/ /rab byung bco lnga ba'i me stag (1926)lor sku gzhogs o'u rgya 'jam dbyangs mkhyen rab dpal bzang mchog nyid sku 355

'khor slob ma'i tshogs bcas dben sa snyan brgyud kyi gdams pa'i khrid chen bzhi'i ya gyal gcod gdan thog gcig ma'i chu mig gnyan khrod 'grims nas gnas 'dir phebs te mdun ri'i rtsa na bzhugs dus rgyab ri'i mgul nas rnam par bkra ba'i 'ja' tshon sna lnga'i dar thag 'then pa'i lam nas rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sgo mtshams lha mo brgyad kyis bskor bas zhal gzigs byung la/ der ma zad de dus ma 'ongs pa na ri khrod 'debs pa'i gsung gi snang ba'ang bstsal yod par 'dra ste rje blo bzang 'phrin las rgya mtshos bris pa'i rnam thar rtogs bajod las/ dgyes pa'i gar dang bcas te snyan pa'i skus/ /legs byas 'od snang dpal gyis sgeg pa'i gnas/ /phul byung bkra shis chos 'khor ri mos mdzes/ /yid 'ong 'phags ma'i rtse dga' sbyin pa'i gling / /ṭ+wāṃdro ṭ+wā /༵ma gahūṃdī nā dī ༵ dībhedi swā /zhoṭ+wāṃn ba stso/la/ rdo ṭ+wāṃ ṭ+wāṃsdu rdo~X thurdo ༵ 'i gsungs so/ /bsam gtan rdzong ni brag ri mtho zhing brjid la nags tshal stug cing dog pas cung zad 'jigs se ba zhig yin mod 'di'i nang na mkha' 'gro'i tshogs khang du grags pa chos 'byung nyis brtsegs kyi dbyibs btod pa'i rdo brtsegs chen po dang / grub dbang dam pa'i phyag jes rang byon/ rdo chen a mo leb dang / kri ṇa'i pags pa'i gzugs ris gsal bar mngon pa'i rdo dang / mchod rten dang rdor dril dang ḍa ma ri sogs brag ngos la rang byon gyi tshul du yod/ gzhan yang ngos na brag khung stong ba dang / chu gnam 'bab/ shug pa kher skyes sogs sa btsan pa'i rang rtags kyang 'dzoms/rdzong rtse na mgon po'i bla rdo brag mgon po zer ba zhig dang / rdzong mdo na sku gzhogs rdo rje 'chang gong ma'i rtsa rlung 'phrul 'khor gyi las rim mdzad pa'i bzhugs gnas ya mtshan byin rlabs can zhig yod pa'i rnam pa ni/ g.ya' chu ri brag nags tshal ra bas bskor/ /rdo chen a mo leb dang kri ṇa'i pags/ /thub dbang dam pa'i phyag rjes rang byon sogs/ /ji bzhin legs 356

/rdon stu sna /༷ ṭ+wābadzo rdocudu phra/ ga/ sdu sna dī/sal rno ngaX ༷༵di ༷di dīṭ+wāṃ ༷ 'khor las rim dang / /thogs 'bebs rdo 'a bas mdzad pa'i tshul 'di dag/ /da lta gnas der mjal na phal ba'izlar/ /mi thong sgro btags gtam gyi gleng mo mang / /'phel yang gzur gnas rdo rje slob tshogs kyis/ /mig mthong lag zin tshul la ji ste 'gong / zhes bla ma gtsang rgan tshang gis gsungs pa ltar ro/ /de lta bu ni ri khrod bsam gtan gyi gnas phun sum tshogs par rje nyid la yi dam lhas gnang pa thob ste lung bstan pa dang lhag par tu rje nyid kyi bka' drin gsum ldan gyi bla ma sku gagogs a rig tshang mya ngan las 'da' khar phyag dbu la bzhag ste byin gyis brlabs nas nged kyis dkar mo phug nas ri khrod cig 'debs par bsams kyang lo yis ma spyog da khyod kyis nges par tu thob dang ri khrod dgon pa legs po zhig 'ong / der ma zad rgyal dbang lnga ba rin po che'i lam rim 'jam dpal zhal lung 'di mdo smad la dpar med pas rgyun 'chad la nye/ de'i par zhig kyang bskos te dgon par bzhugs na rten 'brel phun sum tshogs pa zhig yod ces gsungs/ 'di gsungs kyi tha mar gyur pa'i dbang gis rje nyid kyi thugs la shin tu brtan par bzung ste khong nyed dgung lo so brgyad pa rab byung bcu drug pa'i bgrang bya gsum pa sa sgrul (1929)lo'i sa ga zla ba'i yar tshes bzang po rgyal ba dang po'i nyin sa brtag bslangs kyi sgo nas dkar phyogs lha klu la grogs 'phrin las bcol ba dang /dam pa'i chos 'dul ba nas 'byung ba ltar lag gis bla bsko ba dang / rung khang gcod pa sogs byas nas gzhi btang ste phyi 'dul ba'i kun spyod rnam par dag pa'i tshangs spyod la gnas nas nang gsang sngags rim gnyis kyi rnal 'byor gdan thog gcig nas nyams su len pa'i kun spangs 'dul ba 'dzin pa bslab gsum dur sgrig gsol ba'i sde zhig ris med skye 'gro kun gyis dad gsum bsam pa'i rten gzhi dang bsod nams bsags pa'i zhing sa dam pa 357

dga' ldan snyan brgyud gdams pa'i sgrub sde bkra shis chos 'khor gling zhes gsar tu baspun par mdzad do/ /smras pa/ /slad med gser sbyangs btso ma'i sgrub sde 'dir/ /gnyis med bde stong zung 'jug rol ba'i nga / /'bal med sku gnyis mngon du byed pa la/ /gas nga gsum 'azin las rtag tu 'jug par slon/ /de nas rten 'azel gyi tshul du thog ma'i grwa rgyun zhig bsam pa na sngon nas rnam dkar legs byas kyi bsod nams mchog tu rgyas shing rje nyid kyi gsung gi bdud rtses bskyangs pa'i dam tshig rnam par dag pa'i shel sgong gtsang sangs pa'i byis pa 'o bcu can mig sgo me nas sngags sa'i mtshams thog gong gol brgyud dus skyes chen dam pa gnyis kyis thugs thag bcad de bshol btab kyang ma khog par rma chur bzal/ 'jang chung nas nyin der tshur dgon nang du phebs pa ni lcang skya 'jigs med dar rgyas kyi sprul ba'i sku rin po che 'jam dbyangs shes rab dar rgyas tshang yin tshul 'di ni ches shin tu ya mtshan pa'i rnam par thar ba gsang gsum 'phrul gyi togs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i mthu yis ji srid bar du dgon pa 'dzin skyong spel ba'i skyes chen dam pa bar ma chad par 'byon pa'i rtags yang dag go/ tshul 'di la gtsang ba tshang gis/ lnga rig lang tsho 'phel ba rnam par dar/ /nyams rtogs yo na tan bzang po'i mdzes zhal bzhad/ /gsang gsum dpal rab rgyan gyis yid rab 'phrog/ snyan grags mdzad 'azin rgyas pas srid gsum 'gugs/ / ji lta ji rnyed shes bya'i rnam pa kun/ /gsal ler mkhyen pas tshe 'dzin sgrub phug gzigs/ / 'od chags tshems dkar phreng pa'i byin zer la/ /tsha gdung 'phrog bsil lung bstan snyan pa'i dbyangs/ /ji bzhin byung bsten ri khrod yongs 'du'i gling / /kun 'byung mun 'joms dpal du ji dgar bskrun/ / zhes — gsungs/358

gnas 'de gsang chen mkha' spyod grub pa'i sgrub phug tu brjod pa ni/thog mar sku gzhogs o'u rgya tshang 'dir chu mig la phebs dus rje btsun ma sgo mtshams brgyad kyis bskor ba 'al bzigs shing gsung gis lung bstan thob pa dang / ri khrod btab rjes rdo rje slob ma bzhi bcu skor la rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i byin rlabs stsol skabs 'ja' tshon bkra ba'i lding khang na 'od dmar po blum po 'khyil ba'i dbus na rje khong nyid yum chen dbang mo'i skur gyur ba'i gzigs snang byung ba dang / dgu ba'i yar ngo'i tshes bcu'i nyin tshogs 'khor mchod pa rgya chen mdzad dus gzim gur 'ja' tshon gyis — —btums pa dang ma dwa na dang ka pa la 'phyur te phyi rol tu 'bo ba sogs mkha' spyod dgyes pa'i rtags mtshan mang du byung / rnal 'byor brtson pa sbu —— gzhogs gtsang rgan chos kyi rdo rje sogs bu slob sum bcu dang mnyam du gnyan sa 'grims dus/ dgon pa'i shar ngos kyi leb thog der bde mchog bka' sdod dpal dur khyod bdag po yab yum gyi zhal gzigs thon/ rjes nas khong nyid kyi sku 'khor 'ga' dang lhan du gnas der dur bdag gi bsnyen sgrub las gsum mdzad dus nyin zhig dgung mo khong nyid kyi gsung nas/ dur bdag bsgrub pa'i rten gzhi rdzas rnams gcig ma gtogs kha tshang / ri bong gi dbang po lnga'i mchod pa zhig dgos kyang 'u cag rab tu byung ba rnams la thabs mi 'dug gsungs/ nam gong yo la mtshams nas ag rgyangs shig 'khor g.yog kun gyis thos/ nam langs te bltas pa na gur gyi nye 'dabs su ri bong gi ro zhig 'phangs 'dug khong gi zhal nas dpal dur khrod bdag po srog bdag lcam sring dgyes pa'i 'azin las ya mtshan zhig red gsungs pa dang / ra tshang a khu che rje blo bzang 'od zer tshang gis rje btsun ma'i bsnyen chen phud de dur khrod sgrub/ de'i rgyu mtshan gyis dkar mo phug dgon pa'i dur khrod 'di ga'an las khyad du 'phags zhes kun gyis gleng /nor bu de'u yag mgo nas gtsang rgan tshang bzhugs dus 'ja' 'od glum po 359

dang ḍa ma ru'i sgra byung la khong yang rje btsun ma'i rnal 'byor chen po zhig red/rje lcang skya rin po che tshang gis bsam gtan rdzong mdo'i phar tshur nas 'ja' 'od dang sprin dkar zum po thang du rgyu ba sogs lan 'ga' gzigs/ khong nyid sku tshe gang bor gsang ba'i yi dam gyi lha rje btsun ma'i bskyed rdzogs mthar thon pa zhig yin/ gnas 'di mkha' spyod ma'i gnas khyad par can zhig yin stabs rgya bza'i lha ma zhes mkha' spyod ma'i sgrul bar grags pa zhig yod pa de nam yong cha mi 'tshal bar glo bur tu thon/ de dus bla ma sprul sku bcu phrag tsam dang rje btsun ma'i rnal 'byor ba grwa btsun nyi shu skor zhig gis bsnyen pa grub nas bcu cha'i sbyin sreg byed pa'i skabs dang 'khel/ de dus ser sprengs kyis dgon pa'i nang du gdan drangs pa'i rnam thar yang yod la/ rgya bza'i lha ma ni nam mkha' nas phyag nas 'beb pa dang mngon shes ldan pa zhig yin par gsungs/ rje nyid kyi gdan sa 'dir mkha' spyod ma'i yar ngo'i mar ngo'i tshes bcu dang sgrub thabs sogs cha tshang bar sa skya dang kirti gnyis ku'i phyag len ltar btsugs pa da lta'i bar rgyun chags su gnas pa red/kerte'i cho ga ni kirte blo bzang 'azin las nas brgyud pa yin kyang / de dang sgo bstun nas yo'u rgya rdo rje 'chang gis cho ga mdzad/ de la rwa tshang rje blo bzang 'od zer che tshang gis chog bsgrigs mdzad pa da lta'i bar 'don bzhin pa 'di yin/ khong nyid mya ngan las 'da' khar yang phyogs phyogs nas 'ja' tshon gyi dra bas dar thag 'then pa dang / dri zhim po 'thul ba/ ja ma ru'i sgra grags pa sogs byung / /de ltar na gdan sa dkar mo phug 'di mkha' spyod ma'i byin rlabs drod ma yal bar 'khyil ba'i gnas mchog khyad par can zhig tu the tshom med do/ /sngon phyi nang gsang pa'i mkha' spyod ma grub pa'i rnal 'byor ba nyi shu rtsa lnga lhag tsam 'dir byon nas byin gyis brlabs par ma zad/ 1986lor chos sgo phyes pa'i rjes su yang 'dul ba 'dzin pa chen po rje 'jam dbyangs 'od rgyam 360

zhes na ro mkha' spyod ma'i rnal 'byor ba khong nyid bzhugs shing dbang bskur pa dang sku mya ngan las 'da' khar mkha' spyod ma'i snang ba byung ba sogs brda rtags ya mtshan can mang du byung / gzhan yang sku gagogs tshang gi sku phreng bdun pa rma phar kha'i a lags yo'u rgya tshang 'dir byon nas rje btsun ma'i byin rlabs gnang / deng dus yang bka' drin gsum ldan sgyu bla ma rin po che rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i bskyed dzogs kyi rtogs pa klong du brdol ba'i tshe mtshams ri khrod pa rje lcang skya tshang gis byin gyis brlabs te ri khrod rgyab ri'i lung ba rdzong rtse gsang phu na bzhugs yod/ don gyi gnad 'di dgongs nas yo'u rgya spul ba'i skus/ rgyal kun sor rtogs 'od dmar byu ru'i rdul/ /gzung 'dzin gar gyi dbang mo mkha' spyod ma'i/ /snod bcud dge mtshan byin rlabs rab rdzogs pa'i/ / gnas mchog khyad par can / / zhes dang /rmad byung thugs bskyed smon lam mthu grub pa'i/ /bslab gsum ngur sprig rgyal mtshan 'chang ba'i mgon/ /skyes chen dam pa du ma'i sgrub gnas mchog/gdan sa dkar mo phug/ ces gsung la/ 'di la bla ma rin po che lcang skya tshang gis kyang bsngags brjod gnang / /deng skabs ban phrug chung ngu re la'ang mkha' spyod ma'i cho ga blo na shar shar yod par ma zad chu mig gnyan khrod 'grims pa sogs 'di'i nyams len skor rgyun chags su yod/ de ltar na/ gnas 'di dang sngags sa'i mtshams thog gong zhol/ chos sgang / a tshogs dgon pa/brag dkar sprel rdzong / sdi tsha bkra shis chos sdings sogs la rje btsun ma'i chos skor thad nas 'brel ba shin tu che/ der ma zad/ mang gzhung dang 'a 'a khog rma phar kha tshur kha'i rong 'brog kun gyis sngags ma chad par bgrang pa'i chos rgyun dang bka' drin yang 'di dag la thug de ltar na gsang chen mkha' spyod ma 'i sgrub phug dkar mo chos gling 'di byin rlabs mig mthong lag zin gyi tshul du yod pa'i ri khyod bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig tu thub pas/ 'dir bzhugs dge 'dun pa rnams kyi phyi bslab gsum dur sprig 361

gtsang ma'i bka' gdams kyi spyod pa lhur bzhes thog rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sogs yi dam gyi lha rnams kyi rim gnyis gsang sngags zab mo'i nyams len la chig 'dril du 'bad na ni nges par rang ga'an gnyis ka 'tshang rgya ba'i lam rnyed par 'gyur la/ ma mtha' yang sgod dag pa bde chen gzhal yas khang dang bcud dag pa lha dang lha mo'i skur mos te khor yug 'dzugs sgun dang gtsang spra thon par byas nas sgo gsum dge la spyor rgyu ni rang 'gul gyi bya ba'o /da ni chos sgo phyes zin gyi gnas tshul mdo tsam brjod pa la/ 1982lor dge slong bstan 'dzin chos 'phel phyon nas mtshams la bsdad/ khong ni nywa nag gi yin zhing sngon chad dgon 'di'i grwa rgyun byas/ dus yun ring po'i nang du dka' sdug dang 'thab rtsod brgyud kyang tshul khrims gtsang ma'i sgo nas mthar thon pa'i dge slong tshad ldan dang kha ton dge spyor la shin tu brtson pa/gcod dang nyams len thad nas rnal 'byor pa zhig tu brtsi/ lhag par bla ma'i rnal 'byor lam gyi srog tu 'dzin la dad pa 'gyur ba med pa zhig red/shing byi (1984)lor nges don gyi bla ma rin po che a lags lcang skya tshang gis ri khrod 'grims pa'i nges pa zlog med du gser lag dgon nas chu mig tu phebs par zhal 'phangs mdzad/ don dam du bla ma rdo rje 'chang gi gdan sa bsrung bsams te ri khrod 'dir byon nas rdzong rtse gsang phur bzhugs/de'i phyi lor rje rnam gnyis kyi thugs sras gtso bo rje 'jam dbyangs 'od rgyam mchog nyid pebs nas gzhi 'dzugs pa'i 'go mdzad/ bla ma rin po che lcang skya mchog gis nged gnyis kyis gdan sa mi zin zhes bkag kyang bshol ma thebs par tang gi mi rigs srid jus dngos 'a bas lag bstar byed pa'i dus skabs dang bstun nas dzong dang khul rim pa'i chog ma na brgyud/rab byung bcu drug pa'i me stag (1986)la sgrub sde 'di'i chos sgo phyes/ rje 'jam dbyangs 'od rgyam 'khor 'ga' dang lhan du mkha' spyod ma'i bsnyen 362

mtshams phud de bcu cha'i sbyin sreg thog ma blug phyi lor 'du khang bzhengs pa'i rmang bting / gnyer ba chos bzang dang 'ja' lo gnyis bzhag nas mang tshogs kyi dad zas rnams chud zos su ma song par byas te gtsug lag khang dang dge 'dun gyi sde'i don du phul ba sogs don ldan mdzad/ chos bzang ni bsam pa dkar zhing chos la dga' ba/ rang bzhin drang ba zhig yin stabs dgon pa 'dir drin che ba'i mi'i gras su yod la/ gser lag dgon pa'i rje btsun byams pa khru bcu dgu can bzhengs pa'i sbyin bdag gtso bo yang kho rang byas/ 'ja' lo ni sngon dgon 'di'i grwa rgyun yin pa dang bsam pa dkar zhing dad pa 'gyur ba med pa bcas kyis rang gi khyim las kyang dgon pa 'dir sha tsha ming sku tshegs la ma 'dzems par dgon par zhabs zhu bsgrub mkhan bka' drin che shos yin/ de gnyis lo gsum la gnyer pa byas/'du khang bzhengs nas ma 'thub pa'i bar der rje 'jam dbyangs 'od rgyam tshang zhi bar gshegs pas dgon pa 'dir dmigs rten chad pa lta bu'i dka' ngal chen po byung / de'i tshe bla ma rin po lcang skya tshang gis thugs rje chen pos nye bar bskyangs/ rje nyid kyis thugs bkod gang dgos dang nor gang yong thams cad dgon pa'i cha rkyen la sbyar/ de nas gnyer ba bshad sgrub dang mchog ldan gnyis kyis mdzad/ 'di gnyis kyis 'du khang nang gi sku gsung thugs rten yongs rdzogs mchod rdzas yo byad/ tshon rtsi/ rab gnas ston mo'i mdzad sgo dang bcas legs par mthar phyin pa dang / dka' sdug dang ngal dub mang po khyad du bsad nas sprul sku btsal ba'i bya ba sgrub pa dang / bla brang du gzhi bzung nas phar phyin gtong sgo byas pa sogs bya ba rgya chen po bsgrub yod/ de ltar 'du khang nang gi rten dang brten pa rnams grub rjes bla ma rin po ches dam pa'i chos 'dul ba nas 'byung pa ltar bstan pa'i gzhi rtsa dam pa dgag dbye gso gsum gyi lag len phra zhing zhib pa bla brang ltar btsugs/rgyun 'tshogs dang yar ngo mar ngo'i tshes bcu/ dus bzhi'i sgrub mchod chos 363

thog dmigs bsal sku rim rnam gsum gyi grangs tshad/ gtor bzlog dang drug cu pa'i las rim sogs rim bzhin bca' yig ltar btsugs/dpyid dus su yi ge 'bri klog dang sum rtags dag gsum gyi khrid/ dbyar dus su dbyar gnas la 'ga' re ma gtogs grwa tshang yongs jogs bzhugs nas lam rim dang blo spyong skor/ spyod 'jug chen mo sogs kyi khrid dang dmigs rim bskyangs/ ston khar dbang dang bka' chos kyi rim pa mang du gnang / dgun dus khong nyid gtso byas mtshams la bzhugs mthar kha skong sbyin sreg mnyam du byed pa'i phyag srol rnam par dag pa'ang tshugs yod/rgyun 'tshogs ni rje 'jam dbyangs mkhyen rab dpal bzang po'i nangs dgong gi zhal 'don/ bla mchod dang gnas bcu'i phyag mchod gnyis sbrags nas phyag dang maskol lnga brgya/ mchod pa stong tshar/ dgung mo mchod me 'bul ba'i rim pa dang bcas pa'i nyams len tshugs pa ltar yin/ bla ma rin po che lcang skya tshang gis khong rdo rje 'chang yab sras kyi byugs dgongs dzogs phyir tu bzhengs pa'i lam rim 'jam dpal zhal lung gi dpar dang khong nyid la bzhengs pa'i mtshams khang bcas nang chen gzhung la phul/ 1992lor dgon gong 'og gtso byas g.yer skyong dang bcas pa'i lha sde rnams kyis re ba nan mo zhus pa ltar rdzong dang khul rim pas chog mchan bkod nas a lags rgya bza' dang o'u rgya tshang rnam gnyis kyi spul sku 'tshol bar thag bcad/dgon pa gcig la sprul sku gnyis 'tshol ba'i chog mchan med stabs a lags smad sog tshang dang a lags lcang skya tshang rnam gnyis kyis gros byas mthar a lags yo'u rgya dkar mo phug dgon pa'i dgon bdag lta bur 'tshol rgyur byugs ha cang mthun pa byung / de bas dgon pa gong 'og gnyis nas las don 'di so sor sgrub pa'i 'gan khur ba red/ dkar mo phug dgon par mtshon na grwa ba sum bcu tsam las med pa dang 'byor ba ha cang zhan pas don 'di khur lci mo zhig tu bab yod/ yin na yang / bla ma rin po che lcang skya 36

tshang gis 'gro song btang ba dang thugs bkod gang legs sgos dge slong bshad sgrub dang gnyer ba chos bzang mngags nas sku phreng sngon ma'i skye yul yo'u rgya dang / dpa' mchog nywa nag g.yer skyong sogs kyi mang tshogs khrod nas byis pa lo brgyad yan dang nyer lnga man kyi u 'du mtshan zo drug brgya lhag tsam bsdus te sprul sku thugs thag gcod ched du thar shul yongs 'dzin rin po che'i mdun du lan mang song / go gsum lor sku 'bum gser sdong chen mo'i mdun du7khong thar shul yongs 'dzin rin po che gtso byas bla chen du mas a lags rgya bza' dang a lags yo'u rgya rnam gnyis kyi yang sgrul thugs thag bcad pa red/ sa ga zla ba'i yar tshes bcu gcig nyin dgon pa gong mnyam du thar shul du mtshan yig len par song / de'i nyin kha ba chen po lam mi chod pa zhig babs pa'ang rten 'brel bzang po red ces gsungs 'dug nyin der ser sprengs dang bcas te dgon nang du 'byor 'phral/ya lags lcang skya rin po ches mtshan yig zhal phyes tshe 'di ltar snang / 7'jam mgon bstan pa'i gsal byed o'u rgya rin po che'i yang srid ngos 'dzin ched du/bla ma mchog gsum la gdung shugs drag pos gsol ba btab ste brtag pa bgyis par/ pha skal bzang rgyal dang ma rin mo mtsho gnyis kyi sras/ dge slong blo bzang rgya mtsho zhes pa/ dam pa gang gi skye bar ngos 'dzin byas na legs ngo shar/ /7la mo'i yongs 'dzin blo bzang mkhas thub rgya mtsho nas spyi —lo1 2zlabatshes11la/ zhes phyag tham gnang yod pa red/ /lcang skya tshang gis kyang sngon gyi gdong dpyad lung bstan dang bdo rtags sogs dang mthun pa'i gsung bshad gnang zhing spyan chab bsil bzhin yang sprul 'khrul med red ces khyab bsgrags byas/ da dung kha btags 'then pa dang khri ston byed pa'i mdzad sgo che stabs dpal 'byor 'gro song steng dka' ngal ha cang che/ de dus nya nag sde bas 'gro song gtso bo btang thog dgon 36

gong ma spyi dang 'ba' rong ba sogs kyis mthun rkyen rogs ram byas/ de'i khar dgon pa'i grwa ba re nas kyang rang thog nas sgor lnga brgya re btsal/ de ltar dka' khag dang brtson pa dang du blangs nas zla lnga ba'i tshes bzhi'i nyin gser lag dgon pa'i tshogs chen byang 'dren rnying ba rgya log bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho dang / dgon pa'i bla ma gzhung las pa zla grags/ nang chen dbon po bshad sgrub/ 'di'i skor la dka' tshegs mang po brgyud pa'i gnyer ba chos bzang / sku phreng sngon ma'i sku bdag yo'u rgya'i las byed blo bsam sogs bla brang du song nas bza' phul te kha btags 'then/ gser lag dgon pa'i sku tshab la do dam u yon lhan khang gi mi sna 'jam dbyangs rgya mtsho dang dpal bzang gnyis phebs nas sta gon bsgrigs/ drug pa'i tshes bzhir sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis chos 'khor bskor ba'i nyin der rta bsu dang ja thab/ser sprengs bcas rim par brgyud nas khrir bkod de dga' ston rgya chen po dang bkra shis pa'i dam pa'i chos kyi rten 'azel thog mar phyis/ dgon gong ma'i rta bsu'i 'go 'dzin ni ྅ nag dbyig gnyen dang / kun bzang / ya lags 'ja' ris/ zhang u'i dru'u ci yon tan sogs yin/ sprul sku ni 'jam skor nas yin phyir skyel ma'i gtso bo dpa' mchog blo bstan dang /rdzong yu'i byu'u ci blo bzang bstan pa/ pha ma srun sring lhan 'dzoms sogs rta ba brgyad bcu lhag dang gser lag dgon pa'i byang 'dren rnying ba rgya log bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho gtsos grwa rigs sum cu lhag tsam gyi skyel ma yod/ 'di dag re re dang dgon pa so so/ sde ba so so/ mi sna grags can sogs la rta phrug gos gsum/ khri skal legs skyes sogs 'phrod par byas/dge slong dam chos rgya mtsho dang gso spyong bla ma zla grags gnyis kyis bzhengs pa'i go drug lor legs 'thub byung pa'i mchod rten dang a khu yon tan rgya mtshos bzhengs pa'i go dgu'i lor rten dang brten pa legs par grub pa'i mgon khang / grwa rigs drug cu lhag tsam gyi khang tshan dang bcas ri khrod 366

bkra shis chos gling 'dir lhun chags su gnas yod/ de ltar thog mar dgon pa btab nas lo nyer dgur chags / bar tu nga brgyad thon nam lo nyer drug la 'jig yang bskyar chos sgo phyes nas lo bcu bzhi las ma 'gor ba rab byung bcu bdun pa'i sa yos ( 1999) bar lo bdun bcu'i ring gi chags 'jig gnas gsum gyi lo rgyus rags tsam zhig blta mkhan rnam par zhus pa yin/ /smras pa/ /byin rlabs snying la byin pa'i rnam dpyod kyis/ /lung rigs srid sgrub rno ba'i nyag zan mda'/ /sgro skur lta bar ma reg dbu ma'i thig/ ji ba'in btol ba'i gtam 'di drang srong lugs/ /gsum/ tha mar dge ba rten gyi tho rags tsam bkod nas mnug bsdu ba/'du khang dbus na rje btsun rdo rje chen po/ g.yas su li mu ba'i lugs kyi bde mchog thugs rje chen po phyag bzhi ba/ g.yon na rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ sgror dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo bcas mi tshad re/ de dag gi steng rnams su dbus su rdo rje 'chang 'jam dbyangs mkhyen rab dpal bzang / sku gagogs gtsang rgan blo bzang ngag dbang 'phrin las rgya mtsho/rje blo bzang 'od zer/ g.yas dang por/ pad+ma sasta wa/ rgyal dbang ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho/ gnyis par mkhan chen bo snye sa ta/ chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan/ g.yon dang por/ ya rig dge bshes chen mo/ kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa/ gnyis par/ shing bza' blo bzang dar rgyas/ rje btsun blo bzang bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho bcas khri tshad re/ sgrol ljang stong sku khri tshad ma long pa tsam/ rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur spus legs tshar lnga/ bstan 'gyur tshar gcig rje'i gsung 'bum tshar gnyis/ paṇa chen sku phreng rim byon gyi gsung 'bum/ rje dge 'dun grub kyi gsung 'bum 367

sogs pod stong lhag gnas brtan bcu drug rgyan drug mchog gnyis/grub chen brgyad cu/ rigs ldan drag po/ gdugs dkar sogs kyi rgyan thang / jo bo rje/ sman bla/ mi 'khrugs pa/ sgrol ma/ mkha' spyod ma/'od dpag med bcas kyi zhal thang / dngul 'ba' zhig las grub pa'i sku gdung mchod rten dang zangs kyi mchod rten sogs gzungs 'jug tshad ldan dang bcas te 'du khang chung yang sku gsung thugs rten gyis byur bur gtams yod/ byang chub mchod rten chen mo'i bum nang du lu u ba'i bde mchog mi tshad/ bka' 'gyur tshar gsum/ rje yab sras kyi gsung 'bum sogs bzhugs yod/ mgon khang dbus su yi dam rdo rje 'jigs byed gyan gang /g.yas su mgon po phyag drug pa rgyan gang / g.yon du chos rgyal/ lha mo/rnam sras/ bag tse gtso 'khor gsum/ dam can/ bla sku lnga bcas bzhugs/ gsang 'dus/ bde mchog rta mgrin gsum gyi gyan thang re/chos rgyal phyi sgrub/ dur bdag ge ṭa pa la/ lha ri zhal dkar bcas kyi zhal thang che legs re bcas rten dang brten pa legs par grub yod/ /dri med dam pa'i byin rlabs nye ma'i 'od/ /mkha' mnyam sems can bde ba'i rjes chags pa/ /gnod med 'tshe bral gzhan phan snying rje nyid/ /'dzam gling zhi bde sgrub pa'i lam bzang yin/ /phyi ru tshangs spyod dul pa'i ngur sgrig mdzes/ /nang du bslab gsum spangs rtogs bcud kyis mtho/ /sgom pa'i ting 'dzin lha yi rnam 'gyur gsal/ /'di ni sgrub pa'i sde la ched du bsngags/ /la lung ri thang myul nas mtha' mi chod/ /grong chog kha lag byang kyang dgos pa chung / /bshad sgrub rig pa'i gnas la rtsal sbyangs te/ /chos kyi nang mdzod srungs shig 'dul 'dzin rnams/ /ngo mtshar 'phrul gyi rdzas la re che na/ /bsam gtan dben pa'i gnas der dogs mi bde/ /gom kha gzhan du bsgyur dang 'jig rten gyi/ /god kha thams cad mi 'dod rin gyis nyo/ /bsam gtan dge bas sems la bde ba sgrubs/ /gnas mal longs spyod 368

'byor bas lus la sgrubs/ /lus sems gnyis ka bde bas 'tsho 'dod na/ /rang gi rgyu tshogs sgrub la 'bad par rigs/ /dam pa'i gsang gsum mthong ba'i blo gros kyis/ /'chad pa'i rtogs brjod bdag la med mod kyang / /kha brda rdo chag btsan bsgrigs byas min par/ /nges don lo rgyus 'di ko 'phrul gyis bzhengs/ /'di las rnam dkar bdud rtsi 'o ma'i chab/ /'thor ba byang chen sku bzhi'i rgya mtsho cher/ /'dres pa'i zag med bde dga'i gter chen po/ /mtha' dag ris med 'gro ba'i nyer 'tshor shog/ 'jigs rung rab gtum gshin rje'i grong khyer gyi/ /za byed srog bdag 'jam dpal bka' nyan tshogs/ /sde 'dir mi mthun rkyen gyi bgegs zhi ste/ /bslab gsum bcud bzang bdud rtsis 'tsho bar mdzod/ /sa la'i sman ldongs gnas 'dir byin chags shing / /dad pa'i snang ba dag pa'i bcud rdzogs pa/ /brtan g.yo dge mtshan rten 'brel 'dzoms pa'i gshis/ /mi shigs srog gi rdo rje brtan par smon/ /gsum pa/ yo'ucu'i sngags mang gi gdanarabs rim byungaja bzhin brjod pa g.yal bral shel gyi me long bzhugs so/ /dri med thugs rje'i byang chub mchog tu yongs smin tshogs gnyis rgya mtsho'i kho lag rab tu rdzogs/ /gzigs pa dag pa'i sku bzhi'i mthar son ye shes lnga yi de nyid dzi bzhin mngon du sad/ /slar yang g.yo med spros bral chos sku'i khams las rtsod med 'phrin las lhun gyis grub pa ye/ /skye dgu 'gro ba'i bshes gshen chen po thub dbang pad+ma dkar bo rnam par rgyal gyur cig/ rgyal kun 'azin las ye shes gcig bsdus zag med bde chen phung bo'i sku/ /zag bcas mngal dri ring du spangs shing 'o mtsho'i klong gi pad+ma las/ /rang byung ya mtshan sprul ba'i sku mchog 'gro kun mig gi bdud rtsi ru/ /byon pa'i mtshan bzang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor nam yang srid pa'i sgron mer 'os/ /theg dgu'i yang rtser rdzogs chen lam bzang gis/ /tshe gcig grub brnyes a ti'i rnal 36 9
