'byor ba/ /'brel tshad don ldan te ru ka dpal mchog/ nam mkha' 'jigs byebhe byeṭ+wāṃ ṭ+wāṃ ṭ+wāṃ sdi ṭ+wāṃ sdesgri/zhe/t+t+waṃ ṭ+wāṃ ༷ ṭ+wāṃ ṭ+wāṃ / de khye shaṃṭ+wāṃ sdi snying gi dbus su bzhugs/ /de ltar mchod 'os dam pa la/ /dang ba'i yid kyis phyag 'tshal nas/ /sngags rabs gser ri'i phreng ba yi/ /byung ba mdo tsam bri ba la/ /sgro 'dogs gyi ru'i rgyan cha dang / /phyogs ris mig gi zur mda' med/ /rang bzhin drang po'i gtam 'di la/ /gzur gnas mkhas pa mgu yang srid/ /zhes mchod par brjod de gleng bar bya ba ni ston pa 'ji rten du byon te mdzad 'phrin bcu gnyis mdzad cing mi mjed zhing 'di'i skye dgu rnams byang chub gsum la 'god pa'i chos 'khor rim pa gsum du bskor te lam mchog chos phung brgyad khri bzhi stong gsungs pa de dag thams cad mdo sngags gnyis kyi khongs su 'du zhing / bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu yang rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul du rgyan drug mchog gnyis/ gzhan yang grub chen brgyad bcu'i mtshon pa'i mkhas grub gnyis ldan gyi dam pa mang po byon te bstan pa dang 'gro ba'i don du bya ba byas shing / bod gangs ri'i ljongs 'dir yang mkhan slob chos gsum dang / 'jam dbyangs rnam gsum/ rig 'dzin rje 'bangs nyer lnga sogs bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu grangs las 'das pas chol kha gsum gyi yul gru so sor bstan 'gro'i don rlabs po che mdzad tshul yongs su grags pa ltar la /de las 'dir yo'u rgya'i spyi ba'am sngags mang zhes mtshan snyan dbyar gyi rnga gsang phyogs bcur ldir ba'i chos sde chen po 'di'i byung ba cung zad brjod na/ de yang chu mgo gangs dang chos mgo sangs rgyas zhes pa'i dpe ltar rang 310

re'i lo rgyus kyi rgyun ha cang ring zhing ngo mtshar gtam gyi gleng mo mang po zhig spro rgyu yod na'ang re zhig bzhag ste/ 'dir gtso bo sngags mang gi gdan rabs rim byon skor rags tsam brjod pa la 'jug par 'dod do/ /sngags rabs dang po rdo grub chen gyi dngos slob rdo rje gdung bzhi'i ya gyal/ byang gnam lcags kyi phur bu sa la gdabs 'dra/ rdzogs chen chos dbyings stobs ldan rdo rje zhes las bzhi spyi dang khyad par du mngon spyod drag po'i bka' bab de yin la/ khong gis sdug ldan 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs gzigs nas 'di snang phun tshogs blos btang ste mtshan ldan gyi bshes gnyen bsten nas zab rgyas kyi thos bsam byas tshul dang / bsags sbyang gi rim par nan tan mdzad tshul/ phyogs med ri khyod 'grim zhing thos bsam sgom gsum la brtson pas nyams rtogs thugs la 'khrungs tshul/ ris med kyi gdul bya bskyangs nas chos rgyun mang po btsugs shing gsang sngags kyi bstan pa 'dzin skyong spel gsum gnang tshul sogs khong gi rnam thar thun mong du grags pa la zhal 'phangs te ma bris/ /'der gtso bo yo'u rgya'i sngags mang gi bla rabs dang po mdzad de chos thog gi srol btsugs tshul brjod pa la/ de yang sa 'dir khong yun ring bzhugs shing dad ldan gyi slob bu mang po jes su bzung nas thun mong sngon 'gro'i rim pa nas bzung mtha' 'bras ya ti dzogs pa chen po'i bar gzhi lam 'bras gsum gyi zab rgyas bdud rtsi'i char rgyun phabs te skye dgu'i 'gro ba'i gsos su gyur/ slob bu mang po'i nang na thos bsam mtha' rgya bcad pa'i mkhas pa/ gnas lugs gdeng dang ldan pa'i thub thob/ phyogs med ri khrod 'grim pa'i rnal 'byor sogs mkhas grub gnyis ldan gyi rjes 'jug pa mang po zhig byung yod la/ khong ni bcos min byang chub thugs la 'khrungs pa'i rgyal sras sa thob mi yi gzugs su byon pa dang thugs rje smon lam dus su sad pa'i stobs kyis skye bo pho mo rgan gagon su yin yang blo sna dge bar bcug 371

ste thub pa'i bstan pa dkar 'jam yug gcig tu dar bar mdzad do/ /sa mo glang gi lo'i hor zla bdun pa'i tshes gcig nyin mgo btsugs te dran pa nyer bzhag lag len 'debs pa gnyis kyi khrid lung gsung zhing /snying thig rtsa gsum gyi dbang dang / bla sgrub thig le rgya chen thugs rje chen po sdug bsngal rang grol gyi dbang lung gnang zhing / mtshan mo'i snga thun rnams su chos skyong yongs dzogs kyi srog gtad dang rjes gnang legs par stsol zhing bla rdo bca' tshul dang bsten tshul yang zhal khrid gnang / de nas bzung tshes bcu'i tshogs mchod chen po'i srol gsar 'dzugs gnang zhing / yi dam gyi gtso bo dpal 'dus la byas te mgon po lha chen gza' ste chen po rnam gsum chos skyong du mnga' gsol nas g.yar dam bsgrags shing bka' bsgos nas sgrub rgyud bstan pa'i 'phrin las kyi grogs su gnang zhing / yo'u rgya'i sngags mang sa mo glang la dbu tshugs pa 'di yid la nges dgos tshul dang / snga 'gyur bstan pa'i srog shing 'od gsal klong chen snying thig gi sgrub rgyud 'dzin pa'i yo'u rgya'i sngags mang 'di sangs rgyas bstan pa nam gnas kyi bar du gnas thub pa dang / sngags rabs thams cad du sangs rgyas byang sems kyi sprul ba mang po nges dang ma nges pa'i tshul du 'gro don mdzad tshul gyi ma 'ongs lung bstan mang po gsungs/ a ma sngags srung ma'i sngags rabs thams cad gnyer skyong mdzad pas gzhan las khyad du 'phags 'ong zhes gsung gnang ngo / /spyir sangs rgyas bstan pa dang sems can gyi 'gro don thugs la btags te bstan 'gro'i don rlabs chen mdzad cing / lhag par du sngags mang la 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi 'azin las chab rgyun dkar pos nye bar bskyangs te dgongs pa zhi dbyings su gzhol reg bar bkal drin bskyangs/ /sngags rabs gnyes pa yo'u rgya'i tshogs lam/ khong dgung lo chung du'i dus nas sngon bsags kyi bag chags dkar po'i mthus bskul te bcos min nges 'byung thugs la 'khrungs nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la zhugs/ klog 372

slob pa'i dge rgan las yi ge 'bri klog sbyangs skabs tshegs med du mkhyen/rdzogs chen chos dbyings stobs ldan rdo rje mchog bla mar bsten nas sngon 'gro'i khrid sbyangs kyi rim pa mthar chags su lan gsum gsan zhing blo ldog rnam bzhi bcos min du rgyud la skyes/ de nas rgyal sras lag len dang /bshes springs/ spyod 'jug chen mo sogs thun mong sngon 'gro'i lam rtags kyi rim pa gsan sbyangs gnang zhing sems dang sbyar nas rang rgyud dug lnga'i gnyen por 'gro reg bar tu bsgoms/ yid bzhin mdzod dang yon tan mdzod gnyis zengs re gsan zhing rjes su lo gsum ring sku mdun du bsdad nas mdo rgyud 'grel ba rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gyi steng nas dpe gzigs mdzad skabs gzhung don gyi dka' gnad dogs sel dang sgro 'dogs legs por bcad cing bka' 'dri yang yang byas/ mthar 'dzin gyi rnam rtog nang nas chod cing thos bsam gyi mtha' rgya rig pas bcad de dmus long mig phye ba lta bu'i shes bya'i chos la chags thogs med par mkhyen pa'i blo gros kyi kho lag yongs su rdzogs shing mkhas pa'i go 'phang thob/ rtsa gsum dbang lung dang /gar gling thos grol gyi dbang lung / rtsa rgyud gsang snying gi dbang khrid sogs rgyas par zhus shing / nges med dben pa'i ri khrod du sus kyang mi mthong ba'i bcad rgya la lo du mar bzhugs/ mthar bcos min sems kyi gnas lugs mngon du gyur nas rang byung gi ye shes 'khrul med du rtogs te nyams rtogs kyi yon tan bzang po rgyud la skyes pas grub brgya'i gtsug rgyan du gyur/ /de nas phyir rang yul du phebs nas spyi ba'i sngags mang dang 'dus sde rgya mtsho'i re ba'i pad+mo zhabs kyis blangs rte yo'u rgya'i sngags rabs gnyis pa'i khri la bzhugs/ skal ldan gyi slob ma mang po nye bar bskyangs shing 'azin las phyogs kun tu rgyas/ sngar chos dbyings stobs ldan rdo rje mchog gis gnang ba'i phyag dpe de nal 'don gyi gtso bo gnang zhing / phyag len 'don 'akrig sogs kyang de kho na ltar mdzad/ /373

sngagam rabs gsum pa yo'u rgya'i a khu tshang pad+ma dbang chen/ khong ni rta mong zhes pa'i bu ru 'khrungs shing / chung dus nas ya rab dam pa'i ngang tshul ldan zhing / dge ba'i phyogs la blo 'khor ba zhig yin la/ khong dgung lo dgu yin pa'i dus shig la grub dbang rin po che khong 'di phyogs su phebs te ru skor 'gas ja zhus byed skabs a khu ban de sku mdun du bos nas khyod kyi bu 'di nga la byin na ye chog gsungs par zhal ngo zlog ma thub par grub dbang tshang la grwa rgyun du phul/ klog slob pa'i dge rgan grub mchog khong nyid kyis mdzad de yi ge 'bri klog la sbyangs pa nan tan mdzad/ nyin zhig bla mas rigs byed ma'i rjes gnang zhig gnang nas mtshams la sdod du bcug pas bla ma la gsol ba drag tu btab nas bablas brjod la gzhol skabs rmi lam du bud med dmar mo zhig gis khrag thod phor gang khyer 'ongs te 'di 'thung zer/mi 'byung zhes bshad par slar yang snag tsha thod phor gang khyer 'ongs te blud rjes mi snang bar gyur to/ /de'i rgyu mtshan rnams bla ma la zhus rjes da mtshams la 'dug mi dgos gsungs/ de nas yi ge 'bri klog sogs rtsol ba byed ma dgos par mkhyen skad/ rjes su khong gis gsang 'dus 'don pa dang 'bri ba dus mnyam du byas tshe bton tshar dus bris kyang tshar yod la/ bris legs shing nor ba gcig kyang med/ yo'u rgya'i a khu'i phyag bris yin zhes da lta'ang mthong rgyu yod/ de nas grub dbang rin po che'i mdun nas snying thig gong 'og gi dbang lung khrid gsum lag len bcas gsan zhing khyad par tu mngon spyod kyi las rim phal cher rmog ser tshang gi mdun nas gsan/ nags rgya'i sprul sku'i mdun nas kyang mthu sgrub kyi rigs mang po gsan no/ /rjes su sngags mang dang yul sde pha ma bcas kyis yul la phebs dgos pa'i re ba zhus pa na/ grub dbang tshang gis khyod 'dir bsdad na nga las kyang lhag pa'i bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu chen po zhig yong thag chod yin mod/ da sde tsho dang pha ma'i re ba mi bzlog ched yul la song shig ces gnang ba byin nas byur rang 374

yul la byon/ de nas lo gsum gyi ring la mtshams la bzhugs shing sgom sgrub chu po'i rgyun bzhin bsten zhing / nang rtags dang yon tan thugs la — 'khrungs te gzhan phan 'azin las rgyas pa'i mgo tshugs/ de nas gsang sngags sgrub rgyud bstan srung mang pos thugs rgyud bskul zhing o'u rgya'i spyi sde gnyis kyi re smon bzhin sngags rabs gsum pa'i khri la mnga' gsol zhing skye dgu 'gro ba'i dpal du gyur/ khong gi dbang lung khrid gsum sogs zab rgyas chos kyi mdzad sgo legs par phyes nas sngags mang gi mtshon ris med gdul bya yongs rdzogs chos kyis tshim par mdzad de thar ba'i lam la bkod/dge sdug shan 'byed sogs rgyu 'bras kyi rnam gzhag phra zhing phra ba nas gsung zhing / rku 'phrog dang ri dwags jon pa sogs thams cad la ri rgya rlung rgya bsdams/ sa ga zla ba'i bsnyen gnas chos thog gsar 'dzugs gnang zhing bsnyen gnas cho ga'i srol btsugs/ lo rer bsnyen gnas stong 'khor re bsgrub pa'i dge rgyun da bar du ma nyams par yod pa 'di lags/ de nas khong gis lha dang bla ma'i lung bstan dang yul dus kyi rten 'brel sogs la dgongs nas rtsod ldan snyigs ma'i dus 'dir mtha' dmag rgyal 'gong bzlog pa'i dmigs gnad dang / thub pa'i bstan pa rin po che yun ring du gnas thub pa'i ched rgyal ba thams cad kyi 'grin las kyi ngo bo lha mchog rdo je gzhon nu bka' bab dang dus babs kyi chos yin pa gzigs te kun bzang stobs ldan dbang pos mdzad pa'i stag tshang rdo rje phur ba'i chos thog de hor zla lnga ba'i tshes nyer bzhi nyin nas mgo btsugs te 'don pa'i srol btod/ de dang de la sogs spyir skye 'gro thams cad dang khyad par du yo'u rgya'i sngags mang gis gtso mdzad pa'i spyi sde yongs la bka' drin gzhal du med pa dang mdzad rjes bsub thabs med pa dang ldan no/ /gzhan khong dang dus mnyam yin pa'i rdzong sngon pad+ma thugs mchog rdo rje mchog gis yo'u rgya'i spyi sde yongs la 'azin las kyi thugs bskangs tshul rob 375

tsam bshad na/ go chen nyin gyi brag dmar dgon gsar 'debs gnang zhing skal ldan gyi gdul bya mang po rjes su bzung nas slob rgyun gyi gtso bo o'u rgya'i sngags mang bskyangs shing / dbang lung bka' chos mang po gsungs nas sngags rabs gsum pa ya khu tshang dang mnyam du sngags mang gi chos spyod la bka' drin gzhal du med pa bstsal/ khong gi slob ma'i gtso bo ni sbrul sku a rig tshang dang / yo'u rgya rdo rje 'chang / a khu nya nya'am rgya mtsho/ sman pa bstan dar/ a khu ya tho'am pad+ma kun grol/ ya lags dga' rab/ zi na mkhan chen sogs bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu mang po bskyangs rte 'gro don rlabs po che mdzad/ /sngags rabs bzhi ba yo'u rgya rdo rje 'chang rje mkhyen rab dpal bzang tshang gi 'khrungs rabs ni dkar mo phug dgon pa'i lo rgyus nang bkod zin/ /sngags rabs lnga ba yo'u rgya'i sman pa bstan dar/ khong ni sngags rabs gsum pa pad+ma dbang chen tshang gi sras su 'khrungs shing / chung dus nas dkar po'i bag chags kyis blo sna bsgyur te sangs rgyas bstan pa'i sgor zhugs shing chos kyi bya bas dus 'da' bar mdzad cing / snying dzig skyabs 'gro nas bzung tshogs 'don gyi cho ga thams cad thugs 'dzin mdzad cing rig pa no ba'i tshad du 'jog la/ lan war dang dbu can dbu med kyi 'bri srol/ dkyil 'khor dang lha ris kyi thig rtsa sogs sbyangs bar mdzad/ de nas a khu'i mdun nas kun bzang bla ma'i zhal lung gsan zhing sngon 'gro'i chos drug gi rim pa ji bzhin phud/ snying thig gi chos skor yongs rdzogs kyi dbang lung khrid sogs mthar chags su mnos/ khrid sbyangs la nan tan mdzad/ rdzong sngon pad+ma thugs mchog rdo rje mchog gi sku mdun nas snying thig ya bzhi sgyu 'phrul dbang lung sogs gsan/ klong chen mdzod bdun/ ngal gso skor gsum/ yon tan mdzod rnams la dpe khrid legs par zhus nas de dag la thos bsam rgya cher gnang zhing sgro 'dogs bcad/ a khu tshang dang 376

jong sngon tshang gnyis kyi lung bstan ltar reb gong grub gnas brgyad sogs su kun spangs ri khrod kyi brtul zhugs bzung nas nges med dben pa'i ri khrod du gnas lugs zab mo'i bsgom sgrub la gzhol ba'i dus 'da' bar mdzad/phyir rang yul du phebs te bzhugs skabs/ a khu tshang gis da khyed g.yu rngogs grub chen rdo rje'i mdun du song la gcod dbang zhig zhus zhes pa'i bka' ltar sman pa chos dar dang lhan du g.yu rngogs su phyin/ bla mar rgyu mtshan zhus pas dgyes bzhin rjes su 'dzin pa zhal gyis bzhes/ gcod dbang dang zab chos dmigs pa'i skor mang po bstsal/ rin chen phreng ba'i dpe cha thig gnang ste khong gi tsha mo 'di yum du bsten dgos gsung ba bka' gnang nan zhu byas te phyir phebs/ dzong sngon pad+ma byugs mchog rdo rje tshang gis da khyed khams shig sgang pad+ma byang chub gling ba'i mdun du song la rig 'dzin tshe bdag gi dbang lung zhus la shog dang rang res gshin rje'i sgrub chen zhig 'dzugs dgos zhes pa'i bka' lung ltar/ phyogs med grub gnas rnams su gnas 'brel 'jog bzhin shig sgang du phebs/ rma sprul mdun lo gnyis la bzhugs te gshin rje tshe bdag gi chos skor mtha' dag gsan zhing phyag len dang bcas pa zhib rgyas bslab/ gzhan yang mdo sngags gzhung brgya'i zab gnad kyi gdams ngag dang / snga 'gyur zab gsang snyan brgyud kyi gdam pa sogs bum pa gang byo'i tshul du gnang zhing gshin rje tshe bdag gi gter rtsa'i phyag dpe gnang ba sogs bsnams nas phyir rang yul du phebs/spyi sde yongs kyis bsu ba rgya cher mdzad pa dang chos ston la tshogs kyi 'khor lo gzab rgyas bskor/ /khong gis gshin rje'i i ring dung phyur du phud cing grub pa'i rtags thon/'gro don phyogs med rgyas/ dgu rong sna tshogs rang grol tshang gi dpon bla mdzad de snyan grags gling bzhir khyab pa byung / de nas bla ma rnam gnyis kyi bka' lung spyi bor blangs te yo'u rgya'i sngags rabs lnga ba'i khri la bzhugs/377

rdzogs chen thub bstan chos kyi nyi ma dang lhan du sngags mang la dgos mkho che zhing dbang lung dkon par dmigs nas zab chos khyad par can rin chen gter mdzod chen mo'i dbang lung khrid gsum snyan sprul rin po cher zhus shing sngags mang la bka' drin du bstsal/ /gzhan yang mdo rin po che dang rdo grub sgrul sku rig lo dang sprul sku thub pa sogs zhus te sngags mang la dbang lung bka' chos mang po gnang pa sogs kyis mtshon bka' drin gzhal mtha' bral mang / sngon byon dam pa'i shul bzhag thugs smon la byas rjes rlabs chen ba'ag go/'di skabs mngon spyod drag po'i mthu la dbang 'byor ba'i yo'u rgya'i ya khu blo ldan nam dgra 'joms dug gi me tog rtsal gyi lo rgyus cung zad brjod na/khong ni chu glang la 'khrungs shing chung ming tshe dbang rig 'dzin zer zhing chung dus nas rnam rig bkra zhing snying rje che ba dkon mchog la bcos min gyi dad pa ma 'a ba'i dam pa'i bag chags lhan skyes su yod pa zhig yin/ yo'u rgya'i a khu tshang dge rgan du bsten nas yi ge 'bri klog dang chos spyod ngag 'don gyi rim pa thams cad bslab cing / dzong sngon pad+ma thugs mchog gis skra dbang bskur te dgra 'joms dug gi me tog ces mtshan gnang / rtsa gsum dang phur ba'i dbang lung zhus shing sgrib sbyangs mdzad/ reb gong du phebs nas dgu rong sna tshogs rang grol las rtsa rgyud gsang snying gi dbang dang khrid zhus shing rgyud mgon srog dbang dang bskyed rdzogs zab gnad kyi skor mang po zhus/dpal chen nam mkha'i 'jigs med kyi gdan sa khyung mgon sgar tu phebs nas phur thogs stong gi bla ma nyang pad+ma dbang rgyal las bka' chos gang mang dang / gzhan yang ra a khu tshang dang / gter ston pad+ma tshang / a lags ngag blo tshang sogs dang / reb gong phyogs kyi drag po'i las la mnga' brnyes pa'i skyes chen mang po bsten nas rig pa'i yon tan gser gyis blus te don gnad thams cad khong du chud par byas/ grub gnas brgyad sogs su 378

phebs nas gnas 'brel bzhag de nas phyir rang yul du phebs te nyams len dang bsags sbyang gi las kho na la brtson pa la sogs pa dam pa'i spyod tshul 'ba' zhig la gzhol lo/ /spyir khong ni mi bsun gdug pa'i skye 'gro 'dul phyir sangs rgyas mi yi gzugs su byon pa zhig yin pa snyon du med pa ni sku gagogs shing bza' tshang gis sku sgun bzhes skabs khong ci na 'drir byon te/khyed sku gzhogs shing bzas 'di ltar mdzad na sems can gyis ci ltar byed ces gsungs tshe/ lags so/ /khyed rdo rje gro lod kyi zhal gsungs ga la bzlog phod ces de ma thag snyun gzhi las grol lo/ /yang ma ṇi bla mas 'dus pa mang por dud chang gi rgyun gcod skabs khyed sngags 'chang dgra 'joms ni gu ru rdo rje gro lod dngos yin pas las nyon gyis ga la gnod zhus te dud chang sogs khong la gnang pa sogs kun la grags pa ltar ro/ /skabs shig tsho ba'i nang 'gal ba zhig byung pa la rkyen byas nas bla brang bsang khog tu ru song zhing yab a lo'i mnga' 'og tu bsdad/ der yang bsang khog gi 'go ba dang khong gnyis zhal ma 'cham pas/ dbang shugs ngoms te sdod du ma bcug par khong gis sde brgyad kyi dmag tshogs dpung du sbran zhing bka' bsrung dregs pa'i 'azin las kyis cho 'phrul sna tshogs bstan te pha rol bo'i bsam sbyor ngan pa zhu zhing tshar bcad/ phyin chad de 'dra mi byed par dam bcas/ dad pas spyi bor blangs te skyabs 'og tu zhugs/ de nas bzung 'do ba dang mgon shul bsang tsho sde bdun sogs stod phyogs kyi 'brog sde thams cad khong mngon spyod dregs po'i mthu la mnga' dbang 'byor bar mi phyed pa'i dad pa thob ste dpon du bsten nas mtshan snyan mdzad 'phrin phyogs bcur rgyas/de nas tsung zi lin blo bzang tshe dbang dpal ldan nam yab ya lo zhes stod phyogs sde chen du mar dbang bsgyur ba'i mnga' bdag chen po des pho nya mngags te dri med kha btags dkar po'i sne drangs/ skyes dang 'phrin yig brdzangs nas dpon blar gdan drangs pa dang du blangs/ dpon tshang nas 319

mgon po'i sgrub pa btsugs shing yab rgyal bo'i 'phrin las phyogs bcur rgyas pa dang chab srid yun tu brtan pa'i rim gro dang thugs smon rgya chen gnang /yab ya lo tshang dang chos 'brel gser gyi thag pa dang 'di phyi 'o ma'i rgya mtsho'i 'brel btsugs nas lo gsum lhag la sa der bzhugs/ rjes su yo'u rgya'i spyi sde yongs kyi re ba ltar rang gi yul phyogs su phebs/ g.yer skyong dpon tshang gi dbu blar bkur zhing skya rag la tse gzhi rtsig mdzad pa ni da lta'i dgra 'joms la tse zhes pa 'di yin no/ dus de tsam du khams rdzogs chen du phebs te rdzogs chen yid bzhin nor bu dang / gling bla sku chen tshang /mkhan po thub bsnyen tshang sogs kyi sku mdun du zab rgyas gdam pa'i chos skor mang po gsan sbyangs dang / gshin rje phug dang tshe ring ljongs sogs su gnas 'brel zhus/ dzogs chen yid bzhin nor bu'i zhal nas spyir deng sang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa nub kha'i nyi ma'i rjes su 'brang zhing nag phyogs mgo 'phang mtho la rgyal 'gong mtha' dmag gi kha dar la nye ba'i skabs 'dir gong sa mchog gi zhabs brtan dang gangs can ljongs 'dir dus 'khrugs bzlog pa'i dmigs gnad du ma mgon g.yul mdos shig gsung dgos zhes pa ltar rdzogs chen dgon du sgrub pa btsugs nas khong rdo rje slob dpon du bzhugs pa la sogs pa'i mdzad 'azin mtha' klas kyang 'dir de tsam las ma spyos/ mdor na khong ni don dngos nas 'phrin las bzhi la dbang 'byor ba'i grub zob zhig yin rte yul mi'i 'khrug rtsod sogs mi 'dod pa'i rgud pa mtha' dag thabs sna tshogs kyis zhi bar mdzad pa dang / bstan 'gro la 'tshe ba'i mi bsun skye bo mtha' dag drag sngags dmod pas tshar gcod pa ste las bami'i dpal la rang dbang du spyod pa sogs 'azin las nam mkha' ltar rgya che zhing / rgya mtsho ltar gting zab pa/ lhun po ltar badzid che ba zhig la dus 'der sngags 'chang 'di lta bu zhig ma byung bar grags so/ /sngags rabs drug pa dge bshes tshang ngam thub bstan dge legs dpal 380

bzang po/ khong ni yab chos 'dzin dang yum rdo rje gnyis kyi sras su 'khrungs shing chung dus nas bstan pa'i sgor zhugs nas rab tu byung ste gzhi so thar gyi rgyud legs par bsdams/ gnas lugs rtogs pa'i thugs rgyud phyug cing gzhung lugs rab 'byams smra ba ya khu nya nya rin po che'i mdun du klog dang nyer mkho'i 'don cha sogs bslabs/ spyod 'jug chen mo'i dpe khrid zhus shing gzhung rtsa ba thugs 'dzin mdzad/ rgu ru'i bla ma gsang lo'i mdun du song nas kun bzang bla ma'i khrid sbyangs zhus shing thun mong sngon 'gro'i rim pa lo gcig la sbyangs pa byas/ de nas bla mas lung bstan te khyed khams rdzogs chen shrī sang har song dang rjes su bstan pa dang 'gro ba'i skyabs mgon chen po zhig 'ong gsungs / bla ma'i bka' gsung spyi bor blangs te rdzogs chen shrī sang ha chos grwar phebs shing dpe gzigs kyi gzhi btsugs/ mkhan chen thub bstan snyan grags kyi zhabs kyi pad+mo phyi bor bsten rte gzhung chen bcu gsum gyi rtsa ba thugs 'dzin mdzad cing gzhung lugs rab 'byams rgya mtshor thos bsam lhod med mdzad/ 'dul ba mdo rtsa ba dang me tog phreng rgyan gnyis kyi steng nas gsan zhing shin tu phra ba'i gnas rnams la sgro 'dogs kyi phu thag rig pa'i gtan la phab/ mngon pa mchims che chung dang gong ma la'ang gzugs phra rgyas kyi thad thun mong ma yin pa'i gtan tshigs 'phang ste dam bca' bzung zhing zla med sru ba'i brtul zhugs bskyangs/ tshad ma rnam 'grel dang sde bdun sogs tshad ma'i gzhung thams cad legs par sbyangs shing dbu ma rgyan dang 'jug pa rtsa ba shes rab sogs kyi mtshon te rgya bod kyi dbu ma'i gzhung thams cad la yun ring sbyangs brtson mdzad/ sher phyin la gzigs skabs dpe gzigs dang rtsod pa sbrags te gsan sbyangs byas shing thun min rig pa'i dam bca'i gzhu mchog brtan po la lung rigs mda' mo ches cher 'gengs nas rgol ngan smra ba'i tshogs kun thal bar gtor te gzhung lugs rab 'byams smra ba'i mtshan btags blangs/ /381

de nas mdo phyogs kyi gzhung lugs dzogs par sbyangs rjes thub snyan rin po che'i mdun nas sgyu 'phrul zhi ba/ sdug bsngal rang grol/ zhi khro'i dbang chen/ phur ba rgyud lugs sogs dbang dang lung khrid man ngag gi skor gang mang gsan/ 'jigs med gling ba'i yon tan mdzod rtsa 'grel sbrags te zhib gsan mdzad/ klong chen mdzod bdun gyi khrid rgyas par gsan 'ing / gsar rnying spyi don/ gsang bdag zhal lung 'bru 'azel/gsang bdag dgongs rgyun/ khrid yig zab mo nor bu'i bang mdzod/bskyed rim 'og min bgrod pa'i them skas/ rtsa rlung 'phrul 'khor gtum mo la sogs gegs sel bogs 'don gyi skor/ thun min snyan rgyud chen mo'i khrid/ ye shes bla ma/ tshig gsum gnad brdeg sogs gsan zhing mthar dzogs chen gangs khrod du byon nas sbyangs pa la yun ring bzhugs shing togs pa'i yon tan rgyud la skyes/ spyir grwa sar bzhugs ring la chos phyir dka' ba spyad tshul dang bsgom sgrub kyi skabs su nang rtogs kyi yon tan khyad par can rgyud la skyes tshul sogs mang po zhig spro rgyu yod na'ang 'dir yig tshogs dang gsang sgrogs la 'jigs nas ma bris/ phyir rang yul du phebs te sha 'gying me tog skyel tshal du lo gsum kyi ring mun mtshams la bzhugs nas sgrub sbyangs brtson pa'i dus 'da' bar byas/ de nas yo'u rgya'i sngags rabs drug pa'i khri la bzhugs su gsol nas 'gro don phyogs med rgyas pa'i dbu tshugs/sngags mang 'dus sde rgya mtsho la dbang lung bka' chos mang po gsungs/bzhi ba'i bsgung chen steng bde chen zhing sgrub dang zhing bshad chen mo'i srol gsar 'dzugs gnang / skal ldan slob bu brgya phrag la mdo sngags gzhung lugs mang po'i dpe khrid dus yu na ring po'i bar gnang zhing snyan brgyud chen mo'i khrid sbyang spel rte sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan btsugs/ /khong gi gsung chos kyi skor la kun bzang bla ma'i rgyab chos zur rgyan lung gi phreng ba (shog grangs lnga brgya yod )zhes pa dang / skyabs 'gro'i rnam 382

gabag (shogs grangs brgya yod)/ gzhi phung khams skye mched kyi rab dbye (shog grangs sum brgya yod)/ lta mgur bsnyen yig spyi'i lhan thabs (shog grangs lnga bcu)sogs gsung pod 'ga' bzhugs mod/ dus kyi dbang gis 'jig ste re gnyis ma gtogs mthong rgyu med pas yid phangs pa'i rgyu ru zad do/ /de ltar khong sku tshe gang por 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi 'azin las la bsten nas bstan pa dang 'gro ba'i don rlabs chen mdzad/ /khong gi slob ma'i gtso bo la/ rdzogs chen tshang / a lags mgo dge/a rga rin po che/ ho thog a khu/ a lags 'thab bral/ ya khu thu po tshang /sngags pa gsang lo/ a khu thogs med sogs kyi sras chen brgyad kyi mtshon bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu mang po bskyangs/ mthar dus 'khrugs kyi skabs su rma chen gangs gseng du phebs te dgongs pa dzogs pa'i tshul bstan no/ /sngags rabs bdun pa yo'u rgya'i ya rga tshang ngam 'jam dbyangs 'jigs med blo bzang / yab yo'u rgya'i dpon po te bo dang yum mkha' 'gro mtsho gnyis kyi sras su sku 'khrungs shing / chung dus nas sngon bsags kyi bags chags sad nas bstan pa'i chos sgor zhugs shing / dge bshes rin po bsam sbyor gnyis kyis bsten te bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa zhus shing / blo zlog rnam bzhi nas bzung ste thun mong sngon 'gro'i khrid rnams zhus shing nyams len sngon 'gro'i rim pa mthar chags su sbyangs pa byas/ rgyal sras lag len dang /spyod 'jug chen mo/ sdom gsum rnam nges/ mdzod bdun/ rgyud bla ma/bskyed rim 'og min bgrod pa'i zem skas sogasal gsan sbyangs dang rtsa rlung zhag brgya'i sbyangs pa gnad du thon par sbyangs/ rjes su snyan brgyud chen mo'i khrid zhus nas da na pa'i ri khrod du phebs te lo dgu la bcad rgyar bzhugs shing / ma ṇi dung phyur gsum dang bsnyen gnas stong skor gcig gdan thog gcig nas phud cing sgrub pa'i dus 'da' bar mdzad pa'i nang rtogs kyi yon tan la mnga' brnyes shing rtogs pa klong du brdol/ mtshams 383

khang nang du me tog rtag du khyab par skyes pa sogs rtags mtshan brjod kyis mi lang ba byung / de nas bar skabs dus 'khrugs kyi dbang gis sgrub sbyangs btang snyoms su mi 'jog ka med byung / bcos bsgyur gyi skabs su zog dzi byas shing gral rim dang chos lugs kyi nyes 'gel byas te mnar gcod gang mang myong mod/ khong ni nyams len gyi ngang las skad cig tsam la 'da' ma myong la thams cad rang nyid 'khrul ba'i rang gzugs su bsgom te gzhan gyi steng du khong khro ba dang ngan sems skad cig tsam yang skye ra myong zhes zhal nas gsungs/ khong gi sgrub pa'i skabs kyi rtags mtshan gsang rnam spyi bsgrags kyi nyes pa dang bcos bsgyur skabs kyi rgyu mtshan rnams tshig tshogs la 'jigs nas ma bris/ de nas chos lugs bskyar dar gyi nyin mo'i snang ba spyi mthun bsod nams kyi 'dzin mar shar ba'i dus bzang slebs skabs/ khong gi 'azin las pad+mo'i 'dab brgya phyogs bcur rgyas shing phan bde'i dri bsung kun nas ldang bar gyur/ bcos min byang chub sems kyis gshis rgyud ོbrlan zhing / thugs rje'i smon lam bzang po dus su sad pa'i nye bar bskul te yab mes gong ma'i shul bzhag gces nor la phangs sems dang ma 'ong skye 'gro'i mdun lam la 'od stong sbyin pa'i las khur chen po zag tu bzhes nas yo'u rgya'i sngags rabs bdun pa'i khri la zhabs kyi pad+mo nye bar bkod/dngang lung khrid gsum gyi bdud rtsi'i chab rgyun dkar pos 'gro ba'i gshis rgyud brlan par byas te thar ba'i sa bon bsgrun/ gangs ri'i shing rta chen po snying thig bstan pa'i mnga' bdag kun mkhyen dri med 'od zer dgongs pa zhi dbyings su gzhol ba'i dus chen bod zla bcu gnyis pa'i tshes bco brgyad la rdor sems chos thog chen mo'i srol btsugs/ bde chen zhing sgrub smon lam chen mo bskyar 'dzugs mdzad cing lo rer 'dus pa stong phrag 'ga' re la zhing bshad gnang zhing dge sdug blang dor gyi gnas rnams zhib rgyas su gsungs te dge rgyun bsod nams mi zad nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam par spel/38

sngags mang gi gtso mdzad pa'i ris med gdul bya yongs la snying thig rtsa gsum gyi dbang lung dang stag tshang phur ba'i dbang / nyang gter rta nag dbang /gar gling zhi khro'i dbang / snyan brgyud chen mo'i khrid sbyangs dang / tshig gsum gnad bdeg ye shes bla ma'i khrid sbyangs dang bcas kyis mtshon dbang lung khrid gsum gyis gdul bya mang po rjes su bzung ste thugs rje'i nye bar bskyangs/ mthar gdul bya rtag 'dzin can rnams chos la bskul phyir gzugs sku'i bkod pa re zhig chos kyi dbyings su ngal gso ba'i tshul mdzad pa legs so/ /a lags mtha' bral gtso mdzad pa'i thugs kyi bu chen sku skyes 'jigs 'ba' rin po che dang dam chos 'od zer rnam pa la sngags mang skyong bar gnyer gtad gnang zhing rgyal tshab tu dbang bskur/ /gzhan yo'u rgya'i sngags mang la byas rjes mnga' ba'i dam pa 'ga'i mdzad pa brjod na/ rigs sngags drag spyod la dbang 'byor 'ing bskyed rdzogs dang ldan pa'i sngags 'chang tshul khrims rgya mtsho'am 'jigs med sprul zug dang / spyi sde'i las khur phrag tu bzhes pa'i dbang 'dzin dge shar/rnam dpyod shes rab me ltar 'bar ba'i sngags 'chang pad+ma rig rtsal/ gso dpyad rig pa'i gzhung brgya smra ba'i sman rgan chos dar/ ya mtshan grub rtags sna tshogs ston pa'i grub thob g.yu chung / dbyangs can lha mo mgrin par brgyan pa'i byang 'dren zla grags/ 'tsho byed gzhon nu gnyis par grags pa'i sman pa mkhyen rab/ rgya gar thub chen gyi skye mtha' sha wa/mkha' spyod dbang mo'i rjes su bzung ba a khu chos 'byor sogs rigs pa 'dzin pa'i skyes chen rnams dang / sangs rgyas mi yi gzugs su byon pa yo'u rgya rdo rje 'chang sku phreng rim byon/ rgya bza'i khri rgan tshang / brtsi bzhag rin po che tshang / phur tsha tshang / a rig tshang / hor gdong blo bzang 'azin las tshang / sku nag tshang / rdzong sngon tshang / ya lags dga' rab tshang /385

dzogs chen thub bstan chos kyi nyi ma tshang / mgo dge rin po che/ 'thab bral thub bstan bshad sgrub nyi ma sogs kyis mtshon te skyes rabs gser gyi phreng ba 'dzin pa'i bla sprul/ rim gnyis lam la spyod pa'i sngags 'chang /snang sems dbang du 'byor ba'i grub thob/ gzhung lugs rab 'byams smra ba'i mkhas dbang sogs mdzad 'phrin nyi zla dang mnyam pa/ sa gzhi ltar rgya che zhing snyan grags phyogs su khyab pa du ma byung mod/ re re'i lo rgyus bri ba la dus kyi bskal ba'i phag tu yib cing sa bon ngag rgyun khungs dag cig gnas skabs ma rnyed par bzhag go /de la 'dir o'u rgya'i sngags rabs song zin nas/ da ni 'don chos spyod sgrig srol sogs rags tsam 'god de/ lo re'i hor zla bzhi bar bsnyen gnas dang / lnga bar stag tshang phur ba'i chos zog bdun par tshes bcu chen mo/ dgu bar bskangs bsgrubs/ bcu gnyis par rdor sems chos thog sogs chos thog chen po lnga dang / gzhan yang sde spyi yongs kyi rim gro dang bla ma rnams kyi lung bstan sogs la zur du chos thog chung ngu 'dzugs shing / lo gsum re'i nang du sgrub chen re yang 'tshogs bzhin yod/ chos thog de dag gi 'tshogs lugs dang sgrig srol 'tshogs yun sogs sngags —rabs gong ma rnams kyi ring nas bzung gtan 'khel byas yod la/ ga'an yang dge bskos dang / dbu mdzad/ mchod dpon/ rol mo ba rnams dang / gnyer ba sogs lo gsum re'i nang du thengs gcig brje zhing / de dag gi 'gan khur ni dge bskos nas spyi ba'i las don che phra tshang mar bkod sgrig dang do dam byed cing / dbu mdzad nas 'don bca' yongs rdzogs la dbu khrid mdzad/ mchod dpon gyis chos thog gi mgo nas mjug bar gyi mchod bshams dang mchod dzos yod tshad la bdag byed pa'i 'gan len/rol mo ba rnams kyis 'don bca' dang bstun pa'i rol mo sna tshogs 'bud dkrol byang chub par shes dgos shing / gnyer ba rnams kyis tshogs ras 386

chen mo dang spyi rdzas yongs dzogs la bdag dam byed dgos/ kho tsho chos thog dh+riX ṭ+wāṃ /༷ dīdī / ṭ+wāṃ ṭ+wāṃ gag ṭ+wāṃs dī rdodī nādīsdi ṭ+wāṃ/sa ༵sa ༵ so/dī ṭ+wāṃ tīdu / tshang ma bsgrub tshar dgos/ dad ldan mang tshogs nas rang 'gul gyis gung tshigs dang / mangs 'gyed/ tshogs rdzas sogs gyi 'gro song 'gan len/spyo ba'i ban sngags rnams kyis sngon ma khu tshogs rnam khong nyid kyis btsugs pa'i srol rgyun ltar nyal chas dang za ma rang gis khyer yong dgos shing /gnas tshul gal chen la ma thug na gcig kyang ma lus par yong dgos/ don med du mi 'chad pa ni lam lugs su chags yo da/ /hor bla bzhi ba'i bsnyen gnas ni tshes bcu gsum nyin gyi phyi dror tshogs 'go brtsams shing / spyi sde yongs dzogs 'dzoms thub tshod kyis dgung mor ltung bshags gsungs/ tshes bcu bzhi'i snga se nas gso spyong len 'ing nangs ja bzhes rjes bsang mchod bkra shis 'khyil ba gsungs/ de nas dge slong ma dpal mo'i lugs kyi bsnyen gnas cho ga gsungs shing / smon lam rnam lnga dang / 'ing smon/ bde smon sogs gsungs/ gung tshigs bzhes rjes bskang gso 'don la cho ga'i zhor nas khrus chog 'don/ nyin 'dir cho ga thengs gsum yod la/ dgung mo lhung bshags bton rjes nyin de'i chos spyod tshang ma mjug bsdu/ tshes bco lnga'i nyin kyi 'don pa snga nyin ltar yin la smra ba bcad de gung tshigs mi len/ tshes bcu drug gi snga mo cho ga gcig gi bzla ba grub nas smon lam skabs thor thug 'thung rjes khrus chog 'don/ / tshes bcu drug nas 'go bzung ste bla mas bde chen 'ing khrid gsungs/'di o'u rgya'i dge bshes rin po che'i phyag srol ltar a ga tshang gis btsugs shing / snga mo bsang mchod bkra shis 'khyil ba 'don zhing / 'od dpag med kyi sku thang chen mo'i mdun du mchod pa stong tshar bshams pa dang / mar 387

me dang spos sgron pa dang lha bshos stong sogs 'bul bzhin/ skya ser pho mo tshang mas mnyam du smon lam chos spyod yongs dzogs 'don la/ gung tshigs kyi rjes su bla mas chags med bde chen khrid yig gi steng nas bde chen zhing khrid gsungs shing / de nas spyi ba'i bskang gsol grub rjes dgung ja bzhes/tshogs yun nyin gsum yin la/ 'don cha dang chos khrid sogs snga nyin ltar yin/ tshes bcu dgu'i nyin bsang mchod bkra shis 'khyil ba gsungs rjes grol/ /hor zla lnga bar o'u rgya'i a khu dbang kho tshang gis btsugs pa'i stag tshang phur ba'i chos thog 'dzin/ tshes nyer gsum kyi phyi dror tshogs 'go brtsams te/ phur ba'i cho ga'i bzlas pa grub rjes phur bsrung yongs rdzogs kyi bskang pa dang / gzhan yang rta nag dang mgon po tshogs bdag lha chen/ ma mgon sde lnga/ lha mo/ tshangs ba/ gza' mchog chen po/ dam can/tshe ring ma/ g.yu sgron ma/ mngan ne ma/ gnod sbyin tsi'u dmar po/zangs btsan/ thog rgod/ ge sar sogs kyi bskang ba cha tshang dang /chos skyong khag gi gsol ka bsdus pa/ rma rgyal nas btsan skyes nor bu dgra 'dul sogs kyi gsol ka 'don zhing / 'azin bcol gtor 'bul sogs dang / tshogs 'khor shis brjod snga 'gyur bstan pa rgyas pa'i smon lam sogs grub nas dgung ja bzhes/ de rjes phur ba'i rtsa sgrub cho ga gcig rdzogs par gsungs grub rjes mal du gzims/ tshes nyer ba'i nyin/ snga mo snying thig skyabs 'gro cha tshang grub rjes phur ba'i cho ga rtsa sgrub ltar tshar gcig dang / dkar gsur zhing khams kun khyab gsungs tshar rjes nangs ja bzhes/ de rjes bsang mchod bkra shis 'khyil ba gsungs nas slar phur ba'i cho ga rgyas pa gcig bzla ba'i bar du rtsa sgrub gcig grub rjes dros ja bzhes/ de rjes phur srung yongs rdzogs dang bskang ba kha tshang rdzogs nas gung tshigs bzhes/ de nas na raka dung sprugs dang tshogs 'khor skor zhing 388

('di dus dge bskos nas spos 'grem)chad bstan bsngo smon shis brjod dang snga 'gyur bstan rgyas smon lam sogs grub rjes dgung ja bzhes shing / rtsa sgrub thun gcig gi mjug tu mal du gzims/ tshes nyer lnga dang nyer drug gnyis nyin sngon ma dang 'dra la/ tshes nyer bdun dang nyer brgyad gnyis la/gung tshigs kyi rjes su tshogs 'khor gyi mgor dam tshig nyams chag gso ba dang bsnyen pa'i kha skong ba'i ched du zhing pa'i sbyin bsregs ye shes 'od phung gsungs la/ gzhan rnams gong gi nyin dang 'dra/ tshes nyer dgu'i nyin nangs ja'i bar tu nyin sngon ma rnams dang 'dra la/ nangs ja'i rjes bkra shis 'khyil ba gsungs grub nas phur ba'i cho ga rgyas pa gcig bzlas pa'i bar nas phur srung yongs rdzogs kyi bskang ba grub rjes dros ja bzhes/ de nas bskang ba yongs rdzogs grub rjes gung tshigs bzhes shing / tshogs 'khor dang / zlog pa stong bzlog 'don zhing zor 'phen dang bsngo smon shis brjod snga 'gyur bstan rgyas smon lam sogs grub nas dgung ja bzhes/ phyi nyin nangs ja bzhes rjes bsang mchod bkra shis 'khyil ba gsungs grub nas chos thog grol/ tshogs yun nyin bdun yin/ /bdun pa'i tshes bcu chen mo ni a khu tshogs rnams kyi ring nas dzogs chen chos dbyings rdo rje'i zhal 'don ltar btsugs la/ hor zla bdun pa'i tshes ba'i nyin nas yar 'tshogs yin zhing / nyin de'i phyi dror bla ma rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i las byang / tshogs 'khor bskang ba/ bsngo smon shis brjod/ snga 'gyur bstan rgyas smon lam sogs grub rjes dgung ja bzhes/nyin gnyis par snga mo snying thig skyabs 'gro dang / gu ru le'u bdun/bsam lhun/ bar chad lam sel/ o rgyan gsol 'debs thung ngu yongs rdzogs dang / tshes bcu'i phan yon rje 'bangs nyer lnga'i gsol 'debs/chos dbyings stobs ldan rdo rje'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ dkar gsur zhing khams kun khyab sogs gsungs grub nas nangs ja bzhes/ de nas bkra 389

shis 'khyil ba dang / nang sgrub rig 'dzin 'dus pa/ thugs sgrub dpal chen 'dus pa/ bde chen rgyal mo gsum gyi cho ga dang / thugs je chen po sdug bsngal rang grol gyi cho ga sogs gsungs shing bzlas pa grub nas dros ja bzhes/ de nas bskang ba yongs rdzogs gsungs grub nas gung tshigs bzhes la/ gung tshigs kyi rjes su na raka dung sprugs dang bzhengs bskul skabs dge bskos nas spos 'grem/ tshogs 'khor smon lam shis brjod dang snga 'gyur bstan rgyas smon lam sogs 'don pa grub nas dgung ja bzhes/nyin gsum pa nas tshes bcu chen mo'i bar gyi 'don cha rnams nyin gnyis pa dang 'dra la/ bye brag dmigs bsal khrus chog dang tshogs 'bum sogs grangs gsog de 'don dgos so/ /hor zla dgu ba'i bskang sgrub ni ya rga 'jigs lo rin po ches btsugs la/nyi ma gtan 'khel med cing / mgon po/ lha mo/ sngags bsrung ma/gza' mchog chen po sogs gyi bskang ba gang rung dgos gal la dmigs te 'bum phrag re grub rjes chos thog grol/ 'di la yang snga mo bsang mchod bkra shis 'khyil ba 'don pa dang skabs la lar mtshan mor bskang ba 'don pa sogs kyang yod/ /hor zla bcu gnyis pa'i rdor sems chos thog ni ban sngags yongs kyi dam tshog nyams chag bshags pa'i don du a rga rin po ches btsugs/ zla bcu gnyis pa'i tshes bcu gnyis kyi phyi dror tshogs 'go rtsom/ rdor sems cho ga dang bskang ba sogs thub nas dgung ja bzhes/ tshes bcu gsum nyen gyi snga mor snying dzig skyabs 'gro dang / dkar gsur zhing khams kun khyab —gsungs rjes nangs ja bzhes/ de nas bsang mchod bkra shis 'khyil ba dang / rdor sems cho ga bzla ba'i bar gseng nas bshags pa grub rjes bdag 'jug len cing de nas dros ja bzhes/ de'i rjes nas bskang ba yongs dzogs gsungs grub nas gung tshigs len la/ de rjes tshogs 'khor 390

dang / gnas 'dren/ smon lam/ shis brjod/ snga 'gyur bstan rgyas smon lam sogs grub rjes dgung ja bzhes/ tshes bcu bzhi nas bco brgyad bar 'don cha gong ltar byed la/ tshogs grangs gsog ste 'don dgos pa sogs yod/ 'tshogs yun nyin bdun yin la/ tshes bcu drug gi snga se bsang mchod bkra shis 'khyil ba gsungs grub nas chos thog grol/ /gzhan yang sgrub chen sogs la 'don phyag len zur du yod/ de min spyi ba'i rten gtso bo la/ khams bla rdo grub chen rin po ches gnang pa'i gnod sbyin tsi'u mar gyi rten thang dang / gter chen rin po ches gnang pa'i gza' mchog chen po'i zhal thang sogs dang / bla ma dam pa gzhan gyis gnang pa'i rten 'gangs chen dang / chos skyong khag gi thang ka/ de las gzhan rin chen gter mdzod chen mo dang / snying dzig ya bzhi/ mdzod bdun/'jig gling pod dgu sogs gsungs rab mang po bzhugs so/ /sprus pa/ /'od mtshar stong 'bar thugs kyi klong las mi shigs rdo rje rnam par 'phos/ /brdal khyab gting zab 'o ma'i mtsho ru dri mas dben pa'i pad sdong las/ /thugs rje'i smon lam rnam par dag pa dus kyi bskal ba'i pha rol —nas/ /byang phyogs bsil ldan kha ba'i yul 'dir bstan pa'i srog gi sgron me sbar/ /gangs ri'i shing rta klong chen po'i/ /sprul ba'i zlos gar ngag gi — dbang / /thugs kyi bzhed gzhung snying thig gi/ bstan pa'i snang ba 'di na 'phyur/ /bi ma'i sgyu 'phrul nam mkha'i mtshan/ /thugs sras dzogs chen rnal 'byor ba/ yab sras brgyud pa'i sgron me yi/ /dge ba'i snang ba gling bzhir khyab/ /391

bzhi ba/ mkhan slas dgon sogasakyi gnas chularags bsdus/ /1 mkhan slas dgon/mkhan slas dgon ni da lta'i thang rgan 'ang gi dung dkar sde ba'i sar yod/ bal kho'i a khu rin po che ste/ rje lde tsha 'jam dbyangs byams pa chos grub tshang gis spyi lo1952lor btab/ dgon pa 'di'i grwa rgyun yong khungs dang sbyin bdag gtso bo ni nya nag tsho ba yin pas ྅ nag dgon pa yang zer/nga brgyad lor dgon pa bcos bsgyur byed skabs grwa ba bzhi bcu lhag dang /'du khang dang grwa shag sdom de khang ba rgyan nyi shu lhag yod/ dgon pa'i 'don bca'i thad nas sngon gyi nywa nag spyi ba'i srol rgyun 'dzin byas pa'i khar sde tsha'i phyag len yang kha yar bsnan yod/ /2 chu dmar dgon phyag 'debs gnang mkhan rje byams pa chos grub kyi thugasabasaram 'byor ba byams b.ram grol/ /khong ni rab byung bco lnga ba'i shing pho byi ba ste spyi lo1924lor rje blo bzang gong 'phel gyi tsha mo lha mo sgrol mar ngo mtshar ba'i ltas du ma dang bcas sku 'khrungs/ sku chung ngu'i dus nas nam dkar dge ba'i las la thugs gagol zhing / mi dge sdug las la 'jigs shing snying rje che ba zhig yin/ yum gyis khyod ni bdag gi bu che ba yin pas khyim gzhi 'dzin pa la khyod las 'os med/khyod kyi nu bo bsod nams tshe ring rab tu 'byung bar 'dod ces gsungs te/ngur smrig gi rgyal mtshan bsgo bar ma btang / dgung lo bco brgyad kyi bar tu khu bo dge legs kyi mdun du yi ge spyor klog byang par byas te chos spyod gyi rim pa mang po thugs 'dzin dang gso rigs kyi gzhung yang cung zad sbyangs/ de nas skabs gang 'tshams shig la bstun te ma yum la gsang nas gser lag dgon la phebs nas yongs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po rje byams pa chos grub rin po che'i zhabs la gtugs nas rab byung gi sdom pa mnos te mtshan la 392

byams pa rnam grol gsol/ bla ma de'i mdun du thugs rje chen po sogs rgyud sde mang po'i dbang lung khrid kyi rim pa rnams gsan/ de nas phyir lung dkar zhes pa'i dben gnas su phebs te thugs rje chen po bcu gcig zhal gyi bsnyen sgrub kyi rim pa thog mar mdzad/ de'i phyi lor snga gnas su yi dam rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi bsnyen pa la zla drug bzhugs mthar kha skong sbyin bsregs rgyas par mdzad/ de nas yang bla ma chos thub pa'i mdun du mched grogs rnams dang mnyam du gnyan khrod dben sa snyan brgyud kyi dbang lung legs par gsan te bla ma dang mnyam du gnyan khrod brgya rtsa 'grims/ de nas shar skal ldan rgya mtsho'i mdun du grwa ba bcu phrag gsum dang mnyam du bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa legs par mnos/ lo de'i dpyid dus su khong gi thugs la thos pa ma btsal ba'i sgom pa mi yong bar mkhyen nas/ blos thub kyi grogs gnyis dang mnyam du bla brang bkra shis 'khyil du phebs te/ ya lags bde thang rin po che'i mdun du yi dam rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi dbang lung man ngag gi rim pa dang / bde mchog gsang 'dus/ mi 'khrugs pa sogs kyi dbang lung mang po dang bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen dag las lam sngags sogs kyi khrid mang po gsan bzhes mdzad/ rgyan 'jug sogs thugs 'dzin gnang ste thos bsam gling du zhugs pa'i sta gon byas kyang / sku yul gyi mjal ba 'gas phyir 'gro dgos kyi bskul ma nan cher zhus mthar/ de rnams kyi ngo bzlog ma thub par phyir rang yul phyogs la mi phebs ka med byung/ de nas sngar ltar bla ma chos grub rin po che'i mdun du lhags nas bsdus grwa cha tshang dang / skyabs khrid rim gnyis kyi khrid rgyas par gsan/ lo du ma'i ring la/ gsang 'dus/ mi 'khrugs pa/ mgon po/ yi dam rdo rje 'jigs byed sogs kyi las rung dang bsnyen chen sogs la bzhugs pas nyams togs khyad par can dang / ltas bzang po 'khrungs pa bla mar zhus pas bla ma'i thugs shin tu dgyes te dbang lung bka' chos kyi rim pa lhag lus med par bstsal ba rnams 393

bum pa gang byo'i tshul du mnos pas gang gi thugs sras gcig pur grub/ de nas nywa nag a rig rdo rje 'chang chen po'i zhal snga nas dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang yongs dzogs dang rgyud sde gzhan gyi dbang lung yang gsan/ de rjes sde ba'i pho mo rgan gzhon kun gyis spyi ba'i chos thog kun gyi dbu mdzad la bsko bzhag mdzad kyang / 'du 'dzi'i yo lang rgyas te chos spyod nyams len la bar chad 'byung bar dgongs nas gsang stabs kyis brag dkar sprel dzong la pebs nas a rol rdo rje 'chang rje btsun lung rigs rgya mtsho'i zhabs rdul spyi bor bkod de blo rtags dang lam khrid sogs gsan/ ri khrod skyabs 'jug zhus par rdo rje 'chang nyid kyang thugs dgyes dgyes mdzad/ gnas de ru lo gsum tsam la bzhugs mthar bla ma chos thub rin po che'i bka' bzhin rang yul du pebs te dung dkar da na gnas su dus bzhir yi dam rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi bsnyen sgrub la gagol te bsnyen chen bcu gcig song pas yi dam gyi rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor gsal bar gzigs pa'i nyams rtogs khyad par can thugs la 'khrungs par gsungs/ nga brgyad lor khong gis sgrub pa nyams len gyi mtshams 'jog dgos byung yang / gso rig gi shes bya la brten nas sems can gyi nad yams sel thabs la 'bad/ rig gsar skabs su rab byung bar btsan gyis khyim thabs len du 'jug pa dang / srog chags gsod dgos pa'i sdig las la g.yol ched/ mtshan mor bros nas rka rgan gri shi thog sgod ri rtse'i 'brug dong nang nyin drug la gab rjes lam skabs nas zas phran bu re slong bzhin nyin mo gab mtshan mo song nas yul bla brang phyogs su phebs/ /bla brang la phebs pa'i gnas tshul ni khong la cha rgyus yod pa'i mgo log a khu bde legs rab rgyas zhu ba zhig gi phyag bris las cung zad rtogs thub/khong 1968la sdig las la 'jigs nas gan lho phyogs su phebs pa yin te/thog mar rong 'brog sa khul gang yin la nges med du ldom bu byas bsdad pa 39

dang / de nas ring bo ma 'o na par kha rgya sde ba'i khyim bdag ma'i ming la bkra shis mtsho zer ba zhig tshang la yon bdag byas te/ mtshan mo cung zad re gnyid yur pa dang / nyin gung zas gcig byas te ma ḍi dung phyur smra dag par bzla ba'i skal ba ldan/ khyim bdag de tshang gi drin lan ga'al dka' gsungs/ bar skabs shig nas mgo log dge bshes tshul khrims rgya mtsho zhu ba zhig la mjal nas bde gsang 'jigs gsum dang / dus 'khor gyi thig rtsa sbyangs/ zhal 'don gyi skor mtshan mor gsungs grub par byas te/ nyin mor skor ba dang bris sgug bsnams nas chad med du sbyangs/ sgyud sde dag gi thig ris wa ler thugs ngor ma shar bar bar mtshams 'jog mi gnang / /khong gis 'dod chung chog shes dang chos phyir dka' ba spyad pa'i gnas tshul yang bris yod de/ dper na/ 1973lo'i dbyar khar bsang khog yi kho tshang zer ba'i mi khyim 'ig dbyar sar song ba'i khang stong nas sus kyang mi shes par bzhugs te/ nyin rer rtsam skya cung zad re chu grang mo'i nang —dkrugs te zas gcig byas nas dus yun ring tsam song ba dang / a khu bde legs tshang gis de mthong nas khyed snying rus dang dka' spyad shin tu che zhus pa na/ nga la snying rus med na'ang 'chi chos re rgyun tu sgrub bzhin pa'i tshul yin gsungs/ gzhan rgyun tu kun rig sogs kyi mtshams la 'dug pa dang /nam yin na 'khor lo brtsegs ma zhig 'azen bzhin ma ṇi gsungs pa las/rang dgar 'chags pa mjal ma myong zer/ spyir khong grong chog la gtan nas thugs mi dgyes na'ang 'tsho rten gyi ched du nyin 'ga' der mi 'gro thabs med yin te/ song na'ang sgor brgya kha longs ba zhig kyang gsog 'jog mi byed gsungs/ /de yang 1979lor tang gi mi rigs srid jus dang chos lugs srid jus sgo kun nas don 'bebs byed pa'i go skabs bzang por bstun nas khong gi slob ma'i gtso bo chos bzang gis gong rim nas bla ma rin po che phyir pha yul tu 395

phebs zhu'i dpang yig blangs nas/ phyogs phyogs su 'tshol tu phyin mthar gtso'i ba ris cog zer ba'i gnas shig tu sgrub pa snying bor mdzad bzhin pa dang 'phrad nas pha yul la gdan drangs/ pha yul tu phebs rjes chu dmar sgal gzhong du rang shong spyil bu zhig legs par bzos te/ 'di ni bdag gi bla ma rin po che chos grub dang / ya rig ro rje 'chang / ྅ nag sku lo tshang sogs skyes chen du mas zhabs kyis bkyags shing byin gyis brlabs pa'i—gnas mchog tu gyur pa yin pas/ don nyung bya nyung gi dgon pa zhig—na'adebs rgyu yin zhes gsungs nas/ 1980lor sku mtshams la dam por bzhugs/ phyi lor ma ṇi dung byur can gyi 'khor lo gsum bzhengs pa dang /de dang mnyam du rje blo bzang 'od zer rgya mtsho sogs kyi gzhogs 'degs la brten nas klu dung skyong dkar po'i pho brang bskyar du bzhengs te yul khrus dang dam chos bdud rtsis char chen phab pas lo phyugs legs pa'i dge mtshan byung /de'i phyi lor byis pa 'ga' la rab byung gi sdom pa legs par bstsal te yi ge sbyor klog sogs khrid pa'i mgo brtsams/ de nas bzung lo rer dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi bsnyen chen re la ma chag par bzhugs/ 1985nas86lo'i bar grwa ba bcu phrag la ngur sprig rgyal mtshan legs par bsgos shing kun rig rnam par snang mdzad sogs kyi phyag rgya dang bcas pa bstsal te bsnyen pa grangs mang por 'dug tu bcug skabs der khong gis nye 'khor la grwa ba je mang du song ba la dgongs nas grwa shags 'ga' bzhengs te dgon sde zhig gi gzhi chags par byas/ rim bzhin rgyal ba yab sras kyi gsung 'bum dang /bka' bstan sogs blus par ma zad/ jo bo shakya mu ne'i sman sku mi tshad can gcig rgyu lha shug las thub pa'i mchod rten rnam brgyad/ bla ma a rig rdo rje 'chang gi 'dra sku'i gtsos chos 'brel thob pa'i bla ma mang po'i 'dra sku/myur mdzad ma sogs shog 'bum mang po/ ma ṇi dung phyur can gyi 'khor lo nyer gsum 'khor khang dang bcas pa bzhengs/ 1987lor gong rim nas 396

dgon pa bzhengs chog pa'i chog mchan bkod ma thag dgon pa'i phyogs — bzhir sa brtag bslang dang lto 'bye'i thig gdab pa dang / sa bdag gi snying gter sogs bsgrubs nas 'du khang gsar bzhengs kyi sta gon gnang / sde ba phyi nang gi dad ldan pas 'gan khur blangs 'og gyan nyer lnga can gyi 'du khang zhig bzhengs mgo brtsams te 'grub la nye ba'i skabs su nag phyogs bdud rigs su gtogs pa yid srubs kyi mthu nus snying la reg pa gang zhig gis khong gi sku srog la bar chad du rtsom pa thugs kyis mkhyen te/ zam tsha gser khri blo bzang nam mkha' rgyal mtshan dang / o'u rgya sprul sku blo bzang 'jam dpal rgya mtsho rnam gnyis la dgon mgo nan tur gtad par mchog sprul rnam gnyis kyis kyang zhal gyis bzhes/ khong gis slob bu rnams la dus rgyun du nga'i mi tshe 'di'i ring la yi dam rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi bsnyen chen nyer bdun dang / gdan thog gcig nas ma ḍi dung phyur gnyis dang de'i tshun la dung phyur gsum bton yod gsungs/ khyod cag gis rnam g.yeng dang don med long gtam ma smra bar rje mi la ras pa dang / 'jam mgon gser khang ba/ shar skal ldan rgya mtsho sogs bla ma gong ma rnams kyi rnam thar la mig dpe bltas nas dus rgyun du sdom gsum bslab bya dang / lam gyi rim pa ma nor bar gsang sngags zab mo'i nyams len la 'bad dgos/ de min bla ma mchod pa'i cho ga dang / sman mdo rgyas bsdus gnyis/ pha rgyud gsang pa 'dus pa dang / ma rgyud 'khor lo bde mchog chos rgyal lcag mkhar bcas chos spyod kyi rgyun nam yang skyong dgos zhes bka' gdams gnang /1994lo'i 43tshes 19nyin gyi dgong mor nye bcar gcig kyang bsdad mi chog sang nyin nyi shar la thog ces gsungs te khong gcig pur bzhugs/ nam phyed du nag phyogs bdud kyi bsam pa dzogs phyir gzugs sku'i bkod pa chos dbyings su bsdus/ phyi nyin khong gi gsung las skyes pa'i slob bu rnams kyis blo yul las 'das pa'i don rkyen de 'dra byung yod pa mthong nas yid mya ngan 397

kyis non zhing mig la mchi ma'i char rgyun 'khrigs te gsol 'debs dbyings su gyer/ skyabs rje dam pa rje btsun 'jam dbyangs legs bshad rgya mtsho gtso mdzad pa'i 'dul 'dzin rab byung pa bcu phrag lnga tsam gyis gdung mchod rgyas par byas te gdung bzhus pa na/ du ba dkar po sprin dkar lta bu nar mo zhig lho yi phyogs su 'phyur ba dang / me'i dkyil 'khor mngon par g.yo ba'i klong las ci sogs sngags kyi sgra grags pa snod ldan slob bu rnams kyis dngos su bos/ zhag bdun gyi mthar gdung khang gi sgo phye dus yi dam rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi zhal phyag tshang pa'i sku gcig dang / rang bsrel ril bu mang po babs pa kun gyi mig gi bdud rtsir rgyur/ de nas bzung lo re'i gdung mchod la skya ser kun gyis rdo rje 'dzigs byed kyi sgo nas bdag 'jug len pa dang / sgyung bar gnas pa/ ma ṇi 'khor lo skor ba/ phyag dang mchod pa 'bul ba sogs bgrang gis mi lang ngo / de'i rjes su mchog sprul rnam gnyis kyi thugs bkod ltar/ a lags 'jam dbyangs dang khong gi nye gnas —mkhas btsun gtso byas pa'i rab byung pa dang / mi skya mang pos khur chen bzhes te/ phyi'i 'du khang dang / nang gi rten/ gtso sku sman 'dam las grub pa'i rje yab sras gsum/ g.yas dang po yi dam rdo rje 'jigs byed/gnyis pa thugs rje chen po phyag bzhi ba/ g.yon dang po kun rig gnyis pa sgrol ljang / logs gnyis su rje'i stong sku/ gsung rab kyi skor la bka' 'gyur gsum/ bstan 'gyur gnyis/ gzhan yang po ti mang po/ mchod pa'i yo byad cha tshang sogs 1995lor legs grub byung / zla tshes22nyin sku gzhogs yo'u rgya blo bzang 'jam dpal rgya mtsho gtso byas pa'i gsang chen dkar mo phug bkra shis chos 'khor gling gi dge 'dun mang po dang bcas 'du khang gi rab gnas mdzad sgo la phebs te 'grub ston rgya chen byas so/ /2 zag tho'imatshams thogamatshams thog 'di ni da lta'i dong bo sde ba'i dgun sa ste sha la'i brag tho 398

na yod/ phal cher spyi lo1951lo tsam la dge zhis rin po che khams phyogs nas phyir phebs rjes khyim la mi phebs pa'i dam bcas te de ru bzhugs/ bla ma khong gi thugs dgongs dngos ni 'dzig rten chos brgyad kyi dbang du phra mo zhig kyang mi 'gro bar rang shong spyil bu tsam nas tshe dang sgrub pa snyom par gnang 'dun yod mod/ khong gi 'dod chung chog shes kyi mdzad pas yid drangs shing gsung gi bdud rtsir rol 'dod kyi dad ldan mang po ma bsdus rang 'gul du 'dus pas dgon sde zhig gi thog ma'i gzhi chags/ 1958lor slebs tshe mtshams pa bcu gsur yod pa 'ig tu gyur/ /4 gserade'u dgon bkra gis chos 'khor gling mtsho sngon po dgon gong ma'i dgon pa ste/ dgon gnas ni rkang tsha ha dge zhang gi rdzong ske na yod/ spyi lo1952lor sku gzhogs ma rol rin po ches thugs bkod gnang 'og grwa btsun ma nos 'go 'dzin byas nas btab/dgon pa btab rjes a rol tshang gis gtsang ba lcags mdud tshang mngags nas 'chad nyan la 'go 'dzin gnang / thun te'i nywa nag spyi ba'i drug pa'i sgyung gnas sogs chos srol rgyun 'dzin byas pa'i khar gzhi gsum cho ga'i phyag len phal cher sprel rdzong dgon dang bstun/ nga brgyad lor grwa ba bzhi bcu lhag la 'phel yod/ /spyi lo 1980lor dgon pa phyir slar gso byed skabs thar shul yongs 'dzin blo bzang mkhas grub rin po che'i thugs bkod ltar bzhengs pa dang /khong dgon bdag la'ang gdan drangs/ spyi lo2000lor grwa ba lnga bcu nga gcig yod/ lo 'di 'ga'i ring chos spyod 'grig lam gang thad nas rkang tsha rdzong gi sngon thon dgon sde'i gras su 'dems/ dgon 'di'i chos spyod kyi thad nas rgya lo'i smon lam dang / gsum pa'i sgrub mchod/ bzhi ba'i ma ṇi/drug pa'i mchod pa/ dgu ba'i lcags mkhar/ bod lo'i kun rig sogs kyi mang che ba bla brang bkra shis 'khyil gyi phyag len dang bstun yod/ /399

dgon pa slar gso'i 'dzugs sgrun thad nas chos la dad pa brtan po yod pa'i tsa po dang bsam 'grub rgya mtsho pha bus rang sger gyi 'gro gron phangs med btang pa'i khar gzhan nas dkar thig btsal te/ 'du khang gyan nyer lnga can dang / btsan khang gyan bcu gnyis can/ byams khang rgyan bco lnga can/ sgrol ma'i lha khang bcas rten dang bcas par bzhengs/ thar shul yongs 'dzin rin po che'i thugs bkod ltar bzhengs pa'i byams khang nang gi rtsig ldebs kyi rdo bskos sangs rgyas stong sku ni rgyal khab phyi nang kun tu mthong thos dkon pa'i rten rtsa chen zhig yin/ /gzhan da dung gleng dgos pa zhig ni 'dul 'dzin chen po 'od zer rgya mtsho dang / khong gis zhal bkod ltar rkang tsha dgon gong ma'i chos dad pa yongs nas bzhengs pa'i rje btsun sgrol ma'i tsha 'bum chen po de yin/ /rje btsun 'od zer rgya mtsho da lo dgung grangs brgyad cur son yod la/nga brgyad lo'i dgon sde bcos bsgyur dang rig gsar sogs las 'gul ya nga ba'i khrod tshul khrims kyi brtul zhugs ma nyams par bzhugs/ thengs shig khong se ra dgon par phyag skor la byon skabs rta mgrin yang gsang gi lha khang zhugs la thebs pa sngags bton nas zhi bar mdzad pa dang / de ni rta mgrin gyi sngags dung phyur bcu gsum bzlas pa'i byin rlabs yin par bshad/spyi lo1980lo nas1997lo bar gyi lo bcu bdun ring / khong gis dka' spyad sgos rje btsun sgrol ma'i sku dung phyur bco lnga 'debs pa'i khur chen bsnams nas sems can don gnyer can la dad pa'i rten rlabs chen bsgun par mdzad/ /lnga ba/ dgon gong ma'i cho ba so so'i sbyi ba/1 dpa' mchogabyu ba/dpa' mchog spyi ba ni dpon po chos lo'i skabs su sngags pa sku nag sogs kyis mgo 'dzin byas nas btsugs/ dge bskul thengs dang por 00

'khur mkhan ni dpa' mchog bla 'byung gi bu/ rgya bza' dge 'dun phun tshogs kyi gser lag dgon pa'i grwa rgyun du bslangs pa'i chos mdzad nag po zhes pa de yin/ 'don pa ni bla ma mchod pa dang / mdo gdugs sgrol gsum gyi thog la skabs bab kyi bca' ba ci yod stabs bsdun byed/ grong sngags rnams kyis snying thig rtsa gsum tshogs 'khor dang bskang gso rim par byed/ 'tshogs dus dbyar ston gang rung 'ig la byed pa las dus nges bzung gi gtan 'khel byas med/ spyi chos la zhugs mkhan dge 'dun pa lnga bcu yas mas las med/ de rjes dpon po tshul dbang gi skabs su 'tshogs dus gtan 'khel dang / 'don bca' 'grig lam sogs je zhib je dam du btang ste/ lo re'i dbyar zla lnga ba'i bcu so la spyi ba 'tshogs rte/ bka' 'gyur tshar gcig dang / gdugs dkar/ stag tshang phur ba'i stong zlogarta mgrin yang gsang gi gtor bzlog tshogs brgya/ kong tse 'phrul rgyal gyi rlung rta'i bskang gso sogs bskang gso'i rigs rnams rim par byed/ spyi ba'i dge basbul rnams snga gzhug tu bla rgan tshang gi blo bzang nyi ma dang 'od zer rgya mtsho sogs kyis khur/ dus der ban sngags brgyad cu tsam yod/dpon po rta ris dang bo boku gnyis kyi skabs su spyi ba'i 'grig lam je dam du btang / khyad par tu dpon po bo bo'u skabs su khos gros gzhi bton te/g.yag brgya dang brgyad sogs ja nom gos gsum gtos che ba phul te rwa rgya'i bka' 'gyur blu rgyu'i gros 'cham byung / lo de'i lha babs dus chen la bka' 'gyur rin po che gser lag dgon du gdan drangs nas dga' ston phun sum tshogs pa dang bcas te gser 'gas bton nas 'du khang chen mor ba'agaskabs der dpa' mchog spyi bar ban sngags brgya dang sum cu lhag yod/dge bskul la gser lag dgon pa'i byang 'dren zur ba mkhar rgya'am blo bzang 'od zer bzhag 'di ba spyi ba'i dge bskul la lo bco brgyad —bzhugs par grags/ khong yang bla rgan tshang gi mi yin/ spyir bla rgan tshang 401

gi mi ma gtogs dpa' mchog spyi ba'i dge bskul la bsko bzhag mi bya ba'i srol tshugs/ 1950lor dpon po blo bstan dang 'bum pa gnyis kyi skabs su tshogs ras gsar bzhengs byas te/ nang rten la bka' 'gyur dang / bla mchod zhing thang / gdugs dkar zhal thang sogs dang gzhan mchod chas cha tshang sgrub/ de min nyin rer mchod me stong mchod pa stong dang / nyin dgu'i ring la bsang bye ba/ tsha gsur bye ba/ sbyi ba'i nyin khur sogs gang che btsugs/ 1958lo'i zla 6tshes 4nyin nas 'go brtsams te dbyar sa mdzo mo gong khar nyin bcu gsum gyi ring la spyi ba 'tshogs/ tshes bcu bdun nyin gyi phyi dror bka' 'gyur rin po che'i dbu dum mdo sde skal bzang yang bskyar gsungs nas sangs rgyas bstan 'bar ma gsung rjes brel 'tshub ngang grol/de nas bzung spyi lo 1984lo'i bar rgyun chad/ 1984lor 'bum pa skyabs dang blo bstan/ a lags smad sog a khu rdzong sngon thogs med/ tsho ba so so 'i 'gan khur ba grwa ba kha shas bcas 'tshogs nas dpa' mchog sde bas bka' bstan blu rgyur gros 'cham byung ste/ lo de'i lugs rnying gi zla 5tshes 4la dzong sngon thogs med dang chos mdzad phun tshogs rgya mtsho gnyis zi khron sde dger song nas zla 6tshes 25la bka' bstan gnyis bde blag ngang blus nas phyir phebs/ ser spreng dang bcas gser lag dgon la gdan drangs/rdzong sngon thogs med dang chos mdzad phun tshogs rgya mtsho gnyis la ru dgon gnyis nas legs so bla med phul/ 1986lo'i zla 5ba'i tshes 4la dpa' mchog spyi ba'i gzhi sha la'i mtha' ban de nas bzung / bka' bstan gnyis spyi thog tu gdan drangs/ tsho ba lngas rta bsu dang spyi bas ser spreng bcas dga' ston rgya chen po byas/ bla ma mchod pa'i tshogs gsungs te thams cad kyis tshogs kyi 'khor lo tshim pa drug ldan gyi tshul du rol/ gser lag dgon dang / shing khri dason/ bde chen dgon/ lha lcam dgon/ yo'u rgya'i spyi ba sogs dgon sde dang spyi ba so so'i dge bskul rnams dang / gzhan khul 402

dang rdzong zhang so so sogs kyi 'thus mi rnam pa spyi ba gsar 'dzugs kyi dga' ston la zhugs/ khong ya lags smad sog tshang dang / rdzong sngon thogs med tshang / 'bum pa skyabs/ blo bstan sogs dang / tsho ba lnga'i rgan pa rnams bcas kyis spyi ba'i 'grig lam dang las sne bsko bzhag sogs la gros byas te/ dge bskul la rdzong sngon thogs med dang / blo bzang rgya mtsho gnyis dang / rlung rta khang gi dbu mdzad la 'jam dbyangs 'phrin las/sngags khang gi dbu mdzad la 'jigs med gzhan phan bcas bzhag pa dang /de min tsho ba lnga nas mi nyi shu rtsa lnga 'dems te/ so sor gzhi 'dzin dang /dung 'bud/ tsi 'bud/ sgo gnyer/ do dam pa sogs la bzhag par ma zad/ nyin khur gyi go rim dang 'gan khur len tshul sogs kyang thag bcad/da skabs spyi ba'i nang rten la bka' bstan gnyis dang / gdugs dkar zhal thang gcig sgra dbyangs rgyal bo dang mngon chen rgyal bo gnyis kyi gos thang (rong bo dgon chen nas gnang )re/ tsi dang / rag dung / dung dkar cha re dang / mchod skong / dung phor sogs cha tshang dang / sngags khang dang rlung rta khang la'ang nang rten dang mchod rdzas ci dgos cha tshang bar yod/ /da lta spyi bar ban sngags 180yod pa dang / 'don bca' la tshogs chen nas nang 'tshogs la gnas bcu dang / bla mchod/ gtor bsngos sogs gsungs/ de'i 'phror nyin gsum nas bzhi la bka' 'gyur dag tshar dang skabs bstun gyi zhal 'don mdo gdugs sogs dang tsha gsur/ tsha rteng ma'i skabs su bsang gsungs/ bka' 'gyur tshar rjes gdugs dkar sogs nyin lnga nas drug la gsungs/ sngags khang nas snying thig rtsa gsum dang mgon po tshogs bdag gi khri tshar sogs tshogs grangs med/ seng ོgdong bzlog pa stong dang bskang gsol sogs gsungs/ rlung rta khang nas kong tse'i dgra rlung nyin bzhi dang rta mgrin yang gsang gi gtor zlog dang 403

'brel ba'i zlog stong / tshogs brgya/ bskang gso sogs gsungs/ nyin lnga bar tsho ba lnga'i 'go ba rnams kyis dgra lha bkod bstod gang byed rgyur dge bskul la yar zhu byas te dgra lha bstod dgos tshe tsho ba yongs kyi pho rta thub dang rta mi theg tshad ma zon na sgrig chad gcod rgyu'i kha dan byed/ nyin der ki sgra dang bso sgras bar snang bkang ste sde ba thun mong gi dgra bo bdud kyi so bya nag po rtsa med du ma btang bar dmag phyir mi bsdu ba'i gna' rabs kyi srol ltar byed/ /spyi ba'i sgrig lam gsar 'dzugs byas pa ni/ sbyi ba 'tshogs ring —dkar zas la rol ba las zog lug bshas mi chog par bcos pa dang / chang 'thung bag med kyi spyod tshul dang 'khon rdung res sogs mthun sgril la gnod pa'i byatsud gtan 'gog byed pa/ tsho ba so so'i 'go ba yongs nas rang rang tsho ba'i bsang rtsi dang / gtor rtsam/ tsha gsur gyi rgyu sogs tshags su tshud pa'i 'gan len dgos/ /dge bskul thogs med kyis lo bcu gsum la spyi ba'i 'gan blangs pa dang da lta khong gi dgung lo mtho ba sogs la rkyen byas nas 'go ba rnams la gnang ba zhus par/ kun gyis bka' drin che zhus kyis dga' rtags dang legs so bla med phul thog 1998lor dge bskul gyi 'gan bla rgan tshang gi 'jam dbyangs rig grol la 'khur tu bcug/2 stagasgor sbyi ba/ /de yang sngon sku gagogs ya rig 'jam dbyangs shes rab tshang stag skor tsho bar chibs bsgyur gnang skabs/ rgan pa tshos khong la tsho ba'i bde sdug legs nyes kyi skyabs bcol zhus pa la/ bla ma khong gi zhal nas stag skor tsho bas lo rer gdugs dkar gyi chos thog zhig 'dzugs thub na chos 'dzig rten gnyis kyi bya ba yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel bas shin tu legs gsungs/ de nas bzung lo re'i zla lnga ba'i tshes bco lnga yas mas su gdugs dkar chos thog chen 404

mo nyin bdun la 'tshogs pa'i srol dar/ chos thog btsugs ma thag pa'i skabs su tshogs ras med pas spre'u nag phub nas tshogs 'tshogs/ rjes su rab byub cu drug pa'i me gling (spyi lo1937)lor stag skor tsho ba'i dgon 'brog gnyis kyi rgan pa tshos gros byas te/ de slong blo bzang dar rgyas dang dbu mdzad grags pa/ slob dpon mkhyen rab/ brtsi bzhag tshul khrims/dge slong phun tshogs sogs kyis dbu 'dzin mdzad pa dang / ya khu stag lha dang nam mkha'/ rta kho/ dpa' ris/ srid pas sogs kyis ram 'degs dang tsho ba yongs kyis khur tu blangs nas tshogs ras chen mo gsar bzo legs thub byung ste/ spyi chos sgrub par cha rkyen gsar pa bsgrun/ de rjes spyi lo 1957lor yang tshogs ras sngar las che ba gsar bzo byas mod/phyi lor dus zing gi nang du med par bzos/ de nas slar yang tang gi mi rigs chos lugs srid jus sgo kun nas don 'a bas byas par brten/ spyi lo 1990lor smad sog sprul ba'i sku 'jam dbyangs legs bshad rgya mtshos thugs khur dang 'al bkod lta ra/ stag skor tsho ba'i dge slong blo bzang rgya mtsho dang skal bzang rgya mtsho/ phun tshogs sogs kyis gros mgo bton zhing /dbang chen skyabs dang mchog gsum/ sbyin pa/ mgon lha/ lha 'bum rgyal sogs kyis 'gan len dang tsho ba yongs kyi mang tshogs kyis ram 'degs la brten nas srid la ras zheng bcu bzhi dang / zheng la ras zheng nyi shu yod pa'i tshogs ras shig bzos te stag skor spyi ba'i rgyun nyams pa slar gso byas/lo de'i zla byams 15nyin grwa btsun bzhi bcu lhag gis gdugs dkar chos thog chen mo yang bskyar btsugs te nyin bdun gyi ring la rgyal ba'i bka' chos bsgrags/ spyi ba'i 'don chos gtso bo ni/ chos thog nyin dang por rgyal ba'i yum chen mo sgrogs 'don byed/ de nas nyin re ba'in nang 'tshogs la skyabs 'gro/ bla mchod/ gnas bcu/ sman bla/ sa lam skar gsum/smon lam rnam lnga/ gtor bsngos bcas 'don/ tsha rteng ma dang gung tshigs 05

kyi rjes su gdugs dkar mchog thub ring thung ci thub dang bla ma'i rgyun bsang 'don/ phyi ja'i rjes su 'jig byed dpa' gcig dang drug pa/ gser zhal ma/ mgon chos rnam lnga/ dam can sogs chos skyong rnams kyi bskang gso bcas chag med du 'don/ nyin tha mar rta mgrin yang gsang gi bzlog pa dang / gdugs dkar bzlog pa/ ma ru tse'i bzlog pa bcas 'phangs rjes/sde brgyad rgyag brngan rgyas par gsungs shing dgra bslong bkod nas spyi ba grol/'di ltar lo rer rgyun mthud du 'tshogs la khyad par du spyo lo2000lor smad sog sprul ba'i sku khong dngos su spyi ba'i tshogs thog tu phebs te ser skya kun la gsung chos ci dgar bstsal zhing / thugs smon bla na med pa'i rten 'brel gyi mtshams sbyar ba legs so/ /2 blagan tshang gi spyi ba/ /1941lor dpa' mchog rgya lug gis bla rgan tshang gis gdugs dkar gyi chos thog nyin bdun la 'dzin pa'i srol btsugs pa de da lha'ang rgyun skyong mus yin/ /4 nywa nag gyi ba/ /nywa nag bla spyon gyi skababasu dbu mdzad bla ma snyan sad kyis btsugs par grags/ zla6pa'i nang mchod pa 'bum bshams pa dang sman chog chen mo dang / bla mchod gtso byas pa'i sku rim dang dgra rlung 'dzin/ bdun pa'i nang tshe 'bum pa'i lugs kyi thugs rje chen po zla chos byed/ zla8pa'i nang rta mgrin bzlog pa'i nyin bdun gyi chos thog nywa nag sku los gser lag ltar btsugs/ bod lo'i nang bsrung ma la 'azin bcol gyi bskang gso dang — gdugs dkar nyen bdun la 'don/ spyi lo 1952lor rje byams pa chos grub kyis ྅ nag spyi ba mkhan slas dgon du bsgyur/ /5 gamar skyong spyi ba/ /g.yer skyong bla ma sma skam rin po ches btsugs pa dang / 1958lor 06

'tshogs rgyun chad nas lo ngo sum cu lhag 'gor/ srid jus je lhod du btang rjes chos dad mang tshogs kyis/ yo'u rgya'i sngags rabs bdun pa 'jigs blo rin po che bsam spyor gnyis kyis bla mar bsten cing / khong tshang gdan drangs te chos thog yang bskyar btsugs/ 'don bca' la bla ma'i zhal —bkod ltar dbyar zla gnyis par nyin gsum la thugs rje chen po sdug bsngal rang grol gyi cho ga 'don pa dang / ma gza' dam gsum gyi bskang gso byed/nyin gnyis la spyi sde yongs nas dpal mo lugs kyi bsnyen gnas bsrung zhing cho ga gso spyong dang bcas par bsgrub/ grwa tshang gis gdugs dkar 'don pa dang / dgra rlung bkod pa sogs byed/ston zla gsum par yi dam phur ba'i las byang nyid thun bzhi byas te gsungs shing / phur ba'i stong zlog dang / rta mgrin ya nga gsang gi bzlog pa/ sbyin bsregs sogs chad lus med par bsgrub/ snying thig gi bskang ba sgrub pa dang gdugs dkar yang gsungs/ tshogs yun nyin bdun la byed/ /spyi ba'i dge bskos dang / dbu mdzad/ gnyer ba sogs kyang bla 'jigs blo'i thugs bkod ltar bsko bzhag byed pa'isrol btsugs/drug pa/ phayul dgon gong mayin pa'i bla chen 'ga'i lo sa mdor bsdus/ /zam tsha sku breng bdun pa blo bzang nam mkha'agrol mtshan/ dzi skad du/blo bzang rgyal ba'i ring lugs skyong zhing spel/ /'jam dbyangs bla ma rim blon gtsug tu bkur/ /nam mkha' bzang po bzhin du 'gro la brtse/ /bkra shis rgyal mtshan 'dzin la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i mngon par rtogs pa'i yon tan gyi tshogs la 'gran pa'i do zla dang bral ba/ mchog spul rin po che rje blo bzang nam mkha' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang ni/ dgon gong ma'i ྅ nag dpon tshang du rab byung 07

bcu drug pa'i chu khyi (1982)lo'i zla bzhi ba'i tshes bcu dgu nyin yab dbang chen rnam rgyal dang / yum rdo je mtsho gnyis kyi sras su sku 'khrungs/ de yang dam pa 'di nyid 'jam mgon bstan pa'i srog shing khri chen skal bzang lung rigs rgya mtsho'i zhal snga nas yang sprul du thugs thag bcad tshul ni/ rab byung bcu bdun pa'i lcags lug chu stod zla ba'i nya la skyabs mgon mchog nas mchog sprul rin po che thugs thag gcod rgyu'i bka' khyab gnang / de dus skya ser 'thus mi rnams la bla brang dgon pa'i do dam khang nas kun mkhyen mchog nas pakho chen rin po che'i gsung bkod ltar zam tsha mchog sprul rin po che'i sprul sku gsar tu 'tshol dgos tshul sogs kyi gsung gleng mang po gnang /ser skya mi chen rnams kyis yab sra sa gnyis kyi bka' lung spyi bor bkur nas rang gi rtsa ba'i bla mar lo ngo sum bcu'i ring mjal ba'i skal ba ma byung ba'i gnas tshul sogs dang / khri chen nam mkha' bzang po'i yang sgrul 'khrul med cig gdan sar 'god rgyu'i re ba rnams yar zhu byas/ kun mkhyen rin po che nas kyang khyed rang tshos bla ma dkon mchog la snying nas gsol ba thobs dang yang sprul 'khrul med cig khri sar 'god thub nges yin zhes gsungs/ /lo de'i zla bdun pa'i tshes lnga nyin skyabs mgon rin po che gtso byas te gung thang gser khri/ sde ba gser khri/ lha mo'i gser khri bcas dang / bla brang bkra shis 'khyil gyi bla ma las thog pa dge ba'i bshes gnyen du mas tshogs chen 'du khang chen mo'i mdun du mchog gsum rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i thugs rje bskul/ rten 'byung bsru ba med pa'i bden pa bdar nas 'jam mgon bstan pa'i srog shing zam tsha sku phreng drug pa rje bskal bzang lung rigs rgya mtsho mchog gi yang sprul gyi 'khrungs phyogs dang dgung snyeng bcas brtag pa bgyis 'bras/ mtsho sngon zhing chen thun te rdzong phyogs yas mas su btsal na legs ngo 'byung tshul gsungs/ de nas a lags 'gying phrug tshang gtso byas pa'i lha sde so so'i mi sna dang dgon pa gnyis kyi grwa ba dang bcas sprul sku btsal ba'i 08

phyogs su bzhud/ de nas zla gcig ring byis pa drug brgya bcu tham pa'i ming dang skye yus sogs gsal bor bkod nas dkyus gcig tu skyabs mgon rin po che bzhugs pa'i bla brang bkra shis 'khri du legs par 'byor/ /lo de'i zla dgu ba'i tshes gnyis nyin la kun mkhyen 'jigs med thub bstan chos kyi nyi ma/ gung thang khri chen bstan pa'i dbang phyug sde khri—'jam dbyangs thub bstan rgya mtsho/ khri chen rgyal mtshan seng ge'i mchog sprul blo bzang rnam rgyal lung rigs seng ge bcas dang grwa tshang drug gi bla ma gdan zur/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen rags bsdus/ rmog ri/ shis tshang dgon gnyis kyi grwa ba las thog pa/ lha sde so so'i mi sna bcas kyis kun mkhyen chen po dgyes bzhad rdo rje'i sku phreng rim byon gyi gdung mdun nas smon gsol gnad smin thog rten 'brel bsru ba med pa'i bden pa bdar nas zan bsgyur mthar nya nag nam rgyal gyi bu la sgrul sku'i yi ge legs par bab/ de nas tshes nyer lnga nyin/ bla brang dgon pa gtso byas pa'i skya ser 'thus mi thun ter 'byor nas mchog sprul nyi ma gzhon nur kha btags phul/ gong sa skyabs mgon mchog nas mtshan blo bzang nam mkha' rgyal mtshan zhes su gsol/ zhabs brtan gsol 'debs kyang khong rin po che nas mdzad/ zla dgu ba'i tshes bdun la gser lag dgon du 'dan 'dren zhus/ tshes bcu nyin ngur sprig gi rgyal mtshan legs par bzhes/ chos sde chen po bla brang bkra shis 'khyil nas zla dgu ba'i tshes nyer gnyis la gdan sar 'god rgyu'i sta gon byas shing / dad ldan mang pos mchog sprul nyid la re sgug byas yod pa'i skabs su mtsho sngon zhing chen chos lugs cus nas blu kha skor mi chog pa'i bka' rgya byung / de ltar re zhig gser lag dgon nas mi bzhugs ka med byung /409

'on kyang rjes sor thung gung mtsho lho khul yu'i byu'u ci don thub rgyal gtso byas pa'i 'brel yod 'go khrid mi snas mthun rkyen sbyar 'og mchog spul nyid bla brang du phebs nas khri sar 'khod pa'i skal ba ldan/ rab byung bcu bdun pa'i chu sprel lo'i zla dang po'i tshes nyer bdun nyin kun mkhyen rin po che'i bka' gsung ltar gcan tsha rdzong thog tu chibs kha bsgyur/ tshes nyer brgyad nyin skyabs rje mchog gi zhal nas rgan rgya'i brag dkar dgon du phebs nas nyin 'ga' bzhugs na de ni bde mchog gi gnas yin pas rten 'brel legs par gsung pa ltar rgan gya'i brag dkar dgon du phebs pa'i lam la chas/rgan gya'i sa thog tu glebs skabs der sa gagi dar dkar gyis g.yog 'dra'i kha ba dkar po zhig gis mdun bsus nas dge mtshan gyi rtags khyad par can byung / de nas bla brang dgon dang lha sde so so'i mi snas rim pa bzhin lha dar sogs phul/ rgan rgya'i gzhung nas kyang ja thab rta bsu byas nas rim gyis phebs shing dad ldan mang tshogs la phyag dbang gnang / zla bcu gnyis pa'i tshes bcu gcig nyin gdan sa chen po bla brang bkra shis 'khyil du chibs kha bsgyur/ phebs lam du bla brang dgon pas ja thab che chung bcas su rim bzhin zhabs kyis bcags/ mchog sbrul nyid kyi 'brel yod dgon sde dang lha sde mi sde sogs kyis sna drangs pa'i rlangs 'khor nyis brgya sum bcu lhag gis dus thog tu bsu ba rgya chen mdzad/ bla brang dgon pa'i gzhung nas grwa tshang gis ser sprengs rgyas spras zhus shing kye rdor grwa tshang gsang sngags dar rgyas gling du khri 'bul btegs/ de nyin dpal thugs 'dzin dbang po dang rnam thos sras kyi dbang mdzod lag snod du bkod pa lta bu'i khri ston gyi mdzad sgo'i thog dad ldan ser skya bgrang gis mi la pas mjal dar phul nas bstan pa rgyas 410

pa'i bden brjod sogs rten labrel gyi sgo 'phar yangs por phyes/ bcu gsum nyin skyabs rje mchog nas brtan mkhas kyi yon tan gnyis dang ldan pa yongs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po rje 'jam dbyangs rgya mtsho'i zhal snga nas mchog sprul rin po che'i yongs 'dzin du bskos/ gza' skar 'phrod spyor legs pa'i yar tshes zla gsum pa'i tshes bco lnga nyin dpal ldan rgyud stod grwa tshang gi khri las thog pa a lags bde thang zhabs drungs tshang rje dkon mchog mkhyen rab rgya mtsho'i mdun nas dge bsnyen rab byung dang tshigs snga ma dge tshul gyi sdom pa dkyus gcig tu mnos/ mchog sgrul gyi mtshan yang blo bzang dkon mchog nam mkha' rgyal mtshan zhes gsol/ mas bcu gsum nyin kun mkhyen rin po che nang chen du phebs nas gser zangs las grub pa'i ston sku khru tshad can zhig thugs dam gyi rten du gnang / de'i phyis khri chen gung thang rin po che mchog sgrul nyid kyi bla brang du zhabs kyis bcags rnam pa gnyis gsung gleng mang tsam gnang / zla drug pa'i tshes bdun nyin/ hor tshang mchog sprul rin po che dang mnyam du rgan rgya'i brag dkar la khams bsang du phebs shing / skabs der gnas mjal gnas skor sogs zhib rgyas gnang / da lta dpal ldan bkra shis g.yas su 'khyil ba'i gling du yongs 'dzin rin po che'i thugs rje la brten nas klog pa thos bsam gyi bya ba 'ba' zhig la gagol bzhin pa'i sgang legs so/ / phyag tshu rtogs ldan pa'i sprul ba'i rabs lnga ba 'jig med seng ge dbal gyi dbang phyug khong ni rab byung bcu drug pa'i chu mo glang gi lor dgon gong ma'i yo'u rgya ru/ rnam par dkar ba'i phyogs la yid rab tu dad pa yab sheb rab bzang po dang / yum bkra shis skyid gnyis kyi sras su ngo mtshar ba'i ltas 11

du ma dang bcas rte sku bltams/ sku na chung dus nas byams snying rje dang dad nges 'byung sogs dam pa'i yon tan du ma lhan skyes su mnga'/ dgung grangs bcu gnyis nas snyigs dus bstan pa'i spyi dpal 'jigs med 'od gsal rol ba'i rdo rje dang mkhan chen dkon mchog rin chen mnyes pa du mas bsten nas lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa rgyan du blangs te/ mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas pa'i gzhung lugs rgya mtsho la gsan sbyangs mdzad/dus der dgung grangs nyer gcig tu son pa na sprul ba'i sku rabs lnga ba nyid du ngos bzung pa ltar khri sar bkod/ de rjes dpal ri dam shrī seng ha dang gser rta bla rung chos kyi grong khyer nas skyabs rje yid bzhin nor bu sogs las nges gsang theg pa'i bdud rtsi nod de lo ngo gnyis lhag la thos bsam sgom pa'i shes rab phyogs med du sbyangs/ dgung grangs nyer bzhir rdo grub rin po che'i bka' lung bzhin/ brag dkar sprel rdzong gi gu ru'i sgrub phug tu bsnyen sgrub zab mo'i las la rtse gcig tu gzhol ba na rang bzhin gyi rtog tshogs dbyings su yal nas rab 'byams dag pa'i snang ba 'byams su klas pa zhig byung / nyer drug par gnas chen bla mtshor phebs nas mkha' 'gro bde chen rgyal mo'i tshogs 'khor bskor tshe ngo mtshar ba'i ltas byung tshul sogs rgyas pa gzhan du bkod do/ /rka'u ba sku zeng bdun pa dge 'dun bstan pa rab༅sa/ khong ni rab byung bco lnga ba'i bgrang bya gnyis pa sa pho 'brug (1868)gi lor yab g.yer skyong lo tho dang yum chos sgron gnyes kyi sras su ya mtshan pa'i ltas dang bcas te sku bltams/ dgongs lo dgu'i thog ko'u ba sku sngon ma'i sprul skur ngos bzung / dgon pa'i 'thus tshab rnams kha btags 'then du yong skabs 12

paṇa chen ye shes rgyal mtshan mchog gis ko'u ba sku gong mar gnang pa'i kha btags lha dgu ma dang / chos dung / mgon po'i zhal thang bcas a khu skal hang tshang la gnang zhing / khong tshang gi sbra la yang ko'u ba'i mgon po'i nang sding ma zhes ming btags shing kha g.yang brjod/ khri sar bkod rjes sku gzhogs sgo mang tshang bla mar bsten nas dbu phar 'dul mdo sogs la mkhas par sbyangs shing / grub rtags bstan tshul sogs kyi mdzad pa bsam mi khyab/gdugs rta dar bcu gsum gyi go thob bzhes/ ko'u ba dgon gong zhol gnyis dang / sku 'bum dgon bcas la bdag skyong gnang zhing / bla dpon gnyis kyi khur bsnams te tor mo khag gsum gtso byas pa'i sde tsho nyer dgu dang / rgya bya tshang khri rtse gsum gyi spyi dpon mdzad cing gong mas khri thob gnang / ko'u ba btsan po ma zhes ming du grags/ khong gis rgyun par dbon po ka mdo dang khen rgyal gnyis khrid de log spyod dbang 'dzin pas khral rigs sna tshogs btsan 'gel byas par bkag 'gog dang / btsan gyis khral bsdus te skyel ba'i ko gru mang po 'phrog ste 'bru rigs dang dngos rdzas mi ser la bgos/ de ltar bgyis pas 'go gtso rnams kyi mig nang gi tsher mar gyur/ spyi lo1903lor khong gis sku srun ya lags thar shul dang tshe 'ba'/gsol dpon ban kho sogs sku 'khor nyung shas shig dang mnyam du lha sar phebs pa'i lam skabs su khri ga'i sa sgo brgyud skabs/ sa sgo'i dpon rigs lo ye dkar sdang bya bas mnga' 'bangs kyi khral je yang du gtong rgyu yin tshul dang / kho tsho bar ji ltar 'grig mthun yong bar gros bsdur byed ched ya mon tu phebs dgos tshul sogs bshad pas/ a lags ko'u bas kho tsho la g.yo sgyu yod pa mkhyen bzhin nyams thag 'gro ba'i don du sku srog la ma 'dzims par khri 413

ga'i ya mon du pebs/ sku 'khor rnams ya mon du 'dzul ma thag sngon nas gra sgrig byas yod pa'i dmag mis lag rub byas te bzung ba dang / ya lags rnam pa gnyis la me mda' dang gri yis brgyab kyang mtshon ma bzhes pas/ tho bas brdung ste dmar gsod btang / /a lags ko'u bas log spyod srid gzhung la ngo rgol dang 'gro ba'i bde sdug gi don du skupog blos btang ba'i mdzad jes ni skal ba dang mnyam gnas yin no/ /za skam sku zeng bdun pa blo bzang rtsol khrims rgya mtsho/ yab g.yer skyong dpon po bstan skyong dang / yum gtsug tor gnyis kyi sras su sbu 'khrungs/ ma yum gtsug tor ni khong gi sku gong ma'i mchod chu 'khur mkhan yin la/ sku gong ma grongs khar zhal chems la da res ngas khyod la go ma chod/ skye ba rjes mar go cung tsam ye chod blta gsungs nas sdug gu bkrol nas mo la gnang ba nyar tshags byas/ sku btsa' ran khar rmi lam du yum gyis ral ba'i nang me tog ser po zhig btags yod pa mis la/ bstan skyong gi spun rig los kyang ya mtshan pa'i mi lam rmis pa sogs kyi ltas bzang thon par grags/ khong dgung lo gsum gyi skabs gtsang pani ta dang / a lags la kha tshang rnam pa gnyis kyis thugs brtag gnang nas smra skam sku gong ma'i sgrul skur nges bzung / gad kor 'jams pa'i dbyangs kyi mdun nas rab byung dang dge tshul dkyus gcig tu bsgrubs/ rte'u tshang dge slong chos rgya mtsho yongs 'dzin du bsten/ rgyud sde thams cad byang chub par bslabs/ a rig dge bshes dpal ldan las tshad ma'i skor sbyangs/ bla brang sku gzhogs la kho rin po che'i mdun nas bsnyen par dzogs shing / gtsang dgon pa'i 14

'dul 'dzin yongs kyi gtsug rgyan du gyur/ dgon pa'i grwa tshang gi gser khri mdzad/ rgyun ja'i khri ba dang smon lam khri ba bstud mar lo drug la khur/1940lor mā jag gis gtsang dgon pa bcom brlags su btang rjes/dgon pa slar gso'i 'dzugs spun la rgyu dngos 'bor chen btang ste mthun rkyen baspun/ g.yer skyong sde ba la lo re bzhin pa'i spyi bsrung chos thog btsugs/ gtso bo rta mgrin yang gsang dang / mgon chos lnga/ dgra rlung / gdugs dkar bzlog chen 'bar ma sogs sku rim rgya chen btsugs/gzhan khong gis g.yer skyong sde ba la kha 'dzin mgon skyabs byed pa'i gzhi bdag cig dgos par dgongs nas/ gad kor 'jam pa'i dbyangs la lung bstan zhus te/ gser gagong ri phyor nas rma sras chen po nor bu dgra 'joms kyi lab tse brtsigs/ /dge bshes bstan rgyas/ dge bshes bstan rgyas ni g.yer skyong byams rgyal gyi sras su 'khrungs la/ khong chung dus nas sdi tsha dgon par rab tu byung zhing slob gnyer mdzad/ mi ring bar phar phyin dam bca' bzhag rjes su bla brang bkra shis 'khyil tu phebs nas mtshan ldan gyi bla ma mang po gtsug rgyan du bsten nas gzhung bka' pod lnga la thos bsam rgya chen mdzad/ rab 'byams pa dang rdo rams pa'i mtshan btags thob/ 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum la 'gran pa'i zla dang bral bas rig pa'i dbang byug chen mo 'am sdi tsha'i dge bshes rgya ra zhes pa'i mtshan snyan mdo khams yongs su khyab/ dge bshes bstan pa sogs thugs las skyes pa'i slob bu mkhas pa mang po yod/ /415
