le'u brgyad pa/dgon gong mar dmangs gtso'i bcos bsgyur byas tshun gyi gnas tshul/dang po/ chab srid dang dpal 'byor thadakyi 'pho 'gyur/ /spyi lo1949lo'i zla 8 par mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag gis lan ju blangs rjes/ mā pu t+pang log spyod srid gzhung de sran phung bzhin tu 'thor/zla ba'i tshes mgor rwa rgya dgon du yod pa'i thun te dzong srid gzhung rnying pa dang zi ling bar gyi 'brel ba chad par brten/ rdzong srid gzhung rnying ba dngangs skrag skyes te nyi ma 'khyol ma thub pas srid gzhung gi sdod gnas mang ra la spor zhing / rdzong dpon bstan dar kyis srid gzhung gi 'thus mi dang rjes 'brang ba mi nyi shu lhag khrid nas zi ling du 'go 'dogs par phyin/ zla pa'i zla dkyil du zi ling du glebs shing / zhing chen dmag srid yu yon lhan khang gi kru'u rin li'o han treng dang drung yig chen mo krang go hreng gnyis kyis zugs 'phrad gnang nas tang gi srid jus gsal bshad byas pa dang / kho tsho'i 'os langs mgo 'dogs kyi bya spyod la dga' bsu byed tshul bshad/ de'i mtshungs su khyod tsho da lta bcings 'grol btang zin pa yin/ phyir song rjes sa gnas kyi sgrig khrims dang da lta'i gnas bab bsrung 'dzin legs po byas te ngang sgug byos zhes gdams/ /spyi lo 1950 lo'i zla 7 par thun te bod rigs rang skyong chus gra sgrig u yon lhan khang btsugs shing / 1951 lo'i zla 11tshes 20 nyin thun te bod 416

rigs rang skyong khul btsugs pa dngos su bsgrags/ bstan dar rang skyong khul gyi kru'u zhir bzhag dus de nas bzung dgon gong ma sde bzhi tsho khag bcu gcig gi mi mang nams kyang srid gzhung gsar ba'i mnga' 'bangs su gyur/ sngon lta bu'i dpya khral ldid mo med pa byas nas 'brog pa'i khur bo je yang du btang / rgud skyob dang dngul bun btang nas 'brog pa dbul bo la thon skyed gong du spel ba'i rogs ram byas/ spyi lo1953dang1954 lo gnyis kyi ring la rgyal khab kyis dgon gong mar bsdoms pas sgor mo 'bum bdun dang stong dgu bskyis pa dang / gzhan rgud skyob kyi dngul bun yang btang ste nor 363 dang lug 732nyos te/ dud khyim chig brgya nyer drug gi thon skyed dang 'tsho ba'i thad kyi dka' ngal bsal te rim gyis dka' ngal med par gyur/ /de dus 'brog khul gyi dpal 'byor thad la phyugs las gtso gnyer gyi thon skyed 'phel rgyas gtong ba dang / spyi tshogs chab srid kyi thad la mi bgo mi rtsod/ gral rim mi 'byed/ phyugs dzi byugs bdag gnyis phan gyi srid jus gsar ba lag bstar byas stabs/ phyugs las gong 'phel mgyogs shing mang tshogs kyi 'tsho ba nyin re bzhin yar rgyas su song /1949lor dgon gong mar dud tshang 705yod cing (de'i nang du dpa'— mchog la dud tshang 305dang o'u rgyar247 4 nag la102 g.yer skyong la 51 bcas yod) mi grangs stong tsho bzhi ma longs tsam dang / byugs rigs sna tshogs70893 las med la/ 1953 lor dud tshang 937 dang mi grangs4232yod pa dang / byugs rigs sna tshogs 118214la 'phar zhing /lo bzhi tsam gyi ring la rkyang 'phel4731 byung bas/ rkyang 'phel gyi tshad brgya cha'i 66 80la glebs/ /1954lor dgon gong ma'i khyim tshang dbul phyug bar ma thams cad kyi phyugs zog gong du 'phel yod de/ dper na dpa' mchog dpon skor kho 17

na'i gnas tshul re'u mig du bkod pa las kyang shes thub/gong gsal re'u mig las 'brog dbul dang srug 'bring gi phyugs zog 'phar tshad mgyogs pa ni srid gzhung gis rgyab rogs byas pa'i thog kho tsho'i hur brtson rang bzhin la brten pa gsal bor shes/ phyug4rigs sna —tshogs kyi nang du la lo'i 'phel tshad ha cang mgyogs pa ni bcings 'grol byas rjes rta khral 'jal rgyu med pa'i stabs yin/ /1954lo'i lo mjug tu dgon gong ma'i dpa' mchog dpon skor tsho bar rtsad gcod byas pa ltar na/ tsho ba 'dir dud tshang 44 mi grangs 209 yod cing / mi rer cha snyom nas rgya ma 252 de dang / phye rgya ma 148 rgya ma1 77 ras khri tsi16 8 pags pa 3 3 phying ba 'jog byed kyi bal rgya ma 1 1 mar rgya ma 33 8 chur ba rgya ma 6 4 gro ma rgya ma 1 5bsha' lug gsum re/ skam 0 17re yod/ dpon skor ni phyugs las gtso bo dang zhing las nyung tsam gnyer ba'i tsho ba zhig yin la/ lo de'i bza' 'azu yang phal cher rang gis btab pa red/ /1953lo'i 46par dgon gong ma mi dmangs srid gzhung ste chus gsum 18

pa btsugs/ dpa' mchog 'bum pa dang yo'u rgya'i skal skyabs gnyis kyis chus gsum pa'i chus krang gtso bo dang gzhon pa khur zhing / ྅ nag lcags los tang mu'i byu'u ci gzhon pa khur/ dpa' mchog tsho'u zhis kyis thon skyed kru'u rin dang / yo'u rgya'i lha brtan dang dpa' mchog ban de mgo skrang gis thon skyed las sgrub pa khur/ o'u rgya'i rta bo rgyal chus gsum pa'i tshong khang kru'u rin du bskos/ da dung dgon gong ma'i las byed pa kha shas kyis snga phyir rdzong rim pa'i srid gzhung gi gtso 'gan bzhes/ dpa' mchog blo bstan gyis sngon la rdzong dmangs srid kho yi kho krang khur ba dang / 1956lo'i zla 11tshes 15 nyin rdzong dpon gzhon par bzhag pa dang / 1963lor dzong dpon du bskos/ nywa nag chos 'byor sgyus rdzong mi dmangs khrims khang gi khrims dpon gyi go gnas khur pa dang / g.yer skyong dpa' bo rgyal gyis rdzong nags las sa tshigs kyi kran krang gi 'gan khur/ g.yer skyong khro khos 'bru rigs kho yi kho krang khur/ yo'u rgya'i bsang khos thun te rdzong srid gros kyi kru'u zhi gzhon pa khur/ chus gsum pa ste dgon gong ma'i tsho ba re la zhang re btsugs/ lha dpal dang lha byams gnyis kyis dpa' mchog zhang gi zhang krang gtso bo dang gzhon pa khur/ dpa' stobs dang bsod rgyam gnyis kyis yo'u rgya zhang gi zhang krang gtso gzhon khur/ dbyig gnyen dang yum skyabs gnyis kyis nya nag zhang gi zhang krang gtso gzhon khur/ nywa nag dbang 'bum gyis g.yer skyong zhang tang u'i byu'u ci dang / no'u rgya yis zhang krang khur/zhang bzhi bo re re'i mnga' 'og tu thon skyed ru khag du ma re ang grangs kyi sgrig rim ltar ming du btags nas so sor ru dpon re bsko bzhag byas/ /1955 lor res rogs skor chung dang rim pa thog ma'i phyugs las mnyam las khang tshod lta'i tshul du btsugs/ 1956lor dpa' mchog stag skor du sngon bskyod mnyam las khang dang po btsugs shing / lha byams dang /dbang byug ban de ske thung gsum gyis hre krang gtso gzhon khur/ dpon 1gyi

skor nas sngon bskyod mnyam las khang gnyis pa btsugs te lha dpal dang snying 'bas hre krang gtso gzhon khur/ gle ba nas sngon bskyod mnyam las khang gsum pa btsugs te hre krang mgon po rgyal gyis khur/ 'jam skor nas sngon bskyod mnyam las khang bzhi ba btsugs shing snying dkar dang bsod tshe gnyis kyis hre krang khur/ yo'u rgya nas mnyam las khang zhig btsugs pa'i ming la bcings 'grol mnyam las khang btags pa dang sbyin pa nag dang dbang rdor gyis hre krang khur ro/ /1957lor sde ba kha shas su res rogs tsho chung btsugs pa dang / sngar gyi mnyam las khang lnga'i nang nas dud tshang kha shas rang mos su phyir bud/ /1957lo'i sngon la dgon gong ma'i phyugs las thon skyed la gong 'phel chen po byung ste phyugs zog spyi grangs 2132610la slebs pas bcings 'grol byed skabs kyi spyi grangs las ldab gnyis tsam 'phar ro/ /gnyis pa/ lo gsum ring gi god chagasasgor/1957 lo'i zla 7par sngar gyi dgon gong ma chus gsum pa de mgo mang zhang dang 'jang chung zhang gnyis su bsgyur/ zhang de gnyis kyi ming ni sdod gnas kyi sa ming ltar btags pa yin/1958lo'i zla7 par dgon gong ma'i tsho khag thams cad la mnyam las khang dang / gzhung sger mnyam gnyer byugs ra btsugs shing / mnyam las khang re rer hre krang re bsko bzhag byas/ lo de'i zla 10par yongs khyab tu mi dmangs spyi khang can du bsgyur nas dgon gong mar mgo mang mi dmangs spyi khang dang 'jang chung mi dmangs spyi khang gnyis btsugs/ mgo mang mi —dmangs spyi khang gi khongs gtogs su thog mar sngar gyi sde ba rer ru khag du mar bgos te ang rim ltar gyi ming btags pa dang / 1960 lor sde ba phan tshun bsres te ru khag chen po bdun btsugs pa ste/ da lta'i me ru khi dang wa shar gnyis ru khag dang po byas pa'i ru dpon ni dbang phyug dang — ཿ0

'jigs med gnyis yin/ na rin dang tho si gnyis ru khag gnyis pa byas pa'i ru dpon ni skal bzang rgyal dang thag lo/ lha mo gsum yin/ dong bo dang bra shur gnyis ru khag gsum pa byas pa'i ru dpon ni dbang chen rdo rje dang tshe ring 'bum gnyis yin/ ha zha dang gle'u lung gnyis ru khag bzhi ba byas pa'i ru dpon ni skal bzang dang 'brug mo rgyal/ dpa' rdor gsum yin/ ho thog dang rgyal bo gnyis ru khag lnga ba byas pa'i ru dpon rab lo dang ban de gnyis yin/ chu dmar dang gser thang mkhan slas gsum ru khag drug pa byas pa'i ru dpon ni ban de dang / dpal bzang / dpa' mkhar gsum yin/ bar tshigs dang dung dkar ja la rta ra bcas ru khag bdun pa byas pa'i ru dpon ni sbyin pa dang / lcags lo/ dbang rdor gsum yin pa dang / de min ru khag bdun po so so nas sman pa dang mgar ba shing bzo lham 'debs rdo bzo sogs mnyam gcig tu bsdus nas ru khag cig btsugs pa'i ming la ru khag brgyad pa'am kun khrang (bzo grwa )zer/'jang chung mi dmangs spyi khang gi khongs gtogs su ru khag chen po lnga btsugs te ru dpon rnams ni 'jam dbyangs rgya mtsho dang / yo lo/ tho lu/chos bzang / gna' bo/ pa ring / sbyin pa/ ye shes chos 'dzin —bcas yin/ gong gi ru khag chen po dag gi 'og tu ru chung du ma re btsugs shing so sor mgo dpon re gnyis bsko bzhag byas/1958 lo'i rjes kyi lo gsum ring la g.yon lhung gi srid jus lag bstar byas pas/ thon skyed dpal 'byor la gnod 'tshe tshabam chen thebs nas mang tshogs kyi 'tsho bar lo rgyus steng mthong ma myong ba'i dka' ngal byung ste bkres lhogs kyis mnar nas shi ba'i mi yang mang po yod/ de'i thog la gral rim 'azab rtsod rgya cher spel te nyes 'gel dang gcar rdung btson 'jug —sogs kyis mi la skrag snang yong ba zhig byas/ nga brgyad lo'i lo stod du mang tshogs khrod kyi me mda' dang gri mdung sogs mtshon cha yod tshad gzhung bzhes ཿ1

byas/ de'i rjes nas bla dpon dang ru skor nang gi mi drag gras rnams mnyam gcig tu bsdus nas srid jus slob sbyong dang rang skyon rang brjod gzhan skyon sun 'byin byed pa'i 'gul spyod tsha drag tu spel/ de dus thog mar rong bo nas chos skyong gur mgon med par gtong rgyu dang bla dpon 'dzin bzung byed par ma dga' bar bcoyobasgyur la ngo rgol byed pa'i zing 'khrug langs/ de nas sha sbrang gi sde ba mang che shos nas ngo log byas pa dang / 1958lo'i dbyar khar zing 'khrug sngon 'gog gi ched du mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag stong tsho gsum gyis mdzo mo lung ba nas dgon gong ma'i tshogs ra phyi rim nang rim byas nas bskor te dkar nag dbye ba mi 'byed par skya ser pho mo brgyad bcu lhag bsdams bkyigs byas te btson du ded/ de'i dbang gis de nas cang ma 'gor bar dgon gong ma'i yo'u rgya sde ba'i dud tshang mang che ba dang sde ba gzhan rnams kyi dud tshang 'ga' res ngo log gi mtshon cha gri mdung dang 'ur cha sa sogs pa khyer nas wa ma wol la zing 'khrug tu zhugs /don dam du kho tsho'i ming la gsar brjer ngo rgol byed pa'i zing 'khrug pa zhes pa btags rung kho tshor dmigs yul dang rtsa 'dzugs ci yang med par dngangs skrag gis lo lon rgan gzhon byis pa dang mnyam du rma chur brgal nas skya mo dmar mo'i phyogs su bros byol byas/ de'i mjug 'bras la skye pho mo mang po'i rang srog shor ba dang / phyugs zog khri la nye ba spyong gud du gyur/ ma gzhir zing 'khrug der dmag shugs de 'dra chen po btang nas drag gnon ya nga ba byed mi dgos mod/ skabs de'i g.yon lhung gi srid jus kyi dbang du song ste rgya bskyed pa'i gnad don tshabs je cher btang / tha na rjes nas zing 'khrug su zhugs mkhan phar zhog zing 'khrug sngon 'gog la byas rjes yod pa'i dpa' mchog rta ris dang / g.yer skyong tshe bo/ ྅ nag lcags ka.o'u rgya'i lha brtan sogs kyang 'dzin bzung byas te btson du bcug pa'i tshul byung ba red/ 22

skabs der dgon gong ma'i nang bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin pa dang /log spyod can gyi chos lugs gong gras mi sna/ gsar brje'i ngo rgol zing 'khrugs pa/ spyi tshogs ring lugs la mi dga' ba/ mnyam las khang la sngon 'gog byas pa sogs kyi nag nyes la thag bcad nas 'dzin bzung byas pa'i mi 579 yod pa'i nang du pho 571 dang mo 8 yod/ de'i nang btson khang du shi ba'i pho 322dang mo 5yod/ skabs de'i zing 'khrugs la zhugs mkhan dud tshang 248dang mi grangs 1219yod pa'i nang bsad pa'i pho 221 dang mo 47 yod/ de dus 'dzin bzung byed rgyu'i 'gan khur gyi tshad ma 'dang na las byed pa dang hur brtson can yang bzung nas kha gsab byas pa'i gnas tshul yod de/ dper na/ thang rgan zhang gi zhang krang yum skyabs kyis dka' sdug mang po myangs te btson ma ded nas yong ma thag kho rang yang btson ma'i kha grangs gsab ched 'dzin bzung byas pa lta bu red/ /zing 'khrugs la drag gnon byed pa dang mnyam du tshos lugs dgon sde dag la yang bcos bsgyur byed rgyu je mgyogs su btang / gser lag dang /dkar mo phug mkhan slas/ gser de'u bcas dgon khag bzhi'i bla grwa brgyad brgya lhag gi nang bla ma phal cher dang grwa ba drag gras rnams 'dzin bzung byas shing / grwa ba gzhan tshang ma skya sar 'bab tu bcug tsho rteng bzhi'i sbyi ba 'tshog mi chog par byas pa dang lha rten chos gsum dang dngos spyad gzhan rnams med brlag tu btang / /zing 'khrugs la drag gnon byas rjes mi rigs sa khul gyi chab srid dpal 'byor gyi gnas tshul dngos la ma bstun par gom pa bgrod thengs gcig gi4nam mkha'i dbyings su bsnyegs pa'i gnyis snyom gnyis 'then gyi gung khran rlung cher g.yug byas te/ gcig che gnyis spyi'i mi dang spyi khang can du bsgyur pa dang / sbra gur srang lam can dang / bya spyod dmag don can/ bza' btung za khang can du bsgyur ba sogs dpe mi 423

srid pa'i lam srol lag bstar byas pas/ 'brog dmangs kyi 'tsho ba'i rang dbang dang chab srid rang dbang la mthong thos dkon pa'i rdog badzis thebs/'tsho ba'i thad nas rang khyim nas zas phran bu tsam yang bzhag mi chog payosbra'i kha gseb nas dud pa tsam phyi la 'gro bar yang gzab dgos pa red/ tha na sbra phub sa tsam la mtshon na'ang sbra gur srang lam can la ma bstun na khrims la 'jug pa'i nyen kha yod/ chab srid thog nas da lta nga'i pho ba bkres zhes pa tsam yang zer mi phod de/ dper na/ 'brog pa zhig gis da lta rtsam pa dzi rgyu med pas nga'i sen mo ring bor skyes song zhes bshad pa tsam la rkyen byas nas 'thab rtsod byas te gson por brdung nas bsad pa lta bu red/de min chab srid las 'gul gyi btsan drag ma bzod par slob ma bla ma'i gnya' la zhon nas brnyas bcos byas pa dang / bus pha mar brdung ba/ phu nu'i bar phan tshun gleng log byas rte btson la bskyal ba/ bu bu mos pha mar gral rim dbye mtshams gyes pa/ rang gi pha mes nas brgyud pa'i lha rten chos gsum dang gces nor rmongs dad du brtsis nas rdog dzis dang me bsreg chu bsgyur byas pa sogs rgod bro la bsam blomi 'khor ba'i don rkyen mang po byung /de dus g.yon lhung gis ngar blud pa'i 'brog pa skor zhig gzhi rkang byas te gser lag dgon dga' ldan chos 'khor gling dang / dkar mo gsang chen sgrub phug bkra shis chos 'khor gling / mkhan slas dgon dge ldan phun tshogs gling / brag tho mtshams thog yo'u rgya'i gsang sngags dar rgyas spyi ba bcas rmang med du btang / de dag gi lha rten chos gsum las/ gser dadul dang li ma'i sku rnams dngul khang dang bzo khang du bskyal nas brlags/chos gzhung dang / gso rig brda spod/ skar rtsis/ 'byung rtsis/lo rgyus/ sa dpyad/ rta dpyad sogs rig gnas lnga zung gi dpe cha rtsa chen rnams me bsregs chu bsgyur byas nas shog ste gcig kyang ma lhag lo rgyus ring zhing bzo bkod legs pa'i gtsug lag khang che chung dang / mchod khang /42

nang chen/ grwa shag sogs kyi khang mig gcig kyang ma lus par gtor bshig byas/ chos lugs dad mos btsan gyis bkag ste bla grwa drag rim thams cad 'dzin bzung byas/ grwa btsun phal ba lnga brgya lhag skya sar 'bab tu bcugadapal 'byor thad nas/ thon skyed nus shugs kyi chu tshad dngos dang rgyab 'gal byas nas thon skyed gong du 'phel ba'i grangs ka rdzun ma sprad de mchong bskyod chen mo'i dgos mgo dang mthun par byas/ thon skyed 'brel ba'i thad nas rgyu nor sger la dbang ba'i lam lugs kyi ja ma bcad nas phyugs zog yod tshad gzhung la bsdus te phyugs khyu mang po mnyam du bsres/ lam srol de la gcig sdud chen po dang / bsre khyu chen po/ skong 'then chen po zhes pa'i ming ya mtshan can zhig btags/ de ltar lo phyed tsam gyi ring la byugs zog spyi gzhung la bsdus nas bdag ngan du song ba dang / zing 'khrug gi khrod nas bor stor byung ba'i grangs ka 55134la slebs pa des phyugs zog spyi grangs kyi brgya cha'i 26 3zin/ 1957lo'i lo mjug tu dgon gong mar phyugs zog 213216 yod pa de 1958lo'i lo mjug la thon skabs 142635la mar lhung pa dang / 1959lor phyugs zog 34230rgyang gud du song ba de mar chag tshad brgya cha'i 25 4yin/1960lor mu 'thud du 59lo'i rmang gzhi nas brgya 1 4 mar chag ste lo gsum ring gi gyong gud brgyud nas phyugs zogasnye grangs de1952lo'i tshad la mar bab pas phyugs rigs sna tshogs106887las med/ /lo 'di gsum gyi ring phyugs las gtso bo yin pa'i byed phyogs dang rgyab 'gal byas te/ rtswa sa zhing sar bslog pa rgya bskyed byas/ skabs der sems ma 'khyag na sa mi 'khyag ces pa'i rang byung chos nyid dang 'gal ba'i 'bod tshig 'og tu/ mtho tshad mtsho ngos las spyi khru sum stong bdun brgya yas mas yin pa'i rka rgan lung ba dang / nyag dmar kha/ ri rgyal gong zhol 25

sogs sa char sa rgod bslogs nas zhing btab ste/ rmod phyugs mi nyung pa zhig sa rgod bslogs nas shi bar brten/ mis 'jor gyis mi brko thabs med byung / dper na/ yo'u rgya ru khag gsum pa dang dpa' mchog ru khag gsum pas ha zha lung bar 'jor gyis brkos nas zhing sa bzos par da lta'ang gag brkos nyin zhes ming du thogs pa ltar ro/ /de ltar rang byung chos nyid dang 'gal nas sa rgod bslogs te zhing btab pa des/ rang byung skye dngos do mnyam dang byugs zog 'tsho sa'i rtswa sar gtor brlag tshabs chen thebs pas/ mthar thugs zhing phyugs gnyis pham gyi gnas su lhung nas dpal 'byor gyi nyams nyes chen po byung / /1959lo nas1960lo la mgo log khul shing gcod ru khag dang / mtsho lho khul shing gcod ru khag kos nan dmag rta ra ba/ thun te rdzong bzo bsgrun ru khag bcas kyis rma ngos dang 'jang che chung gi gdod ma'i nags tshal du shing li thang 30753 bcad pa dang / sa mu'u chig stong bzhi brgya lnga bcu'i thog gi nags tshal rtsa ba nas brlags pa des 'jang che chung gi nags tshal la lo rgyus thog byung ma myong pa'i gtor brlag tshabs chen thebs/ /gong gsal gyi rgyu rkyen sna tshogs kyi nyer len du/ bstud mar lo gsum gyi ring la rang byung gnod 'tshe byung ste/ mang tshogs kyi 'tsho ba nyin re las nyin rer je sdug tu song / khyad par du 1959lo'i lo smad nas 1960 lo hril bor sngar mthong thos dkon pa'i mu ge ya nga ba byung / du4ra zhig la 'brog pa mi rer zla re'i bza' 'bru spyi rgya lnga las med pas/ gtso bo zhor zas la mi brten ka med byung / skabs der dgon gong ma sa khul gyi zhor zas gtso bo ni/ gyo ma nyung tsam las gzhan mang che ba rtswa sdum gyi rigs te/ram bu dang / ra mnye/ sog ma'i rtswa tshigs/ lo gar gyi gang bu'i skog shun/ sdum bu khur ma/ na g.yu lo'am bong bu'i rna cog (tha ram lo ma )sdum bu 'khor lo/ sdum bu rna'u lo sogs yin la/ skabs der na g.yu lo 26

sdum bu 'khor lo/ /dug mgo nag a 'dra go 'dra/ /dug ma zos ni zhig med de/ /dug ra ma re lcag ma zos/ /de ma gtogs dug zhig ma bzhag/ ces ngag sgros su gleng / phyis su 'tsho bar cung zad legs bcos byung rjes yang na g.yu lo bka' drin can po/ /thog dang po dka' ngal byung dus/ /khyod phan la zas shig nga med/ /khyod ye bden mi bden 'dod na/ /ru bkal ba'i shul du song ste/ /ngas btang btang ba'i rtug par ltos dang / /bden mi bden de nas gsal yong / / zhes dka' sdug 'tsho ba de kha mtshar la drangs nas brjod/ skabs der bkres skom dang mu ges mnar gcod kyis mi rnams kyi lus zungs nyams nas lus po skam zhing rid par gyur ba'i khar/ lus la mi phan pa'i rtswa sdum gyi rigs rgyun du zos pa dang / ngal rtsol lce zhing du che la 'tsho bcud ma 'dang pa sogs kyi rkyen las rlung 'khris bad gan gyi 'du ba 'khrigs pas/ rims nad dang gcong nad/ mchin nad/ rgyu long— sogs 'ju byed ma lag gi nad/ skrangs rigs bcas kyi nad yams yongs su khyab pas mi mang po tshe las 'das/ de'i nang gi la la ngal gso cung tsam byed mus shi ba dang / la la snga se nyal sa'i nang shi 'dug la la nas rlon dang sdum bu sogs pho bar dug nas shi ba sogs kyis mi grangs je nyung du song ba dang skye 'phel gyi nus pa je zhan du gyur/ gnas tshul de da lta lo na so lnga nas so bdun bar gyi skyes pho mo shin tu nyung ba las kyang rtog thub/gsum pa/ lo rab drug bcu bar legs sgrig byas rjes kyi 'phelacus skor/spyi lo 1961lor krung dbyang gi 'phral myur gyi yig cha don tshan bcu gnyis pa dang / nub byang mi rigs bya ba'i gros tshogs kyi dgongs don/mi dmangs spyi khang gi bya ba'i srol yig don tshan drug cu ba bcas lag bstar don 'bab byas pas/ rim bzhin thon skyed 'brel bar legs sgrig byung ba dang / log lam du song ba'i g.yon gyi nor 'khrul yo baspang byas te/ za 437

khang chen po gtor nas rang rang khyim tshang nas bza' btung byed chog par byas pa dang / hre tos kyi sgrig gzhi legs bcos byed pa'i ched du sngar gyi dgon gong ma'i mgo mang dang 'jang chung gnyis spyi khang gnyis su bsgyur/zhib rtsis sde tshan je dma' ru btang nas ru khag chung ba re zhib rtsis sde tshan du byas/ mang tshogs kyis sngar mnyam las khang la bzhag pa'i phyugs zog la bdag dbang cung zad yod par byas te sngar rta bzhag khyim tshang re la gon rta ris dang / mi gnyis bar la bzhon ma gcig mi rer lug gnyis re bcas rang sger la dbang bar byas/ gcig stom gnyis 'then gyi srid jus yo bsrang byas te/ gzhung la blangs pa'i mang tshogs kyi rgyu dngos dang /thon skyed dang 'tsho ba'i rgyu chas rnams la rin gong bcad de skyin 'tshab 'os 'tshams re byin/ der ma zad sngar nga brgyad lo la 'dzin bzung byas pa'i nyes med btson ma dang btson ma lo 'dang skor zhig btson 'grol byas pa sogs la brten nas/ mang tshogs kyi hur brtson rang bzhin la bskul ma chen po thebs te/ phyugs las thon skyed la gong 'phel chen po byung / lo 'dir dgon gong ma'i phyugs zog gi spyi'i rkyang 'phel tshad brgya cha'i 19la slebs pa dang / phyugs rigs sna tshogs kyi spyi grangs 114048las brgal/1962lor gser lag dgon du bstan pa nyams gso dod tsam byung ba dang /chos dad mang tshogs kyis kha ton sgrub spyong re yang byed chog par gyur/ /sngar gyi dgon gong ma mgo mang dang 'jang chung spyi khang gnyis la bkar yod pa de mgo mang dang / thang rgan/ chu dmar/ 'jang chung bcas zhang bzhi la bcad cing / ྅ nag lcags los 'jang chung zhang gi tang u'i byu'u ci khur ba dang / yo'u rgya'i ban de dang dpa' mchog phun tshogs gnyis kyis thang rgan zhang gi zhang krang gtso gzhon gyi 'gan khur/ dpa' mchog dpal chen gyis chu dmar zhang gi zhang krang khur/ o'u rgya'i ri stos1964lor mgo mang zhang u'i hru'u ci gzhon pa khur/ zhang so so'i khongs 428

gtogs su gnas yul ltar ming btags pa'i ru khag chen po ste/ mgo mang zhang la me ru khi dang / wa shur/ na rin/ tho si/ dong bo/ bra shur bcas ru chen drug dang / thang rgan zhang la ha zha dang / gle'u lung / ho tog ba chung / rgyal bo bcas ru chen lnga/ chu dmar zhang la bar tshigs dang / dung dkar/ gser thang / mkhan slas/ chu dmar/ ja la/rta ra bcas ru chen bdun/ 'jang chung zhang la de'u dkar dang / zam pa/yo 'brang / g.yug lung bcas ru chen bzhi ste bsdoms pas ru chen nyer gsum btsugs pa de dag gi 'go 'dren rnams phal cher gong du bshad pa'i mi de dag gis khur/ ru khag re'i khongs gtogs su ru chung re btsugs nas 'go ba re bskos/ skabs der khag theg gsum dang bya dga' gcig gi do dam lam lugs lag len bstar te/ phyugs khyu'i thon tshad khyim tshang la gtan 'khel byas pa dang thon skyed ru khag gis gcig gyur gyis zhib rtsis byas/ /lo gnyis kyi ring la legs sgrig byas pa brgyud/ 1963lor dgon gong ma zhang bzhi'i phyugs zog spyi grangs 137985 la 'phar zhing / rkyang 'phel byung tshad brgya cha'i nyer brgyad yin/ 1963lo nas1967lo'i bar byugs las gong du spel bar shugs bsnan pas/ lo rer rkyang 'phel gyi bsdur tshad brgya cha'i dgu nas bcur 'phar/ dgon gong mar 1960lor byugs rigs sna tshogs 106887 yod pa de 1967 lor 209000 la 'apel zhing / phal cher ldab gcig gis gong du 'phar ba dang / 1gyi57 lo'i spyo grangs kyi tshad la slebs/ /1965lor sngar gyi zhang bzhi mnyam bsres byas te yo 'brang dang g.yug lung mgo mang la gtogs par byas pa'i mgo mang dang / thang rgan dang chu dmar mnyam du bsres pa'i thang rgan zhang / sngar gyi 'jang chung zhang gi ru chen gsum mgar rtse gol ma la bsres nas zhol ma zhang du bsgyur cing / ru 29

khag kha shas mnyam du bsres te sngar gyi ru khag nyer gsum de ru khag bcu dgur bcos pa da lta'i sde ba bcu dgu yod pa 'di dag go /skabs 'gar ru khag de dag la kung hre zhes zer yang ming gi 'gyur tsam las sgrig gzhi 'gyur med/lo rgyus thog dgon gong ma ni phyugs las gtso bor gnyer ba'i sde ba zhig yin pas/ bza' 'bru tshang ma khri ka dang sku 'bum/ gcan tsha/ rab 'og sogs sa thag ring bo'i zhing las sa khul la song nas nyo dgos pa red/lo rabs bzhi bcu ba'i mgo nas bzung dpa' mchog gi dud tshang kha shas kyis 'byu rigs cung tsam re 'debs mgo brtsams te lo re'i 'bru rigs phal cher rang 'dang brgyab/ dper na/ 'ba' lung tu tshul dbang zhing rgan zhes mi ming thogs pa'i sa zhing yod pa des skabs de'i 'brog pas zhing las gnyer ba'i gnas tshul mtshon thub/ 1951lo nas bzung dpa' mchog dang nywa nag nas zhing 'debs pa'i dud tshang rim bzhin je mang du song / 1959 lo nas bzung dgon gong ma sde bzhi tshang mas zhing btab pa dang / 1960 lor rtswa sa cher slog byas te gnod 'tshe tshabs chen zebs pa'i skabs su 'debs rgya mu'u 28764 yod pa dang / 1961 lor legs sgrig byas rjes rang byung cha rkyen dang bstun nas zhing btab pa dang / 1966 lor dgon gong mar zhing sa 'debs rgya mu'u 16678 yod pa des/ phal cher 'bru rigs rang 'dang rgyag thub pa red/ /bzhi ba/ rig gnas gsar brje chen po'i lo bcu'i ring gi gnas tshul/ /gcig spyir btang gi gnas tshul/ /1958lo nas bzung lo gsum ring gi dka' ngal dus skab brgyud rjes/rgyal khab spyi'i chab srid dang dpal 'phyor byed phyogs la 'gyur ldog byung ste/tang gi mi rigs srid jus bzang po don 'bab byed pa'i go skabs ldan/ 30

dpal 'byor thad nas mang tshogs kyi brtson sems bskul nas thon skyed gong du 'apel ba dang / chab srid thad nas 'brog khul gyi gnas tshul dngos dang bsdun pa'i byed phyogs srid jus gtan 'chab4byas shing / mi rigs kyi yul srol goms 'dris dang chos lugs dad mos/ rig gnas slob gso sogs phyogs gang ci'i thad nas srid jus je lhod du btang bas/ 'tsho ba je bzang dang spyi tshogs bde 'jags yin pa'i dus bzang zhig shar yong /yin na'ang1966lor 'byor med gral rim rig gnas gsar brje chen po 7'go brtsams pa nas bzung sngar gyi grub 'bras thams cad chud gzan nas blo bde bag phebs dang zhi dul snying 'jags kyi skal ba bzang po'i tshab la gral rim 'thab rtsod kyi ma nyes khag g.yog bzo ba'i 'gul bskyod cig thon/1966 lor tang krung dbyang gis lnga ba'i bcu drug gi brda tho dang 'byor med gral rim rig gnas gsar brje chen po'i skor gyi chod don 〉zhes pa'i yig cha bkram pa de brgyud bsgrags byas rjes/ dgon gong ma'i nang du zing cha chen po langs pa'i mgo brtsams/ 1961 lo'i lo stod du nang logs kyi gyen ldog pa skor zhig yong ste mang tshogs khrod nas dmar srung dmag rtsa — 'dzugs byed pa dang dus mtshungs su gsar brje ba rnal ma zhig byed na yod tshad la gyen ldog byed phod mkhan zhig yin dgos pa dril bsgrags shing /de'i nyer len du shing skam la me sbar ba bzhin du che bshad dang / che gleng /yig chen gsar 'gyur/ rtsod pa chen po ste chen po bzhi dar spel byed pa'i tsha rlabs shig 'byur ba dang / rnying bzhi tshoste bsam blo rnying pa dang /rig gnas rnying pa/ yul srol rnying pa/ goms gshis rnying ba bcas rtsa ba nas gtor te/ de'i shul du gsar ba bzhi ste bsam blo gsar ba dang /rig gnas gsar ba/ yul srol gsar ba/ goms gshis gsar ba bcas 'dzugs pa/ lha 'dre gdon bgegs yod tshad gtsang phyags byed pa/ tang nang gi ma rtsa ring lugs kyi lam du 'gro mkhan dbang 'dzin pa pham par gtong 431

ba sogs kyi las 'gul rtswa thang la me shor ba bzhin du spel/ rnying ba bzhi'i ngos 'dzin tshul la bsam blo rnying ba ni mi rigs kyi thun mong min pa'i 'jig rten lta tshul las byung pa'i bsam blo thams cad de/ dper na/ sdug spong dge sgrub dang / pha ma dang rgan rabs la bkur ba/ 'gro ba sems can thams cad la nye ring chags sdang gnyis dang bral ba'i btang snyoms la gnas pa sogs mchog tu 'dzin pa'i srol rgyun bsam blo de'i rigs ni dug rtswa lta bu zhig yin pas ring du 'dor dgos pa dang / gral rim 'thab rtsod kyi don du tshad med lnga'i las bsags dgos kyang ci mi snyam pa/ gsar brje'i las don gyi ched du dmyal ba bco brgyad nas skye dgos kyang 'dzigs skrag med pa zhig la ngos 'dzin/ gral rim dgra bo de med sa'i sa med pas gzhan lta zhog khyim gcig gi mi la'ang yid rton chog pa'i nges pa med pa'i 'du shes 'dzin stangs kyis pha bu'i bar dang / khyo shug bar/ phu nu'i bar/ nye du'i bar/grogs po'i bar lta bu'i snag gi gnyen tshan nang du'ang gu re zhig rtse ba yan chad du kha nas dus dang mi 'tshams pa'i gtam 'chor bar gzab dgos pa red/ rig gnas rnying pa la chos lugs dang 'azel ba'i rig gnas ni de'i khongs su 'du ba bshad ma dgos la/ de min sum rtags dag gsum dang /bzo dang gso rig sgra snyan ngag rtsis sa ris/ sa gnas lo rgyus sogs tshang ma dug rtswa yin la/ tha na dmangs khrod kyi glu la gzhas/ sa bshad ston bshad/ kha mtshar rtse rigs/ sgrung dang gnas bshad sogs kyang log spyod rig gnas su brtsis nas khyim phyags nang du ded/ skabs der ches dgod bro ba zhig ni ma'o kru'u zhi'i sku par bshams pa'i mdun du snga mo gsung btus dang rgyun sbyong rtsom yig gsum bton rjes nyin gcig gi bya spyod dang bsam blo'i 'khyer so'i dam bca' ba dang / phyi dror dam bcas pa de don thog tu 'khyol yod med dang bsam tshul bzang ngan gzhan ci zhig shar ba zhu 'bul byed pa'i lam srol zhig dar de/ rmongs dad rnying ba dor bar khas 'che 3ཿ

na'ang don dam du gtso 'dzin lha ltar bkur ba'i rmongs dad gsar ba zhig gis mi rnams kyi bsam blor yang bskyar dbang bsgyur/ sngon chad kyi bla ma'i zhabs brtan lta bu'i cho ga la nyin rgyun mi mang 'tshogs rte nga tsho'i sems gting gi nyi ma dmar po ma'o kru'u zhi mchog gi sku khams bde ba dang yang nas yang du bde bar sgon/ khong gi mdza' gcugs 'thab grogs lin thu kru'u zhi'i sku khams bde ba dang yang nas yang du bde bar smon zhes pa zhig gi rgyun 'don yod pa dang / gtso 'dzin la bsam tshul zhu skabs ma'o thu'u zhi lags/ ma'o thu'u zhi lags/ de ring nga ma thar gyi bzang po yang ma red/ngan pa yang ma red/ bar ma bar zhig red/ rjes nas khyed kyi bka' brtsis nas shi res byed rgyu yin zhes pa'i btang snyom gyi tshig zhig bshad pa red/ de bas kyang ya mtshan pa ni las 'gul la bstun pa'i dmangs glu gsar ba dag yin de/ dper na/ ma'o kru'u zhi dgung gi nyi ma red/ /'di shar nas yong na nyin srib med/ /mā pu h+phang rtswa mgo'i zil ba red/ /dgung nyi rtse shar dus shul na med/ / lta bu dang / sman khyod ni dmar bsrung dmag mi byos/ /pho nga ni 'byor med gral rim byed/ /zhe snang ba gral rim 'thab rtsod byed/ /sman khyod la dpa' sems yod pa na/ /pho nga yi blo rtsal lhod med yin zhes pa sogs lta bu ded/ yul srol goms gshis kyi thad nas phal cher sngon chad kyi lam srol yod tshad de'i khongs su ma 'dus ba med de/ dper na/ gnyen ston dang nol ston/ sbra ston lta bu'i skabs su gtso 'dzin gyi 'dra sku la gus phyag dang bstod glu len dgos shing / rten 'brel gyi thog mar ches mtho ba'i mdzub ston 'don pa/ nye rtags dang mtshams rtags sogs la ma'o kru'u zhi'i gsung rtsom ster ba/ mi 'das na dge rtsa mi sgrub pa dang / tha na sngar gyi ru chen gyi ming tho si dang na rin me ru khi sogs kyi ming yang lnga bdun (ma'o kru'u zhis lnga ba'i tshes bdun nyin gsung bshad gal chen zhig gnang ba'i rten 'brel la dpyad nas btags) 33

rgyal kha/ dar dmar sogs su bsgyur/ de min skabs der skyes pa'i byis pa la gsar brje rgyal dang / gsar mo skyid/ hong bas (0za) ki min ( 3) yun hong (r+sāb)skyid sogs su btags par ma zad/ sngar gyi chos skyong dang bstan 'dzin bla ma lta bu'i chos lugs tha snyad kyi ming yang bsgyur dgos par bshad/ der ma zad da dung g.yu byur dang / sum/ gser dngul sogs rgyan cha'i rigs dang / 'brug dkar/ zangs dem/ bum pa sogs 'tsho ba'i nyer spyad kyi rigs/ de min gos phrug rtsa chen gyi rigs dang khyad par tu thog na 'brug tshang nyal dang bkra shis rtags brgyad/g.yung drung / pa ṭa/ chu srin/ khyung chen/ hor yig sogs yod pa'i spyon gos dang rgyan cha nyer spyad thams thad rnying ba bzhir brtsis nas 'dor bya'i gras su bzhag sde ba la la nas da dung sngon thon pa byed pa'i don du bud med tsho'i sgra'i lan bu yang cha byad rnying par brtsis nas thung ngur bcad pa dang / rab yin na skyes pa bud med thams cad kyis rgya wa gon dgos par bshad/ de lta bu'i rnying bzhi gtor ba dang gsar bzhi 'dzugs pa/ lha 'dre gdon bgegs gtsang phyags byed pa/ che che drag drag thams cad la gyen ldog byed pa'i las 'gul gyis ngar blud pa la brten nas/ ma gzhir mi gshis drangs shing rgyud 'jam pa/ phyi thag ring zhing khrel yod pa/ mi la byams shing gtong phod mnga' ba'i 'brog pa rnams dus yun thung ngu'i nang ngo bo gzhan du 'gyur te/ gdug tsub che zhing snying rje med pa dang / bdag 'dzin che zhing gzhan la sdang ba/ 'ud la dga' zhing khrel gzhung med pa'i ngo gdong cha med cig tu gyur/ las 'gul gyi sngon la sa 'dir phyugs las mnyam las khang thog mar 'dzugs mkhan/ rgyal yongs kyi ngal rtsol dpe legs can/ thang rgan zhang mi dmangs srid gzhung gi zhang krang lha byams dang / gzhan dgon gong ma'i zhang so so'i srid gzhung gi 'go khrid las byed pa phal che bar tang nang gi ma rtsa ring lugs kyi lam du 'gro mkhan dbang 43

'dzin pa/ bzo bcos ring lugs pa bcas kyi nyes ming btags nas dgag rgyag byas pa dang / de nas rim bzhin du ru chen dang thon skyed ru khag gi 'go khrid pa la'ang nyes ming sna tshogs g.yog nas 'thab rtsod byas/'thabartsod dang dgag rgyag byas kyin dgra bo je mang du gyur/ lhag par tu mgo mang gi rtsam pa'i ril bu'i don rkyen zhes pa byung rjes rdung deg byed yul ldab 'gyur gyis je mang du song / don rkyen de'i thag rjes 'brang thor tu song ba'i mi ma mtha' yang lnga brgya nas drug brgya yod cing / de'i nang gi ril bu bkram mkhan kha shas la log spyod pa'i zhwa mo bskon zhing mang che bar rang dbang med par byas/ skabs de'i 'thab rtsod kyi rnam pa mthong na ya nga zhing skyi g.ya' ba zhig yin te/ 'thab rtsod byed yul gyi lag pa rgyab nas gnya' la 'gug pa dang / khu tshur rdo tho med par gzhu ba/ thag pas bkyigs pa/ gnya' shing sprod pa/ mgo la rdo 'jog pa/ mer bsro ba/gnyid 'gog pa sogs gang dran dran byed/ de min da dung mgo la zhwa ring skon pa dang / ske la mchod cha 'dogs pa/ tha na mi mang khrod nas gcer bur phud nas brnyas bcos byas pa'ang yod/ /1968lo'i lugs gsar gyi gnyis pa'i tshes nyer gsum nyin zi ling du2 23don rkyen zer ba byung rjes/ thun te rdzong mi dmangs drag chas pu'u yis tshes nyer lnga'i nyin rdzongs yongs su yod pa'i 8 18dmar srung 'thab 'dzing ru khag dang / 8 18dmar srung dmag gnyis med par bzo rgyu khyab bsgrags byas pa dang / zla gsum pa'i tshes mgor dgon gong mar yod pa'i rtsa 'dzugs de gnyis kyi 'go ba mi ba'i 'dzin bzung byas/ don rkyen de la brten nas sde ba yongs su zing cha chen po langs/ zla gsum pa'i tshes nyer bzhi nyin krung dbyang gis mtsho sngon gyi 2 23don rkyen la dkar 'don byas rjes/ gong gi rtsa 'dzugs de gnyis slar gsos shing btson du bcug pa'i mi rnams klod 'grol btang / de nas yang dar dmar 'thab 'dzing ru khag 430

zer ba'i rtsa 'dzugs te rtsa gtor byas/ /1968lo'i zla drug par mgo mang dang thang rgan gyi dmar srung dmag rtsa 'dzugs kyi 'go bas zhing chen nas rka rgan chu ho re thang la 'dren pa'i chog mchan blangs rte sa rko rdo slog chen po byas/ chu rka de'i ming la thog mar dkar gsum (ma'o kru'u zhi la blo dkar ba dang gung khran tang la blo dkar ba gsar brjer blo dkar ba)chu rka btags shing / phyis su rgyal kha'i chu rkade nas mi bami tshogs khag rdul du brlag rjes mdzes sdug thang gi chu rka (zatsha tshoza)zhes par ming bsgyur/ chu rka der rgyal khab dang thun mong mi sger bcas kyis mi shugs dang dngos shugs 'bor chen btang na'ang dpal 'byor gyi phan 'bras shin tu chung / /chu rka rko bzhin pa'i sgang la nang logs kyi dmar srung dmag skor zhig yong nas drag 'thab kyi me lce bsgron/ las byed pa dang mang tshogs mi nyung pa zhig gi lus phung la gnod 'tshe tshabs chen bzos/ rigs bzhi'i zhwa gon mi bcu lhag gi rkang lag zha bor btang / ma'o kru'u zhi'i 'dra par mdun nas snyan sgron zhu ba dang / mgron por ja 'drin skabs dang lam du mi la 'phrad skabs gsung btus tshar re 'don pa'am phan tshun 'dri bshad byed pa'i srol btsugs/ srol te lag bstar byed skabs dgod bro ba'i bshad rgyun mang po zhig byung yod de/ dper na/ dmar srung dmag gi 'go ba zhig gis bud med cig la lugs gnyis (spyi tshogs ring lugs dang ma rtsa ring lugs)gang red ces 'dri tshig dris pa'i lan du/ bod lug dang la ha lug gnyis red ces lan btab pa lta bu red/ /1969lor gral rim dpung sde gtsang bsher gyi las 'gul bslangs nas/ 'byor ba'i gral rim yang bskyar bkar te mi skor zhig la phyug po'am byugs bdag gral rim gyi zhwa mo bskon nas 'dam bya 'dems byed kyi dbang cha 'phrog pa dang / btsan shed kyis ngal rtsol bsgyur bkod byed du bcug/ 36

1970lor nas 1971 lo'i bar la gcig rdung gsum rgol (gsar brjer ngo rgol mkhan la rdung deg dang / ham zos brkus 'phrog la ngo rgol/skabs 'tshol tshong log la ngo rgol/ rgyas spras chud zos la ngo rgol )gyi las 'gul 'ur 'ur chem chem gyis bslangs shing / gral rim 'thab rtsod med par sru ba dang / gzhung sger mnyam bsres spu ba/ rang gsum 'gan gcig (rang mos tshong ra gong 'phel du gtong pa dang / rang bzhag sa zhing rgya bskyed du gtong ba/ khe gyong rang 'khur/ thon tshad khyim tshang du gtan 'khel byed pa )dang rang dbang chen po bzhi (sa zhing nyo tshong rang dbang dang /yid brtan dngul bun gtong rgyu rang dbang / gla ba gla rgyu rang dbang /bdag gnyer byed rgyu rang dbang ) bcas ni dgag yul gtso bor gyur/skabs der zhing chen dang khul gyi gyen ldog pa thun te rdzong la yong ste/ khul gsar brje'i u yon lhan khang bya ba'i tshan chung gi ming thog nas ma nyes khag g.yog can dang nor 'khrul can gyi gyod gzhi rdzun ma mi nyung pa zhig bzos te/ya nga ba'i 'thab rtsod dang snying rje med pa'i rdung rdeg byas shing / mi mang po zhig la nyes ming sna tshogs btags nas nyin mo ngal rtsol dang mtshan mor 'thab rtsod kyi sdug bsngal myong dgos pa dang / lto ba dang gnyid 'gog pa la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal bzod glags med pa'i gnas su bskyal/ 'ga' res de 'dra'i 'thab rtsod kyi khrod du 'u thug nas rang srog bcad/ /1976lor rtsa ba'i lam phyogs gnad du 'dzin pa'i lam phyogs slob gso'i las 'gul spel/ zhing grong gi ma rtsa ring lugs kyi spyo ham tshur rgol zer ba zhig la drag rgol byas/ mang tshogs kha shas shig la nyes 'gel thebs/'ga' res dngangs skrag skyes nas rang srog bcad/ las byed pa dang mang tshogs kyi bsam blor rnyog dra chen po bzos/ ta kre dang zhi dbyang gi nyams myong zer bar bslabs/ ri ngos su skas zhing bzos te ta kre'i zhing du btags/ / 37

1976 lo'i lo smad du tang krung dbyang gis mi bzhi tshogs khag rtsa gtor btang bas/ lo rgyus thog mthong thos dkon pa'i mi'i rigs kyi god chag chen po de da gzod mjug sgril/ /gnyes/ rig gnas gsar brje chenapha'i gtor brlag thebs rtsol/ rig gnas gsar brje chen po ni rgyal yongs kyi rang bzhin ldan pa'i chab srid kyi god chag chen po zhig yin pas/ des rgyal khab spyi'i chab srid dang / dpal 'byor/ tshan rig slob gso/ rig gnas sogs phyogs thams cad la gyong gud thebs su bcug pa ni dpag par dka' ba zhig red/ dgon gong ma yang rgyal yongs kyi gnas tshul dang 'dra bar phyogs thams cad la bar chad tshabs chen thebs/ thog mar chab srid thad nas g.yon thal che ba'i lam phyogs kyi shugs rkyen 'og mi rigs rang gi srol rgyun gyi bsam blo bzang po dang / rig gnas bzang po/ yul srol goms gshis bzang po'i rigs thams cad la log par bltas nas dor ba dang / gral rim 'thab rtsod kyi bsam blos las byed pa dang mang tshogs mang po dgra phyogs la ded nas rdung deg byed yul rgya che ru btang bas/ mi rigs nang khul gyi mthun sgril dang spyi tshogs bde 'jags la gnod pa tshabs chen bzos /dpal 'byor thad nas thon skyed kho na sru ba dang / ma rtsa ring lugs kyi salas spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi ljang myug bzang pa'i bsam blo'i lam ston 'og nyin rgyun dgag rgyag dang 'thab rtsod/ yig chen gsar 'gyur/ che rtsod che gleng sogs la g.yeng nas zhing phyugs las thon skyed la bdag ngan dang 'thus shor mang po byung bas/ lo bcu'i ring phal cher dpal 'byor la gong 'phel med par gyur/ de'i thog la rang byung gnas tshul dang mi mthun pa'i dkar gsum chu rka brkos te rgyu 'byor ba dang mi shugs dngos shugs mang po de la bstem pas/ mgo mang dang thang rgan gnyis da lta la thug gi bar dbul phongs las thar mi thub pa'i 'jug 'bras 38

ngan pa 'di 'dra byung / /slob grwa'i slob gso'i thad la yang gnod skyon chen po byung ba ste/ slob chung gi slob ma'i khrod du dmar chung dmag gi rtsa 'dzugs btsugs shing /dge slob rnams kyis rgyun ldan gyi slob khrid bya ba dor te/ 'thab dgag bcos gsum gyi las 'gul du zhugs dgos par ma zad/ ma'o tse tung dgongs pa'i dril bsgrags ru khag zer ba btsugs nas gang sa gar dril bsgrags kyi bya bar brel ba dang / skabs 'gar rang gi sa gnas las brgal te rdzong khag ga'an pa dang yang na khul gzhan par dril bsgrags byed du song nas slob khrid la dal 'gor byas/ 1969lor gzhung sgrub slob grwa mar gtong byas te thon skyed ru khag tu btsugs pa dang / phyugs dbul phyugs 'bring 'og mas slob grwar do dam byed pa'i slob sgrub lam lugs spel te/sngar yod kyi nyin hril lugs kyi slob chung rnams gtor nas 'tsho byed slob phyed du bsgyur cing / ma'o kru'u zhi'i gsung rtsom las bslab deb gzhan med pas/slob khrid kyi rgyu spus je zhan du gyur ba dang / yig rmongs kyi tshad je mthor song /yul srol goms gshis kyi cha nas rgyun ldan gyi chos lugs bya 'gul te shi bo'i dge rtsa dang gson po'i tshe sgrub sogs dang / mchod bshams byed pa/tshos 'khor skor ba/ bzlas 'don byed pa/ sgyung gnas bsrung ba/'bum khang sdug pa/ dar spyog 'then pa/ lha bsang gtong ba/ la tse bstod pa/ mchod kha 'phen pa/ sa rko rdo slog la 'dzems pa sogs thams cad goms srol rnying bar brtsis nas gtan 'gog byas pa dang / nga brgyad lor chos lugs bsgyur bkod byas shul na dmangs khrod du da dung chos dang rig gnas skor kyi dpe cha dang / thang ga lha sku/ mchod chas/ sku gdung mchod rten gyi gzungs gzhugs rtsa chen mi nyung yod pa de dag phal cher gcig kyang ma lhag par gtor brlag byas pas nam yang gsab thabs med 39

pa'i gyong gud brgyugs/ de min rgyud 'dzin dang dar spel byed 'os pa'i sde srol dang / dmangs srol/ yul srol sogs la'ang dgag rgyag byas pasargan pa bkur ba dang / gzhon par gces pa/ sde don bsam pa/ nang mthun gros 'grig yong ba sogs kyi srol bzang med par gyur nas mi gshis gyong bo dang ngan par 'gyur bas da lta la thug gi bar shugs rkyen ngan pa gnas mus yin/ de las gzhan sa khul gyi thun mong ma yin pa'i spyon chas dang / rgyan cha/ dus ston rol lugs/ rten 'brel dpyad lugs sogs kyang lha 'dre gdon bgegs kyi srol la sbyar nas ngo rgol byas pas/ da lta'i rjes rabs gzhon nu tshos rang mi rigs kyi goms srol dang 'gro stangs ji 'dra zhig yin pa'ang mi shes par gyur/ /mdor na rig gnas gsar brje chen pos dngos bo'i 'bras bur gtor brlag byas pa las kyang tshabs che ba ni mi rnams kyi rgyud la bzhag bzhag pa'i ngan gshis yin te/ mi gshis spyong zhing sems rgyud ngan pa ni rgud pa thams cad kyi 'byung gzhi yin pa lo rgyus las ra sprod byas yod/ dper na/ rig gnas gsar brje chen po dang nga brgyad lo'i gyong gud gang yin kyang gong gi g.yon thal che ba'i srid jus la rag las pa yin mod/ 'on kyang /nga tsho rang thog gi rgyu rkyen cung zad kyang med pa ma yin te/ gzhan pas bskul ba tsam gyis ngar langs sla ba dang / blun po chu sna gar khrid dang /rgyob zer na a pha'i mgo dang rgyugs zer na dmyal ba'i 'phreng gi brtag dpyad med pa'i rnam thar kho na bskyangs te/ rang gi pha mes yang mes nas rgyu 'byor ba phangs med btang nas bzhengs ba'i dgon pa bshig mkhan dang / srol rgyun rig gnas dang goms srol la ldog dzis gtong mkhan/ nye du dang grogs po dgra phyogs la bcad nas gcar rdung ya nga ba byed mkhan gtso bo nga tsho rang yin/ gal srid nga tsho rang nyid de 'dra rmongs pa'i tshad la glebs med na gtor brlag gi tshad kyang de 'dra che mi srid/ skabs der nga tsho 'brog khul 0

du 'grim 'thul stabs mi bde ba dang phyi phyogs la 'brel 'dris nyung ba rig gnas slob gso rjes lus yin pa/ lta rgya dang mthong rgya chung ba bcas kyis lan pa'i dbang du ba'ag chog kyang / da lta dus rabs nyer gcig pa'i skabs la thon pa'i dus 'dir/ da dung sa khug chung ba nas bsam blo rmongs shing bag khum nas 'dug mi rung ste/ sngar gyi nyams myong dang bslab byar spyi sdom bzang po zhig byas nas/ sngon thon mi rigs kyi phyogs su 'gro rgyu ni gal shin tu che'o/ /lnga ba/ bcos bsgrur sgo 'byed byas tshun rgya gnas tshul/1976 lor tang grung dbyang gis gami bzhi'i tshogs khag rdul du brlag ste rig gnas brje chen po mjug bsgril ba khyab bsgrags byas rjes/ rgyal khab yongs kyi las rigs so so nas rnyog zing drang bcos byas te nyams pa slar gso dang spyi tshogs ring lugs 'dzugs sgun byed pa'i mtho rlabs shig langs mgo brtsams/ rang re'i dgon gong ma la'ang srid jus bzang po'i nyi gzhon 'phros te/ mi rigs kyi srid jus dang / dpal 'byor/ rig gnas/ chos lugs/ yul srol goms gshis sogs la phyogs yongs nas slar gso thob ste/ rdzogs lda na gyi skal ba bzang po nye bar thon/ /1978lor tang gi skabs bcu gcig pa'i krung yu tshang 'dzoms gros tshogs zengs gsum pa 'tshogs rjes gom gang mdun spos sgos 5rig gnas gsar brje chen po'i nor 'khrul yo bgrang byas pa dang / srid jus rab dang rim pa don 'bab byed mgo tshugs/ /gcig snyog bsrang drang bcos dang gyod gzhi rdzun mar dkar 'don byas pa/thog mar log spyod phyugs bdag dang / bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin pa/chos lugs gong rim mi sna/ gsar brje'i ngo rgol ba/ skabs 'tshol tshong log rgyag mkhan sogs gyi zhwa mo bskon yod pa'i zhwa mo phud de dkar 'don byas/ 41

de min sngon chad nga brgyad lo'i zing 'khrug ni dmigs yul yod pa dang rtsa 'dzugs yod pa'i gsar brje'i ngo rgol gyi drag po'i zing 'khrug cig yin par thag bcad yod kyang / thengs 'dir mi nyubashas kyis ngan bskul byas te mi mang po g.yo 'og tu tshud pa'i zing 'khrug tu thag bcad pa dang / der drag gnon byed pa'i thad nas kyang rgya bskyed thal drag pa dang gyod gzhi rdzun ma mang po bzos pa srid gzhung gis khas blangs/ der brten nga brgyad lor 'dzin bzung byas nas shi ba dang da lta gson por yod pa'i chos lugs gong rim mi sna la rgya bza' blo bzang thub bstan phun tshogs rgya mtsho dang / gtsang rganazla bzang ngag dbang 'phrin las rgya mtsho/ phur tsha blo bzang 'phrin las rgya mtsho/a rig 'jam dbyangs bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan/ yo'u rgya blo bzang lung —rtogs ngo na tan rgya mtsho/ gtsang chung 'jam dbyangs bshad sgrub dam chos rgya mtsho/ smad sog 'jam dbyangs legs bshad rgya mtsho/ hor gdong blo bzang 'phrin las rgya mtsho/ dzogs chen thub bstan chos kyi nyi ma/ mgo dge pad+ma ma dbang chen/ a lags rdzong sngon sogs dang / tsho dpon sde dpon gyi skor la ྅ nag chos 'byor dang / yo'u rgya'i bsang kho/ skal skyabs/ yu rdo/ dpa' mchog 'bum pa/ blo bstan/ g.yer skyong khyo kho sogs kyis gtsos pa'i bla dpon dag dang btson 'jug byas pa'i mang tshogs phal ba yod tshad la dkar 'don byas pa dang 'dzin bzung byas nas shi ba dag gi khyim mi la sgor brgya dang ja gnyis kyis gnang sbyin byas/ der ma zad 'bum pa dang / blo bstan/ khro kho/ dbyig gnyen/ dbang 'bum/yum skyabs sogs sngon chad rdzong las khungs dang / chu'i srid gzhung /zhang srid gzhung du 'go khrid kyi las 'gan 'khur mkhan rnams kyi go gnas dang mtshan snyan slar gso byas/ de'i nang gi kha shas lo na mtho ba dang lus phung yang de 'dra mi bzang ba'i dbang gis las 'khyur ngal gso byas pa las gzhan 'bum pas khul srid gros kyi thu'u zhi gzhon pa khur pa dang / blo bstan 42

gyis gser thang phyugs ra'i gtso 'gan khur/ dbyig gnyen dang dbang 'bum la'ang bya ba 'os 'tshams bkod sgrig byas/ hor gdong blo bzang 'phrin lam rgya mtsho dang / mgo dge pad+ma dbang chen/ a lags 'thab bral/ gser lag a khu thogs med/ nya nag bstan pa/ dpa' mchog 'jam kho sogs rdzong srid gros kyi u yon la 'dems pa dang / a lags mtha' bral gyis snga gzhug tu dzong srid gros kyi kru'u zhi gzhon pa dang / rdzong dmangs chen gyi kru'u rin gagon pa'i 'gan khur ba dang / a khu thogs med kyis dzong srid gros kyi gru'u zhi gagon pa'i 'gan khur te/ dzong yongs kyi gal 'gangs che ba'i bya ba sna tshogs kyi gros bsdur tshogs 'dur zhugs nas srid zhugs gros 'don gyi nus pa 'don bzhin pa'i skabs so/ /gnyis/ tang gi chos lugs sridajus don 'khyol byas pa/ mi bzhi tshogs khag rdul du brlags rjes tang si chos lugs srid jus yang rim bzhin dngos 'bab byung zhing / 1980lo nas bzung dgon sde so so'i chos sgo 'byed pa'i dbu brtsams/ 1981lor dgon gong ma dang /sha sbrang / mgar rtse sogs kyi dad ldan ser skya mang tshogs kyis re 'dun zhus ngor gser lag dgon dge ldan phun tshogs bstan rgyas gling gi chos sgo phye ba'i chog mchan thob/ 1983lo nas bzung dkar mo gsang chen sgrub phug bkra shis chos 'khor gling dang / bde chen dgon bshad sgrub dar rgyas gling /mkhan slas dgon dga' ldan phun tshogs gling / gser rdo'u dgon bkra shis chos 'khor gling bcas kyi chos sgo phyes shing / lcang skya rin po che 'jam dbyangs dar rgyas dang / bshes gnyen 'jam dbyangs 'od zer rgya mtsho/bde chen lho brag 'thab bral thub bstan nyi ma bcas kyis gtso 'gan bzhes te lugs gnyis kyis bskyangs/ 1991lor mkhan slas dgon gyi dge bshes rin po che byams pa chos grub kyi gzims khang shul du sku khang chen mo zhig bzhengs/ gser rde'u dgon pas snga gzhug tu 'du khang dang / btsan 43

khang / sgrol ma'i lha khang sogs nang rten dang bcas pa bzhengs nas grub/ /chos sde so sos chos sgo phyes pa dang lhan du tsho ba so so'i spyi ba'i chos srol yang slar gso'i dbu tshugs/ 1981lor 'thab bral thub bstan nyi ma dang /mgo dge pad+ma dbang chen/ a khu 'jigs med blo gros bcas kyis dbu mdzad nas yo'u rgya'i spyi ba'i chos thog slar gsos pa dang / de nas rim bzhin dpa' mchog dang / nywa nag g.yer skyong bcas kyi spyi ba yang slar btsugs/ chos spyod phyag len sogs sngon bzhin mdzad/ khyad par du1991 lor rka rgan bye gar tu dgon gong mas spyi bsrung mnyam du btsugs te/smad sog rin po che dang / gtsang ba'i sprul sku/ a lags 'thab bral/a lags mgo dge ya khu 'jigs med blo gros sogs kyis gtso 'gan bzhes te dgon sde'i dge 'dun pa dang / tsho chen bzhi'i ban sngags zhal grangs brgya tsho gsum la nye ba lhan du 'dzoms nas chos spyod kyi 'khor lo rgya cher bskor te/ sngon rab byung bcu drug pa'i shing khyi ( 1934)lo nas bzung lo ngo nga bdun ring rgyun chad pa'i spyi bsrung mnyam 'dzugs kyi rgyun slar mthud/ dgra lha dpung bstod byed pa'i lugs srol yang rim bzhin slar gsos te/ snga gzhug tu rgyal bo ko chen dang / btsan skyes/ brag dmar/ri rgyal/ lha ri zhal dkar/ 'brug lung/ btsan/ rgod phrug lha rdzong sogs kyi lab tse rnams bskyar tu bstad cing dar spyog 'then nas rab gnas mdzad/ /1990lor dpa' mchog blo bstan dang / 'bum pa/ o'u rgya'i ri sto/nywa nag dbyig gnyen bcas kyis gtso 'gan bzhes te dgon gong ma'i skya mi brgya tsho drug lhag gle khog tu song ste/ gle 'phyor rgyal po'i lab tse bstad cing /dgra lha dpung bstod gsol mchod rgya chen po byas/ /gsum/ mirigasakyi rig gnas slob gso dang 'azod sten babyur dar byung ba/ 44

1977 lo nas bzung sngar gyi stabs bde'i slob chung gi rmang gzhi'i thog mgo mang dang / thang rgan/ 'jang chung bcas bca' sdod slob chung gsum btsugs shing / 1996lo'i bar tu lo rim lnga ba'i slob ma 393 mthar phyin pa dang / khul mi rigs dge thon slob grwa dang rdzong mi rigs slob 'bring la slob ma 215 bskyal/ lo bcu lhag gi ring la slob grwa 'di dag gis slob gso u yon lhan khang dang rgya che'i mang tshogs kyi rgyab skyor 'og dge slob rnams kyis mnyam du 'bad brtson byas pa brgyud nas 'bras bu legs po thob par/gong rim 'brel yod las khungs kyis gzengs bstod dang bya dga' gnang /khyad par tu thang rgan bca' sdod slob grwa de lo mang po'i ring khul dang rdzong gi sngon thon slob grwa'i gras su 'dems pa dang da lta mtsho sngon zhing chen gyi slob grwa gtso bo'i gras su'ang tshud yod/ da lta dgon gong ma yongs la bca' sdod slob grwa gsum dang / gcig bsdus slob khrid sa tshugs gsum/ sbra gur slob chung so lnga yod cing / slob grwar yod pa'i slob ma chig stong lhag yod/dge rgan 75 yod pa de'i nang gzhung sgrub dge rgan 49 yod pa dang / mtho 'bring dang mtho 'bring yan gyi chu tshad can 9 yod la/ rig gnas gsar brje chen po mjug bsdus pa nas da lta bar dmangs sgrub dge rgan16 gzhung sgrub tu bsgyur/ /1986lo nas yig rmongs sel ba'i bya ba dar spel byas te/ sde ba yongs su rmongs sel 'dzin grwa 21 btsugs shing / snga gzhug tu na gzhon dang dar ma mi sum brgya lhag gi yig rmongs sel/ 1996tshor dgon gong ma yongs la slob gso'i bya ba byed mkhan mi 85yod la/ de'i nang slob grwa chen mo'i cang hri 2dang / slob 'bring gi rim pa dang po'i dge rgan 2 dang /rim pa gnyis pa'i dge rgan rim pa gsum pa'i dge rgan 8yod pa dang /slob chung gi mtho rim dge rgan 2 dang / rim pa gnyis pa'i dge rgan 21yod/ slob grwa chen mo'i zhib 'jug slob ma'i mthar phyin 'dzin yig yod pa 40

2dang / ched las slob chen pa 5 mtho 'bring ba 12dma' 'bring ba — 66bcas yod/ de'i nang du zhing chen rim pa'i bya dga' thob mkhan gcig dang / khul rim pa'i bya dga' thob mkhan lnga dzong rim pa'i bya dga' thob mkhan nyer lnga bcas yod/ /de min 'phrod sten gyi phyogs nas kyang sngar dang bsdur na 'phel rgyas nges can byung yod de/ da lta 'phrod sten khang dang 'phrod sten sa tshugs drug yod la/ sman pa bzhi bcu yod pa'i nang gzhung sgrub sman pa bcu gsum dang /bod sman snyer bdun pod/bzhi/ thon skyed khyem tshang la 'gan gtsang len byed du babyug nas mang chogs kyi 'tsho bar legs bcos byung ba/tang gi krung u tshang 'dzoms gros tshogs zengs gsum pa nas bzung /rgyal khab kyi bya ba'i gnad sa de dpal 'byor 'dzugs sgrun gyi steng du 'khor zhing / bcos bsgyur sgo 'byed kyi byed phyogs de khyon yongs nas lag bstar byas par brten/ spyi tshogs ring lugs dpal 'byor gyi rnam par 'gyur ldog ha cang chen po byung zhing / rang cag 'brog khul du'ang tang gi lam phyogs dang byed phyogs/ srid jus rnams nan tan sgos dngos 'bab byas te/ sngon gyi thon skyed lam lugs rnying bar bsgyur bcos byas thog phyugs zog la rin gong bcad nas khyim tshang la 'gan gtsang len byed du bcug pa dang / zhing phyugs mnyam gnyer gyi rmang gzhi'i thog sna mang bdag gnyer dang / phyogs yongs nas 'phel rgyas gtong ba'i lam lugs yongs su —btsugs shing / 'brog pa mang tshogs kyi hur brtson rang bzhin skul spel gang legs byas pa dang chabs cig khyim tshang kher rkyang gis bdag gnyer byed dka' ba'i thon skyed sgrig bkod dang rnam grangs gcig gyur gyis bdag gnyer byed pa dang / 'brog las ched las can dang / spyi tshogs can/gzhi khyon 'os 'tshams kyis bdag gnyer byed pa bcas kyi byed phyogs gom 6

gang mdun spyos sgos 'thus tshang dang sra brtan du btang ste/ 'gan dbang khe gsum phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa'i spyi'i kha phyogs lag len byas par brten/ dpal 'byor sgrig gzhi bsgyur bcos ma byas pa'i yar sngon dang bsdur na phyogs gang ci'i thad nas 'phel rgyas nges can byung yod/ /yin na yang / mi grangs 'phel tshad mgyogs pa dang rtswa sa'i gnad don tshabs je cher so nga ba sogs kyi dbang gis dgon gong ma da dung sde ba dbul bo'i gras su yod/ mgo mang dang thang rgan gnyis khul rim pa'i dbul sde'i gras su bzhag cing / lo 'ga'i ring gong rim gyis dbul skyor rogs dngul sgor sa ya gnyis dang chig 'bum sum khri dang 'bru rigs spyi rgya bzhi 'bum bdun khri lnga stong gnang nas/ dbul khyim mi nyung pa zhig gi 'tsho ba'i gnad don thag gcod par phan pa byung/ de min 'brog pa'i gzhi sdod sa tshugs bsgrun zhing / tshad dang ldan pa'i gzhi sdod khang ba yang bzo bzhin yod/ /4 1

le'u dgu ba/ dgon gong ma'i mi grags can dag gi lo rgyus mdor bsdus/zur bkod dang po/ dgon gong mar byas rjes can rgya mi grags can/dpa' mchog seng chen/ ming dngos la skal bzang rgyal nag ra zer/kho lo bcu bdun yin pa'i skabs su jag tshogs shig ri thog la brgyug nas la lo ded pa mthong 'phral nye lam nas bud de lam bkag nas dmar 'dzing byas mthar/ jag pa gcig bsad cing gnyis la rmas sde mo phog tu bcug nas la lo ma lus par phyir 'phrog dus de nas bzung kho la dpa' mchog seng chen zhes mtshan snyan shin tu rgyas pa byung / yang lo nyi shu rtsa stod du mi mang po dang mnya du dbus gtsang la mjal skor tu 'gro ba'i lam skabs nas 'brong ru dmar rmas ma zhig ru thog tu brgyug pa bsad pa dang / chu zug nas gsar lam bkag skabs sngon la rta zhon nas rab nyul byas te nyen kha chung sa nas lam btsal ba sogs kyis skad grags lhag par je cher song ste/ dpa' mchog seng chen ni gling dpa' brtul zhig gi skye mtha' yin pa dang / kho la yi dam lhas sdong grogs dang yul lha ga'i bdag lus dang grib ma bzhin 'grogs yod par bshad pas/ phyis su jag pa 'azog bcom byed mkhan gyis skad thos na'ang 'jig par grags/ /gle ba'i khye mo bar/ kho ni gle ba a jo'i bu mo'i bu yin te/ yab ni rab gong grub dbang nam mkha' rgyal mtshan yin par grags/ kho ha lam rab 48

byung bcu gsum pa'i stod tsam la skyes pa yin la/ dgon gong ma gle khog nas nub phyogs su 'gro ba'i gros 'go 'don mkhan dang / skabs de'i sde ba'i las don thams cad la 'go bcangs mkhan gtso bo'i gras yin/ kho ni dpa' rtsal 'gran zla dang bral zhing sde ba'i spyi don la srog phar bsngos byed thub cing / blo rig skyen zhing gtam la mkhas pa zhig yin pa ni da lta yang kun gyes gleng bzhin yod/ khos dpa' rtags ba ga tshul gyi lo rgyus mang po yod de/ dper na/ ru gle khog na yod dus shig la ru skor gyi la lo jag pas ded pa'i ra mdar sring mo'i mag pa dang kho gnyis mnyam du brgyug pa la/mag pa'i rta ni gseb zhig yin pas la lo ded pa tshor te kha ma lon par shor nas jag pa'i nang du thon/ jag pas la lo dang mnyam du ded de/ we/khyod kyi rjes na ded yong mkhan gan su red/ ming la ci zer zhes dris pa la/ mag pas gan nga'i ya 'ang red/ kho'i ming la khyi mo thar zer zhes lan btab par/ jag pa dag gis rtsed mtshar dumakhyi mo/ khyi mo zhes ki btabanas bos/ khyi mo thar gyis jag pa'i rjes chod de khyis wal wal byas nas jag pa bcu lhag yod pa gcig kyang ma lus bar tshang ma mdung gis brgyab ste bsad cing / rta khyu dang mag pa phyir ded nas yong / de'i rjes su sa kha stod nas ya gye gle khyi zhes ming thos pa tsam du'ang 'jig 'jig byed pa zhig yin pas kho yod sa'i ru skor 'a jag pa rta 'ded dar ma myong bar bshad/yang nam zhig gi tshe khe ra'i snying dkar lag lo zhes pa'i jag rkus 'khyam gsum la ngar ba' ru ba gnyis gle khog tu 'ongs te stag bsad/ gsas mkhar ba gas/ sa ming brjes ba sogs mi byed dgu byed skabs dpa' mchog bla rgan gtso byas pa'i dgon gong ma'i mi drag gras rnams kyis ru ba de gnyis btsan gyis phyi la 'ded pa'i sta gon byas/ skabs der gle khyis snying dkar lag lo sogs la nga'i dza ri khrab dkar ming la gle khog btags/ lcags kyi sgam bu'i ming la ba sga btags/ mdzo mo dgu zheng ming la gle gdong btags/9

rdo ra'i gser gzhong ming la shel mjong btags/ a kye gle 'phyor ming la gle 'ar btags zhes gyod bshad mi kun ha las pa zhig 'then par grags/ /nywa nag bla smyon/ kho'i pha'i ming la tshogs tho rna ris zer/ bla spyon ni rab byung bcu bzhi ba'i stod du skyes ba'i mi skad grags can zhig yin la/ kho rang gi khyad chos gtso bo ni sru mkhas shing dpa' snying che ba/ chos kyi phyogs la'ang mkhas pas gzhan la bca' ba rim gro sgrub shes/ mtshams rer sked 'khor gsum btags te jag la 'gro ba dang / mtshams la lar rgyab ser chas gon de sku rim 'dzin pa/ rgyun par kha ku re la dga' ba zhig yin pas bla spyon btags par grags/ rgan po tshos gleng tshul ltar na nya nag bla spyon dang g.yer skyong chos spyon/ rgyal bza'i skal lo gsum la gong mas thob 'dra mnyam byin yod skad/ /kho lo chung dus shig la grong sngags gnyis kyis rten 'brel legs por bsgrigs te/ rta dkar po gnyis kyi ming la dung dkar zhes btags nas/bla spyon tshang la srog mkhar srung 'khor 'dogs par slebs/ kho gnyis khyim la yong khar rta gnyis kha sprel byas te sgo nas btang / cung zad 'gor rjes bla spyon rta gnyis la blta ru mngags/ khos lta dus rta gnyis ka g.yang la lhung 'dug/ phyir yong ste sngags pa gnyis la gnam na 'phur no thang dkar red/ mtha' la 'dril ba dung dkar red ces bshad kyang de gnyis kyis ha ma go/ yang srog mkhar 'khor lo dgu brtsegs red/ dung dkar thog ma thog brtsegs red ces bshad pa'ang ha ma go/ de nas dpon gnyis 'gong bo'i sna 'dren red/ rta gnyis thog ma thog brtsegs red/ ces —bshad ma thag de gnyis kyis ya ha bo zer nas sgo la brgyugs par grags/yang skabs shig ja thang la song ste khyim tshang zhig nas bsnad/ khyim bdag mas nyams ma bzhag par phyin zhig shor/ de nas bla spyon gyis sa chen po ja thang ske nas/ 'brug ldi ru ru zhig gyags gi 'brug red 'brug red zer 50

na/ 'azug deng sang tshang na nyal yod/ rdza red rdza red zer na/ rdza khya yag 'khyag gis bsdams yod/ bo'u red bo'u red zer na/ bo'u skad rum nas rgyags gi bo'u dud gling la 'thibs gi gling 'di nas 'dug srol medagi sa nag gi thab ka min na/ ྅ nag gi kyi zhig bsad song zhes gu re brtses/ thengs shig bla spyon khyim tshang zhig gi ma mchod byas/ khyim bdag lug dzir 'gro khar chung mar ya mchod la de ring gro ma mar khu byin zhes bshad de song / de nas chung mas gro ma mar khu mo rang gis zos/ gro khu a mchod la blud/ khyo bo phyir glebs rjes bla spyon gyis kha ton don pa'i tshul du gro ma mar khu mo rang 'thung / gro khu ya mchod nga la blud/ da dung ma tshar do 'og na/ ye bden mi bden bltas na shes/ mgo la ma rgyag srog la ngan/ lag la ma rgyag bzhon ma skam/ phyi nas sha nyog ko nyog byos/khyos kyang snyog dang ngas kyang snyog zhes bton skad/ bla spyon la phyi nas bltas tshe rgad po'i tshul 'dzin yang bca' ba rim gro la'ang shin tu mkhas/dper na/ skabs shig la kho rang rma chu'i phar phyogs kyi khyim tshang zhig nas lug dzi byas te bsdad/ nyin zhig khyim tshang des rma chu'i tshur phyogs nas sngags pa zhig gdan drangs te btsod skol skabs/ 'grul chen gzhan zhig khyim der thon pa la sngags pas phyag len ji bzhin ma shes par ci bya gtol med du gyur ba mthong nas bla spyon gyis khyod rang kha ton 'don du song /ngas btsod skol zhes byang cha dang ldan par mgon po btsod dmar bskol bas/ mgron po de'i bsam par sa 'dir rgad po 'di 'dra zhig kyang bca' ba phyag len la mkhas na sngags pa 'di ci 'dra zhig yin snyam nas ha las par gyur/ bla spyon dpa' bo'ang 'gran med cig yin la/ skabs shig kho chos spyon dang skal lo gnyis dang mnyam du stod phyogs 'bo rar brgyugs nas dpa' rtags bzhag tshul gyi lo rgyus ya nga gleng rgyu ngo da/ /gamar skyang chos smyon/ kho'i pha ni g.yer skyong bstan pa rgya mtsho yin/ 51

g.yer skyo cho sa spyon dang rgya bza'i skal lo (rab byung bcu gsum pa'i me pho khyi 176lor skyes )gnyis dus thog gcig gi mi yin pa dang gong mas cho lo yang mnyam du sbyar bar grags/ yang zhabs dkar tshogs drug rang grol gyi rnam thar tu g.yer skyong chos spyon skyabs mgon zhabs dkar ba'i ( 1781—1851)sbyin bdag yin par bshad yod pa sogs las khong 'tsho skabs ni spyi lo'i dus rabs bco brgyad pa'i mjug dang bcu dgu ba'i dus 'go yin par nges/ kho rang chung dus pha bstan pa rgya mtsho 'das pa dang / srun che ba gsum gyis khyim so sor bzung pas ma bu gnyis gcig pur lus/ skabs der reb gong phyogs su 'bo ra'i mi 'khyam du 'bod pa'i spun gnyis yod pa de kho ma bu gnyis kyi ru thog tu brgyug ste/ mdzo mo dkar bo dung sgong 'dra ba gtsos bzho 'bri brgyad dgu zhig yod pa 'phrog nas ded cing / ma bu gnyis la gri yis brgyab nas thang la bskyel/ yud tsam nas kho rang brgyal ba las sangs shing / khos khrag dmar 'khyil ba'i mig gong lag pas 'phyid bzhin jag pa'i rjes la blta zhing / a mar nga la mtshon cha med pas lan/dngos gnas nga la mtshon cha zhig med dam zhes dris par/ nga mas kyang pha bstan pa rgya mtsho 'das khar chos spyon la khas btags pa'i me 'da' brgya bo'u kha log de nang kwa'i khog tu bcug yod pa sems la dran nas myur bar phyir blangs nas kho la sprad/ chos spyon gyis am gtsigs bsdams shing dpa' ngar chen pos jag rgod gnyis kyi rjes su bsnyegs/ nyin phyed tsam nas rjes chod cing de gnyis lnga ba'i lam du brdzangs te rang zog phyir ded nas yong bas/ g.yer skyong chos spyon zhes pa'i dpa' ming de thogs/ de'i rjes su khos chung ma blangs shing rgyu nor 'phel ba dang sde mgo bcings bar yang shin tu mdzangs pas tshang mas kho g.yer skyong gi dpon por bskos/ kho lo rer pha yu la reb gong dang dzong dkar sogs su mchod 'bul gnas skor tu 'gro zhing /lo zhig mjal skor tu song nas phyir log skabs la kha zhig tu jag pa mi nyi shu 452

lhag gis 'phrog bcom byed par rtsom dus khos de dag gcig kyang ma shor bar tshang ma tshar bcad pas lhag par snyan grags rgyas/ phyis su khos la kha de nas sdig bshags mchod rten zhig kyang bzhengs/ skabs der sa der chos spyon gong kha zer mod da lta mchod rten gong kha zer/ chos spyon lo nyi shu rtsa 'ga'i thog ྅ nag bla spyon dang / dpa' mchog seng chen/ yo'u rgya'i ban de rgyal bcas dang mnyam du sog po stod ma dang gtugs res byas shing g.yul las rgyal bas dgon gong ma'i bu rgod bzhi zhes pa'i mtshan snyan mdo smad la khyab/ de dus g.yer skyong gi ru 'bab sa gtso bo ni sha la phyi nang dang / uge'ajang che chung / slog shul go'u kha/ longs skyes sogs yin la/ der thengs shig longs skyes nas g.yag snying gsur tu phul bas da lta g.yag snying ri zer don de nas thogs/chos spyon ni dpa' zhing brtul phod pa'i khar rang gi rigs la zhen pa dung las dkar ba zhig yin par grags/ thengs shig kho khri gar 'gro dus shig la ge sar lha khang la mjal skabs shan pa bstan rte 'di'i sngon na 'gyel yod pa 'di su red ces dris pa la/ 'di rgya tsha zhal dkar red ces lan btab/ chos spyon gyis thos ma thag khong khro chen po langs te klad dmar 'di'i snying nad da dung mi sangs sam zhes shan pa'i 'bag sku'i mgo la gris brgyab nas tshal bar btang / phyis su kun gyis mi 'en khog can gyis gris btab pa sor bzhag byas na legs par bshad nas 'bag sku bskyar tu ma—bzhengs par grags/ /chos spyon dpa' bo zhig yin pas cha nas man ching srid gzhung gis kyang gcig chen byas de byu ru dmar po'i tog dang / rma bya sngon mo'i sgro ba so dkar po'i tham ga khu ling nag po'i zhwa mo/ khrab dang rmog yob log dang btsem btsem bcas kyi bdag rkyen gnang ste/ gong ma'i srid gzhung la zhabs zhu dang / 'bangs don rtsod gleng 'dum pa/ sa gnas kyi rkun jag 453

'dul ba sogs kyi 'gan 'khur tu bcug/ kho dzong dkar dgon du song nas rtsa ba'i bla ma rje ma ḍi ba shes rab bkra shis tshang la snyeng rang sa mthar 'khyams yod pas/ srung ma btsan po zhig gnang dgos zhes zhus par/bla mas 'khrid nus na 'di ster ro zhes rgyal bo sku lnga gnang / chos spyon gyis de mur bsang phul ba dang / gnam sa sgul ba lta bu'i ke btab/mdung mgo la skor bzhin srung ma rgyal bo khrid pa la bla ma yang ngo mtshar bar grags/ da lta bar g.yer skyong dpon tshang gis rgyal bo sku lnga srung mar bsten yod pa'i yong khungs ni de nas byung ngo / /dpa' mchog bsod lag/ ha lam rab byung bcu gsum pa'i lcags sprel ( 1800) yas mas la skyes/ kho'i ming ngo mar bsod tho zer te/lag pa la gri phog nas zha bor gyur yod pas mtshang ming du bsod lag thogs/kho'i pha ni 'jam skor gyi mi rabs ches snga ba lha dge zer ba de yin/ kho la snying stobs che zhing / lhag par tu gyod bshad la shin tu mkhas pa zhig yin pas/ sde phyi nang kyod don byung tshe kho bos nas gzu ba byed du 'jug de dus rwa rgya'i sku gagogs shing bza' dang rgyal ba gnyis thugs ma mthun par sus kyang gyod bshad ma thub par grwa tshang kyang phyogs khag gnyis su gyes la nye skabs dpa' mchog bsod lag bos te gzu bshad du bcug sod lag gis khyed bla chen 'gro ba'i skyabs mgon du bkur ba gnyis kyis khyim pa phal ba'i lugs srol ltar dbang brtsad nas dge 'dun gyi sde la srel zhugs su bcug na sangs rgyas bstan pa'i zhabs 'dren du mi 'gro'am zhes so sor rta lcag re gzhus pa na/ bla ma gnyis kyis kyang lags so zhes bsod lag gis gzu bshad pa dang len byas/ thengs shig dpa' mchog gis sde ba gzham la mi lnga bsad nas gnas mal du sdod ma bzod par bros/ bsod lag la'ang kho tshang gi ru ba myur bar bros na legs tshul bshad kyang ngas rgyad ya btsal ba 'bro ba'i don du min zhes sgul ma tshugs par bsdad par grags/404

skabs der kho'i ri skor la bsod skor zer/ /yo'u rgya'i ban de rgyal ske ringaka dge 'dun gyi bu ru skyes/ skabs der a rig gi ru ba mar dgon gong ma'i ru thog tu yong ste rgyun par sa rtsod chu rtsod kyis gtses pa dang / mi shi rta 'gyed kyi don rkyen mang po bzos nas 'gal ba dza drag tu gyur/ de nas dgon gong ma dang a rig sde ba gnyis kyi mi drag tshos gros bsdur byas te so so nas dpa' bo gnyes kyi rgyal pham brtsad nas su rgyal na de la rtswa sa ster rgyu gros 'chams byung / a rig gi dpa' brtul ni e rmag ban de rgyal zhes pa de yin pa dang / dgon gong mar dpa' khas len byed mkhan g.yer skyong chos spyon dang / nywa nag bla spyon/ dpa' mchog sangs chen (skal nag) gle ba'i khyi mo thar bcas yod mod/ rgyan — 'phangs pa'i 'bras bur ban de rgyal ske ring gtugs res byed par 'gro rgyur bab/ ban de rgyal ske ring dang ye zag ban de rgyal gnyis kyis sha la'i lung phu'i sar gtugs res byas pas e rmag dpon po ban de rgyal mtshon ngar ma'i kha la drangs par ma zad/ de'i lag grogs mang po zhig kyang bkums pas rgyal pham gyi rteng ma dgon gong mar thob te/ a rig phyis su yong mi chog par byas/ a rig gi dpa' brtul gsod sa de la ro phyar thogs shing /rjes su ming 'gyur nas ri phyor zer/ de rjes grub thob sngags 'chang chen po 'ig la gzhi phya rtsis byas pa'i lung bstan du/ khyod kyis rtse gsum nas dar gsum dang snying gsum nas gter gsum sbas tshe stag mo thong 'dzin byed pa'i bu gsum skye zhes pa bab pas/ khos sha bo ru rtse dang / bya dar sgo rtse/mdzo mo nu rtse gsum nas bsang btang ming dar phyar/ du ge she'u snying dang /khu lung g.yag snying / nyin shug gtso snying gsum du gter sbas pas phyis su kho la bu skal dbyangs dang / 'dzigs med/ gnam gzhes bcas dpa' —mdzangs brtul phod dang ldan par grags pa'i o'u rgya'i sangs chen spun gsum po skyes/ / 5rgya

dpa' mchog 'a ma me/ kho ha lam rab byung bcu bzhi ba'i me pho sprel (1836)lo la skyes/ kho'i pha lo chung dus grwa ba byed myong bas ming ngo ma sgrib nas ban de zhes 'bod pa dang / gzugs thung ba'i rkyen gyis ban de rte'u li zer/ kho tshang gis srung mar lha mo dmag zor ma bsten pa dang / gzhi bdag gle phyor dang / gnyan chen/ rma rgyal/ rgyal bo go chen sogs la bsang mchod byed/ 'jam me lo bcu lon pa'i skabs der pha ban des phyugs 'tsho dus rgod ma zhig la rte'u zhig rtseb pa de sder mo can thig yin pa mthong bas/ khos than ltas yin par sems te rte'u rgod mar kha bkar nas bsad/ phyis su reb gong sprul sku 'dan chos 'khor tshang phebs nas gnas tshul de zhus pa na/ bla mas thugs bsam zhig btang rjes khyod kyi bu dang rte'u mnyam du cher skyes te/ mi rta mnyam 'phrod byung na gnam 'og tu 'gran zla bral ba zhig yong nges kyang / khyod la las bsod de med song zhes —gsungs par grags/ /'jam me'i pha ban de tshe las 'das rjes sa dpyad pa zhig gdan drangs pa des dur sa 'ba' yi wa gar dris zhes pa der bltas pa dang / de nas bzung sngon gyi srung ma'i khar khri ga'i yul lhar mchod na mi rabs brgyud mar kha las rlung rta dar ba dang rgyu 'byor ba ldan par bshad/ 'ja' me lo gzhon dus pho rtsal sna dgu 'dzoms pa'i khar/ smin ma stug cing mig zung che ba/gdong ba mtho ba'i pho gsar byad gzugs legs pa 'eg yin pas/ gnas la 'gro ran pa'i bu mo dag gi yid smon byed yu du gyur par grags/ kho pho lo bco brgyad kyi skabs der sog res zhes pa'i sde ba nas ming la klu mtsho zer ba'i na chung ma zhig bsus pa der yang bud med kyi mdzes pa'i yon tan ldan pa zhig yin pas/ khyo shug de gnyis la kun gyis mdzes pa'i tshad 'jog byed par bshad/ ma gzhir kho gnyis bza' tshang 'grig cing phan tshun brtse —sems yo da pa zhig yin kyang / thengs shig 'jam me yul na bsdad med pa'i 456

skabs shig la/ klu mtshos mnyam ma bzhag par rgod ma'i chug ge (rgod ma'i 'o ma spyad nas chang snyol byed kyi rdza khog cig )mi rabs sngon ma nas brgyud pa zhig yod pa de lag nas thang gi rdo thog la lhung ste kha bcag pa la/ 'jam me'i a mas las bda' zhig byas par ma dga' nas phargan mo khyod lo lon rgyu yod pas de dus nga'i kha ngor bltas nas 'dug dgos pa'i dus shig shar yong zhes bshad pa g.yog mo zhig gis thos/ 'ja' me phyir thon rjes ya mas gnas tshul de kho la ma bshad kyang / g.yog mos 'jam me la ji bzhin bshad pas kho'i sems shin tu mi dga' bar gyur/ nyin zhig khos klu mtsho la rgyu mtshan ci yang ma bshad par 'gro skal 'dzoms po zhig sgrub thog kho tshang la rta ches bzang ba zhig yod pa der zhon du bcug nas yul la bskyal ba dang /phyir yong khar klu mtsho'i pha sgo khar bos nas mos a ma dang 'khon res byas pa'i gnas tshul 'ib par bshad pa dang / khyad par tu ‘phyis su a ma rgas nas 'gro 'dug mi thub dus klu mtsho'i lag la lhung na dka' mo red/ de las gnyen thag snga mo nas chad na dga' zhes bshad nas phyir log phyis su don de pha mar sdug gtong ba'i chung ma la gleg mi rnyed pa'i skyes pa rnams la bslab bya'i dpe ston du byed par grags/ de nas 'jam mes bskyar tu chung ma len par ma rem par/ lo 'ga'i ring brtag mthar lag las ka dang khog shes rgya gang gi cha nas yang phul du phyin pa'i se rgya'i bu mo zhig khyim thab la bsus/ de la bu bstan kho dang / bstan dar/ co res/ lha chen ba'i dang / bu mo 'brug mo dang / skyid mo sogs bzhi skyes/ 'jam me ni rgyu 'byor ba ldan pa zhig yin mod khong tshang gi mtha' na yod pa'i ru skor tshang ma phal cher 'phyor med nyam chung dag dag yin/ de'i rgyu mtshan ni khong gis 'tsho bar dka' ngal che ba'i 'byor med rnams la phyogs gang ci'i thad nas rogs ram byed par dga' bas/ skyabs la re dgos pa'i mi rnams dri ldan me tog rgyangs ring yang / bung ba sprin gyi tshogs bzhin 'du/ zhes pa'i 457

dpe ltar/ de rnams ma bos rang 'gul du 'jam me'i mtha' la 'khor ba red/ khong gis de dag la rogs skyor byed rgyu ni rang gi sde don sgrub pa'i 'os 'gan chen po zhig tu brtsis yod de/ rgyun du shar khog tshong bar las rogs byas pa'i gla rin la ja thob tshe ru skor med po rnams la 'dra mnyam du ja 'gyed rgyag pa dang / tshong bar song nas 'bru nyos tshe bye 'gyed dang nas 'gyed rgyag pa red/ khong rang nyid kyis de ltar dge ba'i sbyin pa gtong bar ma zad/ rang gi bu phrug rnams la yang nyam chung pha ma ltar bkur dgos shing de tshor grogs phran bu tsam bgyis kyang dge ba'i rtsa bar 'gyur ba'i bslab bya rgyun du gtong ba red/ dper na/ nyin zhig kho'i bu chung ba lha chen la tshar wa phyi g.yog ras rlon dmar po brgyab pa can zhig so ma bzos te gon nas 'gro skabs/ glo'u kha skya'i ri yong gi bu mo 'gas mthong ste/ tsha ru'i phyi g.yog dmar po de dung gdan byas na legs tshul gyi gtam thos ma thag lha chen gyis ci la'ang mi bsam par 'og thu nas bzung ste bu mo rer dmar gdan g.yog spyad re byin pas tshar g.yog phyed ka tsam byin nas tshar/ yul la thon rjes ya mas las 'ded tsam byas kyang / pha 'jam mes bu mo de dag gi re 'dun bskang ba legs tshul gyi bsngags bajod byas/ phyis su 'jam me'i bu mo che ba 'brug mo dme ska'i ba kho tshang la song ba de ru skor la byams pa dang /'grul ba sne len la bzang bas dem khang khra sdang ma thogs pa yang / pha mas chung dus nas tshul bzang ya rab byed dgos pa'i / ta byas par rags las/ thag ring rgyangs nas yong ba'i shar khog gi tshong bas 'brog pa'i ru ba mang po'i nang nas 'jam me kho tsho'i skyabs dang lag grogs la 'tshol ba yang rgyu mtshan med pa min te/ 'jam me la mi nyam chung skyong ba'i pha ma/ dgra nag po gnon pa'i tho ba zhes pa'i mtshan snyan yod pas/ sa cha med rgyas med nas mi bkan mo zhig lag grogs la 'tshol 'dod pa red/ /'jam me rang bzhin du gzhan nor 'phrog cing / 'thab rtsod la mos 4du8

pa zhig min kyang / gal srid gzhan gyis btsan gnon byas tshe rgol lan mthar thug gtong mkhan zhig yin/ skabs shig dpa' mchog gi tshong ba rong phar nang (gcan tsha )la 'gro skabs/ rkang tsha skya ro zhes pa'i sde bas nga brag dkar khis kha g.yag gis bshig rkang lam med sar g.yag lam btod ces spyod bshad brgyab ste tshong lam bkag pa na/ 'jam mes kho'i bu mo'i mag pa dme ska'i ba tho dang / tsha bo bal kho zhwa dmar/ de min dpon skor nu'u zhes sogs dang mnyam du rgol lan tsha thag chod pa sprad mthar/rkang tsha skya ro'i mi gcig bsad pa dang / dpa' mchog tshong ba'i mi rta gcig la'ang skyon ma byung par bde blag ngang rong phar nang la thon pas/ 'jam me sogs la dpa' mchog gi stag phrug bzhi zhes pa'i mtshan snyan thob/ /gzhan yang 'jam me ni rang sde'i mthun sgril mig ltar bsrung mkhan zhig yin pa dang / de'i don du 'chi dgos kyang tsham tshom mi byed mkhan zhig yin/ thengs shig dpa' mchog stag skor dbang skya tshang gi rta khyu sha sbrang 'be bzas da pa de'i nang ma 'jam me red ces pa thos rjes/ khos 'phral du rang la dag sel ma byas par/ rang gi bya spyod ngo mas phyi'i rkun ma'i lag grogs min pa gsal bor yong ched 'be bza'i ri thog tu brgyugs te rta rnams phyir 'phrog pa'i sta gon byas/ khos rang gi nang 'khor khrod nas nga'i 'og rta dmag 'khrug gi khrod nas rgyun du bsad 'gro pas/ su zhig gis rta sga ma zhig khrid nas nga'i rjes ma btang bar 'khrid thub ces dris pa na/ tsha bo dkon mchog bya bas ngas thub ces dpa' khas len byas te rta khrid nas 'jam me gang la brgyugs na de'i rjes la ded/ thog mar 'jam me 'be bza'i ri thog la brgyug ste nyen zon la gzas nas btags yod pa'i rta bdun bsad pa dang / de nas rta sum bcu lhag ded de 'gro skabs/ 'a dge nag sdang bya ba de tsham tshom med par sngon la brgyugs nas lam bkag de nas kho gnyis kyis mtshon thengs 'ga' la g.yug res byas rjes 'be dge nag 459

sdang gi bla mdung gis phug nas thang la bsnyel/ skabs der rjes nas ra mdar yong mkhan yang thon pas/ 'jam me kha phyir 'khor nas gdong gtugs byas mthar phar la mi gcig bsad cing mi gnyis rmas rjes/ rang la gnod ma tshugs par rang yul la thon te/ rang la ma nyes khag g.yog 'khel tshul bden dpa byas shing / sde ba'i la rgya bsrung skyob byas/ /de'i rjes nas dpa' mchog 'jam me'i mtshan snyan phyogs kun la khyab cing / dgon gong ma kho nar ma zad sha sbrang tsho drug mgar rtse tsho ba bco brgyad sogs na'ang ming yod par gyur/ 'jam me ming grags yin pa la brten nas kho yod sa'i bsod skor tsho ba'i ming la'ang 'jam skor thogs shing da lta la thug gi bar ming de ma 'gyur bar yod/ /rab byung bco lnga ba'i lcag mo yo sa (1891)lor kho'i lus phung mi bde ba zhig byung nas rang nyid 'tshams mi thub pa shes rjes/ bu bzhi bo gam du bos te/ tshang mas bstan dar la kha len tshig brtsi byed dgos tshul dang /bstan dar la ched du rgod po 'khrid shes dang / nyam chung skyong shes byed dgos pa sogs kyi kha ta bslab bya mang po btang / de nas bu gsum pa co ris la khyod la dpa' snying khyad du 'phags bayod kyang / de kho nas mi don mi 'grub pas/ blang dor daphyad shes kyi cha nas phu bo bstan dar la blo 'dri dgos zhes bslab bya btang ba dang / ring bo ma 'gor ba'i zla drug pa'i nang tshe'i dus byas/ /dpa' mchog 'jam me grags skad can des lo lnga bcu lhag las ma thub pa ni/ kho'i bu mo chung ba skyid mos mgar rtse'i sngags pa gnyan po zhug thos zhes par gnas ngan bltas te phyir log rjes/ sngags pa de 'bod du yong nas skad cha sbom po bshad pa la/ 'jam me khong khro chen po langs te/ khyod kyi gnyan sdong rtsa nas gcod rgyu yin zhes pa sogs kyi gshe gshe mang po btang nas sgor phud pa de'i gnyan phog pa yin tshul gyi bshad stangs shig kyang —460

yod/ /yo'u rgya'i seng chen/ ming dngos la rnam bzhes zer/ rab byung bcu bzhi ba'i dkyil tsam la ban de rgyal sko ring gi bu ru skyes/ kho rang gi a jo sngags pa 'jigs med glo'u tshang gis bsad pa'i sha lan du phu bo skal bzang rgyal dang mnyam du dmag la chas skabs stabs cung ma 'grig par dmag phyir log rtsis byas mod/ rnam bzhes kyis de ring ci byas kyang dgra sha ma blangs par phyir mi log thag chod yin zhes dgra thog tu shor nas song / kho rang la sngon gzhug nas mda' mang po phog kyang gnod ma tshugs par snying nad brtsad/phyir yul du thon rjes rum nas mda' mang po phyir bton pa mazong nas yul mi rnams ha las par gyur/ de nas bzung kho la o'u rgya'i seng chen zhes — btags/ nyin zhig kho rang lam na 'gro skabs dme rka'i seng chen dang mag pa gnyis thog la shor yong nas mgo la gris gcig brgyab/ kho de ma thag khong khro me 'bar ba ltar langs te/ de gnyis la mdung yus brgyab ste rta las 'phangs/ mgo la rkang snam bskon te rkang thang du yul la 'gro ru bcug par de bas kyang sems can ha las te snyan grags je cher song / rnam bzhes ni mi skye mtha' can zhig yin zer srol yod de/ lo rgas pa'i dus su lha sar song ste/ se 'bras dge gsum rgya lo'i smon lam la 'tshogs skabs grwa tshang gi zhol nas lag gnyis thal mo sbyar te thugs dam du grongs/ phyis su kho grongs shul nas lcang sdong zhig skyes par grags pa'i yal ga zhig 1985 lor o'u rgya'i mjal ba skor zhig gis khyer yong nas btsan skyes lab tse'i pho brang tu brgag /sngags 'chang chen po pad+ma rang grol(sku nag)/ khong ni gdams pa dang mngon shes la chag thogs med cing / mthu dang mngon spyod la dbang 'byor ba'i rnal 'byor pa zhig yin par grags/ khong gis sku tshe gang bor grub rtags ya mtshan can gang mang bstan pa'i lo rgyus yod pa mdor bsdus na 61
