phyugs zog sna tshogs khri tsho 25 12yod pa dang / de'i nang du nor khri tsho 6 7 rta 3100 lug khri tsho 16 36 ra ma khri tsho 1 75 bcas yod/ 'brog pa mi re'i yong sgo sgor1600yin/spyi lo nyis stong lor dge rgan dang las bzo ba 87yod pa dang / slob ma 774yod pa des slob ma slob grwar zhugs tshad kyi brgya cha'i nga bdun dang grangs chung bdun zin yod/ /530

zur brkad lnga ba/gser khang mchod sdong rdo rje lhun po'i dkar chag mthong pa don ldan bzhugs/ /blo bzang rgyal ba'i bstan pa la/ /snang mtha'i sgyu 'phrul chos kyi rje/ /bshad sgrub bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin/ /rnam 'dren mchog gis thugs rjes skyongs/ /phul byung blo gros stobs kyi btsun/ /rmad byung yon tan khur gyis brjid/ /log lta'i mi bsrun sun 'byin pa'i/ /gangs can lha gcig gtsug gi rgyan/ /mkha' mnyam 'gro la rab brtse zhing / /grangs med bskal bar tshogs gnyis bsags/ /stong gsum mi mjed zhing gi dpal/ /shākya seng ge de la 'dul/ /rab 'byams rgyal ba'i spyi gzugs rje/ /grub dbang pad+ma thod phreng rtsal/ /dbyer med gsum ldan bla ma mchog/ sgo gsum mi 'bral rgyan du bzhugs/ /rgyal ba kun gyi gsung gi dpal/ /snyan tshig glu ru gyer pa yi/ /sgra dbyangs lha mo dbyangs can ma/ /bdag blo gzhon nu'i khab tu rol/ /bden don rigs pa'i bdud rtsi btung pa yis/ /legs bshad thu char 'dod rgur 'jo ba'i sprin/ /sdug bsngal tsha gdung 'joms la gtum pa'i dpung / /rgyal bstan pad tshal bzhad pa'i nyi ma rgyal/ /drin ldan bla ma'i gsang gsum sgyu ma'i 'phrul/ /tshur mthong byis blos dpag par mi nus kyang / /gang gi gsang gsum nor bu'i za ma tog/ /grub pa'i byung ba rags tsam 'di na spro/ /de yang ji skad du/ ngag gi dbang phyug dpal ldan danis/ shis 531

brjod phyag bya dngogapo ni/ /nges par bstan pa de yi sgo/ /zhes gsung pa ltar/phyag mchod shis brjod kyi tshigs su bcad pa'i nga ros drangs te gleng par bya ba ni/ lha dang bcas pa'i skye dgu yongs kyi gtsug nor/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi rgyal ba thams cad kyi mkhyen brtse nus gsum gcig tu bsdus pa/ris su ma chad pa'i bstan pa'i mnga' bdag shes bya'i gnas la mkhyen spyan yangs pa/ lha sngags dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i dpal la dbang 'byor ba'i khyab bdag 'khor lo'i mgon po/ snyigs dus mi bsrun gyi skye bo log par 'khu ba rnams chos la bskul phyir/ stong nyid dang rten 'brel zab mo'i nga rdo sgrogs pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa don gyi slad du mtshan nas smos na/7kun gzigs paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa blo bzang 'phrin las lhun grub chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po zhes mtshan snyan lha'i rnga bo che grags pa de nyid kyi gzugs sku'i cha shas bzhugs pa'i/ 7gser khang mchod sdong rdo rje lhun po 'di nyid kyi dkar chag rags tsam 'god pa la gsum ste/ thog mar yid ches bskyed phyir mchod rten sngon bzhengs kyi lo rgyus rags tsam brjod pa/bar tu rnam gzhag gsal phyir mchod sdong bskyar bzhengs skabs kyi rang bsrel sogs bzhugs byang 'god pa/ tha mar tshogs gnyis dzogs phyir sbu gsung thugs rten bzhengs pa dang phyag 'tshal bskor ba sogs kyi phan yon rnams so/ /dang po yid ches bskyed pa la/ rma g.yang phyug mos snyan 'gyur stong gi glu dbyangs len cing rlabs phreng 'dzum dkar gyi me tog bar med du dgod la/ mdzes sdug gya gyu'i 'gros kyis g.yu 'brug sngon mo sa la rgyu ba dang kun nas mtshungs par lho rwa rgya bkra shis 'byung gnas nas g.yas su dkar mo g.yang 'khyil du bskor te 'bab pa'i shar gyi khug par rka che chung gi chab rgyun 532

lhung lhung 'bab pa dang 'ba' stod bkra shis g.yang thang nas thon pa'i 'bab chu gnyis dpag bsam shing gi yal ga bzhin 'ba' yi rgyal bo go chen zhes pa'i lha ri'i rgyab phyogs su g.yu 'brug kha sprod ji bzhin gcig tu 'dres pa/ sngon dus nas rka 'ba' sum mdo zhes grags pa'i sa 'dir rab byung bcu gsum pa'i mid kyi cha la rje gser khang pa blo bzang bstan 'dzin rgya mtshos zhabs kyis bcags te 'dir 'khod pa'i skye 'gro yongs la dad pa'i rten tu gyur pa'i lha khang mchod rten sogs ci yang med pas/ sems can kun ngan song gi rgyu la bag med brtson pa lhur len pa khong gis ma bzod de/ yul 'di'i ser skya pho mo'i dad rten du rka 'ba' sum mdor mchod rten zhig bzhengs shing yul 'di'i skye bo kun gyis mchod rten gyi mtshan la'ang 'brel ba rgyu mtshan du byas nas gser khang mchod rten zhes rje khong gi mtshan gyi sgo nas btags so/ /de yang yab rje gser khang pa'i rnam par thar ba rags tsam brjod na/bdag nyid chen po 'di ni ring mo zhig nas bya dka' ba'i rgyal sras kyi spyod pa thams cad mthar son te sku bzhi'i go 'phang brnyes su zin kyang / thun mong gi snang ngor srid pa ji srid kyi bar tu 'gro ba so so'i skal ba dang 'tsham par sgrul sku'i skye ba bzhes nas 'gro don rgya chen byas so/ /ji skad du/ ha cang phyug pa'i khyim dang ni/ /dbul bo'i khyim du mi skye bar/ /bar ma'i khyim du skye 'gyur zhing / /rab tu byung ba thob par shog / ces gsungs pa ltar/ rig chu stod ces pa'i 'brog sde chen por/ yab no'i ros dang / yum dzā ti skyid gnyis kyisas su rab byung bcu gsum pa'i lcags byi lo'i zla bzhi ba'i tshes brgyad la dge mtshan phun sum tshogs pa'i ltas dang bcas sku bltams so/ /ya khus rmi ltas ltar mtshan dkon mchog skyabs gsol/ dga' ldan lha brgya ma 533

slob ma dgos par thugs su chud/ klog slob pa tshegs med du mkhyen/dgung grangs bdun gyi steng gad gor sprul skus rab byung dang dge tshul dkyus gcig la bsgrub/ rje bdag nyid chen pos/ snying rje che la ring nas goms pa'i yid/ /snying bo med pa'i las la dga' mi 'gyur/ /mang thos bag chags sems la goms rnams kyis/ /mang ba'i shes bya shes par dka' ba min/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ byis pa gzhan ltar rtsed 'jor g.yeng nas dus —'da' ba zhig min par/ 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum sogs dka' tshegs la mi blta bar thugs su chud par mdzad/ gzhan phan 'azin las kyi gter tu gyur pa thub bstan yongs jogs kyi mnga' bdag chen po byams pa dge legs rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'am a rig dge bshes chen mos/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po 'jam dbyangs kun dga'i yang sprul du thugs thag— bcad de sku na phra mo nas thugs brtse bas bu bzhin bskyangs shing dgyes bzhin du dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs par gnang / yi dam 'di nyid kyi rnal 'byor la brten nas mkhas shing grub pa'i go 'phang mthon por gshegs/ khyad par tu lha mchog 'di nyid kyi bsnyen sgrub las gsum yongs su gsal bar mdzad pas/ phyi nang nyer 'tsho'i rigs la —nyams nga med par lung togs bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan srid rtse'i bar tu bsgreng la 'gran zla bral zhing / de yang nges 'byung gi bsam pa rnam par dag pa'i stobs kyis 'khor ba'i phun tshogs la blo log pa dang / byams pa dang snying rje chen po'i mthus mi bsrun pa sus mthong yang yid dang pa dang / dbang bzhis rgyud smin pa'i lag rjes su bde legs thams cad kyi rtsa ba bla ma rdo rje 'chang yin pa'i mos gus lhan skyes su 'khrungs pa bcas so/ /'di ltar bla ma 53

la sangs rgyas dngos kyi 'du shes kyis bshes gnyen tshul bzhin du bsten te/rwa rgya bkra shis 'byung gnas su mdo sngags kyi gzhung la legs par sbyangs shing rgyal ba'i gsung rab mtha' dag gdams par shar nas dben pa'i ri khrod mang por 'grims/ rab gong grub gnas brgyad dang / bya khyung / dgon lung / gser khog/ sku 'bum/ rong bo dgon chen/ la mo bde chen sogs dgon chen khag dang / ri bo rtse lnga/ pe cin/ ya lag sha sogs yus gru du mar pebs te thugs dam mdzad pa sogs zhib par brjod kyis mi la bas na mdor bsdus tsam zhig gleng bya/ rje 'di mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyi dpal la dbang 'byor zhing / theg pa mchog gi dge ba'i bshes gnyen mtshan nyid dang ldan pa du ma'i zhabs pad bsam sbyor gnyis kyis tshul bzhin du bsten nas mdo sngags kyi gzhung la mi 'dzigs pa'i spobs pa brnyes kyang / thugs khengs pa med par dam tshig dang sdom pa mngon skog med par mig 'bras ltar bsrungs shing / rang gzhan gyi srid pa'i rtsa ba drung nas 'byin pa'i thugs stobs rmad du byung bas dben pa'i ri sul kho na bsten nas dka' ba spyad pa la gzhan gyis bsgrun du med pa dang / nyin mtshan dus drug kun tu thugs dam nyams bzhes la rim gyis gzhol bas mdo sngags kyi lam cha tshang la dbang 'byor te kun mkhyen bu ram shing ba'i bstan pa sbyi dang khyad par du 'jam mgon tsong kha pa chen po'i ring lugs gser bzang btso ma lta bu dri ma med pa'i legs bshad 'chad pa la 'gran zla dang bral/ zab lam rim gnyis kyi ting nge 'dzin la gagol ba'i 'dul ba 'dzin pa chen po bya btang dur smrig 'chang ba'i dge 'dun bgrang las 'das pa'i gtsug rgyan du rgyur pa 'di ni/ ngo bo'i gnas tshod la/ bden gnyis kyi gnas tshul ji lta ba bzhin —3na

mngon sum du gzigs la rang gzhan gyi don cha tshang ba mthar phyin kyang /thun mong snang tshod la'ang / gsung rab dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa'i don mtha' dag la gzhan dring mi 'jog pa'i spobs pa mchog brnyes/ sgo gsum gyi spyod pa mtha' dag kyang / dran shes bag yod phun sum tshog4pa nga rgyud chags par gnas pas nyes lhung gi dri mas ma gos shing / tshul khrims dri ngad ldang ba/ ci mdzad mtha' dag gzhan phan lhur len pas/rang don gyi dri mas ma gos par bde stong dbyer med kyi ye shes la rtse gcig tu gzhol zhing / gang snang lha skur shar pa'i dag pa'i rten dang brten pa'i gsal snang gis/ tha mal snang zhen gyi 'khrul togs rtsad nas bcom ste/sdom pa gsum gyi bcas mtshams tshul bzhin du bsrung pa la thugs dam gyi gtso bor mdzad do/ /de ltar yon tan phun sum tshogs pa'i dbang gis/ gzhan phan 'phrin las rgya chen po byung pa ni/ rje bka' drin can de nyid kyi/dgon sde dang bas mtha'i ri khrod du mar blo sbyong dang byang chub lam rim/legs bshad snying bo'i 'grel ba bzhi sbrags/ bskyed dzogs/ spyod 'jug chen mo sogs gzhung chen mo rnams kyi nyams khrid/ skal ldan gdul bya mtha' dag la lan gcig ma yin par mang du bstsal ba'i dbang gis sdom pa gsum gyi bcas mtshams tshul bzhin du bsrungs shing / phyi dro'i kha zas —spangs pa dang / chab len lham 'phud byed pa sogs phyi 'dul ba'i kun spyod la gnas shing / nang lam gyi rim pa'i khrid dmigs skyong pa dang / bskyed dzogs zab mo'i ting 'dzin sgom te gzhung chen mo la bshad sgom byed pa sogs thar lam zin pa'i 'khor tshogs bgrang 'das pa byung zhing / tha na deng sang ri khrod dang / dgon sde che chung kun tu nyin re bzhin gtor ma brgya rtsa—536

gtong ba/ sangs rgyas byang mems kyi sku par mang po 'debs pa/ mchod pa brgya phrag mang po dang bye ba mang po 'bul ba sogs dal ba don ldan byed pa'i rigs mtha' yas pa byung pa yang khong gi phyag srol ma nyams pa'i bka' drin no/ / skyabs mchog dam pa 'di nyid spyi bo'i rgyan du bkur zhing /gsung gi bdud rtsi'i bgo skal spyod pa mtha' yas pa zhig byung pa zhib par bgrang mi nus la/ bden pa'i ri sul du tshogs bsags sgrib spyong dang /sdom gsum gyi bcas mtshams mig 'bras bzhin bsrungs pas dur sprig gi rgyal mtshan 'chang pa brgya phrag mang bos/ klog pa thos bsam gyi 'khor lo/spong pa bsam gtan gyi 'khor lo/ bya ba las kyi 'khor lo ste/ bshad sgrub 'khor lo gsum gyis dus 'da' bar mdzad cing / bstan pa rin po che ches cher gsal bar mdzad nas skyabs rje dam pa 'di nyid kyi rmad byung mdzad bzang skyong mkhan yang sa steng khyab pa nyid do/ /mgon po mchog des mdzad bzang brgya phrag gis/ /ris med 'gro la legs pa'i lam ston bzhin/ /nyin byed 'od dkar gsal ba'i 'jo sgeg gis/ /yangs pa'i khyon 'di'i mun pa gsal bar byas/ /zhes so/ /'dul ba lung las/ mkhas pa gang zhig rab tu sems dang bas/ /sangs rgyas mchod rten dag la goms 'dor na/ /'dzam bu chu bo'i gser gyi srang tshad ni/ /stong phrag brgya yang de dang mnyam pa min/ /zhes sogs mdo rgyud rgya mtshor bsngags pa'i yid drangs te rka 'ba' sum mdor skye dgu'i bsod nams kyi zhing du mchod rten 'di nyid legs par bzhengs pa'o/ /bar tu rnam gzhag gsal bor byed pa la/ bstan pa 'phel 'grib kyi dbang gis bde gshegs mchod rten de lo zla ring mo'i char rlung dang grang ngar 537

gyis nyams par 'dug cing / gnam sa mgo rteng slog cing bod chos ldan gyi zhing 'di mun yul du gyur te rig gnas chos lugs/ yul srol/ goms gshis sogs la rdog badzi thebs pa'i skabs su rmang med du btang nas zhing sar bcos/ spyir bod yul du rgyal bstan dar rgud kyi dbang gis byas pa'i dbye mtshams la bstan pa snga dar dang phyi dar zhes kun la grags shing / snga dar dang phyi dar gyi dbye mtshams kyang glang dar gyis bstan pa bsnubs pa'i sngon la bstan pa snga dar dang / rjes su bskyar du dar ba la phyi dar zhes gsungs/ phyi dar gyi bstan pa lo bcu'i god chag la thug pa'i bar du 'phel zhing rgyas pas bod yul chos kyi zhing khams bston med du gyur cing / mkhas grub bye ba'i bste gnas 'ba' zhig tu gnas mod/ rab byung bcu drug pa'i me rta lor rig gnas gsar brje chen po zhes ming du btags pa'i zing 'tshub nang bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu dam pa rnams bgrongs shing dgon sde phal cher bcoms te rgyal bstan rin po che zang med du brlag zin pa na/ krung mu tshang 'dzoms gros tshogs thengs gsum pa 'tshogs tshun la gangs ri'i ljongs su rgyal bstan slar yang dar ba'i mgo brtsams/ kun gzigs thams cad mkhyen pa blo bzang 'phrin las lhun grub chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos bstan pa yang dar yin par lung gnang ba'i skal bzang 'di la yul 'di'i ser skya dad ldan mang tshogs rnams sangs rgyas kyi chos la bcos min sems kyi dad 'dun shugs drag byed pa gzhir byas thog ngag rgyun ltar na yab rje gser khang pa'i mchod rten bzhugs skabs yul 'dir char chu dus su 'bab pa lo phyugs rtag tu legs shing nad yams mu ge med pa sogs bkra shis dge mtshan gyis khyab pas na/ gser khang mchod rten de slar yang bzhengs pa'i re 538

'dun yul mi mang che bar yod pa dang / khyad par du spyi lo1984lo nas bzung gnas 'dir lo re'i ston dgun gyi mtshams su byugs zog sems can khri phrag mang po dmar gsod byed pa'i bshas ra chen mo 'jigs shing skyi g.ya' ba'i sdig las bsags pa mthong bas lta ci thos pas kyang sems kyis mi tshugs pa zhig tu snang / de'i phyir/ kho bos kyang bcos min sems kyis skyabs gsum la gdung shugs drag pos thugs rten chos sku'i mchod rten bzhengs 'dod tshad med skyes shing / rten de'ang 7kun gzigs paṇa chen sku phreng bcu ba mchog gi rjes dran mchod sdong dang gcig chog byed par gsum ldan rdo rje 'ardzan 'dzin pa dge slong 'jam dbyangs thogs med/ blo bzang bzod pa rnam gnyis dang / ngal gso'i gnang ba thob pa'i dad ldan rgan po 'ba' ban de dang yo'u rgya'i ri sto/ mgar rtse'i dkon 'phrin sogs rgan po re zung ngang na gzhon pa du mar gros byas te rab byung bcu bdun pa'i skye bdag zhes pa lcags lug lor/ rdzong srid gros kyis tshogs 'du 'tshogs skabs gser khang mchod rten bskyar bzhengs byed par gros mthun byung ba de khul u dang dzong u la snyan zhur phul mod/ tang srid las khungs rim pas lo der chog mchan ma byung pas lo gnyis la bshol 'gyangs thebs/ phyis kho bo pe cin du bod brgyud nang bstan slob gling du sdod skabs mkhas dbang dung dkar blo bzang 'azin las dang / bse tshang blo bzang dpal ldan rnam gnyis la mchod rten bzhengs 'dod kyi 'char gzhi dang mchod rten bde legs su — 'thub pa'i skyabs 'jug zhus/ 7mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyi yon tan zla dang bral ba la mo'i yongs 'dzin rin po che blo bzang mkhas grub rgya mtsho mchog la gnas tshul zhus par khong thugs ha cang dgyes bzhin mchod rten rnam pa 53gyi

brgyad kyi nang da res bdud 'dul mchod rten nam byang chub chen po'i mchod rten bzhengs na legs tshul gyi bka' lung gnang pa ltar/ rab byung bcu bdun pa'i chu bya lo'i sprel zla'i tshes bcu la lha bsang rgyag brngan btang zhing lto 'phye'i thig 'debs par brtsams pa na/ char sprin chu 'dzin 'khrigs pa'i ba gam nas snyan pa'i 'brug sgra sgrog cing kha char pazo'i ze'u 'bru dal bur babs pa sogs dge mtshan phun tshogs pa'i ltas rang 'grig tu song pas kun la dga' spro 'phel/ /spyir mchod rten ni chos sku'i mchod rten yin la/ de la yang gdugagachos 'khor dang mi ldan pa so skyes mchod rten/ bden bzhi dag pa'i chos 'khor rim pa bzhi dang ldan pa nyan thos kyi mchod rten/ rten 'brel yan lag bcu gnyis rnam par dag pa'i chos 'khor rim pa bcu gnyis dang ldan pa rang rgyal gyi mchod rten/ chos 'khor rim pa bcu gnyis dang ldan pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod rten no/ /de la dbyibs kyi sgo nas dbye na/ lhung bzed kha spu lta bu/ khang bu brtsegs pa lta bu/ rgyal mtshan ltar grags pa'o zhes gsungs la da lta yongs su grags pa'i bde gshegs mchod rten brgyad kyang rgyal mtshan bsgrings pa lta bu'i mchod rten yin par bshad do/ /las kyi mtha' brjod pa'i mdo las/ sprul ba'i mdzad pa sngon bstan phyir/ /mchod rten brgyad du sku gdung bzhag/ ces gsungs pa ltar/ bdag cag gi ston pa bcom ldan 'das kyi ma 'dris pa'i mdza' bshes chen pos mdzad pa khyad par can mtha' yas pa bstan pa las gtso bor gyur pa rnams bstan pa'i gnas rnams su so so'i skye bo rnams kyis mchod rten brtsigs te dus ston gyi srol btsugs/ yul khag so so ba ste bod dang / bal bo/ 'bar ma/5 0

the lan sogs nang bstan dar ba'i yul so so na rang rang gi thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos can gyi dbyibs dang tshad nges pa med pa'i mchod rten mang du bzhengs pa mthong mod/ ston pa'i mdzad pa gtso che ba rnams la brten nas yul 'khor chen po de dang de'i rgyal bo la sogs pa'i skye 'gro rnams kyi bsod nams kyi zhing ru baspun pa rnams las dpal mgon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis yongs grags dang mthun par bde gshegs ra chod rten brgyad kyi rnam bzhag mdzad pa ltar grong khyer ser skyar bcom ldan 'das sku bltams ma thag phyogs bzhir gom pa bdun bor ba las pad+ma skyes pa sogs mtshon bya rgyu mtshan du byas nas yab rgyal bo sras gtsang sogs kyis bzhengs pa dbyibs thum po pad+ma'i rnam pa can la pad spungs mchod rten/ sa ga zla ba'i nya la mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa'i dus rgyal bo gzugs can snying po sogs kyis bzhengs pa dbyibs gru bzhi ba byang chub mchod rten nam bdud 'dul mchod rten/sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis bden bzhis chos 'khor bskor ba'i tshe 'khor lnga sde bzang pos bzhengs pa dbyibs gru bzhi sgo brgya rtsa brgyad pa ('di la bzhed tshul mang )bkra shis sgo mang ngam chos 'khor mchod rten/ gnas mnyan yod du/ bcom ldan 'das kyis mu stegs ston pa drug sogs cho 'phrul gyis tshar bcad skabs li tsa byi sogs kyis dze ta'i tshal du bzhengs pa dbyibs thu bzhi phyogs bzhir glo 'bur can la cho 'phrul chen po'i mchod rten/yangs pa can gsal ldan du byung ba ston pa sum rtsen du dbyar gnas mdzad de yum bden pa la bkod cing snga dro dgag dbye mdzad/ phyi dro dzam bu sgrung du babs pa la brten nas bzhengs pa/ dbyibs gru bzhi bang rim bzhi'am brgyad pa ngos rer glo 'bur can gzhan du 'byon pa mtshon byed them skas dang 5 1

ldan pa lha babs mchod rten rgyal bo'i khab tu lhas byin gyis dge 'dun gyi dbyen byas pa mchog zung gis 'dum pa la brten nas rgyal byed la sogs pa'i ma ga rta ba rnams kyis bzhengs pa dbyibs bang rim bzhi ba gru bzhi'i grwa bzhi bo mnyam par bcad pa lta bu dbyen bzum mchod rten/ yangs pa can du sku tshe'i 'du byed zla ba gsum du byin gyis brlabs pa'i tshe yangs pa can gyi grong khyer ba rnams kyis bzhengs pa'i dbyibs zum po bang rim gsum can sku tshe byin gyis brlabs pa'am rnam par rgyal ba'i mchod rten/ grong khyer rtswa can du mya ngan las 'das pa'i tshe rtswa can gyi rgyad rnams kyis bzhengs pa 'khor ba'i 'jigs pa dang bral zhing spros pa med pa mtshon byed bang rim med par gdan khri'i steng du bum stan yan chad bzhugs pa myang 'das mchod rten rnams byung ba yin no/ /der ma zad sngon te ru gas drag po 'dul ba'i tshe dur khrod brgyad du/ kyi rdor lha mo brgyad kyi rten nam dngos grub 'byung pa'i mchod rten re re byung ste/ ma gartar bde byed/ sargo lar ri bo ta la/ bal bor bya rung kha shor/ seng ga gling du ge'u don/ li yul du go ma sa la gan na/ kha cher ka na ga u rgyan du dharma tsakra hor du bde spyod gzhon nu'i mchod rten rnams so/ /spyir mchod rten gyi tshad dbyibs nges pa med de mdo sde rnams las sangs rgyas kyi rang bsrel bzhugs pa'i mchod rten dpag tshad kyi rgya khyon—gsungs pa dang / yang mchod rten ni sgyu ru ra'i 'bru tsam/ gdugs ni rgya shug gi lo ma tsam/ srog shing ni khab tsam zhes khang bu brtsegs pa'i mdo las bshad pas rang rang gi sems kyi stobs dang 'byor ba'i khyad par la dpag go/'on kyang bzo nyes 'gog slad du cha tshad kyi lag len gal che bas/ 7gser 542

khang mchod sdong rdo rje lhun po 'di ni sngon gyi mkhas dbang tshad ldan rnams kyi phyag srol la gtugs te bzhengs pa yin/ thengs 'dir bzhengs pa'i gser khang mchod rten 'di la mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyi gzi dpal gangs seng dkar mo mkha' la srab med du 'phyo bas dregs ldan glang bo kun gyi nga rgyal gyi bag 'khum par byed pa'i dam pa rin po che shar gdong blo bzang bshad sgrub rgya mtsho mchog gis gser khang mchod sdong rdo rje lhun po zhes mtshan btags gnang zhing rgyal yongs nang bstan lhan tshogs kyi tshogs gtso rgya nag gi nang ba'i mkhas pa chen po kro phu'u khru'u yis rgya yig tu bsgyur te dngos su phyag bris su gnang pa'i mtshan byang thob pa'o/ /gzhan yang rgyal yongs srid gros kyi kru'u zhi gzhon pa nga phod ngag dbang 'jigs med nas kyang phyag bris dngos su gnang / mchod rten 'di thog mar bzhengs dus mchod rten gyi zhabs ngos kyi rgya khyon dang mnyam pa'i 'og gi sa spyi khri gnyis kyi mtho tshad gting du brus te sngar bshad zin pa bzhin sa bdag lto 'phye'i thig gdab pa'i steng du nged rang nas sgrub dpon gyi khur bzung ste rig sngags 'dzin pa'i sngags 'chang 'od le tshang dang / gsum ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa dge slong thogs med dang 'jam dbyangs chos 'dzin sogs ban sngags du mas phur ba rdo je gzhon nu'i sgo nas dam pa gong ma'i phyag bzhes ma nyams par dam sri mnan zhing sa 'dul bgyis/de'i steng du mchod rten gyi sa 'dzin gyi khyon dang mnyam pa'i nang du ma ṇi 'bum phrag rtsa lnga dang / ma ru tse 'bum bzhi bcu rtsa lnga/ gu ru sirnyi 'bum sum bcu rtsa drug tā re 'bum phrag bzhi/ ga te 'bum gcig rta mgrin 'bum gcig sogs bzlas te bsngags pa'i rte'u 'bum brgya dang bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis kyis 'bum khang chen po'i steng du seng ge brgyad kyis btegs pa'i khri'i 5 3

nang dbus su phongs sel sgrol ma dang / yo rgyan nor lha/ sa bcud bum sgrub/ 'dzam ser gter sgrub sogs gser lag phun tshogs bstan rgyas gling dang / bde chen dgon bshad sgrub dar rgyas gling / shing khri dgon yo rgyan gsang sngags gling gsum gyi dge 'dun phyed dang bzhi brgya'i grangs kyis nyin du mar tshad ldan sgrub pa'i gter dzas su rin po che gser dang / dngul dang / mu men/ mu tig dang / g.yu dang / byu ru dang / ma rgad dang /pad+ma ra ga mchong dang / gzi sogs rin po che dang gna' jos sna tshogs/rgya gar nag dang li yul bal yul/ rang re'i bod yul gyi gnas ri dang dgon sde grags can rnams kyi sa sna chu sna/ gter rdo/ me tog rtsi shing /sman rdzas/ shing tog 'bru sna/ 'bras bu lo ma sogs grangs kyis mi lang ba'i gter gyis seng khri byur bur gtams so/ /khri'i dge bcu nas bum gdan bar gyi khongs 'bum khang du byas pa'i nang du yo rgyan snang srid zil gnon gyi sku grangs stong phrag gcig dang chig brgya bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis/ rdo rje sems dpa'i sku grangs drug bcu rtsa drug gsang bdag 'khor chen gyi sku grangs chig stong lnga brgya/ rgyal ba mi 'khrugs pa'i sku stong phrag chig brgya nyi shu rtsa bzhi/ dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku grangs lnga brgya/ rigs gsum mgon po'i sku grangs sum stong sum brgya/ 'jam dbyangs smra seng gi sku nyis stong lnga brgya nga gsum/ tshe lha rnam gsu gyi sku sum stong nyis brgya nyer drugagasang bdag gi sku stong phrag nyi shu dang nyis brgya zhe dgu sgrol ma'i sku grangs 'bum phrag so bzhi dang stong phrag re gsum bcas bsdoms pas sku 'bum phrag so bdun dang stong phrag gcig lhag tsam bzhugs/ /bum gzungs su bzhugs pa'i nang rten gyi rim pa ni/ gzungs 'bum 5

shel dkar me lung ltar mchod sdong gi dbus ma nor bar srog shing brtan por btsugs/ de la 'khril ba'i tshul gyis rin po che tog nas bzung nyi zla thugs rje'i mdo gzungs chos 'khor bcu gsum/ bre bre gdan/ bum pa'i stod smad bar gsum bang rim rnams dang / seng khri'i stod smad bar gsum la 'bul 'os kyi byin rten rnams/ dbu gzungs/ mgrin gzungs/ stod gzungs/ bar gzungs/ smad gzungs/ pad gzungs/ sku gzungs dang glegs bam/ 'khor lo dang gter 'bum sogs gong smras ltar so so'i go rim dang / dbu zhabs ma nor bar khrid sgon phyag len sogs ma nyams par legs par brgyan te phul ba 'di ltar/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos sku'i ring bsrel/ gtsang bkra shis lhun po dang / sku 'bum byams pa gling /bla brang bkra shis 'khyil/ rwa rgya bkra shis 'byung gnas/ khams sde dge bcas kyi gzungs gzhugs rgyas pa tshar brgya phrag re dang / 'phags yul rda ram sa la'i gzungs gzhugs bskyar par rgyas pa tshar brgya zag 'ga' re bzhugs/ gzhan yang / gzungs chen sde lnga/ rigs gsum mgon po/gu ru sirnyi/ tā re/ rje tsong kha pa chen po dang gong sa skyabs mgon chen po'i mtshan sngags/ tshe lha rnam gsum/ bde gsang 'jigs gsum/ seng gdong gi sngags/ rig byed ma'i sngags/ yig brgya/ mar tse/ drag po sum sgril/ 'khrugs sel sogs grangs brgya phrag du ma bzhugs/ gzhan mdo rgyud bstan bcos kyi skor la/ rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur rin po che tshar gsum pod sum rgya bcu med dgu bstan 'argyur tshar gcig pod nyis brgya nyi shu rtsa bdun/ rje bdag nyid chen po'i bka' 'bum pod bcu dgu rgyal tshab rin po che'i gsung 'bum po ti brgyad/ mkhas grub thams cad mkhyen 5 5

pa'i gsung 'bum po ti bcu drug snga 'gyur rnying ma'i rgyud 'bum po ti nyer drug ting 'phags skal gsum tshar bcu re/ lam sngags gnyis tshar bco lnga re/ bka' thang shel brag ma tshar bcu gsum/ bka' thang sde lnga tshar gsum/ thar mdo tshar bcu/ spyod 'jug chen mo'i 'grel ba tshar gcigartsa ba tshar gsum/ 'bum tshar gsum/ nyi khri tshar gcig ma ṇi bka' 'bum tshar gsum/ legs bshad gser phreng tshar gcig kar gling zhi khro tshar gcig snying thig dum gnyis pod gnyis/ khyon bsdoms sa dge rnying gsum gyi bka' pod bdun brgya lhag bzhugs/ yungs 'bru lta bu'i ring bsrel la/ sangs rgyas 'od srungs kyi 'phel gdung sran tshad tsam gsum/bde bar gshegs pa'i 'phel gdung dang rje gong ma na rim dang skyes chen dam pa du ma'i byin rten sna mang 'dus pa'i thog gong sa skyabs mgon mchog nas nan tan bsgrubs pa'i rten 'dus ril bu/ theg chen chos gling gtsug lag khang du7gong sa skyabs mgon chen po dbu bzhugs kyi ma ṇi dung sgrub ril bu/nges pa don gyi pani ta chen po gter ston bdud 'joms gling pa'i bdud rtsi sman sgrub ril bu/ gu ru mtsho skyes rdo rje'i dbu skra dang snga 'gyur rnying brgyud kyi bdud rtsi 'khrul bral ril bu/ bla brang bkra shis 'khyil gyi dge 'dun pa mang pos bgrangs pa'i ma ṇi ril bu/ rgyal sa pe cin gyi dga' ldan byin chags gling gi byams chen gyi zhal rtsi'i ril bu/ bya khyung gser sdong gi bdud rtsi'i ril bu/ rje bdag nyid chen po'i tshems par ril bu/ spyi nor gong thams cad mkhyen pas phur ba yang snyeng spu gri'i sgo nas smin sgrub sbyang pa'i bdud rtsi chos sman dang 'phagasabod skyes chen du ma'i byin mas phab ldan/rgya gar gnas chen mang po'i rten sna byin can/ thi sirta mchog gi rig 'dzin 546

brgyad pa pad+ma ka ra rje 'bangs nyer lnga sogs kyi bdud rtsi chos sman la gzhir byas sman sgrub phyogs bsdus/ theg chen chos gling nas brgyud pa'i ma ṇi ril bu byin ldan/ jo bo rje'i sku sha/ kun mkhyen klong chen rab 'byams kyi dbu thod dang / 'jigs med gling ba'i sku sha las thub pa'i sman sgrub ril bu/bdag gi rtsa ba'i bla ma 'jam dbyangs dge legs rgya mtsho mchog gi bdud rtsi chos sman byin ldan/ nan nye ro po tā la'i 'phel gdung / paṇa chen sku phreng bcu ba chen po'i gdung tshwa'i ril bu thums chen bcas bzhugs so/ /sku bal gyi rang bsrel ni sku brnyan sogs su gsungs pa ste/ bris 'bur gyi sku — gzugs 'di dag sangs rgyas kyi sku dngos kyi dod lta bur sprul ba'i ring bsrel du bzhag pa la/ sku brnyan gyi skor la/ 7skyabs mgon pa chen sku phreng bcu ba'i gdung tshwa las grub pa'i dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sku che ba gsum/chung ba gcig 'jam dbyangs kyi sku chung ba gnyis/ paṇa chen sku phreng drug pa dpal ldan ye shes mchog gis bzhengs pa'i pe cin nub phyogs lha khang ser bo'i rdo ye shes kyi khang brtsegs mchod rten gyi gzungs 'jug tu bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas tshe dpag med kyi sku byin can zhig (paṇa chen sku phreng bcu bas mchod rten der zhig gso mdzad skab4gnang )bzhugs/ paṇa chen sku phreng bcu ba'i phyag tshwa'i ston pa lnga dang che shos paṇ+ḍi ta'i phyag tshwa'i sku bcu gsum bcas bzhugs/ gzhan yang khams bla shes rab rgyal mtshan gyis gnang ba'i li ma'i ston pa spus legs gcig skyabs mgon paṇa chen bcu ba'i sbu gdung gi mnabs bza' sku'i dri bzang ma yal ba byin rlabs kyi tsha rlangs rab tu 'bar ba'i gos ser bo 'khor lo ma leb chen gcig g.yu 'brug kha sprod ris kyis mdzes shing nang mdzod nyin bde ma'i kha btags shin tu ring po 547

gcig tsong kha pa chen mo'i dbu zha'i tshal bu/ rje dge 'dun grub kyi zhabs chags kyi tshal bu/ gu ru mtsho skyes rdo rje'i zhabs chags kyi tshal bu/ya rig dge bshes chen mo'i dbu sku/ ra lo tsā pa'i na bza'/ rgyal dbang bdun pa dang lnga ba gnyis kyi na bza'i tshal bu re/ rgya gar shar lho bsil ba tshal gyi dur khrod kyi shing tsan dan rkang gcig gi dum bu bcas bzhugs so/ /steng gi bum pa'i nang du rigs ldan drag po 'khor lo can gyi sman sku chen po paṇa chen sku phreng bcu ba'i sku tshad dang mnyam pa zhig bzhugs shing /mdun gyi mchod khang du bod gangs can gyi me tog phog pa'i lha skal 'phags mchog phyag na pad+mo'i rnam rol gong sa rgyal dbang chen po dang / g.yas su gu ru snang srid zil gnon/ sangs rgyas gser thub/ na ro mkha' spyod ma/yi dam pad+ma dbang chen/ gtso sku'i g.yon du rje bdag nyid chen po/sangs rgyas 'od dpag med/ rje btsun sgrol ma/ yi dam rdo rje 'jigs byed/ 'gram gnyis su g.yas mgon po phyag drug pa dang beg tse/ g.yon du dpal ldan dmag zor gyi rgyal mo dang ge sar nor bu dgra 'dul bcas bzhugs/ lha khang gi ldebs ngos su sman bla bde gshegs brgyad/ rgyan drug mchog gnyis/ gnas brtan bcu drug sgrol ma nyer gcig stung bshags kyi lha so lnga/ rgyal ba 'od dpag med/ mi 'khrugs pa/ rnam par snang mdzad bcas kyi ldeb ris kyi thang ka bzhugs/ bum nang dang mchod khang gi steng ngos su grong khyer grol ba'i thang ka gnyis dang / mchod khang gi g.yas g.yon rgyab gsum du ma ṇi dung phyur bcu bdun dang bye chen brgyad/ thar mdo stong tshar lhag gi 'khor lo gsum bcas cha yongs su mnyam pa brgyad bcu rtsa dgu'i 'phreng bas bskor ba'o/ /548

mchod rten kyi pad gzungs sogs khyad chos rnams kyi mtshon don sgob dpon shī gasta'i gsung kong sprul yon tan rgya mtshos thun mong rig gnas rnam gzhag tu gsungs pa las/ pad gzungs rjes su dran pa drug/ pad chen dge bcu rmang tshad med/ /yang na de gnyis ldog pa'ang bshad/ /bang rim bzhi bo rim pa bzhin/ /dran pa nyer bzhag yang dag spong / /rdzu 'phrul rkang bzhi dbang po lnga/ /bum rten stobs lnga bum pa ni/ /byang chub yan lag bre 'phags lam/ /sgyu yi chos rnams rnam par dag/ srog shing kun job pha rol sems/ /rjes dran bden bzhi zad mi skye/ /shes pa bcu yi ngo bo dang / /pad+ma thabs dang shes rab ste/ /'khor lo stobs bcu dran nyer gsum/ /char khebs thugs rje tog chos sku/ /mchod rten nyid kyi ngo bor bshad/ /rgyan rnams rgyal ba'i yon tan te/ /rdo ring mi 'jigs bzhi dang ldan/ /them mas srung ba med pa bzhi/ /rgyal mtshan bdud bzhi'i g.yul las rgyal/ /me tog phreng ba mtshan dpe 'bar/ /rgyal mtshan bzhi ni bden bzhi'i don/ /dril bu tshangs dbyangs drug bcu'i gsung / /nyi zla ye shes snang pa bskyed/ /me long ye shes bzhi dang ldan/ /cod pan chos kyi rgyal srid thob/ /ba dan chos kyi snyan pa'i khyab/ /'bras bu'i chos rnams dag pa'o/ /sgo mang bden bzhi rnam thar brgyad/ /rten 'brel stong nyid bcu drug go/ glo 'bur khyad du 'phags pa yis/ /rnam par 'phrul ba'i 'gro don mdzad/ /them skas sangs rgyas gzhan don byon/ /pad+ma 'khor ba'i skyon ma gos/ /bang rim med pa srid pa yi/ /'jug pa bral zhing spros pa med/ /dbyen skum de rgyu dug gsum dang / /lto bcad rnam thar brgyad mtshon no/ /zhes drangs pa bzhin te/ gser khang mchod sdong rdo rje lhun po zhes gsol ba'i byang chub mchod rten 'di la'ang gong 5 9

gsal de dag las mtshon byed gang ldan zhing mtshon bya gang mtshon pa go bar gyis shig de lta bu'i mchod sdong rten dang brten par bcas pa dngos po zhes pa shing pho khyi lo ste spyi lo 1994lo'i zla 9tshes 22nyin lha babs dus chen la lhar bcas bsod nams kyi zhing bla na ma mchis pa gcig pur grub pa dang chabs gcig tu/ bka' pod gzhung brgya'i nor bu'i do shal mgrin rgyan du 'chang ba sbra ba'i dbang phyug chen po la mo yongs 'dzin blo bzang mkhas grub rgya mtsho mchog zhus te rab gnas rgya cher byas shing rten so so'i dam tshig pa la ye shes pa dngos su bstems te shis pa brjod pa'i me tog gi char chen po 'a bas par mdzad do/ /gzhan yang mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyi yon tan 'gran zla dang bral ba'i skyabs rje g.yer skyong chos pa rin po che mchog gis kyang rab gnas mdzad cing bsngags pa brjod pa sogs mang ngo / /spyir rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs kyi rten rnams grub tsam nyid nas lha dang bcas pa'i sems can gyi bsod nams bsags pa'i zhing sa yin pas rab gnas ma byas kyang chog par gsungs mod/ 'on kyang rgyud rdo rje gur las/ rtag tu sangs rgyas rab gnas bya/ /zin pa'i de ma thag pa ru/ /rab tu gnas pa mchog tu —'gyur/ /'khor lo'i bsgyur ba'i rgyal bo yi/ /dbang phyug thob par the tshom med/ /ces rten gsar bzhengs grub pa la rab gnas kyi cho ga legs par byas na yul khams kun tu bkra shis shing / bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa 'apel ba dang / lo phyug legs shing skye rgu thams cad bde zhing skyid pa'i dpal gyis 'tsho ba sogs phan yon dpag tu med pa 'byung par gsungs so/ /tha mar tshogs gnyis dzogs phyir/ bzhengs pa'i phan yon dang phyag mtshal mchod 'bul skor phyag byed pa'i phan yon bshad pa la/ dam chos 550

pad+ma dkar po las/ rgyal ba'i mchod rten dag la sus mchod cing / /rin chen mchod rten stong phrag du ma dag/gser dang dngul dang 'on te shel gyi'am/rdo yi snying bo'i mchod rten gang gis byas/ /be+eḍūr+ya mchog de bzhin yir+sha— rnyil/ /la las mu tig ke ke ru las byas/ /de dag gis kyang byang chub thob par 'gyur/ /zhes gser dngul sogs rin po che sna bdun gang rung las mchod rten bzhengs pa las bla na med pa'i byang chub 'thob par gsungs/yang de nyid las/ gang gi mchod rten rdo las byas pa dang / /gang gi a ka ru dang tsardo nam/ /gang gis thang shing mchod rten byas pa dang / /la las shing ngam gzhan la sa byas pa dang / /sa dang so phag las ni brtsigs pa yi/ /rgyal ba'i mchod rten dga' bzhin byas pa dang / /de bamin sa rdul phung bo dag las kyang / /mya ngam dgon pa dag tu byas pa dang / /byis pa'i rtsed mor de dang de dag tu/ /gang gis rgyal ba de phyir mchod rten dag/ bye ma las ni phung bo byas pa yang / /de rnams kyis kyang byang chub thob par 'gyur/ /zhes rgyu dman pa sa dang so phag la sogs pa dang / rdo dang / ma ka ru/ tsardon/thang shing dang / tha na byis pas rtsed mo'i ched du bye ma'i phung bo mchod rten lta bur spungs par byas pa4kyang bla na med pa'i byang chub thob par gsungs/las rnam par 'byed pa'i mdo las/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod rten byed pa'i phan yon bco brgyad yod de/ gang zhe na/ rgya chen po'i rigs su skye bar 'gyur ba dang / gzugs bzang bar 'gyur ba dang mdzes shing mig tu sdug par 'gyur ba dang / dbang che zhing grags par 'gyur ba dang /g.yog 'khor rgya chen por 'gyur ba dang g.yog 'khor mi phyed par 'argyur ba dang longs spyod che bar 'gyur ba dang / 'jig rten pa rnams 'khor zhing 551

'du bar 'gyur pa dang kun gyi rten du 'gyur pa dang / phyogs bcur brjod pa dang sgra dang tshigs su bcad pa rgya chen po mngon du 'byung bar 'gyur ba dang lha dang mis mchod par 'gyur ba dang / phyug cing nor mang pa dang ldan par 'gyur pa dang 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal srid 'thob par 'gyur ba dang /lus rdo rje ltar mkhregs par 'gyur pa dang / lus mtshan dang dpe byad ldan par 'gyur ba dang mtho ris su skye bar 'gyur ba dang myur du yongs su mya ngan las 'da' ba ste bco brgyad po de dag ni de ba'in gshegs pa'i mchod rten byed pa'i phan yon no/ /zhes sogs phan yon dpag tu med pa mdo rgyud du ma las gsungs so/ /phyag 'tshal ba'i phan yon ni/ gsal rgyal gyis zhus pa'i mdo las/mi rnams yang dag sangs rgyas mchod rten nam/ /sku gzugs dag la mgo gtugs phyag 'tshal ba/ /de dag lha rnams dang ni mi rnams kyis/ /cher yang che bar bkur ba'i gnas su 'gyur/ /zhes dang / /legs bshad rin po che za ma tog las/ sa bdag 'khor los bsgyur gang la/ /thal mo sbyar ba byas nas ni/ /'khur ba rna rgyan mdzes stung bas/ /gus ldan legs par spyi bo yis/ /lan mang du ni phyag byed pa/ /de dag sangs rgyas phyag byas pa'i/ /'bras bu yin zhes mkhas rnams smra/ / zhes dang / yang de nyid las/'khor lo'i bsgyur rgyal stobs grags ldan/ /yan lag sum cu gnyis mtshan ldan/ /rgyal 'gyur sa steng gtso bo de/ /sangs rgyas la ni phyag byas pa'i/ /'bras bu yin par blo ldan gsungs/ /zhes 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal bo stobs 'phyor dang / snyan par grags pa phun sum tshogs pa dang / /mtshan bzang bo sum bcu rtsa gnyis kyis brgyan pa dang / sa steng na gnas pa'i mi 552

rnam sa kyi gtso bor gyur ba yang sa ngas rgyas la phyag byas pa'i 'bras bur gsungs so/ /mchod pa phul ba'i phan yon ni/ chos thams cad kyi rgyal za'i mdo las/ lha dang bcas pa'i 'dzig rten na/ /dkon mchog gsum po ma gtogs pa/ /yon gyi gnas 'ga' yod min pas/ /dngos bo kun gyis de la mchod/ /ces dang / rje bla mas/ thog mar zhing gi mthu la brten nas ni/ /nang gi bsam pa'i stobs ni skye 'gyur bas/ /dge ba'i bshes dang dkon mchog mchod pa la/ /rgyun mi 'chad pa'i spyor ba bsten tshul lo/ /zhes dang / mdor na/ tshe 'di dang phyi ma'i bde skyid dzi snyed yod pa thams cad dkon mchog mchod pa kho na'i 'bras bu yin te/ sa'i snying bo'i 'khor lo bcu ba'i mdo las/ 'jig rten dag na bde zhing skyid pa/ de kun dkon mchog mchod las 'byung bas/ de bas bde zhing skyid par 'dod pas/dkon mchog mchod la rtag tu brtson bya/ zhes bsngags pa ltar ro/ /mar me 'bul ba ni bde mchog rtsa rgyad las/ gal te dngos grub mchog 'dod na/ /mar me brgya ni 'bul bar bya/ /zhes dang / de'i 'og tu yang / gal te dngos grub mchog 'dod na/ /dri dang me tog de bzhin spos/ /cho ga bzhin du de bzhin mchod/ /mar me brgya yang 'bul bya zhing / /zhes snga phyir mar me brgya 'bul ba'i tshig lan gnyis 'byung ba ni/ mar me'i mchod pa gtso che ba'i don du rje bla mas bde mchog gi rgyud 'grel spas don kun las gsungs/mar me phul na tshe rabs thams cad du dbang bo gsal zhing lus mdzes pa dang / spyan lnga thob par 'gyur ba dang / che gsal myur zab dang /'chad rtsod rtsom gsum dang tho4bsam sgom gsum sogs kyis bsdus pa'i 553

shes rab kyi snang ba khyad par can thob par 'gyur ba dang / gtum mo'i bde drod khyad par can dang de la brten nas dpe dang don gyi 'od gsal sogs thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i lam gyi togs pa khyad par can rgyud la myur du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod rten la phyag dar byas pa'i phan yon bcu yod de/ bcu gang zhen/ gzugs bzang pa dang lta na sdug pa dang mdzes pa dang snyan pa dang / des 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug srab par gyur ba dang / lam du 'gro bar rtswa dang gyo mo dang gseg ma med par 'gyur ba dang btsun pa'i rigs su skye bar 'gyur ba dang longs spyod che bar 'gyur ba dang mtho ris su skye bar 'gyur ba dang myur du yongs su mya ngan las 'da' ba ste/ bcu bo ni phyag dar byas pa'i phan yon no/ /gzhan yang de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod rten la dril bu 'bul ba dang / na bza' 'bul ba dang me tog dbul ba/ bdug spos 'bul ba/ sil snyan 'bul ba sogs kyi phan yon bsam gyis mi khyab kyang yig tshogs la 'jigs nas ma bris so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod rten la rol mo'i bye brag sogs kyis — mchod pa'i phan yon ni/ rin chen phreng ba las/ mchod rten mchod pa'i rol mo dang / /dril bu dag ni phul ba dang / /dung dang ja ni rab phul bas/ /lha yi rna ba thob par 'gyur/ /zhes so/ /snyan shal phul ba'i phan yon ni/spyan ras gzigs kyi mdo las/ 'jig rten mgon po skyob pa la/ /dar gyi 'bul ba phul byas na/ /lha yi dag dang mi rnams kyi/ /don rnams thams cad 'grub par 'gyur/ /zhes dang / ma la phul ba'i phan yon ni/ za ma tog lta bu'i gtam las/ maṇ+ḍal me tog bcas byed pa/ /'gro ba'i bdag po tshe 55

ring zhing / /sna tshogs nad kyi 'jigs las sgrol/ /gang yin de yis skad cig 'thob/ /ces gsungs pa ltar ma ṇ+ḍal phul bas phar phyin drug yongs su dzogs par 'gyur ba dang / tshe ring zhing nad kyi 'jigs pa las thar bar gsungs/khrus gsol phul ba'i phan yon ni/ gsal rgyal gyi mdo las/ mi rnams gang dag thub dbang mchod rten la/ /spos chu dwangs shing gtsang pas khrus gsol ba/ de dag lus la dri ma med pa dang / /gdung ba med cing mdog 'jam mya ngan med/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ rang cag rtsod ldan gyi mi rnams thon mongs pa rags la dkor sgrib dang las sgrib kyis g.yogs pa'i dbang gis rgyun du nyams len re byed khul byas kyang dmigs rnams mi gsal zhing rtogs pa rgyud la mi skye bar shes rgyud bying thugs sogs rnyog pa'i dbang du gyur ba sel ba'i ched du sku gsung thugs rten la khrus yang dang yang du phul na legs par gsungs so/ /mdor na mchod pa gang dang gang phul yang phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad la mchod pa byas par 'gyur ba dang / mchod yul thams cad kyi spyan sngar mchod pa'i yo byad mtha' yas pa'i char 'bab pa dang / sdig stung 'dag cing dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad dang ldan pa dang /rgyun du sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad mthong zhing /dedabugs dbyung par 'gyur pa dang / lha klu gnod sbyin rgyal bo chen po sde bzhi sogs kyis rtag tu srung skyob byed pa dang / shi nas bde ba can gyi ging du skye ba sogs phan yon dpag tu med pa mchod pa'i sprin zhes bya ba'i gzungs las gsungs so/ /skor ba byas pa'i phan yon ni/ mdo sde rgyan gyi rgya 'grel las phyag 'tshal ba dang skor ba byed pa la sogs ni bkur ste'i mchod pa'o/ /zhes—555

gsungs pa ltar/ yul khyad par can la gtso bo lus kyi sgo nas bkur ste byed pa yin la/ spyir dge ba gang byed kyang thog mar kun slong bcas pa gal che/ma gyur sems can thams cad kyi don du dzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin po che myur du 'thob na ci ma rung / de'i phyir rten khyad par can 'di la skor phyag mchod 'bul sogs rnam dkar gyi las khyad par can 'di la 'jug par bya'o snyam pa bsam dgos so/ /mchod rten skor ba'i mdo las/ lus kyi las kyang skor ba yin/ /yid kyi las kyang skor ba yin/ /smon lam btab pa'ang skor ba yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ las kyi spyod lam/ ngag gi bzlas brjod/ lus kyi dad gus gsum tshogs pa'i sgo nas skor ba byas na las ngag yid gsum gyi dge spyor tshang pas don shin tu che/ yang 'du byas kyi dge rtsa la skor ba las bsod nams che ba med/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi las gsum gas bskor ba yin/ sngon rgya gar tu grong khyer dang gtsug lag khang dang / kha saza ṇi'i lha khang la sogs la bskor ba byas pas dngos grub thob pa dang / rkang 'bam gyi nad sogs sos pa'i lo rgyus mang po yod do/ /der ma zad mdo las/ mchod rten bskor ba byas pa yis/ /'dzam bu gling gi mnga' bdag rje/ /sa steng thams cad dbang byed pa'i/ /chos dang ldan pa'i rgyal por 'gyur/ /mchod rten bskor ba byas pa yis/ /'di nas 'phos nas mtho ris 'gro/ /sangs rgyas bstan la dga' ba dang / /rnal 'byor ldan zhing rdzu 'phrul che/ /zhes sogs mang ngo / /mdor na dkon mchog gsum la dad pa'i sems kyis mchod pa dang phyag 'tshal ba dang / bskor ba byas pa'i bsod nams ni nam mkha' bzhin du mtha' med pa yin te/ dpung bzang gis zhus pa'i rgyud las/ dper na nam mkha' mthar thug med pa la/ /556

'dom gyis gzhal bas ma 'a togs mi nus ltar/ /de ltar dkon mchog gsum la brten nas ni/ /phan dang gnod pa byas pa'i mtha' mi rtogs/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /skor ba'i tshad ji tsam du bya ba mtha' gcig tu ma nges kyang / 'on kyang dam pa gong ma'i phyag bzhes ltar skyabs 'gro dang yig brgya sogs 'bum phrag gcig bza bar gsungs ba la rigs 'gre sbyar te bkod pa 'dir chos 'khor rnams bskor bzhin skor ba stong phrag lnga bskor la skor tshad du 'thad do/ /'di ltar snying thag pa nas mchog gsum kun 'dus kyi bdag nyid skyabs gnas gcig chog gi rtsa ba'i bla ma7yab rje thams cad mkhyen cing gzigs pa chen po paṇa chen rin po che mchog gi gzugs sku'i cha shas dam par gyur ba'i gser khang mchod sdong rdo rje lhun po 'di la phyag skor byed pa dang mchod pa 'bul ba rje de nyid kyi sku gsung zugs yon tan dran pa'i dad pa dang / bka' drin dran pa'i gus pa zung 'brel gyi sgo nas rnal 'byor dang 'brel bar sku sgom pa sngags bzla ba dang gsol ba 'debs pa sogs rtse gcig tu 'bad na gong du ji skad gsungs pa'i phan yon rnams kyang bde blag tu 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /de ltar sku gsung thugs rten bzhengs pa dang / mchod pa 'bul ba dang phyag 'tshal ba dang skor ba byed pa sogs kyi phan yon rgya cher gsungs/ ting nge 'dzin rgyal bo las/ zla ba skar ma bcas pa gnas lhung zhing / /ri dang grong dang bcas pa'i sa gzhi la/ /nam mkha'i khams ni rnam pa gzhan gyur kyang / /khyod ni mi bden pa yi tshig mi gsungs/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ des na skye bo dag legs su 'dod pa rnams kyis sangs rgyas kyi gsung la yid ches bskyed de rnam par dkar ba'i bsod nam rlabs po che gsog pa'i tshul 'di la brtson par bya'o/ /der ma 5 1

zad thog mtha' bar gsum du dge ba sgrub po dang sgrub bya'i dge ba/ ji ltar bsgrub tshul sogs 'khor gsum bden med sgyu ma lta bu'i ngang la lta bas rgyas gdab par byas te mthar dge rtsa thams chad tshe 'de'i rkyen bzlog gam lha mi'i phun tshogs thob ched du mi bsngo bar nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du bla med rdzogs byang thob par dmigs te bsngos na dge rtsa rnams rang byang chub ma zob bar du zad par mi 'gyur te/ spyod 'jug las/ dge ba gzhan kun chu shing bzhin du ni/ /'bras bu bskyed nas zad par 'gyur ba nyid/ /byang chub sems kyi ljon shing rtag par yang / /'bras bu 'byin pas mi zad 'phel bar 'gyur/ /zhes dang / slob dpon dpa' bos/ rgya mtsho chen por chu thigs gcig bor ba/ /rgya mtsho ma zad bar tu zad mi 'gyur/ /de bzhin byang chub mchog tu bsngos pa yi/ /bsod nams rnam pa zad par 'gyur ba med/ /ces gsungs pa ltar ro/ /'dir spus pa/ /srid na zla bral chos sku'i mchod sdobache/ /lhag bsam dag pa'i nyer bsan bsod nams mthus/ /kun gzigs snang mtha'i sgyu 'phrul zlos gar rgyas/ /bzhed pa'i thugs smon ji bzhin lhun 'grub shog/'brel thogs rnams kyang dge 'di'i bsod nams kyis/ /ma 'ongs sku phreng rim brgyud dus kun tu/ /dal rten yid bzhin nor la chos spyod bcu'i/ /'dod pa'i re ba skong ba'i dpal 'thob shog/ kho bo'ang tshe rabs phreng—brgyud du/ /gru mdzin mgon 'dis dgyes bzhin rjes bzung ste/ /zab rgyas lam gyis ma nor rgyud sbyangs nas/ /gtan bde'i go 'phang rgyal sa mchog thob shog/ces gser khang rdo rje lhun po'i mchod sdong dkar chag mthong ba don 558

ldan zhes bya ba 'di la rtsom skyon dang go rim 'khrug pa sogs nongs pa mang mod/ 'on kyang / mched grogs rnams kyis bdag la 'bri bar bskul ba ma sdog par 'thab bral skye ming 'dzin pas spyi lo 1995lo'i zla 5ba'i tshes 5la kun gyi spyan lam du phul ba 'di ga'o/ /dge 'dis kyang gru 'dzin mgon gyi bzhed rgu yongs su 'thub pa'i rgyur gyur cig/ bkra shis/ dge'o/ /mgo li/ / / /553
mjug byangakabheX ༅ / // / /// /560
bhebhe / / / de / / / / / / t+t+waṃ bhe ///zhes rtsom pa po nas spyi lo 2001lo'i zla 10tshes 5la/561

rtsom sgrig 'gan 'khur pa/ sgrol ma skyabs/ ca ma par zhus 'gan khur pa/ skra bzang /ma po ma po mdzis 'god khan/ kro'u grung sa ཿ zadagon gong ma'i lo rgyus 'pho 'gyur dang yul srol/ / lhamachogacul gyis ba mas/ mi rlopa/ snyepe pasnga ngashā sna snarwa zhing 'a/shāsda tsho shās/hūṃ t+t+waṃ sgru ༷ ༷ dhi ༷ t+t+waṃ bye// ༷sgrigs/
